segments.illustrated_scene:
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a quarry's heap of sand
    SUBSTANCE: sand and gravel
    CAUSE: Data digs with a shovel and throws sand onto the heap, which grows with each throw
    One heap of sand and gravel, the year's take. It starts below 1970's
    size, and every shovelful Data throws lands on its slope and swells it,
    three throws per year, until it reaches that year's tonnage. The heap's
    AREA scales with the tonnes. A dashed ghost of the 1970 heap stays at
    its foot, so the five-fold growth can be read against it."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    n = len(rows)
    vmax = max(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    SAND = (226, 192, 128)
    SAND_SH = (170, 128, 74)
    SAND_LIT = (246, 220, 166)
    GRAVEL = (132, 126, 118)
    gy = 1460
    cx = 620
    THROWS = 3

    def dims(v):
        s = math.sqrt(max(v, 0.0) / vmax)
        return 440 * s, 600 * s

    def heap_path(hw, h):
        cr.move_to(cx - hw, gy)
        cr.curve_to(cx - hw * 0.55, gy - h * 0.30, cx - hw * 0.22, gy - h,
                    cx, gy - h)
        cr.curve_to(cx + hw * 0.22, gy - h, cx + hw * 0.55, gy - h * 0.30,
                    cx + hw, gy)
        cr.close_path()

    # --- the quarry: sky, far pit walls under haze, sandy floor ---
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (168, 200, 228)), (1.0, (232, 214, 186))], 0, 1100)
    cr.move_to(0, 1080)
    for i in range(9):
        x = i * 135
        cr.line_to(x + 40, 900 + 40 * ((i * 37) % 3))
        cr.line_to(x + 135, 960 + 30 * ((i * 53) % 2))
    cr.line_to(W, 1120)
    cr.line_to(0, 1120)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (196, 158, 110), rim=False)
    for j in range(3):                                 # benches cut in the pit wall
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 112, 72), 0.6))
        cr.set_line_width(5)
        cr.move_to(0, 990 + j * 40)
        cr.line_to(W, 1000 + j * 40)
        cr.stroke()
    haze(cr, 860, 1120, (232, 214, 186), a=0.45)
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (214, 182, 130)), (1.0, (184, 148, 98))], 1100, H)
    for i in range(14):                                # tyre ruts in the floor
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((160, 124, 80), 0.5))
        cr.set_line_width(6)
        y = 1500 + (i * 41) % 380
        cr.move_to(-20, y)
        cr.curve_to(300, y - 20, 700, y + 20, W + 20, y - 10)
        cr.stroke()

    # --- the step: which year is arriving; it arrives in three shovelfuls ---
    k, f = step_through(u, n, hold_first=0.1, hold_last=0.1)
    k = min(k, n - 1)
    start = rows[0][1] * 0.45 if k == 0 else rows[k - 1][1]
    goal = rows[k][1]
    span = 0.9 / THROWS
    landed_amt = 0.0
    j_now, fl_now = THROWS - 1, 1.0
    for j in range(THROWS):
        a0 = 0.05 + j * span
        q = seg(f, a0, a0 + span)
        if 0 < q < 1 or (q <= 0 and j_now == THROWS - 1 and f < a0):
            pass
        if f >= a0 and f < a0 + span:
            j_now, fl_now = j, q
        landed_amt += pop(seg(q, 0.62, 0.95))          # each throw lands, the heap swells
    if f < 0.05:
        j_now, fl_now = 0, 0.0
    v = start + (goal - start) * landed_amt / THROWS
    hw, h = dims(v)

    contact_shadow(cr, cx, gy, hw * 2.3, a=0.45)
    heap_path(hw, h)
    solid(cr, SAND, finish="matte")
    cr.save()                                          # shadow flank, away from KEY
    heap_path(hw, h)
    cr.clip()
    cr.move_to(cx, gy - h - 10)
    cr.curve_to(cx + hw * 0.1, gy - h * 0.5, cx + hw * 0.05, gy - h * 0.2,
                cx - hw * 0.1, gy + 10)
    cr.line_to(cx + hw + 10, gy + 10)
    cr.line_to(cx + hw + 10, gy - h - 10)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(SAND_SH, 0.55))
    cr.fill()
    for i in range(9):                                 # slip-face flow lines
        a = (i - 4) / 4.5
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(SAND_SH if a > 0 else SAND_LIT, 0.55))
        cr.set_line_width(4)
        cr.move_to(cx + a * hw * 0.12, gy - h * 0.96)
        cr.curve_to(cx + a * hw * 0.4, gy - h * 0.55, cx + a * hw * 0.7,
                    gy - h * 0.2, cx + a * hw * 0.95, gy)
        cr.stroke()
    for i in range(int(18 + 40 * hw / 440)):           # gravel in the sand
        gx = cx - hw + ((i * 131) % 1000) / 1000.0 * 2 * hw
        rel = abs(gx - cx) / max(hw, 1)
        top = gy - h * max(0.0, 1 - rel) ** 1.4
        gyy = top + 20 + ((i * 71) % 100) / 100.0 * max(10, (gy - top - 30))
        disc(cr, gx, gyy, 6 + (i % 3) * 3, GRAVEL)
    # the shovelful that just landed slides down the left face
    sl = seg(fl_now, 0.7, 1.0)
    if 0 < sl < 1:
        for i in range(6):
            p = clamp(sl * 1.3 - i * 0.05)
            sx = cx - hw * (0.3 + 0.6 * p)
            sy = gy - h * (1 - (0.3 + 0.6 * p)) ** 1.4
            disc(cr, sx + i * 8, sy - 6, 8, SAND_LIT if i % 2 else SAND)
    cr.restore()
    heap_path(hw, h)
    edge(cr, (92, 66, 38), width=4)

    # the 1970 heap, kept as a ghost so the growth reads against it
    if k >= 1:
        ga = ease(seg(f, 0.0, 0.2)) if k == 1 else 1.0
        ohw, oh = dims(rows[0][1])
        heap_path(ohw, oh)
        cr.set_dash([18, 12])
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(look.INK, 0.85 * ga))
        cr.set_line_width(5)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.set_dash([])
        text(cr, rows[0][0], cx, gy - oh - 18, 44, look.INK, anchor="center",
             alpha=ga)

    # --- Data: points at the heap, then shovels onto it, one swing per throw;
    # he backs off as the heap's foot spreads toward him ---
    dx = cx - hw - 70
    working = 0.06 <= u <= 0.95
    if u < 0.06:
        role, bt = "point", 0
    elif u > 0.95:
        role, bt = "cheer", 0
    else:
        role, bt = "dig", k * THROWS + j_now
    host(role, dx, gy, 220, beat=bt)

    # the throw: sand flies off his shovel and lands on the heap's slope
    fl = seg(fl_now, 0.3, 0.7)
    if 0 < fl < 1 and working:
        x0, y0 = dx + 60, gy - 150
        x1, y1 = cx - hw * 0.35, gy - h * 0.72
        for i in range(9):
            q = clamp(fl * 1.6 - i * 0.07)
            if q <= 0 or q >= 1:
                continue
            px = x0 + (x1 - x0) * q
            py = y0 + (y1 - y0) * q - 160 * math.sin(math.pi * q)
            disc(cr, px, py, 9 - i * 0.5, SAND_LIT if i % 2 else SAND)

    vignette(cr, 0.28)

    # --- readouts ---
    lab, val = landed(rows, k, f, at=0.75)
    fit_readout(cr, f"{val:g} billion tonnes", f"sand & gravel mined · {lab}",
                80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.06)), size=130)
    if k == n - 1:
        b = ease(seg(f, 0.8, 0.95))
        if b > 0:
            r = rows[-1][1] / (rows[0][1] or 1.0)
            fit_readout(cr, f"{r:.1f}× {rows[0][0]}", "the same heap, a year's dig",
                        80, 690, a=b, rgb=P["accent2"], size=84)

stories.title: Americans Stopped Moving. Here's Why.
stories.hook: Your odds of moving collapsed from 1 in 5 to under 1 in 10.
stories.closing: We didn't get more content. We got more stuck.
stories.question: How long have you lived in one place?
stories.caption: In the 1950s, 1 in 5 Americans moved every year. In 2023, it fell below 1 in 10 — the lowest ever recorded. Part of it is licensing rules that used to cover 5% of jobs and now cover 25%. 👇 How long have you lived in the same place?

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a moving van's cargo hold
    SUBSTANCE: cardboard moving boxes
    CAUSE: Data carries boxes off the moving van and places them on the curb as fewer Americans move
    The van's hold is ALL Americans; the boxes fill the share who moved
    that year. Decade by decade Data pulls a load out and places it on the
    curb, and the full share of the hold shrinks as the data falls."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    if len(rows) < 2:
        rows = rows * 2
    n = len(rows)
    T = n - 1
    a0, a1 = 0.12, 0.88
    span = (a1 - a0) / T
    if u < a0:
        k, f = -1, 0.0
    elif u >= a1:
        k, f = T, 0.0
    else:
        k = min(T - 1, int((u - a0) / span))
        f = (u - a0) / span - k

    if k < 0:
        v, shown = rows[0][1], rows[0]
    elif k >= T:
        v, shown = rows[-1][1], rows[-1]
    else:
        va, vb = rows[k][1], rows[k + 1][1]
        v = va + (vb - va) * ease(seg(f, 0.2, 0.35))
        shown = rows[k + 1] if f >= 0.35 else rows[k]

    # backdrop: sky, houses, road, sidewalk
    vgrad(cr, P["drought_sky"], 0, H)
    dawn_sky(cr, t, y1=1300)
    rowhouse(cr, -20, 320, 560, 1300, (156, 92, 72), (122, 70, 56), t=t)
    rowhouse(cr, 780, 320, 600, 1300, (120, 110, 150), (92, 84, 120), t=t)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 70, 78)))
    cr.rectangle(0, 1300, W, 70)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((190, 186, 180)))
    cr.rectangle(0, 1370, W, H - 1370)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 146, 140)))
    cr.rectangle(0, 1366, W, 10)
    cr.fill()

    _van(cr, t, clamp(v / 100.0))

    VAN_X, PILE_X, FY = 620, 820, 1440
    # the curb pile: one load per decade he unloads
    placed = 0
    if 0 <= k < T:
        placed = k + (1 if f >= 0.72 else 0)
    elif k >= T:
        placed = T
    for j in range(placed):
        bx = 935 + (j % 2) * 76
        by = FY - (j // 2) * 64
        land = 1.0
        if 0 <= k < T and j == k:
            land = ease(seg(f, 0.72, 0.8))
        _carton(cr, bx, by - 40 * (1 - land), 70, 62)

    # Data's bit
    carry = False
    if k < 0:
        role, x, b = "point", VAN_X, 0
    elif k >= T:
        role, x, b = "shock", PILE_X, T
    elif f < 0.2:
        if k == 0:
            role, x, b = "point", VAN_X, 0
        else:
            role, x, b = "place", PILE_X + (VAN_X - PILE_X) * ease(f / 0.2), k - 1
    elif f < 0.35:
        role, x, b = "strain", VAN_X, k
        carry = f > 0.28
    elif f < 0.65:
        role, x, b = "hold_up", VAN_X + (PILE_X - VAN_X) * ease(seg(f, 0.35, 0.65)), k
        carry = True
    else:
        role, x, b = "place", PILE_X, k
        carry = f < 0.72
    host(role, x, FY, 220, beat=b)
    if carry:
        _carton(cr, x, FY - 226, 72, 62)

    # readouts
    val = shown[1]
    num = f"{val:.1f}".rstrip("0").rstrip(".")
    fit_readout(cr, f"{num}%", f"of Americans moved · {shown[0]}", 80, 520,
                a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.08)), size=130)
    # "1 in N" only when it is EXACT arithmetic on the value (100 / value),
    # never a rounded ratio the data does not have
    if val > 0:
        ratio = 100.0 / val
        if abs(ratio - round(ratio, 1)) < 1e-9:
            rs = f"{round(ratio, 1):.1f}".rstrip("0").rstrip(".")
            text(cr, f"1 in {rs}", W - 80, 680, 60, look.INK, anchor="right",
                 alpha=ease(seg(u, 0.04, 0.12)))

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a brass balance scale of mortgage payments
    SUBSTANCE: gold coins
    CAUSE: Data lifts gold coins from his chest and places them on the new-mortgage pan until it outweighs the old one
    Lock-in, weighed: the existing mortgage's coins sit on the left pan.
    Data walks to his strongbox, climbs onto it, and places the new rate's
    coins on the right pan batch by batch with his own hands; each batch
    he sets down tips the beam further against the old loan. The ratio is
    what a homeowner would take on by moving."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts[:2]]
    (ln, vn), (lo_lab, vo) = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: -r[1])
    unit = 0.2
    while max(vn, vo) / unit > 40:
        unit *= 2
    n_new = int(round(vn / unit))
    n_old = int(round(vo / unit))
    step = 7

    # sky, a low street of houses, the lawn
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (34, 44, 86)), (0.55, (108, 100, 146)),
               (1.0, (226, 166, 128))], 0, 1160)
    glow(cr, 820, 1000, 340, P["sun_glow"], 0.5)
    for i in range(4):
        rowhouse(cr, i * 270, 270, 280 + 30 * (i % 2), 1160,
                 P["brick"] if i % 2 == 0 else P["brick_cool"],
                 P["brick_shade"] if i % 2 == 0 else P["brick_cool_shade"])
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (70, 108, 60)), (1.0, (40, 66, 40))], 1150, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["curb"]))
    cr.rectangle(0, 1150, W, 18)
    cr.fill()

    # Data: points at the old pile, walks to his chest, climbs it, places
    walk_f = ease(seg(u, 0.04, 0.15))
    up = ease(seg(u, 0.15, 0.2))
    dx = 500 + 360 * walk_f + 70 * up
    fy = 1480 - 230 * up
    hx, hy = dx - 70, fy - 130

    # batches of coins he places on the right pan
    NB = 6
    starts = [0.22 + i * 0.105 for i in range(NB)]
    landed_n = 0
    moving = None
    beat_k = 0
    tilt_mass = 0.0
    for i, ub in enumerate(starts):
        a_i = int(round(n_new * i / NB))
        b_i = int(round(n_new * (i + 1) / NB))
        if u >= ub:
            beat_k = i + 1
        f = seg(u, ub, ub + 0.07)
        if f >= 1:
            landed_n = b_i
        elif f > 0:
            moving = (a_i, b_i, f)
        tilt_mass += (b_i - a_i) * ease(seg(u, ub + 0.07, ub + 0.1))

    diff = (tilt_mass - n_old) / max(1.0, float(n_old))
    ang = 0.11 * clamp(diff, -1.0, 1.0)

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a town gateway being walled up
    SUBSTANCE: grey stone blocks
    CAUSE: Data lifts each stone block off the pile and places it in the gateway, walling it up
    Every job in America is the whole open gateway on the road to the next
    state. Decade by decade Data carries one stone block over and sets it
    in the opening; the walled-up share of the gateway is the share of jobs
    that need a license, 5% in 1950 to 25% today, while the rest of the
    opening still shows the open road."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    n = max(1, len(rows))
    OX0, OX1, OY0, OY1 = 180, 900, 720, 1400
    BW = (OX1 - OX0) / 2.0
    BH = 0.05 * (OX1 - OX0) * (OY1 - OY0) / BW      # one block = 5% of the opening
    units = [clamp(v / 100.0) * 20.0 for _, v in rows] or [0.0]
    nblk = int(math.ceil(max(units) - 1e-6))

    # ---- the land behind the gate
    dawn_sky(cr, t, y1=1020)
    for hx, hr in ((160, 300), (560, 360), (960, 280)):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["leaf_far"]))
        cr.arc(hx, 1000 + hr * 0.55, hr, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()
    for x, w, h in ((200, 110, 130), (320, 90, 170), (420, 120, 120),
                    (560, 100, 160), (670, 120, 140), (800, 100, 110)):
        rowhouse(cr, x, w, h, 1000, P["brick_cool"], P["brick_cool_shade"])
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["pasture"]))
    cr.rectangle(0, 1000, W, H - 1000)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((108, 102, 96)))
    cr.move_to(505, 1000)
    cr.line_to(575, 1000)
    cr.line_to(1000, H)
    cr.line_to(80, H)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((228, 222, 200)))
    for j in range(7):                         # centre dashes, in perspective
        y0 = 1010 + (j ** 1.6) * 30
        cr.rectangle(536 - j, y0, 8 + 2 * j, 14 + 6 * j)
        cr.fill()

    # ---- the border wall and the gateway
    def bricks(x0, y0, x1, y1):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brick"]))
        cr.rectangle(x0, y0, x1 - x0, y1 - y0)
        cr.fill()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brick_shade"]))
        cr.set_line_width(2)
        for i, yy in enumerate(range(int(y0) + 24, int(y1), 24)):
            cr.move_to(x0, yy)
            cr.line_to(x1, yy)
            cr.stroke()
            for xx in range(int(x0) + (18 if i % 2 else 0), int(x1), 36):
                cr.move_to(xx, yy - 24)
                cr.line_to(xx, yy)
                cr.stroke()

    bricks(0, 1200, 110, 1400)
    bricks(970, 1200, W, 1400)
    for px0 in (110, 900):
        bricks(px0, 650, px0 + 70, 1400)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((172, 168, 160)))
        cr.rectangle(px0 - 12, 634, 94, 24)
        cr.fill()
        cr.arc(px0 + 35, 612, 22, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()
    for cx in (55, 1025):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((172, 168, 160)))
        cr.rectangle(cx - 60, 1188, 120, 16)
        cr.fill()
    IRON = (40, 38, 44)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(IRON))
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    cr.move_to(OX0, OY0)
    cr.curve_to(300, 640, 780, 640, OX1, OY0)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    cr.move_to(OX0, OY0 + 22)
    cr.curve_to(300, 666, 780, 666, OX1, OY0 + 22)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.rectangle(420, 662, 240, 44)
    cr.fill()
    text(cr, "NEXT STATE", 540, 694, 28, (236, 232, 220), anchor="center",
         shadow=False)

    # ---- timing: setup, one block per decade, reaction
    U0, U1, LAND = 0.10, 0.90, 0.58
    if u < U0:
        k, f = -1, 0.0
    else:
        s = clamp((u - U0) / (U1 - U0)) * n
        k = min(n - 1, int(s))
        f = min(1.0, s - k)
    prev_u = units[k - 1] if k >= 1 else 0.0
    filled = 0.0 if k < 0 else (units[k] if f >= LAND else prev_u)

    # ---- the wall in the opening: the licensed share of every job
    full = int(filled + 1e-6)
    part = filled - full
    cells = [(i, BW) for i in range(full)]
    if part > 0.02:
        cells.append((full, BW * part))
    for i, w in cells:
        r, c = divmod(i, 2)
        _stone(cr, OX0 + c * BW, OY1 - (r + 1) * BH, w, BH)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"], 0.9))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    for i, w in cells:
        r, c = divmod(i, 2)
        cr.rectangle(OX0 + c * BW + 3, OY1 - (r + 1) * BH + 3, w - 6, BH - 6)
        cr.stroke()
    rest_top = OY1 - (int(math.ceil(filled - 1e-6)) // 2 + 1) * BH
    text(cr, "no license needed", 540, min(800, rest_top - 30), 34, look.INK,
         anchor="center")

    # ---- the open iron gate leaves, swung back against the wall
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(IRON))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    for side in (-1, 1):
        hx = OX0 if side < 0 else OX1
        ox = hx + side * 130
        cr.move_to(hx, 740)
        cr.line_to(ox, 770)
        cr.line_to(ox, 1420)
        cr.line_to(hx, 1400)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.stroke()
        for j in range(1, 6):
            bx = hx + side * 130 * j / 6.0
            cr.move_to(bx, 740 + 30 * j / 6.0)
            cr.line_to(bx, 1400 + 20 * j / 6.0)
            cr.stroke()

    # ---- the pile of blocks still to place
    taken = 0 if k < 0 else k + 1
    pile = max(0, nblk - taken)
    PW, PH, PX, PB = 280, 34, 780, 1532
    for j in range(min(pile, 6)):
        _stone(cr, PX + (j % 2) * 8, PB - (j + 1) * PH, PW, PH)

    # ---- Data: lifts, carries, places, walks back
    HOME = (700.0, 1530.0)
    DH = 220
    carried = None
    dust = 0.0
    if k < 0:
        host("point", HOME[0], HOME[1], DH)
    else:
        i = int(prev_u + 1e-6)
        r, c = divmod(i, 2)
        sx, sy = OX0 + c * BW, OY1 - (r + 1) * BH
        stand = (sx + BW / 2, 1452.0)
        if f < 0.12:
            g = ease(f / 0.12)
            x, fy = HOME
            ox, oy = x - BW / 2, fy - DH - BH - 10
            px, py = PX + (pile % 2) * 8, PB - (pile + 1) * PH
            carried = (px + (ox - px) * g, py + (oy - py) * g,
                       PW + (BW - PW) * g, PH + (BH - PH) * g)
            host("strain", x, fy, DH, beat=k)
        elif f < 0.48:
            g = ease(seg(f, 0.12, 0.48))
            x = HOME[0] + (stand[0] - HOME[0]) * g
            fy = HOME[1] + (stand[1] - HOME[1]) * g
            carried = (x - BW / 2, fy - DH - BH - 10, BW, BH)
            host("hold_up", x, fy, DH, pace=True, beat=k)
        elif f < LAND:
            g = seg(f, 0.48, LAND)
            g = g * g                                  # it drops into its seat
            x, fy = stand
            oy = fy - DH - BH - 10
            carried = (sx + (x - BW / 2 - sx) * (1 - g), oy + (sy - oy) * g, BW, BH)
            host("place", x, fy, DH, beat=k)
        elif f < 0.8 or k == n - 1:
            x, fy = stand
            dust = 1.0 - seg(f, LAND, 0.72)
            if k == n - 1 and f >= 0.8:
                host("cheer" if u < 0.94 else "shock", x, fy, DH, beat=k)
            else:
                host("place", x, fy, DH, beat=k)
        else:
            g = ease(seg(f, 0.8, 1.0))
            x = stand[0] + (HOME[0] - stand[0]) * g
            fy = stand[1] + (HOME[1] - stand[1]) * g
            host("point", x, fy, DH, pace=True, beat=k)
        if carried:
            _stone(cr, *carried)
        if dust > 0:
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["dust"], 0.55 * dust))
            for ex in (sx + 10, sx + BW - 10):
                cr.arc(ex, sy + BH, 18 + 30 * (1 - dust), 0, 2 * math.pi)
                cr.fill()

    # ---- readouts
    if k < 0 or (k == 0 and f < LAND):
        fit_readout(cr, "every US job", "the whole gateway, open", 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.06)), size=110)
    else:
        kk = k if f >= LAND else k - 1
        lab, val = rows[kk]
        fit_readout(cr, f"{val:.0f}%", f"of US jobs need a license · {lab}",
                    80, 520, size=140)
    if u > 0.9 and n >= 2 and rows[0][1] > 0:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{rows[-1][1] / rows[0][1]:.0f}x", f"since {rows[0][0]}",
                    860, 900, anchor="right", a=ease(seg(u, 0.9, 0.96)),
                    rgb=P["accent2"], size=90)

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a packed suitcase on the doorstep
    SUBSTANCE: wet grey concrete
    CAUSE: Data pours concrete from a bucket into the form and it sets around the suitcase
    The closing: the move that never happens. The packed suitcase waits on
    the front step, and decade by decade Data pours one more bucket of
    concrete into the form around it: the concrete's height is the share of
    the suitcase now set in place, the share of jobs that need a license,
    5% in 1950 to 25% today. The rest of the case is still packed and ready,
    and stuck. He steps back from it in shock. Only LANDED values are
    printed — never the level mid-pour."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    if not rows:
        rows = [("", 0.0)]
    n = len(rows)
    vals = [v for _, v in rows]

    # world: the street they never left
    vgrad(cr, P["drought_sky"], 0, H)
    dawn_sky(cr, t, y1=1200)
    rowhouse(cr, -20, 360, 560, 1190, P["brick"], P["brick_shade"])
    rowhouse(cr, 360, 360, 520, 1190, P["brick_cool"], P["brick_cool_shade"])
    rowhouse(cr, 740, 360, 580, 1190, P["brick"], P["brick_shade"])
    vgrad(cr, P["dry_soil"], 1180, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["curb"]))
    cr.rectangle(0, 1180, W, 24)
    cr.fill()

    G = 1420
    sx0, sw, sh = 350, 460, 680
    sy0 = G - sh
    fx0, fx1 = 300, 860
    form_h = 200

    # pours: one bucket per decade, the rise lands on the tip, then it holds
    start, span = 0.10, 0.74 / n
    end = start + n * span
    level, k_now, landed_k = 0.0, -1, -1
    stream = 0.0
    last_end = -1.0
    prev = 0.0
    for k, v in enumerate(vals):
        a = start + k * span
        f = seg(u, a + span * 0.35, a + span * 0.8)
        if u >= a:
            k_now = k
        if f > 0:
            level = prev + (v - prev) * ease(f)
        if 0 < f < 1:
            stream = 1.0
        if f >= 1:
            landed_k = k
            last_end = a + span * 0.8
        prev = v
    dry = seg(u, last_end, last_end + 0.08) if last_end >= 0 else 1.0
    if stream:
        dry = 0.0

    # the hero, packed and waiting
    _suitcase(cr, sx0, sy0, sw, sh)

    # the form, and the concrete in it
    lev_px = sh * level / 100.0
    surf = G - lev_px
    wet, cured = (104, 106, 110), (162, 162, 158)
    col = tuple(int(a + (b - a) * dry) for a, b in zip(wet, cured))
    if lev_px > 0:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(col))
        cr.move_to(fx0 + 30, G)
        cr.line_to(fx0 + 30, surf)
        for i in range(21):
            x = fx0 + 30 + (fx1 - fx0 - 60) * i / 20
            cr.line_to(x, surf + (5 * stream) * math.sin(i * 0.9 + t * 6))
        cr.line_to(fx1 - 30, G)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.fill()
        # wet sheen sliding along the surface
        gx = fx0 + 60 + ((t * 120) % (fx1 - fx0 - 120))
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((230, 232, 236), 0.35 * (1 - dry)))
        cr.rectangle(gx, surf + 4, 90, 6)
        cr.fill()
        # aggregate specks in the mix
        for i in range(30):
            px = fx0 + 40 + (i * 89) % (fx1 - fx0 - 80)
            py = surf + 14 + (i * 53) % max(1, int(lev_px - 18)) if lev_px > 24 else surf + 8
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 118, 112), 0.6))
            cr.arc(px, py, 4, 0, 2 * math.pi)
            cr.fill()
    for bx in (fx0, fx1 - 30):                 # plank form walls
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["log"]))
        cr.rectangle(bx, G - form_h, 30, form_h)
        cr.fill()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["trunk"]))
        cr.set_line_width(3)
        for j in range(1, 4):
            cr.move_to(bx, G - form_h * j / 4)
            cr.line_to(bx + 30, G - form_h * j / 4)
        cr.stroke()

    # Data's bit: sees it, walks up with the bucket, pours, steps back
    walk_in = ease(seg(u, 0.04, start))
    back = ease(seg(u, end, end + 0.06))
    dx = 70 + 160 * walk_in - 120 * back
    if u < start:
        host("point", dx, G + 20, 220, pace=0 < walk_in < 1)
    elif u < end:
        host("pour", dx, G + 20, 220, beat=max(0, k_now))
    else:
        host("shock", dx, G + 20, 220, pace=0 < back < 1)

    # the pour stream from his bucket lip into the form
    if stream and u < end:
        lip_x, lip_y = dx + 80, G - 190
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(wet))
        cr.move_to(lip_x - 10, lip_y)
        cr.curve_to(lip_x + 20, lip_y + 20, fx0 + 70, surf - 60, fx0 + 70, surf)
        cr.line_to(fx0 + 96, surf)
        cr.curve_to(fx0 + 96, surf - 50, lip_x + 30, lip_y + 10, lip_x + 10, lip_y)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.fill()

    # the share marker, in the accent, at the concrete line — the label is
    # the last LANDED value only, held until the next pour lands
    if lev_px > 0:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"]))
        cr.set_line_width(6)
        cr.move_to(fx0 + 30, surf)
        cr.line_to(fx1 + 10, surf)
        cr.stroke()
        if landed_k >= 0:
            text(cr, f"{vals[landed_k]:.0f}%", fx1 + 16, surf + 16, 52, P["accent2"],
                 face="display")

    # readouts
    if landed_k >= 0:
        lab, v = rows[landed_k]
        fit_readout(cr, f"{v:.0f}%", f"of jobs need a license · {lab}", 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, start + span * 0.8, start + span * 0.95)), size=130)
    b = ease(seg(u, end, end + 0.06))
    if b > 0 and vals[0] > 0:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{vals[-1] / vals[0]:.0f}x", f"more than in {rows[0][0]}",
                    W / 2, 1480, anchor="center", a=b, rgb=P["accent2"], size=64)

stories.title: Powerball's Jackpot Denominator Grew 67%
stories.hook: Powerball's jackpot denominator grew 67%, making every ticket weaker.
stories.closing: Bigger jackpots came from making an already remote win even harder.
stories.question: Would that stop you playing?
stories.caption: Winning the Powerball jackpot is a 1 in 292 million shot — worse than a royal flush, worse than a lifetime shark attack, worse than getting struck by lightning nineteen thousand times over. And it's not an accident: in 2015 Powerball deliberately made the odds worse, on purpose, to grow the jackpot. 👇 Still buying a ticket?

segments.say: Powerball's jackpot denominator is 292,201,338, making a lifetime lightning strike dramatically more likely.

segments.illustrated_scene:
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a giant helium blimp
    SUBSTANCE: helium gas
    CAUSE: Data pumps helium with a bellows into the blimp's nose cell until it swells full
    The whole blimp holds the reserves of the four nations in the data, one
    gas cell per country, each cut at its true share of the envelope. Qatar's
    cell is the nose. It starts sagging, and with three strokes of the bellows
    it swells to full size inside the dashed outline of its full shape. Once
    it is full, its share is printed on the cell. The blimp bobs on its mooring
    mast in front of its hangar, and a helium tube trailer drives past the
    camera."""
    rows = sorted([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts], key=lambda r: -r[1])
    tot = sum(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    lq, vq = rows[0]
    share = vq / tot

    n = 3
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.55
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    infl = 0.0 if u < a0 else (k + ease(seg(f, 0.35, 0.8))) / n

    gtop = landscape(cr, t, "desert")

    # the airship hangar far behind, under haze
    building(cr, 620, 1010, 1170, 170, (176, 168, 156), roof_rgb=(120, 124, 132),
             roof="gable", boards=False)
    haze(cr, 900, 1180, (236, 214, 184), a=0.45)

    CX, CY, RX, RY = 590, 1000, 460, 235
    CYb = CY + 12 * math.sin(t * 1.3)
    cut = CX - RX + 2 * RX * share

    def half_h(x, ry):
        d = clamp((x - CX) / RX, -1.0, 1.0)
        return ry * math.sqrt(max(0.0, 1 - d * d)) * (1 - 0.28 * max(0.0, d) ** 1.5)

    def env(ry):
        N = 72
        for i in range(N + 1):
            x = CX - RX + 2 * RX * i / N
            y = CYb - half_h(x, ry)
            if i == 0:
                cr.move_to(x, y)
            else:
                cr.line_to(x, y)
        for i in range(N, -1, -1):
            x = CX - RX + 2 * RX * i / N
            cr.line_to(x, CYb + half_h(x, ry))
        cr.close_path()

    # the blimp's long shadow on the sand, the mooring mast
    cast_shadow(cr, CX - RX + 80, CX + RX - 80, 1452, length=260, a=0.22)
    contact_shadow(cr, CX + 40, 1458, 780, a=0.3)
    MX = 64
    contact_shadow(cr, MX, 1456, 110, a=0.45)
    cylinder(cr, MX - 22, 1452, 44, 1452 - CY + 10, (150, 156, 166), finish="metal")
    for yy in range(int(CY + 60), 1440, 70):           # mast ladder rungs
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 74, 82)))
        cr.set_line_width(4)
        cr.move_to(MX - 30, yy)
        cr.line_to(MX + 30, yy)
        cr.stroke()
    disc(cr, MX, CY - 4, 20, (120, 126, 136), finish="metal")

    # tail fins, behind the envelope
    for sgn in (-1, 1):
        cr.move_to(880, CYb + sgn * 90)
        cr.line_to(1030, CYb + sgn * 250)
        cr.line_to(1068, CYb + sgn * 230)
        cr.line_to(1050, CYb + sgn * 30)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (176, 60, 48))

    # gondola with its windows, hung under the middle
    gy = CYb + RY + 70
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 62, 70)))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    for sx in (CX - 100, CX + 80):
        cr.move_to(sx, CYb + RY - 12)
        cr.line_to(sx + 10, gy - 66)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.move_to(CX - 140, gy - 70)
    cr.line_to(CX + 130, gy - 70)
    cr.curve_to(CX + 165, gy - 60, CX + 160, gy - 10, CX + 120, gy)
    cr.line_to(CX - 120, gy)
    cr.curve_to(CX - 150, gy - 10, CX - 160, gy - 60, CX - 140, gy - 70)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (226, 228, 232), finish="gloss")
    for i in range(6):
        cr.rectangle(CX - 115 + i * 40, gy - 56, 26, 26)
        solid(cr, (70, 110, 150), finish="glass", rim=False)

    # the rest of the envelope: the other three nations' cells, full
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(cut, 0, W, H)
    cr.clip()
    env(RY)
    solid(cr, (214, 218, 226), finish="gloss")
    cr.restore()

    # Qatar's cell, the nose, swelling with every stroke of the bellows
    ryq = RY * (0.3 + 0.7 * infl)
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(0, 0, cut, H)
    cr.clip()
    env(ryq)
    solid(cr, P["accent2"], finish="gloss")
    cr.restore()

    # the envelope's fabric gores, running nose to tail
    cr.save()
    env(RY)
    cr.clip()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 66, 80), 0.28))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for g in (-0.66, -0.33, 0.33, 0.66):
        for i in range(61):
            x = CX - RX + 2 * RX * i / 60
            ry = ryq if x < cut else RY
            y = CYb + g * half_h(x, ry)
            if i == 0:
                cr.move_to(x, y)
            else:
                cr.line_to(x, y)
        cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()

    # seams between the gas cells, at the true proportions
    cuts = [cut]
    c = cut
    for _, v in rows[1:-1]:
        c += 2 * RX * v / tot
        cuts.append(c)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 42, 50)))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    for x in cuts:
        hh = half_h(x, RY)
        cr.move_to(x, CYb - hh)
        cr.line_to(x, CYb + hh)
    cr.stroke()
    if infl < 0.999:
        cr.save()
        cr.rectangle(0, 0, cut, H)
        cr.clip()
        env(RY)
        ghost(cr, a=0.9)
        cr.restore()

    # country names on their cells
    def short(lab):
        ws = lab.split()
        return (".".join(w[0] for w in ws) + ".").upper() if len(ws) > 1 else lab.upper()

    bounds = [CX - RX] + cuts + [CX + RX]
    for i, (lab, _) in enumerate(rows):
        if i == 0:
            continue
        mx = (bounds[i] + bounds[i + 1]) / 2
        s_ = short(lab)
        text(cr, s_, mx, CYb + 14, fit_size(cr, s_, 38, bounds[i + 1] - bounds[i] - 30),
             look.INK, anchor="center", shadow=False)
    qx = (CX - RX + cut) / 2 + 26
    text(cr, lq.upper(), qx, CYb - 58 * infl, 40, look.INK, anchor="center",
         alpha=ease(seg(infl, 0.4, 0.9)), shadow=False)
    done_a = ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.04))
    if done_a > 0:
        text(cr, f"{int(round(share * 100))}%", qx, CYb + 66, 104, look.INK,
             face="display", anchor="center", alpha=done_a)

    # tether from the mast to the nose
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((50, 50, 56)))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    cr.move_to(MX, CY - 4)
    cr.line_to(CX - RX + 2, CYb)
    cr.stroke()

    # Data walks to the nose, then pumps helium up the hose into it
    walk_in = ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.08))
    dx = 820 - 520 * walk_in
    fy = 1452
    nx = CX - RX + 120
    ny = CYb + half_h(nx, ryq)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((36, 36, 40)))
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    cr.move_to(dx + 60, fy - 70)
    cr.curve_to(dx + 150, fy - 150, nx - 30, ny + 150, nx, ny - 4)
    cr.stroke()
    disc(cr, nx, ny - 2, 9, (90, 94, 102), finish="metal")

    # a helium tube trailer passes right by the camera
    tx = W + 120 - ((t * 220) % (W + 820))
    ty = 1780
    contact_shadow(cr, tx + 280, ty + 4, 600, a=0.38)
    cr.rectangle(tx + 150, ty - 52, 420, 22)
    solid(cr, (60, 62, 70))
    for j in range(3):
        y0 = ty - 96 - j * 44
        cr.move_to(tx + 175, y0)
        cr.line_to(tx + 545, y0)
        cr.curve_to(tx + 565, y0, tx + 565, y0 + 40, tx + 545, y0 + 40)
        cr.line_to(tx + 175, y0 + 40)
        cr.curve_to(tx + 155, y0 + 40, tx + 155, y0, tx + 175, y0)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (206, 212, 220), finish="metal")
    # a painted band round the tubes in place of lettering (no text in the caption band)
    for bx in (tx + 250, tx + 470):
        cr.rectangle(bx, ty - 186, 22, 130)
        solid(cr, (190, 52, 42), rim=False)
    box(cr, tx, ty - 20, 140, 130, (190, 52, 42), depth=40, finish="gloss")
    cr.rectangle(tx + 14, ty - 140, 70, 46)
    solid(cr, (80, 120, 160), finish="glass", rim=False)
    for wx in (tx + 60, tx + 230, tx + 300, tx + 500):
        disc(cr, wx, ty - 14, 26, (40, 40, 44))
    foreground(cr, "desert")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    if u < a0:
        host("point", dx, fy, 230)
    else:
        beat = k if u < a1 else n + int((u - a1) / 0.14)
        host("pump", dx, fy, 230, beat=beat)

def _gas_bottle(cr, cx, cy, r, a=1.0):
    # a helium cylinder lying in the rack, its valve end to the camera and its
    # long steel body running back into the picture; the brown shoulder band
    # is helium's colour code, so no lettering is needed on it
    dx, dy = 0.95 * r, -0.55 * r
    L = math.hypot(dx, dy)
    nx, ny = dx / L, dy / L
    px, py = -ny, nx
    ang = math.atan2(py, px)
    cr.new_path()
    cr.move_to(cx + r * px, cy + r * py)
    cr.line_to(cx + dx + r * px, cy + dy + r * py)
    cr.arc_negative(cx + dx, cy + dy, r, ang, ang - math.pi)
    cr.line_to(cx - r * px, cy - r * py)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (118, 124, 136), finish="metal", a=a)
    disc(cr, cx, cy, r, (178, 184, 194), finish="metal", a=a)
    disc(cr, cx, cy, r * 0.68, (152, 98, 56), finish="gloss", a=a)
    disc(cr, cx, cy, r * 0.36, (92, 96, 106), finish="metal", a=a)
    cr.rectangle(cx - r * 0.12, cy - r * 0.5, r * 0.24, r * 0.3)
    solid(cr, P["brass"], finish="metal", a=a)


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a rack of helium gas cylinders
    SUBSTANCE: steel helium cylinders
    CAUSE: Data places the next cylinder into the rack from a rising lift, one per step of demand
    Helium demand at a chip fab, as the cylinders it eats: the 2024 rack
    holds six; Data rides a scissor lift up the rack and places cylinder
    after cylinder until it holds the 2035 projection. The 2024 load stays
    as a dashed ghost with its top marked, so the rack reads at a glance as
    nearly twice as full."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    v0 = v0 or 1.0
    ratio = v1 / v0
    n0 = 6
    nN = max(n0 + 1, int(round(n0 * ratio)))
    m = nN - n0
    cols = 3
    nrows = max(4, (nN + cols - 1) // cols)
    BASE = 1440
    rowh = min(165.0, 660.0 / nrows)
    r = rowh * 0.46
    RX0 = 300
    slot = r * 2.15
    RX1 = RX0 + cols * slot + 24

    def shelf_top(R):
        return BASE - 14 - R * rowh

    def slot_xy(i):
        R, c = i // cols, i % cols
        return RX0 + 12 + slot * (c + 0.5), shelf_top(R) - r - 2

    a0, a1 = 0.1, 0.88
    span = (a1 - a0) / m
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, m - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    idx = n0 + k
    if u < a0:
        placed = n0
    else:
        placed = n0 + k + (1 if f >= 0.8 else 0)
    flying = u >= a0 and f < 0.8

    # the lift: up from the ground to the first new row, then a row at a time
    first_row = n0 // cols
    if u < a0:
        py = 1400 + (shelf_top(first_row) - 1400) * ease(seg(u, 0.0, a0))
    else:
        rr = idx // cols
        pr = (idx - 1) // cols if k > 0 else first_row
        py = shelf_top(pr) + (shelf_top(rr) - shelf_top(pr)) * ease(seg(f, 0.0, 0.2))

    g = landscape(cr, t, "town")
    fab = building(cr, 430, 1040, g, 250, (214, 218, 224), roof="flat", boards=False)
    for wx in range(int(fab["x0"]) + 40, int(fab["x1"]) - 40, 90):
        cr.rectangle(wx, fab["top"] + 60, 50, 40)
        solid(cr, (120, 150, 186), finish="glass", rim=False)
    text(cr, "CHIP FAB", (fab["x0"] + fab["x1"]) / 2, fab["top"] + 40, 34, (60, 66, 80),
         anchor="center", shadow=False)
    haze(cr, 600, g, (206, 214, 228), a=0.3)

    # the rack
    steel = (96, 104, 118)
    cast_shadow(cr, RX0, RX1, BASE, length=320, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, (RX0 + RX1) / 2, BASE + 4, RX1 - RX0 + 80, a=0.4)
    rack_top = shelf_top(nrows) + 10
    for x in (RX0 + 0.95 * r, RX1 + 0.95 * r - 24):
        box(cr, x, BASE - 0.55 * r, 20, BASE - 0.55 * r - rack_top + 0.55 * r, (70, 76, 88),
            finish="metal")
    for R in range(nrows - 1, -1, -1):
        for c in range(cols - 1, -1, -1):
            i = R * cols + c
            if i < placed:
                cx, cy = slot_xy(i)
                _gas_bottle(cr, cx, cy, r)
        box(cr, RX0, BASE - R * rowh, RX1 - RX0, 14, steel, depth=0.95 * r, finish="metal")
    for x in (RX0 - 8, RX1 - 16):
        box(cr, x, BASE, 24, BASE - rack_top, steel, depth=10, finish="metal")

    # THE SCALE on the rack: the 2024 load as a ghost, its top marked
    if u >= a0:
        top0 = shelf_top((n0 + cols - 1) // cols) + 10
        cr.rectangle(RX0 + 4, top0, RX1 - RX0 - 8, BASE - 14 - top0)
        ghost(cr, a=0.9)
        then_mark(cr, RX0 - 20, RX1 + 40, top0, l0)

    # the scissor lift Data rides
    LX0, LX1 = 100, 290
    contact_shadow(cr, (LX0 + LX1) / 2, BASE + 4, 230, a=0.4)
    yel = (232, 180, 40)
    box(cr, LX0, BASE - 10, LX1 - LX0, 34, yel, depth=40)
    for wx in (LX0 + 30, LX1 - 30):
        disc(cr, wx, BASE - 6, 16, (40, 40, 46))
    lo, hi = BASE - 44, py + 20
    nX = 3
    hh = (lo - hi) / nX
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 60, 30)))
    cr.set_line_width(12)
    for j in range(nX):
        ya, yb = lo - j * hh, lo - (j + 1) * hh
        cr.move_to(LX0 + 20, ya)
        cr.line_to(LX1 - 20, yb)
        cr.move_to(LX1 - 20, ya)
        cr.line_to(LX0 + 20, yb)
    cr.stroke()
    box(cr, LX0, py + 20, LX1 - LX0, 20, yel, depth=50)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 56, 40)))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    cr.move_to(LX0, py - 70)
    cr.line_to(LX1, py - 70)
    cr.move_to(LX0 + 4, py)
    cr.line_to(LX0 + 4, py - 70)
    cr.stroke()

    hx = 190.0
    # the cylinder in his hands: off the deck, across, and slid into its slot
    if flying and idx < nN:
        sx, sy = slot_xy(idx)
        hx_, hy_ = hx + 80, py - 120
        if f < 0.15:
            q = ease(seg(f, 0.0, 0.15))
            bx, by = hx + 60, py - r + (hy_ - (py - r)) * q
        elif f < 0.6:
            q = ease(seg(f, 0.15, 0.6))
            ex, ey = sx - 50, sy + 34
            bx = hx_ + (ex - hx_) * q
            by = hy_ + (ey - hy_) * q - 90 * math.sin(math.pi * q)
        else:
            q = ease(seg(f, 0.6, 0.8))
            bx, by = sx - 50 * (1 - q), sy + 34 * (1 - q)
        _gas_bottle(cr, bx, by, r)

    # right by the camera: full cylinders waiting on the dock
    for j, (fx, fy) in enumerate(((800, 1820), (930, 1870))):
        contact_shadow(cr, fx + 55, fy + 4, 150, a=0.4)
        cylinder(cr, fx, fy, 110, 300, (150, 156, 168), finish="metal")
        disc(cr, fx + 55, fy - 305, 30, (152, 98, 56), finish="gloss")
        cr.rectangle(fx + 45, fy - 345, 20, 30)
        solid(cr, P["brass"], finish="metal")
    foreground(cr, "town")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    if u < a0:
        host("point", hx, py, 220)
    elif u < 0.92:
        host("place", hx, py, 220, beat=k)
    else:
        host("cheer", hx, py, 220)

    if u >= a1:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v1))}", f"helium {l1.lower()} · index",
                    W - 80, 520, anchor="right", size=130, max_w=760)
        text(cr, f"{ratio:.1f}x", W - 80, 680, 90, look.INK, face="display",
             anchor="right", alpha=ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.05)))
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v0))}", f"helium {l0.lower()} · index",
                    W - 80, 520, anchor="right", a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130,
                    max_w=760)

    s0 = CX - hw0 - 70
    if u < a0:
        hx = 380 + (s0 - 380) * ease(seg(u, 0.0, a0))
    else:
        hx = max(105.0, CX - hw - 70)
    hy = 1470

    # the drift of plastic at his feet that he digs from: a real little pile
    dcx, dbase = hx + 100, hy + 10
    contact_shadow(cr, dcx, dbase, 230, a=0.35)
    heap_path(cr, dcx, dbase, 60, 100)
    solid(cr, (150, 136, 112))
    cr.save()
    heap_path(cr, dcx, dbase, 60, 100)
    cr.clip()
    for j in range(16):
        bx = dcx - 95 + (j * 0.6180339 % 1.0) * 190
        by = dbase - 6 - ((j * 0.4142136) % 1.0) * 55
        bottle(cr, bx, by, j * 1.3 + 0.4, 1.3, PLASTIC[(j * 3) % len(PLASTIC)])
    cr.restore()
    heap_path(cr, dcx, dbase, 60, 100)
    edge(cr, (40, 36, 32))

    # every shovelful: before the heap is done each one grows it; after, he
    # keeps digging and the loads roll off the top (the story holds)
    if u < a1:

        bx = sx + (ex - sx) * dfly

        for j in range(4):

                   PLASTIC[(dk + j) % len(PLASTIC)])

    # once the heap is done, loose bottles keep tumbling down its flank

            ph = ((u - a1) / 0.16 + j / 3) % 1.0
            side = 1 if j % 2 else -1
            bx = CX + side * hw * (0.08 + 0.8 * ph)
            by = heap_top(CX, BASE, h, hw, bx) - 10
            bottle(cr, bx, by, side * ph * 9 + j, 1.6, PLASTIC[(j * 2 + 1) % len(PLASTIC)])

    # by the camera: bottles and a torn bag stranded on the wet sand
    cr.move_to(700, 1700)
    cr.curve_to(760, 1650, 860, 1660, 900, 1710)
    cr.curve_to(880, 1760, 790, 1790, 730, 1760)
    cr.curve_to(690, 1745, 680, 1720, 700, 1700)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (226, 232, 236), finish="gloss", a=0.9)
    for i in range(5):
        bottle(cr, 120 + i * 215, 1640 + (i % 2) * 90 + i * 12, i * 1.1 + 0.6,
               2.6 + 0.4 * (i % 2), PLASTIC[(i * 2 + 1) % len(PLASTIC)])
    foreground(cr, "coast")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    if u < a0:
        host("point", hx, hy, 240)
    elif u < 0.93:
        host("dig", hx, hy, 240, beat=dk)
    else:
        host("shock", hx, hy, 240)

    done = u >= a0 and k == n - 1 and grow >= 0.999
    if done:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v1)):,}M tons", f"plastic waste a year · {l1}",
                    80, 520, size=130)
        # the multiple sits ON the scale, at the new summit
        text(cr, f"{ratio:.1f}x", W - 40, BASE - h + 20, 84, look.INK, face="display",
             anchor="right", alpha=ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.05)))
    else:

                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

def _bottle_path(cr, cx, base, top, hw, nw):
    """A soda bottle's silhouette: the neck below the cap, a long shoulder
    flaring out, a pinched grip waist, and the petaloid feet it stands on."""
    sh = top + 320
    ym = (sh + base) / 2
    cr.new_path()
    cr.move_to(cx - nw, top + 50)
    cr.line_to(cx - nw, top + 110)
    cr.curve_to(cx - nw, top + 210, cx - hw, top + 230, cx - hw, sh)
    cr.line_to(cx - hw, ym - 120)
    cr.curve_to(cx - hw, ym - 60, cx - hw + 24, ym - 40, cx - hw + 24, ym)
    cr.curve_to(cx - hw + 24, ym + 40, cx - hw, ym + 60, cx - hw, ym + 120)
    cr.line_to(cx - hw, base - 70)
    # the petaloid base: three feet seen from the front, valleys between
    cr.curve_to(cx - hw, base - 28, cx - hw + 12, base, cx - hw + 46, base)
    cr.line_to(cx - 0.46 * hw, base)
    cr.curve_to(cx - 0.40 * hw, base - 32, cx - 0.24 * hw, base - 32, cx - 0.18 * hw, base)
    cr.line_to(cx + 0.18 * hw, base)
    cr.curve_to(cx + 0.24 * hw, base - 32, cx + 0.40 * hw, base - 32, cx + 0.46 * hw, base)
    cr.line_to(cx + hw - 46, base)
    cr.curve_to(cx + hw - 12, base, cx + hw, base - 28, cx + hw, base - 70)
    cr.line_to(cx + hw, ym + 120)
    cr.curve_to(cx + hw, ym + 60, cx + hw - 24, ym + 40, cx + hw - 24, ym)
    cr.curve_to(cx + hw - 24, ym - 40, cx + hw, ym - 60, cx + hw, ym - 120)
    cr.line_to(cx + hw, sh)
    cr.curve_to(cx + hw, top + 230, cx + nw, top + 210, cx + nw, top + 110)
    cr.line_to(cx + nw, top + 50)
    cr.close_path()


def _mix(a, b, f):
    return tuple(int(x + (y - x) * f) for x, y in zip(a, b))


def _bale(cr, x, y, w, h, i):
    """A compressed bale of plastic bottles, strapped: a lit block whose
    front is packed with the bottles it is made of."""
    box(cr, x, y, w, h, (122, 132, 146), depth=0.2 * w)
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(x + 4, y - h + 4, w - 8, h - 8)
    cr.clip()
    for j in range(22):
        bx = x + 10 + ((j * 0.6180339 + i * 0.21) % 1.0) * (w - 20)
        by = y - 10 - ((j * 0.4142136 + i * 0.13) % 1.0) * (h - 20)
        bottle(cr, bx, by, j * 1.3 + i, 1.0 + 0.35 * ((j * 0.37) % 1.0),
               _mix(PLASTIC[(j + i) % len(PLASTIC)], (130, 136, 146), 0.35))
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((36, 36, 40)))
    cr.set_line_width(7)
    for sx in (0.28, 0.72):
        cr.move_to(x + w * sx, y)
        cr.line_to(x + w * sx, y - h)
        cr.line_to(x + w * sx + 0.2 * w * 0.7, y - h - 0.2 * w * 0.5)
    cr.stroke()


def _bin_bag(cr, x, y, s, tint=(38, 40, 46)):
    contact_shadow(cr, x, y + 4, 150 * s, a=0.45)
    cr.new_path()
    cr.move_to(x - 70 * s, y)
    cr.curve_to(x - 95 * s, y - 60 * s, x - 70 * s, y - 120 * s, x - 14 * s, y - 128 * s)
    cr.line_to(x - 22 * s, y - 160 * s)
    cr.line_to(x, y - 140 * s)
    cr.line_to(x + 24 * s, y - 162 * s)
    cr.line_to(x + 14 * s, y - 128 * s)
    cr.curve_to(x + 74 * s, y - 118 * s, x + 98 * s, y - 56 * s, x + 72 * s, y)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, tint, finish="gloss")


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a giant plastic bottle
    SUBSTANCE: crushed plastic bottles
    CAUSE: Data pours bucketfuls of plastic into the bottle and it fills fate by fate
    One whole, split at its true proportions: everything thrown away fills
    ONE giant clear soda bottle, bucket by bucket, in layers stacked from
    the biggest fate at the bottom to the smallest at the top. It reads as
    a bottle by its own tells: a tall slim body with a grip waist, the long
    shoulder narrowing to a neck ring and a small screw cap, and the
    petaloid feet it stands on. The landfill half fills the bottom,
    mismanaged and burned stack above it, and the thin recycled share — in
    the accent — is the sliver under the shoulder. Data pours from a stack
    of baled plastic beside it. Done by 0.56, then held while a bottle keeps
    rolling through the yard."""
    rows = sorted([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts], key=lambda r: -r[1])
    n = len(rows)
    tot = sum(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    a0, a1 = 0.14, 0.56
    span = (a1 - a0) / max(1, n)
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    fly = seg(f, 0.0, 0.45)
    grow = ease(seg(f, 0.3, 0.8))
    started = u >= a0

    CX, BASE, TOP, HW, NW = 690, 1440, 560, 200, 54
    BOT = BASE - 12
    SH = TOP + 320
    FH = BOT - SH
    MOUTH = TOP + 50
    LAYER = [(132, 120, 102), (104, 106, 114), (78, 72, 70), (150, 152, 158)]
    ACC = P["accent2"]

    def col(i):
        return ACC if i == n - 1 else LAYER[i % len(LAYER)]

    # the setting: a town's edge, the yard where the waste is collected
    landscape(cr, t, "town")
    birds(cr, t, y0=760, n=4, rgb=(60, 60, 70))

    # the stack of baled plastic Data pours from, and the ladder up it
    BX, BW, BH = 120, 230, 160
    contact_shadow(cr, BX + BW / 2, 1444, BW + 70, a=0.45)
    cast_shadow(cr, BX, BX + BW, 1440, length=260, a=0.25)
    for i in range(4):
        _bale(cr, BX + (6 if i % 2 else 0), 1440 - BH * i, BW, BH, i)
    btop = 1440 - 4 * BH
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 74, 82)))
    cr.set_line_width(12)
    for lx in (72, 118):
        cr.move_to(lx, 1446)
        cr.line_to(lx + 18, btop - 10)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    for r in range(10):
        y = 1420 - r * 64
        d = 18 * (1440 - y) / (1440 - btop)
        cr.move_to(72 + d, y)
        cr.line_to(118 + d, y)
    cr.stroke()

    # the bottle: shadow, the far side of the clear plastic
    cast_shadow(cr, CX - HW, CX + HW, BASE, length=360, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, CX, BASE + 4, 2 * HW + 40, a=0.45)
    _bottle_path(cr, CX, BASE, TOP, HW, NW)
    solid(cr, (206, 226, 238), a=0.45, edge=False)

    # the layers inside, each the true share of the whole
    cum = 0.0
    tops = []
    cr.save()
    _bottle_path(cr, CX, BASE, TOP, HW, NW)
    cr.clip()
    for i, (lab, v) in enumerate(rows):
        amt = 1.0 if (started and i < k) else (grow if (started and i == k) else 0.0)
        lo, hi = cum, cum + v * amt
        y_lo = BOT - FH * lo / tot
        y_hi = BOT - FH * hi / tot
        y_full = BOT - FH * (cum + v) / tot
        tops.append(((y_lo + y_full) / 2, amt, y_lo - y_full))
        cum += v
        if amt <= 0:
            continue
        c = col(i)
        y_bot = BASE + 4 if i == 0 else y_lo
        cr.save()
        cr.rectangle(CX - HW - 10, y_hi, 2 * HW + 20, y_bot - y_hi)
        cr.clip()
        cr.rectangle(CX - HW - 10, y_hi, 2 * HW + 20, y_bot - y_hi)
        solid(cr, c, rim=False)
        m = int(16 + 110 * v / tot)
        for j in range(m):
            bx = CX - HW + 22 + ((j * 0.6180339 + i * 0.3) % 1.0) * (2 * HW - 44)
            by = y_lo - 8 - ((j * 0.4142136) % 1.0) * max(4.0, y_lo - y_hi - 10)
            bc = c if i == n - 1 else _mix(PLASTIC[(j + i) % len(PLASTIC)], c, 0.55)
            bottle(cr, bx, by, j * 1.7 + i, 1.0 + 0.5 * ((j * 0.29) % 1.0), bc)
        cr.restore()
        # a clean seam where one fate meets the next
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((240, 242, 246), 0.7))
        cr.set_line_width(4)
        cr.move_to(CX - HW, y_hi)
        cr.line_to(CX + HW, y_hi)
        cr.stroke()
    # the bucketful falling down the neck onto the level
    if started and 0 < fly < 1 and u < a1 + 0.02:
        lvl = BOT - FH * sum(v for _, v in rows[:k]) / tot
        for j in range(5):
            p = clamp(fly * 1.4 - j * 0.1)
            if 0 < p < 1:
                bottle(cr, CX - 20 + 14 * (j % 3), MOUTH + (lvl - MOUTH) * p * p,
                       p * 7 + j, 1.6, col(k))
    cr.restore()

    # the arc from his bucket into the mouth
    if started and 0 < fly < 1 and u < a1 + 0.02:
        for j in range(5):
            p = clamp(fly * 1.4 - j * 0.1)
            if 0 < p < 0.5:
                q = p / 0.5
                bx = 330 + (CX - 330) * q
                by = 690 + (MOUTH - 690) * q - 140 * math.sin(math.pi * q)
                bottle(cr, bx + 10 * (j % 2), by, q * 6 + j, 1.6, col(k))

    # the near face of the clear plastic: gloss, grip ribs, highlight
    _bottle_path(cr, CX, BASE, TOP, HW, NW)
    solid(cr, (232, 242, 250), finish="glass", a=0.22)
    ym = (SH + BASE) / 2
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((250, 252, 255), 0.45))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    for ry in (ym - 30, ym, ym + 30):            # the grip rings at the waist
        cr.move_to(CX - HW + 26, ry)
        cr.curve_to(CX - 70, ry + 20, CX + 70, ry + 20, CX + HW - 26, ry)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 255, 255), 0.5))
    cr.set_line_width(16)
    cr.move_to(CX + HW - 46, SH + 30)
    cr.line_to(CX + HW - 46, ym - 70)
    cr.move_to(CX + HW - 46, ym + 70)
    cr.line_to(CX + HW - 46, BASE - 90)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_line_width(10)                       # light down the shoulder
    cr.move_to(CX + NW - 14, TOP + 120)
    cr.curve_to(CX + NW - 10, TOP + 200, CX + HW - 70, TOP + 240, CX + HW - 46, SH)
    cr.stroke()
    # the neck ring, then the small ribbed screw cap
    cr.rectangle(CX - NW - 18, TOP + 66, 2 * (NW + 18), 14)
    solid(cr, (214, 230, 240), finish="glass")
    box(cr, CX - NW - 6, MOUTH, 2 * (NW + 6), 52, (52, 150, 84), depth=14,
        finish="gloss")
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((26, 90, 48)))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    for gx in range(int(CX - NW + 4), int(CX + NW + 6), 13):
        cr.move_to(gx, MOUTH - 6)
        cr.line_to(gx, MOUTH - 46)
    cr.stroke()

    # each landed share named ON its own layer, inside the bottle
    for i, (lab, v) in enumerate(rows):
        lm, amt, hgt = tops[i]
        a = ease(seg(amt, 0.9, 1.0)) if started else 0.0
        if a <= 0:
            continue
        name = lab.split("/")[0].strip().lower()
        s = f"{int(round(100 * v / tot))}% {name}"
        size = min(40, max(28, hgt * 0.55))
        text(cr, s, CX, lm + size * 0.36, size, (248, 249, 252), face="bold",
             anchor="center", alpha=a)

    # right by the camera: bin bags, and a bottle rolling through the yard
    _bin_bag(cr, 110, 1760, 1.5)
    _bin_bag(cr, 980, 1800, 1.3, (52, 60, 54))
    for j in range(3):
        bottle(cr, 330 + j * 170, 1700 + (j % 2) * 90, j * 1.1 + 0.4, 3.2,
               PLASTIC[(j * 2) % len(PLASTIC)])
    rx = -220 + ((t * 170) % 1500)
    bottle(cr, rx, 1600, t * 2.6, 4.2, PLASTIC[1 % len(PLASTIC)])
    foreground(cr, "town")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data: climbs the ladder, pours bucket after bucket, holds up the last
    stand_x, stand_y = 255, btop
    if u < a0:
        p = ease(seg(u, 0.0, a0))
        cp = clamp(p / 0.85)
        hx = 95 + 18 * cp + (stand_x - 113) * seg(p, 0.85, 1.0)
        hy = 1440 - (1440 - stand_y) * cp
        host("climb", hx, hy, 230)
    elif u < a1 + 0.04:
        host("pour", stand_x, stand_y, 230, beat=k)
    elif u < 0.92:
        host("hold_up", stand_x, stand_y, 230)
    else:
        host("shock", stand_x, stand_y, 230)

    # readout: the title, then the landfill half, then the recycled sliver
    first_done = started and (k > 0 or grow >= 0.999)
    last_done = started and k == n - 1 and grow >= 0.999
    if last_done:
        lab, v = rows[-1]
        fit_readout(cr, f"Only {int(round(100 * v / tot))}%",
                    f"of plastic is {lab.lower()}", 80, 500, size=140, rgb=ACC)
    elif first_done:
        lab, v = rows[0]
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(100 * v / tot))}%",
                    f"of plastic is {lab.lower()}", 80, 500, size=140)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Where it goes", "all the plastic we throw away", 80, 500,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=120)

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a tower of recycled plastic bales
    SUBSTANCE: crushed plastic bottle bales
    CAUSE: Data places each new bale on top of the stack and the recycled tower rises
    Each bale is one percent of all the plastic thrown away. In 2019 the
    recycled tower is a short stack. Bale by bale, Data stacks it up to the
    2060 best case and it nearly doubles. The 2019 stack stays on the tower

def _lw(hx, hy, ang, lx, ly):
    c, s = math.cos(ang), math.sin(ang)
    return hx + lx * c - ly * s, hy + lx * s + ly * c


def _arrows(cr, cx, cy, r, rgb):
    vs = [(cx + r * math.cos(-math.pi / 2 + j * 2 * math.pi / 3),
           cy + r * math.sin(-math.pi / 2 + j * 2 * math.pi / 3)) for j in range(3)]
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(rgb))
    cr.set_line_width(9)
    for j in range(3):
        (x0, y0), (x1, y1) = vs[j], vs[(j + 1) % 3]
        sx, sy = x0 + (x1 - x0) * 0.18, y0 + (y1 - y0) * 0.18
        ex, ey = x0 + (x1 - x0) * 0.78, y0 + (y1 - y0) * 0.78
        cr.move_to(sx, sy)
        cr.line_to(ex, ey)
        cr.stroke()
        a = math.atan2(ey - sy, ex - sx)
        cr.move_to(ex + 14 * math.cos(a), ey + 14 * math.sin(a))
        cr.line_to(ex + 14 * math.cos(a + 2.4), ey + 14 * math.sin(a + 2.4))
        cr.line_to(ex + 14 * math.cos(a - 2.4), ey + 14 * math.sin(a - 2.4))
        cr.close_path()
        cr.fill()

    # the load pouring off the tail onto the landfill
    if tip > 0.1:
        sx, sy = _lw(HX, HY, ang, 0, -BH - 30)

segments.illustrated_scene:
# scene standard: 2026-10-11
def _st_geom(N):
    # one flight of stone steps running up the hill away from the camera:
    # (centre x, width, riser foot y, riser top y, tread back y, scale)
    out = []
    yb = 1500.0
    for i in range(N + 1):
        sc = 1.0 / (1.0 + 0.12 * i)
        w = 780.0 * sc
        cx = 520.0 + 250.0 * (1.0 - sc)
        r = 38.0 * sc
        td = 38.0 * sc
        out.append((cx, w, yb, yb - r, yb - r - td, sc))
        yb = yb - r - td
    return out


def _st_spot(g, p):
    # where a foot stands at tread position p (0 = bottom step), stepping up
    N = len(g) - 1
    p = clamp(p, 0, N - 1)
    k = int(min(p, N - 1.001))
    f = p - k
    hop = ease(clamp(f * 1.4))
    a, b = g[k], g[min(k + 1, N - 1)]
    ya, yb = (a[3] + a[4]) / 2, (b[3] + b[4]) / 2
    return a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * f, ya + (yb - ya) * hop, a[5] + (b[5] - a[5]) * f


def _st_feet(cr, x, y, sc, flip):
    # a pair of muddy footprints pressed into a stone tread
    for side in (-1, 1):
        fx = x + side * 26 * sc
        fy = y + (5 * sc if (side > 0) == flip else -5 * sc)
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(fx, fy)
        cr.scale(16 * sc, 7.5 * sc)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 1, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((74, 54, 38), 0.88))
        cr.fill()
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(fx + side * 2 * sc, fy - 9 * sc)
        cr.scale(9 * sc, 4.5 * sc)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 1, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((74, 54, 38), 0.88))
        cr.fill()


def _st_flag(cr, x, y, w, h, t):
    # a big striped summit flag streaming in the wind from a pole top at (x, y)
    bands = [(206, 34, 40), (244, 242, 236), (206, 34, 40), (244, 242, 236), (206, 34, 40)]
    bh = h / len(bands)

    def wave(xi, j):
        return 22 * math.sin(t * 5.0 - xi * 0.045 + 0.3 * j) * (xi / w) ** 0.8

    for j, col in enumerate(bands):
        cr.move_to(x, y + j * bh)
        for i in range(17):
            xi = w * i / 16
            cr.line_to(x + xi, y + j * bh + wave(xi, j))
        for i in reversed(range(17)):
            xi = w * i / 16
            cr.line_to(x + xi, y + (j + 1) * bh + wave(xi, j + 1))
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, col, edge=False, rim=False)
    cr.move_to(x, y)
    for i in range(17):
        xi = w * i / 16
        cr.line_to(x + xi, y + wave(xi, 0))
    for i in reversed(range(17)):
        xi = w * i / 16
        cr.line_to(x + xi, y + h + wave(xi, len(bands)))
    cr.close_path()
    edge(cr, (60, 30, 30), width=3)


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a long stone staircase up a hill
    SUBSTANCE: footprints on the steps
    CAUSE: Data climbs the staircase step by step, leaving footprints on every step he climbs
    One flight of stone steps up a Hong Kong hillside, handrails both sides,
    lamps along it: the WHOLE flight is the top country's day of walking.
    Data climbs from the bottom step and every tread he climbs keeps his
    muddy footprints. About halfway up a dashed mark says where the lowest
    country's whole day ends; he pauses there, then climbs on to the top —
    about twice as far. Done by 0.64 and held: the big summit flag streams
    in the wind, birds cross the sky, he holds his arms up on the top step."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    hi_l, hi_v = max(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    lo_l, lo_v = min(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    hi_v = hi_v or 1.0
    s_lo = lo_v / hi_v
    ratio = hi_v / max(1.0, lo_v)

    N = 16
    g = _st_geom(N)
    top_p = N - 1
    a0, m0, m1, a1 = 0.05, 0.30, 0.37, 0.64
    if u < a0:
        s = 0.0
    elif u < m0:
        s = s_lo * seg(u, a0, m0)
    elif u < m1:
        s = s_lo
    else:
        s = s_lo + (1 - s_lo) * seg(u, m1, a1)
    p = s * top_p
    p_lo = s_lo * top_p

    landscape(cr, t, "coast")
    birds(cr, t, y0=640, n=5, rgb=(44, 46, 60))
    # Hong Kong's towers far across the water, under haze
    for i in range(7):
        bx = -10 + i * 52
        bh = 110 + ((i * 53) % 5) * 40
        box(cr, bx, 1176, 40, bh, (132, 144, 162), depth=10, finish="glass")
    haze(cr, 760, 1180, (214, 222, 232), a=0.6)

    # the hill the staircase is cut into
    cr.move_to(-40, 1300)
    cr.curve_to(160, 1060, 420, 760, 760, 700)
    cr.curve_to(940, 680, 1060, 820, 1120, 900)
    cr.line_to(1120, H)
    cr.line_to(-40, H)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (78, 122, 70))
    for i in range(26):
        tx = 30 + (i * 197) % 1020
        ty = 820 + (i * 131) % 700
        cx_, w_ = None, None
        for gi in g:
            if gi[2] >= ty >= gi[4]:
                cx_, w_ = gi[0], gi[1]
        if ty < 700 + abs(tx - 760) * 0.55:
            continue
        if cx_ is not None and abs(tx - cx_) < w_ / 2 + 70:
            continue
        if ty > 1460 and 120 < tx < 960:
            continue
        sz = 0.35 + 0.25 * (ty - 820) / 700
        tree(cr, tx, ty, sz, P["leaf"], P["leaf_shade"], P["trunk"])

    # the summit flag, big against the sky, streaming in the wind all beat
    tcx, tw, tyb = g[N][0], g[N][1], g[N][2]
    px_ = tcx + tw / 2 + 40
    contact_shadow(cr, px_, tyb + 4, 50, a=0.4)
    cr.rectangle(px_ - 6, 600, 12, tyb - 600)
    solid(cr, (70, 72, 80), finish="metal", rim=False)
    disc(cr, px_, 598, 11, (200, 170, 90), finish="metal")
    _st_flag(cr, px_ + 6, 606, 200, 130, t)

    # the paved landing at the foot of the stairs, out to the camera
    c0, w0, yb0 = g[0][0], g[0][1], g[0][2]
    cast_shadow(cr, c0 - w0 / 2, c0 + w0 / 2, yb0, length=260, a=0.22)
    cr.move_to(c0 - w0 / 2, yb0)
    cr.line_to(c0 + w0 / 2, yb0)
    cr.line_to(c0 + w0 / 2 + 260, H)
    cr.line_to(c0 - w0 / 2 - 260, H)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (168, 160, 146), rim=False)

    # the steps, far first: tread, then riser with its stone joints
    for i in reversed(range(N)):
        cx, w, yb, yr, yt, sc = g[i]
        nx, nw = g[i + 1][0], g[i + 1][1]
        cr.move_to(cx - w / 2, yr)
        cr.line_to(cx + w / 2, yr)
        cr.line_to(nx + nw / 2, yt)
        cr.line_to(nx - nw / 2, yt)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (212, 206, 192), rim=False)
        cr.rectangle(cx - w / 2, yr, w, yb - yr)
        solid(cr, (150, 144, 132))
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((96, 90, 82), 0.7))
        cr.set_line_width(max(1.5, 3 * sc))
        for j in range(1, 5):
            jx = cx - w / 2 + w * (j + (0.5 if i % 2 else 0.0)) / 5.0
            if jx < cx + w / 2 - 4:
                cr.move_to(jx, yr)
                cr.line_to(jx, yb)
        cr.stroke()
        # the footprints left on every step he has climbed
        if i < p - 0.3:
            _st_feet(cr, cx, (yr + yt) / 2, sc, i % 2 == 0)

    # parapet walls up both sides, handrails on posts, lamps
    for side in (-1, 1):
        low = [(gi[0] + side * (gi[1] / 2 + 6 * gi[5]), gi[2]) for gi in g]
        up = [(gi[0] + side * (gi[1] / 2 + 6 * gi[5]), gi[2] - 58 * gi[5]) for gi in g]
        cr.move_to(*low[0])
        for q in low[1:]:
            cr.line_to(*q)
        for q in reversed(up):
            cr.line_to(*q)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (128, 122, 112))
        rail = [(x, y - 70 * g[j][5]) for j, (x, y) in enumerate(up)]
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((58, 60, 68)))
        for j in range(0, N + 1, 2):
            cr.set_line_width(max(2, 7 * g[j][5]))
            cr.move_to(*up[j])
            cr.line_to(*rail[j])
            cr.stroke()
        cr.set_line_width(8)
        cr.move_to(*rail[0])
        for q in rail[1:]:
            cr.line_to(*q)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((200, 204, 212), 0.8))
        cr.set_line_width(2.5)
        cr.move_to(rail[0][0], rail[0][1] - 3)
        for q in rail[1:]:
            cr.line_to(q[0], q[1] - 3)
        cr.stroke()
    for j in (3, 10):
        cx, w, yb, yr, yt, sc = g[j]
        lx = cx + w / 2 + 40 * sc
        cr.rectangle(lx - 5 * sc, yb - 300 * sc, 10 * sc, 300 * sc)
        solid(cr, (60, 62, 70), finish="metal", rim=False)
        glow(cr, lx, yb - 310 * sc, 50 * sc, (255, 226, 160), 0.5)
        disc(cr, lx, yb - 310 * sc, 18 * sc, (250, 232, 180), finish="gloss")

    # footprints walking in across the landing toward the first step
    for j in range(3):
        fy = 1530 + j * 120
        _st_feet(cr, c0 + (j % 2) * 20, fy, 1.15 + 0.2 * j, j % 2 == 0)

    # where the lowest country's whole day of walking ends
    ml = ease(seg(u, m0 - 0.03, m0 + 0.02))
    if ml > 0:
        lx_, ly_, _ = _st_spot(g, p_lo)
        k_ = int(p_lo)
        hw_ = g[k_][1] / 2
        then_mark(cr, lx_ - hw_ - 150, min(860, lx_ + hw_ + 14), ly_, lo_l, a=ml)

    disc(cr, 70, 1850, 70, (138, 132, 120))
    disc(cr, 1010, 1880, 90, (128, 122, 112))
    foreground(cr, "field", y0=1620)
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    if u < a0:
        hx, hy = c0 - 40, yb0 + 20
        host("point", hx, min(1500.0, hy), 240)
    else:
        hx, hy, hs = _st_spot(g, p)
        hh = 180 + 60 * clamp((hs - g[top_p][5]) / (1 - g[top_p][5]))
        if u < a1 + 0.02:
            host("climb", hx, hy, hh, beat=0 if u < m1 else 1)
        else:
            host("hold_up", hx, hy, hh)

    if u >= a1:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(hi_v)):,} steps", f"walked a day · {hi_l}",
                    80, 520, size=110, max_w=700)
        text(cr, f"{ratio:.1f}x", 80, 940, 90, look.INK, face="display",
             anchor="left", alpha=ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.04)))
    elif u >= m0:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(lo_v)):,} steps", f"walked a day · {lo_l}",
                    80, 520, size=110, max_w=700)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Steps a day", f"{hi_l} vs {lo_l}", 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=110, max_w=700)

stories.title: Schools Reopened, But Homeschooling Stayed At 5.4%
stories.hook: Homeschooling was supposed to be a lockdown fad. It wasn't.
stories.closing: Reopening classrooms did not restore the earlier pattern; families kept making different choices about where children learn.
stories.question: What matters most when choosing a school?

segments.illustrated_scene:
# scene standard: 2026-10-22
def _hs_rr(cr, x, y, w, h, r):
    cr.new_sub_path()
    cr.arc(x + w - r, y + r, r, -math.pi / 2, 0)
    cr.arc(x + w - r, y + h - r, r, 0, math.pi / 2)
    cr.arc(x + r, y + h - r, r, math.pi / 2, math.pi)
    cr.arc(x + r, y + r, r, math.pi, 1.5 * math.pi)
    cr.close_path()


def _hs_arm(cr, sx, sy, hx, hy, w, rgb):
    dx, dy = hx - sx, hy - sy
    L = math.hypot(dx, dy) or 1.0
    nx, ny = -dy / L * w, dx / L * w
    cr.move_to(sx + nx, sy + ny)
    cr.line_to(hx + nx * 0.8, hy + ny * 0.8)
    cr.line_to(hx - nx * 0.8, hy - ny * 0.8)
    cr.line_to(sx - nx, sy - ny)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, rgb, rim=False)


def _hs_kid(cr, x, F, s, ph, walking, shirt, skin, hair, pack, a=1.0):
    """A schoolchild walking left, a backpack on its back."""
    contact_shadow(cr, x, F, 70 * s, a=0.35 * a)
    sw = math.sin(ph) if walking else 0.0
    hipy = F - 62 * s
    for sg, off in ((1, -5), (-1, 5)):
        fx = x + off * s + sg * sw * 26 * s
        _hs_arm(cr, x + off * s, hipy, fx, F - 6 * s, 8 * s, (52, 58, 78))
        disc(cr, fx - 5 * s, F - 5 * s, 8 * s, (40, 36, 34))
    _hs_rr(cr, x - 22 * s, F - 128 * s, 44 * s, 72 * s, 14 * s)
    solid(cr, shirt)
    _hs_rr(cr, x + 8 * s, F - 126 * s, 36 * s, 60 * s, 11 * s)
    solid(cr, pack)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 36, 40), 0.8))
    cr.set_line_width(4 * s)
    cr.move_to(x + 10 * s, F - 124 * s)
    cr.line_to(x - 4 * s, F - 92 * s)
    cr.stroke()
    hx, hy = x - 8 * s - sw * 22 * s, F - 72 * s
    _hs_arm(cr, x - 6 * s, F - 118 * s, hx, hy, 6 * s, shirt)
    disc(cr, hx, hy, 6 * s, skin)
    cr.rectangle(x - 6 * s, F - 140 * s, 10 * s, 14 * s)
    solid(cr, skin, rim=False, edge=False)
    disc(cr, x - 2 * s, F - 152 * s, 21 * s, skin)
    cr.arc(x - 2 * s, F - 155 * s, 23 * s, math.pi * 1.0, math.pi * 2.0)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, hair, rim=False)


def _hs_backpack(cr, x, y, s):
    contact_shadow(cr, x + 80 * s, y, 210 * s, a=0.4)
    _hs_rr(cr, x, y - 200 * s, 160 * s, 200 * s, 44 * s)
    solid(cr, (64, 104, 158))
    _hs_rr(cr, x + 24 * s, y - 96 * s, 112 * s, 82 * s, 22 * s)
    solid(cr, (48, 84, 132))
    cr.move_to(x + 40 * s, y - 196 * s)
    cr.curve_to(x + 46 * s, y - 250 * s, x + 114 * s, y - 250 * s, x + 120 * s, y - 196 * s)
    cr.line_to(x + 106 * s, y - 196 * s)
    cr.curve_to(x + 100 * s, y - 232 * s, x + 60 * s, y - 232 * s, x + 54 * s, y - 196 * s)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (40, 70, 112), rim=False)


def _hs_bus(cr, bx, base):
    contact_shadow(cr, bx + 200, base + 2, 420, a=0.4)
    box(cr, bx, base, 390, 130, (236, 184, 40), depth=50, finish="gloss")
    for i in range(6):
        cr.rectangle(bx + 22 + i * 60, base - 112, 44, 42)
        solid(cr, (70, 90, 110), finish="glass", rim=False)
    cr.rectangle(bx, base - 52, 390, 8)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 30, 30)))
    cr.fill()
    cr.rectangle(bx, base - 32, 390, 6)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 30, 30)))
    cr.fill()
    disc(cr, bx + 72, base, 26, (36, 36, 40))
    disc(cr, bx + 310, base, 26, (36, 36, 40))


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a school with children walking out
    SUBSTANCE: children with backpacks
    CAUSE: Data pulls the school's front door open with both hands and the children walk out of it, home
    One brick school, its bell tower and parked yellow bus, and twelve
    homeschooled children: the WHOLE. Two already stand at home in plain
    grey packs (the other reasons); Data hauls the big front door open by
    its latch edge, walking it round on its hinge, and holds it braced
    while the rest file out down the path to the house, each in an accent
    pack: that share of the twelve is the parents who named the school
    environment or safety. A reported reason, so the picture is parents'
    children leaving, not a measured cause. All are out by 0.56 and the
    number lands; the last children are still walking home after it.
    The SCHOOL sign hangs on the bell tower, well above Data's head."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    lab, v = max(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    share = clamp(v / 100.0)
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.56
    N = 12
    out_n = int(round(share * N))

    landscape(cr, t, "town", horizon=1160, time="day", seed="a school", skyline=False)

    # the school, three-quarter, long shadow to the lower right
    SX0, SX1, SB = 250, 900, 1300
    cx = (SX0 + SX1) / 2
    cast_shadow(cr, SX0, SX1, SB, length=260, a=0.28)
    contact_shadow(cr, cx, SB + 2, 700, a=0.4)
    b = building(cr, SX0, SX1, SB, 400, (176, 82, 60), roof="flat")
    top = b["top"]
    # the bell tower
    box(cr, cx - 70, top + 2, 140, 150, (166, 76, 56), depth=30)
    ty = top - 148
    cr.move_to(cx - 78, ty)
    cr.line_to(cx + 8, ty - 96)
    cr.line_to(cx + 106, ty)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (96, 58, 50))
    cr.rectangle(cx - 38, ty + 22, 76, 84)
    solid(cr, (40, 30, 28), rim=False)
    disc(cr, cx, ty + 66, 26, P["brass"], finish="metal")
    # the SCHOOL sign on the tower's face, clear above the doorway and Data
    cr.rectangle(cx - 64, top - 34, 128, 34)
    solid(cr, (238, 232, 214))
    text(cr, "SCHOOL", cx, top - 8, 24, (60, 40, 34), face="bold", anchor="center", shadow=False)
    # windows
    fw = b["x1"] - b["x0"]
    for row in range(2):
        wy = top + 34 + row * 140
        for c in range(6):
            if row == 1 and c in (2, 3):
                continue
            wx = b["x0"] + 30 + c * (fw - 60 - 72) / 5.0
            cr.rectangle(wx - 6, wy - 6, 84, 102)
            solid(cr, (236, 230, 216), rim=False)
            cr.rectangle(wx, wy, 72, 90)
            solid(cr, (126, 164, 192), finish="glass")

    # the doorway: a hallway of lockers inside
    DX0, DX1, DY, GY = cx - 90, cx + 90, 1064, 1290
    dw = DX1 - DX0
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(DX0, DY, dw, GY - DY)
    cr.clip()
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (44, 40, 40)), (1, (110, 96, 78))], DY, GY, DX0, DX1)
    for i in range(5):
        cr.rectangle(DX0 + 12 + i * 34, DY + 50, 28, 150)
        solid(cr, (96, 124, 150), rim=False)
    glow(cr, cx, GY, 160, (240, 210, 160), 0.3)
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((244, 238, 226)))
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    cr.rectangle(DX0, DY, dw, GY - DY)
    cr.stroke()
    box(cr, cx - 140, SB + 10, 280, 18, (196, 190, 180), depth=24)

    # the door, hinged on the right, pulled open by its latch edge
    th = 2.3 * ease(seg(u, a0, 0.22))
    ex = DX1 - dw * math.cos(th)
    drop = 50 * math.sin(th)
    cr.move_to(DX1, DY)
    cr.line_to(ex, DY + drop * 0.4)
    cr.line_to(ex, GY + drop)
    cr.line_to(DX1, GY)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (58, 86, 128) if th < math.pi / 2 else (44, 64, 98), finish="gloss")
    if abs(ex - DX1) > 30:
        wx0 = DX1 + (ex - DX1) * 0.22
        wx1 = DX1 + (ex - DX1) * 0.78
        cr.move_to(wx0, DY + 30 + drop * 0.09)
        cr.line_to(wx1, DY + 30 + drop * 0.31)
        cr.line_to(wx1, DY + 110 + drop * 0.4)
        cr.line_to(wx0, DY + 110 + drop * 0.15)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (150, 186, 210), finish="glass", rim=False)

    # the parked school bus beside it
    _hs_bus(cr, 870, 1350)

    # the path from the steps down to the home
    cr.move_to(cx - 70, SB + 10)
    cr.line_to(cx + 50, SB + 10)
    cr.curve_to(cx + 20, 1420, 420, 1500, 480, 1580)
    cr.line_to(60, 1580)
    cr.curve_to(200, 1470, cx - 160, 1380, cx - 70, SB + 10)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (200, 190, 170), edge=False, rim=False)

    # home, lower left, its door open and warm
    contact_shadow(cr, 80, 1452, 340, a=0.4)
    h = building(cr, -90, 230, 1450, 200, (232, 220, 192), roof_rgb=(130, 72, 58), roof="gable")
    cr.rectangle(h["x1"] - 120, 1450 - 130, 70, 130)
    solid(cr, (250, 214, 150), finish="gloss", rim=False)
    glow(cr, h["x1"] - 85, 1440, 110, (255, 214, 150), 0.4)

    # the children: two home already, the share filing out of the school
    spots = [(110 + (i * 137) % 400, 1478 + (i * 29) % 64) for i in range(N)]
    shirts = [(70, 110, 160), (150, 70, 70), (90, 130, 90), (204, 170, 90), (120, 90, 140),
              (222, 220, 208), (60, 70, 84), (182, 112, 72), (96, 150, 160), (170, 96, 120),
              (110, 110, 70), (210, 120, 90)]
    skins = [(236, 196, 160), (198, 146, 108), (140, 96, 66), (224, 176, 134), (110, 74, 52)]
    hairs = [(50, 36, 28), (120, 80, 40), (30, 28, 30), (196, 160, 100), (90, 60, 40)]
    p0 = (cx - 10, SB + 12)
    p1 = (380, 1390)
    kids = []
    for i in range(N):
        gx, gy = spots[i]
        if i < N - out_n:
            kids.append((gy, gx, 1.1 + 0.05 * (i % 2), 0.0, False, (150, 150, 156), 1.0))
            continue
        j = i - (N - out_n)
        s0 = 0.22 + j * (a1 - 0.04 - 0.22) / max(1, out_n - 1)
        if u < s0:
            continue
        w = clamp((u - s0) / 0.38)
        x = (1 - w) ** 2 * p0[0] + 2 * (1 - w) * w * p1[0] + w * w * gx
        y = (1 - w) ** 2 * p0[1] + 2 * (1 - w) * w * p1[1] + w * w * gy
        kids.append((y, x, 0.8 + 0.3 * w + 0.05 * (i % 2), t * 9 + i, 0 < w < 1,
                     P["accent2"], clamp((u - s0) / 0.02)))
    for k_, (y, x, s, ph, walking, pack, a) in enumerate(sorted(kids, key=lambda r: r[0])):
        _hs_kid(cr, x, y, s, ph, walking, shirts[k_ % 12], skins[(k_ * 3) % 5],
                hairs[(k_ * 2) % 5], pack, a)

    # right by the camera: a schoolbag on the lawn
    _hs_backpack(cr, 820, 1840, 1.3)
    foreground(cr, "town", y0=1560)
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    fy = 1312
    hx = ex + 72
    if u < a0:
        host("point", hx, fy, 300)
    else:
        hands = [(ex - 6, fy - 178 + drop * 0.5), (ex - 6, fy - 118 + drop * 0.6)]
        host("grip", hx, fy, 300, hands=hands,
             lower="follow" if u < 0.22 else "brace", expr="strain")
