segments.illustrated_scene:
# scene standard: 2026-10-16.2
def _bp_brain(cr, cx, cy, rx, ry):
    n = 140
    for i in range(n + 1):
        a = 2 * math.pi * i / n
        r = 1.0 + 0.03 * math.sin(9 * a) + 0.018 * math.sin(15 * a + 1.0)
        s = math.sin(a)
        x = cx + rx * math.cos(a) * r
        y = cy - ry * s * r if s > 0 else cy - ry * s * 0.7 * r
        if i == 0:
            cr.move_to(x, y)
        else:
            cr.line_to(x, y)
    cr.close_path()


def _bp_flake(cr, x, y, s, ang, rgb, a=1.0):
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.rotate(ang)
    cr.move_to(-s, -0.5 * s)
    cr.line_to(0.6 * s, -0.75 * s)
    cr.line_to(s, 0.4 * s)
    cr.line_to(-0.3 * s, 0.7 * s)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(rgb, a))
    cr.fill_preserve()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 30, 40), 0.6 * a))
    cr.set_line_width(1.5)
    cr.stroke()


def _bp_quad(cr, pts_):
    cr.move_to(*pts_[0])
    for p_ in pts_[1:]:
        cr.line_to(*p_)
    cr.close_path()


def _bp_jar(cr, x0, x1, top, base):
    r = 46
    cr.move_to(x0, top)
    cr.line_to(x1, top)
    cr.line_to(x1, base - r)
    cr.curve_to(x1, base, x1, base, x1 - r, base)
    cr.line_to(x0 + r, base)
    cr.curve_to(x0, base, x0, base, x0, base - r)
    cr.close_path()


def _bp_folds(cr, cx, cy, rx, ry, a=0.75):
    cr.save()
    _bp_brain(cr, cx, cy, rx, ry)
    cr.clip()
    y_top = cy - ry
    for i in range(6):
        y0 = y_top + 26 + i * 44
        cr.move_to(cx - rx, y0)
        for s_ in range(1, 41):
            x = cx - rx + s_ * 2 * rx / 40
            cr.line_to(x, y0 + 13 * math.sin(x / 28 + i * 1.7) + 6 * math.sin(x / 11 + i))
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((160, 84, 100), a))
        cr.set_line_width(5)
        cr.stroke()
    cr.move_to(cx - 170, cy + 50)
    cr.curve_to(cx - 90, cy + 5, cx, cy - 15, cx + 100, cy - 55)
    cr.move_to(cx + 30, cy - ry + 5)
    cr.curve_to(cx + 10, cy - 70, cx - 5, cy - 30, cx - 20, cy + 15)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 56, 72), min(1.0, a + 0.15)))
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a human brain in a specimen jar
    SUBSTANCE: colourful plastic fragments
    CAUSE: Data pours a bucket of plastic bits into the jar and they pile up around the brain
    A pathology lab in depth: ceiling lights and side walls running back to
    a window on the city (whatever we breathe), shelves of specimen jars, a
    turning air vent, and on the bench a big glass specimen jar holding a
    human brain. Data climbs a stepladder beside it and tips a bucket of
    bright plastic bits over the rim: they fall in a stream and settle,
    and the plastic rises up the jar around the brain to the 2016 level,
    holds, then he pours again and it climbs to 2024's, about half as much
    again. The 2016 level stays marked on the glass, so the picture makes
    the comparison and no second number is printed. Done by 0.62, held."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    n = len(rows)
    vtop = max(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    a0, a1 = 0.16, 0.62
    span = (a1 - a0) / max(1, n)
    if u < a0:
        k, f, g, cur = 0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
        landed_to = -1
    else:
        k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
        f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
        g = ease(seg(f, 0.12, 0.78))
        prev = rows[k - 1][1] if k > 0 else 0.0
        cur = prev + (rows[k][1] - prev) * g
        landed_to = k if g >= 0.999 else k - 1
    keep = sorted({round(i * (n - 1) / max(1, READOUT_SHOWS - 1))
                   for i in range(READOUT_SHOWS)}) if n > READOUT_SHOWS else list(range(n))
    named = max((i for i in keep if i <= landed_to), default=None)
    pouring = a0 <= u < a1 and 0.04 < f < 0.8

    # the jar and the brain in it
    JX0, JX1, JT, JB = 330, 870, 770, 1250
    IB, IT = JB - 14, JT + 30
    CX, CY, RX, RY = 590, 1050, 210, 150

    def level_y(v):
        return IB - 0.85 * (IB - IT) * v / vtop

    # the room: back wall, floor, ceiling and two side walls running into it
    BW0, BW1, CT, FB = 130, 1010, 420, 1290
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (196, 202, 206)), (1, (226, 228, 228))], 0, FB)
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (150, 150, 152)), (1, (92, 94, 100))], FB, H)
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(0, FB, W, H - FB)
    cr.clip()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 72, 78), 0.3))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(15):
        cr.move_to(570, 860)
        cr.line_to(-1100 + i * 230, H)
    for i in range(6):
        yy = FB + 18 * (1.55 ** i)
        cr.move_to(0, yy)
        cr.line_to(W, yy)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()
    glow(cr, 560, 1400, 520, (255, 246, 226), 0.18)

    # the window on the city: the air we breathe is out there
    WX0, WX1, WY0, WY1 = 200, 840, 610, 1060
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(WX0, WY0, WX1 - WX0, WY1 - WY0)
    cr.clip()
    landscape(cr, t, "town", horizon=990)
    haze(cr, WY0, WY1, (214, 222, 230), a=0.45)
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((84, 90, 100)))
    cr.set_line_width(14)
    cr.rectangle(WX0, WY0, WX1 - WX0, WY1 - WY0)

    # the shelf of specimen jars and the vent beside the window
    box(cr, 880, 880, 120, 16, (150, 132, 110), depth=24)
    for j in range(3):
        cylinder(cr, 886 + j * 38, 864, 30, 62, (196, 214, 210), finish="glass")
    box(cr, 880, 740, 120, 16, (150, 132, 110), depth=24)
    for j in range(3):
        cylinder(cr, 888 + j * 38, 724, 28, 54, (210, 200, 170), finish="glass")
    fx, fy = 945, 1100
    cr.arc(fx, fy, 58, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    solid(cr, (200, 204, 210), finish="metal")
    cr.arc(fx, fy, 46, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((38, 42, 50)))
    cr.fill()
    for b in range(3):
        ang = t * 7.5 + b * 2 * math.pi / 3
        cr.move_to(fx, fy)
        cr.arc(fx, fy, 43, ang - 0.38, ang + 0.38)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (214, 218, 224), finish="metal", rim=False)
    disc(cr, fx, fy, 9, (120, 124, 132), finish="metal")

    # side walls and ceiling, closing the room around the far wall
    _bp_quad(cr, [(0, 0), (BW0, CT), (BW0, FB), (0, FB + 150)])
    solid(cr, (176, 182, 188), edge=False)
    _bp_quad(cr, [(W, 0), (BW1, CT), (BW1, FB), (W, FB + 150)])
    solid(cr, (168, 174, 180), edge=False)
    _bp_quad(cr, [(0, 0), (W, 0), (BW1, CT), (BW0, CT)])
    solid(cr, (138, 140, 146), edge=False)
    for i in range(3):
        z = i / 3.0
        y_ = 60 + 330 * z
        hw_ = 300 - 200 * z
        glow(cr, 570, y_ + 20, 220 - 120 * z, (255, 244, 214), 0.45)
        _bp_quad(cr, [(570 - hw_, y_), (570 + hw_, y_),
                      (570 + hw_ * 0.85, y_ + 50 - 30 * z), (570 - hw_ * 0.85, y_ + 50 - 30 * z)])
        solid(cr, (248, 246, 236), rim=False)
    haze(cr, CT, FB, (220, 224, 228), a=0.18)

    # the bench, in three-quarter
    cast_shadow(cr, 290, 910, 1440, length=280, a=0.25)
    contact_shadow(cr, 600, 1444, 640, a=0.4)
    box(cr, 290, 1440, 590, 170, (150, 156, 166), depth=120, finish="metal")

    _bp_jar(cr, JX0, JX1, JT, JB)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((200, 224, 222), 0.45))
    cr.fill()
    cr.save()
    cr.translate((JX0 + JX1) / 2, JT)
    cr.scale(1, 0.14)
    cr.arc(0, 0, (JX1 - JX0) / 2, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 140, 146), 0.6))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    cr.stroke()

    # the brain inside: stem, cerebellum, cerebrum
    cr.move_to(CX + 60, CY + 90)
    cr.curve_to(CX + 68, CY + 140, CX + 76, CY + 170, CX + 80, IB)
    cr.line_to(CX + 128, IB)

        cr.line_to(JX1, H)

        cr.clip()
        vgrad(cr, [(0, (236, 226, 214)), (1, (200, 188, 176))], ly - 20, IB, JX0, JX1)
        for i in range(260):

    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((90, 110, 118), 0.9))
    cr.set_line_width(7)

    # THE SCALE on the glass: where 2016's plastic reached
    if n > 1 and k >= 1 and cur > rows[0][1] * 1.02:
        then_mark(cr, JX0 + 20, JX1 - 20, level_y(rows[0][1]), rows[0][0])

    # the stepladder he climbs to pour
    contact_shadow(cr, 145, 1504, 200, a=0.35)
    for (xb, xt) in ((70, 110), (220, 190)):

        cr.line_to(xt + 9, 900)

stories.title: Every American Is Now $116,480 In Debt
stories.hook: You're personally in debt. You never signed for it.

stories.question: Did you know you personally owed that much? React below.

stories.title: Everest Isn't the Highest Point on Earth
stories.hook: Everest has been getting credit that belongs to two other mountains.
stories.closing: Highest depends on where you start measuring, so check the starting line before you trust a record.
stories.question: Which mountain is the real winner?
stories.caption: Everest is 8,849 meters above sea level - and still loses twice. Mauna Kea is 10,211 meters from its base on the Pacific floor, and because Earth bulges 21 kilometers at the equator, Chimborazo's summit sits about 2 kilometers farther from the planet's center than Everest's does. Highest, tallest and farthest are three different questions. Which one counts? 👇

segments.say: Everest, at 8,849 meters, tops every list because we measure from sea level. Change the starting line, and the winner changes.

segments.illustrated_scene:
# scene standard: 2026-10-16.2
def _mk_y(x, cx, base, h, hw):
    d = abs(x - cx) / hw
    if d >= 1.0:
        return base
    side = 1.0 if x >= cx else -1.0
    s = (1.0 - d) ** 1.25                                   # concave flanks: a peak
    s += 0.045 * math.exp(-((d - 0.15) / 0.035) ** 2)       # cinder cones on the summit
    s += 0.03 * math.exp(-((d - 0.30) / 0.03) ** 2) * (1.0 if side > 0 else 0.6)
    s += 0.014 * math.sin(d * 41.0 + side * 1.3) * (1.0 - d)  # crags along the ridge
    return base - h * clamp(s, 0.0, 1.0)


def _mk_path(cr, cx, base, h, hw):
    cr.move_to(cx - hw - 80, base + 6)
    for i in range(121):
        x = cx - hw + 2 * hw * i / 120
        cr.line_to(x, _mk_y(x, cx, base, h, hw))
    cr.line_to(cx + hw + 80, base + 6)
    cr.close_path()


def _flank_x(y, cx, base, h, hw):
    lo, hi = cx, cx + hw
    for _ in range(32):
        m = (lo + hi) / 2
        if _mk_y(m, cx, base, h, hw) < y:
            lo = m
        else:
            hi = m
    return (lo + hi) / 2


def _snow_y(x, top):
    return top + 150 + 30 * math.sin(x * 0.09) + 18 * math.sin(x * 0.23 + 1.0)


def _water(cr, y, t, amp=7.0):
    cr.move_to(0, H)
    cr.line_to(0, y)
    for i in range(37):
        x = W * i / 36
        cr.line_to(x, y + amp * math.sin(x * 0.018 + t * 2.6) + 0.5 * amp * math.sin(x * 0.041 - t * 3.3))
    cr.line_to(W, H)
    cr.close_path()


def _boulder(cr, x, y, r, seed):
    cr.new_path()
    for i in range(9):
        a = math.pi + math.pi * i / 8
        rr = r * (0.82 + 0.18 * math.sin(seed * 3.1 + i * 1.7))
        cr.line_to(x + rr * 1.25 * math.cos(a), y + rr * 0.9 * math.sin(a))
    cr.close_path()


def _cloud(cr, x, y, s):
    for j, (ox, oy, r) in enumerate(((0, 0, 50), (55, -22, 62), (118, 0, 48), (60, 14, 52))):
        cr.new_path()
        cr.arc(x + ox * s, y + oy * s, r * s, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        solid(cr, (246, 247, 250), a=0.9, edge=False, rim=j == 1)


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a snow-capped volcanic mountain
    SUBSTANCE: the ocean water
    CAUSE: Data opens drain valves down the mountain's flank and the sea drains away, valve by valve
    A cutaway of the Pacific: Mauna Kea, a big jagged snow-capped volcano
    with observatory domes on its summit, lit from the left and in shadow
    on the right, stands on the ocean floor with only its top above the
    waves. Behind it the basin falls away in hazy undersea ridges, and kelp
    and boulders sit on the seabed right by the camera. Data walks down the
    RIGHT flank along a drain pipe, turning one handwheel valve at a time;
    at each turn the sea drops, until the whole mountain stands bare from
    seafloor to summit. The old sea level stays marked off the LEFT flank,
    and Everest's height is marked on the same mountain, below its summit.
    Done by 0.56 and held; clouds drift behind the peak, kelp sways, the
    last of the water laps at the base and Data keeps cranking."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    total_r = next((r for r in rows if "floor" in r[0].lower()), max(rows, key=lambda r: r[1]))
    above_r = next((r for r in rows if "above" in r[0].lower()), min(rows, key=lambda r: r[1]))
    ev_r = next((r for r in rows if "everest" in r[0].lower()), None)
    total = total_r[1] or 1.0
    above = above_r[1]

    CX, BASE, TOP, HW = 480, 1490, 715, 540
    HM = BASE - TOP
    kpx = HM / total
    SEA = TOP + above * kpx
    END = BASE - 22

    n = 3
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.56
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    drop = ease(seg(f, 0.25, 0.75))
    frac = 0.0 if u < a0 else (k + drop) / n
    wl = SEA + (END - SEA) * frac
    done = u >= a0 and k == n - 1 and drop >= 0.999

    # the setting: sky and far islands over the sea
    landscape(cr, t, "coast", horizon=int(SEA))
    # clouds drift BEHIND the peak, never across it
    for i in range(3):
        cx_ = (t * 70 + i * 520) % 1560 - 260
        _cloud(cr, cx_, 790 + 60 * (i % 2), 1.0 - 0.15 * (i % 2))
    haze(cr, 600, SEA, (206, 214, 228), a=0.3)

    # the ocean basin in cutaway: undersea ridges falling away into the deep
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (92, 100, 112)), (1, (52, 56, 66))], SEA, BASE + 10)
    for base_, amp, sd, rgb in ((SEA + 130, 70, 1.0, (98, 96, 98)),
                                (SEA + 270, 90, 2.3, (112, 100, 90)),
                                (SEA + 390, 70, 3.7, (124, 106, 88))):
        ridge(cr, base_, amp, seed=sd, n=5)
        solid(cr, rgb, edge=False)
    haze(cr, SEA, BASE, (150, 172, 196), a=0.4)
    # the seafloor
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (132, 114, 90)), (1, (78, 66, 54))], BASE, H)

    # the volcano, standing on the ocean floor
    cast_shadow(cr, CX - HW, CX + HW, BASE, length=260, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, CX, BASE + 4, 2 * HW + 80, a=0.45)
    _mk_path(cr, CX, BASE, HM, HW)
    solid(cr, (128, 92, 76))
    cr.save()
    _mk_path(cr, CX, BASE, HM, HW)
    cr.clip()
    cr.new_path()
    # the shadow face: everything right of the summit ridge turns away from the sun
    cr.move_to(CX - 6, TOP - 20)
    cr.curve_to(CX + 30, TOP + 260, CX + 10, BASE - 300, CX + 90, BASE + 20)
    cr.line_to(W + 40, BASE + 20)
    cr.line_to(W + 40, TOP - 20)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 20, 24), 0.34))
    cr.fill()
    # rock ridges and gullies running from the summit down both flanks
    for i in range(11):
        sx = CX - 250 + i * 50
        top_y = _mk_y(sx, CX, BASE, HM, HW)
        lean = (sx - CX) / 250.0
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((64, 44, 40), 0.6))
        cr.set_line_width(6)
        cr.move_to(sx, top_y + 10)
        cr.curve_to(sx + lean * 60, top_y + 180, sx + lean * 170, top_y + 380,
                    sx + lean * 320, BASE)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((190, 150, 126), 0.35))
        cr.set_line_width(3)
        cr.move_to(sx - 8, top_y + 14)
        cr.curve_to(sx - 8 + lean * 60, top_y + 180, sx - 8 + lean * 170, top_y + 380,
                    sx - 8 + lean * 320, BASE)
        cr.stroke()
    # the wet, darker rock the sea has just let go of
    cr.rectangle(0, SEA, W, BASE - SEA + 20)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 50, 60), 0.18))
    cr.fill()
    # the snowcap, with a ragged lower edge running down into the gullies
    cr.move_to(0, 0)
    cr.line_to(W, 0)
    for i in range(61):
        x = W - W * i / 60
        cr.line_to(x, _snow_y(x, TOP))
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (242, 244, 250), finish="gloss", rim=False)
    cr.move_to(CX - 4, TOP - 20)
    cr.curve_to(CX + 30, TOP + 80, CX + 40, TOP + 140, CX + 60, TOP + 230)
    cr.line_to(W, TOP + 230)
    cr.line_to(W, TOP - 20)
    cr.close_path()

    xs = _flank_x(SEA - 10, CX, BASE, HM, HW)

    levels = [SEA + (END - SEA) * i / n for i in range(n)]

    cr.save()

    cr.fill()

    for i in range(37):

        else:

    cr.stroke()

    # the drain gushing out at the right edge while it runs
    gush = 0.0 if u < a0 else seg(f, 0.25, 0.75) * (1 - seg(f, 0.7, 0.8))
    if gush > 0:

    for i in range(6):

    for i, (bx, by, br) in enumerate(((150, 1740, 70), (470, 1800, 92), (800, 1730, 64),

    HD = 232

    def spot(i):

stories.title: Why GPS Would Drift 10 Kilometers Without Einstein
stories.hook: Without relativity, GPS misses by 10 kilometers in one day.
stories.closing: Relativity is not abstract here; it is why turn-by-turn directions land on the right street.
stories.question: Would you trust GPS without relativity?
stories.caption: A GPS satellite clock gains 38 microseconds a day on yours - weaker gravity speeds it up 45, orbital speed drags 7 back. Ignore that and your position slides about 10 kilometers off in a single day, so every satellite is launched running deliberately slow. That correction is why your blue dot lands within 4.9 meters. Did you know your phone runs on relativity? 👇

segments.say: GPS satellite clocks gain 38 microseconds each day, enough to make tiny timing errors grow into navigation errors.

scene.concept: 45 real microsecond-cells light up one at a time under the satellite as gravity pulls its clock ahead, then orbital speed strikes out the last 7 - the 38 that survive ARE the net gain, counted, not asserted.
scene.code:
sat = subject_image('satellite orbiting earth')
grav = values[0]
net = values[1]
speed = values[2]
cols = 9
total = int(round(grav))
rows = math.ceil(total / cols)
cell = min((RX1 - RX0 - 60) // cols, 78)
gw = cols * cell
gx0 = (RX0 + RX1) // 2 - gw // 2
gy0 = RTOP + 430
if sat is not None:
    paste(sat, (RX0 + RX1) // 2 - 130, RTOP + 60, 260, 170)
text('each cell = 1 microsecond / day', (RX0 + RX1) // 2, RTOP + 20, size=32, color=SUBTLE, center=True)
fill_phase = clamp(reveal / 0.5)
strike_phase = clamp((reveal - 0.5) / 0.35)
filled = int(round(total * fill_phase))
struck = int(round(speed * strike_phase))
cut_from = max(total - int(round(speed)), 0)
for i in range(total):
    r = i // cols
    c = i % cols
    x = gx0 + c * cell
    y = gy0 + r * cell
    on = i < filled
    removed = on and i >= cut_from and (i - cut_from) < struck
    if removed:
        d.rounded_rectangle([x + 3, y + 3, x + cell - 3, y + cell - 3], radius=8, fill=rgba(WARN, 90))
        d.line([x + 6, y + 6, x + cell - 6, y + cell - 6], fill=rgba(WARN, 235), width=4)
        d.line([x + cell - 6, y + 6, x + 6, y + cell - 6], fill=rgba(WARN, 235), width=4)
    elif on:

    else:
        d.rounded_rectangle([x + 3, y + 3, x + cell - 3, y + cell - 3], radius=8, outline=rgba(REST, 110), width=2)
kept = min(filled, cut_from) + max(0, min(filled, total) - cut_from - struck)
text(fmt(grav) + ' gravity', gx0, gy0 - 70, size=30, color=HIGHLIGHT)
text('-' + fmt(speed) + ' speed', gx0 + gw - 260, gy0 - 70, size=30, color=WARN)
text('net ' + fmt(kept) + ' / day', (RX0 + RX1) // 2, gy0 + rows * cell + 60, size=44, color=ACCENT, center=True)

stories.title: One Lake Gets Lightning 297 Nights a Year
stories.hook: Lightning avoids water. Nobody told this lake.
stories.closing: That lake has basically forgotten how to switch the sky off.
stories.question: What's the wildest storm you've ever sat through? Tell me below.
stories.caption: About 90% of the world's lightning strikes land, not water - so the single most lightning-struck spot on Earth should not be a lake. It is. Lake Maracaibo in Venezuela takes 232.5 flashes per square kilometer every year and storms on 297 nights, because warm lake water meets cold air falling off the Andes after dark. What's the wildest storm you've sat through? 👇

segments.say: Lightning is a land thing. About 90 percent of the world's flashes hit land and only 10 percent hit ocean, because land heats fast and water barely warms at all.

stories.closing: Even a few unprotected kids can reopen the door, so every vaccine keeps your town safe.

def _ms_rrect(cr, x, y, w, h, r):

    cr.arc(x + r, y + r, r, math.pi, 1.5 * math.pi)
    cr.close_path()


def _ms_head(seat):
    j, c, x, sy, r = seat
    return x, sy - 3.15 * r


def _ms_fan(cr, seat, coat, sick, t, cough=False):
    j, c, x, sy, r = seat
    _ms_rrect(cr, x - 1.25 * r, sy - 2.3 * r, 2.5 * r, 2.3 * r, 0.8 * r)
    solid(cr, coat)
    hx, hy = x, sy - 3.15 * r + 2.0 * math.sin(t * 1.7 + c + 3 * j)
    skin = tuple(int(p + (q - p) * 0.55 * sick) for p, q in zip((228, 190, 156), (236, 146, 124)))
    if sick > 0:
        glow(cr, hx, hy, r * 1.8, (230, 70, 60), 0.4 * sick)
    disc(cr, hx, hy, r, skin)
    cr.arc(hx, hy - r * 0.12, r * 1.03, math.pi * 1.05, math.pi * 1.95)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((54, 40, 34)))
    cr.fill()
    nsp = int(round(12 * sick))
    for q in range(nsp):
        ang = q * 2.39996
        rr = r * (0.18 + 0.6 * ((q * 0.618) % 1.0))
        cr.arc(hx + math.cos(ang) * rr, hy + 0.22 * r + math.sin(ang) * rr * 0.62,
               r * 0.17, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((172, 22, 26)))
        cr.fill()
    if cough:
        cr.arc(hx + 0.35 * r, hy + 0.5 * r, r * 0.22, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 20, 20)))
        cr.fill()


def _ms_vendor(cr, x, foot, h, t):
    contact_shadow(cr, x, foot, h * 0.5, a=0.35)
    sw = math.sin(t * 6.0) * h * 0.06
    for sg in (-1, 1):
        cr.rectangle(x + sg * sw - 0.045 * h, foot - 0.45 * h, 0.09 * h, 0.45 * h)
        solid(cr, (48, 50, 60), rim=False)
    _ms_rrect(cr, x - 0.17 * h, foot - 0.86 * h, 0.34 * h, 0.46 * h, 0.08 * h)
    solid(cr, (238, 234, 226))
    box(cr, x - 0.26 * h, foot - 0.5 * h, 0.52 * h, 0.07 * h, (200, 156, 70), depth=0.1 * h)
    for m in range(4):
        bx = x - 0.22 * h + m * 0.12 * h
        box(cr, bx, foot - 0.57 * h, 0.08 * h, 0.1 * h, (204, 44, 40), depth=0.03 * h)
        disc(cr, bx + 0.04 * h, foot - 0.68 * h, 0.035 * h, (250, 236, 180))
    disc(cr, x, foot - 0.95 * h, 0.09 * h, (226, 186, 152))
    cr.arc(x, foot - 0.97 * h, 0.095 * h, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (200, 40, 36))


def _ms_cloud(cr, cx, cy, R, t):
    if R <= 2:
        return
    for m in range(12):
        ang = m * 2.39996
        rr = R * (0.2 + 0.55 * ((m * 0.618) % 1.0))
        px = cx + math.cos(ang) * rr * 1.1 + 8 * math.sin(t * 1.1 + m)
        py = cy + math.sin(ang) * rr * 0.6
        cr.arc(px, py, R * 0.45, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((206, 130, 120), 0.14))
        cr.fill()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a ballpark grandstand of fans
    SUBSTANCE: red measles spots
    CAUSE: Data pumps a bellows at each sick fan's cough, blowing it along the rows so the faces it reaches break out in red spots
    One grandstand, two sections side by side across an aisle, one coughing
    sick fan in each. First Data pumps the bellows at the flu section's
    sick fan: the cough reaches ONE neighbour. Then he walks over to the
    measles section and pumps again, pump after pump, and the cough rolls
    out until fifteen faces are spotted. THE SCALE is the stand itself: the
    flu side's lone catch ringed as a ghost, the measles side a red block
    of fifteen with clean fans left at its edge — one against fifteen in a
    single look. Done by 0.62 and held; Data keeps pumping, the vendor walks."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    hi_l, vm = max(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    lo_l, vf = min(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])

    # the stand: five rows, two seats of flu, an aisle, five seats of measles
    seats = []
    for j in range(5):
        s = 1.0 - 0.05 * j
        fy = 1400 - 105 * j
        for c in range(7):
            bx = 150 + c * 120 + (60 if c >= 2 else 0)
            x = 540 + (bx - 540) * s
            seats.append((j, c, x, fy, 27 * s))
    idx_of = {(sd[0], sd[1]): i for i, sd in enumerate(seats)}
    FLU_SICK = idx_of[(2, 0)]
    MEA_SICK = idx_of[(2, 4)]

    def _near(src, pool):
        sx_, sy_ = _ms_head(seats[src])
        return sorted(pool, key=lambda i: math.hypot(_ms_head(seats[i])[0] - sx_,
                                                     _ms_head(seats[i])[1] - sy_))
    flu_pool = [i for i, sd in enumerate(seats) if sd[1] < 2 and i != FLU_SICK]
    mea_pool = [i for i, sd in enumerate(seats) if sd[1] >= 2 and i != MEA_SICK]
    flu_order = _near(FLU_SICK, flu_pool)
    mea_order = _near(MEA_SICK, mea_pool)
    NF = max(1, min(len(flu_order), int(round(vf))))
    NM = max(1, min(len(mea_order), int(round(vm))))

    # the clock: flu first, then the walk, then measles pump by pump
    fa0, fa1 = 0.06, 0.16
    ma0, ma1 = 0.22, 0.62
    flu_reach = NF * ease(seg(u, fa0 + 0.03, fa1))
    npump = 5
    span = (ma1 - ma0) / npump
    k = int(clamp((u - ma0) / span, 0, npump - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - ma0 - k * span) / span)
    grow = ease(seg(f, 0.2, 0.75))
    mea_reach = 0.0 if u < ma0 else min(float(NM), NM / npump * (k + grow))
    flu_done = u >= fa1
    mea_done = u >= ma1

    sick_of = {}
    for p, o in enumerate(flu_order):
        sick_of[o] = clamp(flu_reach - p) if p < NF else 0.0
    for p, o in enumerate(mea_order):
        sick_of[o] = clamp(mea_reach - p) if p < NM else 0.0

    COATS = [(64, 110, 170), (214, 168, 70), (96, 140, 96), (150, 84, 140),
             (200, 120, 70), (80, 150, 160), (120, 120, 132), (60, 90, 140)]

    # the ballpark under a low sun, the stand in three-quarter
    landscape(cr, t, "field")
    birds(cr, t, y0=680, n=4, rgb=(60, 60, 70))
    cast_shadow(cr, 60, 1010, 1440, length=320, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, 535, 1444, 1000, a=0.4)
    b = building(cr, 60, 1010, 1440, 640, (206, 196, 176), roof_rgb=(70, 84, 104),
                 roof="flat", boards=False)
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (52, 46, 44)), (1, (104, 92, 80))], b["top"] + 60, 1440,
          b["x0"] + 22, b["x1"] - 22)
    glow(cr, 535, 1440, 480, (240, 200, 140), 0.18)

    # rows back to front: riser, fans, bench plank — each section its own bench
    for j in reversed(range(5)):
        row = [seats[idx_of[(j, c)]] for c in range(7)]
        r = row[0][4]
        fy = row[0][3]
        for c0, c1 in ((0, 1), (2, 6)):
            xa = row[c0][2] - 1.7 * r
            xb = row[c1][2] + 1.7 * r
            box(cr, xa, fy + 40, xb - xa, 40, (150, 144, 136), depth=22)
        for c in range(7):
            i = idx_of[(j, c)]
            if i in (FLU_SICK, MEA_SICK):
                _ms_fan(cr, seats[i], (110, 104, 112), 1.0, t, cough=True)
            else:
                _ms_fan(cr, seats[i], COATS[i % len(COATS)], sick_of.get(i, 0.0), t)
        for c0, c1 in ((0, 1), (2, 6)):
            xa = row[c0][2] - 1.7 * r
            xb = row[c1][2] + 1.7 * r
            box(cr, xa, fy + 14, xb - xa, 20, (176, 124, 76), depth=22)
    for px in (78, 968):
        cylinder(cr, px, 1440, 24, 620, (150, 156, 166), finish="metal")

    # the section banners over each block of seats
    fl_x0 = seats[idx_of[(4, 0)]][2] - 50
    fl_x1 = seats[idx_of[(4, 1)]][2] + 50
    me_x0 = seats[idx_of[(4, 2)]][2] - 50
    me_x1 = seats[idx_of[(4, 6)]][2] + 50
    box(cr, fl_x0, 856, fl_x1 - fl_x0, 44, (90, 98, 112), depth=14)
    box(cr, me_x0, 856, me_x1 - me_x0, 44, (150, 40, 36), depth=14)
    text(cr, lo_l.upper(), (fl_x0 + fl_x1) / 2, 888, 22, look.INK, anchor="center", shadow=False)
    text(cr, hi_l.upper(), (me_x0 + me_x1) / 2, 890, 30, look.INK, anchor="center", shadow=False)

    # the coughs, blown out by the bellows: flu's barely reaches a neighbour
    fx_, fy_ = _ms_head(seats[FLU_SICK])
    fR = 40 + 30 * ease(seg(u, 0.0, fa0)) + 90 * (flu_reach / NF)
    _ms_cloud(cr, fx_, fy_, fR, t)
    mx_, my_ = _ms_head(seats[MEA_SICK])
    if u < ma0:
        mR = 40 + 20 * math.sin(t * 1.3) ** 2
    else:
        p_ = int(min(mea_reach, NM - 0.001))
        far = [math.hypot(_ms_head(seats[o])[0] - mx_, _ms_head(seats[o])[1] - my_)
               for o in mea_order[:NM]]
        lo = far[p_ - 1] if p_ > 0 else 0.0
        mR = 70 + lo + (far[p_] - lo) * (mea_reach - p_)
    _ms_cloud(cr, mx_, my_, mR, t)

    # flu's one catch, ringed: the scale beside measles' fifteen
    ga = ease(seg(u, fa1, fa1 + 0.05))
    if ga > 0:
        gx, gy = _ms_head(seats[flu_order[0]])
        gr = seats[flu_order[0]][4]
        cr.arc(gx, gy, gr + 16, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        ghost(cr, a=0.9 * ga)

    # right by the camera: the vendor walking the front, a dropped popcorn box
    vx = -220 + ((t * 240) % 1520)
    _ms_vendor(cr, vx, 1905, 420, t)
    contact_shadow(cr, 930, 1830, 120, a=0.35)
    box(cr, 880, 1830, 96, 120, (204, 44, 40), depth=26)
    for m in range(3):
        cr.rectangle(892 + m * 30, 1716, 12, 110)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((244, 238, 226), 0.9))
        cr.fill()
    for m in range(5):
        disc(cr, 892 + m * 18, 1706 - (m % 2) * 10, 14, (250, 236, 180))
    foreground(cr, "field")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data: bellows at the flu fan, walks the aisle, bellows at the measles fan
    hx = 200 + 420 * ease(seg(u, fa1 + 0.01, ma0 - 0.01))
    if u < fa0:
        host("point", hx, 1490, 220)
    elif u < fa1 + 0.01:
        host("pump", hx, 1490, 220, beat=0)
    elif u < ma0:
        host("think", hx, 1490, 220)
    elif u < ma1 + 0.04:
        host("pump", hx, 1490, 220, beat=1 + k)
    else:
        host("pump", hx, 1490, 220, beat=1 + npump + int((u - ma1 - 0.04) / 0.14))

    if mea_done:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(vm))} people", f"infected by one {hi_l.lower()} case",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, ma1, ma1 + 0.05)), size=130)
        text(cr, f"{lo_l.lower()}: {vf:g}", (fl_x0 + fl_x1) / 2, 820, 32, look.INK,
             anchor="center", alpha=ease(seg(u, ma1, ma1 + 0.05)))
    elif flu_done:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{vf:g} people", f"infected by one {lo_l.lower()} case",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, fa1, fa1 + 0.04)), size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "One sick fan", f"{lo_l.lower()} vs {hi_l.lower()}", 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

# scene standard: 2026-10-09
def _ms_slots(N):
    ss = [0.8 * (2.2 / 0.8) ** (i / (N - 1)) for i in range(N)]
    tot = sum(ss)
    out, c = [], 0.0
    for s in ss:
        c += s / 2
        q = c / tot
        c += s / 2
        out.append((980 + (90 - 980) * q, 1210 + (1480 - 1210) * q, s))
    return out

    cr.line_to(x, y - h)
    cr.line_to(x + w / 2, y - h + w * 0.6)

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a brick school building
    SUBSTANCE: white fence pickets
    CAUSE: Data hammers pickets into the fence around the school one by one, but it stops short with a gap
    The school is what is being protected: a wide two-storey brick
    elementary school with a flat roof, rows of windows, a bell cupola and a
    flagpole. The whole is the one fence of forty pickets around its yard,
    running from the far corner right up to the camera. Ninety-five percent
    of the fence has to stand to keep measles out; the pickets that would
    close it are dashed ghosts in the accent. Data hammers the fence in from
    the far corner toward the camera until it reaches the kindergartners'
    coverage share, and the gap by the camera stays open. Done by 0.62 and

segments.say: US cases grew about nine times over in two years. A small gap in protection let each outbreak snowball.

scene.concept: each year's case count erupts as a swirling swarm of red spot markers along a rising path -- the swarm barely visible in 2021-2024, exploding by 2026

gx0, gx1 = RX0 + 70, RX1 - 70

# scene standard: 2026-10-09
def _patient(cr, x, y, s, i, t, a=1.0):
    """A sick person: lit legs and shoes, a shirt with shoulders and both
    arms, a head with hair, eyes, a tired mouth, flushed cheeks and a few
    small red measles spots on the face."""
    shirts = [(74, 108, 160), (150, 156, 166), (188, 150, 84), (96, 132, 104),
              (170, 92, 80), (110, 96, 140), (200, 196, 186)]
    pants = [(52, 58, 74), (70, 62, 54), (40, 44, 52), (88, 84, 96)]
    skins = [(236, 196, 164), (196, 148, 112), (150, 104, 76), (226, 180, 140)]
    hairs = [(40, 30, 26), (92, 60, 36), (170, 130, 80), (30, 30, 34), (120, 112, 104)]
    h = 80.0 * s
    bw = 30.0 * s
    hip = y - h * 0.36
    sy = y - h * 0.62
    skin = skins[(i * 3) % len(skins)]
    shirt = shirts[i % len(shirts)]
    # legs, slightly apart, and shoes
    for lx in (x - bw * 0.27, x + bw * 0.05):
        cr.move_to(lx, hip)
        cr.line_to(lx + bw * 0.23, hip)
        cr.line_to(lx + bw * 0.21, y - 3 * s)
        cr.line_to(lx + bw * 0.02, y - 3 * s)
        cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, pants[i % len(pants)], a=a, rim=False)
    for lx in (x - bw * 0.3, x + bw * 0.04):
        cr.rectangle(lx, y - 4 * s, bw * 0.3, 4 * s)
    solid(cr, (34, 30, 30), a=a, rim=False, edge=False)
    # arms hang at the sides, sleeves then hands
    for side in (-1, 1):
        ax = x + side * bw * 0.5
        cr.move_to(ax, sy + bw * 0.02)
        cr.line_to(ax + side * bw * 0.16, sy + bw * 0.1)
        cr.line_to(ax + side * bw * 0.12, hip + 4 * s)
        cr.line_to(ax - side * bw * 0.04, hip + 4 * s)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, shirt, a=a, rim=False)
        disc(cr, ax + side * bw * 0.04, hip + 7 * s, 3.6 * s, skin, a=a)
    # torso with rounded shoulders
    cr.move_to(x - bw / 2, hip + 2 * s)
    cr.line_to(x - bw / 2, sy + bw * 0.25)
    cr.curve_to(x - bw / 2, sy - bw * 0.05, x - bw * 0.3, sy - bw * 0.12, x, sy - bw * 0.12)
    cr.curve_to(x + bw * 0.3, sy - bw * 0.12, x + bw / 2, sy - bw * 0.05, x + bw / 2, sy + bw * 0.25)
    cr.line_to(x + bw / 2, hip + 2 * s)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, shirt, a=a)
    hy = sy - bw * 0.12 - 11 * s
    # neck and head
    cr.rectangle(x - 3.5 * s, hy + 6 * s, 7 * s, 8 * s)
    solid(cr, skin, a=a, rim=False, edge=False)
    disc(cr, x, hy, 12 * s, skin, a=a)
    # hair cap
    cr.arc(x, hy, 12.6 * s, math.pi * 1.02, math.pi * 1.98)
    cr.curve_to(x + 8 * s, hy - 6 * s, x - 8 * s, hy - 7 * s, x - 12.4 * s, hy - 1 * s)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, hairs[(i * 7) % len(hairs)], a=a, rim=False)
    # a fevered flush on the cheeks
    for cx_ in (x - 6 * s, x + 6 * s):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((230, 90, 80), 0.35 * a))
        cr.arc(cx_, hy + 4 * s, 4 * s, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()
    # tired eyes and a flat mouth
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 24, 24), a))
    for ex in (x - 4.2 * s, x + 4.2 * s):
        cr.arc(ex, hy + 0.5 * s, 1.5 * s, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()
    cr.set_line_width(max(1.0, 1.1 * s))
    cr.move_to(x - 3 * s, hy + 7 * s)
    cr.curve_to(x - 1 * s, hy + 6 * s, x + 1 * s, hy + 6 * s, x + 3 * s, hy + 7 * s)
    cr.stroke()
    # measles: a few small spots, forehead, cheeks, chin, neck
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((196, 36, 40), 0.95 * a))

        cr.arc(x + dx * s, hy + dy * s, 1.25 * s, 0, 2 * math.pi)

def _slot(s):
    """The queue outside the gate, running from the gap to the camera."""
    return 300 - 40 * s, 1565 + 78 * s, 1.9 + 0.3 * s


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a hospital yard filling with sick people
    SUBSTANCE: crowds of spotted measles patients
    CAUSE: Data cranks the hospital gate open wider and spotted patients pour through the gap into the yard
    The small gap is a gate in the hospital wall. Each turn of Data's crank
    slides it further open, the queue of red-spotted patients shuffles up
    and the one at the front walks through into the yard, and the crowd
    there spreads: its area is the case count, from the year before the
    jump to the latest. THE SCALE is on the ground: the old crowd stays as
    a dashed ring with its year, inside the one that is now about nine
    times as big. The readout names only the start and the finish, each
    held long enough to read."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    if len(rows) > 1:
        j = max(range(1, len(rows)),
                key=lambda i: rows[i][1] / max(1.0, rows[i - 1][1]))
    else:
        j = 0
    l0, v0 = rows[max(0, j - 1)]
    l1, v1 = rows[-1]
    v0 = v0 or 1.0
    v1 = max(v1, v0)
    ratio = v1 / v0
    n = 6
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.6
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    if u < a0:
        f = 0.0
    grow = ease(seg(f, 0.4, 0.85))
    step = 0.0 if u < a0 else (k + grow) / n
    val = v0 + (v1 - v0) * step
    done = u >= a0 and k == n - 1 and grow >= 0.999

    # the yard crowd: its area is the case count
    CX, CY = 610, 1230
    RX1, RY1 = 440.0, 165.0
    NMAX = 120
    nf = NMAX * val / v1
    rx0 = RX1 * math.sqrt(v0 / v1)
    ry0 = RY1 * math.sqrt(v0 / v1)
    WT, WB = 1400, 1482                       # the yard wall, top and base

    landscape(cr, t, "town", horizon=1040)
    birds(cr, t, y0=700, n=4, rgb=(60, 60, 70))

    # the yard: paved concrete with painted bay lines running back
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (184, 178, 166)), (1, (156, 150, 140))], 1040, WT)
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(0, 1040, W, WT - 1040)
    cr.clip()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 114, 104), 0.35))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(12):
        cr.move_to(540 + (i - 5.5) * 40, 1040)
        cr.line_to(540 + (i - 5.5) * 230, WT)
    for yy in (1090, 1160, 1260, 1380):
        cr.move_to(0, yy)
        cr.line_to(W, yy)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()

    # the hospital behind the yard, three-quarter, throwing its shadow
    cast_shadow(cr, 300, 900, 1040, length=220, a=0.28)
    b = building(cr, 290, 880, 1040, 290, (232, 228, 220), roof_rgb=(150, 154, 162),
                 roof="flat", boards=False)
    for r in range(2):
        for c in range(5):
            wx = b["x0"] + 40 + c * 112
            wy = b["top"] + 92 + r * 78
            cr.rectangle(wx, wy, 66, 50)
            solid(cr, (120, 160, 196), finish="glass")
    cr.rectangle(b["x0"] + 40, b["top"] + 22, 32, 76)
    cr.rectangle(b["x0"] + 18, b["top"] + 44, 76, 32)
    solid(cr, (204, 34, 38), edge=False)
    text(cr, "HOSPITAL", b["x0"] + 112, b["top"] + 76, 46, (204, 34, 38),
         shadow=False)
    # the emergency entrance: glass doors under a red canopy
    cr.rectangle(b["x1"] - 200, 1040 - 96, 140, 96)
    solid(cr, (130, 170, 200), finish="glass")
    box(cr, b["x1"] - 226, 1040 - 100, 192, 22, (196, 40, 42), depth=40, finish="gloss")

    # the gate: slides open with every turn of the crank
    GX0, GW = 150, 210
    GX1 = GX0 + GW
    opn = 0.25 + 0.75 * (0.0 if u < a0 else (k + ease(seg(f, 0.0, 0.45))) / n)
    gxm = GX0 + GW * opn * 0.5

    # the queue shuffles up one place a crank; the front one walks in
    m = ease(seg(f, 0.15, 0.55)) if a0 <= u else 0.0
    walk_p = seg(f, 0.0, 0.75) if a0 <= u else 0.0
    if u >= a1:
        walk_p = 1.0
    out = []                                   # (y, x, s, id) outside the wall
    yard = []                                  # (y, x, s, id, alpha) inside
    for s_i in range(6):
        pid = k + s_i + 1
        xa, ya, sa = _slot(s_i + 1)
        xb, yb, sb = _slot(s_i)
        out.append((ya + (yb - ya) * m, xa + (xb - xa) * m, sa + (sb - sa) * m, pid))
    edge_x = CX - RX1 * math.sqrt(max(nf, 1.0) / NMAX) * 0.95
    if walk_p < 1.0:
        x_s, y_s, s_s = _slot(0)
        if walk_p < 0.45:
            q = ease(walk_p / 0.45)
            wx, wy, ws = x_s + (gxm - x_s) * q, y_s + (WB - 8 - y_s) * q, s_s - 0.2 * q
        else:
            q = ease((walk_p - 0.45) / 0.55)
            tx, ty = edge_x + 30, CY + 70
            wx, wy = gxm + (tx - gxm) * q, WB - 8 + (ty - WB + 8) * q
            ws = 1.7
        if wy >= WT + 20:
            out.append((wy, wx, ws, k))
        else:
            yard.append((wy, wx, ws, k, 1.0))

    contact_shadow(cr, CX, CY + RY1 * 0.4, 2 * RX1 * math.sqrt(nf / NMAX) + 120, a=0.38)
    for i in range(int(min(NMAX, nf + 1))):

        yard.append((py, px, s_, i + 40, al))
    for py, px, s_, i, al in sorted(yard):
        bob = 2.0 * math.sin(t * 2.2 + i * 1.3)
        _patient(cr, px, py + bob - 24 * (1 - al), s_, i, t, a=al)

    # THE SCALE: the old crowd as a dashed ring on the ground, its year on it
    if step > 0.02:
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(CX, CY)
        cr.scale(1.0, ry0 / rx0)
        cr.arc(0, 0, rx0, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        ghost(cr, a=0.95)
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(CX, CY)
        cr.scale(1.0, ry0 / rx0)
        cr.arc(0, 0, rx0 + 4, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        ghost(cr, a=0.6)
        text(cr, l0, CX + rx0 + 14, CY - ry0 + 6, 40, look.INK, face="bold")

    # the gate panel, sliding away behind the right-hand wall
    gpx = GX0 + GW * opn
    for bx in range(8):
        cr.rectangle(gpx + 8 + bx * 25, 1320, 9, WB - 1320)
    cr.rectangle(gpx, 1320, GW, 12)
    cr.rectangle(gpx, 1392, GW, 10)
    solid(cr, (52, 54, 60), finish="metal")

    # the brick wall either side of the gap
    for x0, x1 in ((0, GX0), (GX1, W)):
        cr.rectangle(x0, WT, x1 - x0, WB - WT)
        solid(cr, P["brick"])
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brick_shade"], 0.7))
        cr.set_line_width(2)
        for row in range(1, 3):
            cr.move_to(x0, WT + row * 27)
            cr.line_to(x1, WT + row * 27)
        for col in range(int(x0) + 20, int(x1), 56):
            for row in range(3):
                off = 28 if row % 2 else 0
                cr.move_to(col + off, WT + row * 27)
                cr.line_to(col + off, WT + row * 27 + 27)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.rectangle(x0, WT - 12, x1 - x0, 14)
        solid(cr, (214, 206, 192), edge=False)

    # the gate posts, and on the right one the big crank wheel
    contact_shadow(cr, GX0 - 18, WB + 2, 70, a=0.4)
    box(cr, GX0 - 40, WB, 40, 180, (150, 150, 156), finish="metal")
    disc(cr, GX0 - 20, WB - 186, 16, (190, 190, 196), finish="metal")
    contact_shadow(cr, GX1 + 22, WB + 2, 80, a=0.4)
    box(cr, GX1, WB, 44, 190, (150, 150, 156), finish="metal")
    disc(cr, GX1 + 22, WB - 196, 18, (190, 190, 196), finish="metal")
    wa = opn * 14.0
    WX, WYc, WR = GX1 + 40, 1372, 50
    disc(cr, WX, WYc, WR, (196, 60, 48), finish="metal")
    disc(cr, WX, WYc, WR - 12, (60, 62, 70), finish="metal")
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((196, 60, 48)))
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    for sp in range(4):
        a_ = wa + sp * math.pi / 2
        cr.move_to(WX, WYc)
        cr.line_to(WX + (WR - 6) * math.cos(a_), WYc + (WR - 6) * math.sin(a_))
    cr.stroke()
    disc(cr, WX, WYc, 10, (200, 200, 206), finish="metal")
    disc(cr, WX + WR * math.cos(wa), WYc + WR * math.sin(wa), 11, (40, 40, 44),
         finish="gloss")

    foreground(cr, "town")
    # an ambulance keeps arriving along the front of the yard
    _ambulance(cr, -500 + (t * 420) % 2200, 1830, 1.5, t)
    # the queue outside, right by the camera
    for (y, x, s_, i) in sorted(out):
        contact_shadow(cr, x, y + 2, 40 * s_, a=0.3)
        _patient(cr, x, y, s_, i, t)
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    hx0, hx1, fy = 760, 470, 1490
    if u < a0:
        host("point", hx0 + (hx1 - hx0) * ease(seg(u, 0.0, a0)), fy, 230)
    elif u < a1 + 0.04:
        host("crank", hx1, fy, 230, beat=k)
    elif u < 0.9:
        host("crank", hx1, fy, 230, beat=n + int((u - a1) / 0.1))
    else:
        host("shock", hx1, fy, 230)

    # the readout names only the start and the finish: 285 holds while the
    # crowd swells, the latest lands with the last crank and holds to the end
    lab, v = (l1, v1) if done else (l0, v0)
    fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v)):,} cases", f"US measles · {lab}",
                80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)
    if done:

             anchor="right", alpha=ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.05)))

stories.title: Central Banks Are Hoarding Gold Like It's 1967
stories.hook: Gold just hit $5,405 an ounce. Here's who's buying.
stories.closing: When trust breaks, everyone buys the one thing nobody controls.
stories.question: Would you rather hold gold or cash right now? Tell me below.
stories.caption: Gold just hit an all-time high of $5,405 an ounce -- more than 4x its 2015 price. The buyers aren't panicking retail investors, they're central banks, and they bought more gold in 2025 than almost any year on record. Here's why they started stockpiling it. 👇

segments.say: Gold cost 1,160 dollars an ounce in 2015. In January 2026 it hit 5,405 -- more than four times as much.
So who's buying at that price? Central banks -- from under 500 tonnes a year to over 1,100 tonnes in a single year.

stories.title: You Start Losing Muscle Before You Turn 40
stories.hook: Your muscles started vanishing at 30.
stories.closing: Lifting weights can reverse it, so start now, whatever your age.
stories.question: How many days a week do you lift?
stories.caption: After age 30, you lose 3 to 5 percent of your muscle mass every decade -- and after 70, that jumps to as much as 24 percent a decade. It's called sarcopenia and almost nobody talks about it until it's already happened. Here's the good news: one study reversed it in 12 weeks. 👇

segments.say: By eighty, you've lost over a third of your muscle. And the slide starts quietly, back in your thirties.
Until seventy you lose about four percent a decade. After that the pace more than quadruples, so waiting costs you fast.

stories.title: This Frog Freezes Solid Every Winter And Survives
stories.hook: Your frog froze 65 percent solid. Then it hopped away.
stories.closing: Life can survive far more cold than we thought, even frozen solid, and this frog proves it.
stories.question: Would you trust your body to do that?

segments.say: Most animals die with a little of their body water frozen. The wood frog survives with 65 percent turned to ice.

stories.title: The Star That Faked Its Own Death
stories.hook: Your sky's brightest star dropped to 36 percent and faked its death.
stories.closing: So relax: that scare was just dust, and the real finale is nowhere close.
stories.question: Would you have believed the supernova headlines?

segments.say: In February 2020, Betelgeuse dimmed to about a third of its normal brightness. A drop that big looked like trouble.

scene.concept: a glowing star photo visibly dims under a rising dark veil as the brightness percentage falls
scene.code:
cx, cy = (RX0 + RX1) // 2, 560
r = 260
star = images.get(labels[0])
if star is None:
    star = subject_image('red supergiant star glowing orange')

w = h = r * 2
if star is not None:
    paste(star, cx - r, cy - r, w, h)
else:
    d.ellipse([cx - r, cy - r, cx + r, cy + r], fill=rgba('#F97316', 230))
dim_alpha = int((1.0 - brightness / 100.0) * 210)
d.ellipse([cx - r, cy - r, cx + r, cy + r], fill=rgba('#0B1220', dim_alpha))
for k in range(int(30 * reveal)):
    ang = (k * 2.399) % (2 * math.pi)
    rr = r * 0.3 + (k % 12) * 18

    dy = cy + rr * math.sin(ang) * 0.6
    d.ellipse([dx - 3, dy - 3, dx + 3, dy + 3], fill=rgba('#94A3B8', 150))

label = labels[1] if reveal > 0.5 else labels[0]
text('Betelgeuse -- ' + label, cx, cy + r + 50, size=30, center=True)

segments.say: Turns out a giant dust cloud was hiding half the star. So the dimming was a blocked view, not an ending.

text(str(int(values[1])) + '% clear view', cx + r // 2, cy - r - 70, size=30, color=HIGHLIGHT, center=True)

segments.say: The real explosion is estimated to be a hundred thousand years away. This scare was over within months.

stories.title: Why 6 In 10 US Pets Are Now Overweight
stories.hook: Your dog's not just chubby. It's the norm now.
stories.closing: That extra treat isn't love. It's two years, quietly gone.
stories.question: Is your pet a little overweight? Tell me below.
stories.caption: 59% of US dogs and 61% of cats are now overweight or obese, per the Association for Pet Obesity Prevention. It's not a few chubby pets anymore — it's most of them, and a landmark feeding study found the extra weight can cost a dog nearly two years of life. Is your pet a little overweight? Tell me below 🐶

segments.say: In 2012, 52.5% of US dogs were overweight. By 2022, that hit 59% — most dogs now, not a few chubby pups.

scene.concept: the same dog photo appears at three points on a rising timeline, growing rounder and wider at each stop as the overweight share climbs from 52.5% to 59%
scene.code:

n_pts = min(n, 3)

    v = values[i]
    cx = RX0 + gw * i + gw // 2
    stage = clamp(reveal * n_pts - i)
    frac = clamp(v / vmax)

        text(f'{v:.1f}% overweight', cx, base_y - dh - 26, size=22,

segments.say: Which is why it matters: lean dogs lived a median 13 years, versus 11.2 for overweight littermates. Almost two years, gone.

stories.title: How A Netflix Show Turned Chess Into A 200-Million-Person Habit
stories.hook: Your town vanished as Netflix sparked a 200‑million chess surge
stories.closing: One show turned a niche game into a habit for millions, so what you watch matters.
stories.question: Can you play chess? Comment below
stories.caption: Chess.com had 30 million members when the pandemic began. Then The Queen's Gambit dropped on Netflix, and by 2025 membership hit 200 million — nearly seven times bigger in five years. Do you know how to play chess? Tell me below ♟️

segments.say: Before the pandemic boom, Chess.com had just 30 million members. Now it has nearly seven times that.

scene.concept: chess pawn photos stack into growing towers along a five-point timeline, the 2025 tower dwarfing 2020's single piece

    text(f'{v:.0f}M', cx, base_y - h - 34, size=22,
         color=HIGHLIGHT if i == n_pts - 1 else TEXT, center=True)

segments.say: Then the Netflix show landed, and new signups nearly tripled, to 2.8 million a month. Normal had been about a million.

stories.title: You'd Guess Indonesia. The Data Says Otherwise.
stories.hook: Indonesia gets the fame. America has the volcanoes.
stories.closing: Next time you trust your gut, check the count first. Fame and numbers rarely match.
stories.question: Seen a volcano in person? Where?
stories.caption: The United States has more active volcanoes than any other country on Earth — 165, mostly hiding along Alaska's coastline. It's not a coincidence: the US, Japan, Russia, and Indonesia all sit on the same fault line, the Ring of Fire, which holds 75% of Earth's active volcanoes. Ever seen a volcano in person? Tell me where 🌋

# scene standard: 2026-10-11
def _vc_cone(cr, x, base, h, hw, rgb):
    cr.move_to(x - hw, base)
    cr.curve_to(x - hw * 0.45, base - h * 0.35, x - hw * 0.18, base - h * 0.9, x - 24, base - h)
    cr.line_to(x + 24, base - h)
    cr.curve_to(x + hw * 0.18, base - h * 0.9, x + hw * 0.45, base - h * 0.35, x + hw, base)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, rgb)


def _vc_lava(cr, x, base, h, e, seed):
    top = base - h + 6
    yend = top + (h - 10) * e
    left, right = [], []
    for i in range(10):
        q = i / 9.0
        yy = top + (yend - top) * q
        wob = 16 * math.sin(q * 5.0 + seed)
        w = 10 + 16 * q
        left.append((x + wob - w, yy))
        right.append((x + wob + w, yy))
    cr.move_to(*left[0])
    for p_ in left[1:]:
        cr.line_to(*p_)
    for p_ in reversed(right):
        cr.line_to(*p_)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (246, 112, 36), finish="gloss", rim=False)


def _vc_ordinal(n):
    if 10 <= n % 100 <= 20:
        return f"{n}th"
    return f"{n}" + {1: "st", 2: "nd", 3: "rd"}.get(n % 10, "th")


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a chain of erupting volcanoes
    SUBSTANCE: glowing orange lava
    CAUSE: Data hammers a survey stake at the foot of each volcano and it erupts, counted one by one down the chain
    The United States' 165 volcanoes as one long volcanic chain: eleven
    cones, each standing for about fifteen, erupt one after another as Data
    walks down the line hammering in a survey stake at each. When the US
    chain is fully alight, a dashed mark is laid on the ground in front of
    its foot to where Indonesia's count would end, so a glance shows the
    famous guess falls well short. The mark and its label sit below Data's
    feet so he never stands over them. Done by 0.66, then held while the
    plumes keep drifting."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    ranked = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: -r[1])
    lu, vU = ranked[0]
    vU = vU or 1.0
    ind = next((r for r in rows if "indonesia" in r[0].lower()), ranked[min(3, len(ranked) - 1)])
    lI, vI = ind
    rankI = 1 + [r[0] for r in ranked].index(lI)

    N = 11
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.52
    span = (a1 - a0) / N
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, N - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)

    X0, X1 = 150.0, 930.0
    cones = []
    for i in range(N):
        cx = X0 + (X1 - X0) * i / (N - 1)
        base = 1300 + 14 * (i % 2)
        h = 270 + 46 * ((i * 7) % 3) / 2.0 - 14 * (i % 2)
        cones.append((cx, base, h, 150 - 10 * (i % 2), i))

    def erupt(i):
        if u < a0 or i > k:
            return 0.0
        if i < k:
            return 1.0
        return ease(seg(f, 0.3, 0.75))

    landscape(cr, t, "desert")
    cast_shadow(cr, X0 - 150, X1 + 150, 1310, length=260, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, 540, 1312, 1040, a=0.4)

    for cx, base, h, hw, i in sorted(cones, key=lambda c: c[1]):
        e = erupt(i)
        rock = (98, 84, 78) if e <= 0 else (78, 64, 60)
        _vc_cone(cr, cx, base, h, hw, rock)
        if e > 0:
            glow(cr, cx, base - h, 70 + 30 * e, (255, 140, 50), 0.8 * e)
            _vc_lava(cr, cx, base, h, e, i * 1.7)
            for j in range(3):
                ph = (t * 0.22 + j / 3.0 + i * 0.13) % 1.0
                px = cx + 40 * ph + 8 * math.sin(t + j)
                py = base - h - 30 - 240 * ph
                disc(cr, px, py, 24 + 38 * ph, (128, 122, 118), a=e * (1 - ph) * 0.85)

    # Indonesia's count laid on the ground in front of the US chain, below
    # Data's feet so its label never sits under him
    xI = X0 + (X1 - X0) * vI / vU
    m = ease(seg(u, 0.58, 0.64))
    if m > 0:
        then_mark(cr, X0 - 60, X0 - 60 + (xI - X0 + 60) * m, 1500,
                  f"{lI} {int(round(vI))}", a=m)

    # right by the camera: black lava rocks
    for i in range(5):
        rx = 90 + i * 230
        ry = 1690 + (i % 2) * 90 + i * 12
        contact_shadow(cr, rx, ry + 30, 120, a=0.35)
        disc(cr, rx, ry, 44 + 14 * (i % 3), (54, 46, 44))
    foreground(cr, "desert")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    hy = 1440
    sx_end = xI - 90
    if u < a0:
        host("think", X0 - 60, hy, 220)
    elif u < a1 + 0.02:
        host("hammer", cones[k][0] - 70, hy, 220, beat=k)
    elif u < 0.58:
        q = ease(seg(u, a1 + 0.02, 0.58))
        sx = cones[N - 1][0] - 70
        host("point", sx + (sx_end - sx) * q, hy, 220)
    elif u < 0.68:
        host("hammer", sx_end, hy, 220, beat=N)
    else:
        host("hold_up", sx_end, hy, 220)

    if u >= a1:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(vU))} volcanoes", f"{lu} · the most in the world",
                    80, 520, size=130)
        text(cr, _vc_ordinal(rankI), W - 80, 680, 90, look.INK, face="display",
             anchor="right", alpha=m)
        text(cr, f"{lI}", W - 80, 740, 36, look.INK, anchor="right", alpha=m)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Most volcanoes?", f"{lu}, counted cone by cone",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

# scene standard: 2026-10-11
def _rf_cone(cr, x, base, s, heat, t, i, rock=(98, 86, 80)):
    w, h, cw = 150 * s, 175 * s, 24 * s
    contact_shadow(cr, x, base, 2.3 * w, a=0.38)
    cr.move_to(x - w, base)
    cr.curve_to(x - w * 0.5, base - h * 0.32, x - cw * 1.5, base - h * 0.88, x - cw, base - h)
    cr.line_to(x + cw, base - h)
    cr.curve_to(x + cw * 1.5, base - h * 0.88, x + w * 0.5, base - h * 0.32, x + w, base)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, rock)
    # gullies down the flanks
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((52, 44, 42), 0.55))
    cr.set_line_width(max(2.0, 4 * s))
    for g in (-0.55, -0.15, 0.3, 0.65):
        cr.move_to(x + g * cw, base - h + 6 * s)
        cr.curve_to(x + g * w * 0.3, base - h * 0.6, x + g * w * 0.6, base - h * 0.3,
                    x + g * w * 0.85, base - 4 * s)
    cr.stroke()
    # the crater
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, base - h)
    cr.scale(1, 0.32)
    cr.arc(0, 0, cw, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (46, 38, 36), rim=False)
    if heat <= 0:
        return
    glow(cr, x, base - h, 110 * s * (0.4 + 0.6 * heat), (255, 130, 40), 0.85 * heat)
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, base - h)
    cr.scale(1, 0.32)
    cr.arc(0, 0, cw * 0.9, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 196, 80), heat))
    cr.fill()
    # lava tongues running down the cone
    cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
    for j, g in enumerate((-0.45, 0.1, 0.55)):
        L = h * (0.55 + 0.25 * (j % 2)) * heat
        x0, y0 = x + g * cw, base - h + 4 * s
        x1 = x0 + g * L * 0.75
        cr.move_to(x0, y0)
        cr.curve_to(x0 + g * 10 * s, y0 + L * 0.4, x1 - g * 14 * s, y0 + L * 0.7, x1, y0 + L)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((214, 70, 24)))
        cr.set_line_width(13 * s)
        cr.stroke_preserve()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 190, 80)))
        cr.set_line_width(5 * s)
        cr.stroke()
    cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_BUTT)
    # the ash plume climbing out of it
    for j in range(4):
        ph = (t * 0.22 + j / 4 + i * 0.13) % 1.0
        disc(cr, x + 26 * s * math.sin(ph * 2.4 + i), base - h - 24 * s - ph * 190 * s,
             (20 + 46 * ph) * s, (118, 110, 108), a=(1 - ph) * 0.85 * heat)


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a ring of volcanoes around a sea
    SUBSTANCE: red-hot lava
    CAUSE: Data paddles a canoe around the ring and each volcano he reaches erupts with lava
    One whole: every volcano in the shot is Earth's volcanoes, sixteen cones.
    Three in four of them stand on the ring around the sea and erupt one by
    one as Data paddles round to each; the rest stand off the ring on the
    dry land and stay dark. Done by 0.56 and held: the ring burns, he keeps
    paddling."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    tot = sum(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    ring = next((r for r in rows if "ring" in r[0].lower()), max(rows, key=lambda r: r[1]))
    share = ring[1] / tot
    N = 16
    on = max(1, min(N - 1, int(round(share * N))))
    off = N - on
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.56
    p = seg(u, a0, a1) * on
    k = int(clamp(p, 0, on - 0.001))
    f = p - k

    CX, CY, RX, RY = 540, 1170, 400, 165
    th = [math.pi * 0.8 + i / max(1, on - 1) * math.pi * 1.4 for i in range(on)]

    def heat_of(i):
        return 0.0 if u < a0 else ease(clamp((p - i - 0.5) / 0.4))

    # the sky and a low sun; dark volcanic land
    landscape(cr, t, "coast", horizon=1000)
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (92, 84, 80)), (1, (44, 38, 38))], 1000, H)
    ridge(cr, 1000, 70, seed=2.0, n=5)
    solid(cr, (112, 104, 102), edge=False)
    haze(cr, 880, 1060, (214, 190, 176), a=0.5)

    # the sea inside the ring
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(CX, CY)
    cr.scale(1, RY / RX)
    cr.arc(0, 0, RX * 1.02, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (46, 104, 150), finish="gloss")
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(CX, CY)
    cr.scale(1, RY / RX)
    cr.arc(0, 0, RX, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.save()
    cr.clip()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((190, 220, 240), 0.45))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for j in range(9):
        wy = CY - RY + 20 + j * 36
        cr.move_to(CX - RX, wy)
        for q in range(0, 2 * RX + 1, 40):
            cr.line_to(CX - RX + q, wy + 5 * math.sin(q * 0.04 + t * 1.6 + j))
        cr.stroke()
    for i in range(on):        # the eruptions burn in the water
        h_ = heat_of(i)
        if h_ > 0:
            glow(cr, CX + RX * 0.9 * math.cos(th[i]), CY + RY * 0.9 * math.sin(th[i]),
                 120, (255, 120, 40), 0.35 * h_)
    cr.restore()

    # the volcanoes OFF the ring, dark, on the dry land
    elsewhere = [(95, 1010, 0.6), (990, 1005, 0.6), (130, 1500, 0.95), (960, 1505, 0.95)]
    for j, (ex, ey, es) in enumerate(elsewhere[:off] if off <= 4 else elsewhere):
        if ey < 1300:
            _rf_cone(cr, ex, ey, es, 0.0, t, 40 + j, rock=(140, 136, 134))
    cast_shadow(cr, CX - RX, CX + RX, CY + RY, length=260, a=0.25)

    # the canoe's path: round the inside of the ring to the cone erupting next
    def at(a):
        return CX + 0.66 * RX * math.cos(a), CY + 0.66 * RY * math.sin(a) + 30

    if u < a0:
        ang = th[0] - 0.35
    elif u <= a1:
        frm = th[k - 1] if k > 0 else th[0] - 0.35
        ang = frm + (th[k] - frm) * ease(seg(f, 0.0, 0.5))
    else:
        ang = th[-1] + 0.5 * ease(seg(u, a1, 1.0))
    bx, by = at(ang)

    order = sorted(range(on), key=lambda i: math.sin(th[i]))
    back = [i for i in order if math.sin(th[i]) < 0.35]
    front = [i for i in order if math.sin(th[i]) >= 0.35]
    for i in back:
        x = CX + RX * math.cos(th[i])
        y = CY + RY * math.sin(th[i])
        _rf_cone(cr, x, y, 0.5 + 0.4 * (math.sin(th[i]) + 1) / 2, heat_of(i), t, i)

    # the canoe, and Data in it
    contact_shadow(cr, bx, by + 4, 220, a=0.3)
    cr.move_to(bx - 120, by - 18)
    cr.curve_to(bx - 80, by + 22, bx + 80, by + 22, bx + 120, by - 18)
    cr.line_to(bx + 100, by - 4)
    cr.curve_to(bx + 50, by + 6, bx - 50, by + 6, bx - 100, by - 4)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (150, 94, 54))
    if u < a0:
        host("point", bx, by - 4, 200)
    elif u <= a1 + 0.02:
        host("paddle", bx, by - 4, 200, beat=k)
    else:
        host("paddle", bx, by - 4, 200, beat=on + int((u - a1) / 0.1))

    for i in front:
        x = CX + RX * math.cos(th[i])
        y = CY + RY * math.sin(th[i])
        _rf_cone(cr, x, y, 0.5 + 0.4 * (math.sin(th[i]) + 1) / 2, heat_of(i), t, i)

    for j, (ex, ey, es) in enumerate(elsewhere[:off] if off <= 4 else elsewhere):
        if ey >= 1300:
            _rf_cone(cr, ex, ey, es, 0.0, t, 50 + j, rock=(128, 124, 122))

    # right by the camera: black lava boulders on the shore
    for bxx, byy, r in ((250, 1760, 90), (840, 1800, 120)):
        contact_shadow(cr, bxx, byy + r * 0.7, r * 2.4, a=0.4)
        disc(cr, bxx, byy, r, (54, 48, 48))
    foreground(cr, "coast")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    done = u >= a1
    if done:
        b = ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.05))
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(share * 100))}%",
                    "of Earth's volcanoes sit on the Ring of Fire", 80, 520, a=b, size=150)
        text(cr, f"{int(round((1 - share) * 100))}% elsewhere", W - 80, 860, 40, look.INK,
             anchor="right", alpha=b)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Ring of Fire", "where Earth's volcanoes sit", 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

stories.title: Why Password Length Beats Every Trick You Know
stories.hook: 132 years. Or two weeks. Same password.
stories.closing: Twelve boring characters beat eight clever ones.
stories.question: How long is your longest password, honestly? Tell me below.
stories.caption: A 'strong' 8-character password with symbols now falls in 132 years to a rented GPU rig -- down from 225 years just two editions ago. segments.say: In 2024, a strong eight-character password held up for 225 years against a rented GPU rig. Two editions later, that same password falls in 132 years.

segments.say: In the 1950s, an F1 pit stop took about a minute, drivers sometimes swapping their own tires. By 2023, McLaren did the whole stop in 1.80 seconds.

def _f1_car(cr, x, y, s, blur):
    for k in range(6):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 236, 200), 0.35 * blur))
        cr.set_line_width(5 * s)
        cr.move_to(x - 260 * s - 90 * k * blur, y - 30 * s + k * 12 * s)

    cr.line_to(x - 60 * s, y - 62 * s)
    cr.line_to(x - 20 * s, y - 96 * s)

    cr.line_to(x + 70 * s, y - 58 * s)
    cr.line_to(x + 230 * s, y - 40 * s)
    cr.line_to(x + 240 * s, y - 14 * s)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((24, 24, 30)))
    cr.rectangle(x - 250 * s, y - 88 * s, 50 * s, 34 * s)
    cr.fill()
    cr.rectangle(x + 200 * s, y - 26 * s, 70 * s, 14 * s)
    cr.fill()
    cr.arc(x - 5 * s, y - 104 * s, 20 * s, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P['sun']))
    cr.fill()
    for wx in (x - 150 * s, x + 150 * s):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((20, 20, 24)))
        cr.arc(wx, y, 38 * s, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 120, 130)))
        cr.set_line_width(4 * s)
        ang = x * 0.05
        cr.move_to(wx + 22 * s * math.cos(ang), y + 22 * s * math.sin(ang))
        cr.line_to(wx - 22 * s * math.cos(ang), y - 22 * s * math.sin(ang))
        cr.stroke()

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """How fast 1.8 seconds is: the start-light gantry over a night straight,
    one red light per human reaction time. The lights come on one blink at a
    time, and before the seventh is fully lit the car has already gone. Data
    runs down the gantry slapping at each light as it comes on — always one
    blink behind — and is left spinning in shock as the car blows past."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    (lr, rec), (lh, react) = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: -r[1])[:2]
    ratio = rec / max(react, 1e-06)
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (10, 12, 30)), (0.45, (28, 30, 62)), (0.62, (52, 44, 70)), (0.64, (40, 40, 48)), (1.0, (22, 22, 28))], 0, H)
    for i in range(4):
        fx = 90 + i * 300
        glow(cr, fx, 360, 220, P['sun_glow'], 0.35 + 0.08 * math.sin(t * 3 + i))
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((250, 246, 230)))
        cr.rectangle(fx - 30, 350, 60, 20)
        cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((34, 30, 52)))
    cr.rectangle(0, 1040, W, 150)
    cr.fill()
    for i in range(60):
        fx = (i * 197 + int(t * 7) * 53) % W
        fy = 1060 + i * 61 % 110
        fl = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 9 + i * 1.7)
        if fl > 0.85:
            glow(cr, fx, fy, 26, (255, 255, 240), fl)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P['curb']))
    cr.rectangle(0, 1190, W, 12)
    cr.fill()
    for k in range(12):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((200, 200, 210), 0.6))
        dx = (k * 140 - t * 60) % (W + 140) - 70
        cr.rectangle(dx, 1470, 70, 8)
        cr.fill()
    n = max(1, int(math.ceil(ratio)))
    gx0, gx1 = (110, W - 110)
    sp = (gx1 - gx0) / max(1, n - 1)
    gy = 760
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 30, 36)))
    cr.rectangle(40, gy - 70, W - 80, 30)
    cr.fill()
    for px in (60, W - 60):
        cr.rectangle(px - 12, gy - 70, 24, 1190 - gy + 70)
        cr.fill()
    lit = ratio * ease(seg(u, 0.12, 0.78))
    for k in range(n):
        x = gx0 + k * sp
        on = clamp(lit - k)
        cap = clamp(ratio - k)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((16, 16, 20)))
        cr.rectangle(x - 48, gy - 44, 96, 190)
        cr.fill()
        for j in range(2):
            cy_ = gy + 6 + j * 90
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 20, 22)))
            cr.arc(x, cy_, 34, 0, 2 * math.pi)
            cr.fill()
            if on > 0:
                b = min(on, cap) / max(cap, 1e-06)
                glow(cr, x, cy_, 90, P['redline'], 0.6 * b)
                cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 60, 50), b))
                cr.move_to(x, cy_)
                cr.arc(x, cy_, 34, -math.pi / 2, -math.pi / 2 + 2 * math.pi * b)
                cr.close_path()
                cr.fill()
    cu = seg(u, 0.74, 0.9)
    if 0 < cu < 1:
        _f1_car(cr, -300 + (W + 600) * ease(cu), 1400, 1.1, 1.0)
    chase = clamp(lit / max(ratio, 1e-06))
    hx = gx0 + (gx1 - gx0) * chase
    if u < 0.12:
        role = 'think'
    elif u < 0.74:
        role = 'strain' if lit % 1.0 < 0.5 else 'point'
    elif u < 0.9:
        role = 'shock'
    else:
        role = 'hold_up'
    if role == 'shock':
        dx, dy = (0.0, 0.0)
        host(role, hx + dx, 1330 + dy, 210, pace=False)
    else:
        host(role, hx, 1330, 210)
    fit_readout(cr, f'{rec:g}s', f'{lr.lower()} · {ratio:.1f} human reactions', 80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.1)), size=130)
    b = ease(seg(u, 0.82, 0.95))
    if b > 0:
        fit_readout(cr, f'1 light = {react:g}s', lh.lower(), W / 2, 1000, anchor='center', a=b, rgb=P['accent2'], size=64)

stories.title: Why NASA Waits Almost Two Days For One Reply
stories.hook: 22 hours, one-way. Every single message.
stories.closing: Somewhere out there, your 'hello' is still traveling.
stories.question: Could you wait two days for a text back? Tell me below.
stories.caption: Voyager 1 is so far away that a radio signal now takes over 22 hours just one-way to reach it -- and the same to get a reply back. It's also slowly running out of power, which is why NASA keeps switching its instruments off. Could you wait two days for a text back? Tell me below 🛰️

segments.say: Voyager 1 launched in 1977. By 1990, its last photo of Earth took five and a half hours to arrive. A message today takes more than twenty-two.

segments.illustrated_scene:
# scene standard: 2026-10-09
def _lp_year(s):
    d = ""
    for ch in str(s):
        if ch.isdigit():
            d += ch
            if len(d) == 4:
                return d
        else:
            d = ""
    return None


def _lp_bulb(cr, cx, ny, by, w):
    """One glass bulb of the hourglass: the neck at ny, the wide end at by."""
    dy = by - ny
    cr.move_to(cx - 18, ny)
    cr.curve_to(cx - 34, ny + dy * 0.22, cx - w, ny + dy * 0.32, cx - w, ny + dy * 0.68)
    cr.curve_to(cx - w, ny + dy * 0.94, cx - w * 0.82, by, cx - w * 0.68, by)
    cr.line_to(cx + w * 0.68, by)
    cr.curve_to(cx + w * 0.82, by, cx + w, ny + dy * 0.94, cx + w, ny + dy * 0.68)
    cr.curve_to(cx + w, ny + dy * 0.32, cx + 34, ny + dy * 0.22, cx + 18, ny)
    cr.close_path()


def _lp_tumbleweed(cr, x, y, r, ang):
    contact_shadow(cr, x, y + r, r * 1.8, a=0.3)
    cr.arc(x, y, r, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    solid(cr, (150, 112, 70), a=0.85)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((84, 58, 34)))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    for i in range(7):
        a = ang + i * 0.9
        cr.move_to(x + r * 0.9 * math.cos(a), y + r * 0.9 * math.sin(a))
        cr.curve_to(x + r * 0.2 * math.cos(a + 1.3), y + r * 0.2 * math.sin(a + 1.3),
                    x + r * 0.3 * math.cos(a + 2.6), y + r * 0.3 * math.sin(a + 2.6),
                    x + r * 0.9 * math.cos(a + 3.4), y + r * 0.9 * math.sin(a + 3.4))
    cr.stroke()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a giant hourglass in the desert
    SUBSTANCE: golden sand
    CAUSE: Data pours a bucket of sand in through the top of the empty hourglass and it piles up in the bottom
    Time added, never taken away: a towering hourglass stands in the desert,
    its top bulb EMPTY and its bottom bare in 1972. Data climbs its ladder
    and tips a bucket of sand into the funnel on top, three pours; each one
    falls straight through the empty top bulb and the neck, and the pile in
    the bottom bulb grows while he pours and stops when he stops — nothing
    sits in the top to drain, so the only sand that moves is the sand he
    pours. One notch lights on the post for every leap second it holds.
    The readout prints only the sourced total, once the last pour lands —
    never an in-between count the data does not have — and the second
    number is the zero removed.
    Done by 0.58 and held; a tumbleweed rolls by, the watch ticks."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    added = next((v for l, v in rows if "add" in l.lower()),
                 max((v for _, v in rows), default=0.0))
    removed = next((v for l, v in rows if "subtract" in l.lower() or "remov" in l.lower()),
                   min((v for _, v in rows), default=0.0))
    lab_add = next((l for l, v in rows if v == added), rows[0][0] if rows else "")
    y0 = _lp_year(lab_add) or "1972"
    N = max(1, int(round(added)))

    n = 3
    a0, a1 = 0.14, 0.58
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    grow = ease(seg(f, 0.15, 0.85))
    if u < a0:
        val = 0.0
    else:
        val = added * (k + grow) / n
    done = u >= a0 and k == n - 1 and grow >= 0.999
    pouring = u >= a0 and u < a1 and 0.08 < f < 0.88

    CX, BASE = 560, 1440
    WOOD = (132, 88, 52)
    SAND = (222, 184, 118)

    landscape(cr, t, "desert")

    # the hourglass, standing on the dune with its long shadow
    cast_shadow(cr, CX - 270, CX + 270, BASE, length=340, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, CX, BASE + 4, 620, a=0.4)
    box(cr, CX - 270, BASE, 540, 40, WOOD, depth=70)
    for bx in (CX - 205, CX + 255):                     # back posts
        cylinder(cr, bx, 1388, 28, 560, (110, 72, 42), finish="gloss")

    # the bottom bulb: the pile is the count
    ph = 250.0 * clamp(val / max(1e-9, added))
    cr.save()
    _lp_bulb(cr, CX, 1110, 1400, 215)
    cr.clip()
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (120, 96, 80)), (1, (84, 64, 54))], 1100, 1400, CX - 220, CX + 220)
    if ph > 2:
        heap_path(cr, CX, 1400, ph, 210)
        solid(cr, SAND)
        for i in range(40):
            gx = CX - 190 + (i * 97) % 380
            gy = heap_top(CX, 1400, ph, 210, gx)
            gy = gy + ((i * 0.618) % 1.0) * (1400 - gy)
            cr.arc(gx, gy, 3, 0, 2 * math.pi)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((176, 134, 76), 0.7))
            cr.fill()
    cr.restore()
    # the top bulb: EMPTY glass — nothing in it to drain
    cr.save()
    _lp_bulb(cr, CX, 1110, 820, 215)
    cr.clip()
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (84, 64, 54)), (1, (120, 96, 80))], 820, 1110, CX - 220, CX + 220)
    cr.restore()

    # the poured sand falls straight down from the funnel to the pile, only
    # while he pours
    if pouring:
        sw = 16 * min(1.0, seg(f, 0.08, 0.2)) * (1.0 - seg(f, 0.78, 0.88)) + 2
        cr.rectangle(CX - sw / 2, 782, sw, max(0, 1400 - ph - 782))
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(SAND))
        cr.fill()
        glow(cr, CX, 1400 - ph, 50, (255, 220, 150), 0.45)

    for ny, by in ((1110, 1400), (1110, 820)):          # the glass over it
        _lp_bulb(cr, CX, ny, by, 215)
        solid(cr, (200, 220, 236), finish="glass", a=0.22)
    glow(cr, CX - 120, 920, 70, (255, 250, 235), 0.35)
    glow(cr, CX - 130, 1220, 70, (255, 250, 235), 0.3)

    box(cr, CX - 270, 820, 540, 40, WOOD, depth=70)      # top plate
    for bx in (CX - 250, CX + 220):                      # front posts
        cylinder(cr, bx, 1400, 30, 580, WOOD, finish="gloss")
    # the funnel he pours into, through the open top plate
    cr.move_to(CX - 70, 736)
    cr.line_to(CX + 70, 736)
    cr.line_to(CX + 14, 790)
    cr.line_to(CX - 14, 790)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, P["brass"], finish="metal")

    # THE SCALE on the glass: one notch on the post per leap second held
    tall = 540.0
    gap = tall / N
    lit_n = int(val + 1e-6)
    for i in range(N):
        yy = 1388 - i * gap
        cr.set_line_width(max(3.0, min(8.0, gap * 0.45)))
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"] if i < lit_n else (60, 44, 30),
                               1.0 if i < lit_n else 0.6))
        cr.move_to(CX + 214, yy)
        cr.line_to(CX + 256, yy)
        cr.stroke()
    then_mark(cr, CX - 170, CX + 170, 1398, y0, a=0.9)

    # the ladder up the left side
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((92, 62, 38)))
    cr.set_line_width(12)
    for dx in (0, 70):
        cr.move_to(170 + dx, 1440)
        cr.line_to(260 + dx, 790)
        cr.stroke()
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    for r_ in range(10):
        q = (r_ + 0.5) / 10
        cr.move_to(170 + 90 * q, 1440 - 650 * q)
        cr.line_to(240 + 90 * q, 1440 - 650 * q)
        cr.stroke()

    # Data: climbs, then tips each bucket into the funnel
    climb = ease(seg(u, 0.05, a0))
    if u < a0:
        hx, hy = 205 + 110 * climb, 1440 - 660 * climb
    else:
        hx, hy = 380.0, 778.0
    if pouring:
        q = seg(f, 0.08, 0.88)
        sx, sy = hx + 70, hy - 150
        ex, ey = CX, 742
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(SAND))
        cr.set_line_width(22 * (1 - 0.5 * q))
        cr.move_to(sx, sy)
        cr.curve_to(sx + 70, sy - 30, ex - 20, ey - 90, ex, ey)
        cr.stroke()
        glow(cr, ex, ey, 46, (255, 220, 150), 0.45)

    # right by the camera: a drift of spilled sand, an old pocket watch, a tumbleweed
    heap_path(cr, 880, 1800, 110, 260)
    solid(cr, SAND)
    contact_shadow(cr, 220, 1772, 130, a=0.35)
    disc(cr, 220, 1730, 56, P["coin"], finish="metal")
    disc(cr, 220, 1730, 40, (244, 238, 224), finish="gloss")
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 36, 32)))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    cr.move_to(220, 1730)
    cr.line_to(220 + 28 * math.sin(t * 1.2), 1730 - 28 * math.cos(t * 1.2))
    cr.stroke()
    tx = -120 + ((t * 240) % 1380)
    _lp_tumbleweed(cr, tx, 1690, 62, t * 3.9)
    foreground(cr, "desert")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    if u < 0.05:
        host("point", hx, hy, 210)
    elif u < a0:
        host("climb", hx, hy, 210)
    elif u < a1 + 0.04:
        host("pour", hx, hy, 210, beat=k)
    else:
        host("hold_up", hx, hy, 210)

    # only the sourced total is ever printed, once the last pour has landed
    if done:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(added))} seconds", f"added to the world's clocks since {y0}",
                    80, 520, size=130)
        text(cr, f"{int(round(removed))} removed", W - 80, 690, 80, look.INK,
             face="display", anchor="right", alpha=ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.05)))
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Leap seconds", f"added to the world's clocks since {y0}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)
