def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """One field holds every American farewell. It rises as all headstones,
    the way your grandparents chose. Data walks in, drags a hedge across it in
    two hauls, and every grave the hedge passes turns into a memorial garden.
    The garden stops at cremation's true share of the field and the headstones
    keep burial's share. Data hauls, holds up the hedge post, then strolls
    into the garden he made and cheers."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    (lc, vc), (lb, vb) = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: -r[1])[:2]
    whole = max(100.0, vc + vb)
    FX0, FX1 = 60.0, 1020.0
    FW = FX1 - FX0
    FY0, FY1 = 780.0, 1450.0
    bur_end = FX0 + FW * vb / whole
    split = FX1 - FW * vc / whole
    accent = _col(P["accent2"])

    # sky, distant tree line, the hillside field
    vgrad(cr, P["cleared"], 0, H)
    dawn_sky(cr, t, y1=790)
    birds(cr, t, y0=560, n=4)
    for x, d, s_ in _TREES[:30]:
        tree(cr, x, 770 + 18 * d, 0.42 * s_, P["leaf_far"], P["leaf_far_shade"],
             P["trunk_far"], lean=0.02 * math.sin(t * 0.8 + x))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(_col(P["pasture"])))
    cr.rectangle(0, FY0 - 20, W, H - FY0 + 20)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((92, 72, 52)))
    cr.rectangle(0, FY1 + 10, W, H - FY1 - 10)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 146, 138)))
    cr.rectangle(0, FY1, W, 14)
    cr.fill()

    # the hedge moves in two decisive hauls, with a short hold between them
    prog = 0.5 * ease(seg(u, 0.18, 0.42)) + 0.5 * ease(seg(u, 0.48, 0.7))
    fx = FX1 - (FX1 - split) * prog
    fa = ease(seg(u, 0.1, 0.18))
    land = ease(seg(u, 0.7, 0.8))

    # ground tint: the garden share in the accent, burial in a neutral
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(accent, 0.18 * fa))
    cr.rectangle(fx, FY0, FX1 - fx, FY1 - FY0)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 124, 130), 0.22 * land))
    cr.rectangle(FX0, FY0, bur_end - FX0, FY1 - FY0)
    cr.fill()

    # rows of graves rise back to front, set irregularly like a real cemetery
    other_fade = ease(seg(u, 0.7, 0.78))
    for r in range(7):
        base = 830 + r * 95
        s = 0.62 + 0.075 * r
        rise = ease(seg(u, 0.01 + r * 0.016, 0.07 + r * 0.016))
        n = int(FW / (74 * s))
        for i in range(n):
            if (i * 7 + r * 3) % 5 == 0:
                continue
            x = FX0 + 30 * s + i * (FW - 60 * s) / max(1, n - 1) \
                + ((i * 37 + r * 53) % 21 - 10)
            k = clamp((x - fx) / 50.0)
            h = (1.0 - k) * rise
            if bur_end < x < split:
                h *= 1.0 - other_fade
                k = 0.0
            _stone(cr, x, base, s, h=h)
            _garden(cr, x, base, s, pop(k), 0 if (i + r) % 4 == 0 else 1)

    # the hedge line Data drags
    if fa > 0:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(_col(P["leaf_shade"]), fa))
        cr.set_line_width(16)
        cr.move_to(fx, FY0)
        cr.line_to(fx, FY1)
        cr.stroke()
        for j in range(9):
            py = FY0 + j * (FY1 - FY0) / 8
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(_col(P["log"]), fa))
            cr.rectangle(fx - 7, py - 22, 14, 30)
            cr.fill()
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(_col(P["leaf"]), fa))
            cr.arc(fx, py - 8, 14, 0, 2 * math.pi)
            cr.fill()

    # Data's bit: walks in sizing up the field, hauls the hedge, holds its
    # post, then strolls into the garden and cheers
    if u < 0.16:
        role = "think"
    elif u < 0.7:
        role = "strain"
    elif u < 0.82:
        role = "hold_up"
    else:
        role = "cheer"
    hx = fx - 90
    hx = 640 + (hx - 640) * ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.14))
    hx += 190 * ease(seg(u, 0.82, 0.96))
    foot = 1500
    if 0.16 <= u < 0.82:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 52, 36)))
        cr.set_line_width(5)
        cr.move_to(hx + 20, foot - 140)
        cr.line_to(fx, 1400)
        cr.stroke()
    host(role, hx, foot, 220,
         pace=(u < 0.14) or (0.82 <= u < 0.96))

    # readouts — the intro line is fully gone before the numbers arrive
    intro = fa * (1.0 - ease(seg(u, 0.6, 0.67)))
    if intro > 0.01:
        text(cr, "every American goodbye, one field", 80, 600, 48, look.INK,
             alpha=intro)
    if land > 0.01:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{vc:.1f}%", f"{lc.lower()} · {vc / vb:.1f}× {lb.lower()}",
                    80, 520, a=land, size=150)
        text(cr, f"{vb:.1f}% {lb.lower()}", FX0 + 6, 752, 44, look.INK, alpha=land)
        text(cr, lc.lower(), FX1 - 6, 752, 44, accent, anchor="right", alpha=land)

segments.say: But it's not even. Nevada cremates 81.9 percent of people, while Mississippi is still just 32.8 percent -- tradition and cost still split the country.
segments.illustrated_scene:
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """The cremation lantern. One glass lantern holds all of a state's farewells.
    Data hauls the rope that lifts the ember tray, and the glow rises to each
    state's real cremation share, lowest state first, with only a short hold at
    each. The dark glass above the glow is burial's share. Mississippi's level
    stays notched on the frame. When Nevada's embers top out, a brass bracket
    climbs from the notch up to the glow while Data walks back to it in shock."""
    rows = sorted([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts], key=lambda r: r[1])
    n = max(1, len(rows))
    # the night desert road between the states
    vgrad(cr, P["dawn"], 0, H)
    glow(cr, 820, 360, 260, P["sun_glow"], 0.35)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["paper"], 0.9))
    cr.arc(820, 360, 60, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brick_shade"], 0.85))
    cr.move_to(0, 1180)
    for x, y in [(80, 1040), (300, 1040), (360, 1120), (620, 1120), (700, 990),
                 (900, 990), (960, 1100), (W, 1100), (W, 1300), (0, 1300)]:
        cr.line_to(x, y)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()
    vgrad(cr, P["dry_soil"], 1260, H)

    # step through the states, lowest first: a long rise, then a short hold
    a0, a1 = 0.03, 0.74
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    rise = 0.84
    lev, k, rising = 0.0, -1, False
    for i, (l, v) in enumerate(rows):
        s0 = a0 + i * span
        if u >= s0:
            f = clamp((u - s0) / (span * rise))
            prev = rows[i - 1][1] if i else 0.0
            lev = prev + (v - prev) * ease(f)
            k = i
            rising = f < 1.0
    done_u = a0 + (n - 1) * span + span * rise

    # the lantern: the whole is the glass, the share is the ember glow
    L, R_, top, bot = 200, 660, 700, 1330
    cx = (L + R_) / 2
    glass_h = bot - top
    surf = bot - glass_h * clamp(lev / 100.0)
    glow(cr, cx, surf + 120, 360, P["sun_glow"], 0.55 * clamp(lev / 100.0))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 74, 88), 0.92))          # burial's share: cold glass
    cr.rectangle(L, top, R_ - L, glass_h)
    cr.fill()
    if lev > 0:
        cr.save()
        cr.rectangle(L, top, R_ - L, glass_h)
        cr.clip()
        cr.move_to(L, bot)
        x = L
        while x <= R_:
            cr.line_to(x, surf + 12 * math.sin(x / 38.0 + t * 2.6))
            x += 12
        cr.line_to(R_, bot)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["sun_hot"]))
        cr.fill()
        for j in range(6):                               # ember bands drift upward
            yy = bot - ((t * 70 + j * 105) % (bot - surf + 40))
            if surf + 20 < yy < bot:
                cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["sun"], 0.4))
                cr.rectangle(L, yy, R_ - L, 30)
                cr.fill()
        cr.restore()
    iron = (36, 34, 44)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(iron))
    cr.set_line_width(18)
    cr.rectangle(L, top, R_ - L, glass_h)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    for bx in (L + (R_ - L) / 3, L + 2 * (R_ - L) / 3):
        cr.move_to(bx, top)
        cr.line_to(bx, bot)
        cr.stroke()
    cr.move_to(L - 30, top)                              # the roof
    cr.line_to(cx, top - 70)
    cr.line_to(R_ + 30, top)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()
    cr.rectangle(L - 30, bot, R_ - L + 60, 24)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    cr.arc(cx, top - 92, 24, 0, 2 * math.pi)             # the pulley ring
    cr.stroke()

    # Mississippi's level stays notched on the frame once it has been passed
    if k >= 1 and rows:
        lo_l, lo_v = rows[0]
        ny = bot - glass_h * lo_v / 100.0
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass"]))
        cr.rectangle(L - 40, ny - 5, 60, 10)
        cr.fill()
        text(cr, lo_l, L - 46, ny + 10, fit_size(cr, lo_l, 28, 150), look.INK,
             anchor="right")
        # at the end a bracket climbs from the notch up to the top of the glow
        g = ease(seg(u, done_u + 0.02, done_u + 0.16))
        if g > 0:
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"]))
            cr.set_line_width(8)
            cr.move_to(R_ + 30, ny)
            cr.line_to(R_ + 50, ny)
            cr.line_to(R_ + 50, ny + (surf - ny) * g)
            cr.line_to(R_ + 30, ny + (surf - ny) * g)
            cr.stroke()

    # the brass plate names the state on show
    if k >= 0:
        lab = rows[k][0]
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass"]))
        cr.rectangle(cx - 170, bot + 30, 340, 50)
        cr.fill()
        text(cr, lab, cx, bot + 68, fit_size(cr, lab, 38, 310), P["paper_ink"],
             anchor="center", shadow=False)

    # Data walks back as he hauls the rope; at the end he walks to the gap
    hh = 220
    back = ease(seg(u, done_u + 0.04, done_u + 0.22))
    dx = 740 + 230 * clamp(lev / 100.0) - 200 * back
    fy = 1440
    if back < 0.05:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["log"]))
        cr.set_line_width(5)
        cr.move_to(cx, max(top + 10, surf - 4))
        cr.line_to(cx, top - 92)
        cr.line_to(dx - 24, fy - hh * 0.58)
        cr.stroke()
    if u < a0:
        role = "point"
    elif u >= done_u:
        role = "shock"
    elif rising:
        role = "strain"
    else:
        role = "hold_up"
    host(role, dx, fy, hh)

    # readouts: the current state's sourced share, then the gap
    if k >= 0:
        l, v = rows[k]
        fit_readout(cr, f"{v:.1f}%", f"cremated · {l}", 80, 520,
                    a=ease(clamp((u - a0) / 0.05)), size=130)
    g = ease(seg(u, done_u + 0.10, done_u + 0.20))
    if g > 0 and len(rows) >= 2:
        (lo_l, lo_v), (hi_l, hi_v) = rows[0], rows[-1]
        fit_readout(cr, f"{hi_v - lo_v:.1f} points apart", f"{hi_l} vs {lo_l}",
                    W / 2, 1450 + 30 * (1 - g), anchor="center", a=g,
                    rgb=P["accent2"], size=56)

stories.closing_scene:
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """The closing: two memorial candles on a chapel ledge, each one whole
    state's farewells. Data lights each wick with a long brass taper and
    guides the flame down. Nevada's candle burns away 82% of its height, and
    the ghost of the burned wax glows in the accent. Mississippi's burns only
    33%, and most of its wax still stands. He stops and looks at what's left."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    by = {l.lower(): (l, v) for l, v in rows}
    nv_l, nv_v = by.get("nevada", max(rows, key=lambda r: r[1]))
    ms_l, ms_v = by.get("mississippi", min(rows, key=lambda r: r[1]))
    nv_s, ms_s = clamp(nv_v / 100.0), clamp(ms_v / 100.0)

    # the chapel at dusk: full-height wall, a tall arched window, stone floor
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (22, 18, 34)), (0.5, (44, 32, 46)), (1.0, (64, 46, 40))], 0, H)
    cr.save()
    cr.move_to(380, 1300)
    cr.line_to(380, 420)
    cr.arc(540, 420, 160, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.line_to(700, 1300)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 60, 96), 0.35))
    cr.fill()
    cr.restore()
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (58, 44, 40)), (1.0, (34, 26, 26))], 1400, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((92, 76, 66)))
    cr.rectangle(120, 1380, 840, 30)          # the stone ledge
    cr.fill()

    top, base, w = 700, 1380, 200
    nx, mx = 330, 750

    def flame(x, y, s):
        sway = 5 * math.sin(t * 2.2 + x)
        glow(cr, x, y - 40 * s, 170 * s, P["sun_glow"], 0.75)
        cr.move_to(x + sway, y - 80 * s)
        cr.curve_to(x + 26 * s, y - 40 * s, x + 22 * s, y, x, y)
        cr.curve_to(x - 22 * s, y, x - 26 * s, y - 40 * s, x + sway, y - 80 * s)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["sun_hot"]))
        cr.fill()
        cr.move_to(x + sway * 0.5, y - 46 * s)
        cr.curve_to(x + 10 * s, y - 24 * s, x + 9 * s, y - 4 * s, x, y - 4 * s)
        cr.curve_to(x - 9 * s, y - 4 * s, x - 10 * s, y - 24 * s, x + sway * 0.5, y - 46 * s)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 250, 225)))
        cr.fill()

    def candle(cx, share, b, lit):
        hc = base - top
        wy = base - hc * (1 - share * b)
        if b > 0:                             # the wax that went to flame
            cr.rectangle(cx - w / 2, top, w, wy - top)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"], 0.18))
            cr.fill()
            cr.set_dash([12, 9])
            cr.set_line_width(4)
            cr.rectangle(cx - w / 2, top, w, wy - top)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"], 0.75))
            cr.stroke()
            cr.set_dash([])
        else:
            cr.set_line_width(3)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(INK_2, 0.0))
        g = cairo.LinearGradient(cx - w / 2, 0, cx + w / 2, 0)
        g.add_color_stop_rgba(0, *_c((250, 242, 222)))
        g.add_color_stop_rgba(0.6, *_c((236, 224, 198)))
        g.add_color_stop_rgba(1, *_c((196, 180, 152)))
        cr.rectangle(cx - w / 2, wy, w, base - wy)
        cr.set_source(g)
        cr.fill()
        for k, (dx, dl) in enumerate([(-0.42, 70), (-0.1, 34), (0.3, 54)]):
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((250, 244, 228)))
            px = cx + dx * w
            cr.rectangle(px - 9, wy, 18, dl)
            cr.fill()
            cr.arc(px, wy + dl, 9, 0, math.pi)
            cr.fill()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 30, 26)))
        cr.set_line_width(5)
        cr.move_to(cx, wy)
        cr.line_to(cx, wy - 20)
        cr.stroke()
        if lit:
            flame(cx, wy - 14, 1.0 + 0.15 * pop(seg(lit, 0.0, 1.0)))
        return wy

    nb = ease(seg(u, 0.12, 0.42))
    mb = ease(seg(u, 0.64, 0.84))
    nlit = seg(u, 0.08, 0.14) if u >= 0.08 else 0.0
    mlit = seg(u, 0.60, 0.66) if u >= 0.60 else 0.0
    nwy = candle(nx, nv_s, nb, nlit)
    mwy = candle(mx, ms_s, mb, mlit)

    # his bit: point at the first candle, carry the taper and burn it down,
    # walk to the second and burn that one, then stop and think
    h = 210
    fy = 1500
    if u < 0.08:
        role, x, pace = "point", 120, False
    elif u < 0.44:
        role, x, pace = "hold_up", 130, False
    elif u < 0.62:
        role, x, pace = "hold_up", 130 + 830 * ease(seg(u, 0.44, 0.62)), True
    elif u < 0.86:
        role, x, pace = "hold_up", 960, False
    else:
        role, x, pace = "think", 960, False
    host(role, x, fy, h, pace=pace)
    if role == "hold_up":
        hx, hy = x + (18 if x < 540 else -18), fy - 0.98 * h
        if u < 0.44:
            tx, ty = nx - 26, nwy - 30
        elif u >= 0.62:
            tx, ty = mx + 26, mwy - 30
        else:
            tx, ty = hx + (60 if u < 0.53 else -60), hy - 160
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass"]))
        cr.set_line_width(7)
        cr.move_to(hx, hy)
        cr.line_to(tx, ty)
        cr.stroke()
        glow(cr, tx, ty, 22, P["sun_hot"], 0.8)

    # the labels under each candle land once its burn has stopped
    na = ease(seg(u, 0.40, 0.48))
    ma = ease(seg(u, 0.82, 0.9))
    text(cr, nv_l, nx, 1452, 40, INK, anchor="center", alpha=na)
    text(cr, f"{nv_v:.0f}%", nx, 1500, 44, P["accent2"], face="display",
         anchor="center", alpha=na)
    text(cr, ms_l, mx, 1452, 40, INK, anchor="center", alpha=ma)
    text(cr, f"{ms_v:.0f}%", mx, 1500, 44, P["accent2"], face="display",
         anchor="center", alpha=ma)

    if u < 0.6:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{nv_v:.0f}%", f"of {nv_l} chooses cremation", 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.08)), size=120)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{ms_v:.0f}%", f"{ms_l} still holds out", 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.6, 0.68)), size=120)
stories.hook_scene:
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """The hook: ONE casket stands for every American funeral, and it is already
    burning. The fire starts at the 1970s share at the head end, and Data
    works a bellows that pushes the burn line along the lid until it hits
    today's share, notched in brass from frame 1. The unburnt wood is
    everyone else. Then he climbs onto the lid at the line and cheers."""
    rows = [(str(r[0]), float(r[1])) for r in by_time(pts)]
    l0, v0 = rows[0]
    l1, v1 = rows[-1]
    s0, s1 = clamp(v0 / 100.0), clamp(v1 / 100.0)

    # a dim chapel at dusk, filling the whole frame (vgrad stops are (pos, rgb))
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (28, 22, 34)), (0.6, (52, 38, 46)), (1.0, (74, 52, 48))],
          0, 1180)
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (58, 44, 40)), (1.0, (34, 26, 26))], 1180, H)
    for k in range(3):                                  # chapel windows
        wx = 190 + k * 350
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 96, 120), 0.35))
        cr.rectangle(wx, 300, 90, 200)
        cr.fill()
        cr.arc(wx + 45, 300, 45, math.pi, 0)
        cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((90, 66, 52)))               # the bier
    cr.rectangle(80, 1150, 920, 34)
    cr.fill()
    for lx in (130, 950):
        cr.rectangle(lx - 14, 1184, 28, 200)
        cr.fill()

    # THE CASKET: the whole. Its length is 100% of farewells
    x0, x1, top, bot = 90, 990, 760, 1150
    cw = x1 - x0
    # the burn travels for most of the hook: the story keeps arriving
    fill = ease(seg(u, 0.03, 0.70))
    share = s0 + (s1 - s0) * fill
    bx = x0 + cw * share                                # the burn line

    def coffin(cr):
        cr.move_to(x0 + 40, top)
        cr.line_to(x1 - 40, top)
        cr.line_to(x1, top + 70)
        cr.line_to(x1 - 20, bot)
        cr.line_to(x0 + 20, bot)
        cr.line_to(x0, top + 70)
        cr.close_path()

    coffin(cr)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["log"]))
    cr.fill()
    cr.save()
    coffin(cr)
    cr.clip()
    for g in range(6):                                  # wood grain
        gy = top + 50 + g * 58
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["trunk"], 0.55))
        cr.set_line_width(4)
        cr.move_to(x0, gy)
        cr.curve_to(x0 + cw * 0.3, gy - 12, x0 + cw * 0.6, gy + 12, x1, gy)
        cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 104, 66), 0.5))        # lid seam
    cr.rectangle(x0, top + 120, cw, 10)
    cr.fill()
    # the burnt share: charred wood, its edge a live seam of fire
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 24, 14)))
    cr.rectangle(x0, top, bx - x0, bot - top)
    cr.fill()
    pulse = 0.75 + 0.2 * math.sin(t * 3.0)
    for k in range(9):
        ey = top + 30 + k * 42
        ex = x0 + 30 + (k * 197) % int(max(40, bx - x0 - 40))
        if ex < bx - 20:
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["heat"], 0.45 * pulse))
            cr.arc(ex, ey, 26, 0, 2 * math.pi)
            cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["sun_hot"], 0.9))
    cr.rectangle(bx - 10, top, 14, bot - top)
    cr.fill()
    cr.restore()
    glow(cr, bx, (top + bot) / 2, 220, P["sun_hot"], 0.5 * pulse)

    # where the fire is headed: today's share, notched on the lid from frame 1
    tx = x0 + cw * s1
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass"], 0.9))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    cr.move_to(tx, top - 30)
    cr.line_to(tx, bot + 20)
    cr.stroke()

    # flames standing on the burnt lid: tongues rooted in place, not drifting
    n = int((bx - x0) / 46)
    for i in range(n):
        fx = x0 + 30 + i * 46
        h = (70 + 50 * ((i * 37) % 5) / 4.0) * (0.85 + 0.15 * math.sin(t * 4 + i))
        if fx > bx - 140:
            h *= 1.4                                    # hottest at the front
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["heat"], 0.85))
        cr.move_to(fx - 22, top + 6)
        cr.curve_to(fx - 20, top - h * 0.5, fx + 6 * math.sin(t * 3 + i),
                    top - h * 0.8, fx, top - h)
        cr.curve_to(fx + 8, top - h * 0.6, fx + 22, top - h * 0.4, fx + 22, top + 6)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.fill()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["sun_hot"], 0.9))
        cr.move_to(fx - 10, top + 6)
        cr.curve_to(fx - 8, top - h * 0.3, fx, top - h * 0.5, fx, top - h * 0.55)
        cr.curve_to(fx + 6, top - h * 0.3, fx + 10, top - h * 0.2, fx + 10, top + 6)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.fill()

    # Data drives the fire: he pumps a bellows aimed at the burn line, then
    # climbs up onto the unburnt lid right at the line and cheers there
    pumping = u < 0.70
    up = ease(seg(u, 0.72, 0.88))
    hx = max(160.0, bx - 70) + (tx + 90 - max(160.0, bx - 70)) * up
    fy = 1420 + (top - 1420) * up
    if pumping:
        squeeze = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 6.0)
        nx, ny = hx + 40, fy - 120
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["sack_shade"]))       # bellows body
        cr.move_to(nx - 70, ny - 30 - 20 * squeeze)
        cr.line_to(nx + 10, ny - 8)
        cr.line_to(nx + 10, ny + 8)
        cr.line_to(nx - 70, ny + 30 + 20 * squeeze)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.fill()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass"]))            # nozzle up to the fire
        cr.set_line_width(12)
        cr.move_to(nx + 10, ny)
        cr.line_to(bx - 6, bot - 20)
        cr.stroke()
        glow(cr, bx - 6, bot - 20, 60, P["sun_hot"], 0.6 * squeeze)
        role = "strain"
    elif u < 0.88:
        role = "climb"
    else:
        role = "cheer"
    host(role, hx, fy, 220)

    # the readout swaps when the line lands: then and now, both from pts
    landed_now = fill >= 0.999
    big = f"{v1:.0f}%" if landed_now else f"{v0:.0f}%"
    small = f"chose cremation · {l1}" if landed_now else f"chose cremation · {l0}"
    fit_readout(cr, big, small, 80, 520, size=150)
    a = ease(seg(u, 0.70, 0.80))
    if a > 0:
        text(cr, f"was {v0:.0f}% in the {l0}", 80, 690, 46, INK_2,
             anchor="left", alpha=a)
    # everyone else: a bracket sweeps across the unburnt wood once Data is up
    b = ease(seg(u, 0.84, 0.97))
    if b > 0:
        ex = tx + (x1 - tx) * b
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(INK, 0.85))
        cr.set_line_width(5)
        cr.move_to(tx, bot + 30)
        cr.line_to(ex, bot + 30)
        cr.stroke()
        rest = "everyone else"
        text(cr, rest, (tx + x1) / 2, bot + 80,
             fit_size(cr, rest, 40, max(60, x1 - tx - 20)),
             INK, anchor="center", alpha=b)

segments.say: California alone is sitting on 15 billion dollars of forgotten money. That's cash that belongs to regular people like you.
segments.illustrated_scene:
# scene standard: 2026-10-16.2
def _ufd_dollar(cr, x, cy, s, rgb):

    cr.curve_to(x + 14 * s, cy + 22 * s, x - 8 * s, cy + 24 * s, x - 15 * s, cy + 14 * s)

def _ufd_bag(cr, x, y, s):

    cr.move_to(x - 16 * s, y - 84 * s)
    cr.curve_to(x - 70 * s, y - 64 * s, x - 62 * s, y, x, y)
    cr.curve_to(x + 62 * s, y, x + 70 * s, y - 64 * s, x + 16 * s, y - 84 * s)

    cr.curve_to(x + 360 * s, y - 92 * s, x + 390 * s, y - 80 * s, x + 392 * s, y - 52 * s)

def _ufd_person(cr, x, y, s, t, i, coat, hair, walking):
    """A regular person seen from behind, walking up to the vault."""
    contact_shadow(cr, x, y, 80 * s, a=0.35)
    sw = (math.sin(t * 6 + i * 1.7) * 14 * s) if walking else 0.0
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((44, 46, 60)))
    cr.set_line_width(16 * s)
    cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
    for d in (-1, 1):
        cr.move_to(x + d * 10 * s, y - 70 * s)
        cr.line_to(x + d * 10 * s + d * sw, y - 4 * s)

    cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_BUTT)
    cr.move_to(x - 28 * s, y - 70 * s)

    cr.line_to(x + 18 * s, y - 158 * s)
    cr.curve_to(x + 34 * s, y - 150 * s, x + 34 * s, y - 120 * s, x + 28 * s, y - 70 * s)

    solid(cr, hair, rim=False)


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: the state treasury's unclaimed-money vault
    SUBSTANCE: forgotten cash in the vault
    CAUSE: Data grips the giant vault door and drags it open with his own hands, exposing the money held inside
    A domed state capitol with a columned portico and steps on a plaza;
    regular people walk up to it by the camera while a car goes by. In the
    capitol's base is the UNCLAIMED PROPERTY vault, its steel door shut on
    shelves of cash and money bags. Data grabs the door's handle and hauls
    it aside, state by state: the door opens as far as that state's
    forgotten money, Ohio's, then Texas's, then California's 15 billion
    throws it fully open. Each state leaves a notch on the door's track,
    named on the stone above, so a glance shows California's stash is about
    three times Ohio's. Landed by 0.56 and held, the vault light spilling
    onto the steps while the flag waves and cars pass."""
    rows = sorted([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts], key=lambda r: r[1])
    n = len(rows)
    top = rows[-1][1] or 1.0
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.56
    span = (a1 - a0) / max(1, n)
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    slide = ease(seg(f, 0.15, 0.7))
    prev = rows[k - 1][1] if k > 0 else 0.0
    frac = 0.0 if u < a0 else (prev + (rows[k][1] - prev) * slide) / top
    landed_to = k if slide >= 0.999 else k - 1
    shown = None if (u < a0 or landed_to < 0) else rows[landed_to]

    landscape(cr, t, "town")
    birds(cr, t, y0=760, n=4, rgb=(60, 60, 70))

    BASE = 1440
    STONE = (230, 224, 210)
    COL = (238, 233, 222)
    cast_shadow(cr, 60, 1010, BASE, length=340, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, 535, BASE + 4, 1000, a=0.4)
    b = building(cr, 60, 1010, BASE, 560, STONE, roof_rgb=(150, 146, 138),
                 roof="flat", boards=False)
    rx = (b["x0"] + b["x1"]) / 2
    ty = b["top"]

    # the capitol dome: a colonnaded drum, a gilded ribbed dome, lantern, flag
    cylinder(cr, rx - 160, ty, 320, 80, COL)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((170, 164, 150)))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    for i in range(9):
        cx_ = rx - 140 + i * 35
        cr.move_to(cx_, ty - 8)
        cr.line_to(cx_, ty - 64)
    cr.stroke()
    DR, DK = 150, 0.66
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(rx, ty - 80)
    cr.scale(1, DK)
    cr.arc(0, 0, DR, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (214, 184, 106), finish="metal")
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 120, 60), 0.7))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    for i in range(1, 6):
        ang = math.pi + i * math.pi / 6
        cr.move_to(rx + DR * math.cos(ang), ty - 80)
        cr.curve_to(rx + DR * math.cos(ang), ty - 80 + DR * DK * math.sin(ang) * 0.7,
                    rx + DR * 0.4 * math.cos(ang), ty - 80 - DR * DK,
                    rx, ty - 80 - DR * DK)
    cr.stroke()
    lt = ty - 80 - DR * DK + 4
    cylinder(cr, rx - 20, lt, 40, 40, COL)
    pole_top = lt - 40 - 40
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 70, 76)))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    cr.move_to(rx, lt - 40)
    cr.line_to(rx, pole_top)
    cr.stroke()
    fl = []
    for i in range(13):
        fx = rx + i * 9
        fl.append((fx, pole_top + 7 * math.sin(t * 3.2 - i * 0.5) * (i / 12)))
    cr.move_to(*fl[0])
    for p_ in fl[1:]:
        cr.line_to(*p_)
    for p_ in reversed(fl):
        cr.line_to(p_[0], p_[1] + 46)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (64, 92, 150), rim=False)

    # the portico: pediment, entablature, columns
    cr.move_to(50, 962)
    cr.line_to(rx, 892)
    cr.line_to(1020, 962)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (224, 218, 204))
    box(cr, 50, 1000, 970, 40, (222, 216, 202), depth=20)
    for cx in (78, 600, 680, 760, 840, 920):
        cylinder(cr, cx, BASE, 36, 440, COL)

    # the vault: shelves of cash and money bags behind the doorway
    DX0, DX1, DY, GY = 130, 530, 1040, BASE
    dw = DX1 - DX0
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(DX0, DY, dw, GY - DY)
    cr.clip()
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (52, 42, 30)), (1, (120, 92, 56))], DY, GY, DX0, DX1)
    glow(cr, (DX0 + DX1) / 2, 1240, 300, (255, 214, 140), 0.25 + 0.35 * frac)
    for sy in (1150, 1270):
        cr.rectangle(DX0, sy, dw, 12)
        solid(cr, (122, 92, 58), rim=False)
        for j in range(7):
            _ufd_bundle(cr, DX0 + 10 + j * 56, sy)
        for j in range(6):
            _ufd_bundle(cr, DX0 + 38 + j * 56, sy - 24)
    for i, bx in enumerate((180, 280, 380, 480)):
        _ufd_bag(cr, bx, GY - 4, 0.95 + 0.15 * (i % 2))
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 72, 80)))
    cr.set_line_width(14)
    cr.rectangle(DX0, DY, dw, GY - DY)
    cr.stroke()

    # the steps up to the vault, its light spilling down them as it opens
    box(cr, 30, 1474, 1010, 30, (214, 208, 194), depth=16)
    box(cr, 0, 1508, 1080, 32, (204, 198, 184), depth=16)
    if frac > 0:
        glow(cr, DX0 + dw * frac / 2, GY + 40, 140 + 280 * frac,
             (255, 214, 140), 0.5 * frac)

    # the track, the door sliding along it
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((46, 44, 48)))
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    cr.move_to(DX0 - 20, DY - 20)
    cr.line_to(DX1 + dw + 30, DY - 20)
    cr.stroke()
    dx = DX0 + dw * frac
    cr.rectangle(dx, DY - 8, dw, GY - DY + 8)
    solid(cr, (128, 134, 144), finish="metal")
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((84, 88, 98)))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    cr.rectangle(dx + 18, DY + 10, dw - 36, GY - DY - 28)
    cr.stroke()
    for i in range(6):
        disc(cr, dx + 30 + i * (dw - 60) / 5, DY + 30, 7, (176, 180, 188), finish="metal")
        disc(cr, dx + 30 + i * (dw - 60) / 5, GY - 30, 7, (176, 180, 188), finish="metal")
    wx, wy = dx + dw / 2, 1250
    disc(cr, wx, wy, 84, (150, 156, 166), finish="metal")
    rot = frac * 7.0
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 62, 70)))
    cr.set_line_width(14)
    for i in range(3):
        ang = rot + i * math.pi / 3
        cr.move_to(wx - 74 * math.cos(ang), wy - 74 * math.sin(ang))
        cr.line_to(wx + 74 * math.cos(ang), wy + 74 * math.sin(ang))
    cr.stroke()
    disc(cr, wx, wy, 24, (180, 184, 192), finish="metal")
    box(cr, dx + 50, 1112, dw - 100, 40, (232, 214, 150), depth=6, finish="metal")
    text(cr, "UNCLAIMED PROPERTY", dx + dw / 2, 1102, 26, (50, 44, 36),
         face="bold", anchor="center", shadow=False)
    cr.rectangle(dx + dw - 40, 1280, 16, 110)
    solid(cr, (60, 62, 70), finish="metal")
    for hx_ in (dx + 40, dx + dw - 40):
        disc(cr, hx_, DY - 20, 11, (70, 70, 76), finish="metal")

    # THE SCALE on the track: a notch where each state's money opened it to,
    # its name cut into the stone above, staggered so none collide
    if u >= a0:
        for j in range(0, landed_to + 1):
            nx = DX0 + dw * rows[j][1] / top
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((244, 238, 226)))
            cr.set_line_width(6)
            cr.move_to(nx, DY - 40)
            cr.line_to(nx, DY - 4)
            cr.stroke()
            ly = DY - 50 if j % 2 == 0 else DY - 86
            text(cr, rows[j][0], nx, ly, 30, look.INK, face="bold", anchor="center")

    # right by the camera: regular people walking up to claim it, a car by
    crowd = [(150, 1720, (176, 60, 52), (60, 40, 30)),
             (320, 1700, (70, 120, 96), (30, 26, 24)),
             (480, 1735, (214, 160, 60), (120, 80, 44))]
    for i, (px, py, coat, hair) in enumerate(crowd):
        g = ease(seg(u, 0.05 + 0.08 * i, 0.45 + 0.08 * i))
        walking = 0.0 < g < 1.0
        _ufd_person(cr, px - 360 * (1 - g), py, 1.3, t, i, coat, hair, walking)
    cx = -480 + ((t * 230) % 2040)
    _ufd_car(cr, cx, 1880, 1.15)
    foreground(cr, "town")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    edge_x = dx + dw
    hx = edge_x + 40
    hands = [(edge_x - 32, 1306), (edge_x - 32, 1366)]
    if u < a0:
        host("point", DX1 + 60, 1450, 240)
    elif u < 0.9:
        host("grip", hx, 1450, 240, hands=hands, lower="brace",
             expr="strain" if u < a1 + 0.04 else "happy")
    else:
        host("cheer", hx, 1450, 240)

    if shown is not None:
        lab, v = shown
        fit_readout(cr, f"${v:g} billion", f"forgotten money held by {lab}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, a0, a0 + 0.05)), size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Forgotten money", "the state is holding it for you",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

stories.title: A NASA Lab Makes Atoms Colder Than Deep Space
stories.hook: Space is freezing, and we made something colder.

    SUBSTANCE: silver mercury
    CAUSE: Data slides the warm hatch shut and the mercury shrinks in the cold
    A tall lab thermometer stands on the frozen ground outside a space
    station. Its warm hatch spills orange light across it, and its silver
    column stands at room temperature. Data puts both hands on the hatch's
    sliding door and pushes it shut. As the warm light is cut off, the
    silver mercury shrinks down the tube and stops at the background
    temperature of deep space. That level sits clearly above the
    absolute-zero line marked on the glass, so empty space is cold but not
    zero. The room level stays marked where the column started. Done by
    0.56 and held: frost creeps up the glass, a satellite drifts over, and
    Data keeps leaning on the closed door."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]

# scene standard: 2026-10-16.2
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a big glass jar of glowing atoms
    SUBSTANCE: the glowing atoms
    CAUSE: Data pours liquid nitrogen from a bucket over the jar and the hot atoms slow, turn blue and settle
    Aboard the space station, a big screw-lid glass jar with a paper label
    stands on the lab floor. It is full of hot orange atoms buzzing around
    like fireflies. Data climbs a stepladder beside it and tips a bucket of
    smoking liquid nitrogen over the lid three times. Each time the white
    flood runs down the glass, frost is left behind on it, and the atoms
    inside slow down, turn ice-blue and pull into a tighter knot. THE SCALE
    is on the jar: the first pour's frost line is marked with the nebula's
    name, and the next two pours climb far past it. Landed by 0.6 and held.
    The knot keeps glowing, cold vapour keeps spilling off the floor and
    Data keeps pouring."""
    rows = sorted([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts], key=lambda r: -r[1])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    r = v0 / v1 if v1 > 0 else 0.0
    words = f"{r:,.0f}"
    for big, name in ((1e12, "trillion"), (1e9, "billion"), (1e6, "million")):
        if r >= big:
            words = f"{r / big:,.0f} {name}"
            break
    s1 = f"{v1:.15f}".rstrip("0").rstrip(".")
    if s1 in ("0", ""):
        s1 = f"{v1:g}"
    name1 = l1.split(" (")[0]

    n = 3
    a0, a1 = 0.16, 0.6
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    rise = ease(seg(f, 0.3, 0.8))
    LEV = [0.0, 0.3, 0.68, 1.0]
    fr = 0.0 if u < a0 else LEV[k] + (LEV[k + 1] - LEV[k]) * rise
    done = u >= a0 and k == n - 1 and rise >= 0.999
    heat = 1.0 - fr

    # the jar's geometry
    JX0, JX1 = 200, 800
    NX0, NX1 = 300, 700
    SHY, NY, BOT = 790, 720, 1440
    CX, CY = (JX0 + JX1) / 2, 1110
    LID = NY - 70

    def jar_path():
        rr = 50
        cr.new_path()
        cr.move_to(NX0, NY)
        cr.line_to(NX1, NY)
        cr.curve_to(NX1 + 40, NY + 20, JX1, SHY - 30, JX1, SHY + 20)
        cr.line_to(JX1, BOT - rr)
        cr.curve_to(JX1, BOT, JX1 - rr, BOT, JX1 - rr, BOT)
        cr.line_to(JX0 + rr, BOT)
        cr.curve_to(JX0, BOT, JX0, BOT - rr, JX0, BOT - rr)
        cr.line_to(JX0, SHY + 20)
        cr.curve_to(JX0, SHY - 30, NX0 - 40, NY + 20, NX0, NY)
        cr.close_path()

    # the pour clock: each pour tips, floods the glass, then eases off
    pf = 0.0
    if u >= a0:
        pf = f if u < a1 else ((u - a1) / 0.13) % 1.0
    pour = 0.0 if u < a0 else seg(pf, 0.1, 0.25) * (1 - seg(pf, 0.7, 0.85))
    flood = 0.0 if u < a0 else seg(pf, 0.18, 0.6)

    # the module: walls running back to a rear bulkhead
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (60, 66, 78)), (0.45, (166, 172, 182)), (1, (112, 118, 128))], 0, H)
    cr.rectangle(220, 560, 640, 690)

                             (220, 1250, 0, 1500), (860, 1250, W, 1500)):

    cr.stroke()
    for i in range(3):
        box(cr, 40, 900 + i * 160, 130, 130, (226, 222, 210), depth=30)
    # a porthole with Earth below
    disc(cr, 900, 330, 120, (170, 176, 186), finish="metal")
    cr.save()
    cr.arc(900, 330, 92, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.clip()
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (4, 6, 16)), (1, (14, 18, 40))], 230, 430, 800, 1000)
    disc(cr, 960, 500, 190, (50, 110, 190), finish="gloss")
    cr.restore()
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (126, 132, 142)), (1, (80, 84, 94))], 1250, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 74, 84), 0.5))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(9):

    # the atoms: hot and racing, then cold, blue and packed into a knot
    sp = 0.25 + 0.75 * heat
    for i in range(30):
        ph = i * 2.399
        w = (1.6 + 0.6 * ((i * 0.37) % 1.0)) * sp
        rx = 30 + 220 * heat * (0.5 + 0.5 * ((i * 0.618) % 1.0))

        col = tuple(int(c + (h - c) * heat) for c, h in zip((120, 200, 255), (255, 130, 50)))

         fr * (0.6 + 0.15 * math.sin(t * 2.4)))

    # the glass: tint across it

    g.add_color_stop_rgba(0, 0.85, 0.92, 1.0, 0.18)
    g.add_color_stop_rgba(0.5, 0.85, 0.92, 1.0, 0.04)
    g.add_color_stop_rgba(1, 0.2, 0.25, 0.35, 0.25)
    cr.set_source(g)
    cr.fill()
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 255, 255), 0.55))
    cr.set_line_width(16)
    cr.move_to(JX0 + 50, SHY + 60)
    cr.line_to(JX0 + 50, BOT - 120)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_line_width(7)
    cr.move_to(JX0 + 88, SHY + 90)
    cr.line_to(JX0 + 88, SHY + 300)
    cr.stroke()
    jar_path()
    edge(cr, (40, 50, 66), width=6)
    # the paper label
    cr.new_path()
    cr.rectangle(CX - 120, 1250, 240, 110)
    solid(cr, (238, 230, 206))
    text(cr, "ATOMS", CX, 1322, 44, (70, 60, 50), face="bold", anchor="center",
         shadow=False)
    # the screw lid with its threads
    cylinder(cr, NX0 - 14, NY + 6, NX1 - NX0 + 28, 84, (176, 182, 192), finish="metal")
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((90, 96, 108), 0.8))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    for j in range(5):
        yy = NY - 10 - j * 13
        cr.move_to(NX0 - 12, yy)
        cr.line_to(NX1 + 12, yy - 6)
    cr.stroke()

    # THE SCALE on the jar: where the nebula's cold reached the glass — the
    # mark stops short of centre so its label ends well inside the frame
    if u >= a0 and (k > 0 or rise > 0.999):
        my = BOT - (BOT - NY) * LEV[1]
        then_mark(cr, JX0 + 10, 470, my, l0)

    # the pour: from his bucket, an arc of smoking liquid onto the lid
    hx, hy = 925, LTOP
    if pour > 0:
        sx, sy = hx - 95, hy - 175
        ex, ey = 640, LID + 6
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 248, 255), 0.85 * pour))

        cr.move_to(sx, sy)

            cr.move_to(ex, ey)
            cr.curve_to(ex + s_ * 90, ey - 40, CX + s_ * 230, NY - 20,
                        CX + s_ * 270, NY + 40)
            cr.stroke()
    # cold vapour rolling off the jar's foot
    glow(cr, CX - 140 + 60 * math.sin(t * 0.6), BOT - 10, 230, (222, 238, 250),
         0.15 + 0.3 * fr + 0.25 * pour)
    glow(cr, CX + 180 + 50 * math.sin(t * 0.5 + 1), BOT + 10, 200, (222, 238, 250),
         0.12 + 0.25 * fr + 0.25 * pour)

    # right by the camera: a cargo bag, a toolbox, the handrail
    contact_shadow(cr, 180, 1910, 320, a=0.35)
    box(cr, 40, 1915, 280, 230, (230, 226, 212), depth=60)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 90, 150)))
    cr.set_line_width(14)
    cr.move_to(110, 1685)
    cr.line_to(110, 1915)
    cr.move_to(250, 1685)
    cr.line_to(250, 1915)

    # Data: points from the floor, climbs the ladder, pours, cheers
    if u < 0.06:

    elif u < a0:

stories.hook: The Ocean Is Rising Faster Than Predicted
stories.closing: Buy beachfront property. Or don't. Your call.
stories.question: Would you still buy a house on the coast? Drop it below.
stories.caption: The rate of sea level rise has doubled since 1993 -- and 2024 rose even faster than NASA predicted. By 2050, coastal high-tide flooding could hit 65 days a year nationally. Would you still buy beachfront property? 👇

segments.say: In 1993, satellites measured the ocean rising about 2.1 millimeters a year. By 2024 that rate had roughly doubled to 4.5 millimeters a year. The ocean isn't just rising -- it's rising faster.

segments.say: Scientists expected about 4.3 millimeters of rise in 2024. The ocean rose 5.9 millimeters instead -- mostly because warmer water simply takes up more space. Even the models are running behind.

stories.title: One Vaccine Nearly Wiped Out Chickenpox (3 Charts)
stories.hook: One vaccine nearly ended a childhood disease.
stories.closing: That 9% gap is exactly how a nearly-erased disease comes back.
stories.question: Did you get chickenpox, or just the vaccine? Tell me below.
stories.caption: Before 1995, an estimated 4 million American kids caught chickenpox every year -- it was basically a rite of passage. One vaccine later, cases collapsed by over 95% and deaths dropped from over 100 a year to single digits. Did you get chickenpox, or just the vaccine? 👇

segments.say: Before 1995, doctors estimated 4 million American kids caught chickenpox every single year. It was so common, parents used to plan pox parties to get it over with.

segments.say: That wasn't harmless. Chickenpox killed around 105 Americans a year before the vaccine. Since routine vaccination began, that number has fallen to about 5 deaths a year.

stories.title: Bald Eagles Were Nearly Extinct. Not Anymore. (3 Charts)

stories.closing: From 417 to over 71,000 -- the next one might already be circling above you.

segments.topic: bald eagle nesting pairs over time
segments.say: In 1963, America's national symbol hit an all-time low of just 417 nesting pairs, wiped out by a pesticide called DDT. It was on the edge of disappearing.

segments.say: Once DDT was banned in 1972, the recovery took off. Minnesota alone now hosts about 9,800 nesting pairs, more than twenty times the entire country's 1963 total.
Put it side by side: 417 pairs in 1963, over 71,000 by 2020. That's one of the biggest wildlife comebacks in American history, and it's still growing.

stories.title: Self-Checkout Is Quietly Replacing Cashiers (3 Charts)
stories.hook: Self-checkout was sold as the future. Stores are losing more money on it.
stories.closing: The line moved. So did the job
stories.question: Do you still choose a cashier?
stories.caption: Self-checkout went from a novelty in 6% of big grocery chains in 2000 to over 90% today, while US cashier employment has been shrinking every year since. There's a catch, though -- stores now lose more to theft at self-checkout than they ever did at a staffed register. Do you use it? 👇

segments.say: In 2023, over 92% of major grocery chains have self‑checkout lanes.

def _at(L, z):
    z = clamp(z, 0, len(L) - 1)

        return L[-1]
    f = z - i
    return tuple(p + (q - p) * f for p, q in zip(L[i], L[i + 1]))


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a supermarket's row of checkout lanes
    SUBSTANCE: self-checkout kiosks
    CAUSE: Data places a self-checkout kiosk into each cashier lane, replacing the cashier, lane after lane
    Inside one supermarket, its ten checkout lanes running from right by the
    camera back into the store: the WHOLE is the front end. Each year Data
    sets kiosks down into lanes, working from the far end toward the camera,
    and the cashier there is gone, until that year's share of lanes is
    self-checkout; the overhead sign is cut at the exact share, the
    SELF-CHECKOUT part in the accent, and every landed year leaves a notch on
    it. Done by 0.56 and held: one cashier lane is left, nearest the camera,
    and carts keep rolling past."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    n = len(rows)
    N = 10
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.56
    span = (a1 - a0) / max(1, n)
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    slide = ease(seg(f, 0.05, 0.85))
    prev = rows[k - 1][1] if k > 0 else 0.0
    share = 0.0 if u < a0 else clamp((prev + (rows[k][1] - prev) * slide) / 100.0)
    landed_to = k if slide >= 0.999 else k - 1
    keep = sorted({round(i * (n - 1) / max(1, READOUT_SHOWS - 1))
                   for i in range(READOUT_SHOWS)}) if n > READOUT_SHOWS else list(range(n))
    named = max((i for i in keep if i <= landed_to), default=None)
    shown = None if (u < a0 or named is None) else rows[named]

    # the lanes, big by the camera on the left, running back to the right
    lanes = []
    x, y, s = 50.0, 1440.0, 2.0
    for j in range(N + 1):
        lanes.append((x, y, s))
        x += 70 * s
        y -= 30 * s
        s *= 0.9

    # which year turns which lane over — rank 0 is the FAR lane
    step_of = []
    for r in range(N):
        thr = (r + 0.5) / N * 100.0
        step_of.append(next((i for i in range(n) if rows[i][1] >= thr), None))
    now = [r for r in range(N) if step_of[r] == k]
    conv_r = []
    for r in range(N):
        sr = step_of[r]
        if u < a0 or sr is None or sr > k:
            conv_r.append(0.0)
        elif sr < k:
            conv_r.append(1.0)
        else:
            q = now.index(r)
            conv_r.append(clamp((slide * (len(now) + 1) - q) / 2.0))
    conv = [conv_r[N - 1 - j] for j in range(N)]

    # the store: a warm ceiling with light panels running back into it
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (70, 66, 64)), (0.5, (168, 160, 148)), (1, (214, 206, 190))], 0, 1100)
    for i in range(8):
        z = i / 7.0
        lx = 40 + 900 * z ** 0.8
        ly = 140 + 560 * z ** 0.9
        sc = 1.0 - 0.7 * z
        glow(cr, lx + 90 * sc, ly, 200 * sc, (255, 240, 205), 0.4)
        box(cr, lx, ly, 180 * sc, 22 * sc, (246, 242, 230), depth=40 * sc)
    # the far aisles: tall stocked shelving under haze
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (176, 170, 160)), (1, (120, 114, 106))], 1080, H)
    for i in range(10):
        bx = 10 + i * 108
        hgt = 420 - i * 14
        contact_shadow(cr, bx + 45, 1100, 110, a=0.25)
        box(cr, bx, 1100, 92, hgt, (142, 134, 122), depth=18)
        rows_n = int(hgt // 62)
        for r_ in range(rows_n):
            cr.rectangle(bx + 2, 1100 - 8 - r_ * 62, 90, 5)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((90, 84, 76)))
            cr.fill()
            for c_ in range(4):
                col = [(190, 70, 60), (214, 168, 70), (80, 124, 170), (110, 156, 90)][(i + r_ + c_) % 4]
                cr.rectangle(bx + 6 + c_ * 21, 1100 - 48 - r_ * 62, 17, 38)
                cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(col, 0.9))
                cr.fill()
    haze(cr, 600, 1110, (200, 194, 182), a=0.55)
    # a polished floor running to the camera
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(0, 1100, W, H - 1100)
    cr.clip()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((90, 84, 76), 0.3))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(14):
        cr.move_to(1300, 1000)
        cr.line_to(-900 + i * 200, H)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()
    glow(cr, 540, 1350, 560, (255, 236, 200), 0.2)
    cast_shadow(cr, lanes[0][0], lanes[N][0] + 40, 1450, length=240, a=0.2)

    # the lanes, far first
    for j in reversed(range(N)):
        lx, ly, ls = lanes[j]
        c = conv[j]
        cr.rectangle(lx + 88 * ls, ly - 300 * ls, 6 * ls, 190 * ls)
        solid(cr, (70, 72, 80), finish="metal", rim=False)
        lit = P["accent2"] if c > 0.5 else (240, 214, 140)
        glow(cr, lx + 91 * ls, ly - 300 * ls, 30 * ls, lit, 0.6)
        disc(cr, lx + 91 * ls, ly - 300 * ls, 12 * ls, lit, finish="gloss")
        _till(cr, lx, ly + 30 * ls * clamp(c / 0.45), ls, 1.0 - clamp(c / 0.45))
        d = clamp((c - 0.35) / 0.65)
        _kiosk(cr, lx, ly, ls, clamp(d * 3), (1 - pop(d)) * 260 * ls)

    # the overhead sign over the whole front end, cut at the share
    def _band(z0, z1, rgb):
        if z1 - z0 < 0.01:
            return
        top, bot = [], []
        for i in range(13):
            bx_, by_, bs_ = _at(lanes, z0 + (z1 - z0) * i / 12)
            top.append((bx_, by_ - 340 * bs_))
            bot.append((bx_, by_ - 340 * bs_ + 44 * bs_))
        cr.move_to(*top[0])
        for p_ in top[1:]:
            cr.line_to(*p_)
        for p_ in reversed(bot):
            cr.line_to(*p_)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, rgb)
    L = share * N
    cut = N - L
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 62, 70)))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    for z in (0.4, 4.0, 8.0):
        bx_, by_, bs_ = _at(lanes, z)
        cr.move_to(bx_, by_ - 340 * bs_)
        cr.line_to(bx_, by_ - 340 * bs_ - 200)
    cr.stroke()
    _band(0, cut, (150, 152, 158))
    _band(cut, N, P["accent2"])
    if L > 3.0:
        tx_, ty_, ts_ = _at(lanes, cut + 0.3)
        text(cr, "SELF-CHECKOUT", tx_ + 6, ty_ - 340 * ts_ + 32 * ts_,
             max(20, int(22 * ts_)), look.INK, face="bold", shadow=False)
    if u >= a0:
        for j in range(0, landed_to + 1):
            nx, ny, ns = _at(lanes, N - rows[j][1] / 100.0 * N)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((244, 238, 226)))
            cr.set_line_width(6)
            cr.move_to(nx, ny - 340 * ns - 6)
            cr.line_to(nx, ny - 340 * ns + 50 * ns)
            cr.stroke()
            if j == named or (j == 0 and named is not None and named != 0):
                text(cr, rows[j][0], nx, ny - 340 * ns - 18, 30, look.INK,
                     face="bold", anchor="center")

    # right by the camera: carts rolling through, a basket on the floor
    for j in range(2):
        cx = -240 + ((t * 190 + j * 780) % 1560)
        _cart(cr, cx, 1790 + j * 60, 1.35 + 0.15 * j)
    _basket(cr, 940, 1880, 1.3)
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data works his way from the far lane toward the camera
    P_ = sum(conv)
    dx_, dy_, ds_ = _at(lanes, clamp(N - P_ - 0.5, 0, N - 1))
    hx, hy = dx_ + 30 * ds_, min(1500.0, dy_ + 50 * ds_)
    hh = clamp(120 * ds_, 180, 240)

    elif u < a1 + 0.04:
        host("place", hx, hy, hh, beat=k)
    else:
        host("hold_up", hx, hy, hh)

    if shown is not None:
        lab, v = shown
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v))}%", f"of major grocery chains have self-checkout · {lab}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, a0, a0 + 0.05)), size=130)
    else:

                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a junk heap of cash registers
    SUBSTANCE: old cash registers
    CAUSE: Data tosses cash registers one by one onto the junk heap, and the heap grows with every throw
    Behind the store, the tills that lost their cashiers are thrown on a
    junk pile. Data takes registers off a pallet and tosses them up onto the
    summit, one throw per 100,000 cashier jobs lost between the two years,
    and the heap swells from a few old tills to a mound taller than the
    pallet beside it. The readout goes from the first year's jobs to the
    last year's, plus the jobs lost. All of it lands by 0.56. After that a
    loose till keeps tumbling down the flank while he holds up one more."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    lost = v0 - v1
    m = int(clamp(round(abs(lost) * 10), 3, 6))
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.56
    span = (a1 - a0) / m
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, m - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    fly = seg(f, 0.0, 0.4)
    grow = ease(seg(f, 0.36, 0.72))
    step = 0.0 if u < a0 else (k + grow) / m
    done = u >= a0 and k == m - 1 and grow >= 0.999

    CX, BASE = 400, 1440

    def size(st):
        return 210 + 400 * st, 180 + 180 * st

    h, hw = size(step)

    landscape(cr, t, "town")
    birds(cr, t, y0=760, n=4, rgb=(60, 60, 70))

    # the junk heap: dark rubble with the old tills piled through it
    cast_shadow(cr, CX - hw, CX + hw, BASE, length=320, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, CX, BASE + 4, 2 * hw + 60, a=0.4)
    heap_path(cr, CX, BASE, h, hw)
    solid(cr, (98, 92, 86))
    count = int(7 + 16 * step + 0.5)
    spots = []
    for i in range(count):
        dx = ((i * 0.6180339) % 1.0) * 1.5 - 0.75
        px = CX + hw * dx
        top_y = heap_top(CX, BASE, h, hw, px)
        py = top_y + 70 + (BASE - top_y - 70) * ((i * 0.4142136) % 1.0) * 0.9
        spots.append((py, px, i))
    for py, px, i in sorted(spots):
        _register(cr, px, py, 0.72 + 0.22 * ((i * 0.37) % 1.0),
                  ((i * 0.71) % 1.0 - 0.5) * 1.1)
    heap_path(cr, CX, BASE, h, hw)
    edge(cr, (40, 36, 32))

    # the pallet of registers still to go, beside the heap
    PX = 940
    left = m - k - (1 if (u >= a0 and fly > 0) else 0)
    if done:
        left = 0
    contact_shadow(cr, PX + 40, BASE + 4, 300, a=0.4)
    box(cr, PX - 120, BASE, 300, 26, (150, 112, 70), depth=40)
    for j in range(left):
        col, row = j % 2, j // 2
        _register(cr, PX - 50 + col * 150, BASE - 26 - row * 160, 0.9)

    # Data on the heap's right flank, climbing as it widens
    fx = CX + hw * 0.7
    fy = min(1460.0, heap_top(CX, BASE, h, hw, fx) + 12)

    # the till in flight, from his hands up to the summit
    if u >= a0 and not done and 0 < fly < 1:
        nh, nhw = size((k + 1) / m)
        sx, sy = fx - 20, fy - 200
        ex = CX + 30
        ey = heap_top(CX, BASE, nh, nhw, ex) + 40
        bx = sx + (ex - sx) * fly
        by = sy + (ey - sy) * fly - 240 * math.sin(math.pi * fly)
        _register(cr, bx, by, 1.0, -fly * 2.4)
    # dust where each one lands
    if u >= a0:
        dp = seg(f, 0.38, 0.6)
        if 0 < dp < 1:
            for q in range(5):
                cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["dust"], 0.65 * (1 - dp)))
                cr.arc(CX - 80 + q * 45, BASE - h + 20 - 40 * dp - 12 * (q % 2),
                       22 + 46 * dp, 0, 2 * math.pi)
                cr.fill()

    # once the heap is done the world keeps moving, not the story: a loose
    # till keeps tumbling down the left flank
    if u > a1:
        ph = ((u - a1) / 0.2) % 1.0
        bx = CX - hw * (0.1 + 0.8 * ph)
        by = heap_top(CX, BASE, h, hw, bx) + 30
        _register(cr, bx, by, 0.9, -ph * 5.0)

    # right by the camera: a cart rolling across the lot
    _cart(cr, -320 + (t * 150) % 1700, 1780, 1.5)
    foreground(cr, "town")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    if u < 0.04:
        host("point", 860, 1452, 220)
    elif u < a0:
        w = ease(seg(u, 0.04, a0))
        host("climb", 860 + (fx - 860) * w, 1452 + (fy - 1452) * w, 220)
    elif u < a1 + 0.04:
        host("toss", fx, fy, 220, beat=k)
    else:
        host("hold_up", fx, fy, 220)

    if done:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{v1:.1f}M", f"US cashier jobs · {l1}", 80, 520, size=130)
        text(cr, f"-{lost:.1f}M", W - 80, 690, 90, look.INK, face="display",
             anchor="right", alpha=ease(seg(u, a1 - 0.02, a1 + 0.03)))
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{v0:.1f}M", f"US cashier jobs · {l0}", 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

segments.illustrated_scene:
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a tower of unscanned grocery boxes
    SUBSTANCE: cardboard grocery cartons
    CAUSE: Data climbs a ladder and stacks box after box on the tower, placing one carton per slice of loss
    Outside the supermarket, the goods that walked out unpaid sit as one
    tower of cartons on a pallet in the car park. The staffed registers'
    loss is the tower's first boxes. From that level Data, up a ladder
    leaning on the tower's right side, places carton after carton until
    the tower reaches the self-checkout rate. THE SCALE is on the tower: a
    dashed line marks where the staffed level stopped, with its name
    beneath it on the left, and 1x and 2x ticks up the left side measure
    the new tower in the old one. It ends about two and a half times as
    tall. All of it lands by u=0.54. After that a shopping cart rolls out
    of the lot by the camera and Data holds the top box up."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    hi = max(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    lo = min(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    hv = hi[1] or 1.0
    ratio = hi[1] / (lo[1] or 1.0)
    N = 10
    n0 = int(clamp(round(N * lo[1] / hv), 1, N - 1))
    add = N - n0
    a0, a1 = 0.06, 0.54
    span = (a1 - a0) / add
    if u < a0:
        k, f, land = 0, 0.0, 0.0
    else:
        k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, add - 0.001))
        f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
        land = ease(seg(f, 0.15, 0.6))
    placed = n0 if u < a0 else n0 + k + (1 if land >= 0.999 else 0)
    hcur = n0 if u < a0 else n0 + k + land
    done = u >= a0 and k == add - 1 and land >= 0.999

    TX, BW, BH, BD = 330, 300, 76, 60
    S0 = 1420                                  # pallet top
    BANDS = [(198, 52, 44), (44, 98, 178), (232, 186, 46), (60, 146, 82),
             (210, 112, 40)]

    def jit(i):
        return ((i * 37) % 11 - 5) * 3

    def carton(x, y, i, w=BW, h=BH, d=BD, a=1.0):
        box(cr, x, y, w, h, (196, 154, 102), depth=d, a=a)
        cr.rectangle(x + 16, y - h + 18, w - 32, h * 0.36)
        solid(cr, BANDS[i % len(BANDS)], a=a, rim=False)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 28, 26), 0.85 * a))
        for b in range(9):
            cr.rectangle(x + w - 80 + b * 7, y - 24, 3 if b % 3 else 2, 15)
        cr.fill()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 112, 70), a))
        cr.set_line_width(5)
        cr.move_to(x + w / 2, y - h)
        cr.line_to(x + w / 2, y - h + 14)
        cr.stroke()

    def cart(x, y, s):
        contact_shadow(cr, x, y, 230 * s, a=0.4)
        cr.move_to(x - 110 * s, y - 190 * s)
        cr.line_to(x + 100 * s, y - 190 * s)
        cr.line_to(x + 80 * s, y - 70 * s)
        cr.line_to(x - 90 * s, y - 70 * s)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (168, 176, 188), finish="metal", a=0.9)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 76, 86)))
        cr.set_line_width(3 * s)
        for j in range(1, 10):
            xx = x - 110 * s + j * 21 * s
            cr.move_to(xx, y - 190 * s)
            cr.line_to(xx - 2 * s, y - 70 * s)
        for j in range(1, 4):
            yy = y - 190 * s + j * 30 * s
            cr.move_to(x - 110 * s + j * 5 * s, yy)
            cr.line_to(x + 100 * s - j * 5 * s, yy)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.set_line_width(8 * s)
        cr.move_to(x - 90 * s, y - 70 * s)
        cr.line_to(x - 80 * s, y - 24 * s)
        cr.line_to(x + 75 * s, y - 24 * s)
        cr.line_to(x + 80 * s, y - 70 * s)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((200, 46, 40)))
        cr.set_line_width(12 * s)
        cr.move_to(x + 100 * s, y - 190 * s)
        cr.line_to(x + 150 * s, y - 220 * s)
        cr.stroke()
        for wx in (x - 78 * s, x + 70 * s):
            disc(cr, wx, y - 12 * s, 13 * s, (40, 40, 46))

    # the setting: the supermarket at the edge of town, its car park
    landscape(cr, t, "town")
    st = building(cr, -80, 520, 1190, 300, (222, 214, 198), roof="flat", boards=False)
    cr.rectangle(st["x0"] + 110, st["base"] - 160, 300, 160)
    solid(cr, (150, 192, 214), finish="glass")
    glow(cr, st["x0"] + 260, st["base"] - 80, 160, (250, 236, 200), 0.35)
    cr.rectangle(st["x0"] + 100, st["top"] + 24, 320, 72)
    solid(cr, (46, 120, 70))
    text(cr, "MARKET", st["x0"] + 260, st["top"] + 80, 52, (244, 240, 228),
         anchor="center", shadow=False)
    haze(cr, 700, 1200, (214, 200, 186), a=0.25)
    # asphalt and bay lines
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (88, 90, 96)), (1, (52, 54, 60))], 1240, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((232, 230, 220), 0.8))
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    for j in range(7):
        bx = -100 + j * 220
        cr.move_to(bx + 40, 1260)
        cr.line_to(bx - 120, 1540)
    cr.stroke()

    # the tower of unpaid goods on its pallet
    cast_shadow(cr, TX, TX + BW + BD, 1450, length=420, a=0.32)
    contact_shadow(cr, TX + BW / 2 + 20, 1452, BW + 140, a=0.45)
    box(cr, TX - 20, 1450, BW + 40, 30, (160, 120, 76), depth=BD + 6)
    for i in range(placed):
        carton(TX + jit(i), S0 - i * BH, i)

    # THE SCALE: the staffed level as a dashed line across the tower, named
    # beneath it on the left; 1x / 2x ticks up the left side above the name
    my = S0 - n0 * BH
    if placed > n0 or (u >= a0 and land > 0):
        cr.move_to(TX - 50, my)
        cr.line_to(TX + BW + BD + 20, my)
        ghost(cr, a=0.95)
        lab = lo[0].lower()
        text(cr, lab, TX - 30, my + 50, fit_size(cr, lab, 32, TX - 50), look.INK,
             anchor="right")
        times_ticks(cr, TX - 110, S0, n0 * BH, max(1, int(ratio)))

    # the ladder leaning on the tower's right side
    LX0, LY0, LX1, LY1 = 840, 1450, 690, 680
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 104, 60)))
    cr.set_line_width(12)
    for off in (0, 70):
        cr.move_to(LX0 + off, LY0)
        cr.line_to(LX1 + off, LY1)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    for r in range(13):
        q = r / 12
        x_ = LX0 + (LX1 - LX0) * q
        y_ = LY0 + (LY1 - LY0) * q
        cr.move_to(x_, y_)
        cr.line_to(x_ + 70, y_)
    cr.stroke()

    topy = S0 - hcur * BH
    fy = min(1452.0, topy + 250)
    q = clamp((LY0 - fy) / (LY0 - LY1))
    hx = LX0 + 35 + (LX1 - LX0) * q

    # the carton in his hands, set down onto the top of the stack
    if u >= a0 and land < 0.999:
        i = n0 + k
        sx, sy = hx - 60, fy - 150
        ex, ey = TX + jit(i), S0 - i * BH
        bx = sx + (ex - sx) * land
        by = sy + (ey - sy) * land - 70 * math.sin(math.pi * land)
        carton(bx, by, i)

    # right by the camera: cartons that already walked out, and a cart that
    # rolls off across the lot once the tower has landed
    contact_shadow(cr, 170, 1842, 300, a=0.45)
    carton(30, 1840, 1, w=260, h=110, d=70)
    carton(60, 1730, 3, w=210, h=90, d=56)
    cart(860 - 1400 * ease(seg(u, 0.56, 1.0)), 1790, 1.5)
    foreground(cr, "town")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    if u < a0:
        host("point", hx, fy, 220)
    elif u < a1 + 0.04:
        host("place", hx, fy, 220, beat=k)
    elif u < 0.9:
        host("hold_up", hx, fy, 220)
    else:
        host("shock", hx, fy, 220)

    if done:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{hi[1]:g}%", f"of goods lost · {hi[0].lower()}",
                    80, 520, size=130, max_w=560)
        text(cr, f"{ratio:.1f}x", TX - 40, 740, 90, look.INK, face="display",
             anchor="right", alpha=ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.05)))
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{lo[1]:g}%", f"of goods lost · {lo[0].lower()}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130, max_w=560)

stories.title: The Map In Your Head Is Lying To You
stories.hook: Africa is 14 times bigger than Greenland, but your map hides it.
stories.closing: Mercator maps inflate land far from the equator, so trust the numbers, not the picture.
stories.question: Which country looks wrong on maps?
stories.caption: Africa is 14 times bigger than Greenland -- they just look the same size on your map. It's not an accident, it's math: the Mercator projection stretches land more the farther it sits from the equator. See how far off your mental map really is. Which country looks wrong to you? 👇

segments.say: Africa is about fourteen times bigger than Greenland. You could fit Greenland into Africa fourteen times over.

segments.say: Scientists tested seven brain networks, and none matched the left-brain, right-brain myth. The idea just doesn't show up in the wiring.
segments.illustrated_scene:
def _brain_half(cr, cx, cy, rx, ry, side):
    cr.new_path()
    cr.move_to(cx + side * 6, cy - ry * 0.96)
    for i in range(0, 61):
        a = -math.pi / 2 + math.pi * i / 60.0
        bump = 1.0 + 0.035 * math.sin(a * 11.0 + side)
        x = cx + side * (6 + rx * math.cos(a) * bump)
        y = cy + ry * math.sin(a) * bump * (1.0 if a < 0 else 0.92)
        cr.line_to(x, y)
    cr.line_to(cx + side * 6, cy + ry * 0.84)
    cr.close_path()


def _gyri(cr, cx, cy, rx, ry, side, rgb):
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(rgb, 0.85))
    cr.set_line_width(7)
    for j in range(7):
        yy = cy - ry * 0.75 + j * ry * 0.25
        cr.move_to(cx + side * 30, yy)
        for i in range(1, 13):
            xx = cx + side * (30 + i * rx * 0.075)
            cr.line_to(xx, yy + 18 * math.sin(i * 1.7 + j * 2.3))
        cr.stroke()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a human brain, both halves
    SUBSTANCE: glowing brain networks
    CAUSE: Data cranks the scanner and each network lights up across both halves
    The 2013 scan: a top-down brain split by its central fissure, the
    myth's LEFT/RIGHT line down the middle. Each crank of the scanner
    lights one network, and every one of them spans BOTH halves, so none
    of the networks fits the myth's split."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    (ln, n_tot) = max(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    (lz, n_zero) = min(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    n = max(1, int(round(n_tot)))
    acc = P["accent2"]

    # the lab: full-height ground (stops are (offset, rgb) pairs)
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (14, 20, 34)), (0.6, (26, 36, 58)), (1.0, (40, 50, 72))], 0, 1300)
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (52, 60, 78)), (1.0, (30, 34, 46))], 1300, H)
    haze(cr, 0, 1300, (26, 36, 58), a=0.25)

    # the scanner ring behind the brain
    cx, cy = 540, 930
    cr.new_path()
    cr.arc(cx, cy, 440, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.arc_negative(cx, cy, 372, 2 * math.pi, 0)
    cr.set_fill_rule(cairo.FILL_RULE_EVEN_ODD)
    solid(cr, (196, 202, 214), finish="gloss")
    cr.set_fill_rule(cairo.FILL_RULE_WINDING)
    contact_shadow(cr, cx, 1380, 620, a=0.4)
    box(cr, cx - 260, 1380, 520, 40, (150, 158, 172), depth=40)

    # the brain: two lit hemispheres and their folds
    rx, ry = 300, 250
    pink, pink_d = (232, 168, 170), (176, 104, 112)
    for side in (-1, 1):
        _brain_half(cr, cx, cy, rx, ry, side)
        solid(cr, pink, finish="gloss")
        cr.save()
        _brain_half(cr, cx, cy, rx, ry, side)
        cr.clip()
        _gyri(cr, cx, cy, rx, ry, side, pink_d)
        cr.restore()
        _brain_half(cr, cx, cy, rx, ry, side)
        edge(cr, (90, 40, 50), width=5)

    # the myth's line down the fissure
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((240, 240, 250), 0.7))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    cr.set_dash([18, 14])
    cr.move_to(cx, cy - ry - 70)
    cr.line_to(cx, cy + ry + 40)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_dash([])
    text(cr, "LEFT", cx - 30, cy - ry - 40, 40, INK_2, anchor="right")
    text(cr, "RIGHT", cx + 30, cy - ry - 40, 40, INK_2, anchor="left")

    # the networks: each one lights in BOTH halves, joined across the line
    spots = [(0.45, -0.55), (0.75, -0.15), (0.35, -0.05), (0.62, 0.35),
             (0.28, 0.45), (0.82, 0.25), (0.55, -0.32)]
    k, f = step_through(u, n, hold_first=0.16, hold_last=0.2)
    lit = 0
    for i in range(n):
        if i < k:
            a = 1.0
        elif i == k:
            a = ease(seg(f, 0.35, 0.75))
        else:
            a = 0.0
        if a <= 0:
            continue
        if a >= 0.6:
            lit += 1
        fx, fy = spots[i % len(spots)]
        lx, rxp = cx - rx * fx, cx + rx * fx
        y = cy + ry * fy
        r = 60 * pop(a)
        glow(cr, lx, y, r * 1.6, acc, 0.55 * a)
        glow(cr, rxp, y, r * 1.6, acc, 0.55 * a)
        disc(cr, lx, y, 16 * a, acc, finish="gloss")
        disc(cr, rxp, y, 16 * a, acc, finish="gloss")
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(acc, 0.9 * a))
        cr.set_line_width(6)
        cr.move_to(lx, y)
        cr.curve_to(lx + (cx - lx) * 0.5, y - 70 * a, rxp - (rxp - cx) * 0.5,
                    y - 70 * a, lx + (rxp - lx) * a, y)
        cr.stroke()

    # the scanner console and its crank wheel
    wx, wy = 300, 1330
    contact_shadow(cr, 230, 1500, 220, a=0.4)
    box(cr, 150, 1500, 170, 150, (120, 128, 146), depth=36)
    turn = (k + ease(seg(f, 0.0, 0.6))) * math.pi * 1.2
    disc(cr, wx, wy, 52, (180, 150, 70), finish="gloss")
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 46, 20)))
    cr.set_line_width(7)
    for s in range(4):
        aa = turn + s * math.pi / 2
        cr.move_to(wx, wy)
        cr.line_to(wx + 46 * math.cos(aa), wy + 46 * math.sin(aa))
        cr.stroke()
    hx, hy = wx + 46 * math.cos(turn), wy + 46 * math.sin(turn)
    disc(cr, hx, hy, 12, (210, 210, 220), finish="gloss")

    # Data: points at the brain, cranks the scanner, reacts to the result
    walk_in = ease(seg(u, 0.08, 0.16))
    walk_out = ease(seg(u, 0.84, 0.92))
    x = 120 + 260 * walk_in + 340 * walk_out
    if u < 0.12:
        role, bk = "point", 0
    elif u < 0.84:
        role, bk = "crank", k
    else:
        role, bk = "shock", 0
    contact_shadow(cr, x, 1500, 140, a=0.35)
    host(role, x, 1500, 220, beat=bk)

    vignette(cr, 0.32)

    # readouts
    if u < 0.84:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{lit} of {n}", f"{ln.lower()} · each lights both halves",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.08)), size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(n_zero))} of {n}", lz.lower(), 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.84, 0.9)), rgb=acc, size=150)

segments.say: About 200 million nerve fibers link your brain's two halves. They swap signals constantly, so both sides work on everything together.
segments.illustrated_scene:
def _cc_pt(p0, p1, p2, p3, s):
    m = 1.0 - s
    a, b, c, d = m * m * m, 3 * m * m * s, 3 * m * s * s, s * s * s
    return (a * p0[0] + b * p1[0] + c * p2[0] + d * p3[0],
            a * p0[1] + b * p1[1] + c * p2[1] + d * p3[1])


def _cc_bundle(j):
    return ((300.0, 1120.0 - 22 * j), (450.0, 1040.0 - 16 * j),
            (630.0, 1040.0 - 16 * j), (780.0, 1120.0 - 22 * j))


def _cc_hemi(cr, side):
    def X(x):
        return x if side < 0 else W - x
    cr.new_path()
    cr.move_to(X(470), 640)
    cr.curve_to(X(330), 600, X(120), 700, X(120), 920)
    cr.curve_to(X(120), 1130, X(260), 1250, X(470), 1230)
    cr.close_path()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a brain's two halves bridged
    SUBSTANCE: white nerve-fibre bundles
    CAUSE: Data places fibre bundles one by one across the bridge joining the halves
    A front-on cut through the brain: two hemispheres with the corpus
    callosum arching between them as a thick bridge of white, strand-textured
    fibre bundles. Signals run along them as brighter white streaks in the
    fibre's own colour, never coloured dots. Data walks the arch laying the
    next bundle on the stack; far below, the anterior commissure is a thread
    drawn at its true thickness against the bridge."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    (lc, cc) = max(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    rest = [r for r in rows if r[0] != lc]
    (la, ac) = rest[0] if rest else ("other links", 0.0)
    tot = (cc + ac) or 1.0
    share = cc / tot

    # the scan room: dark, full height, a floor under the brain
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (12, 16, 34)), (0.6, (22, 26, 52)), (1.0, (30, 30, 58))], 0, H)
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (34, 34, 64)), (1.0, (18, 18, 36))], 1400, H)
    glow(cr, 540, 930, 560, (90, 110, 200), 0.35)

    # brainstem standing on the floor
    contact_shadow(cr, 540, 1420, 260, a=0.45)
    cylinder(cr, 495, 1420, 90, 230, (200, 140, 140))

    # the two hemispheres, lit, with folds
    pink = (226, 160, 160)
    fold = (170, 104, 112)
    for side in (-1, 1):
        _cc_hemi(cr, side)
        solid(cr, pink, finish="gloss")
        cr.save()
        _cc_hemi(cr, side)
        cr.clip()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(fold, 0.85))
        cr.set_line_width(6)
        for g in range(9):
            gx = 160 + g * 36
            gx = gx if side < 0 else W - gx
            gy = 680 + (g * 61) % 420
            cr.move_to(gx, gy)
            cr.curve_to(gx + 40 * side, gy + 30, gx - 30 * side, gy + 70,
                        gx + 20 * side, gy + 120)
            cr.stroke()
        cr.restore()

    # the anterior commissure: a thread at its true thickness vs the bridge
    thick = 18.0
    n_total = 6
    ac_w = max(3.0, n_total * thick * (ac / (cc or 1.0)))
    cr.new_path()
    cr.move_to(430, 1195)
    cr.curve_to(500, 1172, 580, 1172, 650, 1195)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 230, 214)))
    cr.set_line_width(ac_w + 2)
    cr.stroke()

    # the corpus callosum: bundles stacked, one placed per step
    k, f = step_through(u, n_total - 1, hold_first=0.14, hold_last=0.14)
    placed = 1 + k
    arriving = pop(f)

    def bez(p, dy):
        p0, p1, p2, p3 = p
        cr.new_path()
        cr.move_to(p0[0], p0[1] + dy)
        cr.curve_to(p1[0], p1[1] + dy, p2[0], p2[1] + dy, p3[0], p3[1] + dy)

    def draw_bundle(j, dy, a):
        p = _cc_bundle(j)
        g = cairo.LinearGradient(0, p[1][1] - 12 + dy, 0, p[1][1] + 12 + dy)
        g.add_color_stop_rgba(0, *_c((252, 250, 242), a))
        g.add_color_stop_rgba(1, *_c((206, 196, 176), a))
        bez(p, dy)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 48, 52), 0.9 * a))
        cr.set_line_width(thick + 5)
        cr.stroke()
        bez(p, dy)
        cr.set_source(g)
        cr.set_line_width(thick)
        cr.stroke()
        # the strands of the bundle: thin fibres running its length
        for o, col in ((-5, (226, 216, 196)), (0, (214, 204, 182)), (5, (200, 190, 168))):
            bez(p, dy + o)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(col, 0.8 * a))
            cr.set_line_width(1.6)
            cr.stroke()
        bez(p, dy - 6)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 255, 255), 0.6 * a))
        cr.set_line_width(2.5)
        cr.stroke()

    for j in range(placed):
        draw_bundle(j, 0.0, 1.0)
    top = placed - 1
    if placed < n_total and f > 0:
        draw_bundle(placed, -70 * (1 - arriving), clamp(f * 2))
        if f >= 0.6:
            top = placed

    # signals trading both ways: bright white streaks running along the
    # fibres themselves, the same white as the strands
    for j in range(placed):
        b = _cc_bundle(j)
        for d, ph in ((1, 0.0), (-1, 0.5)):
            s0 = (t * 0.28 + j * 0.23 + ph) % 1.0
            s0 = s0 if d > 0 else 1.0 - s0
            cr.new_path()
            for i in range(8):
                s = clamp(s0 - d * 0.012 * i)
                px, py = _cc_pt(*b, s)
                if i == 0:
                    cr.move_to(px, py - 2)
                else:
                    cr.line_to(px, py - 2)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 255, 250), 0.9))
            cr.set_line_width(5)
            cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
            cr.stroke()

    haze(cr, 1300, 1540, (22, 22, 44), a=0.25)
    vignette(cr, 0.35)

    # Data walks the arch laying each bundle on top of the stack
    dx = 380 + 320 * ease(seg(u, 0.12, 0.88))
    b = _cc_bundle(top)
    sx, sy = _cc_pt(*b, clamp((dx - 300) / 480.0))
    if u < 0.12:
        role, bt = "point", 0
    elif u < 0.88:
        role, bt = "place", k
    else:
        role, bt = "cheer", 0
    host(role, dx, sy - thick / 2, 210, beat=bt)

    # readouts — the commissure's label sits under its thread; the share
    # line gets its own row well below it so the two never touch
    fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(cc))}M", f"nerve fibers in the {lc.lower()}", 80, 520,
                a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.1)), size=150)
    ra = ease(seg(u, 0.55, 0.7))
    text(cr, f"{int(round(ac))}M", 540, 1262, 54, INK_2, face="display",
         anchor="center", alpha=ra)
    _lab = la.split("(")[0].strip().lower()
    text(cr, _lab, 540, 1300, fit_size(cr, _lab, 30, 420), INK_2,
         anchor="center", alpha=ra)
    _sh = f"{share * 100:.1f}% of the crossing"
    text(cr, _sh, W - 80, 1470, fit_size(cr, _sh, 44, 600), look.INK,
         anchor="right", alpha=ra)

def _nr_order(pts):
    want = [("silent", "Silent Generation"), ("boomer", "Baby Boomers"),
            ("gen x", "Gen X"), ("millennial", "Millennials")]
    rows = []
    for key, name in want:
        for l, v in pts:
            if key in str(l).lower():
                rows.append((name, float(v)))
                break
    if len(rows) < 2:
        rows = sorted([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts], key=lambda r: r[1])
    return rows


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a white country church and its congregation
    SUBSTANCE: churchgoers walking away
    CAUSE: Data shoves the churchyard gate open wider and each generation's share of the flock walks out of the yard and away down the road
    One congregation of twenty in the churchyard is the WHOLE. Generation by
    generation, from the Silent Generation to Millennials, Data shoves the
    gate wider and that generation's share with no religion walks out of the
    yard, through the gate and off to the RIGHT along the road, AWAY from the
    church, in the accent, while the rest stay in the yard and the yard
    visibly thins. THE SCALE is the line on the road: a post marks where the
    Silent Generation's line ended, and the Millennials' line runs far past
    it. Done by 0.62 and held: cars pass on the lane by the camera, the bell
    swings, and Data keeps shoving the gate wide."""
    rows = _nr_order(pts)
    n = len(rows)
    N = 20
    a0, a1 = 0.10, 0.62
    span = (a1 - a0) / max(1, n)
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    slide = ease(seg(f, 0.0, 0.8))
    prev = rows[k - 1][1] if k > 0 else 0.0
    share = 0.0 if u < a0 else prev + (rows[k][1] - prev) * slide
    top = max(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    cnt = [int(round(v / 100.0 * N)) for _, v in rows]
    landed_to = k if slide >= 0.999 else k - 1
    keep = sorted({round(i * (n - 1) / max(1, READOUT_SHOWS - 1))
                   for i in range(READOUT_SHOWS)}) if n > READOUT_SHOWS else list(range(n))
    named = max((i for i in keep if i <= landed_to), default=None)
    shown = None if (u < a0 or named is None) else rows[named]

    # who has walked out, and how far along
    prog = [0.0] * N
    if u >= a0:
        for i in range(N):
            if k > 0 and i < cnt[k - 1]:
                prog[i] = 1.0
        c_prev = cnt[k - 1] if k > 0 else 0
        m = max(0, cnt[k] - c_prev)
        for q in range(m):
            prog[c_prev + q] = clamp(slide * (1 + 0.3 * (m - 1)) - 0.3 * q)

    landscape(cr, t, "field")
    birds(cr, t, y0=700, n=4, rgb=(60, 60, 70))
    haze(cr, 900, 1220, (214, 222, 232), a=0.2)

    # the road out of the churchyard, running off to the right, away
    cr.rectangle(560, 1462, W - 560, 70)

    # the church

    b = building(cr, 120, 540, 1330, 300, WALL, roof_rgb=(84, 88, 100), roof="gable",
                 boards=False)
    rx = (b["x0"] + b["x1"]) / 2

    ttop = ty - 230
    cr.move_to(rx - 68, ttop + 2)
    cr.line_to(rx + 90, ttop + 2)
    cr.line_to(rx + 12, ttop - 140)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (84, 88, 100))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 58, 62)))
    cr.set_line_width(7)
    cr.move_to(rx + 12, ttop - 140)
    cr.line_to(rx + 12, ttop - 190)
    cr.move_to(rx - 6, ttop - 172)
    cr.line_to(rx + 30, ttop - 172)

    _nr_arch(cr, rx - 40, ttop + 30, 80, 120)
    solid(cr, (40, 34, 40), rim=False)
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(rx, ttop + 62)
    cr.rotate(0.5 * math.sin(t * 2.6))
