stories.closing: Free shipping isn't free. Somebody's storefront is paying for it.
stories.question: Do you shop online or in person more? Comment your answer.
stories.caption: Online shopping just hit 16.4% of every retail dollar spent in America. Amazon Prime membership exploded from 54 million to 180 million US shoppers in under a decade -- and physical stores are paying the price, with closures jumping from 4,913 to 7,327 in a single year. Do you shop online or in person more? Comment your answer.

segments.topic: online shopping's share of retail sales
segments.say: Online shopping was just 3.86 percent of retail in 2000. By 2010 it barely moved to 4.4 percent. Today it's 16.4 percent -- nearly all that growth happened in the last 15 years.
segments.illustrated_scene:
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """All of retail is ONE shopping cart. The part of it bought online is a
    wall of parcels, cut at its true share of the cart's width. As each year
    lands, parcels drop in one at a time and the wall shoves further into the
    cart. Data climbs onto the rim and strains against the cut line to push it."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    n = len(rows)
    vals = [r[1] for r in rows]
    labs = [r[0] for r in rows]

    # the transitions: the bigger the jump, the longer it takes to arrive
    wins = []
    if n >= 2:
        deltas = [abs(vals[i] - vals[i - 1]) for i in range(1, n)]
        mean = (sum(deltas) / len(deltas)) or 1.0
        wts = [d + 0.35 * mean for d in deltas]
        gap = 0.08
        span = 0.54 - gap * (n - 2)
        a = 0.26
        for w_ in wts:
            d_ = span * w_ / sum(wts)
            wins.append((a, a + d_))
            a += d_ + gap
    pct = vals[0]
    for i, (a, b) in enumerate(wins, start=1):
        pct += (vals[i] - vals[i - 1]) * ease(seg(u, a, b))
    share = clamp(pct / 100.0)
    k = min(n - 1, sum(1 for a, b in wins if u >= (a + b) / 2))
    val, year = vals[k], labs[k]

    # the store: one full-height background, wall down to the floor
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (236, 230, 220)), (0.72, (214, 206, 194)),
               (0.73, (176, 168, 158)), (1.0, (140, 132, 124))], 0, H)
    for j, lx in enumerate((270, 810)):      # ceiling lights
        glow(cr, lx, 250, 260, P["sun_glow"], 0.5)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 250, 235)))
        cr.rectangle(lx - 90, 236, 180, 22)
        cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 112, 104), 0.5))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    cr.move_to(0, 1400)
    cr.line_to(W, 1400)
    cr.stroke()

    # the cart: its whole basket is 100% of retail
    X0, X1, TOP, BOT = 200.0, 880.0, 860.0, 1230.0
    load = ease(seg(u, 0.02, 0.14))
    ctop = BOT - (BOT - TOP) * load
    xs = X0 + (X1 - X0) * share
    rest_col = (158, 162, 172)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(rest_col))                  # bought in stores
    cr.rectangle(xs, ctop, X1 - xs, BOT - ctop)
    cr.fill()
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(xs, ctop, X1 - xs, BOT - ctop)
    cr.clip()
    for i in range(9):                                 # the store bags
        bx = xs + 30 + i * 80
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((178, 182, 192)))
        cr.rectangle(bx, ctop + 20 + (i % 2) * 30, 58, 90)
        cr.fill()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((128, 132, 142)))
        cr.set_line_width(4)
        cr.arc(bx + 29, ctop + 22 + (i % 2) * 30, 16, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()
    acc = P["accent2"]
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(acc))                       # bought online
    cr.rectangle(X0, ctop, xs - X0, BOT - ctop)
    cr.fill()
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(X0, ctop, xs - X0, BOT - ctop)
    cr.clip()
    shade = tuple(int(c * 0.72) for c in acc)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(shade))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    y = BOT - 62
    while y > ctop:                                    # parcel seams
        cr.move_to(X0, y)
        cr.line_to(xs, y)
        y -= 62
    cr.stroke()
    tape = ease(seg(u, 0.88, 0.97))                    # sealed at the end
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    cr.move_to((X0 + xs) / 2, ctop)
    cr.line_to((X0 + xs) / 2, ctop + (BOT - ctop) * (0.35 + 0.65 * tape))
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 255, 255), 0.9))       # the cut line
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    cr.move_to(xs, ctop)
    cr.line_to(xs, BOT)
    cr.stroke()

    # parcels drop in one at a time while each year arrives
    for a, b in wins:
        m = max(3, int((b - a) / 0.03))
        step = (b - a) / m
        for j in range(m):
            p = seg(u, a + j * step, a + j * step + 0.06)
            if 0 < p < 1:
                bx = X0 + (xs - X0) * (0.3 + 0.4 * ((j * 37) % 10) / 10.0)
                by = 560 + (ctop - 560) * p * p
                cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(acc))
                cr.rectangle(bx - 28, by - 44, 56, 44)
                cr.fill()
                cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(shade))
                cr.set_line_width(5)
                cr.move_to(bx, by - 44)
                cr.line_to(bx, by)
                cr.stroke()

    # wire basket over the contents
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((90, 96, 108)))
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    cr.move_to(170, 820)
    cr.line_to(910, 820)
    cr.line_to(X1, BOT)
    cr.line_to(X0, BOT)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(1, 6):
        f = i / 6.0
        cr.move_to(170 + 740 * f, 820)
        cr.line_to(X0 + (X1 - X0) * f, BOT)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    cr.move_to(910, 820)
    cr.line_to(990, 730)
    cr.line_to(1040, 730)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.move_to(X0 + 40, BOT)
    cr.line_to(250, 1350)
    cr.move_to(X1 - 40, BOT)
    cr.line_to(830, 1350)
    cr.move_to(250, 1350)
    cr.line_to(830, 1350)
    cr.stroke()
    for wx in (250, 830):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((50, 52, 60)))
        cr.arc(wx, 1370, 28, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()

    # his bit: points at the cart, climbs onto the rim, strains the wall along
    c = ease(seg(u, 0.10, 0.25))
    hx = 110 + (max(xs - 20, 190) - 110) * c
    fy = 1440 + (820 - 1440) * c
    role = ("point" if u < 0.10 else "climb" if u < 0.25 else
            "strain" if u < 0.84 else "cheer")
    host(role, hx, fy, 200)

    # readouts
    fit_readout(cr, f"{val:.1f}%", f"of retail bought online · {year}", 80, 520,
                a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.1)), size=140)
    ra = ease(seg(u, 0.1, 0.2))
    text(cr, "in stores", (xs + X1) / 2, 1080, 50, INK,
         anchor="center", alpha=ra, shadow=False)
    if n >= 2:
        b = ease(seg(u, 0.82, 0.9))
        if b > 0:
            text(cr, f"+{vals[-1] - vals[-2]:.1f} pts since {labs[-2]}", W / 2, 1300,
                 54, INK, face="display", anchor="center", alpha=b)

segments.topic: why online shopping grew: Amazon Prime membership
segments.say: Here's why: Amazon Prime grew from 54 million US members in 2015 to 180 million by 2024. Free 2-day shipping stopped feeling optional -- so more of what we buy just moved online.
segments.illustrated_scene:
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """Prime membership is ONE delivery van. In 2015 its cargo box is short;
    Data climbs aboard and shoves the back wall out, push by push, until the
    box is 180/54 as long. The 2015 box stays in neutral — it's 30% of the
    final van — and the new length is lit in the accent."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    share = clamp(v0 / v1 if v1 else 1.0, 0.05, 1.0)

    # the street at morning — full-height ground first
    vgrad(cr, P["dawn"], 0, H)
    for i in range(5):
        lit, shade = ((P["brick"], P["brick_shade"]) if i % 2 == 0
                      else (P["brick_cool"], P["brick_cool_shade"]))
        rowhouse(cr, i * 230 - 30, 240, 520 + (i * 83) % 180, STREET_Y, lit, shade,
                 t=t)
    street(cr)

    # the van rolls in, then parks
    arrive = ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.14))
    dx = 760 * (1 - arrive)
    pushes = [(0.22, 0.34), (0.42, 0.54), (0.62, 0.74)]
    f = sum(ease(seg(u, a, b)) for a, b in pushes) / len(pushes)
    pushing = any(0 < seg(u, a, b) < 1 for a, b in pushes)
    CAB = 860 + dx
    L1 = 780.0
    L0 = L1 * share
    L = L0 + (L1 - L0) * f
    left = CAB - L
    old_x = CAB - L0
    top, floor = 820, 1340
    acc = P["accent2"]
    rest = look.REST

    # the cargo box, cut open so we see inside
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 34, 52), 0.92))
    cr.rectangle(left, top, L, floor - top)
    cr.fill()
    # boxes on the floor: they ride along as the box gets longer
    k = 0
    bx = CAB - 50
    while bx > left + 150:
        for j in range(1 + (k * 7) % 3):
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((196, 150, 98)))
            cr.rectangle(bx - 26, floor - 54 * (j + 1), 52, 50)
            cr.fill()
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 108, 66)))
            cr.rectangle(bx - 3, floor - 54 * (j + 1), 6, 50)
            cr.fill()
        bx -= 66
        k += 1
    # the frame: the 2015 box in neutral, the new length in the accent
    for x0, x1, col in ((old_x, CAB, rest), (left, old_x, acc)):
        if x1 - x0 < 1:
            continue
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(col))
        cr.rectangle(x0, top, x1 - x0, 44)            # roof
        cr.fill()
        cr.rectangle(x0, floor, x1 - x0, 34)          # floor + skirt
        cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(look.INK_2, 0.8))           # the seam where 2015 ended
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    cr.set_dash([14, 10])
    cr.move_to(old_x, top + 44)
    cr.line_to(old_x, floor)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_dash([])
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(acc if f > 0 else rest))   # the back wall he pushes
    cr.rectangle(left - 20, top, 20, floor - top + 34)
    cr.fill()

    # the cab
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((84, 96, 134)))
    cr.move_to(CAB, top + 60)
    cr.line_to(CAB + 110, top + 60)
    cr.line_to(CAB + 185, top + 250)
    cr.line_to(CAB + 190, floor + 34)
    cr.line_to(CAB, floor + 34)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["glass"], 0.9))
    cr.move_to(CAB + 20, top + 90)
    cr.line_to(CAB + 100, top + 90)
    cr.line_to(CAB + 160, top + 240)
    cr.line_to(CAB + 20, top + 240)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()
    glow(cr, CAB + 180, floor - 10, 50, P["sun_glow"], 0.8)

    # wheels (they turn while it drives in, and the rear pair rides the wall)
    spin = -dx / 50.0
    for wx in (left + 90, old_x - 40 if f < 0.2 else CAB - 70, CAB + 110):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((22, 22, 28)))
        cr.arc(wx, 1398, 52, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 124, 138)))
        cr.arc(wx, 1398, 22, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()
        cr.set_line_width(5)
        cr.move_to(wx, 1398)
        cr.line_to(wx + 40 * math.cos(spin), 1398 + 40 * math.sin(spin))
        cr.stroke()

    # his bit: he points the van in, climbs aboard, shoves the back wall out
    # push by push (holding the roof up between shoves), then cheers the length
    board = ease(seg(u, 0.15, 0.22))
    sx, sy = 300 + ((left + 80) - 300) * board, 1440 - 110 * board
    if u < 0.15:
        role = "point"
    elif u < 0.22:
        role = "climb"
    elif u < 0.84:
        role = "strain" if pushing else "hold_up"
    else:
        role = "cheer"
    host(role, sx, sy, 210)

    # readouts
    done = u >= 0.74
    lab, val = (l1, v1) if done else (l0, v0)
    fit_readout(cr, f"{val:.0f} million", f"US Amazon Prime members · {lab}", 80, 520,
                a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.08)), size=130)
    b = ease(seg(u, 0.78, 0.88))
    if b > 0:
        mid = (left + old_x) / 2
        text(cr, f"+{v1 - v0:.0f}M", mid, 960, 96, acc, face="display",
             anchor="center", alpha=b)
        text(cr, f"since {l0}", mid, 1030, 40, look.INK, anchor="center", alpha=b)
        text(cr, l0, (old_x + CAB) / 2, 900, 40, look.INK_2, anchor="center", alpha=b)
    c = ease(seg(u, 0.86, 0.94))
    if c > 0:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{v1 / v0:.1f}×", "the members in nine years" if
                    (int(l1) - int(l0) == 9 if l0.isdigit() and l1.isdigit() else False)
                    else f"the members, {l0}–{l1}",
                    W - 80, 1120, anchor="right", a=c, rgb=acc, size=90, max_w=520)

segments.say: The result: 4,913 stores closed in 2023. In 2024 that jumped to 7,327 -- thousands more empty storefronts in a single year.
segments.illustrated_scene:
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """Store closures, drawn as ONE storefront whose steel shutter is the
    whole of 2024's closures. Data works it from a ladder BESIDE the opening,
    never in front of it: he climbs, grabs the strap on the bar and hauls it
    down to the 2023 line (neutral steel). He holds it there, then hauls it
    the rest of the way, and that last stretch is lit in the accent: the
    extra closures in one year, at their true share of the shutter. Then he
    climbs back up and hangs a CLOSED sign on the steel, clear of his body,
    and the readout lands the new year on top of the old one."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    top = max(v0, v1) or 1.0
    f1, f2 = v0 / top, v1 / top

    # the street: sky, brick frontage, sidewalk
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (28, 32, 52)), (0.5, (70, 66, 88)), (1.0, (150, 120, 110))], 0, H)
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, P["brick_cool"]), (1.0, P["brick_cool_shade"])], 600, 1480)
    for r_ in range(22):                      # brick courses
        y = 604 + r_ * 40
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brick_cool_shade"], 0.55))
        cr.set_line_width(3)
        cr.move_to(0, y)
        cr.line_to(W, y)
        cr.stroke()
        for k in range(10):
            x = (k * 120 + (60 if r_ % 2 else 0)) % W
            cr.move_to(x, y)
            cr.line_to(x, y + 40)
            cr.stroke()
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, P["curb"]), (1.0, P["street"])], 1480, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["curb"]))
    cr.rectangle(0, 1470, W, 18)
    cr.fill()

    # the storefront (the hero), shifted right so Data has his own lane
    SX0, SX1 = 240, 1010
    OX0, OX1, OY0, OY1 = 285, 965, 780, 1440
    OH = OY1 - OY0
    MX = (OX0 + OX1) / 2
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((46, 48, 58)))
    cr.rectangle(SX0, 640, SX1 - SX0, 840)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((34, 36, 44)))
    cr.rectangle(SX0 + 20, 655, SX1 - SX0 - 40, 90)
    cr.fill()
    lit = 1.0 - 0.8 * ease(seg(u, 0.6, 0.85))   # the sign goes dark
    text(cr, "SHOPS", (SX0 + SX1) / 2, 718, 64, (250, 226, 170), face="display",
         anchor="center", alpha=0.25 + 0.75 * lit, shadow=False)
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (22, 24, 32)), (1.0, (40, 42, 52))], OY0, OY1, OX0, OX1)
    for k in range(3):                        # empty shelves inside
        y = OY0 + 170 + k * 170
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 72, 84)))
        cr.rectangle(OX0 + 40, y, OX1 - OX0 - 80, 12)
        cr.fill()

    # the ladder leaning on the brick, left of the storefront — his lane
    LX = 170
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 96, 70)))
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    for rx in (LX - 38, LX + 38):
        cr.move_to(rx, 1478)
        cr.line_to(rx + 6, 760)
        cr.stroke()
    cr.set_line_width(7)
    for k in range(12):
        ry = 1440 - k * 58
        cr.move_to(LX - 36, ry)
        cr.line_to(LX + 42, ry)
        cr.stroke()

    # the shutter: one whole, cut at 2023's share of 2024
    k1 = ease(seg(u, 0.16, 0.42))
    k2 = ease(seg(u, 0.52, 0.74))
    f = f1 * k1 + (f2 - f1) * k2
    yb = OY0 + OH * f
    ycut = OY0 + OH * min(f1, f2)
    neutral, n_line = (150, 154, 164), (108, 112, 122)
    acc = P["accent2"]
    a_line = tuple(int(c * 0.72) for c in acc[:3])
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(OX0, OY0, OX1 - OX0, max(0.0, yb - OY0))
    cr.clip()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(neutral))
    cr.rectangle(OX0, OY0, OX1 - OX0, ycut - OY0)
    cr.fill()
    if yb > ycut:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(acc))
        cr.rectangle(OX0, ycut, OX1 - OX0, yb - ycut)
        cr.fill()
    j = 0
    while yb - 26 * j > OY0:                  # slats roll down with the bar
        y = yb - 26 * j
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(a_line if y > ycut else n_line))
        cr.set_line_width(4)
        cr.move_to(OX0, y)
        cr.line_to(OX1, y)
        cr.stroke()
        j += 1
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 62, 72)))     # the bottom bar + handle
    cr.rectangle(OX0 - 6, yb - 10, OX1 - OX0 + 12, 20)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((200, 204, 214)))
    cr.rectangle(MX - 20, yb + 4, 40, 14)
    cr.fill()
    # the pull strap: from the bar's left end out to his ladder
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 40, 48)))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    cr.move_to(OX0, yb)
    cr.line_to(LX + 30, min(yb + 20, 1460))
    cr.stroke()
    if f > f1 + 0.02:                         # the 2023 mark stays on the steel
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(INK, 0.9))
        cr.set_line_width(5)
        cr.set_dash([18, 12])
        cr.move_to(OX0, ycut)
        cr.line_to(OX1, ycut)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.set_dash([])
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 30, 38)))     # frame over the edges
    cr.set_line_width(14)
    cr.rectangle(OX0, OY0, OX1 - OX0, OY1 - OY0)
    cr.stroke()

    # numbers painted on the shutter, right of where the sign will hang
    NX = MX + 90
    na = ease(seg(u, 0.3, 0.42))
    if ycut - OY0 > 120:
        text(cr, f"{int(round(min(v0, v1))):,}", NX, (OY0 + ycut) / 2 + 20, 76,
             anchor="center", face="display", alpha=na)
        text(cr, f"{l0}", NX, (OY0 + ycut) / 2 + 70, 36,
             anchor="center", alpha=na)
    da = ease(seg(u, 0.72, 0.8))
    if yb - ycut > 90 and da > 0:
        text(cr, f"+{int(round(abs(v1 - v0))):,}", NX, (ycut + yb) / 2 + 24, 80,
             anchor="center", face="display", alpha=da)

    # the CLOSED sign: he hangs it on a hook high on the steel, clear of him
    HX, HY = 400, 812
    ta = ease(seg(u, 0.84, 0.88))
    if ta > 0:
        sw = 0.3 * math.sin(t * 3.2) * math.exp(-5 * seg(u, 0.86, 1.0))
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 40, 48), ta))
        cr.arc(HX, HY, 7, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(HX, HY)
        cr.rotate(sw)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((240, 236, 226), ta))
        cr.rectangle(-90, 34, 180, 72)
        cr.fill()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 40, 48), ta))
        cr.set_line_width(3)
        cr.move_to(-55, 34)
        cr.line_to(0, 0)
        cr.line_to(55, 34)
        cr.stroke()
        text(cr, "CLOSED", 0, 84, 40, P["redline"], anchor="center",
             alpha=ta, shadow=False)
        cr.restore()

    # his act, all from the ladder beside the opening
    hang = min(yb + 210, 1470)
    if u < 0.08:
        role, x, fy = "point", 110, 1470
    elif u < 0.16:
        c = ease(seg(u, 0.08, 0.16))
        role, x, fy = "climb", 110 + (LX - 110) * c, 1470 + (hang - 1470) * c
    elif u < 0.74:
        role, x, fy = "strain", LX, hang      # hauls, holds at 2023, hauls on
    elif u < 0.84:
        c = ease(seg(u, 0.75, 0.84))          # back up the ladder with the sign
        role, x, fy = "climb", LX, 1470 + (1040 - 1470) * c
    elif u < 0.9:
        role, x, fy = "hold_up", LX, 1040     # hooks it on, arm's length away
    else:
        pj = seg(u, 0.9, 0.95)
        pj = pj * pj                          # drops off the ladder
        role, x, fy = "shock", LX - 70 * ease(seg(u, 0.9, 0.96)), 1040 + 430 * pj
    host(role, x, fy, 220)

    # the readout: 2023, then 2024 at full contrast as the shutter passes 2023
    if u < 0.52:
        big, small, a = f"{int(round(v0)):,} stores", f"closed in {l0}", ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.08))
    elif u < 0.88:
        big, small, a = f"{int(round(v1)):,} stores", f"closed in {l1}", ease(seg(u, 0.52, 0.56))
    else:
        big, small, a = (f"{int(round(v1)):,} stores",
                         f"closed in {l1} · up from {int(round(v0)):,}", 1.0)
    fit_readout(cr, big, small, 80, 520, a=a, size=120)

stories.closing_scene:
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """The closing, from across the street at dusk: ONE block of shopfronts
    is all of 2024's closures. Its lights go out bay by bay. The first dark
    stretch is 2023's count, in neutral. The rest goes out in the accent,
    which is the extra closures in one year, cut at their true share of the
    block. A delivery van keeps rolling past the dead windows, and every shop
    that goes dark gets a parcel on its doorstep, because that is where the
    business went. Data carries a plank along the dark windows, strains to
    board up the last lit shop, then backs off in shock at the dark block."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts[:2]])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    whole = max(v0, v1) or 1.0
    share = min(v0, v1) / whole
    extra = abs(v1 - v0)
    acc = P["accent2"]
    rest = look.REST

    # dusk sky that keeps sinking toward night, and the street
    dusk = seg(u, 0.0, 1.0)
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (34 - 12 * dusk, 30 - 10 * dusk, 58 - 8 * dusk)),
               (0.55, (118 - 40 * dusk, 76 - 24 * dusk, 96 - 20 * dusk)),
               (1.0, (214 - 70 * dusk, 140 - 50 * dusk, 98 - 30 * dusk))],
          0, 1000)
    glow(cr, 820, 980, 520, (255, 170, 110), 0.5 - 0.25 * dusk)
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (70, 64, 72)), (1.0, (40, 38, 46))], 1000, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((96, 90, 98)))
    cr.rectangle(0, 1420, W, 70)                 # sidewalk
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 142, 140)))
    cr.rectangle(0, 1486, W, 10)                 # curb
    cr.fill()

    # one long block of shops, drawn as a single facade
    x0, x1 = 60.0, 1020.0
    fw = x1 - x0
    top, sign_y, win_y, base = 640.0, 700.0, 800.0, 1420.0
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 72, 62)))
    cr.rectangle(x0 - 20, top, fw + 40, base - top)
    cr.fill()
    for k in range(6):                           # the brick coursing
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((96, 56, 50)))
        cr.rectangle(x0 - 20, top + 12 + k * 14, fw + 40, 3)
        cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 44, 42)))
    cr.rectangle(x0 - 30, top - 18, fw + 60, 22)  # the cornice
    cr.fill()

    # the lights go out in steps; each step mostly moves, then holds briefly
    def stepped(a, b, n):
        f = seg(u, a, b) * n
        k = int(f)
        return min(n, k + ease(clamp((f - k) * 1.5))) / n

    s1 = stepped(0.06, 0.44, 4) * share                      # 2023's closures
    s2 = stepped(0.48, 0.82, 3) * (1.0 - share)              # the new ones
    dark = s1 + s2
    bx_cut = x0 + fw * share
    bx_dark = x0 + fw * dark

    # the windows: warm light, then dark
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 214, 150)))
    cr.rectangle(x0, win_y, fw, 1330 - win_y)
    cr.fill()
    glow(cr, bx_dark + (x1 - bx_dark) / 2, 1060, 360, (255, 200, 130),
         0.35 * (1.0 - dark))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(rest))
    cr.rectangle(x0, win_y, fw * s1, 1330 - win_y)
    cr.fill()
    if s2 > 0:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(acc))
        cr.rectangle(bx_cut, win_y, fw * s2, 1330 - win_y)
        cr.fill()
    # the pillars between the bays, drawn over the glass
    bays = 12
    for i in range(bays + 1):
        px = x0 + fw * i / bays
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((96, 56, 50)))
        cr.rectangle(px - 7, win_y, 14, base - win_y)
        cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((80, 48, 44)))
    cr.rectangle(x0, 1330, fw, base - 1330)      # the stall risers
    cr.fill()
    # the sign band: 2023's share in neutral, and the jump in the accent
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((52, 40, 44)))
    cr.rectangle(x0, sign_y, fw, 80)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(acc, ease(seg(u, 0.48, 0.56))))
    cr.rectangle(bx_cut, sign_y, x1 - bx_cut, 80)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(INK))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    cr.move_to(bx_cut, sign_y - 10)
    cr.line_to(bx_cut, base)
    cr.stroke()
    a1 = ease(seg(u, 0.08, 0.18))
    text(cr, f"{l0} · {int(v0):,}", x0 + 24, sign_y + 54, 40, INK,
         alpha=a1, shadow=False)
    a2 = ease(seg(u, 0.52, 0.62))
    text(cr, f"+{int(extra):,}", (bx_cut + x1) / 2, sign_y + 56, 46, (30, 24, 28),
         anchor="center", alpha=a2, shadow=False)

    # a parcel drops on each dark doorstep, falling under gravity
    for i in range(bays):
        cxb = x0 + fw * (i + 0.5) / bays
        go = clamp((bx_dark - (x0 + fw * i / bays)) / (fw / bays))
        if go <= 0:
            continue
        pj = 1.0 - ease(clamp(go * 1.4))
        by = 1418 - 260 * pj * pj
        for j in range(1 + (i % 2)):
            yy = by - j * 40
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((196, 150, 98)))
            cr.rectangle(cxb - 26 + j * 6, yy - 40, 52, 40)
            cr.fill()
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 110, 70)))
            cr.rectangle(cxb - 3 + j * 6, yy - 40, 6, 40)
            cr.fill()

    # the CLOSED tag on the last door, swinging slowly
    ta = ease(seg(u, 0.80, 0.88))
    if ta > 0:
        tx, ty = x1 - fw / bays / 2, 1010
        ang = 0.14 * math.sin(t * 1.4)
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(tx, ty)
        cr.rotate(ang)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(INK, ta))
        cr.set_line_width(3)
        cr.move_to(-20, 0)
        cr.line_to(0, -30)
        cr.line_to(20, 0)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((240, 236, 228), ta))
        cr.rectangle(-40, 0, 80, 34)
        cr.fill()
        text(cr, "CLOSED", 0, 25, 20, (40, 30, 34), anchor="center",
             alpha=ta, shadow=False)
        cr.restore()

    # the delivery van keeps rolling past the block, right to left, ~5s a lap
    lap = 1500.0
    vx = W + 200 - ((t * 280.0) % lap)
    vy = 1500.0
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((232, 228, 220)))
    cr.rectangle(vx - 120, vy - 120, 180, 110)          # cargo box
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((200, 196, 190)))
    cr.move_to(vx - 120, vy - 10)                        # cab, facing left
    cr.line_to(vx - 120, vy - 88)
    cr.line_to(vx - 160, vy - 88)
    cr.line_to(vx - 185, vy - 50)
    cr.line_to(vx - 185, vy - 10)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 90, 110)))
    cr.move_to(vx - 128, vy - 80)
    cr.line_to(vx - 156, vy - 80)
    cr.line_to(vx - 174, vy - 54)
    cr.line_to(vx - 128, vy - 54)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((196, 150, 98)))
    cr.rectangle(vx - 50, vy - 92, 44, 36)               # parcel logo
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 28, 34)))
    for wx in (vx - 150, vx + 20):
        cr.arc(wx, vy - 6, 20, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()
    glow(cr, vx - 188, vy - 36, 60, (255, 236, 180), 0.6)

    # Data's bit: he points at the lit block, carries a plank along the dark
    # windows, strains to board the last shop, then backs off in shock
    walk_on = ease(seg(u, 0.08, 0.80))
    if u < 0.08:
        role, hx = "point", 150.0
    elif u < 0.46:
        role, hx = "hold_up", 150 + 790 * walk_on
    elif u < 0.84:
        role, hx = "strain", 150 + 790 * walk_on
    else:
        role, hx = "shock", 940 - 180 * ease(seg(u, 0.84, 0.97))
    if role == "hold_up":
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((170, 132, 90)))
        cr.rectangle(hx - 70, 1180, 140, 22)     # the plank overhead
        cr.fill()
    elif role == "strain":
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((170, 132, 90)))
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(hx + 50, 1250)
        cr.rotate(-0.25 + 0.25 * ease(seg(u, 0.5, 0.8)))
        cr.rectangle(-80, -11, 160, 22)          # the plank going up on a window
        cr.fill()
        cr.restore()
    host(role, hx, 1480, 220)

    fit_readout(cr, f"{int(v1):,} stores", f"closed in {l1} — the whole block",
                80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.1)), size=110)
stories.hook_scene:
def _zig(cr, x, ya, yb):
    n = 14
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        y = ya + (yb - ya) * i / n
        xx = x if i == n else x + (10 if i % 2 else -10)
        cr.line_to(xx, y)


def _note_piece(cr, xa, xb, y0, y1, zl, zr):
    cr.new_path()
    cr.move_to(xa, y0)
    cr.line_to(xb, y0)
    if zr:
        _zig(cr, xb, y0, y1)
    else:
        cr.line_to(xb, y1)
    cr.line_to(xa, y1)
    if zl:
        _zig(cr, xa, y1, y0)
    else:
        cr.line_to(xa, y0)
    cr.close_path()


def _note_face(cr, x0, y0, x1, y1, fill, ink, mark_x=None):
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(fill))
    cr.paint()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(ink, 0.55))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    cr.rectangle(x0 + 26, y0 + 26, x1 - x0 - 52, y1 - y0 - 52)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_line_width(2.5)
    for k in range(5):                       # the engraved guilloche
        yy = y0 + 90 + k * 64
        cr.move_to(x0 + 40, yy)
        for j in range(1, 41):
            xx = x0 + 40 + (x1 - x0 - 80) * j / 40
            cr.line_to(xx, yy + 12 * math.sin(j * 0.9 + k))
        cr.stroke()
    for cx_, cy_ in ((x0 + 80, y0 + 80), (x1 - 80, y0 + 80),
                     (x0 + 80, y1 - 80), (x1 - 80, y1 - 80)):
        cr.arc(cx_, cy_, 30, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(ink, 0.7))
        cr.set_line_width(4)
        cr.stroke()
    if mark_x is None:
        return
    # the medallion: drawn ONCE, on the part that stays
    mx, my = mark_x, (y0 + y1) / 2
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(mx, my)
    cr.scale(1.0, 1.25)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 115, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(fill))
    cr.fill_preserve()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(ink, 0.8))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    cr.stroke()
    text(cr, "$", mx, my + 55, 170, ink, face="display", anchor="center",
         shadow=False)


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """The hook: ONE banknote is everything we spend. Its last share is
    already tearing off; Data drags it clear, hoists it overhead, it gets a
    shipping label, and he carries it out the shop door."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    lab, pct = rows[-1]
    share = clamp(pct / 100.0)

    # the shop, full height
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (44, 38, 52)), (0.55, (74, 60, 62)), (1.0, (40, 32, 34))],
          0, H)
    for sy in (580, 1180):                   # bare shelves on the back wall
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((96, 78, 66)))
        cr.rectangle(0, sy, 870, 16)
        cr.fill()
    # the door out: daylight beyond
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (150, 190, 228)), (1.0, (232, 214, 186))], 600, 1300,
          880, 1080)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass"]))
    cr.set_line_width(14)
    cr.rectangle(880, 600, 220, 700)
    cr.stroke()
    text(cr, "OPEN", 980, 660, 40, (40, 36, 44), anchor="center", shadow=False)
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (92, 76, 66)), (1.0, (38, 30, 30))], 1300, H)

    # the register: its drawer slides open, empty, as the money leaves
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 56, 64)))
    cr.rectangle(90, 1150, 250, 150)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 28, 34)))
    cr.rectangle(80, 1262 + 20 * ease(seg(u, 0.3, 0.42)), 270, 38)
    cr.fill()

    # ONE banknote = all retail spending
    X0, X1, Y0, Y1 = 30.0, 830.0, 590.0, 1060.0
    cut = X0 + (X1 - X0) * (1.0 - share)
    cx_s, cy_s = (cut + X1) / 2, (Y0 + Y1) / 2

    tear = ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.3))            # already ripping on frame 1
    hoist = ease(seg(u, 0.4, 0.55))
    out = ease(seg(u, 0.62, 0.92))           # carried out the door
    dx = 20 + 130 * tear + 240 * out
    lift = -60 * hoist
    ang = 0.06 * (1 - ease(seg(u, 0.25, 0.45))) - 0.04 * math.sin(math.pi * out)

    # what stays in the store: neutral
    _note_piece(cr, X0, cut, Y0, Y1, False, True)
    cr.save()
    cr.clip()
    _note_face(cr, X0, Y0, X1, Y1, P["paper"], P["paper_ink"],
               mark_x=(X0 + cut) / 2)
    cr.restore()
    _note_piece(cr, X0, cut, Y0, Y1, False, True)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["paper_ink"]))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    cr.stroke()

    # the share leaving: accent, same note, true width
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(cx_s + dx, cy_s + lift)
    cr.rotate(ang)
    cr.translate(-cx_s, -cy_s)
    cr.set_source_rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)
    cr.rectangle(cut + 10, Y0 + 14, X1 - cut, Y1 - Y0)
    cr.fill()
    _note_piece(cr, cut, X1, Y0, Y1, True, False)
    cr.save()
    cr.clip()
    _note_face(cr, X0, Y0, X1, Y1, P["accent2"], P["paper_ink"])
    cr.restore()
    _note_piece(cr, cut, X1, Y0, Y1, True, False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["paper_ink"]))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    cr.stroke()
    lb = pop(seg(u, 0.5, 0.62))              # it becomes an online order
    if lb > 0:
        lx, ly = cx_s, Y0 + 130
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(lx, ly)
        cr.scale(lb, lb)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((246, 244, 238)))
        cr.rectangle(-52, -40, 104, 80)
        cr.fill()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 30, 36)))
        for k in range(9):
            cr.rectangle(-42 + k * 10, -26, 3 + (k % 3) * 2, 40)
        cr.fill()
        cr.restore()
    cr.restore()

    # Data drags the torn share, hoists it, and carries it to the door
    fx = min(cx_s + dx, W - 120)
    role = "strain" if u < 0.4 else ("hold_up" if u < 0.92 else "cheer")
    host(role, fx, 1300, 220)

    fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(pct))}%", f"of what we buy - gone online by {lab}",
                80, 470, a=1.0, rgb=P["accent2"], size=150)
    ra = ease(seg(u, 0.3, 0.45))
    rest_label = "the rest stays in the store"
    text(cr, rest_label, (X0 + cut) / 2, 1120,
         fit_size(cr, rest_label, 44, cut - X0 - 40), look.INK,
         anchor="center", alpha=ra)

stories.title: How Did Space Travel Get 4 Times More Common?
stories.hook: You're watching space travel explode: 190 new astronauts in barely 5 years.
stories.closing: And this is just the warm-up act for space travel.
stories.question: Would you ever want to go to space? Tell me why.
stories.caption: 1 in 4 people who have ever reached space got there in just the last five years. Blue Origin alone has flown 92 paying passengers since 2021 -- nearly four times what Virgin Galactic managed in 22 years. Would you ever want to go to space? Tell me why.

segments.topic: how many people have reached space
segments.say: By 2020, just 560 people had ever reached space in 59 years. By 2025, that number hit 750 -- 190 new space travelers added in barely 5 years.

def _space_rocket(cr, x, base, h, a=1.0):
    """A crewed launcher drawn from paths: white body, dark band, nose, fins, capsule window."""
    w = h * 0.22
    top = base - h
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 78, 96), a))            # fins
    for sgn in (-1, 1):
        cr.move_to(x + sgn * w * 0.5, base - h * 0.22)
        cr.line_to(x + sgn * w * 1.05, base + 6)
        cr.line_to(x + sgn * w * 0.5, base)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.fill()
    body = cairo.LinearGradient(x - w / 2, 0, x + w / 2, 0)
    body.add_color_stop_rgba(0, *_c((200, 208, 222), a))
    body.add_color_stop_rgba(0.45, *_c((248, 250, 253), a))
    body.add_color_stop_rgba(1, *_c((150, 160, 180), a))
    cr.set_source(body)
    cr.rectangle(x - w / 2, top + h * 0.2, w, h * 0.8)
    cr.fill()
    cr.move_to(x - w / 2, top + h * 0.2)                 # the nose cone
    cr.curve_to(x - w / 2, top + h * 0.08, x - w * 0.12, top, x, top)
    cr.curve_to(x + w * 0.12, top, x + w / 2, top + h * 0.08, x + w / 2, top + h * 0.2)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 46, 62), a))             # interstage bands
    for fy in (0.36, 0.62):
        cr.rectangle(x - w / 2, top + h * fy, w, h * 0.035)
        cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["flag"], a))
    cr.rectangle(x - w / 2, top + h * 0.7, w, h * 0.05)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 40, 64), a))             # the crew window
    cr.arc(x, top + h * 0.27, w * 0.2, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["glass"], 0.8 * a))
    cr.arc(x - w * 0.05, top + h * 0.26, w * 0.12, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()


def _plume(cr, x, base, w, power, t):
    """Exhaust flame: length follows the launch power, a slow breathing flicker."""
    if power <= 0.02:
        return
    ln = (160 + 260 * power) * (1 + 0.06 * math.sin(t * 3.1))
    glow(cr, x, base + ln * 0.35, ln * 0.8, P["sun_hot"], 0.55 * power)
    for k, (col, sc) in enumerate(((P["heat"], 1.0), (P["sun_hot"], 0.7), ((255, 250, 225), 0.4))):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(col, min(1.0, 0.9 * power + 0.1)))
        cr.move_to(x - w * 0.42 * sc, base)
        cr.curve_to(x - w * 0.5 * sc, base + ln * 0.4 * sc, x - w * 0.1, base + ln * sc,
                    x, base + ln * sc)
        cr.curve_to(x + w * 0.1, base + ln * sc, x + w * 0.5 * sc, base + ln * 0.4 * sc,
                    x + w * 0.42 * sc, base)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.fill()


def _clear_of(y, bands, pad=40.0):
    """1.0 when y sits outside every (y0, y1) text band, fading to 0 inside one,
    so a label never sits on top of another piece of text."""
    a = 1.0
    for y0, y1 in bands:
        if y0 <= y <= y1:
            return 0.0
        d = (y0 - y) if y < y0 else (y - y1)
        a = min(a, clamp(d / pad))
    return a


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """The number is a CROSSING: a crewed rocket rides up through the Karman
    line, and the tally of everyone who has ever reached space jumps from the
    2020 count to the 2025 count the moment it clears. Data climbs the gantry,
    grabs on and rides it through, then cheers in space."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1), (l2, v2) = rows[0], rows[-2], rows[-1]
    try:
        yrs_a = int(l1[:4]) - int(l0[:4])
        yrs_b = int(l2[:4]) - int(l1[:4])
    except (ValueError, IndexError):
        yrs_a, yrs_b = 0, 0
    added = int(round(v2 - v1))

    # --- the launch: the camera rides up with the rocket
    lift = ease(seg(u, 0.42, 0.58))                      # leaves the pad
    cam = 1400 * ease(seg(u, 0.5, 0.8))                  # world falls away
    power = ease(seg(u, 0.36, 0.46))

    # sky darkens from dawn blue to black as we climb
    k = clamp(cam / 1400)

    def mix(a, b):
        return tuple(int(p + (q - p) * k) for p, q in zip(a, b))
    vgrad(cr, [(0, mix((14, 22, 58), (2, 3, 10))),
               (0.55, mix((40, 70, 140), (6, 8, 24))),
               (1, mix((230, 150, 110), (18, 26, 60)))], 0, H)
    for i in range(70):                                  # fixed stars, scroll slowly with the climb
        sx = (i * 197) % W
        sy = ((i * 331) % 1500) + cam * 0.25 - 200
        sy = sy % 1700 - 100
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((235, 240, 255), 0.25 + 0.6 * k * ((i % 5) / 4)))
        cr.arc(sx, sy, 1.5 + (i % 3), 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()

    # the rocket's position, needed to decide whether the tally has flipped
    rx, rh = 560, 620
    rbase = 1440 - 180 * lift
    ky = -100 + cam
    nose = rbase - rh
    cross = clamp((ky - nose) / max(1.0, rbase - nose))
    done = cross >= 1.0

    # the Karman line — the edge of space, 100 km up
    if -40 < ky < H:
        glow(cr, W / 2, ky, 700, (90, 170, 255), 0.18)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((140, 200, 255), 0.85))
        cr.set_line_width(5)
        cr.set_dash([26, 18])
        cr.move_to(0, ky)
        cr.line_to(W, ky)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.set_dash([])
        # its label steps aside whenever the line passes behind a readout
        ly = ky - 18
        bands = [(300, 720)]                             # the big tally + its subtitle
        if done:
            bands.append((860, 1110))                    # the "+N in N years" block
        la = _clear_of(ly, bands)
        if la > 0:
            text(cr, "EDGE OF SPACE · 100 KM", 60, ly, 34, (170, 215, 255),
                 anchor="left", alpha=la)

    # the ground, pad and gantry (world coordinates, scroll down with cam)
    gy = 1440 + cam
    if gy < H + 40:
        vgrad(cr, [(0, (58, 52, 60)), (1, (26, 24, 30))], min(gy, H), H)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((90, 92, 104)))
        cr.rectangle(380, gy - 20, 360, 30)
        cr.fill()
        # gantry tower
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["redline"]))
        cr.set_line_width(8)
        tx0, tx1 = 250, 330
        cr.move_to(tx0, gy)
        cr.line_to(tx0, gy - 760)
        cr.move_to(tx1, gy)
        cr.line_to(tx1, gy - 760)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.set_line_width(4)
        for j in range(10):
            yy = gy - j * 76
            cr.move_to(tx0, yy)
            cr.line_to(tx1, yy - 76)
            cr.move_to(tx0, yy - 76)
            cr.line_to(tx1, yy)
        cr.stroke()
        arm = ease(seg(u, 0.4, 0.5))                     # the crew arm swings back
        cr.set_line_width(12)
        cr.move_to(tx1, gy - 440)
        cr.line_to(tx1 + 150 * (1 - arm) + 20, gy - 440 - 80 * arm)
        cr.stroke()
        # launch smoke billows at the pad
        for j in range(7):
            b = seg(u, 0.4 + j * 0.02, 0.62 + j * 0.02)
            if b > 0:
                rr = 60 + 140 * ease(b)
                cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((225, 222, 230), 0.75 * (1 - 0.5 * b)))
                cr.arc(560 + (j - 3) * 90 * (0.6 + b), gy - 20 - 40 * b, rr, 0, 2 * math.pi)
                cr.fill()
        if power < 0.1:
            steam(cr, 620, gy - 60, t, strength=0.8)     # venting on the pad

    # the rocket: the hero, centred, a third of the frame tall
    _plume(cr, rx, rbase, rh * 0.22, power, t)
    _space_rocket(cr, rx, rbase, rh)

    # --- Data's bit: point at the rocket, climb the gantry, cling on and ride, cheer
    if u < 0.12:
        host("point", 200, 1480, 210)
    elif u < 0.4:
        c = ease(seg(u, 0.12, 0.38))
        host("climb", 290, 1480 - 440 * c, 210)
    elif u < 0.5:
        c = ease(seg(u, 0.4, 0.5))
        host("strain", 290 + 170 * c, 1040 - 180 * lift, 210)
    elif not done or u < 0.84:
        host("hold_up", 460, rbase - 400, 210)
    else:
        host("cheer", 460, rbase - 400, 210)

    # --- readouts
    lab, val = (l2, v2) if done else (l1, v1)
    sub = (f"people had ever reached space · by {lab}"
           + (f" · in {yrs_a} years" if (not done and yrs_a > 0) else ""))
    fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(val)):,}", sub, 80, 520,
                a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.08)), size=150)
    if done:
        b = pop(seg(u, 0.8, 0.86))
        text(cr, f"+{added}", W - 60, 1000, int(110 * max(0.3, b)), P["accent2"],
             face="display", anchor="right")
        if yrs_b > 0:
            text(cr, f"in {yrs_b} years", W - 60, 1060, 40, look.INK, anchor="right",
                 alpha=ease(seg(u, 0.82, 0.9)))

segments.topic: why more space travelers: commercial space companies
segments.say: Why the jump? Blue Origin alone has flown 92 paying passengers since 2021. SpaceX's private missions have flown about 24. Virgin Galactic managed just 23 in 22 years.
segments.illustrated_scene:
def _helmet(cr, x, y, rgb, a=1.0):
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(rgb, a))
    cr.arc(x, y, 10, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((26, 30, 48), a))
    cr.arc(x + 2, y + 1, 5.5, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 255, 255), 0.55 * a))
    cr.arc(x + 4, y - 1, 1.8, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()


def _heap_slot(i):
    r = 0
    cap = 12
    while i >= cap:
        i -= cap
        r += 1
        cap = 12 - r // 2
    return (i - (cap - 1) / 2.0) * 21 + (r % 2) * 5, -12 - r * 18


def _pan(cr, ex, ey, py):
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass_shade"]))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for dx in (-128, 0, 128):
        cr.move_to(ex, ey)
        cr.line_to(ex + dx, py)
        cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass"]))
    cr.move_to(ex - 140, py)
    cr.curve_to(ex - 120, py + 48, ex + 120, py + 48, ex + 140, py)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass_shade"]))
    cr.rectangle(ex - 140, py - 3, 280, 7)
    cr.fill()


def _dropped(u, n, a, b):
    span = max(1e-6, b - a)
    return [clamp((u - (a + span * i / max(1, n))) / 0.035) for i in range(n)]


def _short(s):
    return s.split(" (")[0]


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """Commercial space as a WEIGHT: a brass balance hangs over the Earth.
    SpaceX's and Virgin Galactic's paying flyers drop helmet by helmet into
    one pan and sink it; then Blue Origin's pour into the other and slam the
    beam over, lifting Data, who rode the lighter pan, clean off his feet.
    The tilt is the imbalance, 92 against the other two combined."""
    rows = sorted([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts], key=lambda r: -r[1])
    (ll, lv) = rows[0]
    rest = rows[1:3]
    nL = int(round(lv))
    rn = [int(round(v)) for _, v in rest]
    nR = sum(rn)

    # space over the Earth's limb
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (6, 8, 22)), (0.55, (14, 20, 52)), (1.0, (30, 52, 104))], 0, H)
    for k in range(60):                            # fixed stars, no drift
        sx = (k * 197) % W
        sy = (k * 311) % 1300
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((230, 236, 255), 0.25 + 0.35 * ((k * 7) % 5) / 4))
        cr.arc(sx, sy, 1.2 + (k % 3) * 0.6, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()
    glow(cr, 540, 1700, 900, (70, 150, 255), 0.35)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 96, 170)))
    cr.arc(540, 3400, 1900, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 200, 255), 0.7))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    cr.arc(540, 3400, 1900, math.pi * 1.25, math.pi * 1.75)
    cr.stroke()

    # helmets land one at a time: the two small operators first, then Blue Origin
    dR = _dropped(u, nR, 0.14, 0.38)
    dL = _dropped(u, nL, 0.44, 0.74)
    wR = sum(1 for p in dR if p >= 1)
    wL = sum(1 for p in dL if p >= 1)

    ang = 0.38 * clamp((wL - wR) / 60.0, -1.0, 1.0)
    if u > 0.74:                                    # the slam rings out
        k = (u - 0.74) * 40
        ang += 0.05 * math.sin(k * 1.6) * math.exp(-k * 0.35)
    px, py = 540, 820
    ca, sa = math.cos(ang), math.sin(ang)
    lx, ly = px - 380 * ca, py + 380 * sa
    rx, ry = px + 380 * ca, py - 380 * sa
    lpy, rpy = ly + 320, ry + 320

    # the stand
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass_shade"]))
    cr.rectangle(px - 14, py, 28, 1490 - py)
    cr.fill()
    cr.rectangle(px - 130, 1474, 260, 26)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass"]))
    cr.set_line_width(22)
    cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
    cr.move_to(lx, ly)
    cr.line_to(rx, ry)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.arc(px, py, 26, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()

    _pan(cr, lx, ly, lpy)
    _pan(cr, rx, ry, rpy)

    lead_rgb = P["accent2"]
    rest_rgb = [P["chalk"], (160, 168, 186)]
    for i, p in enumerate(dL):
        if p <= 0:
            continue
        hx, hy = _heap_slot(i)
        f = p * p
        _helmet(cr, lx + hx, lpy + hy - 520 * (1 - f), lead_rgb)
    idx = 0
    for g, n in enumerate(rn):
        for _ in range(n):
            p = dR[idx]
            if p > 0:
                hx, hy = _heap_slot(idx)
                _helmet(cr, rx + hx, rpy + hy - 520 * (1 - p * p),
                        rest_rgb[g % len(rest_rgb)])
            idx += 1

    # pan labels: the sourced counts, shown once each pan's helmets have landed
    aR = ease(seg(u, 0.40, 0.45))
    if aR > 0 and len(rest) >= 2:
        text(cr, f"{rn[0]} + {rn[1]}", rx, rpy + 90, 50, look.INK, face="display",
             anchor="center", alpha=aR)
        text(cr, " + ".join(_short(l).split()[0].upper() for l, _ in rest), rx,
             rpy + 130, 26, INK_2, anchor="center", alpha=aR)
    aL = ease(seg(u, 0.76, 0.81))
    if aL > 0:
        text(cr, f"{nL}", lx, lpy + 90, 54, look.INK, face="display",
             anchor="center", alpha=aL)
        text(cr, _short(ll).upper(), lx, lpy + 130, 26, INK_2,
             anchor="center", alpha=aL)

    # Data: points at the empty scale, hops onto the right pan, catches the
    # helmets as they land, holds on while Blue Origin launches him upward,
    # and lands in shock on the high side
    hop = ease(seg(u, 0.08, 0.14))
    on_x, on_y = rx + 100, rpy - 4
    dx = 960 + (on_x - 960) * hop
    dy = 1480 + (on_y - 1480) * hop - 60 * math.sin(math.pi * hop)
    if u < 0.08:
        role = "point"
    elif u < 0.40:
        role = "hold_up"
    elif u < 0.80:
        role = "strain"
    else:
        role = "shock"
    host(role, dx, min(dy, 1500), 200)

    # readouts
    a1 = ease(seg(u, 0.14, 0.2)) * (1 - ease(seg(u, 0.4, 0.44)))
    if a1 > 0 and len(rest) >= 2:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{rn[0]} + {rn[1]}",
                    f"{_short(rest[0][0])} + {_short(rest[1][0])}",
                    80, 520, a=a1, size=150)
    a2 = ease(seg(u, 0.46, 0.52))
    if a2 > 0:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{nL}", f"{ll} paying passengers", 80, 520, a=a2,
                    rgb=lead_rgb, size=150)
    a3 = ease(seg(u, 0.8, 0.88))
    if a3 > 0 and nR > 0 and nL > nR:
        text(cr, "more than the other two combined", W / 2, 690, 50, look.INK,
             face="bold", anchor="center", alpha=a3)

segments.topic: the shift in space travel since 2020
segments.say: Add it up and 25 percent of everyone who's ever reached space got there in just the last five years. Space travel isn't rare anymore -- it's just getting started.
segments.illustrated_scene:
def _orbit_pts(cx, cy, rx, ry, th0, th1, n=90):
    out = []
    for i in range(n + 1):
        th = th0 + (th1 - th0) * i / n
        out.append((cx + rx * math.cos(th), cy + ry * math.sin(th), math.sin(th) >= 0))
    return out


def _stroke_runs(cr, pts, front, rgb, width, a):
    run = []
    for x, y, f in pts + [(0, 0, not front)]:
        if f == front:
            run.append((x, y))
            continue
        if len(run) > 1:
            cr.move_to(*run[0])
            for q in run[1:]:
                cr.line_to(*q)
            cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
            cr.set_line_width(width)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(rgb, a))
            cr.stroke()
        run = []


def _capsule(cr, x, y, ang, s, a=1.0):
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.rotate(ang)
    cr.scale(s, s)
    cr.move_to(-34, -26)
    cr.line_to(26, -12)
    cr.curve_to(40, -8, 40, 8, 26, 12)
    cr.line_to(-34, 26)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((226, 230, 238), a))
    cr.fill()
    cr.rectangle(-44, -24, 12, 48)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 78, 96), a))
    cr.fill()
    cr.arc(4, 0, 9, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 60, 110), a))
    cr.fill()
    cr.restore()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """One whole, split: every person who has ever reached space is ONE orbit
    around the Earth. The first 59 years draw most of the ring; then Data
    hauls the last five years' crewed capsule round the front of it himself,
    and the stretch he lights is a quarter of the whole loop."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts[:2]])
    old, new = rows[0], rows[-1]
    for r in rows:
        lo = r[0].lower()
        if "since" in lo or "after" in lo or "last" in lo:
            new = r
        elif "before" in lo or "until" in lo:
            old = r
    if old is new:
        old = rows[0] if rows[0] is not new else rows[-1]
    tot = (old[1] + new[1]) or 1.0
    share = new[1] / tot

    # space, full bleed; fixed stars (no drift)
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (6, 8, 22)), (0.6, (12, 16, 40)), (1, (18, 22, 52))], 0, H)
    for i in range(90):
        sx = (i * 397) % W
        sy = (i * 263) % H
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((220, 226, 240), 0.25 + 0.5 * ((i * 37) % 10) / 10))
        cr.arc(sx, sy, 1.5 + (i % 3), 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()

    cx, cy, R = 540, 1060, 290
    rx, ry = 470, 200
    span = 2 * math.pi * share
    n_start = math.pi / 2 + span / 2           # new stretch centred on the front
    n_end = math.pi / 2 - span / 2
    o_len = 2 * math.pi - span

    a_old = ease(seg(u, 0.02, 0.28))
    b_new = ease(seg(u, 0.30, 0.68))
    o_pts = _orbit_pts(cx, cy, rx, ry, n_end, n_end - o_len * a_old, 160) if a_old > 0 else []
    th_head = n_start - span * b_new
    n_pts = _orbit_pts(cx, cy, rx, ry, n_start, th_head, 60) if b_new > 0 else []

    # the faint full track, then the back half of what is flown
    _stroke_runs(cr, _orbit_pts(cx, cy, rx, ry, 0, 2 * math.pi, 180), False, INK_2, 4, 0.25)
    if o_pts:
        _stroke_runs(cr, o_pts, False, INK_2, 18, 0.75)

    # the Earth, turning slowly
    glow(cr, cx, cy, R * 1.35, (80, 150, 255), 0.35)
    g = cairo.RadialGradient(cx - 90, cy - 110, 30, cx, cy, R)
    g.add_color_stop_rgba(0, *_c((70, 140, 230)))
    g.add_color_stop_rgba(1, *_c((18, 50, 120)))
    cr.arc(cx, cy, R, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.set_source(g)
    cr.fill()
    cr.save()
    cr.arc(cx, cy, R, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.clip()
    drift = (t * 14) % 900
    for k in range(6):
        lx = cx - 450 + ((k * 170 + drift) % 900)
        ly = cy - 160 + (k * 113) % 320
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(lx, ly)
        cr.scale(1.0, 0.62)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 70 + (k * 23) % 50, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 150, 90), 0.9))
        cr.fill()
    for k in range(5):
        wx = cx - 450 + ((k * 210 + drift * 1.4) % 900)
        wy = cy - 220 + (k * 97) % 440
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(wx, wy)
        cr.scale(1.0, 0.25)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 110, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((240, 244, 250), 0.35))
        cr.fill()
    shade = cairo.RadialGradient(cx - 120, cy - 120, R * 0.5, cx, cy, R * 1.05)
    shade.add_color_stop_rgba(0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
    shade.add_color_stop_rgba(1, 0, 0, 0.05, 0.55)
    cr.set_source(shade)
    cr.paint()
    cr.restore()

    # the front half: old years in neutral, the last five in the accent
    if o_pts:
        _stroke_runs(cr, o_pts, True, INK_2, 18, 0.75)
    if n_pts:
        _stroke_runs(cr, n_pts, True, P["accent2"], 40, 0.25)
        _stroke_runs(cr, n_pts, True, P["accent2"], 22, 1.0)

    # the capsule leads the new stretch
    hx, hy = cx + rx * math.cos(th_head), cy + ry * math.sin(th_head)
    tang = math.atan2(-ry * math.cos(th_head), rx * math.sin(th_head))
    cap_a = ease(seg(u, 0.24, 0.32))
    if cap_a > 0:
        glow(cr, hx, hy, 90, P["accent2"], 0.6 * cap_a)
        lift = 70 * ease(seg(u, 0.68, 0.76))
        _capsule(cr, hx, hy - 24 - lift, tang, 1.3 * pop(seg(u, 0.24, 0.32)), cap_a)

    # Data: points at the old ring, then hauls the capsule round, holds it up
    th_d = min(n_start + 0.26, th_head + 0.26)
    dx, dy = cx + rx * math.cos(th_d), cy + ry * math.sin(th_d)
    if u < 0.26:
        role = "point"
    elif u < 0.68:
        role = "strain"
    elif u < 0.86:
        role = "hold_up"
    else:
        role = "cheer"
    host(role, dx, dy, 210, pace=(0.32 < u < 0.66))

    # the new stretch's count lands once the haul is done, and stays
    c_a = ease(seg(u, 0.66, 0.72))
    if c_a > 0:
        text(cr, f"{int(round(new[1]))}", hx, hy + 110, 64, P["accent2"],
             face="display", anchor="center", alpha=c_a)

    # readouts
    a1 = ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.08)) * (1 - ease(seg(u, 0.62, 0.7)))
    if a1 > 0:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(old[1]))}", f"reached space · {old[0].lower()}",
                    80, 520, a=a1, size=140)
    a2 = ease(seg(u, 0.7, 0.78))
    if a2 > 0:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(share * 100))}%",
                    f"of everyone who reached space · {new[0].lower()}",
                    80, 520, a=a2, rgb=P["accent2"], size=160)
        text(cr, f"{int(round((1 - share) * 100))}% · {old[0]}", W - 80, 1440,
             fit_size(cr, f"{int(round((1 - share) * 100))}% · {old[0]}", 36, 700),
             INK_2, anchor="right", alpha=a2)

stories.hook_was: Getting to space just stopped being rare.
stories.closing_scene:
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    # order-proof: pre-sort by value (label as tie-break) so by_time's stable
    # sort gives the same pair whichever order pts arrives in
    rows = by_time(sorted([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts[:2]],
                          key=lambda r: (-r[1], r[0])))
    (l_old, v_old), (l_new, v_new) = rows[0], rows[1]
    total = v_old + v_new
    share = v_new / (total or 1.0)

    # the launch coast at first light: the same coast, the morning after
    dawn_sky(cr, t, y1=1180)
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (46, 70, 104)), (1.0, (28, 44, 70))], 1120, 1250)
    for i in range(6):                        # slow swell on the sea
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 150, 190), 0.25))
        cr.set_line_width(3)
        yy = 1150 + i * 18
        cr.move_to(0, yy)
        for x in range(0, W + 60, 60):
            cr.line_to(x, yy + 4 * math.sin(x * 0.02 + t * 0.8 + i))
        cr.stroke()
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (70, 66, 60)), (1.0, (36, 34, 32))], 1240, H)

    rx, top, bot = 680, 640, 1360
    half = 88
    ign = ease(seg(u, 0.7, 0.82))
    shake = 1.5 * ign * math.sin(t * 31)
    rx_s = rx + shake

    # the gantry he climbs
    gx = 500
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 60, 50)))
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    for x in (gx - 30, gx + 30):
        cr.move_to(x, 1420)
        cr.line_to(x, 860)
        cr.stroke()
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    for k in range(12):
        y = 1420 - k * 48
        cr.move_to(gx - 30, y)
        cr.line_to(gx + 30, y - 48)
        cr.stroke()
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    cr.move_to(gx + 30, 900)                  # the access arm to the tank port
    cr.line_to(rx - half, 900)
    cr.stroke()

    # the flame: engines lit, clamps holding — the warm-up
    if ign > 0:
        L = 60 + 220 * ign
        glow(cr, rx_s, bot + 60, 260 * ign, P["sun_hot"], 0.9 * ign)
        for w_, col in ((70, P["heat"]), (40, P["sun_hot"]), (18, (255, 250, 230))):
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(col, ign))
            cr.move_to(rx_s - w_, bot)
            cr.curve_to(rx_s - w_ * 0.8, bot + L * 0.5,
                        rx_s - 6, bot + L * (0.95 + 0.04 * math.sin(t * 9)),
                        rx_s, bot + L)
            cr.curve_to(rx_s + 6, bot + L * 0.9,
                        rx_s + w_ * 0.8, bot + L * 0.5, rx_s + w_, bot)
            cr.close_path()
            cr.fill()
        for k in range(3):                    # vapour billows out of the trench
            steam(cr, rx - 200 + k * 200, 1440, t, strength=1.6 * ign)

    # the pad
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((90, 88, 86)))
    cr.rectangle(rx - 190, 1400, 380, 40)
    cr.fill()

    # the rocket — its tank IS everyone who has ever flown
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((232, 234, 238)))
    cr.rectangle(rx_s - half, top, 2 * half, bot - top)
    cr.fill()
    cr.move_to(rx_s - half, top)
    cr.curve_to(rx_s - half, top - 70, rx_s - 20, top - 130, rx_s, top - 140)
    cr.curve_to(rx_s + 20, top - 130, rx_s + half, top - 70, rx_s + half, top)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((170, 176, 186)))
    for sgn in (-1, 1):                       # fins
        cr.move_to(rx_s + sgn * half, bot - 160)
        cr.line_to(rx_s + sgn * (half + 70), bot + 30)
        cr.line_to(rx_s + sgn * half, bot)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.fill()
    t0, t1 = top + 30, bot - 20
    th = t1 - t0
    f_old = ease(seg(u, 0.04, 0.3))
    f_new = ease(seg(u, 0.4, 0.66))
    h_old = th * (v_old / (total or 1.0)) * f_old
    h_new = th * share * f_new
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(rx_s - half + 16, t0, 2 * half - 32, th)
    cr.clip()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((34, 38, 48)))
    cr.paint()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["cool"]))
    cr.rectangle(rx_s - half, t1 - h_old, 2 * half, h_old)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"]))
    cr.rectangle(rx_s - half, t1 - h_old - h_new, 2 * half, h_new)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(1, 1, 1, 0.25)
    cr.rectangle(rx_s - half + 22, t0, 14, th)
    cr.fill()
    cr.restore()
    if f_new > 0:
        glow(cr, rx_s, t1 - h_old - h_new, 90, P["accent2"], 0.5 * f_new)

    # the hose he hauls: from the ground up the gantry to the tank port
    hx0, hy0 = 90, 1430
    climb = ease(seg(u, 0.35, 0.65))
    walk_ = ease(seg(u, 0.12, 0.35))
    dx = 150 + (gx - 150) * walk_
    dfy = 1440 - (1440 - 920) * climb
    hand = (dx + 20, dfy - 140)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 30, 34)))
    cr.set_line_width(12)
    cr.move_to(hx0, hy0)
    cr.curve_to(hx0 + 80, hy0 + 20, hand[0] - 60, hand[1] + 120, hand[0], hand[1])
    if u > 0.35:
        cr.curve_to(hand[0] + 60, hand[1] - 20, rx - half - 40, 890, rx - half, 900)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass"]))
    cr.arc(hx0, hy0, 26, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()

    if u < 0.12:
        role = "think"
    elif u < 0.35:
        role = "strain"
    elif u < 0.65:
        role = "climb"
    elif u < 0.84:
        role = "hold_up"
    else:
        role = "shock"
    host(role, dx, dfy, 210)

    # readouts: only the sourced values and arithmetic on them, never a count-up
    a0 = ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.08))
    if u < 0.66:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v_old))}", f"people in space · {l_old.lower()}",
                    60, 520, a=a0, size=130, max_w=400)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(total))}", "people have ever flown",
                    60, 520, size=130, max_w=400)
    b = ease(seg(u, 0.62, 0.74))
    if b > 0:
        fit_readout(cr, f"+{int(round(v_new))}", f"{l_new.lower()}", 60, 760,
                    a=b, rgb=P["accent2"], size=90, max_w=380)
    c = ease(seg(u, 0.76, 0.88))
    if c > 0:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(share * 100))}%", "of all of it — and only warming up",
                    60, 1000, a=c, rgb=P["accent2"], size=90, max_w=380)
