def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """The hook: the launch coast at dusk, the pad already swallowed by one
    exhaust cloud that keeps swelling. Five crewed rockets tear out of it one
    after another, and the tally of everyone who has ever flown jumps in one
    move from the 2020 count to the 2025 count. One faint old trail on the
    left stands for the first 59 years. Data climbs the swelling cloud as it
    grows, then reacts in shock at the top."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (y_a, v_a), (y_b, v_b), (y_c, v_c) = rows[0], rows[-2], rows[-1]

    def yr(s):
        try:
            return int(float(s))
        except ValueError:
            return 0
    old_years = yr(y_b) - yr(y_a)
    new_years = yr(y_c) - yr(y_b)
    added = v_c - v_b

    # the sky: dusk over the launch coast, full frame
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (10, 12, 38)), (0.45, (40, 30, 78)), (0.66, (196, 110, 96)),
               (0.72, (60, 44, 70)), (1.0, (18, 16, 28))], 0, H)
    glow(cr, 820, 1260, 360, P["sun_glow"], 0.55)

    # the first 59 years: one slow faint trail, long since gone cold
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((220, 210, 230), 0.22))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    cr.move_to(140, 1300)
    cr.curve_to(150, 1000, 190, 760, 260, 560)
    cr.stroke()

    # the coast and the pad
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((22, 20, 34)))
    cr.move_to(0, 1320)
    cr.curve_to(300, 1300, 700, 1340, W, 1310)
    cr.line_to(W, H)
    cr.line_to(0, H)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((34, 32, 48)))
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    for gx in (340, 780):                     # service towers, half in smoke
        cr.move_to(gx, 1330)
        cr.line_to(gx, 1060)
        cr.stroke()
        for k in range(6):
            cr.move_to(gx - 22, 1320 - k * 44)
            cr.line_to(gx + 22, 1290 - k * 44)
            cr.stroke()

    # five rockets, one after another, each tearing out of the cloud —
    # the first is already climbing on frame one
    pads = [460, 620, 520, 700, 400]
    starts = [-0.1, 0.1, 0.27, 0.44, 0.6]
    cleared = 0.0
    for k, (px, s0) in enumerate(zip(pads, starts)):
        f = seg(u, s0, s0 + 0.3)
        if f <= 0:
            continue
        rise = f * f                          # it accelerates off the pad
        lean = (k - 2) * 60
        ry = 1180 - 1400 * rise
        rx = px + lean * rise
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 236, 210), 0.55))
        cr.set_line_width(14)
        cr.move_to(px, 1180)
        cr.curve_to(px, 1180 - 300 * rise, rx, ry + 200, rx, ry + 60)
        cr.stroke()
        if ry > -120:
            glow(cr, rx, ry + 70, 70, P["sun_hot"], 0.9)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((244, 244, 250)))
            cr.rectangle(rx - 14, ry - 50, 28, 110)
            cr.fill()
            cr.move_to(rx - 14, ry - 50)
            cr.line_to(rx, ry - 88)
            cr.line_to(rx + 14, ry - 50)
            cr.close_path()
            cr.fill()
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["redline"]))
            cr.rectangle(rx - 14, ry - 20, 28, 10)
            cr.fill()
        cleared += ease(seg(f, 0.25, 0.45))

    # the hero: one exhaust cloud, already huge, swelling as they launch
    grow = ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.7))
    R = 300 + 150 * grow
    cx, cy = 560, 1270
    puffs = [(-0.8, 0.1, 0.55), (-0.45, -0.3, 0.62), (0.0, -0.5, 0.7),
             (0.45, -0.28, 0.62), (0.82, 0.08, 0.55), (-0.2, 0.05, 0.75),
             (0.3, 0.1, 0.72)]
    for k, (fx, fy, fr) in enumerate(puffs):
        b = 1.0 + 0.04 * math.sin(t * 1.3 + k)
        px, py, pr = cx + fx * R, cy + fy * R, fr * R * b
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 140, 160)))
        cr.arc(px, py + 18, pr, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 226, 230)))
        cr.arc(px - 10, py, pr * 0.94, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()
    glow(cr, cx, cy - 40, R * 0.8, P["sun_hot"], 0.35 + 0.25 * cleared / 5)

    # Data: points at the cloud, climbs its swelling flank, reacts at the top
    c = ease(seg(u, 0.1, 0.78))
    hx = 190 + 260 * c
    fy = 1470 - (1470 - (cy - 0.62 * R)) * c
    role = "point" if u < 0.1 else ("climb" if u < 0.8 else "shock")
    host(role, hx, fy, 210)

    # the old era's label, drawn after Data and clear of his climb
    text(cr, f"{int(round(v_b))} in {old_years} years", W - 80, 1000, 40, INK_2,
         anchor="right", alpha=0.85)

    # the tally of everyone who has flown: one jump, 2020 count to 2025 count
    jumped = u >= 0.35
    n = v_c if jumped else v_b
    sz = 150 * (pop(seg(u, 0.35, 0.45)) if jumped else 1.0)
    fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(n))}", "people have ever reached space", 80, 520,
                a=1.0, size=max(100, sz))
    b = ease(seg(u, 0.4, 0.52))
    if b > 0:
        fit_readout(cr, f"+{int(round(added))} in {new_years} years", "",
                    W / 2, 760, anchor="center", a=b, rgb=P["accent2"],
                    size=84)

stories.title: Beavers Crashed To 100,000. Now There Are 12 Million.
stories.hook: We nearly wiped out nature's best firefighter.
stories.closing: Turns out the 'pest' flooding your yard might be a firefighter.
stories.question: Have you ever seen a real beaver dam up close? I want to know.
stories.caption: Beavers were hunted down to just 100,000 in North America by 1900 -- from tens of millions before the fur trade. Now they're back to about 12 million, and scientists found land near their dams burns 3 times less in wildfires. Have you ever seen a real beaver dam up close? I want to know.

segments.topic: beavers crashed to near extinction, now rebounding
segments.say: Beavers once numbered around 100 million across North America. Fur trappers crashed that to just 100,000 by 1900. Today they're back to about 12 million -- still a fraction of what once was.

segments.topic: why it matters: beavers as nature's firefighter
segments.say: Here's why that matters: a peer-reviewed study found streams without beaver dams burned 3 times worse in wildfires than streams with them. Beaver ponds act like natural firebreaks.

segments.topic: how much water beavers store per dam
segments.say: A single beaver dam can hold 1.1 million gallons of water -- more than an Olympic swimming pool. That stored water keeps the land green enough to survive drought and fire.

stories.title: 2.6 Million Kids Are Raised By A System No One Runs
stories.hook: It's nearly 8 times bigger than official foster care.
stories.closing: Somebody's grandma is quietly doing the government's job for free.
stories.question: Did a grandparent ever step in to raise you? Share your story.
stories.caption: 2.6 million American kids are being raised by grandparents or other relatives right now -- nearly 8 times more than the 343,077 kids in the official foster care system. It's quietly absorbing the fallout of the overdose crisis, and it's costing these grandparents: 18.3% of them live in poverty. Did a grandparent ever step in to raise you? Share your story.

segments.topic: the hidden foster system: kids raised by grandparents
segments.say: 2.6 million kids are being raised by grandparents or other relatives right now. Compare that to the official foster care system: just 343,077 kids. This unofficial safety net is nearly 8 times bigger.

segments.topic: why grandparents are stepping into foster care's gap
segments.say: Here's why: drug overdose deaths went from 16,849 a year in 1999 to a peak of 107,941 in 2022. Even after easing to 79,384 in 2024, that's still far higher than it used to be -- and grandparents are catching the fallout.

segments.topic: the cost to grandparents doing foster care's job
segments.say: It comes at a cost: 18.3 percent of grandparents raising grandchildren live in poverty, compared with 15.1 percent of kids nationally. They're absorbing a crisis with less money, not more.

stories.title: Astronauts On The ISS See 16 Sunrises Every Day
stories.hook: You've never moved this fast: 27,600 kilometers an hour, right over your head.
stories.closing: Even in space, you can't dodge a 24-hour day.
stories.question: How many hours of daylight did you get today? Tell me below.
stories.caption: The ISS orbits Earth every 93 minutes at 27,600 km/h -- about 30 times faster than a jet. That means its crew sees roughly 16 sunrises every single day. How many hours of daylight did YOU get today? 👇

segments.topic: how fast the ISS orbits compared to a jet
segments.say: The ISS circles Earth at 27,600 kilometers an hour -- about 30 times faster than a commercial jet's 900. That speed isn't for show: it's exactly what keeps the station from falling into the ground.

segments.topic: why the ISS orbit period is so short
segments.say: So why so fast? Altitude decides orbital speed: the ISS orbits every 93 minutes, GPS satellites take 720, and geostationary satellites take a full 1,440 -- exactly matching Earth's spin.

segments.topic: how many sunrises the ISS sees in a day
segments.say: Each 93-minute lap flips the station from night to day, so a new sunrise comes every 93 minutes. On the ground that same cycle takes 1,440 minutes. Up there, it happens 16 times a day.

stories.hook_was: How many sunrises do you see in a day?

stories.title: Colon Cancer Screening Age Just Dropped From 50 To 45
stories.hook: Your odds of colon cancer under 55 nearly doubled — and the line's still climbing.
stories.closing: Doctors moved the age. Maybe put it on your calendar too.
stories.question: Do you know your recommended screening age? Tell me below.
stories.caption: 1 in 5 colorectal cancer cases are now diagnosed before age 55 -- double the share from 1995. That's why doctors dropped the recommended screening age from 50 to 45. Do you know your number? 👇

segments.topic: how colon cancer diagnoses under 55 keep climbing
segments.say: In 1995, just 11 percent of colorectal cancer cases were found in people under 55. By 2019, that hit 20 percent -- nearly double, and the line hasn't flattened yet.
segments.illustrated_scene:
def _colon_path():
    """The large bowel seen from the front. The path runs from the rectum and
    sigmoid at the lower right, up the descending colon, across the transverse
    colon and down the ascending colon to the caecum. The share fills it from
    the rectum end, where a screening scope goes in first."""
    way = [(560, 1420), (700, 1395), (840, 1330), (850, 1180), (850, 1000),
           (845, 840), (790, 770), (660, 745), (540, 760), (420, 745),
           (300, 775), (250, 850), (250, 1030), (255, 1200), (290, 1330)]
    out = []
    for (x0, y0), (x1, y1) in zip(way, way[1:]):
        n = max(2, int(math.hypot(x1 - x0, y1 - y0) / 12))
        for i in range(n):
            f = i / n
            out.append((x0 + (x1 - x0) * f, y0 + (y1 - y0) * f))
    out.append(way[-1])
    cum = [0.0]
    for (x0, y0), (x1, y1) in zip(out, out[1:]):
        cum.append(cum[-1] + math.hypot(x1 - x0, y1 - y0))
    return out, cum


def _along(pp, cum, frac):
    """Returns the point `frac` of the way along the bowel and the index just before it."""
    L = cum[-1] * clamp(frac)
    for i in range(1, len(cum)):
        if cum[i] >= L:
            f = (L - cum[i - 1]) / max(1e-6, cum[i] - cum[i - 1])
            (x0, y0), (x1, y1) = pp[i - 1], pp[i]
            return (x0 + (x1 - x0) * f, y0 + (y1 - y0) * f), i
    return pp[-1], len(pp) - 1


def _upto(pp, cum, frac):
    (fx, fy), fi = _along(pp, cum, frac)
    return pp[:fi] + [(fx, fy)]


def _span(pp, cum, a, b):
    """The run of bowel between fractions a and b of its length."""
    (ax, ay), ai = _along(pp, cum, a)
    (bx, by), bi = _along(pp, cum, b)
    return [(ax, ay)] + pp[ai:bi] + [(bx, by)]


def _stroke_run(cr, pts_, w, rgb, a=1.0):
    if len(pts_) < 2:
        return
    cr.set_line_width(w)
    cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
    cr.set_line_join(cairo.LINE_JOIN_ROUND)
    cr.move_to(*pts_[0])
    for p in pts_[1:]:
        cr.line_to(*p)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(rgb, a))
    cr.stroke()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """The share of colorectal cancers found in younger adults, drawn as that
    share of the BOWEL itself lit up in warning red. The colon draws itself
    in; the 1995 share floods in from the rectum end one percentage point at
    a time, each point landing with a pulse; the 2019 share pushes on up the
    colon the same way, carrying Data with it as he braces against the red
    front. Then the 1995 stretch lifts off as a ghost and lays itself down
    again past the notch: 2019's stretch is nearly two of them. Data drops
    back to the floor in shock at the ratio."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts[:2]])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    ratio = v1 / v0 if v0 else 0.0

    # the clinic: a cool examination-room wall down to the floor
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (28, 44, 62)), (0.55, (40, 60, 80)), (1.0, (16, 24, 36))], 0, H)
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (60, 78, 96)), (1.0, (22, 30, 42))], 1450, H)
    glow(cr, 550, 1080, 560, (120, 170, 210), 0.35)

    pp, cum = _colon_path()
    tissue, tissue_lit, tissue_sh = (214, 132, 138), (240, 170, 170), (150, 76, 90)
    breathe = 6 * math.sin(t * 1.3)                # the gut is alive: a slow swell
    reveal = ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.12))               # the bowel draws itself in
    body = _upto(pp, cum, max(0.002, reveal))
    _stroke_run(cr, body, 150 + breathe, tissue_sh)
    _stroke_run(cr, body, 128 + breathe, tissue)
    _stroke_run(cr, [(x - 14, y - 14) for x, y in body], 40, tissue_lit, 0.45)
    # haustra: the pouch folds across the tube
    for i in range(6, len(body) - 2, 7):
        (x0, y0), (x1, y1) = body[i - 1], body[i + 1]
        dx, dy = x1 - x0, y1 - y0
        n = math.hypot(dx, dy) or 1.0
        nx, ny = -dy / n, dx / n
        cx, cy = body[i]
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(tissue_sh, 0.8))
        cr.set_line_width(6)
        cr.move_to(cx - nx * 58, cy - ny * 58)
        cr.curve_to(cx - nx * 20 + dx * 0.6, cy - ny * 20 + dy * 0.6,
                    cx + nx * 20 + dx * 0.6, cy + ny * 20 + dy * 0.6,
                    cx + nx * 58, cy + ny * 58)
        cr.stroke()

    # the share as a length of bowel, arriving a percentage point at a time:
    # each point surges in, then settles, so the front keeps visibly landing
    f0 = seg(u, 0.10, 0.30)
    f1 = seg(u, 0.36, 0.72)

    def _stepped(f, n):
        if f <= 0:
            return 0.0, 0.0
        if f >= 1:
            return float(n), 0.0
        k = f * n
        whole = int(k)
        ph = k - whole
        return whole + ease(clamp(ph / 0.6)), ph

    n0 = max(1, int(round(v0)))
    n1 = max(1, int(round(v1 - v0)))
    s0, ph0 = _stepped(f0, n0)
    s1, ph1 = _stepped(f1, n1)
    share = (v0 * s0 / n0 + (v1 - v0) * s1 / n1) / 100.0
    (fx, fy), fi = _along(pp, cum, share)
    red = pp[:fi] + [(fx, fy)]
    _stroke_run(cr, red, 112 + breathe, WARN, 0.92)
    _stroke_run(cr, [(x - 12, y - 12) for x, y in red], 28, (255, 190, 170), 0.5)
    if share > 0.005:
        glow(cr, fx, fy, 130 + 20 * math.sin(t * 2.2), WARN, 0.6)
    # each landed point sends a pulse ring out of the front
    filling = (0 < f0 < 1) or (0 < f1 < 1)
    if filling:
        ph = ph0 if 0 < f0 < 1 else ph1
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(WARN, 0.8 * (1 - ph)))
        cr.set_line_width(10 * (1 - ph) + 2)
        cr.arc(fx, fy, 70 + 150 * ph, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.stroke()

    # where 1995 stopped: a notch on the bowel that stays behind as the red passes
    (mx, my), _ = _along(pp, cum, v0 / 100.0)
    ma = ease(seg(u, 0.29, 0.34))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(INK, ma))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    cr.move_to(mx + 70, my)
    cr.line_to(mx + 110, my)
    cr.stroke()
    text(cr, l0, mx + 120, my + 14, 40, INK, anchor="left", alpha=ma)
    (ex, ey), _ = _along(pp, cum, v1 / 100.0)
    ea = ease(seg(u, 0.70, 0.75))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(INK, ea))
    cr.move_to(ex + 70, ey)
    cr.line_to(ex + 110, ey)
    cr.stroke()
    text(cr, l1, ex + 120, ey + 14, 40, INK, anchor="left", alpha=ea)

    # nearly double: the 1995 stretch lifts off as a ghost and slides up the
    # colon to lay itself down again past its own notch
    gs = ease(seg(u, 0.73, 0.85))
    ga = ease(seg(u, 0.72, 0.76)) * (1 - 0.5 * ease(seg(u, 0.92, 1.0)))
    if ga > 0:
        a0 = (v0 / 100.0) * gs
        ghost = _span(pp, cum, a0, a0 + v0 / 100.0)
        _stroke_run(cr, ghost, 124, P["accent2"], 0.35 * ga)
        _stroke_run(cr, ghost, 124, P["accent2"], 0.0)
        cr.set_line_width(8)
        cr.set_dash([22, 16], -t * 60)
        cr.move_to(*ghost[0])
        for p in ghost[1:]:
            cr.line_to(*p)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"], 0.9 * ga))
        cr.stroke()
        cr.set_dash([])

    # his bit: he points from the far side of the floor, climbs to the red
    # front, braces against it and is carried up with it point by point,
    # then drops back to the floor in shock
    climb = ease(seg(u, 0.16, 0.34))
    down = ease(seg(u, 0.86, 0.95))
    hx0, hy0 = 180, 1500
    hx1, hy1 = fx - 30, fy + 40
    hx = hx0 + (hx1 - hx0) * climb
    hy = hy0 + (hy1 - hy0) * climb
    hx = hx + (560 - hx) * down
    hy = hy + (1500 - hy) * down
    if u < 0.16:
        role = "point"
    elif u < 0.34:
        role = "climb"
    elif u < 0.86:
        role = "strain"
    else:
        role = "shock"
    host(role, hx, min(hy, 1510), 210)

    # the readout only ever prints a year that has landed
    k = 1 if f1 >= 1.0 else 0
    lab, val = rows[-1] if k else rows[0]
    fit_readout(cr, f"{val:g}%", f"of colorectal cancers found in younger adults · {lab}",
                80, 490, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.08)), size=140)
    b = ease(seg(u, 0.82, 0.90))
    if b > 0:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{ratio:.1f}x", f"the share since {l0}", 550, 1060,
                    anchor="center", a=b, rgb=P["accent2"], size=int(80 + 40 * pop(b)),
                    max_w=460)

segments.topic: why the colon cancer screening age dropped to 45
segments.say: So screening moved to catch it: the recommended starting age used to be 50. Since 2021 it's 45 -- five years earlier, aimed right at this younger wave.
segments.illustrated_scene:
def _candle_spots(n):
    """Candles planted on the top tier, back row to front row, left to right."""
    cx, cy, rx, ry = 540, 860, 310, 55
    rows = [(-30, n // 3), (0, n // 3), (30, n - 2 * (n // 3))]
    spots = []
    for r_, (dy, cnt) in enumerate(rows):
        half = rx * math.sqrt(max(0.0, 1 - (dy / ry) ** 2)) * 0.86
        for c in range(cnt):
            f = (c + 0.5) / max(1, cnt)
            spots.append((cx - half + 2 * half * f + (r_ % 2) * 6, cy + dy, r_))
    return spots


def _candle(cr, x, base, lit, col, a=1.0, t=0.0, i=0, s=1.0, spin=0.0):
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, base)
    cr.rotate(spin)
    cr.scale(s, s)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(col, a))
    cr.rectangle(-7, -64, 14, 64)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 255, 255), 0.55 * a))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for k in range(3):
        cr.move_to(-7, -14 - k * 18)
        cr.line_to(7, -22 - k * 18)
        cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 30, 30), a))
    cr.set_line_width(2)
    cr.move_to(0, -64)
    cr.line_to(0, -72)
    cr.stroke()
    if lit > 0:
        f = lit * (1.0 + 0.05 * math.sin(t * 4 + i * 1.7))
        glow(cr, 0, -84, 34 * f, P["sun_glow"], 0.55 * a * lit)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["sun_hot"], a * lit))
        cr.move_to(0, -72)
        cr.curve_to(-9 * f, -76, -6 * f, -90 * f, 0, -98 * f)
        cr.curve_to(6 * f, -90 * f, 9 * f, -76, 0, -72)
        cr.fill()
    cr.restore()


def _tier(cr, x0, x1, y0, y1, ry):
    cxm, rx = (x0 + x1) / 2, (x1 - x0) / 2
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((200, 146, 100)))
    cr.rectangle(x0, y0, x1 - x0, y1 - y0)
    cr.fill()
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(cxm, y1)
    cr.scale(rx, ry)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 1, 0, math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((250, 238, 242)))
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(cxm, y0)
    cr.scale(rx, ry)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 1, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.fill()
    cr.move_to(x0, y0)
    for k in range(13):
        dx = x0 + (x1 - x0) * (k + 0.5) / 13
        dy = y0 + ry + 40 + 26 * (k % 3)
        cr.line_to(dx - 18, y0 + ry * 0.6)
        cr.curve_to(dx - 12, dy, dx + 12, dy, dx + 18, y0 + ry * 0.6)
    cr.line_to(x1, y0)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """The screening age as the candles on a birthday cake: fifty candles
    light one by one for the old starting age. Data climbs the cake and
    wrenches out the five big red ones, one at a time: each lifts clear of
    the icing, then tumbles, still burning, across and out of the frame.
    The headline holds the old age while he works and snaps to the new one
    only when the last candle is gone — it never prints a number between.
    He hops down and FIVE YEARS EARLIER lands in ink on the dark ground
    above the cake."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts[:2]]
    if rows[0][1] >= rows[1][1]:
        (lo, old), (ln, new) = rows[0], rows[1]
    else:
        (lo, old), (ln, new) = rows[1], rows[0]
    n = int(round(old))
    gap = old - new
    n_rm = max(1, min(8, int(round(gap))))
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (46, 34, 58)), (0.6, (96, 64, 72)), (1.0, (140, 92, 78))], 0, 1400)
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (120, 78, 52)), (1.0, (62, 38, 30))], 1400, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((164, 112, 76)))
    cr.rectangle(0, 1396, W, 10)
    cr.fill()
    grow = ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.07))
    glow(cr, 540, 880, 520, P["sun_glow"], 0.12 + 0.28 * ease(seg(u, 0.06, 0.3)))
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(540, 1400)
    sc = 0.6 + 0.4 * pop(seg(u, 0.0, 0.07))
    cr.scale(sc, sc)
    cr.translate(-540, -1400)
    _tier(cr, 150, 930, 1130, 1400, 60)
    _tier(cr, 230, 850, 860, 1130, 55)
    cr.restore()
    spots = _candle_spots(n)
    front = [i for i, s in enumerate(spots) if s[2] == 2]
    first = max(0, len(front) // 2 - n_rm // 2 - 2)
    gone = front[first:first + n_rm]
    d = 0.44 / n_rm
    # each: lifted clear of the icing while he strains, then thrown out of
    # the frame; the flight overlaps the next pull so one is always moving
    plan = {}
    for k, i in enumerate(gone):
        s0 = 0.34 + k * d
        lift = ease(seg(u, s0, s0 + d * 0.45))
        fly = seg(u, s0 + d * 0.45, s0 + d * 1.75)
        plan[i] = (k, lift, fly)
    out = sum(1 for k, lift, fly in plan.values() if fly >= 1.0)
    flying = []
    for i, (x, y, r_) in enumerate(spots):
        # one candle catches after another, all the way through the climb
        lit = ease(seg(u, 0.06 + 0.24 * i / n, 0.075 + 0.24 * i / n))
        if i in plan:
            k, lift, fly = plan[i]
            if fly <= 0:
                # the five stand out from the start: taller, red, marked
                _candle(cr, x, y - 120 * lift, lit, P["redline"], a=grow,
                        t=t, i=i, s=1.35, spin=0.12 * math.sin(t * 9) * lift)
            elif fly < 1:
                flying.append((k, x, y - 120, lit, i, fly))
        else:
            tone = (238, 226, 214) if i % 2 == 0 else (226, 212, 222)
            _candle(cr, x, y, lit, tone, a=grow, t=t, i=i)
    fx = [spots[i][0] - 50 for i in gone]
    end_x = 975.0
    if u < 0.14:
        role, hx, fy = "point", 120.0, 1500.0
    elif u < 0.34:
        c = ease(seg(u, 0.14, 0.34))
        role = "climb"
        hx = 120 + (fx[0] - 120) * c
        fy = 1500 - (1500 - 905) * c
    elif u < 0.84:
        hx, fy = fx[0], 905.0
        for k in range(n_rm):
            s0 = 0.34 + k * d
            if u >= s0 and k:
                hx = fx[k - 1] + (fx[k] - fx[k - 1]) * ease(seg(u, s0, s0 + d * 0.25))
        role = "strain"
    else:
        # he hops down off the cake to the table's edge, arms up
        j = ease(seg(u, 0.84, 0.93))
        hx = fx[-1] + (end_x - fx[-1]) * j
        fy = 905 + (1500 - 905) * j - 160 * math.sin(math.pi * j)
        role = "hold_up" if u < 0.93 else "cheer"
    host(role, hx, fy, 210)
    # the thrown candles fly OVER everything, big and burning, off frame right
    for k, sx, sy, lit, i, fly in flying:
        ex, ey = W + 160, 900 + 70 * (k % 3)
        f = ease(fly)
        lx = sx + (ex - sx) * f
        ly = sy + (ey - sy) * f - 70 * math.sin(math.pi * f)
        glow(cr, lx, ly - 90, 60, P["sun_glow"], 0.5 * lit)
        _candle(cr, lx, ly, lit, P["redline"], t=t, i=i, s=1.5,
                spin=2.2 * math.pi * f)
    # the headline holds the OLD age until every candle is out, then snaps
    # to the NEW one — only the two sourced ages are ever printed
    done = out >= n_rm
    if done:
        val, lab = new, ln
        a = ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.08))
    else:
        val, lab = old, lo
        a = ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.08))
    fit_readout(cr, str(int(round(val))) + " years",
                "first screening · " + lab.lower(),
                80, 480, a=a, size=130)
    b = ease(seg(u, 0.86, 0.95))
    if b > 0:
        msg = str(int(round(gap))) + " YEARS EARLIER"
        text(cr, msg, 540, 700, fit_size(cr, msg, 84, 900, face="display"), INK,
             face="display", anchor="center", alpha=b, shadow=False)

segments.topic: colon cancer risk for people born decades apart
segments.say: But the risk itself changed too: if you were born in 1990, you carry 2 times the colon cancer risk of someone born in 1950 -- and 4 times the rectal cancer risk. Genetics didn't shift. Something else did.
segments.illustrated_scene:
def _slab(cr, x, base, s, col, a=1.0):
    """A cast-iron weight: one unit of risk. It is unlabelled; the readout gives the number."""
    w0, w1, h = 120 * s, 84 * s, 96 * s
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 44, 54), a))
    cr.set_line_width(12 * s)
    cr.arc(x, base - h, 26 * s, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.move_to(x - w0 / 2, base)
    cr.line_to(x + w0 / 2, base)
    cr.line_to(x + w1 / 2, base - h)
    cr.line_to(x - w1 / 2, base - h)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(col, a))
    cr.fill_preserve()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((20, 22, 30), 0.5 * a))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 255, 255), 0.18 * a))
    cr.rectangle(x - w1 / 2 + 8 * s, base - h + 8 * s, 10 * s, h - 16 * s)
    cr.fill()


def _short(lab):
    return lab.split(":")[0].split("(")[0].strip()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """Risk weighed on a doctor's balance: one iron weight for the 1950
    cohort, and for 1990 as many of the same weight as the ratio says. Data
    hefts the extra weight across the clinic onto the 1990 pan, shoves it
    home, and the beam slams down on that side: twice the load."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts[:2]]
    (lh, hi), (llo, lo) = rows if rows[0][1] >= rows[1][1] else rows[::-1]
    ratio = hi / (lo or 1.0)
    n_r = int(clamp(round(ratio), 1, 5))
    FLOOR = 1440
    # the clinic
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (34, 46, 72)), (0.6, (58, 76, 104)), (1.0, (80, 96, 118))], 0, H)
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (70, 62, 58)), (1.0, (36, 32, 34))], FLOOR, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 255, 255), 0.06))
    cr.rectangle(0, FLOOR - 70, W, 14)
    cr.fill()
    glow(cr, 540, 760, 560, (170, 200, 240), 0.22)
    # the balance: raised so both pans ride clear above Data's head
    px, py, L, hang = 540, 720, 350, 330
    tip = seg(u, 0.64, 0.76)
    settle = math.exp(-6.0 * max(0.0, u - 0.76) * 8) * math.sin(max(0.0, u - 0.76) * 90)
    th_max = 0.2 * clamp(ratio - 1.0, 0.0, 1.0)
    th = th_max * (pop(tip) + 0.12 * settle * (tip >= 1))
    ca, sa = math.cos(th), math.sin(th)
    lx, ly = px - L * ca, py - L * sa
    rx, ry = px + L * ca, py + L * sa
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 132, 96)))            # column + foot
    cr.rectangle(px - 22, py, 44, FLOOR - py - 20)
    cr.fill()
    cr.move_to(px - 150, FLOOR)
    cr.line_to(px + 150, FLOOR)
    cr.line_to(px + 90, FLOOR - 40)
    cr.line_to(px - 90, FLOOR - 40)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass_shade"]))
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass"]))                # beam
    cr.set_line_width(26)
    cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
    cr.move_to(lx, ly)
    cr.line_to(rx, ry)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_BUTT)
    cr.arc(px, py, 36, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass_shade"]))
    cr.arc(px, py, 14, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()
    pw = max(260, n_r * 118 + 30)
    warn = ease(seg(u, 0.7, 0.8))
    pans = []
    for ex, ey, wd in ((lx, ly, 260), (rx, ry, pw)):
        pyy = ey + hang
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((190, 176, 140), 0.9))
        cr.set_line_width(4)
        for dx_ in (-wd / 2 + 14, wd / 2 - 14):
            cr.move_to(ex, ey)
            cr.line_to(ex + dx_, pyy)
        cr.stroke()
        pans.append((ex, pyy, wd))
    # the 1990 side glows warning red once the beam falls
    if warn > 0:
        glow(cr, pans[1][0], pans[1][1] - 60, 300, WARN,
             0.45 * warn * (0.8 + 0.2 * math.sin(t * 3.0)))
    for ex, pyy, wd in pans:
        cr.move_to(ex - wd / 2, pyy)
        cr.line_to(ex + wd / 2, pyy)
        cr.curve_to(ex + wd / 2 - 20, pyy + 44, ex - wd / 2 + 20, pyy + 44, ex - wd / 2, pyy)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass"]))
        cr.fill()
    iron = (70, 76, 90)
    s = 0.95
    _slab(cr, pans[0][0], pans[0][1], s, iron)
    slots = [pans[1][0] - (n_r - 1) * 59 + k * 118 for k in range(n_r)]
    for k in range(n_r - 1):
        _slab(cr, slots[k], pans[1][1], s, iron)
    # Data's bit: point at the level scale, heft the extra weight, carry it
    # across, shove it onto the 1990 pan, recoil as the beam drops
    walk_f = ease(seg(u, 0.25, 0.58))
    dx = 380 + 420 * walk_f
    lift = ease(seg(u, 0.15, 0.25))
    place = ease(seg(u, 0.58, 0.66))
    back = ease(seg(u, 0.76, 0.86))
    dx -= 90 * back
    head = FLOOR - 250
    if place <= 0:
        wx = dx + 70 * (1 - lift)
        wb = FLOOR + (head - FLOOR) * lift
    else:
        wx = dx + (slots[-1] - dx) * place
        wb = head + (pans[1][1] - head) * place
    if u < 0.15:
        role = "point"
    elif u < 0.58:
        role = "hold_up"
    elif u < 0.76:
        role = "strain"
    elif u < 0.9:
        role = "shock"
    else:
        role = "think"
    host(role, dx, FLOOR, 210, pace=(0.25 < u < 0.58))
    _slab(cr, wx, wb, s, (150, 52, 48) if place >= 1 else iron)
    # the cohort names ride on the pan fronts: drawn after Data and above his head
    for (ex, pyy, _), lab in ((pans[0], llo), (pans[1], lh)):
        text(cr, _short(lab), ex, pyy + 30, 30, look.INK, anchor="center")
    # the readout: level first, then the multiple once it lands
    if tip < 0.5:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{lo:g}×", _short(llo).lower() + " · baseline risk", 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.08)), size=150)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{ratio:g}×", "the colon cancer risk · " + _short(lh).lower(),
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.7, 0.78)), rgb=WARN, size=160)

stories.hook_was: Colon cancer used to skip people under 50.
stories.closing_scene:
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """Closing: the kitchen wall calendar. Doctors moved the age: Data tears the
    SOMEDAY and NEXT YEAR pages off, and THIS YEAR is left. Then he drags a red
    marker around the page, which reads BOOK SCREENING. The risk multiple he
    reacts to is the ratio of the two sourced cohort risks. Only the page on
    top shows its title, and every piece of text is drawn after him."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts[:2]]
    (lh, hi), (ll, lo) = rows if rows[0][1] >= rows[1][1] else rows[::-1]
    ratio = hi / (lo or 1.0)

    # the room: a warm evening wall, a dusk window, a wooden floor
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (58, 44, 52)), (0.6, (92, 70, 66)), (1.0, (70, 52, 48))], 0, H)
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (96, 66, 44)), (1.0, (54, 36, 26))], 1400, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 26, 20)))
    cr.rectangle(0, 1392, W, 12)
    cr.fill()
    for k in range(6):                         # floorboards
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 26, 20), 0.5))
        cr.set_line_width(3)
        cr.move_to(0, 1450 + k * 80)
        cr.line_to(W, 1450 + k * 80)
        cr.stroke()
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (60, 50, 110)), (1.0, (230, 140, 110))], 170, 470, 70, 330)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((36, 26, 30)))
    cr.set_line_width(14)
    cr.rectangle(70, 170, 260, 300)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    cr.move_to(200, 170)
    cr.line_to(200, 470)
    cr.move_to(70, 320)
    cr.line_to(330, 320)
    cr.stroke()
    glow(cr, 540, 1020, 620, P["sun_glow"], 0.22)

    # the wall clock: time ticks on, one decisive second at a time
    ccx, ccy, cR = 930, 800, 70
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["paper"]))
    cr.arc(ccx, ccy, cR, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((36, 26, 30)))
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    cr.arc(ccx, ccy, cR, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.stroke()
    tick = int(t) + ease(clamp((t % 1.0) * 5))
    for ang, ln, lw in ((tick * 2 * math.pi / 12 - math.pi / 2, 58, 4),
                        (-math.pi / 2 + 1.1, 34, 8), (-math.pi / 2 + 3.4, 48, 6)):
        cr.set_line_width(lw)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["redline"] if lw == 4 else (36, 26, 30)))
        cr.move_to(ccx, ccy)
        cr.line_to(ccx + ln * math.cos(ang), ccy + ln * math.sin(ang))
        cr.stroke()

    # the calendar: the hero, hung from a nail
    px0, py0, pw, ph = 280, 700, 520, 650

    def page(x, y, band, a=1.0):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((20, 14, 16), 0.35 * a))
        cr.rectangle(x + 10, y + 12, pw, ph)
        cr.fill()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["paper"], a))
        cr.rectangle(x, y, pw, ph)
        cr.fill()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(band, a))
        cr.rectangle(x, y, pw, 110)
        cr.fill()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["paper_ink"], 0.12 * a))   # the day grid, faint
        cr.set_line_width(2)
        for r_ in range(1, 5):
            cr.move_to(x + 20, y + 110 + r_ * 104)
            cr.line_to(x + pw - 20, y + 110 + r_ * 104)
        cr.stroke()

    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((36, 26, 30)))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    cr.move_to(px0 + 40, py0)
    cr.line_to(540, 640)
    cr.line_to(px0 + pw - 40, py0)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.arc(540, 640, 9, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()

    pages = [("SOMEDAY", P["brick_cool"], seg(u, 0.26, 0.36)),
             ("NEXT YEAR", P["brick"], seg(u, 0.38, 0.48))]
    page(px0, py0, P["redline"])
    top_label = "THIS YEAR"
    for label, band, p in reversed(pages):
        if p <= 0:
            page(px0, py0, band)
            top_label = label                  # the last one drawn is on top

    # the marker ring, drawn by hand around the page
    wp = ease(seg(u, 0.52, 0.8))
    rcx, rcy, rR = 540, 1070, 200
    a0 = -math.pi * 0.6
    if wp > 0:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["redline"]))
        cr.set_line_width(14)
        cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
        cr.arc(rcx, rcy, rR, a0, a0 + 2 * math.pi * 1.04 * wp)
        cr.stroke()

    # his bit: he points at SOMEDAY, climbs the calendar and tears the old pages
    # off, drags the marker around THIS YEAR, then drops down and takes it in
    if u < 0.1:
        role, hx, fy = "point", 170, 1480
    elif u < 0.25:
        c = ease(seg(u, 0.1, 0.25))
        role, hx, fy = "climb", 170 + 120 * c, 1480 - 780 * c
    elif u < 0.5:
        role, hx, fy = "strain", 290, 700
    elif u < 0.82:
        ang = a0 + 2 * math.pi * 1.04 * wp
        role = "hold_up"
        hx = rcx + rR * math.cos(ang) - 30
        fy = rcy + rR * math.sin(ang) + 120
        if u < 0.52:
            k = seg(u, 0.5, 0.52)
            hx, fy = 290 + (hx - 290) * k, 700 + (fy - 700) * k
    else:
        d = ease(seg(u, 0.82, 0.9))
        ang = a0 + 2 * math.pi * 1.04
        sx = rcx + rR * math.cos(ang) - 30
        sy = rcy + rR * math.sin(ang) + 120
        role = "hold_up" if d < 1 else "think"
        hx = sx + (880 - sx) * d
        fy = sy + (1480 - sy) * d - 90 * math.sin(math.pi * d)
    host(role, hx, min(fy, 1490), 210)

    # text AFTER him: only the page on top shows its title
    text(cr, top_label, px0 + pw / 2, py0 + 80, 58, (250, 246, 240), face="display",
         anchor="center", shadow=False)
    if wp > 0:
        cr.save()
        cr.rectangle(0, 0, px0 + 60 + (pw - 120) * clamp(wp * 1.2), H)
        cr.clip()
        text(cr, "BOOK", rcx, rcy - 10, 96, P["redline"], face="display",
             anchor="center", shadow=False)
        text(cr, "SCREENING", rcx, rcy + 80, 66, P["redline"], face="display",
             anchor="center", shadow=False)
        cr.restore()

    # the pages he has torn off, falling blank-side down past him
    for i, (label, band, p) in enumerate(pages):
        if p <= 0 or p >= 1:
            continue
        g = p * p                              # it falls, gravity not glide
        cr.save()
        fx = px0 + pw / 2 - (190 - 120 * i) * p
        fy2 = py0 + ph / 2 + (1440 - py0 - ph / 2 + 10 * i) * g
        cr.translate(fx, fy2)
        cr.rotate((-0.5 + 0.3 * i) * p)
        cr.scale(1 - 0.45 * p, 1 - 0.87 * ease(p))
        page(-pw / 2, -ph / 2, band)
        cr.restore()
    for label, band, p in pages:               # torn sheets settle on the floor
        if p >= 1:
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["paper"]))
            cr.save()
            cr.translate(px0 + pw / 2 - 190 + 120 * pages.index((label, band, p)), 1450)
            cr.scale(1, 0.18)
            cr.rectangle(-140, -60, 280, 120)
            cr.fill()
            cr.restore()
    for k in range(3):                         # the binding rings, over it all
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 60, 70)))
        cr.set_line_width(7)
        cr.arc(px0 + 110 + k * 150, py0, 18, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.stroke()

    b = ease(seg(u, 0.78, 0.9))
    if b > 0:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{ratio:g}× the risk",
                    f"{lh.split(':')[0].lower()} vs {ll.split('(')[0].strip().lower()}",
                    80, 560, a=b, size=100)
stories.hook_scene:
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """A fever thermometer for the whole generation: the red column is the
    share of colorectal cancers found under 55. It is already at 1995's mark
    and surging in frame one; Data rides the mercury head, bracing as it
    shoves him up to 2019's mark, holds the top back, and it keeps
    creeping past him anyway."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts[:2]])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    ratio = v1 / v0 if v0 else 0.0
    vmax = max(v0, v1) * 1.2 or 1.0
    # the clinic wall, full height
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (30, 36, 56)), (0.55, (40, 46, 68)), (1.0, (22, 24, 38))], 0, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((52, 58, 82), 0.6))           # wainscot rail
    cr.rectangle(0, 1180, W, 14)
    cr.fill()
    glow(cr, 540, 1060, 520, WARN, 0.18 + 0.12 * ease(seg(u, 0.1, 0.45)))
    cx, top, bot, tw = 540, 760, 1330, 190
    by, br = 1400, 115
    L = bot - top

    def lvl(v):
        return bot - L * v / vmax

    # it is already rising in frame one; slams to 2019; holds; keeps creeping
    rise = ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.42))
    v_now = v0 + (v1 - v0) * rise
    creep = seg(u, 0.58, 1.0)
    head = lvl(v_now) - 40 * creep * creep
    # glass body (back)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((210, 225, 240), 0.16))
    cr.arc(cx, by, br + 18, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()
    cr.rectangle(cx - tw / 2 - 18, top - 40, tw + 36, by - top + 40)
    cr.fill()
    cr.arc(cx, top - 40, tw / 2 + 18, math.pi, 0)
    cr.fill()
    # mercury: bulb + column, with a meniscus that sloshes as it surges
    red = WARN
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(red))
    cr.arc(cx, by, br, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()
    slosh = 10 * math.sin(t * 7) * (1 - seg(u, 0.42, 0.55)) + 4 * math.sin(t * 3) * creep
    cr.move_to(cx - tw / 2, by)
    cr.line_to(cx - tw / 2, head + slosh)
    cr.curve_to(cx - tw / 4, head - 18, cx + tw / 4, head - 18, cx + tw / 2, head - slosh)
    cr.line_to(cx + tw / 2, by)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()
    glow(cr, cx, head, 160, red, 0.35)
    # the two marks etched on the glass
    for (lab, v, a) in ((l0, v0, 1.0), (l1, v1, ease(seg(u, 0.38, 0.5)))):
        y = lvl(v)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(look.INK, 0.85 * a))
        cr.set_line_width(5)
        cr.move_to(cx + tw / 2 + 24, y)
        cr.line_to(cx + tw / 2 + 80, y)
        cr.stroke()
        text(cr, f"{lab} · {int(round(v))}%", cx + tw / 2 + 96, y + 14, 40,
             look.INK, anchor="left", alpha=a)
    # Data rides the mercury head: braced as it shoves him up, holding the
    # top back, then shocked as it keeps climbing under him
    role = ("point" if u < 0.07 else "strain" if u < 0.45 else
            "hold_up" if u < 0.86 else "shock")
    host(role, cx - 10 + 30 * rise, min(head - 6, 1500), 200)
    # glass front: highlight sweeps down the tube
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 255, 255), 0.22))
    cr.rectangle(cx - tw / 2 + 14, top - 30, 16, by - top - 80)
    cr.fill()
    gy = top + (L + 60) * ((t * 0.45) % 1.0)
    glow(cr, cx - tw / 2 + 22, gy, 60, (255, 255, 255), 0.25)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((230, 238, 250), 0.5))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    cr.arc(cx, by, br + 18, -math.pi / 2 + 0.6, 2 * math.pi - math.pi / 2 - 0.6)
    cr.stroke()
    # the readout: 11% already on screen, 20% slams in on arrival
    now = (l1, v1) if u >= 0.42 else (l0, v0)
    fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(now[1]))}%", f"of colorectal cancers under 55 · {now[0]}",
                80, 520, size=130)
    b = pop(seg(u, 0.45, 0.6))
    if b > 0:
        text(cr, f"{ratio:.1f}×", 80, 1010, 110 * b, WARN, face="display",
             anchor="left", alpha=clamp(b))
        text(cr, "nearly double", 80, 1070, 40, look.INK, anchor="left",
             alpha=clamp(b))
    c = ease(seg(u, 0.66, 0.8))
    if c > 0:
        text(cr, "and still rising", 80, 1150, 44, look.INK, anchor="left", alpha=c)

stories.title: Two Cicada Broods Emerged Together For The First Time Since 1803
stories.hook: 13 and 17 just found their one shared year — and it happened in your backyard.
stories.closing: So... will you still be around in 2245?
stories.question: Which cicada brood year were you born into? Tell me below.
stories.caption: Two periodical cicada broods -- one on a 13-year clock, one on a 17-year clock -- emerged together in 2024 for the first time since 1803. Do the math (13 x 17 = 221) and you'll see why it won't happen again until 2245. Which brood year were you born into? 👇

segments.topic: the two cicada broods and their different clocks
segments.say: Brood XIX runs on a 13-year clock. Brood XIII runs on 17. Both cicada broods were due to emerge in 2024 -- and for once, they emerged together.

def _cicada(cr, x, y, s, wing, a=1.0):
    """One cicada seen from above, head up: a nymph shell, and wings once it moults."""
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.scale(s, s)
    if wing > 0:
        for side in (-1, 1):
            cr.save()
            cr.rotate(side * (0.25 + 0.2 * wing))
            cr.scale(0.45, 1.0)
            cr.arc(side * 40, 20, 46 * wing, 0, 2 * math.pi)
            cr.restore()
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((205, 225, 235), 0.55 * a))
            cr.fill_preserve()
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((190, 120, 40), 0.8 * a))
            cr.set_line_width(2)
            cr.stroke()
    cr.save()
    cr.scale(1.0, 1.9)
    cr.arc(0, 8, 18, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((58, 38, 24) if wing > 0 else (150, 104, 58), a))
    cr.fill()
    cr.save()
    cr.scale(1.45, 1.0)
    cr.arc(0, -26, 15, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 28, 20) if wing > 0 else (130, 90, 50), a))
    cr.fill()
    for side in (-1, 1):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((214, 52, 36), a))
        cr.arc(side * 18, -30, 6.5, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()
    cr.restore()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """Two underground clocks: each brood's nymph waits in its chamber while
    a soil dial ticks round — 13 big steps for one, 17 finer steps for the
    other — both close in the same instant, and the two broods break the
    surface together and climb the same oak. Data digs down to them, then
    climbs the trunk beside them."""
    rows = sorted([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts[:2]], key=lambda r: r[1])
    (ls, vs), (ll, vl) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    GROUND = 760
    TX = 830
    ACC = P["accent2"]

    # the world: sky, the oak, the soil the broods live in
    dawn_sky(cr, t, y1=GROUND + 20)
    vgrad(cr, P["dry_soil"], GROUND, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((62, 42, 28), 0.6))
    cr.rectangle(0, GROUND, W, H - GROUND)
    cr.fill()
    for k in range(5):                       # roots reach down toward the broods
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["trunk"], 0.85))
        cr.set_line_width(22 - 3 * k)
        cr.move_to(TX + 20, GROUND)
        cr.curve_to(TX - 60 * k, GROUND + 90, TX - 140 * k, GROUND + 60 + 40 * k,
                    TX - 170 * k + 60, GROUND + 170 + 30 * (k % 2))
        cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["trunk"]))
    cr.rectangle(TX - 55, 170, 110, GROUND - 160)
    cr.fill()
    for k in range(6):                       # bark
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 28, 18), 0.5))
        cr.set_line_width(4)
        bx = TX - 38 + k * 15
        cr.move_to(bx, 200)
        cr.curve_to(bx + 8, 400, bx - 8, 560, bx + 4, GROUND)
        cr.stroke()
    sway = 5 * math.sin(t * 0.6)
    for k, (dx, dy, r) in enumerate([(-190, 120, 150), (0, 40, 200), (170, 110, 160),
                                     (-80, 230, 140), (120, 250, 150)]):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["leaf_shade"] if k % 2 else P["leaf"]))
        cr.arc(TX + dx + sway, dy, r, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["pasture"]))
    cr.rectangle(0, GROUND - 14, W, 26)
    cr.fill()

    # the two clocks: both sweep one full turn in the same time, in their own steps
    tick = seg(u, 0.14, 0.58)
    emerge = ease(seg(u, 0.60, 0.72))
    rise = ease(seg(u, 0.72, 0.90))
    dials = [(280, ls, vs, TX - 70, 470), (800, ll, vl, TX + 70, 560)]
    for cx, lab, n, trunk_x, top_y in dials:
        cy, R = 1090, 190
        steps = int(round(n))
        pn = tick * steps
        k = min(steps, int(pn))
        ang = (k + (ease(clamp((pn - k) * 3.0)) if k < steps else 0.0)) / steps
        done = tick >= 1.0
        if done:
            glow(cr, cx, cy, R * 1.3, ACC, 0.45 * (1 - 0.5 * rise))
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((34, 24, 17)))
        cr.arc(cx, cy, R, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()
        for i in range(steps):               # one notch per year of this brood's clock
            a0 = -math.pi / 2 + 2 * math.pi * i / steps
            lit = i < k
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(ACC if lit else look.INK, 1.0 if lit else 0.3))
            cr.set_line_width(12 if lit else 7)
            cr.move_to(cx + (R - 34) * math.cos(a0), cy + (R - 34) * math.sin(a0))
            cr.line_to(cx + (R - 6) * math.cos(a0), cy + (R - 6) * math.sin(a0))
            cr.stroke()
        ha = -math.pi / 2 + 2 * math.pi * ang
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(look.INK))
        cr.set_line_width(10)
        cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
        cr.move_to(cx, cy)
        cr.line_to(cx + (R - 50) * math.cos(ha), cy + (R - 50) * math.sin(ha))
        cr.stroke()
        if emerge > 0:                       # the tunnel it digs to daylight
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((24, 16, 11), emerge))
            cr.set_line_width(34)
            cr.move_to(cx, cy - R + 10)
            cr.line_to(cx, cy - R + 10 - (cy - R - GROUND + 10) * emerge)
            cr.stroke()
        # the brood: waits curled in the chamber, rises, walks to the oak, climbs, moults
        if rise <= 0:
            bx, by = cx, cy + (GROUND - cy) * emerge
        else:
            walk_f = ease(clamp(rise * 2.2))
            climb_f = ease(clamp(rise * 2.2 - 1.0))
            bx = cx + (trunk_x - cx) * walk_f
            by = GROUND - 10 - (GROUND - 10 - top_y) * climb_f
        _cicada(cr, bx, by, 1.3, ease(seg(u, 0.84, 0.95)))
        ta = 1.0 - 0.6 * rise
        text(cr, f"{n:g} years", cx, cy + R + 60, 64, look.INK, face="display",
             anchor="center", alpha=ta)
        nm = lab.split(" (")[0]
        text(cr, nm, cx, cy + R + 112, fit_size(cr, nm, 38, 420), look.INK_2,
             anchor="center", alpha=ta)

    # Data's bit: points at the ground, digs down to wind the clocks, climbs the oak
    if u < 0.14:
        host("point", 150, GROUND, 210)
    elif u < 0.60:
        host("strain", 150 + 400 * ease(seg(u, 0.14, 0.58)), GROUND, 210)
    elif u < 0.90:
        c = ease(seg(u, 0.62, 0.88))
        host("climb", 550 + 170 * ease(seg(u, 0.60, 0.68)), GROUND - 180 * c, 210)
    else:
        host("cheer", 720, GROUND - 180, 210)

    a1 = ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.08)) * (1 - ease(seg(u, 0.62, 0.70)))
    if a1 > 0:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{vs:g} vs {vl:g} years", "two broods, two underground clocks",
                    80, 520, a=a1, size=120, max_w=620)
    a2 = ease(seg(u, 0.70, 0.78))
    if a2 > 0:
        fit_readout(cr, "Together", "both clocks struck at once: the broods emerge side by side",
                    80, 520, a=a2, size=120, max_w=620)

segments.topic: why cicada broods only line up every 221 years
segments.say: So why is that rare? 13 times 17 equals 221, so these cicada broods only line up every 221 years. The last time was 1803. The next time is 2245.
segments.illustrated_scene:
def _cicada(cr, x, y, ang, s, body, eye, a=1.0):
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.rotate(ang)
    cr.scale(s, s)
    # wings: two translucent blades lying back along the body
    for side in (-1, 1):
        cr.save()
        cr.rotate(side * 0.22)
        cr.scale(1.0, 0.34)
        cr.arc(-26, 0, 40, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["glass"], 0.55 * a))
        cr.fill_preserve()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["log"], 0.7 * a))
        cr.set_line_width(2)
        cr.stroke()
    # body
    cr.save()
    cr.scale(1.0, 0.55)
    cr.arc(-8, 0, 26, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(body, a))
    cr.fill()
    # head and the red eyes
    cr.arc(18, 0, 13, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(body, a))
    cr.fill()
    for side in (-1, 1):
        cr.arc(24, side * 10, 6, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(eye, a))
        cr.fill()
    cr.restore()


def _slice(cr, cx, cy, R, rot):
    # an oak slice: bark rim, heartwood, growth rings, one radial check
    cr.arc(cx, cy, R + 14, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["trunk_far"]))
    cr.fill()
    cr.arc(cx, cy, R, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["stump_top"]))
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for k in range(1, 9):
        cr.arc(cx, cy, R * k / 9.0, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["stump"], 0.55))
        cr.stroke()
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    cr.move_to(cx + 12 * math.cos(rot + 0.3), cy + 12 * math.sin(rot + 0.3))
    cr.line_to(cx + R * 0.92 * math.cos(rot + 0.3), cy + R * 0.92 * math.sin(rot + 0.3))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["crack"], 0.8))
    cr.stroke()
    cr.arc(cx, cy, 22, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass"]))
    cr.fill()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """Why 221: two oak-slice wheels ringed with cicadas — 13 on one, 17 on
    the other — meshed like gears. Data cranks them year by year; the two
    marked cicadas only touch again after 221 turns of the crank, then
    lift off together and land in his hands."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts[:2]]
    (l0, v0) = rows[0]
    (l1, v1) = rows[1] if len(rows) > 1 else rows[0]
    NA, NB = 13, 17
    RA = 200.0
    RB = RA * NB / NA
    cy = 975.0
    ax = 540 - (RA + RB) / 2 - 10
    bx = ax + RA + RB
    contact = (ax + RA, cy)

    # the setting: a summer evening wood, a clearing of bare soil
    vgrad(cr, P["cleared"], 0, H)
    dawn_sky(cr, t, y1=1300)
    for x, d, s_ in _TREES[:34]:
        tree(cr, x, 1290 + 30 * d, 0.55 * s_, P["leaf_far"], P["leaf_far_shade"],
             P["trunk_far"])
    vgrad(cr, P["cleared"], 1270, H)

    # the years turned: a pulsing year-by-year crank (it surges and eases
    # each year but never stops dead), a held beat, then the long time-lapse
    f = NA * seg(u, 0.18, 0.38)
    n = f - 0.8 * math.sin(2 * math.pi * f) / (2 * math.pi)
    n += (v0 - NA) * ease(seg(u, 0.44, 0.78))
    rotA = n * 2 * math.pi / NA
    rotB = -n * 2 * math.pi / NB

    # the crank Data turns, chained to the hub of the 13 wheel
    kx, ky = 400.0, 1395.0
    cr.set_line_width(7)
    cr.set_dash([18, 12], -n * 30.0)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["log"]))
    for off in (-18, 18):
        cr.move_to(kx + off, ky)
        cr.line_to(ax + off, cy)
        cr.stroke()
    cr.set_dash([])
    cr.rectangle(kx - 46, ky, 92, 90)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["trunk"]))
    cr.fill()
    cr.arc(kx, ky, 30, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass_shade"]))
    cr.fill()
    hx, hy = kx + 46 * math.cos(rotA * 1.5), ky + 46 * math.sin(rotA * 1.5)
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass"]))
    cr.move_to(kx, ky)
    cr.line_to(hx, hy)
    cr.stroke()

    # the two broods, one cicada per year of their cycle
    _slice(cr, ax, cy, RA, rotA)
    _slice(cr, bx, cy, RB, rotB)
    fly = ease(seg(u, 0.84, 0.94))
    meet = pop(seg(u, 0.78, 0.86)) if u >= 0.78 else 0.0
    dark = P["bean"]
    marks = []
    for cx_, R, N, rot, base in ((ax, RA, NA, rotA, 0.0), (bx, RB, NB, rotB, math.pi)):
        for i in range(N):
            ang = base + rot + i * 2 * math.pi / N
            px, py = cx_ + (R - 8) * math.cos(ang), cy + (R - 8) * math.sin(ang)
            if i == 0:
                marks.append((px, py, ang))
                continue
            _cicada(cr, px, py, ang, 0.95, dark, P["redline"], 0.95)

    if meet > 0:
        glow(cr, contact[0], contact[1], 170 * meet, P["sun_glow"], 0.8 * (1 - 0.5 * fly))

    # the marked pair: they meet, then lift off and land in his hands
    handy = 1480 - 250
    for j, (px, py, ang) in enumerate(marks):
        tx_, ty_ = 540 + (-34 if j == 0 else 34), handy
        x_ = px + (tx_ - px) * fly
        y_ = py + (ty_ - py) * fly - 160 * math.sin(math.pi * fly)
        a_ = ang + (-math.pi / 2 - ang) * fly
        glow(cr, x_, y_, 70, P["accent2"], 0.55)
        _cicada(cr, x_, y_, a_, 1.05, P["accent2"], P["redline"])

    # Data's bit: points at the wheels, cranks the years through, then
    # catches the pair that finally line up and cheers the moment they land
    walk1 = ease(seg(u, 0.04, 0.18))
    walk2 = ease(seg(u, 0.80, 0.86))
    x = 150 + (kx - 70 - 150) * walk1 + (540 - (kx - 70)) * walk2
    moving = (0.04 < u < 0.18) or (0.80 < u < 0.86)
    if u < 0.12:
        role = "point"
    elif u < 0.80:
        role = "strain"
    elif u < 0.94:
        role = "hold_up"
    else:
        role = "cheer"
    host(role, x, 1480, 220, pace=moving)

    # the readout: the sourced 221, never a running count — first the
    # wait since 1803, then (after the first has fully gone) the wait ahead
    small0 = l0.split(" (")[0].lower()
    small1 = l1.split(" (")[0].lower()
    if u < 0.80:
        a0 = ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.08)) * (1 - ease(seg(u, 0.74, 0.80)))
        if a0 > 0:
            fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v0))} years", small0, 80, 520,
                        a=a0, size=140)
    elif u >= 0.82:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v1))} years", small1, 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.82, 0.87)), rgb=P["accent2"], size=140)

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """One staked acre of woodland floor. First the ordinary acre: a handful
    of cicadas land on the leaf litter, one per 500 bugs. Then Data grabs the
    litter and strains to roll it back like a carpet across the whole acre,
    and underneath it is the prime-habitat swarm at the same scale, each bug
    popping up as the roll passes. The readout names only the two sourced
    densities — the ordinary acre, then the prime acre the roll uncovers —
    and he ends at the far stake, shocked at how much more there is."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts[:2]]
    (lp, vp), (ls, vs) = rows if rows[0][1] >= rows[1][1] else rows[::-1]
    vs = vs or 1.0
    per = vs / 6.0                                   # bugs per drawn cicada
    n_swarm = int(min(3200, vp / per))

    # the backdrop runs the full height of the frame
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (120, 170, 200)), (0.35, (196, 214, 190)), (0.45, (92, 120, 70)),
               (1, (48, 64, 38))], 0, H)
    for x, d, s_ in _TREES[:36]:
        tree(cr, x, 830 + 30 * d, 0.5 * s_, P["leaf_far"], P["leaf_far_shade"],
             P["trunk_far"])

    top, bot = 830.0, 1470.0
    ht, hb = 360.0, 520.0

    def px(f, y):
        k = (y - top) / (bot - top)
        return W / 2 + (f - 0.5) * 2 * (ht + (hb - ht) * k)

    def py(g):
        return top + (bot - top) * g

    # the acre: leaf litter inside four stakes and a rope
    cr.move_to(px(0, top), top)
    cr.line_to(px(1, top), top)
    cr.line_to(px(1, bot), bot)
    cr.line_to(px(0, bot), bot)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((132, 96, 52)))
    cr.fill()

    # the roll: Data peels the litter back across the acre
    f = ease(seg(u, 0.3, 0.84))

    cr.save()
    cr.move_to(px(0, top), top)
    cr.line_to(px(f, top), top)
    cr.line_to(px(f, bot), bot)
    cr.line_to(px(0, bot), bot)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.clip()
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (70, 52, 34)), (1, (52, 38, 24))], top, bot)
    cr.restore()

    for i in range(60):                               # litter leaves not yet rolled
        lf = (i * 0.382 + 0.07) % 1.0
        lg = (i * 0.618 + 0.21) % 1.0
        if lf < f:
            continue
        lx, ly = px(lf, py(lg)), py(lg)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((168, 118, 60) if i % 2 else (110, 78, 40)))
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(lx, ly)
        cr.rotate(i * 1.3)
        cr.scale(1.0, 0.45)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 10 + 8 * lg, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.fill()

    # the swarm under the litter: each cicada stands for the same number of bugs
    for i in range(n_swarm):
        fx = (i * 0.61803398875 + 0.03) % 1.0
        fy = (i * 0.7548776662 + 0.13) % 1.0
        if fx > f - 0.005:
            continue
        sp = pop(clamp((f - fx) / 0.05))
        y = py(0.02 + 0.96 * fy)
        x = px(0.02 + 0.96 * fx, y)
        _cicada(cr, x, y, (3.2 + 3.4 * fy) * sp, (i * 2.399) % 6.283)

    # the ordinary acre: six cicadas land one at a time
    six = [(0.2, 0.3), (0.72, 0.18), (0.46, 0.58), (0.84, 0.74), (0.14, 0.82), (0.6, 0.9)]
    for k, (fx, fy) in enumerate(six):
        land = ease(seg(u, 0.03 + k * 0.035, 0.09 + k * 0.035))
        if land <= 0:
            continue
        y = py(fy)
        x = px(fx, y)
        _cicada(cr, x + 220 * (1 - land), y - 360 * (1 - land), 13 + 6 * fy, 0.4 * (1 - land),
                wing=0.25 * (1 - land) + 0.04 * math.sin(t * 3 + k))

    # the rolled-up litter itself, a log of leaves along the peel line
    if 0 < f < 1:
        cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((96, 66, 34)))
        cr.set_line_width(46)
        cr.move_to(px(f, top), top)
        cr.line_to(px(f, bot), bot)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((176, 128, 66)))
        cr.set_line_width(18)
        cr.move_to(px(f, top) + 6, top)
        cr.line_to(px(f, bot) + 8, bot - 6)
        cr.stroke()

    # the stakes and rope that mark off the acre
    corners = [(px(0, top), top), (px(1, top), top), (px(1, bot), bot), (px(0, bot), bot)]
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((235, 222, 190), 0.85))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    for j in range(4):
        (ax, ay), (bx, by) = corners[j], corners[(j + 1) % 4]
        cr.move_to(ax, ay - 30)
        cr.line_to(bx, by - 30)
        cr.stroke()
    for cx_, cy_ in corners:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 84, 50)))
        cr.rectangle(cx_ - 7, cy_ - 50, 14, 58)
        cr.fill()

    # his bit: he points at the sparse acre, thinks, grabs the litter and
    # strains to roll it across the whole plot, then takes in the swarm
    if u < 0.14:
        role, hx = "point", 110
    elif u < 0.3:
        role, hx = "think", 110
    elif u < 0.86:
        role, hx = "strain", clamp(px(f, bot) - 60, 110, 960)
    else:
        role, hx = "shock", 960
    host(role, hx, 1505, 215)

    # readouts: only the two sourced densities, each held long enough to read
    if u < 0.3:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(vs)):,}", f"cicadas per acre · {ls.lower()}", 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.08)), size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(vp)):,}", f"cicadas per acre · {lp.lower()}", 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.3, 0.37)), size=130)
    b = ease(seg(u, 0.84, 0.92))
    if b > 0:
        text(cr, f"{vp / vs:,.0f}× as many", W - 80, 750, 72, P["accent2"], face="display",
             anchor="right", alpha=b)

def _shell(cr, x, y, s, a=1.0, rot=0.0):
    """One empty cicada shell (the exuvia a nymph leaves on the bark)."""
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.rotate(rot)
    cr.scale(s, s)
    cr.save()
    cr.scale(1.0, 1.45)

    cr.restore()

    cr.fill()

    cr.move_to(0, -11)
    cr.line_to(0, 11)
    for sd in (-1, 1):
        cr.move_to(sd * 7, -4)
        cr.line_to(sd * 15, -11)

def _bucket(cr, x, y, rot, a=1.0):

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """The closing: the same dusk backyard, the chorus over. Data gathers
    what the swarm left behind — empty shells — into one big glass jar,
    one shell per typical wooded acre. A prime acre fills it that many
    times over. He screws the lid on like a time capsule, climbs down and
    sits with it, wondering who opens the next one."""
    rows = sorted([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts], key=lambda r: r[1])
    (lt, vt), (lp, vp) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    vt = vt if vt > 0 else 1.0
    n = max(1, min(1500, int(round(vp / vt))))

    # --- the backyard at dusk, going to night
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (30, 28, 72)), (0.55, (128, 76, 112)), (1.0, (232, 146, 98))], 0, 1200)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((12, 12, 34), 0.35 * ease(seg(u, 0.5, 1.0))))
    cr.rectangle(0, 0, W, 1200)
    cr.fill()
    my = 380 - 60 * ease(u)
    glow(cr, 860, my, 150, (250, 236, 200), 0.35)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((246, 238, 214)))
    cr.arc(860, my, 46, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()
    # the fence
    for i in range(14):
        fx = 10 + i * 80
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((66, 50, 58)))
        cr.move_to(fx, 1190)
        cr.line_to(fx, 1040)
        cr.line_to(fx + 30, 1016)
        cr.line_to(fx + 60, 1040)
        cr.line_to(fx + 60, 1190)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.fill()
    cr.rectangle(0, 1070, W, 18)
    cr.rectangle(0, 1140, W, 18)
    cr.fill()
    # the lawn
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (74, 112, 62)), (1.0, (28, 52, 34))], 1170, H)
    # porch light spilling onto the grass
    glow(cr, 40, 1180, 420, (255, 206, 130), 0.28 + 0.04 * math.sin(t * 1.3))
    # the two holes they climbed out of
    for hx in (150, 990):
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(hx, 1620)
        cr.scale(1.0, 0.35)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 44, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((24, 18, 14)))
        cr.fill()
    for i in range(60):
        gx = (i * 97) % W
        gy = 1200 + (i * 53) % 700
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((110, 150, 80), 0.8))
        cr.set_line_width(4)
        cr.move_to(gx, gy)
        cr.line_to(gx + 5 * math.sin(t * 1.6 + i), gy - 22)
        cr.stroke()

    # --- the jar (the hero)
    jx0, jx1, jt, jb = 290, 790, 740, 1440
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(540, jb + 6)
    cr.scale(1.0, 0.16)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 280, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((10, 20, 12), 0.5))
    cr.fill()

    def jar_path():
        r = 46
        cr.new_path()
        cr.move_to(jx0 + r, jt)
        cr.line_to(jx1 - r, jt)
        cr.arc(jx1 - r, jt + r, r, -math.pi / 2, 0)
        cr.line_to(jx1, jb - r)
        cr.arc(jx1 - r, jb - r, r, 0, math.pi / 2)
        cr.line_to(jx0 + r, jb)
        cr.arc(jx0 + r, jb - r, r, math.pi / 2, math.pi)
        cr.line_to(jx0, jt + r)
        cr.arc(jx0 + r, jt + r, r, math.pi, 1.5 * math.pi)
        cr.close_path()

    jar_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((190, 220, 230), 0.16))
    cr.fill()

    # the fill: three pours, each held so it can be read
    f = (0.3 * ease(seg(u, 0.30, 0.40)) + 0.35 * ease(seg(u, 0.46, 0.58))
         + 0.35 * ease(seg(u, 0.64, 0.76)))
    cf = max(1.0, n * f)
    cols = 20
    nrows = max(1, (n + cols - 1) // cols)
    cw = (jx1 - jx0 - 24) / cols
    ch = min(28.0, (jb - jt - 30) / nrows)
    ss = min(cw / 22.0, ch / 28.0) * 1.05
    cr.save()
    jar_path()
    cr.clip()
    for i in range(min(n, int(cf) + 6)):
        arr = clamp((cf - i) / 6.0)
        if arr <= 0:
            continue
        r_, c_ = divmod(i, cols)
        tx = jx0 + 12 + cw * (c_ + 0.5) + (r_ % 2) * cw * 0.22
        ty = jb - 10 - ch * (r_ + 0.5)
        fall = 1.0 - arr
        yy = ty - (ty - (jt - 20)) * fall * fall
        _shell(cr, tx, yy, ss, rot=0.5 * math.sin(i * 1.7))
    cr.restore()
    # glass rim and shine
    jar_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((230, 244, 250), 0.55))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 255, 255), 0.22))
    cr.rectangle(jx0 + 30, jt + 40, 22, jb - jt - 120)
    cr.fill()
    cr.rectangle(jx0 + 24, jt - 18, jx1 - jx0 - 48, 22)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((200, 226, 236), 0.4))
    cr.fill()

    # the lid comes down and is screwed on
    la = ease(seg(u, 0.79, 0.87))
    if la > 0:
        ly = 620 + (jt - 30 - 620) * la
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass"], la))
        cr.rectangle(jx0 + 16, ly, jx1 - jx0 - 32, 34)
        cr.fill()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass_shade"], la))
        for k in range(12):
            cr.rectangle(jx0 + 30 + k * 38, ly + 4, 6, 26)
        cr.fill()

    # --- the ladder
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 104, 62)))
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    for lx in (850, 930):
        cr.move_to(lx, 1450)
        cr.line_to(lx, 930)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_line_width(7)
    for k in range(7):
        ry = 1420 - k * 78
        cr.move_to(850, ry)
        cr.line_to(930, ry)
    cr.stroke()

    # --- Data's bit
    ax = ease(seg(u, 0.15, 0.23))
    ay = ease(seg(u, 0.21, 0.30))
    down = ease(seg(u, 0.88, 0.97))
    x = 170 + 720 * ax
    fy = 1500 - 570 * ay + 570 * down
    pouring = (0.30 < u < 0.40) or (0.46 < u < 0.58) or (0.64 < u < 0.76)
    if u < 0.15:
        role = "point"
    elif u < 0.30:
        role = "climb"
    elif u < 0.79:
        role = "strain" if pouring else "hold_up"
    elif u < 0.88:
        role = "hold_up"
    elif u < 0.96:
        role = "climb"
    else:
        role = "think"
    host(role, x, fy, 210)
    if 0.28 < u < 0.79:
        bx, by = x - 80, fy - 200
        _bucket(cr, bx, by, -1.1 if pouring else -0.15,
                a=ease(seg(u, 0.28, 0.31)) * (1 - ease(seg(u, 0.77, 0.79))))
        if pouring:
            top = jb - 10 - ch * (cf / cols)
            for k in range(6):
                q = (t * 1.1 + k / 6.0) % 1.0
                sx = bx - 30 + (600 - (bx - 30)) * q
                sy = by + (top - by) * q * q
                _shell(cr, sx, sy, ss, rot=q * 4 + k)

    # --- readouts: only the two sourced densities, each held long enough to read
    a0 = ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.08))
    if u < 0.70:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(vt)):,}", f"cicadas · {lt.lower()}", 80, 520,
                    a=a0, size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(vp)):,}", f"cicadas · {lp.lower()}", 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.70, 0.74)), size=130)
    text(cr, f"1 shell = {int(round(vt)):,} · {lt.lower()}", 540, 1488, 34,
         look.INK, anchor="center", alpha=ease(seg(u, 0.04, 0.14)))
    b = ease(seg(u, 0.82, 0.88))
    if b > 0:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{n}× a typical acre", "sealed in one jar", W / 2, 640,
                    anchor="center", a=b, rgb=P["accent2"], size=60)

def _cicada(cr, x, y, ang, s, wing, a=1.0):
    """A periodical cicada drawn from paths: (x, y) is the abdomen tip,
    the body runs along ang, wing 0..1 spreads the wings."""
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.rotate(ang + math.pi / 2)
    cr.scale(s, s)
    body = (38, 30, 24)
    for side in (-1, 1):                          # wings behind the body
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(8 * side, -225)

        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((190, 215, 230), 0.45 * a))

    cr.translate(0, -95)

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """The hook: dusk in an ordinary backyard, and out of two holes in the
    lawn a 13-year cicada and a 17-year cicada are ALREADY climbing out at
    once. The 17 is the slower one — Data strains to haul it up — then the
    two crawl head to head and spread their wings in their one shared year,
    while Data props them up from below. 13 x 17 is the wait."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts[:2]]
    rows = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    lo, hi = rows[0][1], rows[-1][1]
    every = lo * hi

    # the backyard at dusk
    dawn_sky(cr, t, y1=1000)
    rowhouse(cr, 600, 420, 300, 1000, P["brick"], P["brick_shade"], t=t)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((238, 226, 204)))       # the picket fence
    for i in range(14):
        fx = 10 + i * 80
        if 600 < fx < 1020:
            continue
        cr.rectangle(fx, 880, 44, 120)
        cr.fill()
        cr.move_to(fx, 880)
        cr.line_to(fx + 22, 856)
        cr.line_to(fx + 44, 880)
        cr.fill()
    cr.rectangle(0, 912, 600, 14)
    cr.fill()
    g = cairo.LinearGradient(0, 990, 0, H)         # the lawn, full bleed
    g.add_color_stop_rgb(0, 0.30, 0.50, 0.24)
    g.add_color_stop_rgb(0.5, 0.20, 0.38, 0.17)
    g.add_color_stop_rgb(1, 0.10, 0.20, 0.10)
    cr.set_source(g)
    cr.rectangle(0, 990, W, H - 990)
    cr.fill()
    for i in range(46):                            # grass tufts, rooted
        gx = (i * 157) % W
        gy = 1060 + (i * 83) % 460
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["pasture_lit"], 0.8))
        cr.set_line_width(4)
        cr.move_to(gx, gy)
        cr.line_to(gx + 5 * math.sin(t * 1.2 + i), gy - 26)
        cr.stroke()

    holes = [(300.0, 1250.0), (780.0, 1250.0)]
    for hx, hy in holes:                           # the emergence holes
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((92, 64, 40)))
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(hx, hy + 6)
        cr.scale(1.0, 0.36)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 105, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.fill()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((22, 14, 10)))
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(hx, hy)
        cr.scale(1.0, 0.32)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 66, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.fill()

    # both are already coming out on frame 1; the 17 lags
    out_l = 0.45 + 0.55 * ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.24))
    out_r = 0.25 + 0.75 * ease(seg(u, 0.05, 0.42))
    meet = ease(seg(u, 0.48, 0.7))
    spread = ease(seg(u, 0.72, 0.82))
    s = 1.15
    L = 312 * s
    tilt = 0.45 * meet
    bugs = []
    for k, (hx, hy) in enumerate(holes):
        side = 1 if k == 0 else -1
        out = out_l if k == 0 else out_r
        bx = hx + side * 100 * meet
        by = hy - 50 * meet + L * (1 - out)
        ang = -math.pi / 2 + side * tilt
        bugs.append((bx, by, ang))
    glow(cr, 540, 890, 60 + 240 * meet, P["sun_glow"], 0.55 * meet)
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(0, 0, W, 1256)                    # still inside the ground
    cr.clip()
    for bx, by, ang in bugs:
        _cicada(cr, bx, by, ang, s, spread)
    cr.restore()

    # his bit: shock at the holes, haul the slow 17 out, then prop the pair
    walk_in = ease(seg(u, 0.42, 0.62))
    if u < 0.07:
        role = "shock"
    elif u < 0.42:
        role = "strain"
    elif u < 0.86:
        role = "hold_up"
    else:
        role = "cheer"
    hx_ = 900 - 360 * walk_in
    fy_ = 1330 + 160 * walk_in
    host(role, hx_, fy_, 220, pace=0.42 < u < 0.62)

    # each brood's clock on its back — drawn AFTER Data so he never covers it
    for k, (bx, by, ang) in enumerate(bugs):
        v = lo if k == 0 else hi
        ax = bx + 115 * s * math.cos(ang)
        ay = by + 115 * s * math.sin(ang)
        if ay < 1235:
            text(cr, f"{v:.0f}", ax, ay + 22, 64, (242, 245, 250),
                 face="display", anchor="center")

    fit_readout(cr, f"{lo:.0f} × {hi:.0f}", "years apart · one shared year",
                80, 520, size=150)
    b = ease(seg(u, 0.62, 0.74))
    if b > 0:
        fit_readout(cr, f"every {every:.0f} years", "your backyard, this time",
                    W / 2, 730, anchor="center", a=b, rgb=P["accent2"], size=72)
