segments.say: In 1990, the under-5 mortality rate was 93.5 per thousand live births. By 2024 it fell to 37.4 — a 60 percent drop in one generation.
segments.illustrated_scene:
def _kid(cr, x, y, s, col, a):
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(col, a))
    cr.move_to(x - 16 * s, y)
    cr.line_to(x - 12 * s, y - 38 * s)
    cr.curve_to(x - 12 * s, y - 50 * s, x + 12 * s, y - 50 * s, x + 12 * s, y - 38 * s)
    cr.line_to(x + 16 * s, y)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()
    cr.arc(x, y - 62 * s, 13 * s, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """One crowd of children born on a hillside at dawn. A dark curtain drops
    over the share who do not reach five, cut at the true rate per thousand.
    Data hauls the curtain back year by year, and each drop frees children
    from behind it: one walks out into the sunlit foreground for every one
    fewer death per thousand."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in by_time([(l, v) for l, v in pts])]
    n = len(rows)
    X0, X1 = 90.0, 990.0

    # the years: each step is a haul (the curtain moves) followed by the
    # freed children walking out, so the story keeps arriving
    a0, a1 = 0.18, 0.9
    steps = max(1, n - 1)
    L = (a1 - a0) / steps
    v = rows[0][1]
    cur = 0
    for i in range(n - 1):
        w0 = a0 + i * L
        f = ease(seg(u, w0, w0 + 0.5 * L))
        if f > 0:
            v = rows[i][1] + (rows[i + 1][1] - rows[i][1]) * f
        if f >= 0.999:
            cur = i + 1
    edge = X1 - (X1 - X0) * (v / 1000.0)      # true proportion of the whole crowd

    # the world: dawn over a hill, the sun climbing as the rate falls
    vgrad(cr, P["cleared"], 0, H)
    dawn_sky(cr, t, y1=1000)
    sun_y = 760 - 140 * ease(seg(u, 0.1, 0.95))
    glow(cr, 760, sun_y, 380, P["sun_glow"], 0.35 + 0.35 * ease(seg(u, 0.2, 0.9)))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["pasture"]))
    cr.move_to(0, 780)
    cr.curve_to(300, 700, 700, 720, W, 760)
    cr.line_to(W, H)
    cr.line_to(0, H)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["pasture_lit"], 0.5))
    cr.move_to(0, 1460)
    cr.curve_to(400, 1430, 700, 1450, W, 1440)
    cr.line_to(W, H)
    cr.line_to(0, H)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()

    # the whole: one crowd of children, back rows small, front rows large
    alive = (214, 206, 190)
    lost = P["accent2"]
    for r in range(9):
        y = 810 + r * 72
        s = 0.95 + r * 0.11
        step = 36 * s
        m = int((X1 - X0) / step)
        for c in range(m + 1):
            j = ((c * 7919 + r * 104729) % 97) / 97.0
            j2 = ((c * 3301 + r * 7727) % 89) / 89.0
            x = X0 + c * step + (j - 0.5) * step * 0.7 + (r % 2) * step * 0.4
            if x < X0 or x > X1:
                continue
            sv = s * (0.82 + 0.3 * j2)
            b = clamp((edge - x) / 26.0)
            col = tuple(int(lo + (hi - lo) * b) for lo, hi in zip(lost, alive))
            _kid(cr, x, y + 30, sv, col, 0.95)

    # the curtain over the lost share: it drops in, then Data hauls it back
    drop = ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.12))
    bottom = 760 + 680 * drop
    sway = 6 * math.sin(t * 1.3)
    if drop > 0:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((22, 18, 38), 0.62))
        cr.move_to(edge + sway, 760)
        cr.curve_to(edge - 8, 760 + (bottom - 760) * 0.35,
                    edge + 10 + sway, 760 + (bottom - 760) * 0.7, edge, bottom)
        cr.line_to(W, bottom)
        cr.line_to(W, 760)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.fill()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 52, 84), 0.6))
        cr.set_line_width(3)
        for q in range(3):
            fx = edge + 18 + q * 22
            if fx < W:
                cr.move_to(fx + sway * 0.6, 770)
                cr.line_to(fx, bottom - 10)
                cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass"]))
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    cr.move_to(X0 - 20, 756)
    cr.line_to(W, 756)
    cr.stroke()

    # the freed: one child per death-per-thousand avoided walks out of the
    # dark into the sunlit foreground, and stays there
    freed_col = (250, 228, 176)
    slot = 0
    for i in range(n - 1):
        w0 = a0 + i * L
        m = max(0, int(round(rows[i][1] - rows[i + 1][1])))
        for j in range(m):
            st = w0 + 0.15 * L + 0.3 * L * (j / max(1, m))
            q = ease(seg(u, st, st + 0.55 * L))
            if q <= 0:
                slot += 1
                continue
            sx = edge - 10 - (j % 3) * 14
            sy = 1000 + (j * 137 + i * 61) % 400
            col_ = slot % 26
            row_ = slot // 26
            dx = 120 + col_ * 24 + (row_ % 2) * 12
            dy = 1462 + row_ * 20
            x = sx + (dx - sx) * q
            y = sy + (dy - sy) * q
            hop = 10 * abs(math.sin(q * math.pi * 5)) if q < 1 else 0.0
            _kid(cr, x, y - hop, 0.9 + 0.3 * q, freed_col, 0.97)
            slot += 1

    # Data's bit: he points at the dark from the left, walks to the
    # curtain's edge, hauls it back on a rope year by year, then cheers
    walk_in = ease(seg(u, 0.06, 0.18))
    hx = 260 + (edge - 60 - 260) * walk_in
    if u < 0.18:
        role = "point"
    elif u < 0.9:
        role = "strain"
    else:
        role = "cheer"
    if 0.18 <= u < 0.9:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass"]))
        cr.set_line_width(5)
        cr.move_to(hx + 20, 1480 - 130)
        cr.curve_to(hx + 50, 1320, edge - 10, 1260, edge + sway * 0.5, 1180)
        cr.stroke()
    host(role, hx, 1480, 220, pace=(0.06 <= u < 0.18))

    # readouts: only landed years are printed
    yl, yv = rows[cur]
    fit_readout(cr, f"{yv:.1f}", f"under-5 deaths per thousand births · {yl}", 80, 470,
                a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.08)), size=140)
    if n >= 2:
        v0, vn = rows[0][1], rows[-1][1]
        pct = int(round((v0 - vn) / v0 * 100)) if v0 else 0
        b = ease(seg(u, 0.9, 0.97))
        if b > 0:
            text(cr, f"-{pct}%", W - 80, 640, 96, P["accent2"], face="display",
                 anchor="right", alpha=b)
            text(cr, f"since {rows[0][0]}", W - 80, 700, 40, look.INK,
                 anchor="right", alpha=b)

segments.topic: the fix behind falling child mortality: immunization
segments.say: The fix wasn't fancy. DPT immunization coverage climbed from 17 percent in 1980 to 85 percent of kids today — one shot, given almost everywhere.
segments.illustrated_scene:
def _vial_path(cr, x, y, w, h, r):
    cr.new_sub_path()
    cr.arc(x + w - r, y + r, r, -math.pi / 2, 0)
    cr.arc(x + w - r, y + h - r, r, 0, math.pi / 2)
    cr.arc(x + r, y + h - r, r, math.pi / 2, math.pi)
    cr.arc(x + r, y + r, r, math.pi, 1.5 * math.pi)
    cr.close_path()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """One vial holds every child aged 12-23 months. The DPT dose fills it
    year by year at the true coverage. Each year it rises in a step, then
    holds briefly while that year's mark is etched onto the glass at its
    level, so the climb leaves a readable ladder of years. Years where
    coverage did not move are one step, labelled as a span, so the scene
    never sits frozen on a flat stretch. Data rides the rising dose. He
    strains it up at each rise and holds it up while it holds. At the end he
    leaps down to the street to cheer."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]) or [("", 0.0)]
    steps = []
    for l, v in rows:
        if steps and abs(steps[-1][1] - v) < 0.05:
            steps[-1] = (steps[-1][0].split("–")[0] + "–" + l, v)
        else:
            steps.append((l, v))
    n = len(steps)
    VX, VW, VT, VH = 310, 460, 720, 700
    VB = VT + VH

    dawn_sky(cr, t, y1=1120)
    vgrad(cr, P["cleared"], 1100, H)
    rowhouse(cr, -20, 250, 440, 1440, P["brick"], P["brick_shade"], t=t)
    rowhouse(cr, 850, 250, 380, 1440, P["brick_cool"], P["brick_cool_shade"], t=t)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["curb"]))
    cr.rectangle(0, 1436, W, 14)
    cr.fill()

    # one step lands per slot: the dose rises, the year is etched, a short hold
    a0, a1 = 0.12, 0.80
    slots = max(1, n - 1)
    if n == 1:
        k, f, g = 0, 1.0, 1.0
    elif u >= a1:
        k, f, g = slots - 1, 1.0, 1.0
    elif u < a0:
        k, f, g = 0, 0.0, 0.0
    else:
        p = clamp((u - a0) / (a1 - a0)) * slots
        k = min(int(p), slots - 1)
        q = p - k
        f = ease(clamp(q / 0.6))
        g = ease(clamp((q - 0.6) / 0.25))
    v0 = steps[k][1]
    v1 = steps[min(k + 1, n - 1)][1]
    first_fill = ease(seg(u, 0.02, 0.11))
    val = (v0 + (v1 - v0) * f) if u >= a0 else steps[0][1] * first_fill
    rising = (u < a0 and first_fill < 1) or (0 < f < 1 and abs(v1 - v0) > 0.05)
    kk = min(k + 1, n - 1) if (u >= a0 and f >= 1) else k
    year, shown = steps[kk]

    # the vial: its shadow, the cap, the glass
    cr.set_source_rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22)
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(540, VB + 18)
    cr.scale(1.0, 0.12)
    cr.arc(0, 0, VW * 0.6, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass_shade"]))
    cr.rectangle(540 - 120, VT - 70, 240, 76)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass"]))
    cr.rectangle(540 - 110, VT - 66, 220, 30)
    cr.fill()

    _vial_path(cr, VX, VT, VW, VH, 60)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["glass"], 0.35))
    cr.fill()

    frac = clamp(val / 100.0)
    surf = VB - VH * frac
    cr.save()
    _vial_path(cr, VX, VT, VW, VH, 60)
    cr.clip()
    amp = 6 + 10 * (1.0 if rising else 0.0)
    cr.move_to(VX, VB + 10)
    for i in range(0, 25):
        x = VX + VW * i / 24.0
        cr.line_to(x, surf + amp * math.sin(t * 2.4 + i * 0.6))
    cr.line_to(VX + VW, VB + 10)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"]))
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(1, 1, 1, 0.16)            # a highlight down the glass
    cr.rectangle(VX + 40, VT + 30, 34, VH - 60)
    cr.fill()
    cr.restore()
    _vial_path(cr, VX, VT, VW, VH, 60)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(look.INK, 0.85))
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    cr.stroke()

    # Data points at the vial, jumps onto the dose, rides it up, leaps down
    ride_x, ride_y = VX + VW - 110, surf
    j = ease(seg(u, 0.05, 0.12))
    hx = 930 + (ride_x - 930) * j
    hy = 1440 + (ride_y - 1440) * j - 160 * math.sin(math.pi * j)
    jd = ease(seg(u, 0.86, 0.94))
    if jd > 0:
        hx = ride_x + (900 - ride_x) * jd
        hy = ride_y + (1440 - ride_y) * jd - 140 * math.sin(math.pi * jd)
    if u < 0.05:
        role = "point"
    elif j < 1:
        role = "climb"
    elif u >= 0.86:
        role = "cheer"
    elif rising:
        role = "strain"
    else:
        role = "hold_up"
    host(role, hx, hy, 200)

    # the ladder of years etched on the glass, each at its true level
    for i, (lab, v) in enumerate(steps):
        if i == 0:
            s_ = ease(seg(u, 0.09, 0.14))
        elif u >= a1 or (i - 1) < k or ((i - 1) == k and f >= 1 and u >= a0):
            s_ = 1.0 if (u >= a1 or (i - 1) < k) else g
        else:
            s_ = 0.0
        if s_ <= 0:
            continue
        ty = VB - VH * clamp(v / 100.0)
        reach = 150 if i % 2 else 20
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(look.INK, 0.8 * s_))
        cr.set_line_width(4)
        cr.move_to(VX + 4, ty)
        cr.line_to(VX + 4 - (reach + 4) * s_, ty)
        cr.stroke()
        text(cr, lab, VX - reach - 4 + 60 * (1 - s_), ty + 12, 34, look.INK,
             anchor="right", alpha=s_)

    # every label goes on after Data, so he never stands in front of text
    text(cr, "DPT", 540, VT - 90, 44, look.INK, anchor="center",
         alpha=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.1)))
    fit_readout(cr, f"{shown:.0f}%", f"of kids got the DPT shot · {year}", 80, 470,
                a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.08)), size=130)
    b = ease(seg(u, 0.82, 0.9))
    if b > 0 and len(rows) > 1:
        fit_readout(cr, f"+{rows[-1][1] - rows[0][1]:.0f} points",
                    f"since {rows[0][0]}", W / 2, 1180, anchor="center", a=b,
                    rgb=look.INK, size=90, max_w=420)

segments.topic: health spending behind the falling child mortality
segments.say: And the world backed it with money — health spending rose from 8.6 percent of global GDP in 2000 to 10.1 percent by 2023, funding the shot.
segments.illustrated_scene:
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """Inside a vault: the world's whole economy is ONE brick of banknotes and
    the health slice is cut off its left end at the true share of GDP. The
    camera pushes in on the cut until one point of GDP is a hand's width.
    Then, year by year, Data walks out onto the rest of the brick, heaves a
    bundle of notes off it and carries it back to the cut. When he shoves it
    in, the bright health slab grows by that year's gain. In the dip year he
    hauls a bundle back out the other way. The 2000 slab stays dark and every
    added bundle is bright, so the rise reads as money he physically moved.
    Every label is drawn AFTER Data, so he never stands in front of words."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    n = len(rows)
    r0lab, r0 = rows[0]

    # ---- the vault: stone wall and floor, full height
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (34, 38, 58)), (1.0, (20, 22, 36))], 0, 1440)
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (58, 50, 48)), (1.0, (30, 26, 28))], 1440, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((86, 74, 68)))
    cr.rectangle(0, 1440, W, 8)
    cr.fill()
    glow(cr, 540, 700, 520, (70, 80, 120), 0.35)

    # ---- camera: the whole brick first, then push in on the health end
    z = ease(seg(u, 0.1, 0.2))
    pxpt = math.exp(math.log(9.0) + z * math.log(76.0 / 9.0))

    def X(v):
        return 60 + v * pxpt

    # ---- the year cycle
    t0, t1 = 0.26, 0.93
    steps = max(1, n - 1)
    span = (t1 - t0) / steps
    act = None                                   # (i, a, b, p) inside a year step
    if u >= t0 and n >= 2 and u < t1:
        i = min(steps - 1, int((u - t0) / span))
        p = clamp(((u - t0) - i * span) / span)
        act = (i, rows[i][1], rows[i + 1][1], p)
    if act is None:
        val = r0 if (u < t0 or n < 2) else rows[-1][1]
        k = 0 if (u < t0 or n < 2) else n - 1
    else:
        i, a, b, p = act
        if b >= a:
            val = a + (b - a) * ease(seg(p, 0.62, 0.78))
            k = i + 1 if p >= 0.7 else i
        else:
            val = a + (b - a) * ease(seg(p, 0.2, 0.36))
            k = i + 1 if p >= 0.3 else i
    shown_lab, shown_val = rows[k]

    # ---- the brick, dropped in with gravity
    drop = seg(u, 0.0, 0.07)
    yo = -700 * (1 - drop) ** 2
    top, base, dep = 960 + yo, 1440 + yo, 40
    feet_top = top - 20

    def block(xa, xb, col):
        xb = min(xb, W + 60)
        if xb <= xa:
            return
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(col))
        cr.rectangle(xa, top, xb - xa, base - top)
        cr.fill()
        sh = tuple(int(c * 0.8) for c in col)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(sh))
        cr.move_to(xa, top)
        cr.line_to(xa + dep, top - dep)
        cr.line_to(xb + dep, top - dep)
        cr.line_to(xb, top)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.fill()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 30, 30), 0.16))
        cr.set_line_width(2)
        yy = top + 14
        while yy < base:                          # edges of the stacked notes
            cr.move_to(xa, yy)
            cr.line_to(xb, yy)
            cr.stroke()
            yy += 16

    cut = X(val)
    old = tuple(int(c * 0.55) for c in P["accent2"])
    block(cut, X(100.0), P["paper"])              # the rest of the economy
    block(X(0.0), X(min(val, r0)), old)           # health in 2000
    if val > r0:
        block(X(r0), cut, P["accent2"])           # health money added since
    # medical cross on the 2000 slab
    cw = max(12.0, (X(r0) - X(0)) * 0.12)
    ccx, ccy = (X(0) + X(min(val, r0))) / 2, top + 150
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((250, 250, 250), 0.9))
    cr.rectangle(ccx - cw / 2, ccy - cw * 1.5, cw, cw * 3)
    cr.rectangle(ccx - cw * 1.5, ccy - cw / 2, cw * 3, cw)
    cr.fill()
    # the saw line at the cut
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["redline"], 0.9))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    cr.move_to(cut, top)
    cr.line_to(cut, base)
    cr.stroke()

    # ---- the gain bracket on the floor (a mark, not text)
    if z > 0.9 and val - r0 > 0.02:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"]))
        cr.set_line_width(5)
        cr.move_to(X(r0), base + 10)
        cr.line_to(X(r0), base + 26)
        cr.line_to(cut, base + 26)
        cr.line_to(cut, base + 10)
        cr.stroke()

    # ---- Data: points at the brick, climbs on, then hauls money year by year
    def bundle(x, y, w, a=1.0):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"], a))
        cr.rectangle(x - w / 2, y - 28, w, 56)
        cr.fill()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["paper"], a))
        cr.rectangle(x - 7, y - 30, 14, 60)
        cr.fill()

    H_ = 210
    if u < 0.2:
        host("point", 320, 1480, H_)
    elif u < t0:
        c = ease(seg(u, 0.2, t0))
        host("climb", 320 + (X(r0) + 45 - 320) * c, 1480 + (feet_top - 1480) * c, H_)
    elif act is not None:
        i, a, b, p = act
        bw = max(46.0, abs(b - a) * pxpt)
        home, far = X(a) + 45, X(a) + 190
        if b >= a:
            if p < 0.25:
                host("hold_up", home + (far - home) * ease(p / 0.25), feet_top, H_)
            elif p < 0.62:
                x = far + (home - far) * ease((p - 0.25) / 0.37)
                lift = ease(seg(p, 0.25, 0.33))
                bundle(x, feet_top - 20 - 215 * lift, bw)
                host("strain", x, feet_top, H_)
            elif p < 0.8:
                host("strain", cut + 45, feet_top, H_)
            else:
                host("cheer", X(b) + 45, feet_top, H_)
        else:
            farb = X(b) + 190
            if p < 0.2:
                host("shock", home, feet_top, H_)
            elif p < 0.36:
                bundle(cut + 45, feet_top - 20 - 215 * ease(seg(p, 0.2, 0.36)), bw)
                host("strain", cut + 45, feet_top, H_)
            elif p < 0.7:
                x = X(b) + 45 + (farb - X(b) - 45) * ease((p - 0.36) / 0.34)
                bundle(x, feet_top - 235, bw)
                host("strain", x, feet_top, H_)
            elif p < 0.8:
                f = seg(p, 0.7, 0.8)
                bundle(farb + 40, feet_top - 235 + 215 * f * f, bw, a=1 - 0.8 * f)
                host("hold_up", farb, feet_top, H_)
            else:
                c = ease(seg(p, 0.8, 1.0))
                host("point", farb + (X(b) + 45 - farb) * c, feet_top, H_)
    else:
        host("cheer", cut + 45, feet_top, H_)

    # ---- labels on the whole — drawn after Data so he never covers them
    ra = ease(seg(u, 0.07, 0.12))
    wide = 1 - z
    if wide > 0:
        rest = "the rest of the world economy"
        text(cr, rest, (cut + X(100)) / 2, top + 200, fit_size(cr, rest, 46, 600),
             P["paper_ink"], anchor="center", alpha=ra * wide, shadow=False)
        text(cr, "health", (X(0) + cut) / 2, base + 55, 40, look.INK,
             anchor="center", alpha=ra * wide)
    if z > 0:
        lab0 = f"health in {r0lab}"
        text(cr, lab0, ccx, top + 330, fit_size(cr, lab0, 54, max(60, X(r0) - X(0) - 60)),
             (250, 250, 250), anchor="center", alpha=z, shadow=False)
        text(cr, "rest of the", (cut + W) / 2 + 10, top + 330, 32, P["paper_ink"],
             anchor="center", alpha=z, shadow=False)
        text(cr, "world economy", (cut + W) / 2 + 10, top + 370,
             fit_size(cr, "world economy", 32, max(60, W - cut - 30)), P["paper_ink"],
             anchor="center", alpha=z, shadow=False)

    # ---- the gain since 2000, in solid ink under the bracket
    dk = shown_val - r0
    if z > 0.9 and val - r0 > 0.02 and dk > 0:
        lx = clamp((X(r0) + cut) / 2, 250, 830)
        text(cr, f"+{dk:.1f} points since {r0lab}", lx, base + 78, 46, look.INK,
             anchor="center", shadow=False)

    # ---- readouts
    fit_readout(cr, f"{shown_val:g}%", f"of world GDP spent on health · {shown_lab}",
                80, 470, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.08)), size=120)

def _cloud_blobs(cr, ox, oy):
    blobs = [(220, 900, 92), (330, 835, 122), (470, 795, 142), (610, 825, 132),
             (740, 860, 120), (850, 912, 90), (300, 955, 82), (540, 958, 92),
             (760, 962, 82), (420, 960, 78), (660, 965, 78)]
    for bx, by, r in blobs:
        cr.new_sub_path()
        cr.arc(bx + ox, by + oy, r, 0, 2 * math.pi)


def _cradle(cr, cx, base, rock, lit):
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(cx, base)
    cr.rotate(rock)
    wood = tuple(int(a + (b - a) * lit) for a, b in zip((92, 70, 58), (196, 150, 104)))
    wood_d = tuple(int(c * 0.7) for c in wood)
    # rockers
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(wood_d))
    cr.set_line_width(18)
    cr.arc(0, -260, 290, math.radians(58), math.radians(122))
    cr.stroke()
    # basket
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(wood))
    cr.move_to(-170, -210)
    cr.line_to(170, -210)
    cr.curve_to(170, -60, 110, -30, 0, -30)
    cr.curve_to(-110, -30, -170, -60, -170, -210)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()
    # hood
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(wood_d))
    cr.move_to(-170, -210)
    cr.curve_to(-170, -330, -60, -360, -20, -350)
    cr.line_to(-20, -210)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()
    # blanket and the baby
    blank = tuple(int(a + (b - a) * lit) for a, b in zip((70, 80, 110), (150, 190, 236)))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(blank))
    cr.move_to(-150, -215)
    cr.curve_to(-60, -250, 60, -250, 160, -218)
    cr.line_to(160, -200)
    cr.line_to(-150, -200)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()
    skin = tuple(int(a + (b - a) * lit) for a, b in zip((120, 96, 84), (238, 196, 164)))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(skin))
    cr.arc(95, -240, 34, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()
    cr.restore()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """The hook: one storm cloud of risk hangs over a cradle — the whole
    1990 rate. It is already tearing in frame 1: Data hauls the 60% that is
    gone off the sky on a rope, the sun breaks through that gap onto the
    cradle, and only the 2024 remnant is left casting its shadow."""
    rows = by_time([(str(r[0]), float(r[1])) for r in pts])
    l0, v0 = rows[0][0], rows[0][1]
    l1, v1 = rows[-1][0], rows[-1][1]
    keep = v1 / v0 if v0 else 0.0
    drop = 1.0 - keep

    p = 0.62 * ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.3)) + 0.38 * ease(seg(u, 0.5, 0.72))
    lift = 0.15 + 0.85 * p                  # already tearing on frame 1

    # sky: storm-dark, warming where the gap opens
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (28, 32, 52)), (0.5, (60, 62, 86)), (1.0, (120, 104, 110))],
          0, 1250)
    glow(cr, 720, 900, 180 + 320 * lift, P["sun_glow"],
         (0.35 + 0.55 * lift) * (0.95 + 0.05 * math.sin(t * 1.5)))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["sun"], 0.3 + 0.7 * lift))
    cr.arc(720, 900 + 120 * (1 - lift), 90, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (58, 70, 58)), (0.5, (40, 48, 42)), (1.0, (26, 30, 30))],
          1200, H)

    x0, x1 = 128, 952
    xc = x0 + (x1 - x0) * keep              # the cut at the true 2024 share
    dx, dy = 20 + 90 * p, -30 - 160 * p

    # shadows on the ground/cradle
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((10, 12, 22), 0.55))
    cr.rectangle(x0, 1010, xc - x0, 480)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((10, 12, 22), 0.5 * (1 - lift)))
    cr.rectangle(xc + dx, 1010, x1 - xc, 480)
    cr.fill()
    # sunbeam through the gap
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["sun_glow"], 0.22 * lift))
    cr.move_to(xc, 1000)
    cr.line_to(xc + dx + 40, 1000 + dy)
    cr.line_to(x1 + 60, 1490)
    cr.line_to(xc - 20, 1490)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()

    rock = 0.035 * lift * math.sin(t * 2.2)
    _cradle(cr, 430, 1470, rock, 0.25 + 0.75 * lift)

    # the part that remains: neutral, heavy
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(0, 0, xc, H)
    cr.clip()
    _cloud_blobs(cr, 0, 0)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((66, 70, 84)))
    cr.fill()
    cr.restore()
    # the part that is gone: accent, lifting away whole at its true size
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(xc + dx, 0, W, H)
    cr.clip()
    cr.translate(dx, dy)
    _cloud_blobs(cr, 0, 0)
    col = tuple(int(a + (b - a) * lift) for a, b in zip((66, 70, 84), P["accent2"]))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(col))
    cr.fill()
    cr.restore()
    # torn edge
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(INK_2, 0.6))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    for k in range(7):
        yy = 760 + k * 36
        cr.move_to(xc, yy)
        cr.line_to(xc + (10 if k % 2 else -8), yy + 18)
        cr.stroke()

    # Data hauls the gone share off the sky, backing away as it comes
    hx = 720 + 240 * p
    fy = 1480
    ax, ay = x1 - 50 + dx, 990 + dy
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["log"]))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    cr.move_to(hx - 20, fy - 150)
    cr.line_to(ax, ay)
    cr.stroke()
    host("strain" if u < 0.76 else "cheer", hx, fy, 220)

    # numbers
    fit_readout(cr, f"-{drop * 100:.0f}%",
                f"child deaths before five · {l0} to {l1}", 80, 490,
                a=1.0, size=150)
    text(cr, f"{v1:g}", (x0 + xc) / 2 + 20, 900, 80, look.INK, face="display",
         anchor="center")
    text(cr, f"left in {l1}", (x0 + xc) / 2 + 20, 950, 30, INK_2,
         anchor="center")
    ga = ease(seg(u, 0.05, 0.3))
    text(cr, f"{v0 - v1:.1f} fewer", (xc + x1) / 2 + dx, 880 + dy, 64, look.INK,
         face="display", anchor="center", alpha=ga)
    text(cr, f"of {v0:g} in {l0}", (xc + x1) / 2 + dx, 925 + dy, 30, look.INK,
         anchor="center", alpha=ga)

stories.title: Why Are 44% Of Rural Homes Still Cooking Over Fire?
stories.hook: 85 percent of the countryside got wired up, and it still left the stove burning.
stories.closing: Wired up isn't the same as cooked up.
stories.question: Does your kitchen run on gas, electric, or fire? Comment below.
stories.caption: Rural electricity access jumped to 85%. Clean cooking fuel access is still stuck near 56% — so nearly half of rural homes worldwide are still burning wood or charcoal to cook dinner. Here's the gap nobody wired shut.

segments.say: Rural electricity access jumped from 67 percent in 2000 to 85 percent by 2024 — most of the world's countryside finally got wired up.
segments.illustrated_scene:
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """Rural electricity: ONE countryside hill is every rural home. Data drags
    the power line across it and the hill lights up behind him. The lit part of
    the hill is the share of homes with power, and it grows year by year from
    66.5% to 84.9%. The dark rest of the hill still has chimney smoke from
    cooking fires — and at the end he walks into it."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    labs = [r[0] for r in rows]
    vals = [r[1] for r in rows]
    n = len(vals)
    GROUND = 1500
    WIN = (255, 196, 130)          # P["window"] is gradient stops, not a colour

    def top(x):
        d = (x - 540) / 600.0
        return GROUND - 700 * math.sqrt(max(0.0, 1 - d * d))

    # the whole: the hill's AREA, cut at the true share
    xs = list(range(0, W + 1, 6))
    area = [0.0]
    for i in range(1, len(xs)):
        area.append(area[-1] + (GROUND - top(xs[i])) * 6)
    tot_a = area[-1] or 1.0

    def split_for(share):
        goal = share * tot_a
        for i in range(1, len(xs)):
            if area[i] >= goal:
                f = (goal - area[i - 1]) / max(1e-6, area[i] - area[i - 1])
                return xs[i - 1] + 6 * f
        return float(W)

    # the years arrive one at a time: long drags, short holds to read them
    s0 = seg(u, 0.04, 0.2)
    v = vals[0] * ease(s0)
    idx = 0
    moving = 0.0 < s0 < 1.0
    step = (0.86 - 0.22) / max(1, n - 1)
    for k in range(1, n):
        a = 0.22 + step * (k - 1)
        b = a + step * 0.78
        s = seg(u, a, b)
        v += (vals[k] - vals[k - 1]) * ease(s)
        if 0.0 < s < 1.0:
            moving = True
        if u >= b:
            idx = k
    split = split_for(clamp(v / 100.0, 0.0, 1.0)) if v > 0 else 0.0

    # sky and land, full frame
    dawn_sky(cr, t, y1=1100)
    g = cairo.LinearGradient(0, 1000, 0, H)
    g.add_color_stop_rgb(0, 44 / 255, 52 / 255, 58 / 255)
    g.add_color_stop_rgb(1, 22 / 255, 26 / 255, 32 / 255)
    cr.set_source(g)
    cr.rectangle(0, 1000, W, H - 1000)
    cr.fill()

    def hill_path():
        cr.move_to(0, GROUND)
        for x in xs:
            cr.line_to(x, top(x))
        cr.line_to(W, GROUND)
        cr.close_path()

    # the hill: neutral where there's no power, accent where the line reaches
    hill_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((58, 64, 78)))
    cr.fill()
    cr.save()
    hill_path()
    cr.clip()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["sun"], 0.85))
    cr.rectangle(0, 0, split, H)
    cr.fill()
    if v > 0:
        glow(cr, split, 1150, 160, P["sun_glow"], 0.5)
    cr.restore()

    # homes scattered over the hill: windows light up as the edge passes them
    smokes = []
    for i in range(44):
        hx = 50 + (i * 211) % 980
        ty = top(hx) + 40
        if ty > GROUND - 50:
            continue
        hy = ty + ((i * 137) % int(max(1, GROUND - 40 - ty)))
        s_ = 0.7 + 0.3 * ((i * 53) % 10) / 10.0
        w_, h_ = 44 * s_, 30 * s_
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brick_shade"]))
        cr.rectangle(hx - w_ / 2, hy - h_, w_, h_)
        cr.fill()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brick_cool_shade"]))
        cr.move_to(hx - w_ / 2 - 6, hy - h_)
        cr.line_to(hx, hy - h_ - 22 * s_)
        cr.line_to(hx + w_ / 2 + 6, hy - h_)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.fill()
        lit = clamp((split - hx) / 30.0)
        if lit > 0:
            glow(cr, hx, hy - h_ / 2, 30 * s_, WIN, 0.6 * lit)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(WIN if lit > 0.5 else (26, 28, 36)))
        cr.rectangle(hx - 7 * s_, hy - h_ * 0.7, 14 * s_, 12 * s_)
        cr.fill()
        if lit <= 0 and i % 3 == 0:
            smokes.append((hx + w_ * 0.3, hy - h_ - 14 * s_))
    for sx, sy in smokes[:6]:          # still cooking over fire
        steam(cr, sx, sy, t, strength=0.5)

    # the power line: poles along the lit hill, the wire runs to Data's hands
    line_x = max(150.0, split + 50)
    walk_on = ease(seg(u, 0.88, 0.97))     # the reaction: he steps into the dark
    dx = line_x + (min(W - 90.0, line_x + 150) - line_x) * walk_on
    fy = GROUND - 10
    poles = [px for px in range(70, W, 150) if px < split - 10]
    prev = None
    for px in poles:
        py = top(px) + 8
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["log"]))
        cr.rectangle(px - 5, py - 80, 10, 80)
        cr.fill()
        cr.rectangle(px - 22, py - 78, 44, 7)
        cr.fill()
        if prev:
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((20, 20, 26)))
            cr.set_line_width(3)
            cr.move_to(prev[0], prev[1])
            cr.curve_to(prev[0] + 50, prev[1] + 22, px - 50, py - 58, px, py - 80)
            cr.stroke()
        prev = (px, py - 80)
    if prev:
        hand = (line_x, fy - 150)
        sag = 40 if moving else 70     # pulled taut while he drags it
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((20, 20, 26)))
        cr.set_line_width(4)
        cr.move_to(prev[0], prev[1])
        cr.curve_to(prev[0] + 40, prev[1] + sag, hand[0] - 40, hand[1] + sag,
                    hand[0], hand[1])
        cr.stroke()

    # his bit: point at the dark hill, drag the line across it, hold it up at
    # each year, then walk into the still-dark part and think
    if u < 0.04:
        role = "point"
    elif u >= 0.88:
        role = "think"
    elif moving:
        role = "strain"
    else:
        role = "hold_up"
    host(role, dx, fy, 220)

    # readouts
    fit_readout(cr, f"{vals[idx]:.1f}%", f"rural homes with power · {labs[idx]}",
                80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.06)), size=140)
    b = ease(seg(u, 0.84, 0.92))
    if b > 0:
        text(cr, f"+{vals[-1] - vals[0]:.1f} points since {labs[0]}", 80, 700, 56,
             P["accent2"], anchor="left", alpha=b)
    c = ease(seg(u, 0.9, 0.97))
    if c > 0:
        text(cr, f"{100 - vals[-1]:.1f}% still dark", W - 80, 780, 48, look.INK,
             anchor="right", alpha=c)

segments.say: But clean cooking fuel access crawled from just 24 percent to 56 percent — so 44 percent of rural homes are still cooking over open fire or charcoal.
segments.illustrated_scene:
def _hearth_flame(cr, x, base, w, h, rgb, a):
    cr.move_to(x - w, base)
    cr.curve_to(x - w, base - h * 0.45, x - w * 0.2, base - h * 0.7, x, base - h)
    cr.curve_to(x + w * 0.2, base - h * 0.7, x + w, base - h * 0.45, x + w, base)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(rgb, a))
    cr.fill()


def _log_side(cr, x, y, w, h, a=1.0):
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["log"], a))
    cr.rectangle(x - w / 2, y - h / 2, w, h)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["stump_top"], a))
    cr.arc(x + w / 2, y, h / 2, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()


def _strand_y(s, x):
    base = 640 + s * 130
    d = (x - 540) / 470.0
    return base + 70 * (1 - d * d)


def _slot_xy(i):
    s = i // 8
    c = i % 8 if s % 2 == 0 else 7 - i % 8
    x = 130 + c * 118 + (s % 2) * 50
    return x, _strand_y(s, x)


def _bulb(cr, x, y, lit, pop_s):
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 26, 28)))
    cr.rectangle(x - 10, y, 20, 18)
    cr.fill()
    r = 26 * pop_s if lit > 0 else 22
    if lit > 0:
        glow(cr, x, y + 44, 90 * pop_s, P["sun_glow"], 0.55 * lit)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["sun"], 0.35 + 0.65 * lit))
    else:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 64, 66), 0.9))
    cr.arc(x, y + 44, r, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()
    if lit > 0:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 250, 225), 0.8 * lit))
        cr.arc(x - 7, y + 38, 8 * pop_s, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """A rural kitchen at night. Strands of bulbs hang across the room: each
    bulb is an equal slice of the last year's kWh per person. The first
    year's bulbs flick on, then Data rolls his ladder along the strands and
    screws in the next bulbs as each year lands. Below, the pot sits on the
    same open wood fire the whole time: the lights multiply, the fire never
    changes."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in by_time(pts)]
    n = len(rows)
    vmax = max(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    v0, v1 = rows[0][1], rows[-1][1]

    # ---- year steps: each value arrives over most of its step, then holds
    p = clamp((u - 0.12) / 0.68) * max(1, n - 1)
    k = min(int(p), max(0, n - 2))
    f = ease(clamp((p - k) / 0.6)) if n > 1 else 1.0
    va = rows[k][1]
    vb = rows[min(k + 1, n - 1)][1]
    vcur = va + (vb - va) * f
    j = k if f < 0.5 else min(k + 1, n - 1)
    lab, val = rows[j]
    changing = n > 1 and 0.0 < f < 1.0 and 0.12 < u < 0.8

    # ---- the bulbs: 24 slots, each one vmax/24 kWh
    slots = 24
    unit = vmax / slots
    n0 = v0 / unit
    if u < 0.12:                       # the first year's bulbs flick on
        nlit = n0 * ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.11))
    else:
        nlit = vcur / unit
    lit_frac = nlit / slots

    # ---- the mud-walled kitchen, lit by the bulbs
    vgrad(cr, P["dry_soil"], 0, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(0.05, 0.03, 0.05, 0.62 - 0.22 * lit_frac)
    cr.paint()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((18, 12, 14), 0.7))      # soot-blackened ceiling
    cr.rectangle(0, 0, W, 380)
    cr.fill()
    glow(cr, 540, 820, 380 + 360 * lit_frac, P["sun_glow"], 0.15 + 0.35 * lit_frac)
    sh = cairo.LinearGradient(0, 380, 0, 660)        # soot falls behind the readout
    sh.add_color_stop_rgba(0, 0.07, 0.04, 0.05, 0.75)
    sh.add_color_stop_rgba(1, 0.07, 0.04, 0.05, 0.0)
    cr.set_source(sh)
    cr.rectangle(0, 380, W, 280)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((62, 44, 34)))           # packed earth floor
    cr.rectangle(0, 1470, W, H - 1470)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((44, 30, 24)))
    cr.rectangle(0, 1470, W, 10)
    cr.fill()

    # ---- the ladder follows the bulb being fitted (drawn behind the pot)
    q = clamp(max(nlit, n0), 0.0, slots - 1.0)
    qi = min(int(q), slots - 2)
    qf = q - qi
    xa, _ = _slot_xy(qi)
    xb, _ = _slot_xy(qi + 1)
    lx = clamp(xa + (xb - xa) * ease(qf), 90, 990)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["trunk"]))
    cr.set_line_width(12)
    for side in (-1, 1):
        cr.move_to(lx + side * 50, 1478)
        cr.line_to(lx + side * 42, 1030)
        cr.stroke()
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    for r_ in range(7):
        y = 1440 - r_ * 64
        cr.move_to(lx - 48, y)
        cr.line_to(lx + 48, y)
        cr.stroke()
    for side in (-1, 1):                             # castors
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 26, 28)))
        cr.arc(lx + side * 50, 1482, 12, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()

    # ---- the strands of bulbs (the hero): they multiply with the kWh
    for s in range(3):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((24, 20, 22)))
        cr.set_line_width(5)
        for xi in range(0, 1001, 20):
            x = 40 + xi
            if xi == 0:
                cr.move_to(x, _strand_y(s, x))
            else:
                cr.line_to(x, _strand_y(s, x))
        cr.stroke()
    for i in range(slots):
        x, y = _slot_xy(i)
        li = clamp(nlit - i)
        _bulb(cr, x, y, li, 0.7 + 0.3 * pop(li) if li > 0 else 1.0)

    # ---- the fire: the same fire, beat start to beat end
    fx, fb = 540, 1440
    glow(cr, fx, fb - 80, 280, P["heat"], 0.55)
    for i in range(7):
        _log_side(cr, fx - 110 + (i * 53) % 220, fb - 14 - 16 * (i // 4), 100, 22)
    for i in range(7):
        fl = 1.0 + 0.18 * math.sin(t * 7 + i * 1.7)
        _hearth_flame(cr, fx - 120 + i * 40, fb - 20, 30, 120 * fl, P["sun_hot"], 0.85)
        _hearth_flame(cr, fx - 120 + i * 40, fb - 20, 16, 72 * fl, P["sun"], 0.9)
    for sx in (400, 680):                            # hearth stones
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((96, 84, 78)))
        cr.arc(sx, fb - 40, 44, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 60, 56)))
        cr.arc(sx + 10, fb - 20, 36, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()

    # ---- the blackened pot over the flames
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((28, 24, 26)))
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(fx, 1270)
    cr.scale(1.0, 0.8)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 165, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((52, 46, 48)))
    cr.rectangle(fx - 155, 1128, 310, 28)
    cr.fill()
    glow(cr, fx - 70, 1230, 70, P["heat"], 0.25)
    steam(cr, fx, 1120, t, strength=0.8)

    # ---- Data: points up at the lights, climbs, rolls the ladder along and
    # screws in each new bulb, climbs down to the fire that never changed
    top = 1060
    x_start = _slot_xy(min(int(n0), slots - 1))[0]
    if u < 0.1:
        host("point", clamp(x_start + 150, 200, 900), 1500, 220)
    elif u < 0.18:
        c = ease(seg(u, 0.1, 0.18))
        host("climb", clamp(x_start + 150, 200, 900) + (lx - clamp(x_start + 150, 200, 900)) * c,
             1500 - (1500 - top) * c, 220)
    elif u < 0.84:
        host("strain" if changing else "hold_up", lx, top, 220)
    else:
        d = ease(seg(u, 0.84, 0.95))
        ex = 800 if lx < 700 else 820
        role = "climb" if u < 0.9 else ("shock" if u < 0.96 else "think")
        host(role, lx + (ex - lx) * d, top + (1500 - top) * d, 220)

    # ---- readouts
    fit_readout(cr, f"{val:,.0f} kWh", f"electricity per person · {lab}", 80, 520,
                a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.08)), size=120)
    b = ease(seg(u, 0.82, 0.92))
    if b > 0:
        glow(cr, 540, 1070, 360, (8, 5, 7), 0.85 * b)
        text(cr, f"+{v1 - v0:,.0f} kWh since {rows[0][0]}", 540, 1050, 64,
             P["accent2"], face="display", anchor="center", alpha=b)
        text(cr, "and the pot still sits on fire", 540, 1104, 44, (250, 247, 240),
             anchor="center", alpha=b)

segments.topic: power use behind the rural electricity gap
segments.say: Meanwhile overall electricity use per person climbed from 2,093 to 3,558 kilowatt-hours a year — the world is using more power, just not always the cleanest kind.
segments.illustrated_scene:
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """One LPG cylinder is every rural home. The gas inside it is the share
    that cooks clean, and it fills year by year from the first to the last
    reading. Each rise is one year landing, then it holds so the year can be
    read. Data climbs the ladder on the cylinder as the gas rises, strains at
    the valve to push the next year in, and cheers once the last year is in.
    The empty steel above the gas is the rest of the homes, still cooking
    over fire."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    n = len(rows)
    cx, bw, top, bot = 600.0, 440.0, 720.0, 1470.0
    x0, x1 = cx - bw / 2, cx + bw / 2

    def ly(v):
        return bot - (bot - top) * clamp(v / 100.0)

    # --- the timeline: fill arrives, then each year rises and holds ---
    idx = 0
    moving = False
    if u < 0.08:
        cur = 0.0
    elif u < 0.2:
        f = ease(seg(u, 0.08, 0.2))
        cur = rows[0][1] * f
        moving = f < 1.0
    else:
        cur = rows[0][1]
        span = (0.85 - 0.2) / max(1, n - 1)
        for i in range(1, n):
            a = 0.2 + (i - 1) * span
            f = ease(seg(u, a, a + span * 0.4))
            if f > 0:
                cur = rows[i - 1][1] + (rows[i][1] - rows[i - 1][1]) * f
                if f < 1.0:
                    moving = True
                    idx = i - 1
                else:
                    idx = i
    level = ly(cur)

    # --- the village at dusk ---
    dawn_sky(cr, t, y1=1180)
    vgrad(cr, P["dry_soil"], 1160, H)
    for k, hx in enumerate([70, 170, 900, 1010]):     # huts on the horizon
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((52, 40, 36)))
        cr.rectangle(hx - 34, 1140, 68, 44)
        cr.fill()
        cr.move_to(hx - 44, 1142)
        cr.line_to(hx, 1106)
        cr.line_to(hx + 44, 1142)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.fill()
        if k % 2 == 0:                                # a cooking-fire plume
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["mist"], 0.35))
            cr.set_line_width(14)
            cr.move_to(hx + 10, 1110)
            cr.curve_to(hx + 10 + 20 * math.sin(t * 0.6 + k), 1040,
                        hx - 20, 990, hx + 16 * math.sin(t * 0.4 + k), 920)
            cr.stroke()

    # --- the ladder he climbs ---
    lx = 300.0
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["log"]))
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    for rx in (lx - 26, lx + 26):
        cr.move_to(rx, 1500)
        cr.line_to(rx, top - 10)
        cr.stroke()
    cr.set_line_width(7)
    y = 1490.0
    while y > top:
        cr.move_to(lx - 26, y)
        cr.line_to(lx + 26, y)
        cr.stroke()
        y -= 48

    # --- the cylinder: one whole ---
    def body():
        r = 90
        cr.new_sub_path()
        cr.arc(x1 - r, top + r, r, -math.pi / 2, 0)
        cr.arc(x1 - r, bot - r * 0.5, r * 0.5, 0, math.pi / 2)
        cr.arc(x0 + r * 0.5, bot - r * 0.5, r * 0.5, math.pi / 2, math.pi)
        cr.arc(x0 + r, top + r, r, math.pi, 1.5 * math.pi)
        cr.close_path()

    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((34, 38, 48)))              # foot ring
    cr.rectangle(cx - bw * 0.36, bot - 10, bw * 0.72, 30)
    cr.fill()
    body()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((72, 80, 94)))              # the rest: neutral steel
    cr.fill()
    cr.save()
    body()
    cr.clip()
    slosh = (10.0 if moving else 3.0)
    cr.move_to(x0 - 10, H)
    cr.line_to(x0 - 10, level)
    for i in range(0, 23):
        sx = x0 + i * bw / 22
        cr.line_to(sx, level + slosh * math.sin(i * 0.7 + t * 3.0))
    cr.line_to(x1 + 10, H)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"]))              # the share: the gas
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 255, 255), 0.35))     # its surface
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    for i in range(0, 23):
        sx = x0 + i * bw / 22
        sy = level + slosh * math.sin(i * 0.7 + t * 3.0)
        (cr.move_to if i == 0 else cr.line_to)(sx, sy)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 255, 255), 0.10))     # steel shine
    cr.rectangle(x0 + 50, top, 36, bot - top)
    cr.fill()
    cr.restore()
    body()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((20, 22, 30)))
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    cr.stroke()
    # the collar and valve
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((52, 58, 70)))
    cr.rectangle(cx - 70, top - 40, 140, 44)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass"]))
    cr.rectangle(cx - 22, top - 80, 44, 42)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((52, 58, 70)))
    cr.set_line_width(12)
    cr.arc(cx, top - 40, 110, math.pi * 1.1, math.pi * 1.9)
    cr.stroke()
    # once the last year is in, the burner lights: the clean flame
    fl = ease(seg(u, 0.86, 0.94))
    if fl > 0:
        glow(cr, cx, top - 100, 70 * fl, (90, 160, 255), 0.8 * fl)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 190, 255), fl))
        cr.move_to(cx - 18, top - 82)
        cr.curve_to(cx - 14, top - 110, cx + 3 * math.sin(t * 5), top - 130 * fl - 20,
                    cx, top - 140 * fl - 10)
        cr.curve_to(cx + 3, top - 112, cx + 16, top - 104, cx + 18, top - 82)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.fill()

    # year tag riding the gas level
    if u >= 0.2 or (u > 0.08 and not moving):
        text(cr, rows[idx][0], x1 + 24, level + 14, 42, look.INK)

    # --- Data: walks in, climbs with the gas, strains at the valve, cheers ---
    if u < 0.08:
        host("point", 140 + 160 * ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.08)), 1500, 210)
    elif u >= 0.88:
        host("cheer", lx, min(1500.0, level), 210)
    else:
        host("climb" if moving else "strain", lx, min(1500.0, level), 210)

    # --- readouts ---
    if u > 0.08:
        lab, val = rows[idx]
        fit_readout(cr, f"{val:.1f}%", f"of rural people cook clean · {lab}", 80, 490,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.08, 0.16)), size=140)
    rest_a = ease(seg(u, 0.86, 0.95))
    if rest_a > 0:
        my = (top + ly(rows[-1][1])) / 2
        text(cr, "the rest:", cx, my - 10, 44, look.INK, anchor="center",
             alpha=rest_a)
        text(cr, "still over fire", cx, my + 50, 56, look.INK, face="display",
             anchor="center", alpha=rest_a)

    capped = seg(u, 0.5, 0.62)                 # he gets the lid on...
    burst = ease(seg(u, 0.78, 0.86))           # ...and the smoke blows it off
    lid_y = ch_top - 14 - 90 * burst * burst

segments.say: The global labor force grew from 2.3 billion people in 1990 to 3.7 billion by 2025 — the biggest working-age population the world has ever had.
segments.illustrated_scene:
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """The world's workforce as ONE crowd standing shoulder to shoulder along
    the curve of the Earth. The whole arc is 2025's workforce; the 1990 crowd
    rises first and fills its true share in a neutral, then each later year
    adds a new wave of workers who rise out of the ground in the accent
    colour. Data strains at the front of the line, pushing it around the
    planet as it grows, and a cheer ripples down the whole crowd at the end."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    n = len(rows)
    v0 = rows[0][1]
    vmax = max(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    base_frac = v0 / vmax

    # --- decisive steps: each year arrives (most of its slot), then holds
    intro = ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.1))
    p = clamp((u - 0.1) / 0.76) * (n - 1)
    k = min(int(p), n - 2)
    fr = p - k
    if p >= n - 1:
        k, fr = n - 2, 1.0
    f = ease(clamp(fr / 0.72))
    v = rows[k][1] + (rows[k + 1][1] - rows[k][1]) * f
    frac = v / vmax if u >= 0.1 else base_frac * intro

    # --- the sky and the planet (full-bleed background)
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (10, 14, 34)), (0.5, (22, 30, 70)), (1.0, (14, 18, 44))], 0, H)
    cx, cy, R = 540, 1010, 330
    glow(cr, cx, cy, R + 170, (70, 120, 200), 0.45)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((34, 92, 158)))
    cr.arc(cx, cy, R, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()
    cr.save()
    cr.arc(cx, cy, R, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.clip()
    drift = (t * 22) % 900                     # the continents turn slowly
    lands = [(-260, -120, 150), (-120, 60, 120), (80, -180, 110), (200, 90, 170),
             (380, -40, 130), (560, 140, 120), (640, -160, 100)]
    for lx, ly, lr in lands:
        for off in (0, -900):
            x = cx + ((lx + drift + 450) % 900) - 450 + off
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((76, 146, 96)))
            cr.arc(x, cy + ly, lr, 0, 2 * math.pi)
            cr.fill()
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((58, 120, 80)))
            cr.arc(x + lr * 0.3, cy + ly + lr * 0.25, lr * 0.55, 0, 2 * math.pi)
            cr.fill()
    g = cairo.RadialGradient(cx - 120, cy - 140, R * 0.2, cx, cy, R)
    g.add_color_stop_rgba(0, 1, 1, 1, 0.10)
    g.add_color_stop_rgba(1, 0, 0, 0.1, 0.45)
    cr.set_source(g)
    cr.paint()
    cr.restore()

    # --- the crowd: one whole arc of workers = 2025's workforce
    a0, a1 = math.radians(200), math.radians(340)
    N = 64
    shown = N * frac
    neutral = (206, 200, 188)
    accent = P["accent2"]
    wp = seg(u, 0.86, 1.0) * (N + 14)          # the cheer that runs down the line
    for i in range(N):
        appear = clamp(shown - i)
        if appear <= 0:
            continue
        a = a0 + (a1 - a0) * (i + 0.5) / N
        rise = pop(appear) if appear < 1 else 1.0
        h = (46 + (i * 37) % 22) * rise
        d = wp - i
        hop = 18 * math.sin(math.pi * d / 14) if 0 < d < 14 else 0.0
        col = neutral if i < N * base_frac else accent
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(cx + R * math.cos(a), cy + R * math.sin(a))
        cr.rotate(a + math.pi / 2)
        cr.translate(0, -hop)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(col))
        cr.set_line_width(4)
        cr.move_to(-3, 0)
        cr.line_to(-2, -h * 0.4)
        cr.move_to(3, 0)
        cr.line_to(2, -h * 0.4)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.rectangle(-6, -h * 0.82, 12, h * 0.45)
        cr.fill()
        if hop > 0:                            # arms up as the cheer passes
            cr.move_to(-6, -h * 0.78)
            cr.line_to(-12, -h * 1.1)
            cr.move_to(6, -h * 0.78)
            cr.line_to(12, -h * 1.1)
            cr.stroke()
        cr.arc(0, -h * 0.9, 6.5 * rise, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()
        if i % 3 == 0:                         # hard hats on some of the crew
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["sun"]))
            cr.arc(0, -h * 0.93, 7.5 * rise, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
            cr.fill()
        elif i % 3 == 1 and hop <= 0:          # a tool over the shoulder
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["log"]))
            cr.set_line_width(3)
            cr.move_to(5, -h * 0.6)
            cr.line_to(12, -h * 1.05)
            cr.stroke()
        cr.restore()

    # --- Data: points as 1990 rises, then pushes the front of the line
    # around the planet as it grows, and cheers when the front arrives
    af = a0 + (a1 - a0) * frac + 0.07
    hx, hy = cx + (R + 4) * math.cos(af), cy + (R + 4) * math.sin(af)
    if u < 0.1:
        role = "point"
    elif u < 0.86:
        role = "strain"
    else:
        role = "cheer"
    host(role, hx, hy, 200)

    # --- readouts: only landed years, never an in-between number
    lab, val = rows[k + 1] if (u >= 0.1 and f > 0.5) else rows[k if u >= 0.1 else 0]
    fit_readout(cr, f"{val / 1e9:.1f} billion", f"people in the world's workforce · {lab}",
                80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.08)), size=130)
    b = ease(seg(u, 0.86, 0.96))
    if b > 0:
        grew = (vmax - v0) / 1e9
        fit_readout(cr, f"+{grew:.1f} billion", f"workers since {rows[0][0]}",
                    W / 2, 1400, anchor="center", a=b, rgb=accent, size=80)

def _dep_person(cr, x, y, s, rgb, a, kind):
    # one dependent: a child (small) or an elder (with a cane), feet at y
    if a <= 0:
        return
    h = 44 * s
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(rgb, a))
    cr.move_to(x - 12 * s, y)
    cr.curve_to(x - 14 * s, y - h * 0.7, x - 8 * s, y - h, x, y - h)
    cr.curve_to(x + 8 * s, y - h, x + 14 * s, y - h * 0.7, x + 12 * s, y)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()
    cr.arc(x, y - h - 10 * s, 10 * s, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()
    if kind == 2:                                # the elder's cane
        cr.set_line_width(3.5 * s)
        cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
        cr.move_to(x + 16 * s, y)
        cr.line_to(x + 14 * s, y - h * 0.62)
        cr.line_to(x + 8 * s, y - h * 0.66)
        cr.stroke()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """The dependency ratio as a LOAD: one great litter carried by a line of
    working-age people, piled with everyone who depends on them (one figure
    per two dependents per 100 workers). Year by year dependents hop down
    off the pile one at a time and walk away out of frame, the plank lifts
    and the carriers straighten up under it. Data walks in, gets his hands
    under the front of the plank and holds it up, and cheers once the load
    has lightened."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    n = len(rows)
    v0 = rows[0][1]
    counts = [int(round(v / 2.0)) for _, v in rows]
    d = 0.76 / max(1, n - 1)
    tr = 0.7 * d
    starts = [0.14 + (i - 1) * d for i in range(n)]

    # the current load: it moves while a year arrives, then settles
    v = v0
    shown = 0
    for i in range(1, n):
        f = ease(seg(u, starts[i], starts[i] + tr))
        v += (rows[i][1] - rows[i - 1][1]) * f
        if seg(u, starts[i], starts[i] + tr) >= 0.5:
            shown = i

    # the setting: a dawn sky over a packed-earth square
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (24, 30, 58)), (0.55, (62, 70, 110)), (1.0, (214, 150, 110))],
          0, 1180)
    glow(cr, 820, 900, 380, P["sun_glow"], 0.55)
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (120, 92, 70)), (0.5, (84, 62, 48)), (1.0, (52, 38, 30))],
          1180, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 30, 24), 0.35))
    cr.rectangle(0, 1180, W, 10)
    cr.fill()

    # the plank: it sags under the pile and lifts as the pile shrinks
    x0p, x1p = 150.0, 930.0
    lift = (v0 - v) * 6.0
    sag = max(0.0, (v - 40.0) * 1.4)
    base = 1090.0 - lift

    def plank_y(x):
        fr = clamp((x - x0p) / (x1p - x0p))
        return base + sag * math.sin(math.pi * fr)

    # carriers: arms up to the plank, knees bent by the load
    bend = clamp((v - 50.0) / 26.0)
    feet = 1440.0
    cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
    for k, cx in enumerate([300, 400, 500, 600, 700, 800, 880]):
        py = plank_y(cx)
        sh = py + 62
        hip = sh + (feet - sh) * 0.45
        knee = (hip + feet) / 2
        col = (54, 60, 82)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(col))
        cr.set_line_width(18)
        for sgn in (-1, 1):
            cr.move_to(cx + 8 * sgn, hip)
            cr.line_to(cx + (12 + 34 * bend) * sgn, knee)
            cr.line_to(cx + 12 * sgn, feet)
            cr.stroke()
        cr.set_line_width(28)
        cr.move_to(cx, hip)
        cr.line_to(cx, sh)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.set_line_width(12)
        for sgn in (-1, 1):
            cr.move_to(cx + 12 * sgn, sh + 4)
            cr.line_to(cx + 16 * sgn, py + 14)
            cr.stroke()
        cr.arc(cx, sh - 24, 17, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()

    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["log"]))
    cr.set_line_width(28)
    cr.move_to(x0p, plank_y(x0p))
    for j in range(1, 41):
        xx = x0p + (x1p - x0p) * j / 40
        cr.line_to(xx, plank_y(xx))
    cr.stroke()

    # the pile of dependents: one figure per 2 dependents per 100 workers.
    # Each one that the year sheds hops down to the ground and WALKS AWAY
    # out of frame — spread across the whole year, so the story keeps arriving
    per_row = [10, 9, 8, 7, 4]
    rest_col = look.REST
    idx = 0
    for r_, cnt in enumerate(per_row):
        for c in range(cnt):
            if idx >= counts[0]:
                break
            fx = 540 - (cnt - 1) * 34 + c * 68 + (8 if r_ % 2 else 0)
            fy = plank_y(fx) - 14 - r_ * 60
            kind = (idx * 7 + r_) % 3
            s = 0.78 if kind == 0 else 1.0
            hop = 0.0
            wk = 0.0
            stage = 0
            for i in range(1, n):
                if counts[i] <= idx < counts[i - 1]:
                    stage = i
                    j = counts[i - 1] - 1 - idx
                    m = max(1, counts[i - 1] - counts[i])
                    gap = 0.75 * d / m
                    a_ = starts[i] + j * gap
                    hop = seg(u, a_, a_ + 0.06)
                    wk = seg(u, a_ + 0.06, a_ + 0.22)
                    break
            if idx >= counts[-1] and stage == 0:
                wk = 1.0
            if wk >= 1.0:
                idx += 1
                continue
            if hop > 0:
                # hops off the pile to the ground, then walks off to the right
                lx = fx + 160 * hop
                py = fy + (feet - fy) * hop * hop - 80 * math.sin(math.pi * hop)
                px = lx + (W + 80 - lx) * wk
                if wk > 0:
                    py = feet - 8 * abs(math.sin(wk * 14))
                glow(cr, px, py - 30, 60, P["accent2"], 0.4 * (1 - wk))
                _dep_person(cr, px, py, s, P["accent2"], 1.0, kind)
            else:
                _dep_person(cr, fx, fy, s, rest_col, 1.0, kind)
            idx += 1

    # Data: points from the right, walks under the front of the plank,
    # holds it up through every year, then cheers the lighter load
    walk_in = ease(seg(u, 0.04, 0.16))
    dx = 930 - 750 * walk_in
    if u < 0.16:
        role = "point"
    elif u < 0.30:
        role = "strain"
    elif u < 0.92:
        role = "hold_up"
    else:
        role = "cheer"
    host(role, dx, feet, 220, pace=(0.04 < u < 0.16))

    # readouts: all straight from pts
    lab, val = rows[shown]
    vs = f"{val:.1f}".rstrip("0").rstrip(".")
    fit_readout(cr, f"{vs} per 100", f"dependents per 100 workers · {lab}",
                80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.08)), size=130)
    b = ease(seg(u, starts[-1] + tr, starts[-1] + tr + 0.05))
    if b > 0:
        diff = f"{v0 - rows[-1][1]:.1f}".rstrip("0").rstrip(".")
        text(cr, f"{diff} fewer to carry", W - 80, 700, 56, P["accent2"],
             face="display", anchor="right", alpha=b)
        text(cr, f"since {rows[0][0]}", W - 80, 752, 34, look.INK,
             anchor="right", alpha=b)
    text(cr, "each figure = 2 dependents per 100 workers", W / 2, 1500, 30,
         look.INK, anchor="center", alpha=0.8 * ease(seg(u, 0.05, 0.15)))
