segments.say: Glaciers used to lose about 85 billion tons of ice a year. Now it's 390 billion tons a year, and still climbing.
segments.illustrated_scene:
def _ice_top(x):
    return 700 + 60 * clamp(x / 960.0, 0.0, 1.3)


def _ice_fill(cr, y0, y1):
    cr.save()
    cr.clip()
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (236, 246, 253)), (0.5, (176, 212, 238)), (1.0, (104, 156, 204))],
          y0, y1)
    cr.restore()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """A glacier's calving face: each period's yearly loss is one slab of the
    SAME ice cliff, its width proportional to the tonnes, cracking off and
    crashing into the sea in time order — 85, then 230, then 390. Data walks
    the ice to each crack line and pries the slab loose; the cliff he stands
    on shrinks under him."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]) or [("now", 1.0)]
    n = len(rows)
    tot = sum(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    SEA = 1180
    widths = [560.0 * v / tot for _, v in rows]
    faces = [960.0]
    for w_ in widths:
        faces.append(faces[-1] - w_)
    a0, L = 0.05, 0.90 / n

    def ph(k, a, b):
        return seg(u, a0 + k * L + a * L, a0 + k * L + b * L)

    # sky + far mountains
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (150, 190, 225)), (0.6, (196, 222, 240)), (1.0, (226, 238, 246))],
          0, SEA)
    for mx, mh, mw in [(120, 520, 420), (480, 600, 520), (900, 470, 460)]:
        cr.move_to(mx - mw / 2, SEA)
        cr.line_to(mx, SEA - mh)
        cr.line_to(mx + mw / 2, SEA)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((132, 150, 172)))
        cr.fill()
        cr.move_to(mx - mw * 0.12, SEA - mh * 0.76)
        cr.line_to(mx, SEA - mh)
        cr.line_to(mx + mw * 0.12, SEA - mh * 0.76)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((240, 246, 252)))
        cr.fill()

    # the glacier body: everything not yet fallen
    started = [ph(k, 0.5, 0.68) > 0 for k in range(n)]
    face = faces[0]
    for k in range(n):
        if started[k]:
            face = faces[k + 1]
    cr.move_to(-10, _ice_top(-10))
    for i in range(12):
        x = -10 + (face + 10) * i / 11.0
        cr.line_to(x, _ice_top(x) + 8 * math.sin(i * 1.7))
    for j in range(8):
        y = _ice_top(face) + (SEA - _ice_top(face)) * j / 7.0
        cr.line_to(face + (14 if j % 2 else -6), y)
    cr.line_to(-10, SEA)
    cr.close_path()
    _ice_fill(cr, 680, SEA)
    for i in range(int(max(0, face) // 46)):          # crevasse streaks
        x = 30 + i * 46
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 170, 215), 0.45))
        cr.set_line_width(3)
        cr.move_to(x, _ice_top(x) + 30)
        cr.line_to(x + 10, SEA - 40 - (i * 37) % 140)
        cr.stroke()

    # the crack opening along the current slab's line
    for k in range(n):
        c = ease(ph(k, 0.2, 0.5))
        if c > 0 and not started[k]:
            cx = faces[k + 1]
            top = _ice_top(cx)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 60, 100)))
            cr.set_line_width(7)
            cr.move_to(cx, top)
            for j in range(1, 7):
                yy = top + (SEA - top) * c * j / 6.0
                cr.line_to(cx + (10 if j % 2 else -10), yy)
            cr.stroke()

    # the falling slabs: tip over the face, crash, drift out as bergs
    for k in range(n):
        if not started[k]:
            continue
        w_ = widths[k]
        px = faces[k]
        f = ph(k, 0.5, 0.68)
        g = f * f
        drift = 320 * ease(clamp((u - (a0 + k * L + 0.68 * L)) / 0.6))
        bob = 6 * math.sin(t * 1.3 + k) if f >= 1 else 0.0
        hl = SEA - _ice_top(px - w_)
        hr = SEA - _ice_top(px)
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(px + drift, SEA + 260 * g + bob)
        cr.rotate(0.9 * g)
        cr.move_to(-w_, -hl)
        cr.line_to(0, -hr)
        for j in range(1, 7):
            cr.line_to(10 if j % 2 else -6, -hr + hr * j / 6.0)
        cr.line_to(-w_, 0)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.restore()
        _ice_fill(cr, SEA - 520, SEA + 300)

    # the sea
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(0, SEA, W, H - SEA)
    cr.clip()
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (52, 104, 146)), (1.0, (18, 46, 78))], SEA, H)
    cr.restore()
    for i in range(7):
        y = SEA + 24 + i * 48
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 200, 230), 0.22))
        cr.set_line_width(3)
        cr.move_to(0, y)
        for x in range(0, W + 40, 40):
            cr.line_to(x, y + 5 * math.sin(x * 0.02 + t * 0.8 + i))
        cr.stroke()

    # the splash where each slab lands
    for k in range(n):
        sp = ph(k, 0.66, 0.8)
        if 0 < sp < 1:
            sx = faces[k] + 0.3 * widths[k]
            for r_ in range(3):
                cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((240, 248, 255), 0.8 * (1 - sp)))
                cr.set_line_width(8)
                cr.save()
                cr.translate(sx, SEA + 10)
                cr.scale(1.0, 0.3)
                cr.arc(0, 0, 40 + 180 * sp + r_ * 40, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
                cr.restore()
                cr.stroke()

    # Data's bit: walk to the crack line, pry the slab loose, react
    hx = 560.0
    role = "think"
    for k in range(n):
        if u < a0 + k * L:
            break
        target = faces[k + 1] - 60
        prev = hx
        hx = prev + (target - prev) * ease(ph(k, 0.0, 0.2))
        q = (u - a0 - k * L) / L
        if q < 0.2:
            role = "climb"
        elif q < 0.6:
            role = "strain"
        else:
            role = "shock" if k == n - 1 else "point"
    host(role, hx, _ice_top(hx) + 4, 210)

    # readouts
    k_now = 0
    for k in range(n):
        if u >= a0 + k * L:
            k_now = k
    lab, val = rows[k_now]
    fa = ease(seg(u, a0 + k_now * L, a0 + k_now * L + 0.12 * L))
    fit_readout(cr, f"{val:.0f} billion tons", f"ice lost a year · {lab}", 80, 480,
                a=fa, size=130)
    b = ease(seg(u, a0 + (n - 1) * L + 0.75 * L, 0.98))
    if b > 0 and n > 1 and rows[0][1] > 0:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{rows[-1][1] / rows[0][1]:.1f}× faster",
                    f"than {rows[0][0]}", W / 2, 1300, anchor="center", a=b,
                    rgb=P["accent2"], size=96)

segments.topic: glacier ice loss vs Greenland ice sheet
segments.say: That's already bigger than Greenland's whole ice sheet loses -- 390 billion tons from glaciers versus about 330 billion from Greenland.
segments.illustrated_scene:
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    rows = sorted([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts[:2]], key=lambda r: -r[1])
    (lb, vb), (ls, vs) = rows[0], rows[1]
    diff = vb - vs
    ICE = (214, 236, 248)
    ICE_SH = (150, 192, 222)
    ICE_DK = (96, 140, 178)
    GROUND = 1480
    FX, FY = 540, 1200            # fulcrum top
    HALF = 440
    SB = 270.0                    # bigger block's side; area is the tonnes
    SS = SB * math.sqrt(vs / vb) if vb > 0 else SB
    ex = diff / vb if vb > 0 else 0.0

    # --- the setting: polar sky, glacier peaks left, Greenland dome right
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (28, 44, 86)), (0.55, (86, 130, 178)), (1.0, (196, 222, 238))],
          0, 1320)
    glow(cr, 820, 380, 360, (255, 236, 200), 0.35)
    for k, (px, ph, pw) in enumerate([(-40, 330, 300), (180, 420, 340), (400, 300, 260)]):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 92, 130)))
        cr.move_to(px - pw / 2, 1300)
        cr.line_to(px + pw * 0.05, 1300 - ph)
        cr.line_to(px + pw / 2 + 60, 1300)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.fill()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(ICE))
        cr.move_to(px + pw * 0.05, 1300 - ph)
        cr.line_to(px - pw * 0.12, 1300 - ph * 0.55)
        cr.line_to(px + pw * 0.08, 1300 - ph * 0.62)
        cr.line_to(px + pw * 0.24, 1300 - ph * 0.5)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((200, 222, 240)))
    cr.move_to(640, 1300)
    cr.curve_to(760, 1150, 1000, 1140, 1180, 1300)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()
    # the sea between, slow swell
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (40, 86, 128)), (1.0, (22, 54, 92))], 1290, GROUND)
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    for i in range(6):
        y = 1320 + i * 28
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 200, 230), 0.35))
        cr.move_to(0, y)
        for x in range(0, W + 40, 40):
            cr.line_to(x, y + 5 * math.sin(x * 0.02 + t * 0.9 + i))
        cr.stroke()
    # the ice shelf they stand on
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (226, 240, 250)), (1.0, (176, 206, 228))], GROUND, H)

    # --- the balance: tilt follows the weight actually on it
    a = -0.2 * ease(seg(u, 0.12, 0.22)) + 0.3 * ease(seg(u, 0.6, 0.72))
    th = -a

    def pp(s, up):
        return (FX + s * math.cos(th) + up * math.sin(th),
                FY + s * math.sin(th) - up * math.cos(th))

    def ice(cx, by, side, rot, alpha=1.0, slab=0.0):
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(cx, by)
        cr.rotate(rot)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(ICE, alpha))
        cr.rectangle(-side / 2, -side, side, side)
        cr.fill()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(ICE_SH, alpha))
        cr.rectangle(side * 0.28, -side, side * 0.22, side)
        cr.fill()
        if slab > 0:   # the share of this block that Greenland doesn't match
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"], alpha * slab))
            cr.rectangle(-side / 2, -side, side, side * ex)
            cr.fill()
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(ICE_DK, alpha * slab))
            cr.set_line_width(5)
            cr.move_to(-side / 2, -side + side * ex)
            for j in range(1, 7):
                cr.line_to(-side / 2 + side * j / 6,
                           -side + side * ex + (8 if j % 2 else -6))
            cr.stroke()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(ICE_DK, alpha * 0.6))
        cr.set_line_width(3)
        cr.move_to(-side * 0.3, -side * 0.7)
        cr.line_to(-side * 0.1, -side * 0.45)
        cr.line_to(-side * 0.22, -side * 0.2)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(ICE_DK, alpha))
        cr.set_line_width(4)
        cr.rectangle(-side / 2, -side, side, side)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.restore()

    # fulcrum rock
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((84, 92, 110)))
    cr.move_to(FX, FY + 6)
    cr.line_to(FX - 130, GROUND)
    cr.line_to(FX + 130, GROUND)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()
    # plank
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(FX, FY)
    cr.rotate(th)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["log"]))
    cr.rectangle(-HALF, -14, 2 * HALF, 22)
    cr.fill()
    cr.restore()

    # Greenland's year of ice drops onto the right pan
    f = seg(u, 0.02, 0.12)
    gx, gy = pp(300, 8)
    ice(gx, gy - 700 * (1 - f * f), SS, th, alpha=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.03)))

    # the glaciers' year: hauled in from the left, hoisted on
    bx = -150 + 390 * ease(seg(u, 0.22, 0.45))
    lift = ease(seg(u, 0.5, 0.6))
    lx, ly = pp(-300, 8)
    cx = bx + (lx - bx) * lift
    by = GROUND + (ly - GROUND) * lift
    slab = ease(seg(u, 0.64, 0.74))
    ice(cx, by, SB, th * lift, slab=slab)
    if seg(u, 0.18, 0.47) > 0 and u < 0.47:   # the haul rope
        dx = bx + 200
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 90, 60)))
        cr.set_line_width(5)
        cr.move_to(bx + SB / 2, GROUND - SB * 0.4)
        cr.line_to(dx - 20, GROUND - 120)
        cr.stroke()

    # --- Data's bit: points at Greenland's block, hauls the glacier ice in,
    # hoists it onto the pan, climbs his load and cheers as it outweighs
    if u < 0.1:
        host("point", 900, GROUND, 220)
    elif u < 0.22:
        w = ease(seg(u, 0.1, 0.22))
        host("point", 900 + (50 - 900) * w, GROUND, 220, pace=True)
    elif u < 0.47:
        host("strain", bx + 200, GROUND, 220)
    elif u < 0.6:
        w = ease(seg(u, 0.47, 0.52))
        host("hold_up", 440 + (390 - 440) * w, GROUND, 220)
    elif u < 0.84:
        c = ease(seg(u, 0.62, 0.82))
        topx, topy = pp(-300, 8 + SB)
        host("climb", 390 + (topx - 390) * c, GROUND + (topy - GROUND) * c, 220)
    else:
        topx, topy = pp(-300, 8 + SB)
        host("cheer", topx, topy, 220)

    # --- labels, drawn after Data so he never stands over them
    la = ease(seg(u, 0.12, 0.2))
    tx, ty = pp(300, 8 + SS + 40)
    text(cr, ls, tx, ty, fit_size(cr, ls, 34, 300), look.INK, anchor="center", alpha=la)
    if u > 0.6:
        tx, ty = pp(-300, 8 + SB + 40)
        text(cr, lb, tx, ty, fit_size(cr, lb, 34, 300), look.INK, anchor="center",
             alpha=ease(seg(u, 0.62, 0.7)))

    # --- readouts
    if u < 0.58:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{vs:.0f}B tonnes", f"{ls.lower()} · lost per year", 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.08)), size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{vb:.0f}B tonnes", f"{lb.lower()} · lost per year", 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.58, 0.64)), size=130)
    if slab > 0:
        fit_readout(cr, f"+{diff:.0f}B tonnes", f"more than the {ls.lower()}",
                    W / 2, 760, anchor="center", a=slab, rgb=P["accent2"], size=72)

segments.topic: glacier melt and sea level rise
segments.say: All that melted glacier ice doesn't just vanish -- it's already pushed global sea levels up 18 millimeters since 2000.
segments.illustrated_scene:
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """Where the melt goes: the side of one harbour quay, with the sea rising
    up its stone face. Data pries a slab off the glacier at the left end of
    the quay, carries it over his head to the edge and heaves it in. Then he
    walks back and pries the next one. The sea climbs the painted tide staff
    to each year's total in time order: 0, then 7, then 18 mm. The water
    rising up the wall is the number."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    if len(rows) < 2:
        rows = rows + rows
    vals = [v for _, v in rows]
    top = max(vals) or 1.0
    DECK = 880
    SEA0 = 1420
    scale = min(22.0, 440.0 / max(top - vals[0], 1.0))

    def lvl(mm):
        return SEA0 - (mm - vals[0]) * scale

    def ease_in(x):
        # starts from rest, arrives still moving, so the throw carries on from it
        return x * x * (2.0 - x)

    STONE = (128, 120, 110)
    STONE_SH = (96, 90, 84)
    ICE = (222, 240, 250)
    ICE_SH = (150, 192, 222)
    SEA = (38, 104, 150)
    SEA_LIT = (92, 170, 210)
    GX, EX = 260.0, 580.0          # where he pries, where he throws
    CARRY_Y = DECK - 250

    # sky over the whole frame
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (120, 168, 210)), (0.5, (186, 214, 232)), (1.0, (210, 226, 236))], 0, H)
    glow(cr, 820, 300, 260, (255, 240, 210), 0.5)

    # the glacier at the left end of the quay
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(ICE))
    cr.move_to(0, 600)
    cr.line_to(140, 620)
    cr.line_to(230, 680)
    cr.line_to(270, 760)
    cr.line_to(280, DECK)
    cr.line_to(0, DECK)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(ICE_SH, 0.9))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    for k in range(4):
        cr.move_to(60 + k * 55, 640 + k * 18)
        cr.line_to(80 + k * 50, 760 + k * 20)
        cr.stroke()

    # the quay: deck, then the stone wall the sea climbs
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(STONE_SH))
    cr.rectangle(0, DECK, W, 26)
    cr.fill()
    for r in range(12):
        y = DECK + 26 + r * 60
        off = 0 if r % 2 == 0 else 70
        for c in range(-1, 9):
            x = off + c * 140
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(STONE if (r + c) % 3 else STONE_SH))
            cr.rectangle(x + 3, y + 3, 134, 54)
            cr.fill()
    for bx in (420, 760):                     # bollards on the deck
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 58, 62)))
        cr.rectangle(bx - 16, DECK - 40, 32, 40)
        cr.fill()

    # the tide staff painted on the wall
    sx = 960
    ytop = lvl(top) - 30
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((240, 240, 236)))
    cr.rectangle(sx - 14, ytop, 28, SEA0 + 40 - ytop)
    cr.fill()
    nmm = int(round(top - vals[0]))
    for mm in range(nmm + 1):
        y = lvl(vals[0] + mm)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 30, 36)))
        cr.set_line_width(3)
        cr.move_to(sx - 14, y)
        cr.line_to(sx + (14 if mm % 5 == 0 else 0), y)
        cr.stroke()

    # the bit: one window per rise, in time order
    m = len(rows) - 1
    w0, wl = 0.1, 0.82 / m
    level = vals[0]
    shown = 0
    hx, role = GX, "strain"                   # prying the first slab loose
    prying = u < w0
    falling = None
    for k in range(1, m + 1):
        w = (u - w0 - (k - 1) * wl) / wl
        d = vals[k] - vals[k - 1]
        rise = ease(seg(w, 0.52, 0.8)) if w > 0 else 0.0
        level += d * rise
        if rise > 0.5:
            shown = k
        if 0 <= w < 1 or (k == m and w >= 1):
            bw = 50 + min(d, 20) * 5
            if w < 0.12:
                role, hx = "strain", GX                  # prying it off the ice
                prying = True
            elif w < 0.46:
                role = "hold_up"                         # carrying it overhead
                hx = GX + (EX - GX) * ease_in(seg(w, 0.12, 0.46))
            elif w < 0.62:
                role, hx = "strain", EX                  # the heave into the sea
            elif k == m:
                role, hx = ("shock" if w > 0.85 else "cheer"), EX
            elif w < 0.7:
                role, hx = "cheer", EX
            elif w < 0.86:
                role = "point"                           # back to the glacier
                hx = EX - (EX - GX) * ease(seg(w, 0.7, 0.86))
            else:
                role, hx = "strain", GX                  # prying the next slab
                prying = True
            if 0.12 <= w < 0.46:
                bx, by = hx, CARRY_Y
                cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(ICE))
                cr.rectangle(bx - bw / 2, by - bw * 0.7, bw, bw * 0.7)
                cr.fill()
                cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(ICE_SH))
                cr.rectangle(bx - bw / 2, by - 14, bw, 14)
                cr.fill()
            if 0.46 <= w < 0.75:
                # thrown, not dropped: it leaves his hands already moving
                f = seg(w, 0.46, 0.58)
                drop = lvl(vals[k - 1]) - CARRY_Y
                falling = (EX + 150 * f, CARRY_Y + drop * (0.3 * f + 0.7 * f * f),
                           bw, f, seg(w, 0.58, 0.72))

    # the crack he is working open in the glacier face
    if prying:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 110, 150)))
        cr.set_line_width(5)
        cr.move_to(250, 700)
        cr.line_to(236, 760)
        cr.line_to(248, 820)
        cr.line_to(238, DECK)
        cr.stroke()

    # the thrown slab and its splash
    if falling:
        fx, fy, bw, f, sp = falling
        if f < 1:
            cr.save()
            cr.translate(fx, fy - bw * 0.35)
            cr.rotate(1.2 * f)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(ICE))
            cr.rectangle(-bw / 2, -bw * 0.35, bw, bw * 0.7)
            cr.fill()
            cr.restore()
        if sp > 0:
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((240, 250, 255), 1 - sp))
            cr.set_line_width(6)
            cr.arc(fx, fy, 30 + 120 * sp, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
            cr.stroke()

    # the sea, up the wall
    sy = lvl(level)
    cr.move_to(0, H)
    for i in range(0, W + 21, 20):
        cr.line_to(i, sy + 8 * math.sin(i / 70.0 + t * 1.6))
    cr.line_to(W, H)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(SEA, 0.82))
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(SEA_LIT))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    for i in range(0, W + 1, 20):
        y = sy + 8 * math.sin(i / 70.0 + t * 1.6)
        (cr.move_to if i == 0 else cr.line_to)(i, y)
    cr.stroke()
    # a faint line on the wall where the sea started in the first year
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((250, 250, 250), 0.5))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    cr.set_dash([14, 10])
    cr.move_to(0, SEA0)
    cr.line_to(W, SEA0)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_dash([])

    # staff labels, each one appears as the sea reaches it
    for k, (lab, v) in enumerate(rows):
        if k <= shown:
            text(cr, f"{lab} · {v:.0f} mm", sx - 34, lvl(v) + 10, 36, look.INK,
                 anchor="right")

    host(role, hx, DECK, 210)

    lab, v = rows[shown]
    fit_readout(cr, f"+{v - vals[0]:.0f} mm", f"global sea level since {rows[0][0]} · {lab}",
                80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.08)), size=150)

stories.closing_scene:
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """The closing, full bleed: a whole range of ice peaks stands on a glacier
    shelf above the open sea. Data walks up to each peak and shoves it along
    the shelf until it tips off the edge and crashes into the sea. Each splash
    lifts the waterline against the cliff. When the last peak goes, the shelf
    is bare, the sea stands higher, and the latest sourced sea level lands
    once as a still number. Data stands in shock at the empty edge."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    if len(rows) < 2:
        rows = rows + rows if rows else [("", 0.0), ("", 0.0)]
    vals = [v for _, v in rows]
    labs = [l for l, _ in rows]
    last_val, last_lab = vals[-1], labs[-1]

    ICE = (228, 242, 251)
    ICE_SH = (152, 192, 224)
    ICE_DK = (100, 142, 180)
    CLIFF = (128, 172, 208)
    CLIFF_DK = (84, 124, 164)
    SEA_TOP = (44, 98, 146)
    SEA_BOT = (12, 32, 60)
    SHELF_Y = 1300
    EDGE_X = 800
    SEA0, RISE = 1440, 100

    # the range: shoved off right to left, nearest the edge first
    peaks = [(610, 480, 170), (400, 620, 200), (220, 500, 160)]
    wins = [(0.08, 0.36), (0.36, 0.63), (0.63, 0.90)]

    def state(k):
        cx, h, hw = peaks[k]
        a, b = wins[k]
        f = seg(u, a, b)
        d = EDGE_X - (cx + hw)
        slide = ease(seg(f, 0.2, 0.62))
        tip = seg(f, 0.62, 0.82)
        theta = 1.75 * tip * tip
        drop = 760 * seg(f, 0.72, 0.92) ** 2
        return f, cx + d * slide, h, hw, theta, drop

    # the sea climbs one step per peak that lands in it
    landed_amt = 0.0
    for k in range(3):
        f = seg(u, wins[k][0], wins[k][1])
        landed_amt += ease(seg(f, 0.76, 0.96))
    sea_y = SEA0 - RISE * landed_amt / 3.0

    # sky, full frame
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (176, 200, 226)), (0.55, (140, 172, 208)),
               (1.0, (86, 122, 166))], 0, H)
    glow(cr, 860, 760, 360, (255, 222, 188), 0.5)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((96, 140, 182)))
    cr.rectangle(0, 1180, W, H - 1180)
    cr.fill()

    # the glacier shelf the range stands on
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(CLIFF))
    cr.move_to(0, SHELF_Y)
    cr.line_to(EDGE_X, SHELF_Y)
    cr.line_to(EDGE_X - 30, H)
    cr.line_to(0, H)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(CLIFF_DK, 0.8))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    for k in range(6):
        x = 90 + k * 125
        cr.move_to(x, SHELF_Y + 30)
        cr.line_to(x + 14, SHELF_Y + 120 + 20 * (k % 2))
        cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(ICE))
    cr.rectangle(0, SHELF_Y - 8, EDGE_X, 16)
    cr.fill()

    def draw_peak(cx, h, hw):
        top = SHELF_Y - h
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(ICE))
        cr.move_to(cx - hw, SHELF_Y)
        cr.line_to(cx, top)
        cr.line_to(cx, SHELF_Y)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.fill()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(ICE_SH))
        cr.move_to(cx, top)
        cr.line_to(cx + hw, SHELF_Y)
        cr.line_to(cx, SHELF_Y)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.fill()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(ICE_DK, 0.7))
        cr.set_line_width(4)
        for j in range(3):
            fy = 0.3 + 0.2 * j
            yy = top + h * fy
            cr.move_to(cx + hw * fy * 0.15, yy)
            cr.line_to(cx + hw * fy * 0.55, yy + 30)
            cr.stroke()

    # back to front: leftmost first, so the peak at the edge sits in front
    for k in (2, 1, 0):
        f, cx, h, hw, theta, drop = state(k)
        if f >= 0.97:
            continue
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(EDGE_X, SHELF_Y + drop)
        cr.rotate(theta)
        cr.translate(-EDGE_X, -SHELF_Y)
        draw_peak(cx, h, hw)
        cr.restore()

    # the near sea, standing against the cliff
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, SEA_TOP), (1.0, SEA_BOT)], sea_y, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((204, 232, 250), 0.8))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    cr.move_to(0, sea_y)
    for x in range(0, W + 40, 40):
        cr.line_to(x, sea_y + 5 * math.sin(x * 0.02 + t * 1.4))
    cr.stroke()

    # the splash where each peak goes in
    for k in range(3):
        f = seg(u, wins[k][0], wins[k][1])
        sp = seg(f, 0.74, 0.96)
        if 0.0 < sp < 1.0:
            sx = EDGE_X + 130
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 246, 253), 0.85 * (1 - sp)))
            cr.save()
            cr.translate(sx, sea_y)
            cr.scale(1.0, 0.55)
            cr.arc(0, 0, 50 + 170 * ease(sp), math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
            cr.fill()
            cr.restore()
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 246, 253), 0.7 * (1 - sp)))
            cr.set_line_width(10)
            lift = math.sin(math.pi * sp)
            for side in (-1, 1):
                cr.move_to(sx + side * 30, sea_y)
                cr.curve_to(sx + side * 70, sea_y - 220 * lift,
                            sx + side * 140, sea_y - 160 * lift,
                            sx + side * (60 + 160 * sp), sea_y)
                cr.stroke()

    # Data walks up to each peak, shoves it to the edge and over,
    # then stands in shock on the empty shelf
    start_x = 120.0
    if u < wins[0][0]:
        role, dx = "think", start_x
    elif u >= wins[2][1]:
        role, dx = "shock", EDGE_X - 2 * peaks[2][2] - 14
    else:
        k = 0
        for j in range(3):
            if wins[j][0] <= u < wins[j][1]:
                k = j
        f, cx, h, hw, theta, drop = state(k)
        prev_x = start_x if k == 0 else EDGE_X - 2 * peaks[k - 1][2] - 14
        c0 = peaks[k][0] - hw - 14
        if f < 0.2:
            role = "point"
            dx = prev_x + (c0 - prev_x) * ease(seg(f, 0.0, 0.2))
        else:
            role = "strain"
            dx = min(cx - hw - 14, EDGE_X - 2 * hw - 14)
    dx = max(60.0, dx)
    host(role, dx, SHELF_Y, 220)

    # the finding, landed once and held: the latest sourced sea level, no counter
    a = ease(seg(u, 0.88, 0.95))
    if a > 0:
        small = "higher seas by " + last_lab + " from shed ice"
        fit_readout(cr, "+" + str(int(round(last_val))) + " mm", small,
                    80, 540, a=a, size=140)
stories.hook_scene:
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    vals = [v for _, v in rows]
    labs = [l for l, _ in rows]
    first, last = vals[0], vals[-1]
    ratio = last / first if first else 0.0
    ICE = (222, 240, 250)
    ICE_SH = (150, 192, 222)
    ICE_DK = (90, 134, 176)
    WATER = (70, 150, 205)
    WATER_LT = (170, 220, 245)
    LIP = 1080
    SEA = 1390
    MX = 600
    w = last * 1.15                     # the outflow's width IS today's tonnes
    w0 = first * 1.15                   # the old channel, at the old tonnes
    # sky + sea, full height
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (196, 222, 240)), (1.0, (236, 244, 250))], 0, SEA)
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (48, 104, 150)), (1.0, (18, 46, 78))], SEA, H)
    # distant peaks
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((176, 204, 226)))
    cr.move_to(0, 900)
    for px, py in [(120, 760), (260, 840), (400, 720), (560, 820),
                   (720, 700), (880, 800), (1080, 740)]:
        cr.line_to(px, py)
    cr.line_to(W, 900)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()
    # the glacier: the hero mass, upper-middle, full width
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(ICE))
    cr.move_to(-20, LIP)
    for px, py in [(-20, 760), (110, 690), (230, 730), (360, 640), (500, 680),
                   (620, 610), (760, 670), (880, 640), (1000, 700), (1100, 680)]:
        cr.line_to(px, py)
    cr.line_to(1100, LIP)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(ICE_SH, 0.8))
    for px, py in [(360, 640), (620, 610), (880, 640)]:
        cr.move_to(px, py)
        cr.line_to(px + 70, LIP)
        cr.line_to(px + 150, LIP)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.fill()
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(ICE_DK, 0.7))
    for k in range(9):
        cx = 70 + k * 118
        cy = 820 + (k * 53) % 160
        cr.move_to(cx, cy)
        cr.line_to(cx + 18, cy + 50)
        cr.line_to(cx + 6, cy + 100)
        cr.stroke()
    # ice cliffs either side of the outflow, down to the sea
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(ICE_SH))
    cr.rectangle(-20, LIP, MX - w / 2 + 20, SEA - LIP)
    cr.rectangle(MX + w / 2, LIP, W - MX - w / 2 + 20, SEA - LIP)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(ICE_DK, 0.5))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    for k in range(10):
        x = 30 + k * 108
        if MX - w / 2 - 10 < x < MX + w / 2 + 10:
            continue
        cr.move_to(x, LIP + 10)
        cr.line_to(x + 10, SEA)
        cr.stroke()
    # the mouth in the ice, as wide as the melt
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 76, 112)))
    cr.move_to(MX - w / 2, LIP)
    cr.curve_to(MX - w / 2, LIP - w * 0.55, MX + w / 2, LIP - w * 0.55, MX + w / 2, LIP)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()
    # the meltwater torrent pouring out of it — already roaring on frame 1
    cr.save()
    cr.move_to(MX - w / 2, LIP)
    cr.curve_to(MX - w / 2, LIP - w * 0.45, MX + w / 2, LIP - w * 0.45, MX + w / 2, LIP)
    cr.line_to(MX + w / 2 + 12, SEA)
    cr.line_to(MX - w / 2 - 12, SEA)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.clip_preserve()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(WATER))
    cr.fill()
    n = max(3, int(w / 22))
    cr.set_line_width(7)
    for i in range(n):
        sx = MX - w / 2 + (i + 0.5) * w / n
        off = ((t * 520 + i * 137) % 360)
        for j in range(3):
            y0 = LIP - w * 0.4 + off + j * 360 - 360
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(WATER_LT, 0.7))
            cr.move_to(sx, y0)
            cr.line_to(sx, y0 + 140)
            cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()
    # the old channel: what the same ice used to shed, outlined inside the flood
    ga = ease(seg(u, 0.32, 0.45))
    if ga > 0:
        cr.save()
        cr.set_dash([18, 12])
        cr.set_line_width(6)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 255, 255), 0.9 * ga))
        cr.move_to(MX - w0 / 2, LIP - w0 * 0.3)
        cr.line_to(MX - w0 / 2, SEA)
        cr.move_to(MX + w0 / 2, LIP - w0 * 0.3)
        cr.line_to(MX + w0 / 2, SEA)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.restore()
    # foam where it hits the sea, as big as the flow
    for k in range(6):
        fx = MX - w / 2 + (k + 0.5) * w / 6
        r = w * 0.12 + 14 * math.sin(t * 7 + k * 1.7)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((240, 248, 252), 0.85))
        cr.arc(fx, SEA + 6, max(10, r), 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(WATER_LT, 0.5))
    cr.rectangle(0, SEA - 4, W, 10)
    cr.fill()
    # Data braces a plank against the torrent; two surges shove him back,
    # each one a decisive slide and then a hold, and he ends up in shock
    s1 = ease(seg(u, 0.12, 0.28))
    s2 = ease(seg(u, 0.50, 0.66))
    shove = 95 * s1 + 95 * s2
    edge = MX - w / 2
    hx = edge - 50 - shove
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(hx + 40, LIP - 70)
    cr.rotate(-0.35 - 0.2 * (s1 + s2))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["log"]))
    cr.rectangle(-12, -80, 24, 170)
    cr.fill()
    cr.restore()
    role = "strain" if u < 0.8 else "shock"
    host(role, hx, LIP, 210)
    # readouts: only numbers the data has, each held the whole time it shows
    fit_readout(cr, f"{last:.0f} billion t / yr", f"glacier melt · {labs[-1]}", 80, 480,
                size=120)
    b = ease(seg(u, 0.35, 0.47))
    if b > 0:

segments.illustrated_scene:
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """One apartment tower at night is everyone. Its floors are cut at the
    true proportions: the bottom band asleep with the early birds, the wide
    middle band in between, and the top quarter the true night owls. Data
    climbs the fire ladder past every floor. The early birds' windows go dark
    and the in-betweens' come on as he passes them. At the top he pulls the
    breaker and the owls' windows light one by one in the accent. He lifts
    the moon over them, and the rest of the tower dims so the owls are what
    is left."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    tot = sum(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    owl = None
    for r in rows:
        lo = r[0].lower()
        if "evening" in lo or "night" in lo or "owl" in lo:
            owl = r
    if owl is None:
        owl = min(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    rest = [r for r in rows if r is not owl]
    mid = max(rest, key=lambda r: r[1]) if rest else (owl[0], 0.0)
    morn = [r for r in rest if r is not mid]
    morn = morn[0] if morn else (mid[0], 0.0)
    s_owl, s_mid, s_morn = owl[1] / tot, mid[1] / tot, morn[1] / tot

    WIN = (255, 214, 120)        # a lit owl window
    INIT = (64, 66, 98)          # a window before Data reaches it
    ASLEEP = (24, 26, 44)
    MIDC = (150, 156, 186)       # neutral: the in-betweens
    ACC = P["accent2"]

    def mix(c0, c1, f):
        f = clamp(f)
        return tuple(int(a + (b - a) * f) for a, b in zip(c0, c1))

    # night sky to street, full frame
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (8, 10, 34)), (0.55, (22, 24, 66)), (1.0, (44, 38, 88))], 0, 1500)
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (34, 32, 52)), (1.0, (14, 14, 26))], 1480, H)
    for i in range(38):                       # fixed stars
        sx = (i * 263) % W
        sy = 40 + (i * 149) % 620
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((230, 232, 255), 0.45))
        cr.arc(sx, sy, 2 + (i % 3), 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()
    for k in range(7):                        # skyline behind the hero tower
        bx = -40 + k * 170
        bh = 260 + (k * 97) % 220
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((26, 26, 52)))
        cr.rectangle(bx, 1480 - bh, 150, bh)
        cr.fill()

    # the moon rises as he lifts it
    lift = ease(seg(u, 0.7, 0.88))
    mx, my = 860, 760 - 160 * lift
    glow(cr, mx, my, 200, (200, 210, 255), 0.3 + 0.2 * lift)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 238, 250)))
    cr.arc(mx, my, 62, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((22, 24, 66)))
    cr.arc(mx + 26, my - 14, 54, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()

    # THE TOWER: one whole, split at the true shares
    tx0, tx1 = 300, 760
    top, base = 700, 1480
    th = base - top
    y_owl = top + th * s_owl
    y_mid = y_owl + th * s_mid
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 42, 70)))
    cr.rectangle(tx0, top, tx1 - tx0, th)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 62, 96)))
    cr.rectangle(tx0 - 14, top - 18, tx1 - tx0 + 28, 22)
    cr.fill()

    # Data's climb drives the lower floors: each one changes as he passes it
    walk_in = ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.12))
    climb = ease(seg(u, 0.12, 0.44))
    foot_top = y_owl + 10
    fy0 = 1478.0
    fy = fy0 + (foot_top - fy0) * climb
    climbed = fy0 - fy

    pull = seg(u, 0.47, 0.7)
    dim = ease(seg(u, 0.88, 0.97))            # the rest of the tower steps back
    wcols, ww, wh = 5, 54, 40
    gap = (tx1 - tx0 - wcols * ww) / (wcols + 1)

    def band(y0, y1, kind):
        n = max(1, int((y1 - y0) // 64))
        fh = (y1 - y0) / n
        total = n * wcols
        for f in range(n):
            fy_ = y0 + f * fh + (fh - wh) / 2
            depth = base - (fy_ + wh / 2)     # how far up from the street
            passed = clamp((climbed - depth + 20) / 36)
            for c in range(wcols):
                wx = tx0 + gap + c * (ww + gap)
                if kind == "owl":
                    k = (n - 1 - f) * wcols + c   # bottom floor first, window by window
                    on = clamp(pull * (total + 1) - k)
                    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(mix(INIT, WIN, on)))
                    cr.rectangle(wx, fy_, ww, wh)
                    cr.fill()
                    if on >= 1:
                        glow(cr, wx + ww / 2, fy_ + wh / 2, 46, WIN, 0.35)
                elif kind == "mid":
                    col = mix(mix(INIT, MIDC, passed), ASLEEP, 0.55 * dim)
                    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(col))
                    cr.rectangle(wx, fy_, ww, wh)
                    cr.fill()
                else:
                    col = mix(mix(INIT, ASLEEP, passed), (16, 16, 30), dim)
                    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(col))
                    cr.rectangle(wx, fy_, ww, wh)
                    cr.fill()
                    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((50, 52, 80), passed))   # curtain drops
                    cr.rectangle(wx, fy_, ww, wh * 0.3 * passed)
                    cr.fill()

    band(top, y_owl, "owl")
    band(y_owl, y_mid, "mid")
    band(y_mid, base, "morn")
    for yy, col in ((y_owl, ACC), (y_mid, MIDC)):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(col, 0.9))
        cr.set_line_width(6)
        cr.move_to(tx0 - 10, yy)
        cr.line_to(tx1 + 10, yy)
        cr.stroke()
    owl_a = clamp(pull * 1.2)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(ACC, 0.9 * owl_a))
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    cr.rectangle(tx0 - 4, top - 4, tx1 - tx0 + 8, y_owl - top + 4)
    cr.stroke()

    # fire ladder up the left wall
    lx = tx0 - 70
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 124, 150)))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    for xx in (lx - 26, lx + 26):
        cr.move_to(xx, base)
        cr.line_to(xx, top + 30)
        cr.stroke()
    yy = base - 20
    while yy > top + 40:
        cr.move_to(lx - 26, yy)
        cr.line_to(lx + 26, yy)
        cr.stroke()
        yy -= 50
    # the breaker box at the owl floors
    bx, by = tx0 - 8, y_owl - 60
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 74, 100)))
    cr.rectangle(bx - 30, by - 40, 40, 80)
    cr.fill()
    ang = -0.9 + 1.8 * ease(seg(u, 0.45, 0.5))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(ACC))
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    cr.move_to(bx - 10, by)
    cr.line_to(bx - 10 + 40 * math.sin(ang), by - 40 * math.cos(ang))
    cr.stroke()

    # Data's bit: points at the tower, climbs past every floor, throws the
    # breaker, lifts the moon over the owls, cheers
    fx = 120 + (lx - 120) * walk_in
    if u < 0.12:
        role = "point"
    elif u < 0.45:
        role = "climb"
    elif u < 0.7:
        role = "strain"
    elif u < 0.9:
        role = "hold_up"
    else:
        role = "cheer"
    host(role, fx, fy, 200)

    # readouts, each one landing when its band is done
    fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(s_owl * 100))}%",
                f"are true night owls · {owl[0].split('(')[0].strip().lower()}",
                80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.5, 0.6)), size=150)
    la = ease(seg(u, 0.38, 0.46)) * (1 - 0.4 * dim)
    text(cr, f"{int(round(s_mid * 100))}%", tx1 + 30, (y_owl + y_mid) / 2 + 10, 72,
         look.INK, face="display", alpha=la)
    _ml = mid[0].lower()
    text(cr, _ml, tx1 + 30, (y_owl + y_mid) / 2 + 56, fit_size(cr, _ml, 34, 290),
         INK_2, alpha=la)
    ma = ease(seg(u, 0.2, 0.28)) * (1 - 0.4 * dim)
    text(cr, f"{int(round(s_morn * 100))}%", tx1 + 30, (y_mid + base) / 2 + 10, 60,
         INK_2, face="display", alpha=ma)
    _bl = morn[0].lower()
    text(cr, _bl, tx1 + 30, (y_mid + base) / 2 + 50, fit_size(cr, _bl, 30, 290),
         INK_2, alpha=ma)

def _seg_frac(h, R):
    if h <= 0:
        return 0.0
    if h >= 2 * R:
        return 1.0
    th = 2 * math.acos(clamp(1 - h / R, -1.0, 1.0))
    return (th - math.sin(th)) / (2 * math.pi)


def _level_for(share, R):
    lo, hi = 0.0, 2 * R
    for _ in range(40):
        mid = (lo + hi) / 2
        if _seg_frac(mid, R) < share:
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid
    return (lo + hi) / 2


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """One giant alarm clock is all of 'when you wake up'. Data hauls the
    winding rope; as he pulls, DNA rises inside the clock to the true 44%
    of its face (by area). He holds it there, the rest floods in as habit,
    and the bells ring."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    lab, val = rows[0]
    share = clamp(val / 100.0, 0.0, 1.0)

    cx, cy, R = 540, 1010, 300
    dawn_sky(cr, t, y1=1180)
    vgrad(cr, P["earth"], 1160, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["curb"]))
    cr.rectangle(0, 1470, W, 14)
    cr.fill()

    # --- the act timeline
    pull = ease(seg(u, 0.12, 0.55))          # he hauls the rope: DNA rises
    habit = ease(seg(u, 0.62, 0.78))         # the rest floods in
    ring = seg(u, 0.80, 0.92)                # the alarm goes off

    shake = 10 * math.sin(t * 40) * (1 if 0 < ring < 1 else 0)
    ccx = cx + shake

    # legs and bells
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass_shade"]))
    for sx in (-1, 1):
        cr.set_line_width(26)
        cr.move_to(ccx + sx * R * 0.55, cy + R * 0.8)
        cr.line_to(ccx + sx * R * 0.8, cy + R * 1.18)
        cr.stroke()
    for sx in (-1, 1):
        bx, by = ccx + sx * R * 0.62, cy - R * 0.92
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass"]))
        cr.arc(bx, by, 95, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.fill()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass_shade"]))
        cr.rectangle(bx - 100, by - 8, 200, 16)
        cr.fill()
    # hammer between the bells
    ha = 0.5 * math.sin(t * 40) if 0 < ring < 1 else 0.0
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(ccx, cy - R * 0.95)
    cr.rotate(ha)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass_shade"]))
    cr.set_line_width(14)
    cr.move_to(0, 40)
    cr.line_to(0, -60)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.arc(0, -70, 22, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()
    cr.restore()

    # body
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass"]))
    cr.arc(ccx, cy, R + 34, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["paper"]))
    cr.arc(ccx, cy, R, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()

    # the fill: one face, cut at the true share by AREA
    lvl = _level_for(share * pull, R)
    gy = cy + R - lvl
    cr.save()
    cr.arc(ccx, cy, R, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.clip()
    if habit > 0:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["mist"], 0.9 * habit))
        cr.rectangle(ccx - R, cy - R, 2 * R, (gy - (cy - R)) * habit)
        cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"]))
    cr.rectangle(ccx - R, gy, 2 * R, cy + R - gy)
    cr.fill()
    # DNA strands inside the genetic share; they turn as he winds
    ph = pull * 9.0
    for r_ in range(9):
        yb = cy + R - 40 - r_ * 66
        if yb < gy + 20:
            break
        for strand in (0, 1):
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["paper"], 0.85 if strand == 0 else 0.55))
            cr.set_line_width(6)
            for i in range(61):
                x = ccx - R + i * (2 * R / 60)
                y = yb + 20 * math.sin(x * 0.03 + ph + strand * math.pi)
                (cr.move_to if i == 0 else cr.line_to)(x, y)
            cr.stroke()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["paper"], 0.45))
        cr.set_line_width(4)
        for i in range(12):
            x = ccx - R + 25 + i * 50
            a1 = 20 * math.sin(x * 0.03 + ph)
            cr.move_to(x, yb + a1)
            cr.line_to(x, yb - a1)
            cr.stroke()
    # the cut line
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(look.INK))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    cr.move_to(ccx - R, gy)
    cr.line_to(ccx + R, gy)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()

    # ticks and hands
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["paper_ink"]))
    for k in range(12):
        a = k * math.pi / 6
        cr.set_line_width(8 if k % 3 == 0 else 4)
        cr.move_to(ccx + (R - 14) * math.sin(a), cy - (R - 14) * math.cos(a))
        cr.line_to(ccx + (R - 44) * math.sin(a), cy - (R - 44) * math.cos(a))
        cr.stroke()
    ah = -0.6 + pull * 2 * math.pi * 0.9
    am = pull * 2 * math.pi * 10.8
    for ang, ln, wd in ((ah, R * 0.5, 16), (am, R * 0.78, 10)):
        cr.set_line_width(wd)
        cr.move_to(ccx, cy)
        cr.line_to(ccx + ln * math.sin(ang), cy - ln * math.cos(ang))
        cr.stroke()
    sa = int(t) * math.pi / 30                 # the second hand ticks
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["redline"]))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    cr.move_to(ccx, cy)
    cr.line_to(ccx + R * 0.85 * math.sin(sa), cy - R * 0.85 * math.cos(sa))
    cr.stroke()
    cr.arc(ccx, cy, 14, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()

    # winding crank on the right, the rope runs to Data's hands
    kx, ky = ccx + R + 50, cy + 90
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass_shade"]))
    cr.arc(kx, ky, 26, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()
    ka = pull * 14
    cr.set_line_width(12)
    cr.move_to(kx, ky)
    cr.line_to(kx + 46 * math.cos(ka), ky + 46 * math.sin(ka))
    cr.stroke()

    # Data's bit
    foot = 1470
    hx = 760 + 230 * pull
    if u < 0.12:
        role = "point"
    elif u < 0.55:
        role = "strain"
    elif u < 0.80:
        role = "hold_up"
    else:
        role = "cheer" if u < 0.92 else "shock"
    if u >= 0.12:
        hand = (hx - 40, foot - 130)
        sag = 40 * (1 - pull) if u < 0.55 else 0
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["log"]))
        cr.set_line_width(8)
        cr.move_to(kx + 46 * math.cos(ka), ky + 46 * math.sin(ka))
        cr.curve_to(kx + 60, ky + 60 + sag, hand[0] - 40, hand[1] + sag,
                    hand[0], hand[1])
        cr.stroke()
    host(role, hx, foot, 220)

    # readouts
    fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(val))}%", f"of your wake-up time is {lab.lower()}",
                80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.1)), size=140)
    if pull > 0.9:
        text(cr, lab, ccx, cy + R - lvl * 0.5 + 18, 54, look.INK, face="display",
             anchor="center", alpha=ease(seg(u, 0.5, 0.58)))
    if habit > 0:
        text(cr, "Habit", ccx, cy - R * 0.45, 58,
             P["paper_ink"], face="display", anchor="center", alpha=habit,
             shadow=False)

segments.illustrated_scene:
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """The body clock as one sun that Data pushes across the sky with a pole.
    The sun is one sleeper over a whole lifetime. For each age it slides to
    that age's mid-sleep hour: later until 20, then earlier every decade
    after. Data strains to push it there, then holds it up so the hour can
    be read. At the end he is shocked by how far back it has come by 70."""
    raw = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]

    def _age(lbl):
        d = "".join(ch for ch in lbl if ch.isdigit())
        return int(d) if d else None

    if raw and all(_age(l) is not None for l, _ in raw):
        rows = sorted(raw, key=lambda r: (_age(r[0]), r[0], r[1]))
    else:
        rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in by_time(raw)]

    dawn_sky(cr, t, y1=1120)
    if not rows:
        vgrad(cr, P["cleared"], 1100, H)
        host("think", 300, 1240, 220)
        return
    n = len(rows)
    vals = [v for _, v in rows]
    lo, hi = min(vals), max(vals)
    span = (hi - lo) or 1.0

    def fx(v):
        return (v - lo) / span

    # each move takes most of its slot, then the sun holds so it can be read
    s0, s1 = 0.08, 0.9
    slot = (s1 - s0) / max(1, n - 1)
    pos = fx(vals[0])
    k_cur = 0
    moving = False
    for k in range(1, n):
        a = s0 + (k - 1) * slot
        m = seg(u, a, a + slot * 0.72)
        if m > 0:
            pos = fx(vals[k - 1]) + (fx(vals[k]) - fx(vals[k - 1])) * ease(m)
            k_cur = k if m >= 0.5 else k - 1
            moving = 0 < m < 1

    # a later body clock leaves the sky darker
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((18, 20, 52), 0.12 + 0.45 * pos))
    cr.rectangle(0, 0, W, 1120)
    cr.fill()

    # the sun is the hero: one sun gliding along its arc to each age's hour
    sx = 230 + 620 * pos
    sy = 930 - 150 * math.sin(math.pi * (0.2 + 0.6 * pos))
    R = 200
    glow(cr, sx, sy, R * 2.1, P["sun_glow"], 0.75 + 0.12 * math.sin(t * 2.2))
    rot = t * 0.35 + pos * 2.5               # its rays turn as it travels
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["sun_hot"], 0.7))
    cr.set_line_width(16)
    for i in range(12):
        ang = rot + i * math.pi / 6
        cr.move_to(sx + math.cos(ang) * (R + 25), sy + math.sin(ang) * (R + 25))
        cr.line_to(sx + math.cos(ang) * (R + 85), sy + math.sin(ang) * (R + 85))
        cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["sun"]))
    cr.arc(sx, sy, R, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["sun_hot"], 0.55))
    cr.arc(sx - 40, sy - 40, R * 0.62, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()
    birds(cr, t, y0=560, n=4)

    # the ground: a hill Data stands on
    vgrad(cr, P["cleared"], 1100, H)
    cr.move_to(0, 1220)
    cr.curve_to(300, 1150, 760, 1170, W, 1210)
    cr.line_to(W, H)
    cr.line_to(0, H)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["leaf_far_shade"]))
    cr.fill()

    # Data's pole holds the sun up, and he moves with it
    dx = clamp(sx - 250, 110, 820)
    fy = 1240
    hand = (dx + 30, fy - 190)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["log"]))
    cr.set_line_width(14)
    cr.move_to(*hand)
    cr.line_to(sx - R * 0.62, sy + R * 0.62)
    cr.stroke()
    if u < s0:
        role = "point"
    elif u > 0.92:
        role = "shock"
    elif moving:
        role = "strain"
    else:
        role = "hold_up"
    host(role, dx, fy, 220)

    lab, v = rows[k_cur]
    fit_readout(cr, f"{v:.1f} h", f"after midnight · mid-sleep at {lab.lower()}",
                80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.06)), size=130)

    pk = max(range(n), key=lambda i: (vals[i], -i))
    b = ease(seg(u, 0.9, 0.97))
    if b > 0 and pk < n - 1:
        diff = vals[pk] - vals[-1]
        fit_readout(cr, f"{diff:.1f} h earlier",
                    f"{rows[pk][0].lower()} to {rows[-1][0].lower()}",
                    W / 2, 1390, anchor="center", a=b, rgb=P["accent2"], size=72)

        return int(d) if d else 0

    rows = sorted([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts], key=lambda r: (_age(r[0]), r[1]))
    lp, vp = max(rows, key=lambda r: (r[1], -_age(r[0])))
    ll, vl = rows[-1]

    # the bedroom the night began in: one tall window of night going to dawn
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (22, 22, 48)), (0.5, (34, 30, 64)), (1.0, (44, 36, 58))], 0, H)
    wx0, wy0, wx1, wy1 = 90, 110, 990, 780
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (14, 18, 52)), (0.6, (30, 34, 90)), (1.0, (70, 60, 110))],
          wy0, wy1, wx0, wx1)
    dawn = 0.25 + 0.6 * ease(seg(u, 0.1, 1.0))
    glow(cr, 540, wy1, 520, (240, 150, 110), 0.35 * dawn)
    mx = 820 - 380 * ease(u)
    my = 260 + 380 * ease(u)
    glow(cr, mx, my, 150, (230, 230, 255), 0.5)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 236, 250)))
    cr.arc(mx, my, 62, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 60, 90)))
    cr.set_line_width(18)
    cr.rectangle(wx0, wy0, wx1 - wx0, wy1 - wy0)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    cr.move_to(540, wy0)
    cr.line_to(540, wy1)
    cr.move_to(wx0, 450)
    cr.line_to(wx1, 450)
    cr.stroke()

    floor = 1300
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (58, 44, 52)), (1.0, (40, 30, 38))], floor, H)

    # the tug-of-war over the covers: work pulls, the body takes them back
    tug1 = ease(seg(u, 0.08, 0.26))
    yank1 = ease(seg(u, 0.32, 0.38))
    tug2 = ease(seg(u, 0.42, 0.60))
    yank2 = ease(seg(u, 0.66, 0.74))
    off = 170 * tug1 * (1 - yank1) + 240 * tug2 * (1 - yank2)
    roll = ease(seg(u, 0.66, 0.76))          # the body picks its side
    breath = 8 * math.sin(t * 1.6)

    # the bed: the hero of the frame
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((96, 66, 52)))
    cr.rectangle(80, 820, 70, floor - 820)
    cr.fill()
    cr.arc(115, 820, 35, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()
    cr.rectangle(720, 1000, 46, floor - 1000)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((230, 226, 236)))
    cr.rectangle(140, 1040, 590, 100)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 86, 66)))
    cr.rectangle(140, 1140, 590, 40)
    cr.fill()
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(240, 1010)
    cr.scale(1.0, 0.45)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((246, 244, 250)))
    cr.arc(0, 0, 100, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()
    cr.restore()
    # the sleeper's body
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(500, 1035)
    cr.scale(1.0, 0.18)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((110, 120, 170)))
    cr.arc(0, 0, 230, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()
    cr.restore()
    # the blanket, dragged toward Data and snatched back
    bx0 = 290 + off
    bx1 = 730 + off
    top = 985 - breath - 18 * roll
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"]))
    cr.move_to(bx0, 1140)
    cr.curve_to(bx0 - 10, 1060, bx0 + 40, top, bx0 + 150, top + 10)
    cr.curve_to(bx0 + 280, top + 30, bx1 - 80, 1010, bx1, 1030)
    cr.line_to(bx1 + 20, 1220)
    cr.line_to(bx1 - 40, 1230)
    cr.line_to(bx0 + 20, 1150)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()
    # the body's hand grabs its corner whenever the covers leave
    if off > 4:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((232, 192, 162)))
        cr.set_line_width(22)
        cr.move_to(300, 1030)
        cr.line_to(bx0 + 10, 1040)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.arc(bx0 + 14, 1040, 16, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()
    # head: face up, then rolled onto its side
    hx, hy = 232 + 14 * roll, 985
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((232, 192, 162)))
    cr.arc(hx, hy, 46, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((58, 40, 32)))
    cr.arc(hx - 8, hy - 6, 48, math.pi * (0.8 - 0.6 * roll), math.pi * (1.9 + 0.5 * roll))
    cr.fill()
    if roll < 0.5:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 40, 40)))
        cr.set_line_width(4)
        cr.arc(hx + 14, hy + 4, 10, 0.2, math.pi - 0.2)
        cr.stroke()

    # the body's own clock on the wall: its hand swings from the peak to the last age
    swing = ease(seg(u, 0.80, 0.90))
    hour = vp + (vl - vp) * swing
    ccx, ccy, cR = 880, 900, 70
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 230, 220)))
    cr.arc(ccx, ccy, cR, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 60, 90)))
    cr.set_line_width(8)

    cr.stroke()
    for k in range(12):
        a = k / 12 * 2 * math.pi
        cr.move_to(ccx + 54 * math.cos(a), ccy + 54 * math.sin(a))
        cr.line_to(ccx + 62 * math.cos(a), ccy + 62 * math.sin(a))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    cr.stroke()
    ah = hour / 12 * 2 * math.pi - math.pi / 2
    am = (hour % 1.0) * 2 * math.pi - math.pi / 2
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"]))
    cr.set_line_width(9)
    cr.move_to(ccx, ccy)
    cr.line_to(ccx + 38 * math.cos(ah), ccy + 38 * math.sin(ah))
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 50, 70)))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    cr.move_to(ccx, ccy)
    cr.line_to(ccx + 56 * math.cos(am), ccy + 56 * math.sin(am))
    cr.stroke()

    # Data is work: walks in, hauls the covers twice, gets them snatched back
    walkin = ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.08))
    stumble = ease(seg(u, 0.74, 0.80))
    dx = 1000 - 200 * walkin + 0.8 * off + 60 * stumble
    if u < 0.08:
        role = "think"
    elif u < 0.78:
        role = "strain"
    else:
        role = "shock"
    host(role, dx, floor, 220)

    # the finding it built to
    a1 = ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.08)) * (1 - ease(seg(u, 0.78, 0.82)))
    if a1 > 0:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{vp:.1f} h after midnight",
                    f"the body's own mid-sleep · {lp.lower()}", 80, 520,
                    a=a1, size=110)
    a2 = ease(seg(u, 0.84, 0.90))
    if a2 > 0:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{vp - vl:.1f} h earlier by {ll.lower()}",
                    "the body moved · the shift start never asked", 80, 520,
                    a=a2, size=110)

def _owl_cut(cx, R, frac):
    """x of the vertical cut whose RIGHT side holds frac of the disc's area."""
    lo, hi = -R, R
    target = frac * math.pi * R * R
    for _ in range(40):
        d = (lo + hi) / 2
        a = R * R * math.acos(clamp(d / R, -1.0, 1.0)) - d * math.sqrt(max(0.0, R * R - d * d))
        if a > target:
            lo = d
        else:
            hi = d
    return cx + (lo + hi) / 2


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """The hook: one full moon is everybody's night. Data is already hauling
    a sleeping-blanket across it, and it stops where the truth is — three
    quarters of the moon tucked in asleep, one true quarter left lit for the
    night owls. He braces the blanket there, then reels at how little is left."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    tot = sum(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    owl = [r for r in rows if "evening" in r[0].lower() or "owl" in r[0].lower()]
    (lo_, vo) = owl[0] if owl else min(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    share = vo / tot
    rest = 1.0 - share
    one_in = max(1, int(round(1.0 / share))) if share > 0 else 0

    # night sky, full height
    vgrad(cr, [(0.0, (10, 12, 34)), (0.55, (28, 30, 70)), (1.0, (44, 40, 86))], 0, H)
    for i in range(46):                         # fixed stars, they do not drift
        sx = (i * 197 + 61) % W
        sy = 80 + (i * 113) % 1180
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((230, 232, 255), 0.35 + 0.25 * ((i * 7) % 3) / 2))
        cr.arc(sx, sy, 2 + (i % 3), 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()

    cx, cy, R = 540, 1010, 330
    # the blanket is already moving in frame 1: from 40% covered to the true 75%
    k = ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.48))
    covered = 0.40 + (rest - 0.40) * k
    cut = _owl_cut(cx, R, 1.0 - covered)
    lit_a = 0.55 + 0.35 * ease(seg(u, 0.48, 0.62))

    glow(cr, cut + (cx + R - cut) / 2, cy, 520, (250, 220, 140), 0.35 * lit_a)
    # the moon: everyone's night, one whole
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((250, 228, 156)))
    cr.arc(cx, cy, R, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()
    for (mx, my, mr) in [(-120, -90, 46), (90, 60, 34), (150, -150, 26), (-40, 170, 40), (200, 130, 22)]:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((226, 198, 122), 0.8))
        cr.arc(cx + mx, cy + my, mr, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()

    # the blanket over the sleeping share, clipped to the disc
    cr.save()
    cr.arc(cx, cy, R, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.clip()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((58, 64, 98)))
    cr.rectangle(cx - R - 10, cy - R - 10, cut - (cx - R - 10), 2 * R + 20)
    cr.fill()
    for j in range(5):                          # quilt folds
        fx = cx - R + 40 + j * 70
        if fx < cut - 10:
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((44, 48, 80)))
            cr.set_line_width(6)
            cr.move_to(fx, cy - R)
            cr.curve_to(fx + 20, cy - 100, fx - 20, cy + 100, fx, cy + R)
            cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 128, 170)))      # hem along the cut
    cr.rectangle(cut - 10, cy - R, 10, 2 * R)
    cr.fill()
    cr.restore()

    # the sleepers' share speaks once the blanket lands
    za = ease(seg(u, 0.62, 0.74))
    sleep_x = (cx - R + cut) / 2
    text(cr, f"{int(round(rest * 100))}%", sleep_x, cy - 10, 96, look.INK,
         face="display", anchor="center", alpha=za)
    text(cr, "asleep", sleep_x, cy + 50, 40, look.INK, anchor="center", alpha=za)
    for j in range(3):
        zz = ease(seg(u, 0.74 + j * 0.05, 0.8 + j * 0.05))
        text(cr, "z", sleep_x + 60 + j * 34, cy - 110 - j * 40, 40 + j * 10,
             look.INK_2, anchor="center", alpha=zz, shadow=False)
    # the owls' sliver, lit
    oa = ease(seg(u, 0.5, 0.62))
    ox = (cut + cx + R) / 2
    sz = 70 + 12 * pop(seg(u, 0.5, 0.64))
    text(cr, f"{int(round(share * 100))}%", ox, cy + 20, sz, (30, 26, 60),
         face="display", anchor="center", alpha=oa, shadow=False)

    # ground, a dark hill
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((18, 20, 40)))
    cr.move_to(0, 1430)
    cr.curve_to(300, 1380, 760, 1400, W, 1440)
    cr.line_to(W, H)
    cr.line_to(0, H)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()

    # Data hauls the blanket by its rope: his spot follows the hem
    hx = clamp(cut + 190, 560, 960)
    foot = 1490
    chord = math.sqrt(max(0.0, R * R - (cut - cx) ** 2))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((200, 170, 120)))
    cr.set_line_width(7)
    cr.move_to(cut - 5, cy + chord * 0.85)
    cr.curve_to(cut + 40, cy + chord + 60, hx - 60, foot - 60, hx - 20, foot - 140)
    cr.stroke()
    role = "strain" if u < 0.52 else ("hold_up" if u < 0.84 else "shock")
    host(role, hx, foot, 220)

    fit_readout(cr, f"1 in {one_in}", "are real night owls", 80, 520,
                a=1.0, size=150)

# scene standard: 2026-10-11.2
def _mb_body(cr, cx, base, h):
    hw, nw, ny = 0.42 * h, 0.11 * h, base - 0.80 * h
    cr.move_to(cx - nw, ny)
    cr.curve_to(cx - nw - 0.06 * h, ny + 0.10 * h, cx - hw, base - 0.50 * h,
                cx - hw, base - 0.24 * h)
    cr.curve_to(cx - hw, base - 0.04 * h, cx - 0.55 * hw, base, cx, base)
    cr.curve_to(cx + 0.55 * hw, base, cx + hw, base - 0.04 * h, cx + hw, base - 0.24 * h)
    cr.curve_to(cx + hw, base - 0.50 * h, cx + nw + 0.06 * h, ny + 0.10 * h, cx + nw, ny)
    cr.close_path()


def _mb_top(cr, cx, base, h):
    ny, ty = base - 0.80 * h, base - h
    nw, fw = 0.11 * h, 0.22 * h
    cr.move_to(cx - nw, ny)
    cr.line_to(cx - fw, ty + 0.04 * h)
    for i in range(4):
        xa = cx - fw + i * fw / 2
        xb = xa + fw / 2
        ya = ty + (0.04 if i % 2 == 0 else 0.0) * h
        yb = ty + (0.0 if i % 2 == 0 else 0.04) * h
        cr.curve_to(xa + fw / 6, ya - 0.03 * h, xb - fw / 6, yb - 0.03 * h, xb, yb)
    cr.line_to(cx + nw, ny)
    cr.close_path()


def _money_bag(cr, cx, base, h):
    burlap = (204, 170, 116)
    ny, ty = base - 0.80 * h, base - h
    nw, hw = 0.11 * h, 0.42 * h
    # the coins brimming in its mouth, behind the ruffle's front lip

        disc(cr, cx - 0.14 * h + i * 0.07 * h, ty + 0.01 * h - (i % 2) * 0.02 * h,
             0.035 * h, P["coin"], finish="metal")
    _mb_body(cr, cx, base, h)
    solid(cr, burlap)
    # the cloth's folds, gathered up into the neck
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 92, 56), 0.55))
    cr.set_line_width(max(3.0, 0.008 * h))
    for sgn in (-1, 1):
        cr.move_to(cx + sgn * nw * 0.6, ny + 0.03 * h)
        cr.curve_to(cx + sgn * 0.12 * h, ny + 0.16 * h, cx + sgn * 0.26 * h,
                    base - 0.5 * h, cx + sgn * 0.30 * h, base - 0.38 * h)
    cr.stroke()
    # the dollar sign printed on its belly
    text(cr, "$", cx, base - 0.13 * h, int(0.46 * h), (34, 104, 58), face="display",
         anchor="center", shadow=False)
    _mb_top(cr, cx, base, h)
    solid(cr, (214, 182, 128))
    # the rope tied round the neck, with its bow
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((112, 70, 34)))
    cr.set_line_width(max(6.0, 0.03 * h))
    cr.move_to(cx - nw - 0.02 * h, ny)
    cr.curve_to(cx - nw * 0.4, ny + 0.025 * h, cx + nw * 0.4, ny + 0.025 * h,
                cx + nw + 0.02 * h, ny)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_line_width(max(4.0, 0.018 * h))
    for sgn in (-1, 1):
        cr.move_to(cx + nw, ny + 0.01 * h)
        cr.curve_to(cx + nw + sgn * 0.08 * h, ny - 0.06 * h, cx + nw + 0.12 * h,
                    ny + sgn * 0.04 * h, cx + nw, ny + 0.01 * h)
    cr.move_to(cx + nw, ny + 0.01 * h)
    cr.line_to(cx + nw + 0.05 * h, ny + 0.10 * h)
    cr.move_to(cx + nw, ny + 0.01 * h)
    cr.line_to(cx + nw + 0.09 * h, ny + 0.08 * h)
    cr.stroke()


def _ladder(cr, ax, ay, x0, x1, base):
    for lx in (x0, x1):
        cr.move_to(lx - 9, base)
        cr.line_to(ax - 7 + (lx - ax) * 0.04, ay)
        cr.line_to(ax + 7 + (lx - ax) * 0.04, ay)
        cr.line_to(lx + 9, base)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (150, 104, 60), rim=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 82, 46)))
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    for i in range(1, 9):
        q = i / 9.0
        y = base + (ay - base) * q
        cr.move_to(x0 + (ax - x0) * q, y)
        cr.line_to(x1 + (ax - x1) * q, y)
    cr.stroke()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a giant money bag with a dollar sign
    SUBSTANCE: gold coins
    CAUSE: Data pours buckets of gold coins into the bag's mouth and it swells bigger
    The world's billionaire fortune as the thing everyone knows it by: a
    burlap money bag, its neck tied with rope, a $ on its belly, coins
    brimming at the mouth. Its height is the count of billionaires. Data
    climbs a ladder beside it and pours bucket after bucket of gold in; with
    each pour it swells, 2015 to the middle of the run to the record. THE
    SCALE is on the bag: 2015's bag stays as a dashed ghost with its top
    marked, so "nearly doubled" reads at a glance. Done by 0.56 and held
    while he keeps pouring and stray coins roll past the camera."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    n = len(rows)
    top = max(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    v_first, v_last = rows[0][1], rows[-1][1]
    if n >= 3:
        mid_target = (v_first + v_last) / 2
        mid = min(range(1, n - 1), key=lambda i: abs(rows[i][1] - mid_target))
        keep = [0, mid, n - 1]
    else:
        keep = list(range(n))
    m = max(1, len(keep) - 1)
    a0, a1 = 0.12, 0.56
    span = (a1 - a0) / m
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, m - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    grow = ease(seg(f, 0.18, 0.78))
    if u < a0 or len(keep) < 2:
        val = rows[keep[0]][1]
        landed_to = 0
    else:
        v_from, v_to = rows[keep[k]][1], rows[keep[min(m, k + 1)]][1]
        val = v_from + (v_to - v_from) * grow
        landed_to = k + 1 if grow >= 0.999 else k
    lab, v = rows[keep[min(landed_to, len(keep) - 1)]]

    CX, BASE, HMAX = 640.0, 1440.0, 720.0
    h = HMAX * val / top
    h0 = HMAX * v_first / top

    landscape(cr, t, "town")
    haze(cr, 700, 1300, (222, 214, 204), a=0.3)
    cast_shadow(cr, CX - 0.42 * h, CX + 0.42 * h, BASE, length=300, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, CX, BASE + 4, 0.9 * h + 40, a=0.45)
    _money_bag(cr, CX, BASE, h)

    # THE SCALE on the bag: 2015's bag as a ghost, its top marked
    if u >= a0 and h - h0 > 8:
        _mb_body(cr, CX, BASE, h0)
        _mb_top(cr, CX, BASE, h0)
        ghost(cr, a=0.9)
        then_mark(cr, CX + 0.05 * h0, CX + 0.30 * h, BASE - h0, rows[0][0])

    # the ladder he climbs to reach the mouth
    LX = 350.0
    _ladder(cr, LX, 830.0, 250.0, 450.0, BASE)

    # where he stands: the rung that puts his bucket at the bag's mouth
    fy_work = min(1440.0, BASE - h + 150)
    fy0 = BASE - h0 + 150
    if u < 0.03:
        fy = BASE
    elif u < a0:
        fy = BASE + (fy0 - BASE) * ease(seg(u, 0.03, a0))
    else:
        fy = fy_work

    # the gold pouring from his bucket into the mouth
    if u >= a0 and u < a1:
        g = seg(f, 0.05, 0.62) * 1.7
    elif u >= a1:
        cyc = ((u - a1) / 0.14) % 1.0
        g = seg(cyc, 0.1, 0.7) * 1.7
    else:
        g = 0.0
    if 0 < g < 1.7:
        sx, sy = LX + 80, fy - 175
        ex, ey = CX - 0.06 * h, BASE - h + 0.02 * h
        for j in range(9):
            p = g - j * 0.08
            if 0 < p < 1:
                bx = sx + (ex - sx) * p
                by = sy + (ey - sy) * p - 110 * math.sin(math.pi * p)
                disc(cr, bx, by, 16, P["coin"], finish="metal")

    # right by the camera: stray coins rolling across the pavement
    for j in range(3):
        rx = -80 + ((t * 170 + j * 430) % 1240)
        ry = 1700 + j * 60
        contact_shadow(cr, rx, ry + 34, 70, a=0.3)
        disc(cr, rx, ry, 34 + 4 * j, P["coin"], finish="metal")
    foreground(cr, "town")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    if u < 0.03:
        host("point", LX, BASE, 220)
    elif u < a0:
        host("climb", LX, fy, 220)
    elif u < a1 + 0.04:
        host("pour", LX, fy, 220, beat=k)
    elif u < 0.92:
        host("pour", LX, fy, 220, beat=m + 1 + int((u - a1) / 0.14))
    else:
        host("cheer", LX, fy, 220)

    fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v)):,}", f"billionaires in the world · {lab}",
                80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)
    done = u >= a0 and landed_to >= m
    if done and n > 1:
        ratio = v_last / (v_first or 1.0)
        al = ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.05))

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a casino slot machine
    SUBSTANCE: gold coins
    CAUSE: Data cranks the slot machine's lever and it pays out gold coins onto the heap
    The billionaires' combined fortune as a jackpot: on a casino floor one
    big slot machine, arched topper of bulbs, three reels of coins, cherries,
    bars and bells, the lever with its red ball. Data walks up the aisle,
    takes the lever in both hands and hauls it down; each pull spins the
    reels to three coins and coins spurt out of the tray onto the heap in
    front of it, which swells from 2015's size to 2025's — big, more than
    twice as tall. Years the fortune dipped are not pulls; the heap only
    grows on the record years. THE SCALE is on the heap: 2015's heap as a
    dashed ghost with its top marked, 1x/2x ticks right up its flank, so a
    glance says more than twice as much. Done by 0.56 and held; he keeps
    pulling, the spill keeps rolling down the flanks."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    mono = []
    for r in rows:
        if not mono or r[1] >= mono[-1][1]:
            mono.append(r)

    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = mono[0], mono[-1]

    npull = len(mono) - 1

    span = (a1 - a0) / npull
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, npull - 0.001))

        val, li = v0, 0
    else:
        val = mono[k][1] + (mono[k + 1][1] - mono[k][1]) * grow
        li = k + 1 if grow >= 0.999 else k
    nm = len(mono)
    keep = sorted({round(i * (nm - 1) / max(1, READOUT_SHOWS - 1))
                   for i in range(READOUT_SHOWS)}) if nm > READOUT_SHOWS else list(range(nm))
    named = max((i for i in keep if i <= li), default=0)
    shown = mono[named]

    PER = 0.11
    if u < a0:
        pidx, pf = 0, 0.0
    elif u < a1:
        pidx, pf = k, f
    else:
        q = (u - a1) / PER
        pidx, pf = npull + int(q), q % 1.0

    # the heap is BIG: 2015's is 150px, 2025's more than twice that
    CX, BASE = 400, 1490
    H0 = 150.0
    h = H0 * val / v0
    hw = min(280.0, 1.0 * h)

    # the casino: a dark ceiling of warm lamps, banks of machines going back
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (26, 16, 28)), (0.6, (70, 34, 46)), (1, (110, 56, 60))], 0, 1170)
    for i in range(6):

        lx = 120 + 840 * z

        glow(cr, lx, ly, 160 - 80 * z, (255, 214, 150), 0.5)
        disc(cr, lx, ly, 18 - 9 * z, (255, 236, 190), finish="gloss")
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (112, 30, 44)), (1, (54, 14, 26))], 1150, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((214, 168, 70), 0.16))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(-8, 16):
        cr.move_to(i * 110, 1150)
        cr.line_to(i * 110 + 700, H)
        cr.move_to(i * 110, 1150)
        cr.line_to(i * 110 - 700, H)
    cr.stroke()
    for i in reversed(range(5)):
        s = 1.0 - 0.14 * i
        _sm_bank(cr, 790 + i * 58, 1190 - i * 14, s)
    for i in reversed(range(2)):
        s = 0.8 - 0.12 * i
        _sm_bank(cr, 20 + i * 90, 1170 - i * 12, s)
    haze(cr, 500, 1200, (96, 52, 62), a=0.5)

    # THE SLOT MACHINE, three-quarter, its long shadow on the carpet
    cast_shadow(cr, 200, 740, 1440, length=300, a=0.32)
    contact_shadow(cr, 450, 1446, 600, a=0.45)
    box(cr, 200, 1440, 440, 560, (178, 30, 42), depth=100, finish="gloss")
    box(cr, 215, 880, 410, 130, (232, 184, 62), depth=92, finish="metal")
    for j in range(3):
        _sm_coin(cr, 320 + j * 100, 818, 30, 0.95)
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(420, 750)
    cr.scale(1, 0.45)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 205, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (190, 30, 44), finish="gloss")
    for j in range(9):
        a = math.pi + math.pi * (j + 0.5) / 9
        on = 1.0 if (j + int(t * 4)) % 2 else 0.55
        disc(cr, 420 + 180 * math.cos(a), 750 + 0.45 * 180 * math.sin(a) + 4, 9,
             tuple(int(c * on) for c in (255, 232, 160)), finish="gloss")
    bx = 420 + 46 * math.sin(t * 2.2)
    glow(cr, bx, 650, 90, (255, 90, 70), 0.5)
    disc(cr, 420, 660, 26, (220, 40, 40), finish="gloss")
    cr.rectangle(235, 925, 370, 190)
    solid(cr, (200, 204, 214), finish="metal")
    for r in range(3):
        sp = ease(seg(pf, 0.12, 0.42 + 0.08 * r)) if u >= a0 else 0.0
        _sm_reel(cr, 250 + r * 120, 940, 100, 160, 10 * (pidx + sp))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((210, 30, 40), 0.9))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    cr.move_to(244, 1020)
    cr.line_to(596, 1020)
    cr.stroke()
    box(cr, 200, 1170, 440, 26, (70, 70, 80), depth=100, finish="metal")
    for j, col in enumerate([(230, 60, 50), (240, 200, 70), (70, 170, 90)]):
        disc(cr, 290 + j * 90, 1156, 14, col, finish="gloss")
    # the payout chute, lit gold from inside
    cr.rectangle(300, 1215, 240, 50)
    solid(cr, (30, 20, 22), rim=False)
    glow(cr, 420, 1240, 120, (255, 200, 90), 0.35)
    box(cr, 280, 1290, 280, 26, (200, 204, 212), finish="metal")

    # the jackpot heap spilling out onto the carpet, made of coins
    cast_shadow(cr, CX - hw, CX + hw, BASE, length=260, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, CX, BASE + 4, 2 * hw + 60, a=0.45)
    heap_path(cr, CX, BASE, h, hw)
    solid(cr, (206, 156, 44), finish="metal")
    cr.save()
    heap_path(cr, CX, BASE, h, hw)
    cr.clip()
    count = int(70 + 160 * (val - v0) / max(0.01, v1 - v0))
    for i in range(count):
        dx = ((i * 0.6180339) % 1.0) * 1.9 - 0.95
        py = (i * 0.4142136) % 1.0
        px = CX + hw * dx
        ty = heap_top(CX, BASE, h, hw, px)
        yy = BASE - (BASE - ty) * py * 0.95 - 4
        _sm_coin(cr, px, yy, 17 + 6 * ((i * 0.37) % 1.0), 0.35 + 0.3 * ((i * 0.53) % 1.0))
    cr.restore()
    heap_path(cr, CX, BASE, h, hw)
    edge(cr, (90, 60, 14))

    # THE SCALE on the heap: 2015's heap as a ghost, its top marked, ticks
    # right up its flank
    if u >= a0 and val > v0 + 0.05:
        heap_path(cr, CX, BASE, H0, hw0)
        ghost(cr, a=0.9)
        then_mark(cr, CX - 130, CX + 130, BASE - H0, l0)
        times_ticks(cr, 50, BASE, H0, max(1, int(ratio)))

    # the lever on the machine's side, at Data's hands: hauled down, sprung back
    th = 0.35
    if u >= a0:
        th += 1.85 * (ease(seg(pf, 0.0, 0.12)) - ease(seg(pf, 0.14, 0.32)))
    PX, PY, L = 708, 1250, 165
    ex, ey = PX + L * math.sin(th), PY - L * math.cos(th)
    disc(cr, PX, PY, 24, (190, 194, 204), finish="metal")
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 154, 164)))
    cr.set_line_width(16)
    cr.move_to(PX, PY)
    cr.line_to(ex, ey)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 238, 244), 0.8))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    cr.move_to(PX - 3, PY - 2)
    cr.line_to(ex - 3, ey - 2)
    cr.stroke()
    disc(cr, ex, ey, 30, (214, 30, 36), finish="gloss")

    # the payout: coins spurt from the chute onto the heap
    if u >= a0:
        sp = seg(pf, 0.38, 0.85)
        if 0 < sp < 1:
            mx, my = 420, min(1240.0, BASE - h - 30)
            for j in range(9):
                q = clamp(sp * 1.6 - j * 0.08)
                if 0 < q < 1:
                    tx = CX + (j - 4) * 60
                    ty = heap_top(CX, BASE, h, hw, tx) - 8
                    x = mx + (tx - mx) * q
                    y = my + (ty - my) * q - 150 * math.sin(math.pi * q)
                    _sm_coin(cr, x, y, 22, 0.25 + 0.7 * abs(math.sin(q * 6 + j)))
    if u > a1:
        for j in range(3):
            ph = ((u - a1) / 0.15 + j / 3) % 1.0
            side = 1 if j % 2 else -1
            x = CX + side * hw * (0.1 + 0.85 * ph)
            y = heap_top(CX, BASE, h, hw, x) - 8
            _sm_coin(cr, x, y, 20, 0.3 + 0.6 * abs(math.sin(ph * 9 + j)))

    # right by the camera: a coin cup brimming, coins on the carpet
    contact_shadow(cr, 880, 1822, 150, a=0.45)
    cylinder(cr, 820, 1820, 120, 150, (232, 232, 238), finish="gloss")
    for j in range(5):
        _sm_coin(cr, 838 + j * 22, 1676 - (j % 2) * 8, 20, 0.4)
    for (x, y, r) in [(110, 1760, 34), (250, 1850, 40), (170, 1900, 30), (640, 1880, 36)]:
        contact_shadow(cr, x, y + 6, 2.2 * r, a=0.3)
        _sm_coin(cr, x, y, r, 0.42)
    rx = -100 + ((t * 170) % 1300)
    _sm_coin(cr, rx, 1720, 30, 0.95)
    vignette(cr, a=0.3)

    # Data: walks up the aisle to the machine, then hauls the lever, pull
    # after pull, his hands on its red ball
    m = ease(seg(u, 0.0, a0))
    hx = 1040 + (800 - 1040) * m
    if u < a0:

    elif u < a1 + 0.02:
        host("crank", 800, 1460, 240, beat=k)
    else:
        host("crank", 800, 1460, 240, beat=pidx)

    lab, v = shown
    fit_readout(cr, f"${v:.1f} trillion", f"all billionaires combined · {lab}",
                80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)
