        cr.line_to(-5, -72)
        cr.line_to(5, -72)
        cr.line_to(30, -142)
        cr.line_to(21, -142)
        cr.line_to(0, -86)
        cr.line_to(-21, -142)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (40, 72, 156), rim=False)
        disc(cr, 0, -62, 17, (226, 182, 64), finish="metal")
    cr.restore()
    cr.restore()


def _nb_curtain(cr, x0, x1):
    cr.rectangle(x0, 0, x1 - x0, 1500)
    solid(cr, (150, 28, 36))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((90, 14, 22), 0.7))
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    for i in range(1, 5):
        fx = x0 + (x1 - x0) * i / 5.0
        cr.move_to(fx, 0)
        cr.line_to(fx + 6, 1500)
    cr.stroke()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: three prizewinners on an awards stage
    SUBSTANCE: men in tailcoats
    CAUSE: Data hangs a gold medal on each white-haired man who walks on to replace a young one
    The chemistry prize is shared by up to three, so the WHOLE is the three
    laureates in white tie standing on the Nobel stage under the gold
    medallion. Last century two of the three (the share) were under forty:
    dark hair, young faces, medals on. One young winner after another walks
    off into the wings, a white-haired, bespectacled man in tails walks on
    to take the mark, and Data hangs the medal on him. The banner over them
    is cut at the share in the accent, notched where last century stood,
    and shrinks to nothing. Landed by 0.66 and held: three seasoned
    laureates bowing to the applause while Data holds up the last medal."""
    rows = _nb_order([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    N = 3
    y0 = int(clamp(round(N * v0 / 100.0), 0, N))
    yN = int(clamp(round(N * v1 / 100.0), 0, N))
    m = max(0, y0 - yN)
    a0, a1 = 0.06, 0.66
    span = (a1 - a0) / max(1, m)
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, max(1, m) - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span) if u >= a0 else 0.0
    land = ease(seg(f, 0.7, 0.85))
    if u < a0 or m == 0:
        val = v0
    else:
        val = v0 + (v1 - v0) * clamp((k + land) / m)
    landed_now = u >= a1
    after = clamp((u - a1) / 0.04)

    SX = [250, 540, 830]
    FOOT = 1390
    PH = 420

    # the Nobel stage: deep blue backdrop, the gold medallion
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (12, 20, 44)), (0.6, (28, 48, 98)), (1, (44, 66, 122))], 0, 1200)
    glow(cr, 540, 700, 330, (255, 214, 120), 0.35)
    disc(cr, 540, 700, 165, (212, 170, 72), finish="metal")
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 110, 40)))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    cr.arc(540, 700, 138, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(555, 692)
    cr.scale(0.8, 1.0)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 68, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.move_to(503, 690)
    cr.line_to(482, 722)
    cr.line_to(506, 728)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (182, 140, 54), finish="metal")
    cr.rectangle(530, 750, 56, 60)
    solid(cr, (182, 140, 54), finish="metal", rim=False)
    haze(cr, 0, 420, (24, 40, 84), a=0.25)
    # flower urns at the back corners
    for fx in (190, 890):
        contact_shadow(cr, fx, 1192, 120, a=0.3)
        cylinder(cr, fx - 40, 1190, 80, 70, (220, 214, 200))
        for j in range(7):
            disc(cr, fx - 48 + j * 16, 1104 - 14 * math.sin(j * 1.3), 18,
                 [(232, 196, 70), (240, 240, 236), (210, 60, 70)][j % 3])
    # the stage floor
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (56, 74, 130)), (1, (30, 40, 80))], 1180, 1500)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((20, 26, 50), 0.6))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    cr.move_to(0, 1182)
    cr.line_to(W, 1182)
    cr.stroke()

    # a spotlight sweeping the stage
    sx = 540 + 300 * math.sin(t * 1.2)
    cr.move_to(500, -20)
    cr.line_to(580, -20)
    cr.line_to(sx + 190, 1400)
    cr.line_to(sx - 190, 1400)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 246, 220), 0.10))
    cr.fill()
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(sx, 1400)
    cr.scale(1, 0.22)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 200, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 246, 220), 0.24))
    cr.fill()

    # who stands on each mark
    standing, leaving, coming = [], [], []
    for si in range(N):
        young0 = si < y0
        if young0 and si >= yN and m > 0:
            j = y0 - 1 - si
            if u < a0 or j > k:
                standing.append((SX[si], False, True, si))
            elif j < k:
                standing.append((SX[si], True, True, si))
            else:
                ex = SX[si] + (-280 - SX[si]) * ease(seg(f, 0.0, 0.55))
                if ex > -260:
                    leaving.append((ex, si))
                cx = 1320 + (SX[si] - 1320) * ease(seg(f, 0.15, 0.7))
                coming.append((cx, f >= 0.8, si, f < 0.7))
        else:
            standing.append((SX[si], not young0, True, si))

    for ex, si in leaving:
        _nb_person(cr, ex, FOOT - 14, PH * 0.97, False, t, walk=t * 9, medal=True, v=si)
    for x, old, med, si in standing:
        bow = 0.0
        if landed_now:
            bow = after * max(0.0, math.sin(t * 2.6 - si * 0.9)) ** 2
        cast_shadow(cr, x - 50, x + 50, FOOT, length=140, a=0.15)
        _nb_person(cr, x, FOOT, PH, old, t, bow=bow, medal=med, v=si)
    for cx, med, si, moving in coming:
        _nb_person(cr, cx, FOOT + 6, PH, True, t, walk=t * 9 if moving else 0.0,
                   medal=med, v=si + 1)

    # the banner over the three, cut at the under-forty share
    BX0, BX1, BY = 150, 930, 884
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 62, 70)))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    for cxx in (BX0 + 20, BX1 - 20):
        cr.move_to(cxx, BY)
        cr.line_to(cxx, 0)
    cr.stroke()
    cut = BX0 + (BX1 - BX0) * clamp(val / 100.0)
    if BX1 - cut > 2:
        cr.rectangle(cut, BY, BX1 - cut, 48)
        solid(cr, (150, 152, 158))
    if cut - BX0 > 2:
        cr.rectangle(BX0, BY, cut - BX0, 48)
        solid(cr, P["accent2"])
    if cut - BX0 > 280:
        text(cr, "UNDER FORTY", BX0 + 18, BY + 36, 30, look.INK, face="bold", shadow=False)
    elif BX1 - cut > 330:
        text(cr, "FORTY AND OVER", BX1 - 18, BY + 36, 30, look.INK, face="bold",
             anchor="right", shadow=False)
    if u >= a0:
        nx = BX0 + (BX1 - BX0) * clamp(v0 / 100.0)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((244, 238, 226)))
        cr.set_line_width(6)
        cr.move_to(nx, BY - 10)
        cr.line_to(nx, BY + 56)
        cr.stroke()
        text(cr, l0, nx, BY - 18, 30, look.INK, face="bold", anchor="center")

    # the wings: exits go behind the curtains
    _nb_curtain(cr, 0, 130)
    _nb_curtain(cr, 950, W)
    cr.rectangle(0, 0, W, 130)
    solid(cr, (130, 24, 32))

    # the stage lip and the audience right by the camera, applauding at the end
    cr.rectangle(0, 1500, W, 64)
    solid(cr, (84, 58, 40))
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (18, 20, 34)), (1, (8, 8, 14))], 1564, H)
    hairs = [(40, 32, 30), (120, 110, 104), (70, 48, 34), (200, 196, 190)]
    for i in range(7):
        hx_ = 60 + i * 160
        hy_ = 1790 + (i % 2) * 70
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(hx_, hy_ + 150)
        cr.scale(1.5, 0.8)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 90, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        solid(cr, (30, 30, 40))
        disc(cr, hx_, hy_, 64, hairs[i % 4])
        if landed_now:
            gap = 14 + 26 * abs(math.sin(t * 8 + i * 1.3))
            for sg in (-1, 1):
                disc(cr, hx_ + sg * gap, hy_ - 92, 20, (220, 178, 150))
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data walks to each mark and hangs the medal on the new laureate
    if m > 0 and u >= a0:
        prev = 960 if k == 0 else SX[y0 - k] + 150
        tgt = SX[y0 - 1 - k] + 150
        dx = prev + (tgt - prev) * ease(seg(f, 0.0, 0.55))
    elif m > 0:
        dx = 960
    else:
        dx = 960 - 300 * ease(seg(u, 0.1, 0.5))
    if u < a0:
        host("point", dx, 1480, 220)
    elif u < a1 + 0.04:
        host("place", dx, 1480, 220, beat=k)
    else:
        host("hold_up", dx, 1480, 220)

    if landed_now:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v1))}%", f"of chemistry Nobel winners under forty · {l1}",
                    80, 520, size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v0))}%", f"of chemistry Nobel winners under forty · {l0}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

stories.hook_was: Science used to reward the young. Not anymore.

stories.title: Only 41% Of American Boys Still Play Sports Regularly
stories.hook: Your son's team is quietly disappearing, and poor kids are losing it first.
stories.closing: Data benched himself in 2013. Never looked back.
stories.question: Did you play sports as a kid?
stories.caption: In 2013, half of American boys played a sport regularly. Now it's 41 percent -- and the drop is steepest for the kids who can least afford to be left out. Here's the data 👇

segments.say: Ten years ago, half of American boys played team sports. Now it's barely four in ten.
Poorer teens got hit hardest: only about one in four still plays.
segments.illustrated_scene:
# scene standard: 2026-10-09
def _yk_kid(cr, x, y, s, t, i, jersey, a=1.0, run=True):
    h = 100.0 * s
    ph = t * (9.0 if run else 5.0) + i * 1.7
    sw = math.sin(ph) * (0.5 if run else 0.25)
    contact_shadow(cr, x, y, 44 * s, a=0.3 * a)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((38, 40, 52), a))
    cr.set_line_width(max(3.0, 8 * s))
    cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
    hip = y - 0.45 * h
    cr.move_to(x - 4 * s, hip)
    cr.line_to(x - 4 * s + sw * 0.22 * h, y)
    cr.move_to(x + 4 * s, hip)
    cr.line_to(x + 4 * s - sw * 0.22 * h, y)
    cr.stroke()
    skin = [(232, 190, 150), (160, 110, 76), (110, 72, 50), (200, 150, 110)][i % 4]
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(skin, a))
    cr.set_line_width(max(3.0, 7 * s))
    sh = y - 0.76 * h
    cr.move_to(x - 0.13 * h, sh)
    cr.line_to(x - 0.13 * h - sw * 0.2 * h, sh + 0.3 * h)
    cr.move_to(x + 0.13 * h, sh)
    cr.line_to(x + 0.13 * h + sw * 0.2 * h, sh + 0.3 * h)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.new_path()
    cr.rectangle(x - 0.14 * h, y - 0.84 * h, 0.28 * h, 0.42 * h)
    solid(cr, jersey, a=a)
    disc(cr, x, y - 0.95 * h, 0.12 * h, skin, a=a)


def _yk_ghost_kid(cr, x, y, s):
    h = 100.0 * s
    cr.new_path()
    cr.rectangle(x - 0.14 * h, y - 0.84 * h, 0.28 * h, 0.42 * h)
    cr.new_sub_path()
    cr.arc(x, y - 0.95 * h, 0.12 * h, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.move_to(x - 4 * s, y - 0.42 * h)
    cr.line_to(x - 4 * s, y)
    cr.move_to(x + 4 * s, y - 0.42 * h)
    cr.line_to(x + 4 * s, y)
    ghost(cr, a=0.9)


def _yk_jersey(cr, x, y, s, rgb, a=1.0):
    k = 64.0 * s
    shape = [(-0.16, 0), (-0.5, 0.1), (-0.66, 0.4), (-0.42, 0.5), (-0.36, 0.32),
             (-0.36, 1.0), (0.36, 1.0), (0.36, 0.32), (0.42, 0.5), (0.66, 0.4),
             (0.5, 0.1), (0.16, 0)]
    cr.new_path()
    cr.move_to(x + shape[0][0] * k, y + shape[0][1] * k)
    for px_, py_ in shape[1:]:
        cr.line_to(x + px_ * k, y + py_ * k)
    cr.curve_to(x + 0.1 * k, y + 0.16 * k, x - 0.1 * k, y + 0.16 * k, x - 0.16 * k, y)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, rgb, a=a)
    cr.rectangle(x - 0.36 * k, y + 0.56 * k, 0.72 * k, 0.1 * k)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((248, 248, 244), 0.85 * a))
    cr.fill()
    disc(cr, x, y - 3, 6 * s, (70, 72, 80), finish="metal", a=a)


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a neighborhood soccer field full of kids
    SUBSTANCE: the kids playing
    CAUSE: Data takes each quitting kid's jersey and places it on the sideline fence as the kid walks off the field
    The whole team on the field is every low-income teen. Kid by kid, the
    ones who quit run to the sideline, hand Data their jersey and walk away;
    he places each jersey on the fence rail, moving down it. First the field
    thins to 2012's share, holds, then thins again to 2022's — about one in
    four still playing. The 2012 players who left since stay as dashed
    outlines where they stood, so the loss reads on the field itself.
    Done by ~0.66 and held: the last few kids keep passing the ball."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    p0, p1 = clamp(v0 / 100.0), clamp(v1 / 100.0)
    N = 16
    n0 = max(1, min(N, int(round(p0 * N))))
    n1 = max(1, min(n0, int(round(p1 * N))))
    order = [5, 11, 2, 14, 8, 0, 9, 3, 13, 6, 15, 1, 10, 4, 12, 7]
    spots = [(((i * 0.618034) % 1.0) * 0.8 + 0.1, ((i * 0.41421) % 1.0) * 0.78 + 0.1)
             for i in range(N)]
    leavers = order[n0:] + order[n1:n0]
    m1, m2 = N - n0, n0 - n1
    M = len(leavers)
    D = 0.12
    starts = []
    for m in range(M):
        if m < m1:
            starts.append(0.06 + (0.22 * m / (m1 - 1) if m1 > 1 else 0.0))
        else:
            gap = min(0.05, 0.08 / max(1, m2 - 1))
            starts.append(0.46 + (m - m1) * gap)
    arr = [s_ + D for s_ in starts]
    end1 = max(arr[:m1]) if m1 else 0.06
    end2 = max(arr) if M else 0.06
    done1, done2 = u >= end1, u >= end2

    FY0, FY1 = 860.0, 1440.0

    def lx(y):
        return 200 + (10 - 200) * (y - FY0) / (FY1 - FY0)

    def rx(y):
        return 880 + (1070 - 880) * (y - FY0) / (FY1 - FY0)

    def px(y, s):
        return lx(y) + (rx(y) - lx(y)) * s

    def at(fx, fy):
        y = FY0 + (FY1 - FY0) * fy
        return px(y, fx), y, 0.75 + 0.8 * fy

    def slot_x(j):
        return 90 + j * (820.0 / max(1, M - 1))

    landscape(cr, t, "town", horizon=840)
    for x in (170, 900):
        cast_shadow(cr, x, x + 18, FY0, length=260, a=0.25)
        contact_shadow(cr, x + 9, FY0 + 2, 50, a=0.35)
        cylinder(cr, x, FY0, 18, 360, (150, 154, 162), finish="metal")
        glow(cr, x + 9, FY0 - 370, 90, (255, 244, 210), 0.5)
        box(cr, x - 30, FY0 - 352, 78, 34, (226, 228, 232), depth=16, finish="metal")
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (84, 128, 64)), (1, (58, 98, 46))], FY1 - 10, H)

    # the pitch, mown in stripes
    cr.move_to(lx(FY0), FY0)
    cr.line_to(rx(FY0), FY0)
    cr.line_to(rx(FY1), FY1)
    cr.line_to(lx(FY1), FY1)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (82, 150, 70))
    for i in range(0, 12, 2):
        a_, b_ = i / 12.0, (i + 1) / 12.0
        cr.move_to(px(FY0, a_), FY0)
        cr.line_to(px(FY0, b_), FY0)
        cr.line_to(px(FY1, b_), FY1)
        cr.line_to(px(FY1, a_), FY1)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((112, 178, 88), 0.55))
        cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((246, 246, 240), 0.9))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    cr.move_to(lx(FY0), FY0)
    cr.line_to(rx(FY0), FY0)
    cr.line_to(rx(FY1), FY1)
    cr.line_to(lx(FY1), FY1)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.move_to(px(FY0, 0.5), FY0)
    cr.line_to(px(FY1, 0.5), FY1)
    cr.stroke()
    cy_ = (FY0 + FY1) / 2
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(px(cy_, 0.5), cy_)
    cr.scale(1.0, 0.4)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 130, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.stroke()

    # the left goal
    gA, gB = at(0.0, 0.35), at(0.0, 0.62)
    hA, hB = 150 * gA[2], 150 * gB[2]
    cast_shadow(cr, gA[0] - 40, gB[0] + 20, gB[1], length=160, a=0.22)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((235, 238, 240), 0.5))
    cr.set_line_width(2)
    for j in range(7):
        q = j / 6.0
        xa = gA[0] + (gB[0] - gA[0]) * q
        ya = gA[1] + (gB[1] - gA[1]) * q
        hh = hA + (hB - hA) * q
        cr.move_to(xa, ya - hh)
        cr.line_to(xa - 60, ya - hh * 0.4)
        cr.line_to(xa - 60, ya)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((250, 250, 250)))
    cr.set_line_width(9)
    cr.move_to(gA[0], gA[1])
    cr.line_to(gA[0], gA[1] - hA)
    cr.line_to(gB[0], gB[1] - hB)
    cr.line_to(gB[0], gB[1])
    cr.stroke()

    teams = [(214, 64, 48), (60, 110, 200)]

    # THE SCALE on the field: the 2012 players who have since quit, as ghosts
    if done2 and m2 > 0:
        far = None
        for i in order[n1:n0]:
            gx, gy, gs = at(*spots[i])
            _yk_ghost_kid(cr, gx, gy, gs)
            if far is None or abs(gx - 540) > abs(far[0] - 540):
                far = (gx, gy, gs)
        text(cr, l0, far[0], far[1] - 118 * far[2], 28, look.INK, face="bold",
             anchor="center")

    # the kids: players keep playing, quitters run to the fence and walk off
    drawn, players = [], []
    for i in range(N):
        fx0, fy0 = spots[i]
        jersey = teams[i % 2]
        if i in leavers:
            m = leavers.index(i)
            st, ar = starts[m], arr[m]
            if u < st:
                fx = clamp(fx0 + 0.04 * math.sin(t * 1.8 + i), 0.04, 0.96)
                fy = clamp(fy0 + 0.04 * math.cos(t * 1.3 + i), 0.05, 0.95)
                x, y, s = at(fx, fy)
                drawn.append((y, x, s, i, jersey, 1.0, True))
                players.append((x, y, s))
            elif u < ar:
                w = ease((u - st) / D)
                x0, y0, s0 = at(fx0, fy0)
                tx = slot_x(m)
                drawn.append((y0 + (1468 - y0) * w, x0 + (tx - x0) * w,
                              s0 + (1.45 - s0) * w, i, jersey, 1.0, True))
            else:
                w = clamp((u - ar) / 0.16)
                if w < 1:
                    drawn.append((1468, slot_x(m) - 620 * w, 1.45, i, (150, 150, 156),
                                  1.0 - w, True))
        else:
            fx = clamp(fx0 + 0.05 * math.sin(t * 1.8 + i), 0.04, 0.96)
            fy = clamp(fy0 + 0.04 * math.cos(t * 1.3 + i), 0.05, 0.95)
            x, y, s = at(fx, fy)
            drawn.append((y, x, s, i, jersey, 1.0, True))
            players.append((x, y, s))
    for y, x, s, i, jersey, alpha, run in sorted(drawn):
        _yk_kid(cr, x, y, s, t, i, jersey, a=alpha, run=run)
    if len(players) >= 2:
        pp = sorted(players)
        idx = int(t / 0.8) % len(pp)
        q = (t / 0.8) % 1.0
        (xa, ya, sa), (xb, yb, sb) = pp[idx], pp[(idx + 1) % len(pp)]
        bx, by = xa + (xb - xa) * ease(q), ya + (yb - ya) * ease(q)
        hop = 70 * math.sin(math.pi * q)
        contact_shadow(cr, bx, by, 30, a=0.3)
        disc(cr, bx, by - 14 - hop, 14, (246, 246, 246), finish="gloss")

    # the sideline fence the jerseys hang on
    for x in range(40, 1080, 125):
        contact_shadow(cr, x + 6, 1520, 34, a=0.35)
        box(cr, x, 1520, 12, 125, (150, 154, 162), depth=6, finish="metal")
    for ry in (1402, 1488):
        cr.rectangle(30, ry, 1020, 12)
        solid(cr, (176, 180, 188), finish="metal")
    for m in range(M):
        if u >= arr[m]:
            pj = pop(clamp((u - arr[m]) / 0.05))
            _yk_jersey(cr, slot_x(m), 1410, 0.85 * pj, teams[leavers[m] % 2])
    if done1 and 0 < m1 < M:
        bx = (slot_x(m1 - 1) + slot_x(m1)) / 2
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((244, 238, 226)))
        cr.set_line_width(6)
        cr.move_to(bx, 1392)
        cr.line_to(bx, 1500)
        cr.stroke()

    # right by the camera: a ball and a water bottle in the grass
    contact_shadow(cr, 880, 1790, 150, a=0.4)
    disc(cr, 880, 1725, 70, (248, 248, 248), finish="gloss")
    for ang in (0.3, 2.4, 4.4):
        disc(cr, 880 + 38 * math.cos(ang), 1725 + 38 * math.sin(ang), 15, (40, 40, 46))
    disc(cr, 880, 1725, 17, (40, 40, 46))
    bottle(cr, 190, 1740, 0.35, 3.2, (70, 140, 220))
    foreground(cr, "field")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data works down the fence, at the slot of the jersey coming in
    pos = sum(clamp((u - (a_ - 0.09)) / 0.07) for a_ in arr)
    hx = slot_x(clamp(pos - 0.5, 0, max(0, M - 1))) + 55
    hy = 1515
    if u < 0.06:
        host("point", slot_x(0) + 55, hy, 220)
    elif u < 0.68:

    else:

    if done2:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v1))}%",
                    f"of low-income teens still play sports · {l1}, about 1 in {int(round(100 / max(1.0, v1)))}",
                    80, 520, size=130)

segments.say: Indoor farms raised $8 billion in four years, then barely an eighth of that after. Investors lost faith.

# scene standard: 2026-10-16.2
def _vj_path(cr, x0, x1, top, base):
    # a glass jar's outline: a threaded neck, round shoulders, a wide body
    w = x1 - x0
    nk = 0.16 * w
    sh = top + 80
    r = 38
    cr.new_path()
    cr.move_to(x0 + nk, top + 22)
    cr.curve_to(x0 + nk, sh - 10, x0, sh - 24, x0, sh + 36)
    cr.line_to(x0, base - r)
    cr.curve_to(x0, base, x0, base, x0 + r, base)
    cr.line_to(x1 - r, base)
    cr.curve_to(x1, base, x1, base, x1, base - r)
    cr.line_to(x1, sh + 36)
    cr.curve_to(x1, sh - 24, x1 - nk, sh - 10, x1 - nk, top + 22)
    cr.close_path()


def _vj_level(top, base, fill):
    lo, hi = base - 10, top + 96
    return lo - (lo - hi) * fill


def _vj_coin(cr, x, y, r, tilt=0.42):
    # a real gold coin lying flat: its milled edge below, a lit metal face on top
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.scale(1, tilt)
    cr.arc(0, 9, r, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["coin_edge"]))
    cr.fill()
    disc(cr, 0, 0, r, P["coin"], finish="metal")
    cr.arc(0, 0, r * 0.68, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["coin_edge"], 0.55))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()


def _vj_jar(cr, x0, x1, top, base, fill):
    w = x1 - x0
    nk = 0.16 * w
    # the back of the glass
    _vj_path(cr, x0, x1, top, base)
    solid(cr, (196, 222, 230), finish="glass", a=0.35, edge=False)
    # the gold inside, coins heaped every which way up to a mounded top
    if fill > 0.002:
        ly = _vj_level(top, base, fill)
        cr.save()
        _vj_path(cr, x0, x1, top, base)
        cr.clip()
        cr.rectangle(x0, ly + 6, w, base - ly)
        solid(cr, (150, 104, 30), finish="metal", rim=False, edge=False)
        y = base - 16
        row = 0
        while y > ly + 4:
            x = x0 + 10 + ((row * 0.618) % 1.0) * 30
            i = 0
            while x < x1 + 10:
                jx = ((i * 0.4142 + row * 0.73) % 1.0) * 10 - 5
                jy = ((i * 0.7071 + row * 0.31) % 1.0) * 8 - 4
                tl = 0.36 + 0.18 * ((i * 0.37 + row * 0.11) % 1.0)
                _vj_coin(cr, x + jx, y + jy, 27, tl)
                x += 44
                i += 1
            y -= 24
            row += 1
        # the mounded top of the gold, higher in the middle
        x = x0 + 12
        i = 0
        while x < x1:
            m = math.sin(math.pi * (x - x0) / w)
            _vj_coin(cr, x, ly + 6 - 14 * m - 5 * ((i * 7) % 3), 27,
                     0.36 + 0.1 * (i % 3))
            x += 38
            i += 1
        cr.restore()
    # the front of the glass: two long highlights and an ink edge
    cr.save()
    _vj_path(cr, x0, x1, top, base)
    cr.clip()
    cr.rectangle(x0 + 20, top + 110, 26, base - top - 160)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 255, 255), 0.32))
    cr.fill()
    cr.rectangle(x0 + 60, top + 130, 9, base - top - 210)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 255, 255), 0.22))
    cr.fill()
    cr.restore()
    _vj_path(cr, x0, x1, top, base)
    edge(cr, (48, 58, 66), width=6)
    # the screw-thread neck
    cr.rectangle(x0 + nk - 8, top - 4, w - 2 * nk + 16, 34)
    solid(cr, (176, 182, 190), finish="metal")
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((96, 102, 112)))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for j in range(3):
        cr.move_to(x0 + nk - 6, top + 5 + j * 9)
        cr.line_to(x1 - nk + 6, top + 9 + j * 9)
    cr.stroke()


def _vj_stream(cr, sx, sy, ex, top, ey, t):
    # coins poured from the bucket: up over the rim, then falling into the jar
    for i in range(10):
        s = (t * 1.6 + i / 10.0) % 1.0
        if s < 0.45:
            p = s / 0.45
            x = sx + (ex - sx) * p
            y = sy + (top - 30 - sy) * p - 70 * math.sin(math.pi * p)
        else:
            q = (s - 0.45) / 0.55
            x = ex + 16 * math.sin(i * 1.7)
            y = top - 30 + (ey - (top - 30)) * q * q
        _vj_coin(cr, x, y, 24, 0.5 + 0.4 * math.sin(i + t * 6))


def _vj_ladder(cr, cx, top, base, w):
    # a sturdy wooden step ladder with a platform at the top to stand on
    contact_shadow(cr, cx, base + 4, w + 60, a=0.45)
    for rx in (cx - w / 2, cx + w / 2 - 22):
        cr.rectangle(rx, top, 22, base - top)
        solid(cr, (150, 108, 62))
    y = top + 70
    while y < base - 20:
        cr.rectangle(cx - w / 2 + 14, y, w - 28, 16)
        solid(cr, (176, 132, 82), rim=False)
        y += 80
    box(cr, cx - w / 2 - 10, top + 4, w + 20, 22, (176, 132, 82), depth=18)


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: two glass jars of gold coins
    SUBSTANCE: gold coins
    CAUSE: Data pours bucket after bucket of coins into the first jar until it is full, then pours the next years' money into the second and it barely covers the bottom
    The money the vertical farm behind them raised. Four years of it fills
    the first jar to the neck, bucket by bucket, Data up a ladder at its
    mouth. He climbs down, up the next ladder, and pours the next two years'
    money into an identical jar: it covers only an eighth of it, and ticks
    up the second jar's side count how many of those it would take to fill
    it like the first — 1x to 8x — so one look says "an eighth". Landed by
    0.62 and held: Data holds up his empty bucket while the investors'
    trucks drive away down the road."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    v0 = v0 or 1.0
    share = clamp(v1 / v0)
    ratio = v0 / v1 if v1 else 8.0

    TOP, BASE = 790, 1440
    J1, J2 = (205, 525), (640, 960)
    n1 = 4
    a0, a1 = 0.06, 0.40
    span = (a1 - a0) / n1
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n1 - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    fill1 = 0.0 if u < a0 else (k + ease(seg(f, 0.2, 0.75))) / n1
    b0, b1 = 0.48, 0.62
    f2 = seg(u, b0, b1)
    fill2 = share * ease(seg(f2, 0.2, 0.6))
    full1 = fill1 >= 0.999
    done2 = f2 >= 0.6

    landscape(cr, t, "field")
    # the vertical farm the money was for: stacked floors of lettuce under pink light
    cast_shadow(cr, 110, 970, 1160, length=240, a=0.2)
    b = building(cr, 110, 970, 1160, 470, (206, 210, 216), roof="flat", boards=False)
    cols, nrows = 6, 4
    gw = (b["x1"] - b["x0"] - 40) / cols
    gh = (b["base"] - b["top"] - 110) / nrows
    for r_ in range(nrows):
        for c_ in range(cols):
            wx = b["x0"] + 20 + c_ * gw + 7
            wy = b["top"] + 90 + r_ * gh + 7
            cr.rectangle(wx, wy, gw - 14, gh - 14)
            solid(cr, (226, 112, 190), finish="glass", rim=False)
            cr.rectangle(wx + 4, wy + 4, gw - 22, 7)
            solid(cr, (255, 196, 236), finish="gloss", rim=False, edge=False)
            for j in range(3):
                disc(cr, wx + 18 + j * (gw - 50) / 2, wy + gh - 30, 12, (96, 178, 72))
    # the farm's sign, up on the roof at the far right where Data never goes
    sx0, sx1 = 700, b["x1"] - 14
    sy0, sy1 = b["top"] - 92, b["top"] - 30
    for px in (sx0 + 30, sx1 - 30):
        cr.rectangle(px - 5, sy1, 10, b["top"] - sy1 + 4)
        solid(cr, (70, 72, 80), finish="metal", rim=False)
    cr.rectangle(sx0, sy0, sx1 - sx0, sy1 - sy0)
    solid(cr, (56, 118, 72))
    fs = fit_size(cr, "VERTICAL FARM", 34, sx1 - sx0 - 24)
    text(cr, "VERTICAL FARM", (sx0 + sx1) / 2, sy1 - 18, fs, (244, 246, 240),
         face="bold", anchor="center", shadow=False)
    haze(cr, 560, 1170, (228, 214, 204), a=0.3)

    # the road the investors leave by
    cr.rectangle(0, 1590, W, 120)
    solid(cr, (92, 90, 94), rim=False, edge=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 224, 170)))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    cr.set_dash([40, 34])
    cr.move_to(0, 1650)
    cr.line_to(W, 1650)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_dash([])

    # the jars, and the ladders Data stands on at their mouths
    for x0, x1 in (J1, J2):
        cast_shadow(cr, x0, x1, BASE, length=300, a=0.3)
        contact_shadow(cr, (x0 + x1) / 2, BASE + 4, x1 - x0 + 60, a=0.45)
    PY = TOP + 140
    D1, D2 = (118, PY), (582, PY)
    _vj_ladder(cr, D1[0], PY, BASE, 130)
    _vj_ladder(cr, D2[0], PY, BASE, 104)
    _vj_jar(cr, J1[0], J1[1], TOP, BASE, fill1)
    _vj_jar(cr, J2[0], J2[1], TOP, BASE, fill2)

    # the coins in flight from his bucket
    if a0 <= u < a1 and 0.12 < f < 0.78:
        _vj_stream(cr, D1[0] + 60, D1[1] - 160, (J1[0] + J1[1]) / 2, TOP,
                   _vj_level(TOP, BASE, fill1), t)
    if 0.12 < f2 < 0.62:
        _vj_stream(cr, D2[0] + 50, D2[1] - 160, (J2[0] + J2[1]) / 2, TOP,
                   _vj_level(TOP, BASE, fill2), t)

    # THE SCALE on the second jar: its own eighth, counted up its side —
    # eight of the new money stack to where the first jar's reached
    if done2 and share > 0:
        unit = (BASE - 10 - _vj_level(TOP, BASE, share))
        times_ticks(cr, 985, BASE - 10, unit, max(1, int(round(ratio))),
                    a=ease(seg(f2, 0.6, 0.9)))
    text(cr, l0, (J1[0] + J1[1]) / 2, 1500, 34, look.INK, face="bold", anchor="center")
    text(cr, l1, (J2[0] + J2[1]) / 2, 1500, 34, look.INK, face="bold", anchor="center")

    # after it lands the investors drive off, one truck after another
    if u > 0.58:
        for j in range(3):
            q = (u - 0.58 - 0.14 * j) / 0.2
            if 0 <= q <= 1.0:
                tx = -420 + q * 1800
                contact_shadow(cr, tx + 170, 1702, 360, a=0.35)
                truck(cr, tx, 1695, 2.1)

    # right by the camera: a crate of the farm's lettuce, coins spilled in the grass
    contact_shadow(cr, 900, 1882, 280, a=0.4)
    box(cr, 780, 1880, 230, 110, (176, 132, 82), depth=50)
    for c_ in range(4):
        disc(cr, 812 + c_ * 52, 1762, 30, (104, 182, 76))
    for i in range(4):
        _vj_coin(cr, 120 + i * 130, 1840 + (i % 2) * 40, 44, 0.4 + 0.08 * (i % 2))
    foreground(cr, "field", y0=1730)
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data: pours the first jar full, climbs across to the second, pours again
    if u < a0:
        host("point", D1[0], D1[1], 230)
    elif u < a1:
        host("pour", D1[0], D1[1], 230, beat=k)
    elif u < b0:
        m = ease(seg(u, a1, b0))
        hx = D1[0] + (D2[0] - D1[0]) * m
        hy = D1[1] + 260 * math.sin(math.pi * m)
        host("climb", hx, hy, 230)
    elif u < 0.64:
        host("pour", D2[0], D2[1], 230, beat=n1)
    elif u < 0.92:
        host("hold_up", D2[0], D2[1], 230)
    else:
        host("shock", D2[0], D2[1], 230)

    if done2:
        fit_readout(cr, f"${v1:g} billion",
                    f"raised {l1} · about 1/{int(round(ratio))} as much",
                    80, 520, size=130, max_w=900)
    elif full1:
        fit_readout(cr, f"${v0:g} billion", f"raised by indoor farms · {l0}",
                    80, 520, size=130, max_w=900)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Vertical farms", f"money raised, {l0} vs {l1}", 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130, max_w=900)

# scene standard: 2026-10-16.2
def _vf_lettuce(cr, x, y, s, rot=0.0):
    """A head of butter lettuce: ruffled outer leaves, a pale heart, veins."""
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.rotate(rot)
    cr.scale(s, s)
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(0, 6)
    cr.scale(1.0, 0.5)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 34, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (48, 112, 46))
    for i in range(7):
        a = math.pi + i * math.pi / 6
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(21 * math.cos(a), 4 + 15 * math.sin(a))
        cr.rotate(a + math.pi / 2)
        cr.scale(0.66, 1.0)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 18, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        solid(cr, (66, 146, 58))
    for i in range(3):
        a = math.pi * (1.2 + 0.3 * i)
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(10 * math.cos(a), -4 + 10 * math.sin(a))
        cr.rotate(a + math.pi / 2)
        cr.scale(0.7, 1.0)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 13, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        solid(cr, (132, 200, 82))
    cr.arc(0, -8, 8, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    solid(cr, (200, 234, 136), rim=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((214, 240, 170), 0.7))
    cr.set_line_width(2)
    for i in range(5):
        a = math.pi * (1.1 + 0.2 * i)
        cr.move_to(0, 0)
        cr.line_to(28 * math.cos(a), 4 + 20 * math.sin(a))
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()


def _vf_sprig(cr, x, y, s):
    """A small far-off lettuce head: two lit lobes, cheap enough for the back rows."""
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.scale(s, s * 0.7)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 14, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (70, 150, 62), edge=False)
    cr.arc(x - 3 * s, y - 4 * s, 6 * s, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 210, 100), 0.9))
    cr.fill()


def _vf_sign(cr, cx, y, label, sw, c):
    """The company's own name board, hung over its rack on two wires. When the
    rack goes down one wire lets go and the board swings off true."""
    ang = 0.2 * ease(seg(c, 0.3, 1.0))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 42, 50)))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    cr.move_to(cx - sw * 0.35, y - 64)
    cr.line_to(cx - sw * 0.35, 300)
    cr.move_to(cx + sw * 0.35, y - 64 + sw * 0.7 * math.sin(ang))
    cr.line_to(cx + sw * 0.35, 300 + 60 * ang)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(cx - sw * 0.35, y - 64)
    cr.rotate(ang)
    cr.translate(-(cx - sw * 0.35), -(y - 64))
    box(cr, cx - sw / 2, y, sw, 64, (36, 96, 60), depth=18, finish="gloss")
    text(cr, label, cx - 9, y - 18, 40, look.INK, face="bold", anchor="center",
         shadow=False)
    cr.restore()


def _vf_rack(cr, x, w, base, h, c, sway):
    """A steel grow rack: white trays packed with lettuce under LED bars, four
    uprights. `c` 0..1 collapses it — the tiers pancake down and the legs buckle."""
    TS = 100
    n = max(1, int((h - 40) // TS))
    tiers = []
    for i in range(n):
        rest = base - 30 - i * TS
        fin = base - 10 - i * 26
        q = seg(c, i * 0.05, 0.6 + i * 0.05) ** 2      # it FALLS
        y = rest + (fin - rest) * q
        ang = (0.09 if i % 2 else -0.07) * q
        dx = (22 if i % 2 else -18) * q + sway * (base - rest) / h
        tiers.append((y, ang, dx))
    extra = h - 30 - (n - 1) * TS
    top = tiers[-1][0] - max(14.0, extra * (1 - c))
    tsx = tiers[-1][2]
    L = base - top
    k = min(90.0, 0.5 * math.sqrt(max(0.0, h * h - L * L)))
    BX = 40

    def legs(pts_, dark):
        for (lx, out) in pts_:
            mid = (base + top) / 2
            for wdt, col in ((16, (40, 42, 50)), (10, dark), (3, (226, 230, 238))):
                cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(col))
                cr.set_line_width(wdt)
                cr.move_to(lx, base)
                cr.line_to(lx + out * k + tsx / 2, mid)
                cr.line_to(lx + tsx, top)
                cr.stroke()

    legs([(x + BX, -1), (x + w + BX, 1)], (104, 110, 122))
    for i, (y, ang, dx) in enumerate(tiers):
        cx = x + w / 2 + dx
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(cx, y)
        cr.rotate(ang)
        cr.translate(-cx, -y)
        tx = x + dx
        lit = 1.0 - clamp(c * 1.6)
        glow(cr, cx, y - 50, w * 0.6, (250, 150, 236), 0.42 * lit + 0.04)
        cr.rectangle(tx + 10, y - 94, w - 20, 10)
        solid(cr, (255, 226, 252) if lit > 0.3 else (130, 120, 138),
              finish="gloss", rim=False)
        # the trays are PACKED: big overlapping heads, back row then front
        nh = max(2, int((w - 30) // 58))
        sp = (w - 44) / max(1, nh - 1)
        for j in range(nh):
            _vf_lettuce(cr, tx + 22 + j * sp + 14, y - 44, 1.0, 0.1 * ((j + i) % 3 - 1))
        for j in range(nh):
            _vf_lettuce(cr, tx + 22 + j * sp, y - 30, 1.18, 0.12 * ((j + i + 1) % 3 - 1))
        box(cr, tx, y, w, 24, (228, 230, 234), depth=40, finish="gloss")
        cr.restore()
    box(cr, x + tsx, top + 12, w, 12, (150, 156, 166), depth=40, finish="metal")
    legs([(x, -1), (x + w, 1)], (150, 156, 166))
    # heads spilled off the crushed trays, sliding out across the floor
    sp_ = ease(seg(c, 0.55, 1.0))
    if sp_ > 0:
        for j in range(6):
            side = -1 if j % 2 == 0 else 1
            hx = x + w / 2 + side * (w * 0.2 + j * 20 + 110 * sp_)
            _vf_lettuce(cr, hx, base + 30 + 18 * (j % 3), 1.3, side * sp_ * 2.4 + j)


def _vf_crate(cr, x, y, w, s):
    """A wooden harvest crate by the camera, heaped with fresh heads."""
    contact_shadow(cr, x + w / 2, y + 4, w + 60, a=0.45)
    for j in range(int(w // (58 * s)) + 1):
        _vf_lettuce(cr, x + 24 * s + j * 58 * s, y - 84 * s - 14 * (j % 2), 1.45 * s,
                    0.25 * ((j % 3) - 1))
    box(cr, x, y, w, 90 * s, (176, 126, 74), depth=36 * s)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((110, 74, 40), 0.85))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    for r in range(1, 3):
        cr.move_to(x + 4, y - r * 90 * s / 3)
        cr.line_to(x + w - 4, y - r * 90 * s / 3)
    cr.stroke()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a tall rack of growing lettuce
    SUBSTANCE: lettuce and its trays
    CAUSE: Data hammers out the rack's leg and the lettuce tiers crash down
    Inside an indoor farm, aisles of grow racks glowing under pink LED light
    run back into the dark. Two racks stand in front, each as tall as its
    money and hung with its company's name: Bowery's at its 2.3 billion peak,
    Plenty's at the 1 billion it raised — 1x/2x ticks between them measure
    the giant in the small one. The trays are packed with heads of lettuce.
    Data swings a sledgehammer at Bowery's front leg, one strike, two, three:
    the legs buckle, the lights die and the tiers pancake onto the floor,
    lettuce rolling toward the camera, the name board swinging loose. He
    walks across and does it to Plenty. Landed by 0.69 and held: ghosts of
    both racks stand over the wreckage, heads keep rolling, he strikes again."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    (lb, vb) = max(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    (lp, vp) = min(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    nb = lb.split(" (")[0]
    np_ = lp.split(" (")[0]
    vp_ = vp or 1.0
    ratio = vb / vp_

    BASE = 1400
    HP = 340.0
    HB = min(800.0, HP * ratio)
    BXR, BW = 560, 440
    PXR, PW = 150, 240

    c_b = seg(u, 0.26, 0.38)
    c_p = seg(u, 0.59, 0.69)

    def shake(hits):
        s = 0.0
        for hh in hits:
            d = u - hh
            if 0 <= d < 0.06:
                s += 18 * math.exp(-d * 50) * math.sin(d * 260)
        return s

    # the farm hall: a dark ceiling with rows of LED grow bars running back
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (22, 18, 30)), (0.6, (58, 44, 66)), (1, (96, 76, 100))], 0, 1120)
    VX, VY = 540, 900
    for i in reversed(range(8)):
        z = i / 7.0
        sc = 1.0 - 0.78 * z
        ly = 110 + (VY - 260 - 110) * z ** 0.85
        for side in (-1, 1):
            lx = VX + side * 420 * sc - 110 * sc
            glow(cr, lx + 110 * sc, ly + 10 * sc, 170 * sc, (255, 150, 226), 0.35)
            box(cr, lx, ly, 220 * sc, 14 * sc, (255, 224, 248), depth=34 * sc,
                finish="gloss")
    # the aisles behind: racks of lettuce under pink light, receding
    for side in (-1, 1):
        for i in reversed(range(5)):
            z = i / 4.0
            sc = 1.0 - 0.6 * z
            fw = 150 * sc
            fx = VX + side * (520 - 330 * z) - fw / 2
            fb = 1120 - 40 * z
            fh = 420 * sc
            contact_shadow(cr, fx + fw / 2, fb, fw + 20, a=0.25)
            box(cr, fx, fb, fw, fh, (96, 98, 112), depth=24 * sc, finish="metal")
            for r in range(4):
                ty = fb - 14 * sc - r * fh / 4
                cr.rectangle(fx + 6 * sc, ty - fh / 4 + 16 * sc, fw - 12 * sc, fh / 4 - 22 * sc)
                cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((214, 108, 196), 0.85))
                cr.fill()
                for cc in range(3):
                    _vf_sprig(cr, fx + fw * (0.22 + 0.28 * cc), ty - 14 * sc, 1.1 * sc)
    haze(cr, 560, 1130, (70, 52, 78), a=0.5)
    # the polished concrete floor running to the camera, pink light on it
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (96, 90, 102)), (1, (150, 146, 142))], 1110, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 66, 76), 0.35))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(12):
        cr.move_to(VX, VY)
        cr.line_to(-1100 + i * 300, H)
    cr.stroke()
    glow(cr, 560, 1360, 560, (244, 160, 230), 0.16)

    # Plenty, the smaller rack
    cast_shadow(cr, PXR, PXR + PW, BASE, length=220, a=0.28)
    contact_shadow(cr, PXR + PW / 2 + 20, BASE + 4, PW + 80, a=0.4)
    _vf_rack(cr, PXR, PW, BASE, HP, c_p, shake([0.52, 0.56]))
    # Bowery, the giant
    cast_shadow(cr, BXR, BXR + BW, BASE, length=300, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, BXR + BW / 2 + 20, BASE + 4, BW + 80, a=0.42)
    _vf_rack(cr, BXR, BW, BASE, HB, c_b, shake([0.12, 0.19]))

    # whose rack is whose: the company's own board hung over it
    _vf_sign(cr, BXR + BW / 2 + 20, BASE - HB - 40, nb.split(" ")[0].upper(), 300, c_b)
    _vf_sign(cr, PXR + PW / 2 + 20, BASE - HP - 40, np_.split(" ")[0].upper(), 220, c_p)

    # THE SCALE in the picture: where each rack stood, Bowery in Plenty's height
    if c_b > 0.5:
        cr.rectangle(BXR, BASE - HB, BW, HB)
        ghost(cr, a=0.8 * ease(seg(c_b, 0.5, 1.0)))
    if c_p > 0.5:
        cr.rectangle(PXR, BASE - HP, PW, HP)
        ghost(cr, a=0.8 * ease(seg(c_p, 0.5, 1.0)))
    ta = ease(seg(u, 0.08, 0.14))
    if ta > 0:
        times_ticks(cr, 440, BASE, HP, max(1, int(ratio)), a=ta)

    # Data: three strikes on Bowery's front leg, walks across, Plenty's next
    FY = 1480
    if u < 0.39:
        hx = 480
    elif u < 0.46:
        hx = 480 - 400 * ease(seg(u, 0.39, 0.46))
    else:
        hx = 80

    # loose heads rolling off the wreck toward the camera
    if u > 0.34:
        for j in range(3):
            ph = (t * 0.42 + j / 3.0) % 1.0
            rx = 780 - 260 * ph + 60 * j
            ry = 1450 + 300 * ph
            s_ = 1.3 + 1.0 * ph
            _vf_lettuce(cr, rx, ry, s_, -(260 * ph) / (34 * s_))

    # right by the camera: harvest crates of fresh heads, never shipped
    _vf_crate(cr, 30, 1830, 320, 1.25)
    _vf_crate(cr, 750, 1850, 290, 1.3)
    vignette(cr, a=0.3)

    if u < 0.06:
        host("point", hx, FY, 240)
    elif u < 0.39:
        host("hammer", hx, FY, 240, beat=0 if u < 0.13 else (1 if u < 0.20 else 2))
    elif u < 0.46:
        host("point", hx, FY, 240)
    else:
        host("hammer", hx, FY, 240, beat=3 if u < 0.53 else (4 if u < 0.78 else 5))

    if u < 0.06:
        fit_readout(cr, "Vertical farms", "the biggest names in indoor farming",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130, max_w=460)
    elif u < 0.46:
        fit_readout(cr, f"${vb:.1f}B", f"{nb} at its peak · shut down",
                    80, 520, size=130, max_w=460)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"${vp:.1f}B", f"{np_} raised · bankrupt",
                    80, 520, size=130, max_w=460)

# scene standard: 2026-10-16.2
def _vf_mix(a, b, k):
    return tuple(int(x + (y - x) * k) for x, y in zip(a, b))


def _vf_lettuce(cr, x, y, r, lit):
    # a head of lettuce: a ruffled two-tone green rosette sitting in its tray
    dark_leaf = _vf_mix((22, 30, 28), (70, 150, 64), lit)
    lite_leaf = _vf_mix((34, 44, 40), (132, 214, 96), lit)
    for j in range(5):
        a = math.pi + j * math.pi / 4
        cr.arc(x + r * 0.55 * math.cos(a), y + r * 0.35 * math.sin(a), r * 0.62, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(dark_leaf))
        cr.fill()
    cr.arc(x, y - r * 0.25, r * 0.6, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    solid(cr, lite_leaf, edge=False)


def _vf_crate(cr, x, y, s):
    # a produce crate of fresh lettuce, right by the camera
    contact_shadow(cr, x + 90 * s, y + 4, 220 * s, a=0.4)
    box(cr, x, y, 180 * s, 70 * s, (170, 124, 78), depth=40 * s)
    for c_ in range(4):
        _vf_lettuce(cr, x + 26 * s + c_ * 42 * s, y - 62 * s, 26 * s, 1.0)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 84, 50)))
    cr.set_line_width(4 * s)
    for r_ in range(1, 3):
        cr.move_to(x + 4, y - r_ * 22 * s)
        cr.line_to(x + 180 * s - 4, y - r_ * 22 * s)
    cr.stroke()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a tall glass greenhouse of lettuce
    SUBSTANCE: its pink grow lights
    CAUSE: Data hauls the farm's main power lever down notch by notch and floor after floor goes dark
    The money is the light: a tall glass greenhouse in a town, a peaked
    glass roof on top, every floor a long tray of big green lettuce heads
    glowing under pink grow lights at the peak year's funding, its light
    spilling pink over the yard. Data grips the heavy red main lever of the
    big breaker box at its foot and drags it down, one notch per pull, and
    the floors go dark from the top until only the following year's share
    is lit, one floor in eleven; the dark floors' lettuce goes black with
    them. The peak's height stays marked on the roofline, so one look says
    almost all of it went out. Done by 0.62 and held; delivery trucks keep
    driving off past crates of unsold lettuce by the camera, and Data keeps
    leaning on the lever."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    # the peak is the larger value, the year after the smaller — by value,
    # never by list order (the labels carry no year for by_time to sort on)
    (l0, v0) = max(rows, key=lambda r: (r[1], r[0]))
    (l1, v1) = min(rows, key=lambda r: (r[1], r[0]))
    v0 = v0 or 1.0
    n = 4
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.62
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    pull = ease(seg(f, 0.0, 0.82))
    p = 0.0 if u < a0 else (k + pull) / n
    val = v0 + (v1 - v0) * p
    frac = clamp(val / v0)
    done = u >= a0 and k == n - 1 and pull >= 0.999

    landscape(cr, t, "town")
    birds(cr, t, y0=700, n=4, rgb=(60, 60, 70))

    X0, X1, BASE = 200, 700, 1440
    TOP = 760
    DEP, RISE = 120, 64
    PK = TOP - 180
    cx = (X0 + X1) / 2
    pink = (238, 96, 210)
    # the grow lights spill pink across the yard while they are on
    glow(cr, cx + 60, BASE + 60, 520, pink, 0.45 * frac)
    cast_shadow(cr, X0, X1 + DEP, BASE, length=340, a=0.32)
    contact_shadow(cr, cx + 50, BASE + 4, X1 - X0 + 180, a=0.4)

    # the side going back into the picture, glass over dim racks
    cr.move_to(X1, BASE)
    cr.line_to(X1 + DEP, BASE - RISE)
    cr.line_to(X1 + DEP, TOP - RISE)
    cr.line_to(X1, TOP)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, _vf_mix((34, 38, 46), (150, 70, 140), frac), finish="glass")
    # the peaked glass roof, front gable and the far slope
    cr.move_to(cx, PK)
    cr.line_to(cx + DEP, PK - RISE)
    cr.line_to(X1 + DEP + 10, TOP - RISE)
    cr.line_to(X1 + 10, TOP)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (176, 204, 214), finish="glass")
    cr.move_to(X0 - 14, TOP)
    cr.line_to(cx, PK)
    cr.line_to(X1 + 14, TOP)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, _vf_mix((150, 178, 190), (240, 170, 226), frac), finish="glass")
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 240, 244)))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    for m in range(1, 6):
        mx = X0 + (X1 - X0) * m / 6
        my = TOP - (TOP - PK) * (1 - abs(mx - cx) / (cx - X0))
        cr.move_to(mx, TOP)
        cr.line_to(mx, my)
    cr.stroke()

    # the glass front: eleven floors, each a long tray of lettuce
    NF = 11
    fh = (BASE - TOP) / NF
    dark = (18, 20, 26)
    for i in range(NF):
        lit = clamp(frac * NF - i)
        fy0 = TOP + (NF - 1 - i) * fh
        col = _vf_mix(dark, pink, lit)
        cr.rectangle(X0, fy0, X1 - X0, fh)
        solid(cr, col, finish="glass", rim=False, edge=False)
        if lit > 0.05:
            glow(cr, cx, fy0 + fh * 0.3, 300, pink, 0.22 * lit)
        # the tray and its lettuce heads, big enough to read from across a room
        ty = fy0 + fh - 12
        cr.rectangle(X0 + 8, ty, X1 - X0 - 16, 10)
        solid(cr, _vf_mix((70, 72, 78), (232, 234, 236), 0.3 + 0.7 * lit), rim=False)
        for c_ in range(9):
            _vf_lettuce(cr, X0 + 34 + c_ * 54, ty - 4, 23, 0.05 + 0.95 * lit)
        # the grow-light bar along the ceiling of each floor
        cr.rectangle(X0 + 8, fy0 + 4, X1 - X0 - 16, 7)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(_vf_mix((50, 50, 58), (255, 200, 248), lit)))
        cr.fill()
    # white greenhouse frame over the glass
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 240, 244)))
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    cr.rectangle(X0, TOP, X1 - X0, BASE - TOP)
    for m in range(1, 4):
        mx = X0 + (X1 - X0) * m / 4
        cr.move_to(mx, TOP)
        cr.line_to(mx, BASE)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    for i in range(1, NF):
        cr.move_to(X0, TOP + i * fh)
        cr.line_to(X1, TOP + i * fh)
    cr.stroke()

    # THE SCALE on the greenhouse: where the light reached at the peak
    if u >= a0:
        then_mark(cr, X0 - 20, X1 + 40, TOP + 4, l0)

    # the big breaker box at its foot, a thick cable into the greenhouse
    BX, BY = 900, 1470
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((34, 34, 40)))
    cr.set_line_width(12)
    cr.move_to(BX + 10, BY - 30)
    cr.curve_to(850, BY + 10, 790, BY - 10, X1 + 40, BASE - 14)
    cr.stroke()
    contact_shadow(cr, BX + 55, BY + 2, 160, a=0.45)
    box(cr, BX, BY, 100, 200, (96, 102, 112), depth=34, finish="metal")
    # hazard stripes and a lightning sign on its face
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(BX + 6, BY - 40, 88, 28)
    cr.clip()
    for s_ in range(-2, 8):
        cr.move_to(BX + s_ * 22, BY - 12)
        cr.line_to(BX + s_ * 22 + 14, BY - 12)
        cr.line_to(BX + s_ * 22 + 42, BY - 40)
        cr.line_to(BX + s_ * 22 + 28, BY - 40)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((240, 196, 40)))
        cr.fill()
    cr.restore()
    cr.move_to(BX + 50, BY - 190)
    cr.line_to(BX + 82, BY - 136)
    cr.line_to(BX + 18, BY - 136)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (244, 200, 46), rim=False)
    cr.move_to(BX + 54, BY - 178)
    cr.line_to(BX + 42, BY - 158)
    cr.line_to(BX + 54, BY - 158)
    cr.line_to(BX + 46, BY - 142)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 30, 34)))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    cr.stroke()
    # the notches the lever clicks through
    PX, PY = 930, 1350
    for j in range(n + 1):
        th_ = math.radians(-120 - 75 * j / n)
        cr.move_to(PX + 120 * math.cos(th_), PY + 120 * math.sin(th_))
        cr.line_to(PX + 134 * math.cos(th_), PY + 134 * math.sin(th_))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((240, 196, 40)))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    cr.stroke()
    th = math.radians(-120 - 75 * p)
    ex, ey = PX + 110 * math.cos(th), PY + 110 * math.sin(th)
    gx, gy2 = PX + 80 * math.cos(th), PY + 80 * math.sin(th)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 20, 18)))
    cr.set_line_width(20)
    cr.move_to(PX, PY)
    cr.line_to(ex, ey)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((214, 56, 42)))
    cr.set_line_width(14)
    cr.move_to(PX, PY)
    cr.line_to(ex, ey)
    cr.stroke()
    disc(cr, PX, PY, 16, (70, 70, 76), finish="metal")
    disc(cr, ex, ey, 14, (30, 30, 34), finish="gloss")

    # right by the camera: delivery trucks pulling out and away, one after
    # another, from the moment the money starts going to the end
    if u > a0 + 0.1:
        tt = (u - a0 - 0.1) * 6.0
        for j in range(2):
            tx = -420 + ((tt * 520 + j * 950) % 1900)
            contact_shadow(cr, tx + 120, 1735 + j * 50, 300, a=0.35)
            truck(cr, tx, 1720 + j * 50, 1.8 + 0.15 * j)
    # and the crates of lettuce nobody is buying, nearest of all
    _vf_crate(cr, 30, 1900, 1.25)
    _vf_crate(cr, 790, 1880, 1.15)
    foreground(cr, "town")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    FX, FY = 860, 1470
    if u < a0:
        wx = 300 + (FX - 300) * ease(seg(u, 0.0, a0))
        host("point", wx, FY, 230)
    elif u < 0.93:
        host("grip", FX, FY, 230, beat=k, hands=[(ex, ey), (gx, gy2)],
             lower="brace", expr="strain")
    else:
        host("shock", FX, FY, 230)

    if done:
        drop = int(round((v0 - v1) / v0 * 100))
        fit_readout(cr, f"-{drop}%", f"indoor farm funding · {l1.lower()}",
                    80, 520, size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v0))}", f"indoor farm funding index · {l0.lower()}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

# scene standard: 2026-10-16.2
def _hk_bill(cr, x, y, ang, s, a=1.0):
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.rotate(ang)
    cr.rectangle(-24 * s, -12 * s, 48 * s, 24 * s)
    solid(cr, (150, 204, 132), a=a, rim=False)
    cr.rectangle(-20 * s, -8.5 * s, 40 * s, 17 * s)

    cr.stroke()
    cr.save()
    cr.scale(1, 0.55)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 9 * s, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 120, 66), 0.8 * a))
    cr.fill()
    cr.restore()


def _hk_rot(px, py, ang, lx, ly, s=1.0):
    ca, sa = math.cos(ang), math.sin(ang)
    lx, ly = lx * s, ly * s
    return px + lx * ca - ly * sa, py + lx * sa + ly * ca


def _hk_leg(cr, lx, rgb, drop=0.0):
    # a short, rounded pig leg tapering out of the belly to a cloven trotter;
    # drawn BEFORE the body so its top disappears into it, no seam
    b = 232 + drop
    cr.move_to(lx - 44, 100)
    cr.curve_to(lx - 50, 160, lx - 40, b - 30, lx - 30, b)
    cr.curve_to(lx - 12, b + 8, lx + 12, b + 8, lx + 30, b)
    cr.curve_to(lx + 40, b - 30, lx + 50, 160, lx + 44, 100)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, rgb, finish="gloss")
    for dx in (-15, 15):
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(lx + dx, b + 4)
        cr.scale(1, 0.8)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 16, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        solid(cr, (140, 70, 88), finish="gloss", rim=False)


def _hk_growhouse(cr, x, base, w, h):
    # a far-off vertical farm: a dark tower with pink grow-light floors
    contact_shadow(cr, x + w / 2, base, w * 1.1, a=0.25)
    box(cr, x, base, w, h, (92, 100, 118), depth=0.3 * w, finish="glass")
    floors = int(h // 34)
    for i in range(floors):
        fy = base - 18 - i * 34
        cr.rectangle(x + 8, fy - 12, w - 16, 12)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 120, 200), 0.85))
        cr.fill()
    glow(cr, x + w / 2, base - h / 2, w * 0.9, (236, 120, 200), 0.25)


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a giant pink piggy bank
    SUBSTANCE: paper dollar bills
    CAUSE: Data hauls the rope that lifts the piggy bank, and the bills pour out of its open belly and blow away
    The hook: the money is already leaving. A huge piggy bank hangs from a
    wooden gantry in a field below the glowing towers of the vertical farms,
    its plug knocked out, and a torrent of bills pours from its belly and
    blows off the frame while Data hauls it higher, hand over hand, backing
    away along the rope, its tail running through his hands to a coil on
    the grass. By u=0.45 the torrent is spent: the pig swings empty, a last
    bill drips out now and then, and the readout has gone from what was
    raised to what came next."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]

    GROUND = 1460
    landscape(cr, t, "field")
    # the farms the money built, glowing pink on the horizon
    _hk_growhouse(cr, 130, 1185, 120, 300)
    _hk_growhouse(cr, 300, 1180, 90, 210)
    _hk_growhouse(cr, 760, 1182, 110, 260)
    _hk_growhouse(cr, 905, 1178, 80, 180)
    haze(cr, 820, 1200, (226, 214, 214), a=0.45)

    # the gantry the pig hangs from
    BEAM_Y = 650
    contact_shadow(cr, 52, GROUND, 110, a=0.4)
    contact_shadow(cr, 1030, GROUND, 110, a=0.4)
    cast_shadow(cr, 30, 74, GROUND, length=260, a=0.25)
    cast_shadow(cr, 1008, 1052, GROUND, length=260, a=0.25)
    box(cr, 30, GROUND, 44, GROUND - BEAM_Y + 20, (150, 108, 68), depth=14)
    box(cr, 1008, GROUND, 44, GROUND - BEAM_Y + 20, (150, 108, 68), depth=14)
    box(cr, 14, BEAM_Y, 1050, 40, (166, 120, 76), depth=16)

    # the haul: each pull lifts the pig a little higher
    beats = 5
    k = int(clamp(u / 0.17, 0, beats))
    fk = clamp(u / 0.17 - k)
    lift = 16 * (k + ease(seg(fk, 0.15, 0.55)))
    empty = ease(seg(u, 0.3, 0.45))
    S = 1.12
    PX = 520
    PY = 1000 - lift - 20 * empty
    sway = (0.03 + 0.05 * empty) * math.sin(t * 2.3)

    # shadow of the hanging pig on the grass

    for lx in (-140, 170):
        _hk_leg(cr, lx, (196, 108, 126), drop=-10)

    # tail
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(pink_d))

    cr.curve_to(312, 140, 190, 212, 20, 212)
    cr.curve_to(-160, 212, -300, 140, -300, 0)
    cr.close_path()

    # belly shading so it reads round, not flat
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(20, 150)
    cr.scale(1, 0.32)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 230, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((190, 100, 120), 0.35))
    cr.fill()
    # near ear, folded forward
    cr.move_to(-250, -140)
    cr.curve_to(-250, -210, -230, -250, -215, -268)
    cr.curve_to(-180, -230, -150, -190, -150, -160)

    solid(cr, pink_d, finish="gloss")
    cr.move_to(-232, -160)
    cr.curve_to(-228, -200, -220, -228, -214, -240)
    cr.curve_to(-195, -210, -178, -188, -172, -168)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((246, 182, 194)))
    cr.fill()
    # snout
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(-305, 10)
    cr.scale(0.75, 1)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 72, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (246, 170, 182), finish="gloss")
    for ny in (-14, 34):
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(-318, ny)
        cr.scale(0.6, 1)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 14, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 50, 64)))
        cr.fill()
    disc(cr, -195, -70, 20, (40, 26, 30), finish="gloss")
    # a smile, cheek blush
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 70, 88)))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    cr.arc(-235, 50, 40, 0.3 * math.pi, 0.7 * math.pi)
    cr.stroke()
    glow(cr, -170, 20, 46, (244, 120, 140), 0.35)
    # coin slot and the ring
    cr.rectangle(-110, -204, 120, 18)
    solid(cr, (90, 36, 50), rim=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((90, 92, 100)))
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    cr.arc(40, -214, 16, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.stroke()
    # the open plug hole in its belly
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(20, 196)
    cr.scale(1, 0.4)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 46, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 24, 36)))
    cr.fill()
    cr.restore()

    # the name on its flank, placed in frame coordinates, inside the picture
    text(cr, "BOWERY", name_at[0], name_at[1], 66, (150, 70, 88), face="display",
         anchor="center", shadow=False)

    # the money pouring out of it and blowing off the frame
    NB = 70
    for i in range(NB):
        ue = -0.3 + 0.72 * (i / (NB - 1.0)) ** 0.7
        a = (u - ue) * 3.0
        if a < 0:
            continue
        x = hole[0] - 380 * a - 90 * a * a + 30 * math.sin(i * 1.7)
        y = hole[1] + 90 * a + 170 * a * a + 26 * math.sin(a * 5 + i)
        if x < -90 or y > 1900:
            continue
        _hk_bill(cr, x, y, a * 3.5 + i, 1.6 + 0.3 * ((i * 0.37) % 1.0))
    # once it is empty, a last bill drips out now and then
    if u > 0.45:
        for j in range(2):
            ph = ((u - 0.45) / 0.22 + j * 0.5) % 1.0
            x = hole[0] - 260 * ph - 60 * ph * ph
            y = hole[1] + 40 * ph + 380 * ph * ph
            _hk_bill(cr, x, y, ph * 4 + j, 1.8)

    # right by the camera: bills that already blew out, lying in the grass
    for i in range(5):
        bx = 90 + i * 140 + 10 * math.sin(t * 1.3 + i)
        by = 1690 + (i % 2) * 90 + i * 12
        _hk_bill(cr, bx, by, 0.4 + i * 0.9 + 0.08 * math.sin(t * 2 + i), 2.7)

    # Data hauls the rope hand over hand, backing away from the pulley; the
    # rope runs from the pulley THROUGH his hands to a coil on the grass
    hx = 760 + 170 * ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.75))
    fy = 1452
    hand = (hx + 34, fy - 92)
    coil = (hx + 70, fy + 6)

    for r_ in range(3):
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(coil[0], coil[1] - r_ * 6)
        cr.scale(1, 0.32)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 38 - r_ * 6, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((112, 84, 52)))
        cr.set_line_width(8)
        cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((112, 84, 52)))
    cr.set_line_width(9)
    cr.move_to(ring[0], PUL[1])
    cr.line_to(*PUL)
    cr.line_to(*hand)
    cr.curve_to(hand[0] + 30, hand[1] + 50, coil[0] + 30, coil[1] - 40, coil[0] + 20, coil[1] - 10)
    cr.stroke()

    foreground(cr, "field")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    if u < 0.88:
        host("haul", hx, fy, 240, beat=k)
    else:
        host("shock", hx, fy, 240)

    if u < 0.42:
        fit_readout(cr, f"${v0:g} billion", f"raised by indoor farms · {l0}",
                    80, 520, size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"${v1:g} billion", f"the next two years · {l1}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.42, 0.47)), size=130)

# scene standard: 2026-10-16.2
def _vf_crate(cr, x, y, w, h, t, i):
    contact_shadow(cr, x + w / 2, y + 4, w + 40, a=0.4)
    box(cr, x, y, w, h, (156, 112, 70), depth=0.18 * w)
    for j in range(5):
        hx = x + 34 + j * (w - 60) / 4
        hy = y - h - 14 + 6 * math.sin(t * 0.8 + j + i)
        disc(cr, hx, hy, 38, (104, 168, 72))
        disc(cr, hx - 8, hy - 10, 18, (150, 204, 104))


def _vf_poster(cr, x0, y0, w, h, t):
    # the farm's ad: racks of lettuce glowing under pink grow light
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (66, 30, 92)), (1, (196, 74, 146))], y0, y0 + h, x0, x0 + w)
    glow(cr, x0 + w * 0.68, y0 + h * 0.3, 280, (255, 150, 214), 0.5)
    for r in range(3):
        sy = y0 + 112 + r * 104
        for c in range(11):
            lx = x0 + 48 + c * (w - 96) / 10
            disc(cr, lx, sy - 24, 27, (96, 176, 80))
            disc(cr, lx - 7, sy - 32, 12, (162, 222, 122))
        cr.rectangle(x0 + 18, sy, w - 36, 14)
        solid(cr, (206, 204, 216), finish="metal", rim=False)
    for k in range(3):
        cr.rectangle(x0 + 30 + k * (w - 80) / 2, y0 + 30, (w - 140) / 3, 12)
        solid(cr, (255, 170, 226), finish="gloss", rim=False)


def _vf_scrap(cr, x, y, ang, s, a=1.0):
    # a torn sheet of the poster, ragged edges, blowing away in the wind
    ca, sa = math.cos(ang), math.sin(ang)
    shape = [(-95, -62), (-40, -70), (10, -58), (70, -72), (98, -30), (90, 18),
             (100, 60), (40, 68), (-20, 56), (-70, 70), (-100, 30), (-88, -14)]
    for i, (px, py) in enumerate(shape):
        qx = x + s * (px * ca - py * sa)
        qy = y + s * (px * sa + py * ca)
        if i == 0:
            cr.move_to(qx, qy)
        else:
            cr.line_to(qx, qy)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (176, 66, 140), a=a)
    for px, py in ((-45, 0), (5, -8), (55, 4)):
        qx = x + s * (px * ca - py * sa)
        qy = y + s * (px * sa + py * ca)
        disc(cr, qx, qy, 24 * s, (96, 176, 80), a=a)
        disc(cr, qx - 6 * s, qy - 8 * s, 10 * s, (162, 222, 122), a=a)


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a roadside billboard for a vertical farm
    SUBSTANCE: the billboard's paper poster
    CAUSE: Data grips the torn edge of the poster and rolls it up off the board by hand, walking it back along the catwalk
    The closing: the farm was SOLD as the future of food, and the hype
    comes down. The whole billboard is the peak year's money; in three
    tugs Data rolls the poster off the board until only the following
    year's share of it is still pasted up, a narrow strip by the left post,
    the rest bare plywood. The board itself is the whole, so one look reads
    how little is left. Torn sheets of the ad blow away off the board in
    the wind the whole time. Real food still sits in the crates by the
    camera: they can grow it, the money ran out first."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts[:2]]
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows if rows[0][1] >= rows[1][1] else rows[::-1]
    v0 = v0 or 1.0
    keep = clamp(v1 / v0)
    drop = int(round((v0 - v1) / v0 * 100))
    n = 3
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.5
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    tug = ease(seg(f, 0.0, 0.85))
    peel = 0.0 if u < a0 else clamp((k + tug) / n)
    done = u >= a1
    remain = 1.0 - (1.0 - keep) * peel

    BX, BY, BW, BH = 150, 1130, 760, 380
    PX0, PY0 = BX + 12, BY - BH + 12
    PW, PH = BW - 24, BH - 24
    PY1 = PY0 + PH
    cx = PX0 + PW * remain
    GB = 1330

    landscape(cr, t, "field")
    birds(cr, t, y0=640, n=4, rgb=(60, 56, 70))
    # the vertical farms on the horizon, dark now
    for tx, tw, th in ((24, 120, 560), (950, 116, 620)):
        box(cr, tx, 1180, tw, th, (70, 76, 90), depth=26, finish="glass")
        for r_ in range(int(th // 70) - 1):
            cr.rectangle(tx + 12, 1180 - th + 30 + r_ * 70, tw - 24, 26)
            solid(cr, (40, 42, 52), finish="glass", rim=False, edge=False)
    haze(cr, 560, 1190, (224, 212, 198), a=0.45)

    # the billboard: legs, board, header, catwalk
    cast_shadow(cr, BX, BX + BW, GB, length=300, a=0.3)
    for lx in (300, 740):
        contact_shadow(cr, lx + 14, GB + 4, 80, a=0.4)
        cylinder(cr, lx, GB, 28, GB - BY + 10, (110, 114, 122), finish="metal")
    box(cr, BX, BY, BW, BH, (88, 84, 80), depth=44)
    # the bare plywood under the poster
    cr.rectangle(PX0, PY0, PW, PH)
    solid(cr, (168, 160, 146), rim=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((132, 124, 112)))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    for j in range(1, 4):
        cr.move_to(PX0 + PW * j / 4, PY0)
        cr.line_to(PX0 + PW * j / 4, PY1)
    cr.move_to(PX0, PY0 + PH / 2)
    cr.line_to(PX0 + PW, PY0 + PH / 2)
    cr.stroke()
    # what is still pasted up
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(PX0, PY0, max(0.0, cx - PX0), PH)
    cr.clip()
    _vf_poster(cr, PX0, PY0, PW, PH, t)
    cr.restore()
    # the header the hype was sold under
    for hx_ in (330, 730):
        cr.rectangle(hx_, BY - BH - 40, 14, 44)
        solid(cr, (96, 100, 108), finish="metal", rim=False)
    cr.rectangle(250, 676, 560, 62)
    solid(cr, (182, 48, 38))
    slogan = "THE FUTURE OF FOOD"
    text(cr, slogan, 530, 722, fit_size(cr, slogan, 40, 500), (244, 238, 226),
         face="bold", anchor="center", shadow=False)
    # the catwalk he works from
    box(cr, 140, 1166, 790, 14, (120, 124, 132), depth=30, finish="metal")
    for sx in (200, 520, 860):
        cr.move_to(sx, 1166)
        cr.line_to(sx + 30, BY)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 72, 80)))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    cr.stroke()

    # the torn tail hanging off the roll, flapping in the wind
    ta = ease(seg(u, a0, a0 + 0.05))
    rr = 12 + 30 * peel
    if ta > 0:
        sway = 44 * math.sin(t * 2.4) + 16 * math.sin(t * 3.7)
        cr.move_to(cx - rr, PY1 - 10)
        cr.line_to(cx + rr, PY1 - 10)
        cr.curve_to(cx + rr + 30, PY1 + 90, cx + rr + 70 + sway, PY1 + 180,
                    cx + rr + 90 + sway, PY1 + 270)
        cr.line_to(cx + 10 + sway * 0.8, PY1 + 300)
        cr.curve_to(cx - rr + sway * 0.4, PY1 + 200, cx - rr - 10, PY1 + 90,
                    cx - rr, PY1 - 10)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (236, 228, 214), a=ta)
    # the roll of poster in his hands
    cr.rectangle(cx - rr, PY0 - 8, 2 * rr, PH + 16)
    solid(cr, (240, 232, 220))
    cr.rectangle(cx - rr * 0.4, PY0 - 8, rr * 0.5, PH + 16)
    solid(cr, (206, 96, 160), rim=False, edge=False)

    # torn sheets of the ad tear off the roll and blow away across the field,
    # two in the air at a time, all through the beat and after it lands
    if u >= a0:
        for j in range(2):
            if u < a0 + j * 0.13:
                continue
            ph = ((u - a0) / 0.26 + j * 0.5) % 1.0
            sx0, sy0 = cx + 40, 980
            sx = sx0 + (W + 260 - sx0) * ph
            sy = sy0 - 300 * ph + 50 * math.sin(ph * 6.0 + j * 2.0)
            _vf_scrap(cr, sx, sy, ph * 4.2 + j * 1.3, 1.25 + 0.2 * j,
                      a=clamp(ph * 8.0))

    # right by the camera: the food the farms DID grow
    _vf_crate(cr, 40, 1880, 320, 130, t, 0)
    _vf_crate(cr, 720, 1870, 300, 120, t, 3)
    foreground(cr, "field")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    hx = cx - 22
    hands = [(cx - 4, 992), (cx - 4, 1042)]
    if u < a0:
        host("point", hx, 1150, 220)
    elif not done:
        host("grip", hx, 1150, 220, hands=hands, lower="brace", expr="strain")
    else:
        host("grip", hx, 1150, 220, hands=hands, lower="stand", expr="shock")

    if done:
        fit_readout(cr, f"-{drop}%", f"indoor farm funding · {l1.lower()}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.04)), size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Indoor farm money", f"{l0.lower()} = {int(round(v0))}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=110)

def _ss_walker(cr, x, base, s, t, coat, cloth, hair=(58, 40, 30), stride_=1.0):
    """A person walking with a garment over the arm: trousers, shoes, a coat,
    a head of hair. stride_ scales the leg swing (a slow push, a brisk walk)."""
    ph = math.sin(t * 5.0 * stride_ + x * 0.01) * stride_
    contact_shadow(cr, x, base, 110 * s, a=0.35)
    cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
    for sgn in (1, -1):
        fx = x + sgn * 28 * s * ph
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((44, 46, 58)))
        cr.set_line_width(26 * s)
        cr.move_to(x + sgn * 10 * s, base - 116 * s)
        cr.line_to(fx, base - 14 * s)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(fx + 8 * s, base - 8 * s)
        cr.scale(1.0, 0.5)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 20 * s, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        solid(cr, (30, 28, 30), rim=False)
    cr.move_to(x - 38 * s, base - 108 * s)
    cr.curve_to(x - 46 * s, base - 200 * s, x - 36 * s, base - 252 * s, x, base - 258 * s)
    cr.curve_to(x + 36 * s, base - 252 * s, x + 46 * s, base - 200 * s, x + 38 * s, base - 108 * s)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, coat)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(coat))
    cr.set_line_width(22 * s)
    cr.move_to(x + 26 * s, base - 236 * s)
    cr.line_to(x + 44 * s, base - 176 * s)
    cr.line_to(x + 70 * s, base - 186 * s)
    cr.stroke()
    if cloth is not None:
        bx = x + 52 * s
        cr.move_to(bx - 22 * s, base - 196 * s)
        cr.curve_to(bx + 28 * s, base - 208 * s, bx + 36 * s, base - 150 * s, bx + 30 * s, base - 92 * s)
        cr.line_to(bx - 8 * s, base - 98 * s)
        cr.curve_to(bx, base - 140 * s, bx - 4 * s, base - 166 * s, bx - 22 * s, base - 178 * s)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, cloth)
    disc(cr, x, base - 290 * s, 32 * s, (214, 170, 136))
    cr.arc(x, base - 294 * s, 33 * s, math.pi * 1.0, math.pi * 2.0)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, hair, rim=False)


def _ss_rack(cr, x0, x1, ground, h, s, new, t, sway, n=5):
    """A rolling garment rack on casters: two uprights, a top rail, a header
    card, garments on hangers. A store's is chrome with identical new tees;
    a thrift shop's is wood with every garment different."""
    legc = (204, 208, 218) if new else (150, 112, 72)
    fin = "metal" if new else "matte"
    rail = ground - h
    cast_shadow(cr, x0, x1, ground, length=200 * s, a=0.25)
    contact_shadow(cr, (x0 + x1) / 2, ground, x1 - x0 + 40 * s, a=0.4)
    cr.rectangle(x0, ground - 34 * s, x1 - x0, 12 * s)
    solid(cr, legc, finish=fin)
    for px in (x0 + 8 * s, x1 - 8 * s):
        cylinder(cr, px - 7 * s, ground - 26 * s, 14 * s, h - 26 * s, legc, finish=fin)
        disc(cr, px, ground - 12 * s, 12 * s, (40, 40, 46), finish="gloss")
    cr.rectangle(x0 - 10 * s, rail - 8 * s, x1 - x0 + 20 * s, 14 * s)
    solid(cr, legc, finish=fin)
    for i in range(n):
        gx = x0 + 50 * s + (x1 - x0 - 100 * s) * i / max(1, n - 1)
        kind = 0 if new else _SS_KINDS[i % len(_SS_KINDS)]
        ang = sway * (1 + 0.15 * i) + 0.03 * math.sin(t * 1.4 + i * 1.7)
        _ss_garment(cr, gx, rail - 2 * s, ang, 0.8 * s, kind, new=new)
    cx = (x0 + x1) / 2
    cr.rectangle(cx - 4 * s, rail - 30 * s, 8 * s, 24 * s)
    solid(cr, legc, finish=fin, rim=False)
    cr.rectangle(cx - 75 * s, rail - 92 * s, 150 * s, 64 * s)
    if new:
        solid(cr, (250, 250, 252), finish="gloss")
        text(cr, "NEW", cx, rail - 44 * s, int(44 * s), (196, 40, 46), face="display",
             anchor="center", shadow=False)
    else:
        solid(cr, (214, 180, 128))
        text(cr, "USED", cx, rail - 44 * s, int(44 * s), (60, 40, 28), face="display",
             anchor="center", shadow=False)


def _ss_streaks(cr, x, y0, y1, amt):
    """Speed streaks trailing a rolling rack, attached to it, only while it rolls."""
    if amt <= 0.01:
        return
    cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
    for i in range(4):
        yy = y0 + (y1 - y0) * (i + 0.5) / 4

        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((250, 250, 250), 0.75 * amt))
        cr.set_line_width(7)
        cr.move_to(x - 20, yy)
        cr.line_to(x - 20 - ln, yy)
        cr.stroke()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: two clothing racks racing
    SUBSTANCE: racks of clothes
    CAUSE: Data shoves the used-clothes rack down the street, shove after shove, five times as far as the new rack creeps
    A RACE down one shopping street in two lanes, both racks lined up on the
    same chequered start line, both pushed by someone. In the far lane a mall
    clerk wheels a chrome store rack of identical new blue tees; in the near
    lane, big by the camera, Data shoves a wooden thrift rack packed with
    mixed used clothes. Every shove of his rolls the used rack a long way,
    speed streaks behind it, while the clerk's rack only creeps — the
    store's growth against the thrift shop's. A dashed line drops from the
    new rack's front down to the used lane, and the street is ticked off in
    that length, 1x..5x, so the used rack ends about five new-rack lengths
    of travel ahead. Done by ~0.56 and held while shoppers keep carrying
    used clothes past the camera and the racks sway."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    fast_l, fast = max(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    slow_l, slow = min(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    base_v = slow if slow > 0 else 1.0
    ratio = max(1.0, fast / base_v)
    S = 5
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.56
    span = (a1 - a0) / S
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, S - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    move = ease(seg(f, 0.2, 0.7))           # the rack rolls on the shove
    if u < a0:
        prog, mv = 0.0, 0.0
    elif u >= a1:
        prog, mv = 1.0, 0.0
    else:
        prog, mv = (k + move) / S, move

    P0 = 520.0                              # the start line: both fronts
    D = 540.0                               # how far used travels
    d = D / ratio                           # how far new travels
    GF, GB = 1470.0, 1070.0                 # near and far lane ground
    sb = 0.82
    WF, WB = 400.0, 380.0 * sb
    HF, HB = 470.0, 400.0 * sb
    pf = P0 + D * prog
    pb = P0 + d * prog
    rolling = math.sin(math.pi * mv) if 0 < mv < 1 else 0.0
    sway_f = -0.22 * rolling
    sway_b = -0.05 * rolling

    # the setting: a shopping street, the city behind, the mall left, the
    # thrift shop right
    landscape(cr, t, "town", horizon=950)
    for i in range(8):                      # the far skyline fills the sky
        bh = 260 + (i * 97) % 190
        box(cr, -30 + i * 150, 950, 120, bh, (170, 178, 194), depth=28)
        for r_ in range(int(bh // 60) - 1):
            cr.rectangle(-18 + i * 150, 950 - 50 - r_ * 60, 96, 14)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((214, 222, 232), 0.7))
            cr.fill()
    haze(cr, 560, 960, (214, 218, 228), a=0.6)
    cast_shadow(cr, 20, 580, 950, length=200, a=0.22)
    m = building(cr, 20, 580, 950, 250, (200, 204, 214), roof_rgb=(90, 94, 104),
                 roof="flat", boards=False)
    mw = m["x1"] - m["x0"]
    cr.rectangle(m["x0"] + 40, m["base"] - 150, mw - 80, 140)
    solid(cr, (150, 182, 206), finish="gloss")
    cr.rectangle(m["x0"] + 14, m["top"] + 16, 150, 60)
    solid(cr, (40, 44, 56))
    text(cr, "MALL", m["x0"] + 89, m["top"] + 62, 42, (244, 240, 232),
         face="display", anchor="center", shadow=False)
    cast_shadow(cr, 640, 1040, 950, length=200, a=0.22)
    th = building(cr, 640, 1040, 950, 230, (172, 92, 70), roof_rgb=(96, 70, 60),
                  roof="flat", boards=False)
    tw = th["x1"] - th["x0"]
    cr.rectangle(th["x0"] + 40, th["base"] - 140, tw - 80, 130)
    solid(cr, (160, 176, 170), finish="gloss")
    for i in range(8):                      # the striped awning
        ax = th["x0"] + 20 + i * (tw - 40) / 8
        cr.move_to(ax, th["base"] - 190)
        cr.line_to(ax + (tw - 40) / 8, th["base"] - 190)
        cr.line_to(ax + (tw - 40) / 8 + 6, th["base"] - 150)
        cr.line_to(ax + 6, th["base"] - 150)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (226, 206, 160) if i % 2 else (70, 120, 96), rim=False)
    text(cr, "THRIFT", (th["x0"] + th["x1"]) / 2, th["top"] + 56, 40, (244, 236, 214),
         face="display", anchor="center")
    haze(cr, 600, 960, (220, 222, 228), a=0.2)

    # the ground: the sidewalk, a two-lane road, the near pavement
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (198, 194, 186)), (1, (172, 168, 160))], 950, 1004)
    cr.rectangle(0, 998, W, 10)
    solid(cr, (150, 146, 140), rim=False)
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (96, 98, 108)), (1, (72, 74, 82))], 1008, 1500)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 226, 170), 0.85))  # the lane line between them
    for i in range(7):
        cr.rectangle(20 + i * 160, 1150, 90, 9)
    cr.fill()
    cr.rectangle(0, 1494, W, 12)
    solid(cr, (150, 146, 140), rim=False)
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (196, 190, 180)), (1, (164, 158, 150))], 1506, H)

    # the chequered start line across both lanes
    for i in range(20):
        y0 = 1010 + i * 24.5
        for j in range(2):
            cr.rectangle(P0 - 16 + j * 16, y0, 16, 24.5)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((240, 240, 240) if (i + j) % 2 else (30, 30, 34)))
            cr.fill()

    # far lane: the mall clerk wheeling the chrome rack of new clothes, creeping
    _ss_walker(cr, pb - WB - 34, GB, 0.72, t, (40, 44, 56), None, (30, 26, 24),
               stride_=0.35 if 0 < mv < 1 else 0.0)
    _ss_streaks(cr, pb - WB, GB - HB + 40, GB - 60, 0.25 * rolling)
    _ss_rack(cr, pb - WB, pb, GB, HB, sb, True, t, sway_b)

    # near lane: the used-clothes rack he shoves, big by the camera, packed full
    _ss_streaks(cr, pf - WF - 60, GF - HF + 60, GF - 80, rolling)
    _ss_rack(cr, pf - WF, pf, GF, HF, 1.0, False, t, sway_f, n=6)

    # THE SCALE in the street: how far new got, dropped down to the used
    # lane, and the street ticked off in that length
    if prog > 0:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 255, 255), 0.9))
        cr.set_line_width(5)
        cr.set_dash([18, 12])
        cr.move_to(pb, GB + 6)
        cr.line_to(pb, GF + 18)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.set_dash([])
        nt = min(8, int(ratio + 1e-6))
        for i in range(1, nt + 1):
            x = P0 + d * i
            if x > 1062:
                break
            on = pf >= x - 1
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((250, 250, 250), 1.0 if on else 0.35))
            cr.set_line_width(6)
            cr.move_to(x, GF + 6)
            cr.line_to(x, GF + 26)
            cr.stroke()
            text(cr, f"{i}x", min(x, 1040), 1530, 34, look.INK, face="bold",
                 anchor="center", alpha=1.0 if on else 0.35)

    # Data behind the used rack, hands on its upright, shoving it on
    hx = pf - WF - 18
    if u < a0:
        host("point", hx, GF, 240)
    elif u < a1 + 0.04:
        host("shove", hx, GF, 240, beat=k)
    else:
        host("shove", hx, GF, 240, beat=S)

    # right by the camera, below Data: shoppers carrying used clothes off,
    # a crate of more
    foreground(cr, "town")
    for j in range(2):
        px = -240 + ((t * 200 + j * 780) % 1560)
        _ss_walker(cr, px, 1900 + j * 15, 0.95 + 0.08 * j, t,
                   [(64, 70, 90), (60, 100, 84)][j], [(176, 58, 52), (206, 160, 70)][j],
                   [(58, 40, 30), (150, 110, 60)][j])
    contact_shadow(cr, 920, 1905, 280, a=0.45)
    box(cr, 810, 1905, 220, 140, (176, 136, 88), depth=56)
    for i, kind in enumerate((2, 3, 4)):
        _ss_garment(cr, 850 + i * 70, 1700 - (i % 2) * 18, -0.5 + 0.35 * i, 0.55, kind)
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    if u >= a1:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{ratio:.0f}x faster",
                    f"{fast_l.lower()} +{fast:g}% · {slow_l.lower()} +{slow:g}%",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.05)), size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Used vs. new", "how fast clothing sales grew last year",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)
