def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a thrift store clothing rack
    SUBSTANCE: secondhand clothes on hangers
    CAUSE: Data places secondhand garments on the rack, armful after armful, and shoppers crowd in to buy
    Inside a thrift store, one long rail of secondhand clothes running
    from right by the camera back into the shop: how full it is is the
    year's secondhand sales. The 2023 rail stands as a dashed ghost; Data
    walks down the rail hanging garment after garment onto its growing end,
    each one flying from his hands onto the next hook, until it holds the
    2029 projection, and with every armful another shopper walks in to
    browse: a smaller crowd becomes a bigger one. Done by 0.56 and held;
    shoppers with bags keep walking past the camera."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    v0 = v0 or 1.0
    v1 = v1 or 1.0
    ratio = v1 / v0
    n = 4
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.56
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    grow = ease(seg(f, 0.25, 0.8))
    step = 0.0 if u < a0 else (k + grow) / n
    val = v0 + (v1 - v0) * step
    done = u >= a0 and k == n - 1 and grow >= 0.999

    # the rail: big by the camera on the left, running back to the right
    RX0, RY0, RX1, RY1 = 60.0, 1090.0, 1030.0, 1000.0

    def at(z):
        return (RX0 + (RX1 - RX0) * z, RY0 + (RY1 - RY0) * z, 1.6 - 0.45 * z)

    N = 14
    cnt = N * val / v1
    cnt0 = N * v0 / v1

    # the shop: a warm back wall, pendant lamps, tall shelves of folded clothes
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (78, 64, 58)), (0.5, (170, 142, 116)), (1, (206, 182, 150))], 0, 1080)
    fold = [(178, 70, 62), (82, 122, 168), (212, 170, 74), (104, 150, 96),
            (150, 96, 150), (226, 214, 196)]
    for i in range(6):
        bx = 22 + i * 176
        contact_shadow(cr, bx + 70, 1070, 160, a=0.25)
        box(cr, bx, 1070, 146, 440, (122, 96, 74), depth=24)
        for r_ in range(6):
            for c_ in range(2):
                box(cr, bx + 10 + c_ * 66, 1070 - 20 - r_ * 70, 58, 30,
                    fold[(i + r_ + c_) % len(fold)], depth=10)
    haze(cr, 600, 1080, (210, 190, 164), a=0.45)
    for i in range(4):
        lx = 150 + i * 260
        ly = 300 + (i % 2) * 40
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 36, 34)))
        cr.set_line_width(3)
        cr.move_to(lx, 0)
        cr.line_to(lx, ly - 40)
        cr.stroke()
        glow(cr, lx, ly + 30, 210, (255, 228, 176), 0.45)
        cr.move_to(lx - 18, ly - 40)
        cr.line_to(lx + 18, ly - 40)
        cr.line_to(lx + 52, ly + 10)
        cr.line_to(lx - 52, ly + 10)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (46, 74, 70), finish="metal")
        disc(cr, lx, ly + 14, 14, (255, 236, 190), finish="gloss")
    # a wooden floor running to the camera
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (150, 112, 78)), (1, (100, 70, 48))], 1070, H)
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(0, 1070, W, H - 1070)
    cr.clip()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 48, 32), 0.35))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(16):
        cr.move_to(1200, 980)
        cr.line_to(-1000 + i * 190, H)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()
    glow(cr, 540, 1330, 560, (255, 230, 190), 0.2)

    # the rack: two metal stands, a rail, its long shadow
    cast_shadow(cr, RX0, RX1, 1480, length=260, a=0.25)
    for z, fy in ((0.02, 1490.0), (0.98, 1410.0)):
        sx, sy, ss = at(z)
        contact_shadow(cr, sx, fy, 150 * ss, a=0.4)
        cr.rectangle(sx - 6 * ss, sy, 12 * ss, fy - sy - 10)
        solid(cr, (150, 154, 162), finish="metal")
        box(cr, sx - 55 * ss, fy, 110 * ss, 12 * ss, (90, 94, 102), depth=20 * ss,
            finish="metal")
    cr.move_to(RX0 - 10, RY0 - 8 * 1.6)
    cr.line_to(RX1 + 10, RY1 - 8 * 1.15)
    cr.line_to(RX1 + 10, RY1 + 8 * 1.15)
    cr.line_to(RX0 - 10, RY0 + 8 * 1.6)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (176, 180, 188), finish="metal")

    # where Data stands: at the rail's growing end
    ze = clamp(cnt / N)
    ex, ey, es = at(ze)
    hx = min(995.0, ex + 40)
    hy = 1490 - 80 * ze
    hand = (hx + 10, hy - 150)

    # the clothes, back to front so the near ones overlap; each new one
    # flies from his hands up onto its hook
    cols = [(178, 70, 62), (70, 104, 150), (214, 168, 70), (96, 140, 92),
            (146, 92, 140), (222, 208, 186), (60, 64, 74), (196, 112, 82)]
    for i in reversed(range(N)):
        arr = clamp(cnt - i)
        if arr <= 0:
            continue
        gx, gy, gs = at((i + 0.5) / N)
        e = ease(arr)
        px = hand[0] + (gx - hand[0]) * e
        py = hand[1] + (gy - hand[1]) * e - 120 * math.sin(math.pi * e)
        sway = 2.5 * math.sin(t * 1.6 + i * 0.9) * gs
        _hanger_garment(cr, px + sway, py, gs * 0.95, cols[(i * 3) % len(cols)],
                        (i * 7) % 3, a=clamp(arr * 3))

    # THE SCALE on the rack: the 2023 rail as a ghost, its end named
    if step > 0.02:
        zc = cnt0 / N
        p0, p1 = at(0.0), at(zc)
        cr.move_to(p0[0] - 30, p0[1] - 30)
        cr.line_to(p1[0], p1[1] - 30)
        cr.line_to(p1[0], p1[1] + 200 * p1[2])
        cr.line_to(p0[0] - 30, p0[1] + 200 * p0[2])
        cr.close_path()
        ghost(cr, a=0.9)
        text(cr, l0, p1[0], p1[1] - 46, 34, look.INK, face="bold", anchor="center")
    if done:
        pe = at(cnt / N)
        text(cr, l1.split(" ")[0], min(pe[0], W - 70), pe[1] - 46, 34, look.INK,
             face="bold", anchor="center")

    # the crowd browsing the rack grows with every armful: a smaller crowd, then a bigger one
    coats = [(70, 84, 110), (128, 62, 58), (88, 104, 78), (156, 124, 72), (96, 80, 120)]
    hairs = [(52, 36, 28), (180, 140, 80), (30, 28, 30), (120, 70, 40), (90, 90, 96)]
    crowd = 5 * val / v1
    for j in reversed(range(5)):
        a_ = clamp(crowd - j)
        if a_ <= 0:
            continue
        tx = 90 + j * 150
        px = tx - (1 - ease(a_)) * 560
        _person(cr, px, 1525 + (j % 2) * 12, 1.25, coats[j], hairs[j], t * 7 + j,
                walking=a_ < 1, back=True)

    # Data hangs the next garment at the rail's growing end
    if u < a0:
        host("point", hx, hy, 230)
    elif u < a1 + 0.04:
        host("place", hx, hy, 230, beat=k)
    else:
        host("hold_up", hx, hy, 230)

    # right by the camera: shoppers carrying their finds out past the lens
    for j in range(2):
        sx = 1260 - ((t * 220 + j * 780) % 1600)
        _person(cr, sx, 1790 + j * 80, 1.6 + 0.15 * j, coats[(j + 2) % 5],
                hairs[(j + 3) % 5], t * 7 + j, bag=True)
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    if done:
        fit_readout(cr, f"${int(round(v1))}B", f"secondhand clothing sales · {l1}",
                    80, 520, size=130)
        text(cr, f"{ratio:.1f}x", W - 80, 720, 90, look.INK, face="display",
             anchor="right", alpha=ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.05)))
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"${int(round(v0))}B", f"secondhand clothing sales · {l0}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

def _fm_person(cr, x, base, s, t, coat, skin, walking, bag):

def _fm_canopy_path(cr, X0, x1, BY, FY, DX, VH):

def _fm_rack(cr, x0, x1, rail_y, foot_y, t, seed, wheels=False):

        gx = x0 + 16 + g * 26
        _sh_shirt(cr, gx, rail_y + 4, 0.62, cols[(seed * 3 + g) % len(cols)],

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a flea market's striped canopy over a crowd
    SUBSTANCE: stalls of secondhand clothes
    CAUSE: Data shoves a rolling rack of used clothes across the square and the market's canopy spreads over the shoppers
    The secondhand market as one town-square flea market, and the square's
    crowd as all of America: forty shoppers stand across it. Data shoves
    the market's rolling rack out across the square, the striped canopy
    and its racks of used clothes unrolling behind him, and every shopper
    it reaches picks up a bag of secondhand clothes. One shove carries it
    to 2023's share of the crowd, it holds, a second carries it to 2024's;
    2023's edge stays as a dashed ghost with its year, so the market's
    reach over the same crowd reads on the canopy itself. Done by 0.64
    and held while shoppers with their bags keep walking past the camera."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    a0, m1, m2, a1 = 0.06, 0.32, 0.42, 0.64
    p1 = ease(seg(u, a0, m1))
    p2 = ease(seg(u, m2, a1))
    share = clamp((v0 * p1 + (v1 - v0) * p2) / 100.0)
    X0, X1 = 40, 1040
    cut = X0 + (X1 - X0) * share
    c0 = X0 + (X1 - X0) * clamp(v0 / 100.0)
    BY, FY, DX, VH = 840, 960, 50, 44
    GROUND = 1480

    # the town and the square
    landscape(cr, t, "town")
    haze(cr, 700, 1180, (226, 214, 200), a=0.3)
    cr.rectangle(0, 1180, W, H - 1180)
    solid(cr, (184, 176, 164), edge=False, rim=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((132, 124, 112), 0.5))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(6):
        y = 1200 + i * i * 22
        cr.move_to(0, y)
        cr.line_to(W, y)
    for i in range(12):
        cr.move_to(540 + (i - 5.5) * 60, 1180)
        cr.line_to(540 + (i - 5.5) * 260, H)
    cr.stroke()

    # the market's shadow on the square, then its racks of used clothes
    if cut - X0 > 20:
        cast_shadow(cr, X0, cut, 1290, length=240, a=0.25)
    for r in range(8):
        rx0 = X0 + 30 + r * 124
        rx1 = rx0 + 100
        cover = clamp((cut - 20 - rx1) / 50.0)
        if cover <= 0:
            continue
        drop = (1 - pop(cover)) * 50
        contact_shadow(cr, (rx0 + rx1) / 2, 1290, 120, a=0.3 * cover)
        _fm_rack(cr, rx0 + DX * 0.5, rx1 + DX * 0.5, 1080 + drop, 1290, t, r)

    # the crowd: forty shoppers, the whole square
    N = 40
    neutral = (150, 150, 158)
    coats = [(84, 96, 140), (170, 72, 62), (196, 170, 120), (96, 134, 96),
             (130, 100, 150), (210, 206, 198), (70, 74, 92), (186, 120, 70)]
    skins = [(232, 190, 160), (198, 150, 112), (150, 104, 74), (110, 76, 54),
             (224, 176, 140)]
    crowd = []
    for i in range(N):
        x = X0 + (i + 0.5) * (X1 - X0) / N
        row = i % 2
        y = 1320 + row * 110 + 14 * ((i * 0.618) % 1.0)
        crowd.append((y, x, i, row))
    crowd.sort()
    for y, x, i, row in crowd:
        p = clamp((cut - x) / 40.0)
        col = coats[i % len(coats)]
        coat = tuple(int(a + (b - a) * p) for a, b in zip(neutral, col))
        _fm_person(cr, x, y, 0.5 + 0.12 * row, t, coat, skins[(i * 3) % len(skins)],
                   False, pop(p))

    # the canopy over the market, unrolled to where the rack has reached
    x1 = max(X0 + 4, cut + 70)
    if cut - X0 > 6:
        px = X0 + 10
        while px < x1 - 40:
            cylinder(cr, px - 7, GROUND, 14, GROUND - (FY + VH), (80, 82, 90), finish="metal")
            px += 170
        ns = int((x1 - X0) // 70) + 1
        for i in range(ns):
            sx0 = X0 + i * 70
            sx1 = min(x1, sx0 + 70)
            if sx1 <= sx0:
                break
            rgb = P["accent2"] if i % 2 == 0 else (244, 238, 224)
            cr.move_to(sx0 + DX, BY)
            cr.line_to(sx1 + DX, BY)
            cr.line_to(sx1, FY)
            cr.line_to(sx0, FY)
            cr.close_path()
            solid(cr, rgb, edge=False)
            cr.rectangle(sx0, FY, sx1 - sx0, VH)
            solid(cr, rgb, edge=False, rim=False)
            cr.arc((sx0 + sx1) / 2, FY + VH, (sx1 - sx0) / 2, 0, math.pi)
            cr.close_path()
            solid(cr, rgb, edge=False, rim=False)
        cr.move_to(x1, FY)
        cr.line_to(x1 + DX, BY)
        cr.line_to(x1 + DX, BY + VH)
        cr.line_to(x1, FY + VH)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (150, 60, 50))
        _fm_canopy_path(cr, X0, x1, BY, FY, DX, VH)
        edge(cr, (40, 36, 40))
        if x1 - X0 > 470:
            text(cr, "SECONDHAND", X0 + 24, FY + 34, 34, look.INK, face="bold", shadow=False)

    # the rolling rack at the market's edge, the one Data shoves
    contact_shadow(cr, cut + 35, GROUND + 6, 150, a=0.35)
    _fm_rack(cr, cut - 20, cut + 90, 1240, GROUND - 4, t, 9, wheels=True)

    # THE SCALE on the canopy: where 2023's market reached over the crowd
    if u >= m2:
        _fm_canopy_path(cr, X0, c0, BY, FY, DX, VH)
        ghost(cr, a=0.9)
        cr.move_to(c0, FY + VH)
        cr.line_to(c0, GROUND + 10)
        ghost(cr, a=0.9)
        text(cr, l0, c0 + DX / 2, BY - 16, 32, look.INK, face="bold", anchor="center")

    # right by the camera: shoppers carrying their secondhand bags past
    for j in range(2):
        span = W + 500
        if j == 0:
            sx = -250 + ((t * 170) % span)
        else:
            sx = W + 250 - ((t * 140 + 700) % span)
        _fm_person(cr, sx, 1780 + j * 90, 1.0 + 0.15 * j, t,
                   [(70, 96, 140), (160, 70, 60)][j], skins[j * 2], True, 1.0)
    foreground(cr, "town")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data shoves the rack out across the square, then keeps it there
    hx = clamp(cut - 70, 110, 980)
    if u < a0:
        host("point", hx, GROUND, 220)
    elif u < 0.68:
        host("shove", hx, GROUND, 220, beat=0 if u < m2 else 1)
    elif u < 0.93:
        host("shove", hx, GROUND, 220, beat=2 + int((u - 0.68) / 0.12))
    else:
        host("cheer", hx, GROUND, 220)

    sub = "of Americans shop secondhand"
    if u >= a1:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v1))}%", f"{sub} · {l1}", 80, 520, size=130)
    elif u >= m1:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v0))}%", f"{sub} · {l0}", 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, m1, m1 + 0.04)), size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Shopping used", f"share of Americans, {l0}–{l1}", 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

# scene standard: 2026-10-11.2
def _cl_path(cr, w, h, kind):
    cr.new_path()
    if kind == 3:                                   # jeans
        cr.move_to(-0.36 * w, 0)
        cr.line_to(0.36 * w, 0)
        cr.line_to(0.40 * w, h)
        cr.line_to(0.07 * w, h)
        cr.line_to(0.0, 0.32 * h)
        cr.line_to(-0.07 * w, h)
        cr.line_to(-0.40 * w, h)
        cr.close_path()
        return
    hem = 0.40 if kind != 1 else 0.58               # a dress flares out
    cr.move_to(-0.22 * w, 0)
    cr.line_to(-0.50 * w, 0.05 * h)
    cr.line_to(-0.64 * w, 0.30 * h)
    cr.line_to(-0.43 * w, 0.38 * h)
    cr.line_to(-hem * w, h)
    cr.line_to(hem * w, h)
    cr.line_to(0.43 * w, 0.38 * h)
    cr.line_to(0.64 * w, 0.30 * h)
    cr.line_to(0.50 * w, 0.05 * h)
    cr.line_to(0.22 * w, 0)
    cr.curve_to(0.12 * w, 0.14 * h, -0.12 * w, 0.14 * h, -0.22 * w, 0)
    cr.close_path()


def _cl_garment(cr, x, y, w, h, kind, rgb, ang, peg, a=1.0):

    cr.save()

    cr.rotate(ang)
    _cl_path(cr, w, h, kind)
    solid(cr, rgb, a=a)
    if kind == 2:                                   # a flannel's checks
        cr.save()
        _cl_path(cr, w, h, kind)
        cr.clip()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 30, 30), 0.35 * a))
        cr.set_line_width(6)
        for i in range(-5, 6):
            cr.move_to(i * 22, 0)
            cr.line_to(i * 22, h)
            cr.move_to(-w, 100 + i * 26)
            cr.line_to(w, 100 + i * 26)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.restore()
    if kind == 3:                                   # jeans: waistband and seams
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((230, 200, 120), 0.7 * a))
        cr.set_line_width(3)
        cr.move_to(-0.36 * w, 0.06 * h)
        cr.line_to(0.36 * w, 0.06 * h)
        cr.move_to(-0.24 * w, 0.32 * h)
        cr.line_to(-0.24 * w, 0.95 * h)
        cr.move_to(0.24 * w, 0.32 * h)
        cr.line_to(0.24 * w, 0.95 * h)
        cr.stroke()
    if kind == 0 and peg != (210, 206, 196):
        cr.rectangle(0.08 * w, 0.55 * h, 0.22 * w, 0.2 * h)   # a sewn patch
        solid(cr, tuple(min(255, c + 50) for c in rgb), a=a, rim=False)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((250, 246, 236), 0.8 * a))
        cr.set_line_width(2.5)
        cr.set_dash([6, 5])
        cr.rectangle(0.08 * w + 4, 0.55 * h + 4, 0.22 * w - 8, 0.2 * h - 8)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.set_dash([])
    for px in (-0.3 * w, 0.3 * w):                  # the pegs
        cr.rectangle(px - 6, -14, 12, 32)
        solid(cr, peg, a=a, rim=False)
    cr.restore()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a backyard clothesline of clothes
    SUBSTANCE: secondhand clothes
    CAUSE: Data hauls the pulley line hand over hand, carrying his used clothes across the yard
    The closing: Data's whole wardrobe is secondhand, and soon so is
    everyone's. One pulley clothesline runs from his back porch to the
    neighbour's house across a fenced backyard lawn; the WHOLE line is the
    country's clothes, and the washing on it is big — full-size shirts,
    flannels, dresses and jeans filling the middle of the frame. It starts
    hung with identical new grey tees. Pull by pull Data walks backward
    across the lawn hauling the rope, and his mismatched used clothes ride
    out of his house along the line while the new tees roll off into the
    neighbour's, until the used share reaches the latest year's share —
    past the dashed 2023 mark on the line. The year labels sit ABOVE the
    line in the open sky, the earlier left of its mark and the later right
    of its own, so neither overlaps the other and Data, down on the lawn,
    never stands over one. Done by 0.55 and held: a gust swings the washing,
    Data holds the rope taut, and his porch sign says ARCHIVAL."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    s0, s1 = clamp(v0 / 100.0), clamp(v1 / 100.0)
    n = 4
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.55
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    move = ease(seg(f, 0.12, 0.72))
    prog = 0.0 if u < a0 else (k + move) / n
    done = u >= a0 and k == n - 1 and move >= 0.999

    X0, X1, LY, SAG = 150.0, 950.0, 880.0, 50.0
    L = X1 - X0
    off = L * s1 * prog

    def line_y(x):
        s = clamp((x - X0) / L)
        return LY + SAG * 4 * s * (1 - s)

    landscape(cr, t, "field")
    birds(cr, t, y0=760, n=4, rgb=(60, 60, 70))

    # a picket fence across the back of the yard, softened by distance
    FB, FH = 1215, 96
    cr.rectangle(120, FB - FH * 0.78, 840, 12)
    cr.rectangle(120, FB - FH * 0.3, 840, 12)
    solid(cr, (214, 208, 196), rim=False)
    cr.new_path()
    for i in range(30):
        px = 128 + i * 28.5
        cr.move_to(px, FB)
        cr.line_to(px, FB - FH + 10)
        cr.line_to(px + 8, FB - FH)
        cr.line_to(px + 16, FB - FH + 10)
        cr.line_to(px + 16, FB)
        cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (236, 232, 222))
    haze(cr, 1100, FB + 10, (220, 210, 196), a=0.25)

    # the two houses the line runs between: his porch left, the neighbour's right
    cast_shadow(cr, -60, 180, 1330, length=260, a=0.28)
    contact_shadow(cr, 60, 1332, 300, a=0.4)
    building(cr, -60, 180, 1330, 560, (176, 150, 120), roof="gable", depth=70)
    cast_shadow(cr, 920, 1160, 1330, length=200, a=0.28)
    contact_shadow(cr, 1030, 1332, 280, a=0.4)
    building(cr, 920, 1160, 1330, 560, (150, 160, 172), roof="gable", depth=50)
    # his back door and his sign, hung over it
    box(cr, 30, 1330, 110, 220, (110, 74, 52), depth=10)
    disc(cr, 120, 1230, 7, P["brass"], finish="metal")
    cr.rectangle(8, 1050, 168, 56)
    solid(cr, (236, 226, 204))
    text(cr, "ARCHIVAL", 92, 1090, 32, (60, 44, 34), face="bold", anchor="center",
         shadow=False)
    # the neighbour's door onto a dark hall
    cr.rectangle(960, 1110, 110, 220)
    solid(cr, (50, 44, 42), rim=False)

    # the pulleys on the two walls
    for px in (X0, X1):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 60, 66)))
        cr.set_line_width(9)
        cr.move_to(px, LY)
        cr.line_to(px + (-40 if px < 540 else 40), LY)
        cr.stroke()
        disc(cr, px, LY, 22, (150, 152, 160), finish="metal")

    # the line: the hauled share in the accent, the rest a neutral cord
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 72, 80)))
    cr.move_to(X0, LY)
    for i in range(1, 41):
        x = X0 + L * i / 40
        cr.line_to(x, line_y(x))
    cr.stroke()
    if off > 2:
        cr.set_line_width(10)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"]))
        cr.move_to(X0, LY)
        for i in range(1, 31):
            x = X0 + off * i / 30
            cr.line_to(x, line_y(x))
        cr.stroke()

    # the washing, big, riding the line
    N = 7
    d = L / N
    used = [((176, 64, 52), 0), ((214, 168, 70), 1), ((70, 110, 150), 3),
            ((176, 92, 60), 2), ((150, 96, 140), 1), ((226, 214, 190), 0),
            ((60, 90, 130), 3)]
    gust = ease(seg(u, 0.56, 0.62))
    for m in range(N):
        x = X0 + ((m * d + d / 2 + off) % L)
        a = clamp((x - X0) / 34) * clamp((X1 - x) / 34)
        if a <= 0.01:
            continue
        sway = 0.05 * math.sin(t * 1.7 + m * 0.7) + gust * 0.22 * math.sin(t * 3.4 + m * 0.5)
        if x - X0 < off:
            q = int(round((x - X0 - off) / d)) % N
            rgb, kind = used[q]
            _cl_garment(cr, x, line_y(x), 124, 270 if kind != 3 else 300, kind, rgb,
                        sway, P["accent2"], a)
        else:
            _cl_garment(cr, x, line_y(x), 118, 250, 0, (132, 140, 152), sway,
                        (210, 206, 196), a)

    # THE SCALE on the line: where last year's share reached, and this year's.
    # The dashes drop through the washing; the year labels sit up in the sky
    # above the line, parted left and right — clear of each other and of Data.
    if u >= a0:
        marks = ((l0, s0, 1.0, "right", -14),
                 (l1, s1, 1.0 if done else 0.0, "left", 14))
        for (lab, s, al, anc, dx) in marks:
            if al <= 0:
                continue
            mx = X0 + L * s
            my = line_y(mx)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((244, 238, 226), 0.9 * al))
            cr.set_line_width(5)
            cr.set_dash([14, 10])
            cr.move_to(mx, my - 50)
            cr.line_to(mx, my + 300)
            cr.stroke()
            cr.set_dash([])
            text(cr, lab, mx + dx, my - 64, 36, look.INK, face="bold", anchor=anc,
                 alpha=al)

    # right by the camera: a big wicker basket heaped with his used clothes
    contact_shadow(cr, 300, 1850, 460, a=0.45)
    for i, (rgb, kind) in enumerate(used[:5]):
        _cl_garment(cr, 160 + i * 72, 1660 + (i % 2) * 18, 104, 150, kind, rgb,
                    0.35 * (i - 2), (190, 150, 90))
    cr.move_to(70, 1710)
    cr.line_to(530, 1710)
    cr.line_to(490, 1860)
    cr.line_to(110, 1860)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (176, 136, 82))
    cr.save()
    cr.move_to(70, 1710)
    cr.line_to(530, 1710)
    cr.line_to(490, 1860)
    cr.line_to(110, 1860)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.clip()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 88, 50), 0.75))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    for j in range(6):
        cr.move_to(60, 1736 + j * 24)
        cr.line_to(540, 1736 + j * 24)
    for j in range(12):
        cr.move_to(90 + j * 38, 1710)
        cr.line_to(110 + j * 33, 1860)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()
    cr.rectangle(60, 1700, 480, 18)
    solid(cr, (196, 156, 98))
    foreground(cr, "field")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data backs across the lawn as he hauls; the rope runs from the pulley to his hands
    hx = 330 + 260 * prog
    fy, hh = 1470, 240
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 72, 80)))
    cr.set_line_width(7)
    cr.move_to(X0, LY + 22)
    cr.curve_to(X0 + 40, LY + 320, hx - 140, fy - 220, hx - 20, fy - 0.62 * hh)
    cr.stroke()
    if u < a0:
        host("point", hx, fy, hh)
    elif u < a1 + 0.05:
        host("haul", hx, fy, hh, beat=k)
    else:
        host("hold_up", hx, fy, hh)

    if done:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v1))}%", f"of Americans shop secondhand · {l1}",
                    80, 660, size=120)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Secondhand", f"Americans who shop it, {l0}–{l1}",
                    80, 660, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=120)

stories.title: One Campaign Cut A Top Baby Killer In Half
stories.hook: For years, the way we put babies to bed was killing them.
stories.closing: Know a new parent? Tell them: back to sleep. It costs nothing and it works.
stories.question: Did you know which way babies should sleep?
stories.caption: SIDS deaths in the US fell by more than half in under two decades -- not from new medicine, but from one changed instruction to parents. Here's how 'back to sleep' became one of the most effective public health campaigns ever. Did you know which way babies should sleep? 👇

segments.say: SIDS deaths fell to 0.64 per thousand babies, less than half the 1991 rate. One simple change in how babies sleep did that.

scene.concept: two rows of cribs, glowing nightlights drop from 13 to 6 per 10,000 babies

        if lit:
            keep = 1.0 if k < n else (1 - hold)

        else:
            d.ellipse([cx - 30, cy - 18, cx + 30, cy + 42], fill=rgba(SUBTLE, 60))
    text(fmt(v), RX1 - 300, y0 - 90, size=72, color=HIGHLIGHT if r == 0 else TEXT)

segments.say: Before the campaign, over 85% of SIDS cases were babies put down on their stomachs. Flipping them onto their backs did the trick.
segments.illustrated_scene:
# scene standard: 2026-10-11
def _sids_baby(cr, cx, cy, flipf, s=1.0):
    """A sleeping baby lying along x, head to the right. flipf 0 = face-down,
    1 = face-up; in between the baby is lifted and rolled over."""
    sy = math.cos(math.pi * flipf)
    up = flipf > 0.5
    lift = 70 * math.sin(math.pi * flipf)
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(cx, cy - lift)
    cr.scale(s, s * max(0.3, abs(sy)))
    contact_shadow(cr, 0, 40, 380, a=0.3 * (1 - math.sin(math.pi * flipf)))
    # feet
    disc(cr, -190, 8, 30, (150, 196, 226))
    # body in a sleepsuit
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(-40, 0)
    cr.scale(1.0, 0.42)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 150, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (150, 196, 226))
    # arms
    disc(cr, 40, -38, 30, (150, 196, 226))
    disc(cr, 40, 40, 30, (150, 196, 226))
    disc(cr, 66, -40, 18, (244, 206, 180))
    disc(cr, 66, 44, 18, (244, 206, 180))
    # head
    disc(cr, 140, 0, 66, (244, 206, 180))
    if not up:
        # face-down: the back of the head, all hair, and the suit's back seam
        cr.arc(132, 0, 64, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        solid(cr, (96, 66, 44), rim=False)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((100, 140, 176)))
        cr.set_line_width(5)
        cr.move_to(-170, 0)
        cr.line_to(60, 0)
        cr.stroke()
    else:
        # face-up: a tuft, closed eyes, a small smile, the tummy
        cr.arc(186, 0, 30, -1.4, 1.4)
        solid(cr, (96, 66, 44), rim=False)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 46, 40)))
        cr.set_line_width(5)
        for ey in (-22, 22):
            cr.arc(146, ey, 11, 0.3 * math.pi, 0.7 * math.pi)
            cr.stroke()
        cr.arc(112, 0, 14, -0.35 * math.pi, 0.35 * math.pi)
        cr.stroke()
        glow(cr, 130, -36, 16, (240, 140, 140), 0.5)
        glow(cr, 130, 36, 16, (240, 140, 140), 0.5)
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(-60, 0)
        cr.scale(1.0, 0.6)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 60, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        solid(cr, (196, 226, 244), edge=False)
    cr.restore()


def _sids_star(cr, x, y, r, rgb):
    cr.move_to(x, y - r)
    for i in range(1, 10):
        a = -math.pi / 2 + i * math.pi / 5
        rr = r if i % 2 == 0 else r * 0.45
        cr.line_to(x + rr * math.cos(a), y + rr * math.sin(a))
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, rgb, finish="gloss")


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a baby asleep in a crib
    SUBSTANCE: the sleeping baby
    CAUSE: Data lifts the face-down baby and places it on its back in the crib
    A nursery at night. The crib's blanket over the front rail is the WHOLE
    of SIDS cases before the campaign, cut at the true proportion: the
    stomach-down share spreads across it in the accent as Data draws it over
    the rail, a thin pale sliver at the far end is the back-up share, the
    rest neutral. Then Data lifts the baby lying on its stomach and places it
    on its back. Done by 0.62 and held; the mobile keeps turning. The blanket's
    labels appear only where Data has already walked past, so he never
    stands over them."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    stom = max(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    back = min(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    s_share = clamp(stom[1] / 100.0)
    b_share = clamp(back[1] / 100.0)

    g0, g1 = 0.08, 0.34          # the blanket's stomach-down share spreads
    w0, w1 = 0.34, 0.42          # Data walks to the head of the crib
    f0, f1 = 0.42, 0.62          # the baby is rolled onto its back
    grow = ease(seg(u, g0, g1))
    flip = ease(seg(u, f0, f1))

    # the nursery: a night-blue wall, a window with the moon, a wooden floor
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (26, 30, 58)), (1, (58, 64, 104))], 0, 1210)
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (128, 92, 64)), (1, (66, 46, 32))], 1200, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 28, 20), 0.35))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(9):
        cr.move_to(-200 + i * 180, H)
        cr.line_to(300 + i * 70, 1200)
    cr.stroke()
    box(cr, 0, 1214, W, 16, (210, 200, 186), depth=6)
    # window
    box(cr, 700, 760, 300, 360, (220, 210, 196), depth=24)
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (14, 18, 46)), (1, (40, 50, 96))], 418, 742, 716, 984)
    glow(cr, 900, 500, 110, (250, 240, 200), 0.5)
    disc(cr, 900, 500, 44, (246, 238, 210))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((220, 210, 196)))
    cr.set_line_width(12)
    cr.move_to(850, 418)
    cr.line_to(850, 742)
    cr.move_to(716, 580)
    cr.line_to(984, 580)
    cr.stroke()
    haze(cr, 380, 1100, (40, 46, 84), a=0.25)
    # a warm night-light glow on the crib
    glow(cr, 540, 1180, 520, (255, 210, 150), 0.22)

    # the crib, three-quarter: back posts and headboard first
    cast_shadow(cr, 160, 806, 1440, length=260, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, 520, 1444, 720, a=0.45)
    wood = (236, 226, 208)
    for bx in (300, 920):
        cylinder(cr, bx - 13, 1330, 26, 420, wood)
    cr.move_to(300, 930)
    cr.line_to(920, 930)
    cr.line_to(920, 1140)
    cr.line_to(300, 1140)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (214, 202, 182))
    for i in range(1, 12):
        x = 300 + i * 620 / 12
        cr.rectangle(x - 5, 950, 10, 180)
        solid(cr, (188, 176, 156), rim=False)
    # the mattress
    cr.move_to(180, 1252)
    cr.line_to(800, 1252)
    cr.line_to(920, 1142)
    cr.line_to(300, 1142)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (246, 244, 238))
    _sids_baby(cr, 540, 1200, flip, s=0.95)

    # front: posts, slats, rail
    for bx in (160, 780):
        cylinder(cr, bx, 1440, 26, 420, wood)
    for i in range(1, 14):
        x = 186 + i * 594 / 14
        cr.rectangle(x - 5, 1262, 10, 176)
        solid(cr, wood, rim=False)
    box(cr, 170, 1262, 630, 22, wood, depth=10)

    # THE WHOLE: the blanket over the front rail, cut at the true shares
    BX0, BX1, BY0, BY1 = 188, 792, 1270, 1416
    bw = BX1 - BX0

    def _blanket():
        cr.move_to(BX0, BY0)
        cr.line_to(BX1, BY0)
        cr.line_to(BX1, BY1)
        for i in range(12, -1, -1):
            x = BX0 + bw * i / 12
            cr.line_to(x, BY1 + 10 * math.sin(i * 1.3))
        cr.close_path()

    _blanket()
    solid(cr, (150, 152, 160))
    cr.save()
    _blanket()
    cr.clip()
    sx1 = BX0 + bw * s_share * grow
    cr.rectangle(BX0, BY0 - 5, sx1 - BX0, BY1 - BY0 + 30)
    solid(cr, P["accent2"], rim=False)
    bx0 = BX1 - bw * b_share
    ba = ease(seg(u, g1 - 0.06, g1))
    cr.rectangle(bx0, BY0 - 5, BX1 - bx0, BY1 - BY0 + 30)
    solid(cr, (246, 242, 230), a=ba, rim=False)
    # quilting seams
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 255, 255), 0.35))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(1, 8):
        cr.move_to(BX0 + bw * i / 8, BY0)
        cr.line_to(BX0 + bw * i / 8, BY1 + 10)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()
    _blanket()
    edge(cr, (40, 36, 44))

    # Data's spot, worked out before any label so the labels keep clear of him
    FY = 1480
    DX_START = 230
    DX_EDGE = BX0 + bw * s_share
    DX_HEAD = 900
    if u < g0:
        dx = DX_START
    elif u < w0:
        dx = DX_START + (DX_EDGE - DX_START) * grow
    elif u < f0:
        dx = DX_EDGE + (DX_HEAD - DX_EDGE) * ease(seg(u, w0, w1))
    else:
        dx = DX_HEAD

    # the stomach label sits at the blanket's left end and appears only once
    # Data has walked well past it (his body is ~70px each side of dx)
    SL_X, SL_SIZE = BX0 + 24, 34
    sl_right = SL_X + SL_SIZE * 0.62 * len("ON STOMACH")
    sl_a = ease(clamp((dx - 100 - sl_right) / 60.0)) if grow > 0.5 else 0.0
    if sl_a > 0:
        text(cr, "ON STOMACH", SL_X, BY0 + 84, SL_SIZE, look.INK, face="bold",
             alpha=sl_a)
    # the back label rides above the blanket's far end, above Data's head
    if ba > 0:
        text(cr, "ON BACK", BX1 - 8, BY0 - 30, 30, look.INK, face="bold",
             anchor="right", alpha=ba)

    # the mobile over the crib keeps turning
    MX, MY, MR = 620, 820, 230
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((200, 196, 210)))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    cr.move_to(MX, 0)
    cr.line_to(MX, MY)
    cr.stroke()
    hang = []
    for i in range(5):
        a = t * 0.6 + i * 2 * math.pi / 5
        hang.append((math.sin(a), MX + MR * math.cos(a), MY + 40 * math.sin(a), i))
    for d, x, y, i in sorted(hang):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((200, 196, 210)))
        cr.set_line_width(3)
        cr.move_to(MX, MY)
        cr.line_to(x, y + 40)
        cr.stroke()
        sc = 0.8 + 0.2 * d
        col = [(250, 214, 96), (246, 176, 120), (250, 214, 96), (170, 206, 240), (246, 176, 120)][i]
        _sids_star(cr, x, y + 90, 48 * sc, col)
    disc(cr, MX, MY, 14, (220, 214, 230), finish="gloss")

    # right by the camera: a rug and a teddy bear
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(540, 1780)
    cr.scale(1.0, 0.22)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 560, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (176, 140, 170), edge=False)
    contact_shadow(cr, 930, 1860, 220, a=0.4)
    disc(cr, 930, 1760, 100, (168, 116, 72))
    disc(cr, 930, 1620, 72, (168, 116, 72))
    disc(cr, 876, 1566, 28, (150, 100, 60))
    disc(cr, 984, 1566, 28, (150, 100, 60))
    disc(cr, 930, 1640, 26, (214, 176, 130))
    disc(cr, 850, 1840, 40, (150, 100, 60))
    disc(cr, 1010, 1840, 40, (150, 100, 60))
    vignette(cr, a=0.3)

    # Data: draws the blanket across, then walks to the head of the crib
    # and lays the baby on its back, and keeps tucking it in
    if u < g0:
        host("point", dx, FY, 220)
    elif u < w0:
        host("hold_up", dx, FY, 220)
    elif u < f0:
        host("point", dx, FY, 220)
    elif u < 0.74:
        host("place", dx, FY, 220, beat=0)
    else:
        host("place", dx, FY, 220, beat=1)

    if flip >= 0.999:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{back[1]:g}%", "of SIDS babies had been put down on their backs",
                    80, 520, size=130)
    elif u >= g0 + 0.1:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{stom[1]:g}%", "of SIDS babies had been put down on their stomachs",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, g0 + 0.1, g0 + 0.15)), size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Before the campaign", "how SIDS babies had been put to sleep",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=110)

v = values[0]
n = int(round(v / 100.0))
cols = 6
for k in range(n):
    cx = RX0 + 100 + (k % cols) * 165
    cy = RTOP + 150 + (k // cols) * 150
    t = clamp(reveal * 1.4 - k * 0.02)

    d.line([cx - 52, cy + 36, cx - 52, cy + 56], fill=rgba(TEXT, int(200 * t)), width=4)
    d.line([cx + 52, cy + 36, cx + 52, cy + 56], fill=rgba(TEXT, int(200 * t)), width=4)
text(fmt(v * clamp(reveal * 1.2)), 540, RBOT - 200, size=120, color=HIGHLIGHT, center=True)

segments.say: Lightning killed just 18 people in the latest year, a tiny toll next to the 1940s.
segments.illustrated_scene:
# scene standard: 2026-10-22
def _ltn_puffs(cx, base, w):
    lobes = [(-0.40, -0.09, 0.11), (-0.27, -0.14, 0.15), (-0.10, -0.18, 0.18),
             (0.10, -0.17, 0.17), (0.28, -0.13, 0.14), (0.41, -0.08, 0.10),
             (-0.16, -0.33, 0.16), (0.06, -0.39, 0.18), (0.22, -0.31, 0.13),
             (-0.02, -0.51, 0.14), (0.14, -0.53, 0.11)]
    return [(cx + dx * w, base + dy * w, r * w) for dx, dy, r in lobes]


def _ltn_outline(cr, cx, base, w):
    # the thunderhead's silhouette: the upper envelope of its puffs over a flat dark base
    pf = _ltn_puffs(cx, base, w)
    xa = min(x - r for x, y, r in pf)
    xb = max(x + r for x, y, r in pf)
    N = 64
    cr.move_to(xa, base)
    for i in range(N + 1):
        x = xa + (xb - xa) * i / N
        ys = [py - math.sqrt(max(0.0, r * r - (x - px) ** 2)) for px, py, r in pf if abs(x - px) < r]
        cr.line_to(x, min(min(ys) if ys else base, base))
    cr.line_to(xb, base)
    cr.curve_to(xb - 0.2 * w, base + 0.05 * w, xa + 0.2 * w, base + 0.05 * w, xa, base)
    cr.close_path()


def _ltn_storm(cr, cx, base, w, flash):
    _ltn_outline(cr, cx, base, w)
    solid(cr, (70, 74, 92), edge=False)
    cr.save()
    _ltn_outline(cr, cx, base, w)
    cr.clip()
    pf = sorted(_ltn_puffs(cx, base, w), key=lambda p: p[1])
    ytop, ybot = pf[0][1], pf[-1][1]
    # soft billows: each puff lit from the upper left, no hard rims inside the cloud
    for px, py, r in pf:
        q = clamp((py - ytop) / max(1.0, ybot - ytop))
        lit = tuple(int(a + (b - a) * q) for a, b in zip((196, 200, 216), (96, 100, 122)))
        sh = tuple(int(c * 0.55) for c in lit)
        g = cairo.RadialGradient(px - 0.35 * r, py - 0.4 * r, 0.1 * r, px, py, r)
        g.add_color_stop_rgba(0, lit[0] / 255, lit[1] / 255, lit[2] / 255, 1.0)
        g.add_color_stop_rgba(0.75, sh[0] / 255, sh[1] / 255, sh[2] / 255, 0.95)
        g.add_color_stop_rgba(1, sh[0] / 255, sh[1] / 255, sh[2] / 255, 0.0)
        cr.arc(px, py, r * 1.05, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.set_source(g)
        cr.fill()
    # the heavy dark underside a thunderstorm carries
    g = cairo.LinearGradient(0, base - 0.26 * w, 0, base + 0.04 * w)
    g.add_color_stop_rgba(0, 26 / 255, 28 / 255, 40 / 255, 0.0)
    g.add_color_stop_rgba(1, 26 / 255, 28 / 255, 40 / 255, 0.92)
    cr.set_source(g)
    cr.paint()
    if flash > 0:
        glow(cr, cx, base - 0.15 * w, 0.55 * w, (220, 228, 255), 0.75 * flash)
    cr.restore()
    _ltn_outline(cr, cx, base, w)
    edge(cr, (24, 26, 36))


def _ltn_rain(cr, cx, base, w, ground, t):
    sway = 30 * math.sin(t * 0.8)
    x0, x1 = cx - 0.4 * w, cx + 0.4 * w
    cr.save()
    cr.move_to(x0, base)
    cr.line_to(x1, base)
    cr.line_to(x1 + 60 + sway, ground)
    cr.line_to(x0 + 60 + sway, ground)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.clip()
    g = cairo.LinearGradient(0, base, 0, ground)
    g.add_color_stop_rgba(0, 60 / 255, 68 / 255, 90 / 255, 0.7)
    g.add_color_stop_rgba(1, 60 / 255, 68 / 255, 90 / 255, 0.05)
    cr.set_source(g)
    cr.paint()
    # fixed slanted streaks inside the curtain: the rain's texture, not drifting particles
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 162, 190), 0.35))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    nst = int(max(4, w / 22))
    for i in range(nst):
        sx = x0 - 40 + (x1 - x0 + 80) * i / nst
        cr.move_to(sx, base)
        cr.line_to(sx + 60 + sway, ground)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()


def _ltn_bolt(cr, x0, y0, x1, y1, seed, a):
    if a <= 0:
        return
    pp = [(x0, y0)]
    nseg = 7
    for i in range(1, nseg):
        q = i / nseg
        pp.append((x0 + (x1 - x0) * q + 40 * math.sin(seed * 3.1 + i * 2.3), y0 + (y1 - y0) * q))
    pp.append((x1, y1))
    cr.set_line_join(cairo.LINE_JOIN_ROUND)
    for wdt, col, al in ((60, (150, 175, 255), 0.35), (18, (255, 250, 222), 1.0)):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(col, al * a))
        cr.set_line_width(wdt)
        cr.move_to(*pp[0])
        for p_ in pp[1:]:
            cr.line_to(*p_)
        cr.stroke()
    glow(cr, x1, y1, 150, (230, 235, 255), 0.85 * a)


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a deadly thunderstorm cloud
    SUBSTANCE: storm cloud and lightning
    CAUSE: Data hammers a grounding rod in at each farmhouse and the killing storm shrinks with every rod
    The storm cloud's size is the year's lightning toll: the 1940s
    thunderhead towers over three farmhouses, a black sky, a curtain of
    rain. House by house Data drives a grounding rod in with a sledgehammer,
    a lightning rod goes up on the roof, the next bolt hits the rod
    harmlessly, the cloud shrinks to the next year's toll and the sky
    clears. The 1940s thunderhead stays as a dashed ghost with its top
    marked, so the small storm left reads as a sliver of it. Done by 0.62
    and held: bolts keep striking the rods, Data keeps hammering."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    if len(rows) < 2:
        rows = rows * 2
    n = len(rows)
    m = n - 1
    top = max(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.62
    span = (a1 - a0) / m
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, m - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    shrink = ease(seg(f, 0.4, 0.85))
    if u < a0:
        val = rows[0][1]
        landed_to = 0
    else:
        val = rows[k][1] + (rows[k + 1][1] - rows[k][1]) * shrink
        landed_to = k + 1 if shrink >= 0.999 else k
    keep = sorted({round(i * (n - 1) / max(1, READOUT_SHOWS - 1))
                   for i in range(READOUT_SHOWS)}) if n > READOUT_SHOWS else list(range(n))
    named = max((i for i in keep if i <= landed_to), default=0)

    CW0, CB = 920.0, 1140.0
    GROUND = 1470.0
    s = math.sqrt(max(val, 0.0) / top)
    cw = max(130.0, CW0 * s)
    drift = 40 * math.sin(t * 0.5) * ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.08))
    ccx = 540 + drift

    # bolt timing, shared by the cloud's inner flash and the sky flash
    bolt = None
    by0 = CB + 0.02 * cw
    if u >= a0 and u < a1:
        if 0.46 <= f < 0.66:
            bolt = (k, k + 2.0, 1.0 - (f - 0.46) / 0.2)
    elif u >= a1:
        per = 1.1
        p_ = (t % per) / per
        if p_ < 0.25:
            bolt = (int(t / per) % m, int(t / per) + 0.5, 1.0 - p_ / 0.25)
    pre_a = 1.0 - seg(t, 0.15, 0.45) if u < a0 else 0.0
    fl = bolt[2] if bolt else pre_a

    # the farm under the storm: the sky is as dark as the storm is deadly
    landscape(cr, t, "field")
    dark = 0.25 + 0.65 * s
    g = cairo.LinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 1250)
    g.add_color_stop_rgba(0, 20 / 255, 24 / 255, 38 / 255, min(0.95, dark + 0.1))
    g.add_color_stop_rgba(1, 26 / 255, 30 / 255, 44 / 255, dark * 0.85)
    cr.rectangle(0, 0, W, 1250)
    cr.set_source(g)
    cr.fill()
    cr.rectangle(0, 1250, W, H - 1250)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((24, 28, 42), dark * 0.5))
    cr.fill()
    haze(cr, 1080, 1260, (96, 102, 118), a=0.3)

    # THE HERO: the thunderhead, its size the year's toll, its rain under it
    _ltn_rain(cr, ccx, CB, cw, GROUND - 40, t)
    _ltn_storm(cr, ccx, CB, cw, fl)
    # THE SCALE: the 1940s thunderhead stays where it stood, dashed, its top marked
    if val < rows[0][1] * 0.98:
        _ltn_outline(cr, 540, CB, CW0)
        ghost(cr, a=0.9)
        then_mark(cr, 400, 660, CB - 0.65 * CW0, rows[0][0])

    # the farmhouses, one rod each, their windows lit
    slot = 960.0 / m
    hw = min(260.0, slot * 0.78)
    cols = [(222, 212, 192), (178, 84, 62), (150, 170, 184)]
    rods, spots = [], []
    for j in range(m):
        x0 = 40 + j * slot + (slot - hw) / 2
        x1 = x0 + hw
        cast_shadow(cr, x0, x1, GROUND, length=220, a=0.3)
        contact_shadow(cr, (x0 + x1) / 2, GROUND + 2, hw + 40, a=0.38)
        b = building(cr, x0, x1, GROUND, 165, cols[j % 3], roof="gable")
        pk = b.get("peak", b["top"] - 70)
        py = pk[1] if isinstance(pk, (tuple, list)) else pk
        # a chimney, a door, two warm windows: a home
        box(cr, x0 + hw * 0.18, b["top"] - 30, 28, 76, (120, 70, 56), depth=10)
        dwid = hw * 0.2
        cr.rectangle((x0 + x1) / 2 - dwid / 2, GROUND - 92, dwid, 92)
        solid(cr, (92, 60, 44), rim=False)
        for wx in (x0 + hw * 0.12, x1 - hw * 0.12 - hw * 0.2):
            cr.rectangle(wx, GROUND - 128, hw * 0.2, 50)
            solid(cr, (255, 214, 140), finish="glass", rim=False)
            glow(cr, wx + hw * 0.1, GROUND - 102, 50, (255, 210, 130), 0.45)
        rx = (x0 + x1) / 2
        gx = x1 + 22
        spots.append(gx - 80)
        rods.append((rx, py - 64))
        inst = u >= a0 and (j < k or (j == k and f >= 0.45))
        if u >= a0 and j <= k:
            drive = 1.0 if j < k else ease(seg(f, 0.3, 0.45))
            rh = 20 + 80 * (1 - drive)
            contact_shadow(cr, gx, GROUND + 22, 34, a=0.3)
            cr.rectangle(gx - 7, GROUND + 20 - rh, 14, rh)
            solid(cr, (176, 120, 70), finish="metal")
        if inst:
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 92, 52)))
            cr.set_line_width(6)
            cr.move_to(rx, py)
            cr.line_to(x1, b["top"])
            cr.line_to(x1, GROUND)
            cr.line_to(gx, GROUND + 4)
            cr.stroke()
            cr.rectangle(rx - 5, py - 58, 10, 60)
            solid(cr, (160, 164, 172), finish="metal")
            disc(cr, rx, py - 64, 11, (200, 204, 212), finish="metal")

    # the bolts: into the open field before, onto a rod after each one goes in
    if u < a0:
        _ltn_bolt(cr, ccx - 60, by0, 540, 1330, 1.0, pre_a)
    elif bolt is not None:
        rx, ry = rods[bolt[0]]
        _ltn_bolt(cr, ccx + (rx - ccx) * 0.3, by0, rx, ry, bolt[1], bolt[2])

    # right by the camera: the farm fence, the grass
    for i in range(4):
        px = 40 + i * 300
        contact_shadow(cr, px + 18, 1772, 70, a=0.35)
        box(cr, px, 1770, 36, 190, (120, 92, 64), depth=14)
    cr.rectangle(0, 1640, W, 16)
    solid(cr, (138, 106, 74))
    cr.rectangle(0, 1700, W, 16)
    solid(cr, (138, 106, 74))
    foreground(cr, "field")
    if fl > 0:
        cr.rectangle(0, 0, W, H)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((225, 232, 255), 0.18 * fl))
        cr.fill()
    vignette(cr, a=0.3)

    # Data goes house to house driving the rods in
    FY = GROUND + 24
    HH = 240
    if u < a0:
        host("point", spots[0], FY, HH)
    else:
        if k > 0 and f < 0.3:
            hx = spots[k - 1] + (spots[k] - spots[k - 1]) * ease(f / 0.3)
        else:
            hx = spots[k]
        if u < a1:
            bt = 2 * k + (1 if f >= 0.3 else 0)
        else:
            bt = 2 * m + int((u - a1) / 0.12)
        host("hammer", hx, FY, HH, beat=bt)

    WHITE = (244, 246, 250)
    lab, v = rows[named]
    fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v))} deaths", f"killed by lightning a year · {lab}",
                80, 470, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), rgb=WHITE, size=120)
    if landed_to >= n - 1 and u >= a0:
        ratio = rows[0][1] / max(rows[-1][1], 1.0)
        # said inside the empty 1940s outline: the hollow IS the lives no longer lost
        text(cr, f"{ratio:.0f}x fewer", 540, 830, 96, WHITE, face="display",
             anchor="center", alpha=ease(seg(u, a1 - 0.02, a1 + 0.04)))

# scene standard: 2026-10-22
def _lz_bolt_path(cr, x, y, h):
    """A jagged lightning bolt as the current path, its strike tip at (x, y), `h` tall."""
    pts_ = [(-0.12, -1.0), (0.16, -1.0), (0.04, -0.66), (0.22, -0.66),
            (0.02, -0.34), (0.14, -0.34), (0.0, 0.0), (-0.08, -0.40),
            (-0.20, -0.40), (-0.04, -0.70), (-0.18, -0.70)]
    for i, (px, py) in enumerate(pts_):
        X = x + px * h
        Y = y + py * h
        if i == 0:
            cr.move_to(X, Y)
        else:
            cr.line_to(X, Y)
    cr.close_path()


def _lz_bolt(cr, x, y, h, a=1.0):
    """The bolt drawn lit: a hot glow, a gloss yellow-white body, a white-hot core edge."""
    if a <= 0.01 or h < 4:
        return
    glow(cr, x, y - 0.5 * h, 0.8 * h, (255, 236, 150), 0.5 * a)
    _lz_bolt_path(cr, x, y, h)
    solid(cr, (255, 216, 70), finish="gloss", a=a)
    _lz_bolt_path(cr, x, y, h)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 252, 232), 0.85 * a))
    cr.set_line_width(max(2.0, 0.014 * h))
    cr.stroke()


def _lz_cloudbank(cr, drift, y, rgb, seed, a=1.0):
    """One storm-cloud bank as a single lit mass: billows merged into one path, flat-ish base."""
    for i in range(14):
        r = 95 + 38 * ((i * 7 + seed) % 3)
        x = -220 + ((i * 115 + drift + seed * 57) % 1540)
        cr.new_sub_path()
        cr.arc(x, y - 0.35 * r, r, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.new_sub_path()
    cr.rectangle(-60, y - 60, W + 120, 70)
    solid(cr, rgb, edge=False, a=a)


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a giant lightning bolt
    SUBSTANCE: the lightning bolt itself
    CAUSE: Data saws chunks off the giant lightning bolt, cut by cut, until it is a fortieth of its size
    A storm over a beach. The 1940s bolt comes down out of the storm clouds
    and stands planted in the sand, as tall as the sky, its size the
    per-person risk of being killed by it. Data walks up the beach with a
    saw and cuts it down, four strokes, each one dropping a chunk that
    fizzles out on the sand, until the bolt is one fortieth of its old size
    by area, knee-high beside him. The 1940s bolt stays as a dashed ghost
    with its year, so forty to one reads at a glance. Landed by 0.6 and
    held: the storm rolls off, the surf keeps washing in, he keeps holding
    up the stub."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    hi, lo = max(v0, v1), (min(v0, v1) or 1.0)
    hi = hi or 1.0
    ratio = hi / lo
    y0_lab, y1_lab = l0.split()[0], l1.split()[0]

    n = 4
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.6
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    cutp = ease(seg(f, 0.3, 0.75))
    step = 0.0 if u < a0 else (k + cutp) / n
    done = u >= a0 and k == n - 1 and cutp >= 0.999

    CX, BASE, H0 = 600, 1440, 840.0

    def _h(s):
        return H0 * math.sqrt((lo / hi) ** s)

    hb = _h(step)

    gy = landscape(cr, t, "coast")
    clear = ease(seg(u, 0.62, 1.0))
    # the storm darkens the whole shot, lifting once it lands
    cr.rectangle(0, 0, W, gy)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((22, 26, 42), 0.55 * (1 - 0.5 * clear)))
    cr.fill()
    cr.rectangle(0, gy, W, H - gy)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((18, 22, 30), 0.2 * (1 - 0.6 * clear)))
    cr.fill()

    # a lifeguard tower up the beach, far behind
    TX, TB = 70, 1350
    cast_shadow(cr, TX, TX + 150, TB, length=200, a=0.25)
    contact_shadow(cr, TX + 75, TB + 2, 180, a=0.3)
    for lx in (TX + 10, TX + 124):
        cylinder(cr, lx, TB, 16, 150, (214, 206, 190))
    box(cr, TX - 10, TB - 150, 170, 110, (232, 228, 214), depth=40)
    cr.rectangle(TX + 18, TB - 236, 114, 50)
    solid(cr, (60, 70, 86), finish="glass", rim=False)
    cr.move_to(TX - 26, TB - 260)
    cr.line_to(TX + 186, TB - 260)
    cr.line_to(TX + 216, TB - 280)
    cr.line_to(TX + 4, TB - 280)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (196, 56, 48))
    haze(cr, 1100, TB, (120, 126, 142), a=0.3)

    # the storm clouds: two merged banks rolling across, the bolt comes out of them
    drift = 50 * t + 420 * clear
    _lz_cloudbank(cr, 0.6 * drift, 690, (104, 108, 126), 1, a=0.96)
    _lz_cloudbank(cr, drift, 760, (66, 70, 88), 2, a=0.97)

    # scorched sand where the bolt is planted
    contact_shadow(cr, CX, BASE + 4, max(80, 0.55 * hb), a=0.45)
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(CX, BASE + 2)
    cr.scale(1, 0.25)
    cr.arc(0, 0, max(50, 0.34 * hb), 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (70, 56, 44), rim=False, edge=False, a=0.85)

    # THE SCALE: the 1940s bolt as a ghost where it stood
    if u > a0 + 0.04:
        _lz_bolt_path(cr, CX, BASE, H0)
        ghost(cr, a=0.9)

    # the hero
    _lz_bolt(cr, CX, BASE, hb)
    glow(cr, CX, BASE, max(60, 0.28 * hb), (255, 240, 180), 0.55)

    # the chunk the last stroke cut, tumbling to the sand and fizzling out
    if u >= a0 and 0.3 < f < 1.0:
        q = clamp((f - 0.3) / 0.7)
        hp = _h(k / n)
        cx_ = CX + 0.1 * hp + 280 * q
        cy_ = BASE - 0.7 * hp + (0.7 * hp) * q * q
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(cx_, cy_)
        cr.rotate(2.2 * q)
        _lz_bolt(cr, 0, 0, 0.45 * (hp - _h((k + 1) / n)) + 40, a=1.0 - q)
        cr.restore()

    # right by the camera: surf washing up the sand, a cooler and a beach ball
    wv = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 2 * math.pi / 2.6)
    wy = 1860 - 150 * wv
    cr.move_to(0, H)
    cr.line_to(0, wy + 20)
    for i in range(13):
        cr.line_to(i * 90, wy + 18 * math.sin(i * 1.3 + t * 1.5))
    cr.line_to(W, wy + 10)
    cr.line_to(W, H)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (120, 160, 176), finish="gloss", edge=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((244, 248, 250), 0.9))
    cr.set_line_width(14)
    cr.move_to(0, wy + 20)
    for i in range(13):
        cr.line_to(i * 90, wy + 18 * math.sin(i * 1.3 + t * 1.5))
    cr.line_to(W, wy + 10)
    cr.stroke()
    contact_shadow(cr, 200, 1700, 220, a=0.4)
    box(cr, 110, 1700, 180, 110, (200, 64, 56), depth=46, finish="gloss")
    box(cr, 100, 1590, 200, 22, (236, 236, 230), depth=50)
    contact_shadow(cr, 900, 1712, 130, a=0.4)
    disc(cr, 900, 1660, 54, (236, 200, 60), finish="gloss")
    cr.arc(900, 1660, 54, -2.2, -0.9)
    cr.arc_negative(900, 1660, 20, -0.9, -2.2)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (40, 120, 200), rim=False)
    foreground(cr, "coast", y0=1600)
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data walks up the beach and saws the bolt down, closing in as it shrinks
    cut_x = CX - 0.2 * hb - 85
    if u < a0:
        hx = 220 + (cut_x - 220) * ease(seg(u, 0.0, a0))
        host("point", hx, 1460, 236)
    elif u < a1 + 0.04:
        host("cut", cut_x, 1460, 236, beat=k)
    elif u < 0.92:
        host("hold_up", cut_x, 1460, 236)
    else:
        host("cheer", cut_x, 1460, 236)

    # labels and readout last, clear of Data
    if u > a0 + 0.04:
        text(cr, y0_lab, CX + 0.26 * H0, BASE - 0.55 * H0, 36, look.INK, anchor="left",
             alpha=ease(seg(u, a0 + 0.04, a0 + 0.09)))
    if done:
        text(cr, y1_lab, CX + 0.25 * hb + 30, BASE - 0.5 * hb, 32, look.INK,
             anchor="left", alpha=ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.04)))
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(ratio))}x less deadly",
                    f"lightning, per person · {y1_lab} vs {y0_lab}", 80, 520, size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Lightning", f"deaths per person · {y0_lab}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

def _skiff(cr, bx, wy, s, roll, part):

def _bolt(cr, x0, y0, x1, y1, a):
    if a <= 0:
        return
    pts_ = [(x0, y0)]
    for i in range(1, 8):
        q = i / 8.0
        jog = (58 if i % 2 else -50) * (1 - q * 0.5)
        pts_.append((x0 + (x1 - x0) * q + jog, y0 + (y1 - y0) * q))
    pts_.append((x1, y1))
    glow(cr, x1, y1, 380, (220, 230, 255), 0.9 * a)
    glow(cr, x0, y0, 260, (220, 230, 255), 0.6 * a)
    bx, by = pts_[3]
    for wdt, col, al in ((48, (160, 184, 255), 0.35), (17, (252, 250, 236), 1.0)):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(col, al * a))
        cr.set_line_width(wdt)
        cr.move_to(*pts_[0])
        for p_ in pts_[1:]:
            cr.line_to(*p_)
        cr.move_to(bx, by)
        cr.line_to(bx + 110, by + 120)
        cr.line_to(bx + 150, by + 230)
        cr.stroke()
    # the splash ring where it hits the water
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x1, y1)
    cr.scale(1, 0.25)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 90 + 60 * (1 - a), 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 242, 255), 0.8 * a))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    cr.stroke()


def _thunderhead(cr, x0, t):
    # one towering storm cloud whose leading edge is x0: billowing lit tops,
    # a bulging front, a flat dark base over the lake
    base = 770

        cr.new_sub_path()
        cr.arc(x0 + 120 + 50 * math.sin(i * 1.9), cy, 120 + 24 * (i % 3), 0, 2 * math.pi)
    for i in range(18):
        cx = x0 + 140 + i * 80
        cr.new_sub_path()
        cr.arc(cx, base - 40 + 22 * math.sin(i * 1.7 + t * 0.3), 70 + 12 * ((i * 0.37) % 1.0),
               0, 2 * math.pi)


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a fishing boat on a stormy lake
    SUBSTANCE: a black thunderstorm and lightning
    CAUSE: Data paddles the fishing boat off the dock out to open water as the storm rolls over him
    The fishing beat: a green johnboat with its rod out, tied by the dock
    under a fair sky. Stroke by stroke Data paddles it off the dock into the
    middle of the lake while a black thunderhead rolls in from the right
    until it covers the whole sky and the swells rise. Landed by 0.56 and
    held: a bolt cracks into the open water right beside the boat, he
    flinches, then keeps paddling, and a second bolt hits. The readout is
    the share: one in ten lightning deaths are people fishing."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    tot = sum(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    fish = next(((l, v) for l, v in rows if "fish" in l.lower()),
                min(rows, key=lambda r: r[1]))
    one_in = int(round(tot / fish[1])) if fish[1] else 0
    pct = int(round(100.0 * fish[1] / tot))

    n = 4
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.56
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    surge = ease(seg(f, 0.2, 0.85))
    prog = 0.0 if u < a0 else (1.0 if u >= a1 else (k + surge) / n)
    storm = ease(seg(u, 0.04, a1))

    HZ = 1020
    BX0, BY0, S0 = 600.0, 1420.0, 1.3
    BX1, BY1, S1 = 640.0, 1200.0, 1.08
    bx = BX0 + (BX1 - BX0) * prog
    wy = BY0 + (BY1 - BY0) * prog
    bs = S0 + (S1 - S0) * prog
    rough = 0.4 + 0.6 * storm
    roll = 0.04 * math.sin(t * 1.4) * rough
    bob = 8 * math.sin(t * 1.4 + 0.6) * rough

    # the setting: a lake shore, the sky going black as the storm comes
    landscape(cr, t, "coast", horizon=HZ)
    g = cairo.LinearGradient(0, 0, 0, HZ)
    g.add_color_stop_rgba(0, 0.07, 0.08, 0.11, 0.8 * storm)
    g.add_color_stop_rgba(1, 0.20, 0.22, 0.28, 0.65 * storm)
    cr.set_source(g)
    cr.rectangle(0, 0, W, HZ)
    cr.fill()

    # the thunderhead rolling in from the right until it fills the sky
    cx0 = 900 - 1200 * storm
    cr.save()
    _thunderhead(cr, cx0, t)
    cr.clip()
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (128, 132, 146)), (0.45, (76, 80, 94)), (1, (30, 32, 42))], 0, 830)
    glow(cr, cx0 + 80, 160, 260, (200, 204, 216), 0.35)
    cr.restore()
    # the rain curtain hanging from its base down to the far shore
    rc = cairo.LinearGradient(0, 760, 0, HZ)
    rc.add_color_stop_rgba(0, 0.16, 0.17, 0.22, 0.75)
    rc.add_color_stop_rgba(1, 0.30, 0.32, 0.38, 0.25)
    cr.set_source(rc)
    cr.rectangle(max(0, cx0 + 180), 760, W, HZ - 760)
    cr.fill()

    flash = (math.sin(math.pi * seg(u, 0.60, 0.68))
             + math.sin(math.pi * seg(u, 0.80, 0.90)))
    if flash > 0:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((210, 220, 250), 0.3 * flash))
        cr.rectangle(0, 0, W, HZ)
        cr.fill()

    # the far shore under haze
    ridge(cr, HZ, 60, seed=2.0)
    solid(cr, (56, 70, 64), edge=False)
    treeline(cr, HZ + 4, (36, 52, 44), n=16, seed=3)
    haze(cr, 860, HZ + 10, (96, 104, 118), a=0.5)

    # the lake: blue water, broad swells rolling in that grow with the storm
    top_c = tuple(int(a + (b - a) * storm) for a, b in zip((92, 136, 170), (50, 70, 88)))
    bot_c = tuple(int(a + (b - a) * storm) for a, b in zip((40, 84, 120), (18, 32, 48)))
    vgrad(cr, [(0, top_c), (1, bot_c)], HZ, H)
    for r in range(7):
        y = HZ + 40 + 34 * r + 7 * r * r
        amp = (5 + 5 * r) * rough
        lam = 220 + 70 * r
        ph = t * (30 + 16 * r) + r * 80
        cr.move_to(0, y)
        for x in range(0, W + 31, 30):
            cr.line_to(x, y + amp * math.sin((x + ph) * 2 * math.pi / lam))
        cr.line_to(W, y + 40 + 10 * r)
        cr.line_to(0, y + 40 + 10 * r)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((14, 28, 44), 0.3))
        cr.fill()
        for x in range(0, W, lam):
            cx = x + (ph % lam) - lam * 0.25
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((226, 236, 242), 0.5 * storm))
            cr.set_line_width(3 + r * 0.6)
            cr.move_to(cx - 18 - 4 * r, y - amp + 2)
            cr.line_to(cx + 18 + 4 * r, y - amp + 2)
            cr.stroke()

    # the bolts, down out of the storm's base into open water beside him
    for (s0, s1) in ((0.60, 0.68), (0.80, 0.90)):
        ba = math.sin(math.pi * seg(u, s0, s1))
        _bolt(cr, 240, 760, 330, BY1 - 10, ba)

    # the dock he set off from, running out from the camera on the left
    cast_shadow(cr, 0, 300, H - 40, length=200, a=0.25)
    for px, py in ((128, 1290), (210, 1560), (300, 1880)):
        cr.rectangle(px - 12, py - 20, 24, 110)
        solid(cr, (92, 68, 46), rim=False)
    cr.move_to(0, 1250)
    cr.line_to(140, 1246)
    cr.line_to(330, H)
    cr.line_to(0, H)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (168, 128, 86))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((110, 80, 52), 0.7))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(1, 14):
        yy = 1250 + (H - 1250) * (i / 14.0) ** 1.6
        cr.move_to(0, yy)
        cr.line_to(140 + 190 * (yy - 1250) / (H - 1250), yy)
    cr.stroke()
    # the slack mooring rope still tied to the dock post
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((222, 204, 160)))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    cr.move_to(150, 1300)
    cr.curve_to(200, 1400, 240, 1440, 250, 1420 - 100 * prog)
    cr.stroke()

    # the boat, Data in it with his paddle
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(bx, wy + 40 * bs + bob)
    cr.scale(1, 0.18)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 330 * bs, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((10, 20, 30), 0.4))
    cr.fill()
    _skiff(cr, bx, wy + bob, bs, roll, "inside")
    fx, fy = bx - 40 * bs, wy - 56 * bs + bob
    hh = 240 - 20 * prog
    if u < a0:
        host("think", fx, fy, hh)
    elif u < 0.60:
        host("paddle", fx, fy, hh, beat=k)
    elif u < 0.72:
        host("shock", fx, fy, hh)
    else:
        host("paddle", fx, fy, hh, beat=n + int((u - 0.72) / 0.09))
    _skiff(cr, bx, wy + bob, bs, roll, "hull")
    # the chop slapping the hull's waterline
    cr.move_to(bx - 340 * bs, wy + 26 * bs + bob)
    for x in range(-340, 351, 30):
        cr.line_to(bx + x * bs, wy + (28 + 8 * rough * math.sin((x + t * 90) / 40.0)) * bs + bob)
    cr.line_to(bx + 350 * bs, wy + 90 * bs)
    cr.line_to(bx - 340 * bs, wy + 90 * bs)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 52, 72), 0.8))
    cr.fill()

    # right by the camera: his tackle box open on the dock, lures in it
    contact_shadow(cr, 150, 1820, 210, a=0.45)
    box(cr, 60, 1820, 170, 96, (196, 64, 44), finish="gloss")
    cr.rectangle(70, 1722, 150, 10)
    solid(cr, (60, 60, 66), rim=False)
    for i, col in enumerate(((240, 200, 60), (80, 170, 220), (240, 240, 236))):
        disc(cr, 100 + i * 42, 1716, 10, col, finish="gloss")
    foreground(cr, "coast", y0=1760)
    vignette(cr, a=0.32)

    if u >= a1:
        fit_readout(cr, f"1 in {one_in}", f"US lightning deaths happen fishing · {pct}%",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.05)), size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Gone fishing", "into a thunderstorm",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

segments.illustrated_scene:
# scene standard: 2026-10-09
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a giant phone built like a slot machine
    SUBSTANCE: red notification badges
    CAUSE: Data cranks the phone's slot lever and every pull spills a load of red badges onto the heap
    A phone as tall as a building stands in a town at dusk, built like a
    slot machine: app icons on spinning reels, a lever on its side, a payout
    tray under the screen. Every pull of the lever spins the reels and spills
    red notification badges out of the tray onto a heap in front of it. The
    heap starts at 2023's 144 checks a day and grows pull by pull to 2024's
    205. 2023's heap stays on it as a dashed ghost with its top marked, so it
    reads as about one and a half times as much. It is done by 0.56 and then
    holds: Data keeps pulling, and the extra badges tumble off the heap."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    v0 = v0 or 1.0
    ratio = v1 / v0
    n = 6
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.56
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    if u < a1:
        k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
        f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    else:                                   # he keeps pulling, the story holds
        q = (u - a1) / 0.11
        k = n + int(q)
        f = q - int(q)
    fly = seg(f, 0.2, 0.55)
    grow = ease(seg(f, 0.4, 0.75))
    if u < a0:
        step = 0.0
    elif u < a1:
        step = (k + grow) / n
    else:
        step = 1.0
    val = v0 + (v1 - v0) * step
    done = u >= a1 or (k == n - 1 and grow >= 0.999)

    CX, BASE = 540, 1460
    H0 = 220.0
    h = H0 * val / v0
    hw = min(380.0, 1.15 * h)
    h0, hw0 = H0, min(380.0, 1.15 * H0)

    landscape(cr, t, "town")

    # the phone: a slot machine as tall as a building
    PX, PB, PW, PH, PD = 320, 1330, 400, 680, 70
    cast_shadow(cr, PX, PX + PW + PD, PB, length=320, a=0.32)
    contact_shadow(cr, PX + PW / 2 + 30, PB + 4, PW + 120, a=0.45)
    box(cr, PX, PB, PW, PH, (34, 36, 44), depth=PD, finish="gloss")
    top = PB - PH
    # the screen, glowing
    sx0, sx1, sy0, sy1 = PX + 26, PX + PW - 26, top + 40, PB - 120
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(sx0, sy0, sx1 - sx0, sy1 - sy0)
    cr.clip()
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (40, 54, 110)), (1, (18, 22, 52))], sy0, sy1, sx0, sx1)
    glow(cr, (sx0 + sx1) / 2, (sy0 + sy1) / 2, 260, (120, 150, 255), 0.35)
    # three reels of app icons
    ICONS = [(226, 52, 60), (60, 190, 110), (70, 140, 240), (250, 190, 50), (190, 80, 220)]
    pitch = 120.0
    rc = (sy0 + sy1) / 2 - 20
    for r_ in range(3):
        rx = sx0 + 24 + r_ * 112
        cr.rectangle(rx, rc - 170, 96, 340)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 238, 246)))
        cr.fill()
        spin = 0.0 if u < a0 else k * 4 + ease(seg(f, 0.05 + 0.08 * r_, 0.45 + 0.08 * r_)) * 4
        base_i = int(spin)
        off = (spin - base_i) * pitch
        for j in range(-2, 3):
            iy = rc + j * pitch + off - pitch * 0.5 + 60
            col = ICONS[(base_i - j + r_ * 2) % len(ICONS)]
            cr.rectangle(rx + 12, iy - 36, 72, 72)
            solid(cr, col, finish="gloss")
        cr.rectangle(rx, rc - 170, 96, 340)
        edge(cr, (20, 22, 30))
    cr.restore()
    # payline
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((250, 200, 60), 0.9))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    cr.move_to(sx0 + 10, rc + 0)
    cr.line_to(sx1 - 10, rc + 0)
    cr.stroke()
    # the camera notch, the payout tray
    cr.rectangle((PX + PX + PW) / 2 - 50, top + 14, 100, 14)
    solid(cr, (14, 14, 18), rim=False)
    TRX, TRY = PX + PW / 2, PB - 70
    cr.rectangle(TRX - 120, TRY - 24, 240, 44)
    solid(cr, (12, 12, 16), rim=False)
    cr.rectangle(TRX - 130, TRY + 20, 260, 18)
    solid(cr, (150, 150, 162), finish="metal")

    # the lever on the phone's side
    pull = 0.0 if u < a0 else clamp(seg(f, 0.0, 0.15) - seg(f, 0.25, 0.5))
    ang = -1.25 + 1.4 * ease(pull)
    LX, LY, LL = PX + PW + PD - 4, 1130, 200
    disc(cr, LX, LY, 22, (120, 120, 130), finish="metal")
    ex, ey = LX + LL * math.cos(ang), LY + LL * math.sin(ang)
    cr.set_line_width(16)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((190, 190, 200)))
    cr.move_to(LX, LY)
    cr.line_to(ex, ey)
    cr.stroke()
    disc(cr, ex, ey, 30, (220, 40, 50), finish="gloss")

    def _badge(x, y, r):
        disc(cr, x, y, r, (222, 42, 52), finish="gloss")
        cr.rectangle(x - r * 0.12, y - r * 0.45, r * 0.24, r * 0.9)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((250, 248, 246)))
        cr.fill()

    # the heap of badges in front of the phone
    contact_shadow(cr, CX, BASE + 4, 2 * hw + 60, a=0.4)
    heap_path(cr, CX, BASE, h, hw)
    solid(cr, (170, 36, 46))
    cr.save()
    heap_path(cr, CX, BASE, h, hw)
    cr.clip()
    count = int(50 + 120 * (val - v0) / max(1.0, v1 - v0) + 0.5)
    for i in range(count):
        dx = ((i * 0.6180339) % 1.0) * 1.9 - 0.95
        py = (i * 0.4142136) % 1.0
        bx = CX + hw * dx
        ty = heap_top(CX, BASE, h, hw, bx)
        _badge(bx, BASE - (BASE - ty) * py * 0.95 - 8, 16 + 8 * ((i * 0.37) % 1.0))
    cr.restore()
    heap_path(cr, CX, BASE, h, hw)
    edge(cr, (60, 14, 20))

    # THE SCALE on the heap: 2023's heap as a ghost, its top marked
    if step > 0.02:
        heap_path(cr, CX, BASE, h0, hw0)
        ghost(cr, a=0.9)
        then_mark(cr, CX - 150, CX + 150, BASE - h0, l0)

    # the payout: badges spilling from the tray onto the heap
    if u >= a0 and 0 < fly < 1:
        tx, ty = CX + 30, BASE - h - 14
        for j in range(5):
            ff = clamp(fly * 1.3 - j * 0.07)
            if ff <= 0 or ff >= 1:
                continue
            bx = TRX + (j - 2) * 30 + (tx + (j - 2) * 40 - TRX - (j - 2) * 30) * ff
            by = TRY + (ty - TRY) * ff * ff - 60 * math.sin(math.pi * ff)
            _badge(bx, by, 26)
    # after it lands, the extra badges tumble down the flanks
    if u > a1:
        for j in range(4):
            ph = ((u - a1) / 0.14 + j / 4) % 1.0
            side = 1 if j % 2 else -1
            bx = CX + side * hw * (0.08 + 0.85 * ph)
            _badge(bx, heap_top(CX, BASE, h, hw, bx) - 14, 24)

    # right by the camera: badges scattered on the pavement
    for i in range(5):
        _badge(110 + i * 215, 1660 + (i % 2) * 70 + i * 12, 40 + 8 * (i % 2))
    foreground(cr, "town")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data walks in to the lever and cranks it, standing on the heap's flank
    hx = 1020 - 150 * ease(seg(u, 0.0, a0 + 0.04))
    hy = BASE
    if abs(hx - CX) < hw:
        hy = min(BASE, heap_top(CX, BASE, h, hw, hx) + 10)
    hy = min(1500.0, hy)
    if u < a0:
        host("point", hx, hy, 220)
    else:
        host("crank", hx, hy, 220, beat=k)

    if done:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v1))} checks", f"phone pickups a day · {l1}",
                    80, 520, size=130)
        text(cr, f"{ratio:.1f}x", W - 80, 640, 90, look.INK, face="display",
             anchor="right", alpha=ease(seg(u, a1 - 0.04, a1 + 0.02)))
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v0))} checks", f"phone pickups a day · {l0}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a giant clock face in a town square
    SUBSTANCE: smartphones with lit screens
    CAUSE: Data tosses phones onto the clock's hours and they pile up over a third of its face
    A great clock laid into the paving of a town square is the whole waking
    day, one tick per waking hour. Data walks round its rim from the top,
    tossing armfuls of phones onto the hours; each throw lands and the hours
    it covers vanish under a mound of glowing screens, until the phone's
    share of the day is buried at its true size, about a third of the one
    face. Done by 0.56 and held: Data holds up one more phone, loose phones
    slide off the mound, and people keep crossing the square with their
    heads bowed over their own."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    total = sum(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    scr = next((r for r in rows if "phone" in r[0].lower() or "screen" in r[0].lower()),
               min(rows, key=lambda r: r[1]))
    v = scr[1]
    share = v / total
    full = 2 * math.pi * share
    n = max(1, int(round(v)))
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.56
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    wk = ease(seg(f, 0.0, 0.3))
    fly = seg(f, 0.25, 0.6)
    grow = ease(seg(f, 0.5, 0.85))
    if u < a0:
        cov = 0.0
    elif u >= a1:
        cov = 1.0
    else:
        cov = (k + grow) / n
    ang = full * cov
    done = u >= a1

    def mid(j):
        return full * (j + 0.5) / n

    CX, CY, RX, RY = 540, 1150, 440, 270

    landscape(cr, t, "town", horizon=800)
    # the square's own buildings round the far side, in three-quarter view
    for x0, x1, wh, rgb, roof in ((-60, 260, 230, (176, 92, 70), "gable"),
                                  (300, 640, 170, (206, 190, 160), "flat"),
                                  (690, 1130, 250, (150, 120, 104), "gable")):
        fr = building(cr, x0, x1, 820, wh, rgb, roof=roof, boards=False)
        for wx in range(int(fr["x0"]) + 30, int(fr["x1"]) - 50, 70):
            for wy in (fr["top"] + 40, fr["top"] + 120):
                if wy + 50 < 810:
                    cr.rectangle(wx, wy, 36, 50)
                    solid(cr, (255, 214, 150), finish="glass", rim=False)
    haze(cr, 480, 830, (226, 206, 186), a=0.5)
    birds(cr, t, y0=640, n=4, rgb=(50, 50, 62))

    # the clock set into the square: a low stone dais, brass ring, cream face
    cast_shadow(cr, CX - RX, CX + RX, CY + RY, length=300, a=0.28)
    contact_shadow(cr, CX, CY + RY + 30, 2 * RX + 40, a=0.4)
    _ell(cr, CX, CY + 34, RX + 26, RY + 18)
    solid(cr, (120, 116, 110))
    _ell(cr, CX, CY, RX + 26, RY + 18)
    solid(cr, P["brass"], finish="metal")
    _ell(cr, CX, CY, RX, RY)
    solid(cr, (240, 234, 216), finish="gloss")
    for i in range(int(round(total))):
        a = 2 * math.pi * i / total
        big = i % 4 == 0
        r0 = 0.84 if big else 0.9
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((36, 34, 40)))
        cr.set_line_width(12 if big else 7)
        cr.move_to(CX + r0 * RX * math.sin(a), CY - r0 * RY * math.cos(a))
        cr.line_to(CX + 0.97 * RX * math.sin(a), CY - 0.97 * RY * math.cos(a))
        cr.stroke()
    for ha, hl, hw in ((-1.05, 0.5, 18), (3.7, 0.72, 12)):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((0, 0, 0), 0.25))
        cr.set_line_width(hw)
        cr.move_to(CX + 8, CY + 10)
        cr.line_to(CX + 8 + hl * RX * math.sin(ha), CY + 10 - hl * RY * math.cos(ha))
        cr.stroke()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 28, 34)))
        cr.move_to(CX, CY)
        cr.line_to(CX + hl * RX * math.sin(ha), CY - hl * RY * math.cos(ha))
        cr.stroke()

    # the buried hours: a MOUND of glowing phones, layer on layer
    if ang > 0.002:
        ma = ang / 2
        glow(cr, CX + 0.5 * RX * math.sin(ma), CY - 0.5 * RY * math.cos(ma), 300,
             (110, 170, 255), 0.5)
        _sector(cr, CX, CY, RX, RY, ang, 0.98)
        solid(cr, (40, 70, 130), finish="glass", rim=False)
        for L, cnt in ((0, 150), (1, 110), (2, 70), (3, 40)):
            lift = L * 22
            rr = 0.98 - 0.2 * L
            cr.save()
            _sector(cr, CX, CY - lift, RX, RY, ang, rr)
            cr.clip()
            for i in range(cnt):
                pa = ((i * 0.6180339 + L * 0.13) % 1.0) * full
                if pa > ang:
                    continue
                pr = rr * (0.12 + 0.86 * math.sqrt((i * 0.4142136 + L * 0.29) % 1.0))
                _phone(cr, CX + pr * RX * math.sin(pa), CY - lift - pr * RY * math.cos(pa),
                       1.35 + 0.3 * ((i * 0.37) % 1.0), i * 1.3 + L)
            cr.restore()
        _sector(cr, CX, CY, RX, RY, ang, 0.98)
        edge(cr, (24, 40, 80))
    disc(cr, CX, CY, 18, P["brass"], finish="metal")
    if done:
        ma = full / 2
        text(cr, f"{int(round(share * 100))}%", CX + 0.45 * RX * math.sin(ma),
             CY - 60 - 0.45 * RY * math.cos(ma) + 26, 96, look.INK, face="display",
             anchor="center", alpha=ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.05)))

    # Data walks the rim clockwise, one throw per hour of screen time
    if u < a0:
        da = 0.0
    elif done:
        da = mid(n - 1)
    else:
        pa_ = mid(k - 1) if k > 0 else 0.0
        da = pa_ + (mid(k) - pa_) * wk
    hx = CX + 1.1 * RX * math.sin(da)
    hy = min(1500.0, CY - 1.1 * RY * math.cos(da) + 6)

    if a0 <= u < a1 and 0 < fly < 1:
        sx, sy = hx, hy - 170
        ex = CX + 0.55 * RX * math.sin(mid(k))
        ey = CY - 40 - 0.55 * RY * math.cos(mid(k))
        bx = sx + (ex - sx) * fly
        by = sy + (ey - sy) * fly - 220 * math.sin(math.pi * fly)
        glow(cr, bx, by, 70, (120, 180, 255), 0.6)
        for j in range(3):
            _phone(cr, bx + 26 * (j - 1), by + 10 * (j % 2), 2.0, fly * 7 + k + j * 1.9,
                   flat=1.0)

    # once the mound is done the world moves, not the story: phones slide off it
    if u > a1:
        for j in range(2):
            ph = ((u - a1) / 0.18 + j / 2) % 1.0
            pa = full * (0.3 + 0.4 * j)
            pr = 0.5 + 0.55 * ph
            _phone(cr, CX + pr * RX * math.sin(pa),
                   CY - 50 * (1 - ph) - pr * RY * math.cos(pa), 1.8, ph * 6 + j, flat=0.8)

    # right by the camera: people crossing the square, heads in their phones
    for i in range(3):
        wx = 1220 - ((t * 150 + i * 480) % 1440)
        _walker(cr, wx, 1720 + i * 45, 1.45 + 0.1 * i, t, i)
    foreground(cr, "town")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    if u < a0:
        host("point", hx, hy, 220)
    elif u < a1 + 0.04:
        host("toss", hx, hy, 220, beat=k)
    else:
        host("hold_up", hx, hy, 220)

    if done:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v))} hours", "of the waking day, on a phone screen",
                    80, 520, size=130, max_w=900)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Your waking day", "how much of it goes to a screen?",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130, max_w=900)

stories.title: The US Government Lost Money On Every Penny For 19 Years
stories.hook: The government keeps making pennies that lose money every single time.
stories.closing: So the penny you ignore in the couch costs more to make than it's worth.
stories.question: Do you still bother picking up pennies?
stories.caption: The US Mint has lost money on every single penny it's made since 2006. By 2024 each one cost 3.69 cents to produce. Do you still bother picking up pennies off the ground? 👇

segments.say: Making one penny now costs 3.69 cents. That's triple what it cost back in 2006.
