def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a brass balance scale weighing one penny
    SUBSTANCE: copper-zinc penny blanks
    CAUSE: Data places metal blanks on the cost pan, one per strike, and the beam tips under the cost
    Inside the Mint: one penny on the left pan, and on the right what it
    costs to make one, stacked as the zinc-and-copper blanks it is made of,
    one blank's height per cent. In 2006 the stack stood just over the
    penny's worth; blank by blank Data builds it up to 2024's cost and the
    beam tips hard against the penny. The 2006 stack stays as a ghost on the
    pan with its year on it, so the new stack reads as three of the old.
    Done by 0.56, then held while pennies keep rolling across the mint floor."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    v0 = v0 or 1.0
    ratio = v1 / v0
    n = 5
    a0, a1 = 0.10, 0.56
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    fly = seg(f, 0.0, 0.4)
    grow = ease(seg(f, 0.35, 0.7))
    step = 0.0 if u < a0 else (k + grow) / n
    val = v0 + (v1 - v0) * step

    FLOOR, PIV, ARM, CH = 1460, 900, 340, 230
    UNIT = 60.0                                   # px of blanks per cent of cost
    theta = 0.30 * clamp((val - 1.0) / max(0.01, v1 - 1.0))

    # the Mint: a tall hall, arched windows, presses running back under haze
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (52, 50, 56)), (0.55, (128, 118, 106)), (1, (176, 162, 140))], 0, FLOOR)
    for i in range(3):
        wx = 120 + i * 330
        cr.move_to(wx, 760)
        cr.line_to(wx, 300)
        cr.arc(wx + 100, 300, 100, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.line_to(wx + 200, 760)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (232, 214, 172), finish="glass", rim=False)
        glow(cr, wx + 100, 520, 260, (255, 226, 170), 0.3)
    for i in range(7):
        bx = 20 + i * 150
        contact_shadow(cr, bx + 55, 1180, 130, a=0.25)
        box(cr, bx, 1180, 110, 230 + 40 * (i % 2), (96, 104, 116), depth=28, finish="metal")
        disc(cr, bx + 55, 1060, 18, (196, 112, 62), finish="metal")
    # a belt of fresh pennies running past the presses
    cr.rectangle(0, 1180, W, 26)
    solid(cr, (60, 62, 68), finish="metal", rim=False)
    for i in range(12):
        px = (i * 110 + t * 90) % (W + 110) - 55
        disc(cr, px, 1172, 16, (204, 120, 68), finish="metal")
    haze(cr, 280, 1220, (190, 176, 152), a=0.45)
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (150, 134, 112)), (1, (98, 86, 72))], 1210, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 60, 50), 0.35))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(12):
        cr.move_to(540, 1150)
        cr.line_to(-1000 + i * 280, H)
    cr.stroke()

    # the scale: base, post, beam, chains, pans
    cast_shadow(cr, 300, 980, FLOOR, length=280, a=0.28)
    contact_shadow(cr, 540, FLOOR + 4, 260, a=0.4)
    box(cr, 440, FLOOR, 200, 50, (88, 70, 52), depth=40)
    box(cr, 518, FLOOR - 50, 44, FLOOR - 50 - PIV, P["brass"], depth=14, finish="metal")
    c, s = math.cos(theta), math.sin(theta)
    lx, ly = 540 - ARM * c, PIV - ARM * s
    rx, ry = 540 + ARM * c, PIV + ARM * s
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(540, PIV)
    cr.rotate(theta)
    cr.rectangle(-ARM - 20, -14, 2 * ARM + 40, 28)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, P["brass"], finish="metal")
    disc(cr, 540, PIV, 26, P["brass_shade"], finish="metal")
    # needle: points straight up at balance, swings with the cost
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(540, PIV)
    cr.rotate(theta)
    cr.move_to(-8, 0)
    cr.line_to(0, -150)
    cr.line_to(8, 0)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, P["redline"], finish="gloss")

    lpy, rpy = ly + CH, ry + CH
    _chains(cr, lx, ly, lx, lpy)
    _chains(cr, rx, ry, rx, rpy)
    # left pan: the penny itself, standing on its edge
    _penny(cr, lx, lpy - 108, 104, label=True)
    _pan(cr, lx, lpy)
    # right pan: what it costs to make it, stacked as blanks
    h = UNIT * val
    cylinder(cr, rx - 80, rpy, 160, h, (198, 116, 64), finish="metal")
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 62, 30), 0.55))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    yy = rpy - 14
    while yy > rpy - h + 10:
        cr.move_to(rx - 80, yy)
        cr.curve_to(rx - 40, yy + 8, rx + 40, yy + 8, rx + 80, yy)
        yy -= 14
    cr.stroke()
    _pan(cr, rx, rpy)
    # THE SCALE on the stack: 2006's cost as a ghost where it stood, its top marked
    if step > 0.02:
        h0 = UNIT * v0
        cr.rectangle(rx - 80, rpy - h0, 160, h0)
        ghost(cr, a=0.9)
        then_mark(cr, rx - 90, rx + 40, rpy - h0, l0)

    # Data walks in from the penny's side to the cost pan
    hx = 200 + 520 * ease(seg(u, 0.0, a0))
    hy = FLOOR
    if u >= a0 and 0 < fly < 1:
        sx, sy = hx + 40, hy - 220
        ex, ey = rx, rpy - h - 12
        bx = sx + (ex - sx) * fly
        by = sy + (ey - sy) * fly - 200 * math.sin(math.pi * fly)
        for j in range(2):
            cylinder(cr, bx - 70, by - j * 14, 140, 14, (210, 128, 72), finish="metal")

    # right by the camera: pennies rolling across the mint floor
    for j in range(3):
        px = -160 + ((t * 170 + j * 470) % 1400)
        r = 70 + 14 * j
        contact_shadow(cr, px, 1660 + j * 80 + r, r * 1.6, a=0.3)
        _penny(cr, px, 1660 + j * 80, r, spin=(t * 170 + j * 470) / r)
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    if u < a0:
        host("point", hx, hy, 230)
    elif u < a1 + 0.04:
        host("place", hx, hy, 230, beat=k)
    elif u < 0.9:
        host("hold_up", hx, hy, 230)
    else:
        host("shock", hx, hy, 230)

    done = u >= a0 and k == n - 1 and grow >= 0.999
    if done:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{v1:.2f}¢", f"to make one penny · {l1}", 80, 520, size=130)
        text(cr, f"{ratio:.0f}x", W - 80, 680, 90, look.INK, face="display",
             anchor="right", alpha=ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.05)))
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{v0:.2f}¢", f"to make one penny · {l0}", 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

# scene standard: 2026-10-11.2
def _pm_penny(cr, x, y, r, roll=0.0, blank=False):
    disc(cr, x, y, r, (196, 112, 62), finish="metal")
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 62, 34), 0.9))
    cr.set_line_width(max(2, r * 0.08))
    cr.arc(x, y, r * 0.82, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.stroke()
    if blank:
        return
    # the profile on the face, turning as it rolls
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.rotate(roll)
    cr.move_to(-r * 0.30, r * 0.50)
    cr.curve_to(-r * 0.42, r * 0.05, -r * 0.40, -r * 0.45, r * 0.02, -r * 0.52)
    cr.curve_to(r * 0.30, -r * 0.50, r * 0.38, -r * 0.20, r * 0.30, r * 0.02)
    cr.line_to(r * 0.40, r * 0.12)
    cr.line_to(r * 0.26, r * 0.22)
    cr.curve_to(r * 0.26, r * 0.40, r * 0.10, r * 0.50, -r * 0.30, r * 0.50)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((140, 74, 40), 0.9))
    cr.fill()
    cr.restore()


def _pm_roll(cr, x, y, s):
    # a paper-wrapped roll of pennies lying on the floor, its copper end showing
    contact_shadow(cr, x + 60 * s, y + 18 * s, 150 * s, a=0.35)
    cr.rectangle(x, y - 30 * s, 120 * s, 44 * s)
    solid(cr, (214, 196, 160))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 60, 44)))
    cr.rectangle(x + 30 * s, y - 30 * s, 14 * s, 44 * s)
    cr.fill()
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x + 120 * s, y - 8 * s)
    cr.scale(0.45, 1.0)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 22 * s, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (196, 112, 62), finish="metal")


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a coin press with a gauge
    SUBSTANCE: copper pennies
    CAUSE: Data cranks the press, every turn mints a penny and moves the cost needle up
    The Mint's press room. Data turns the crank, the ram comes down and a
    penny rolls out, and the big gauge on the press reads what the pennies
    cost, measured in what they are WORTH: the copper zone is one face
    value, with ticks at 1x, 2x and 3x around the dial. The first turn takes
    the needle to the edge of the copper, which is what the pennies are
    worth. The rest push it on to the cost, nearly four times their worth.
    Done by 0.56 and held: the needle stays put, Data keeps cranking and
    pennies keep rolling out."""
    rows = sorted([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts], key=lambda r: r[1])
    (lf, face), (lc, cost) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    face = face or 1.0
    ratio = cost / face
    top = max(1, int(math.ceil(ratio)))
    n = 4
    a0, a1 = 0.12, 0.56
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    if u < a0:
        k, f = 0, 0.0
    else:
        q = (u - a0) / span
        k, f = int(q), q % 1.0
    live = u >= a0
    # the needle: the first turn brings it to the worth, the rest on to the cost
    marks = [0.0, 1.0] + [1.0 + (ratio - 1.0) * j / (n - 1) for j in range(1, n)]
    if not live:
        mult = 0.0
    elif k >= n:
        mult = ratio
    else:
        mult = marks[k] + (marks[k + 1] - marks[k]) * ease(seg(f, 0.38, 0.8))
    done = live and (k >= n or (k == n - 1 and f >= 0.8))
    worth_in = live and (k >= 1 or f >= 0.8)

    # ---- the press room -------------------------------------------------
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (52, 60, 66)), (0.6, (92, 100, 104)), (1, (128, 132, 130))], 0, 1160)
    for i in range(4):                       # tall factory windows, low sun
        wx = 40 + i * 270
        vgrad(cr, [(0, (250, 226, 176)), (1, (214, 176, 128))], 120, 760, wx, wx + 170)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((48, 54, 60)))
        cr.set_line_width(10)
        cr.rectangle(wx, 120, 170, 640)
        cr.move_to(wx + 85, 120)
        cr.line_to(wx + 85, 760)
        for yy in (280, 440, 600):
            cr.move_to(wx, yy)
            cr.line_to(wx + 170, yy)
        cr.stroke()
        glow(cr, wx + 85, 700, 260, (255, 214, 150), 0.25)
    for i in range(5):                       # the far line of presses
        bx = 30 + i * 215
        contact_shadow(cr, bx + 70, 1150, 160, a=0.3)
        box(cr, bx, 1150, 120, 300, (86, 104, 116), depth=30, finish="metal")
        disc(cr, bx + 60, 900, 24, (210, 200, 176))
    haze(cr, 120, 1160, (150, 150, 144), a=0.5)
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (118, 116, 110)), (1, (70, 68, 66))], 1150, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 58, 56), 0.35))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(12):
        cr.move_to(540, 1000)
        cr.line_to(-1000 + i * 280, H)
    cr.stroke()
    glow(cr, 520, 1300, 520, (255, 220, 170), 0.18)

    # ---- the press ------------------------------------------------------
    X0, X1, BASE = 210, 750, 1440
    cast_shadow(cr, X0, X1 + 120, BASE, length=300, a=0.32)
    contact_shadow(cr, (X0 + X1) / 2 + 40, BASE + 6, X1 - X0 + 200, a=0.45)
    steel = (70, 96, 116)
    # the output chute, down to the bin by the camera
    cr.move_to(X0 + 10, 1190)
    cr.line_to(X0 + 10, 1230)
    cr.line_to(120, 1640)
    cr.line_to(40, 1640)
    cr.line_to(X0 - 50, 1190)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (150, 156, 164), finish="metal")
    box(cr, X0, BASE, X1 - X0, 250, steel, depth=130, finish="metal")       # bed
    cylinder(cr, 420, 1200, 120, 24, (150, 156, 164), finish="metal")      # the die
    for cx_ in (X0 + 20, X1 - 90):                                           # columns
        cylinder(cr, cx_, 1190, 70, 210, (120, 130, 140), finish="metal")
    box(cr, X0 - 10, 990, X1 - X0 + 20, 120, steel, depth=130, finish="metal")  # crown

    # the ram's stroke: held up while he winds, then it SLAMS onto the blank
    sk = k if live else -1
    sf = f
    if live:
        if sf < 0.3:
            drop = 0.0
        elif sf < 0.4:
            drop = ((sf - 0.3) / 0.1) ** 2
        else:
            drop = 1.0 - ease(seg(sf, 0.45, 0.95))
    else:
        drop = 0.0
    ry = 1000 + 150 * drop
    # the blank on the die, struck on the slam, then knocked into the chute
    if live:
        if sf < 0.3:
            slide = ease(seg(sf, 0.0, 0.25))
            _pm_penny(cr, 300 + 180 * slide, 1176, 34, blank=True)
        elif sf < 0.45:
            _pm_penny(cr, 480, 1176, 34, blank=sf < 0.4)
    cr.rectangle(445, 990, 70, ry - 990)
    solid(cr, (176, 182, 188), finish="metal")
    box(cr, 400, ry + 30, 160, 60, (92, 104, 114), depth=30, finish="metal")
    if live and sf > 0.38 and drop > 0.85:
        glow(cr, 480, 1180, 120, (255, 236, 200), 0.5 * drop)
    # pennies rolling down the chute, one per stroke, each into the bin
    for back in range(2):
        kk = sk - back
        if kk < 0:
            continue
        p = ((sf + back) - 0.45) / 1.2
        if 0 < p < 1:
            if p < 0.18:
                px, py = 480 - 230 * (p / 0.18), 1176
            else:
                q2 = (p - 0.18) / 0.82
                px, py = X0 - 20 - 120 * q2, 1180 + 420 * q2 * q2
            _pm_penny(cr, px, py - 30, 40, roll=-p * 14)

    # ---- the gauge on top: COST, measured in what the pennies are worth --
    GX, GY, GR = 520, 820, 175
    cr.rectangle(GX - 30, GY + 120, 60, 80)
    solid(cr, (120, 130, 140), finish="metal")
    disc(cr, GX, GY, GR + 22, (150, 120, 70), finish="metal")
    disc(cr, GX, GY, GR, (236, 230, 214))
    A0, SW = 0.75 * math.pi, 1.5 * math.pi

    def ang(m):
        return A0 + SW * clamp(m / top)
    cr.set_line_width(34)
    cr.arc(GX, GY, GR - 34, ang(0), ang(1.0))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((196, 112, 62)))
    cr.stroke()
    cr.arc(GX, GY, GR - 34, ang(1.0), ang(top))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 152, 158), 0.7))
    cr.stroke()
    if mult > 1.0:                                    # what it cost past its worth
        cr.arc(GX, GY, GR - 34, ang(1.0), ang(mult))
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"]))
        cr.stroke()
    for m in range(0, top + 1):
        a_ = ang(m)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 40, 44)))
        cr.set_line_width(6)
        cr.move_to(GX + (GR - 10) * math.cos(a_), GY + (GR - 10) * math.sin(a_))
        cr.line_to(GX + (GR - 58) * math.cos(a_), GY + (GR - 58) * math.sin(a_))
        cr.stroke()
        if 1 <= m <= max(1, int(ratio)):
            text(cr, f"{m}x", GX + (GR - 92) * math.cos(a_), GY + (GR - 92) * math.sin(a_) + 11,
                 30, (40, 40, 44), face="bold", anchor="center", shadow=False)
    na = ang(mult)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 30, 26)))
    cr.set_line_width(12)
    cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
    cr.move_to(GX - 30 * math.cos(na), GY - 30 * math.sin(na))
    cr.line_to(GX + (GR - 30) * math.cos(na), GY + (GR - 30) * math.sin(na))
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_BUTT)
    disc(cr, GX, GY, 22, (60, 60, 64), finish="metal")
    text(cr, "COST", GX, GY + 135, 34, (40, 40, 44), face="bold", anchor="center",
         shadow=False)

    # the crank wheel on the press's side
    CX, CY = 860, 1290
    disc(cr, CX, CY, 70, (110, 118, 126), finish="metal")
    spin = (k + ease(seg(f, 0.0, 0.4))) * 2 * math.pi if live else 0.0
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((50, 52, 56)))
    cr.set_line_width(14)
    cr.move_to(CX, CY)
    cr.line_to(CX + 62 * math.cos(spin), CY + 62 * math.sin(spin))
    cr.stroke()
    disc(cr, CX, CY, 16, (60, 62, 66), finish="metal")

    # ---- right by the camera: the bin of new pennies, rolls on the floor --
    contact_shadow(cr, 120, 1860, 300, a=0.4)
    box(cr, -20, 1860, 280, 200, (126, 92, 60), depth=60)
    for i in range(7):
        _pm_penny(cr, 10 + i * 36, 1668 + (i % 2) * 10, 30, roll=i)
    _pm_roll(cr, 560, 1790, 2.0)
    _pm_roll(cr, 760, 1860, 1.8)
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data walks up to the crank, then works it, turn after turn
    if not live:
        w = ease(seg(u, 0.0, a0 * 0.9))
        host("point", 600 + 340 * w, 1500, 220)
    else:
        host("crank", 940, 1500, 220, beat=k)

    if done:
        fit_readout(cr, f"${int(round(cost))}M", "what the Mint spent making pennies",
                    80, 520, size=130)
        text(cr, f"{ratio:.1f}x", W - 80, 640, 90, look.INK, face="display",
             anchor="right", alpha=ease(seg(u, a1 - 0.02, a1 + 0.03)))
    elif worth_in:
        fit_readout(cr, f"${int(round(face))}M", "what those pennies were worth",
                    80, 520, size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Pennies", "worth versus cost", 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

stories.title: NASA's Mars Helicopter Was Built For 5 Flights. It Flew 72.
stories.hook: A tiny helicopter wasn't supposed to last this long.
stories.closing: Five flights were the ask. Seventy-two was the answer.
stories.question: Would you have guessed seventy-two?
stories.caption: NASA's Ingenuity was built for just 5 flights on Mars. It flew 72 — and logged over 10 miles doing it. Here's how a helicopter kept flying far longer than anyone planned. Would you have bet on five or seventy-two? 👇

segments.topic: ingenuity's planned 5 flights vs its actual 72 on mars
segments.say: NASA built Ingenuity for just five test flights on Mars, but it flew seventy-two.
segments.illustrated_scene:
# scene standard: 2026-10-09
def _ig_blade(cr, x, y, s, th):
    """One rotor: a tapered, lit pair of blades, foreshortened from above."""
    R = 280 * s
    for sg in (1, -1):
        ex, ey = sg * R * math.cos(th), sg * 0.1 * R * math.sin(th)
        ln = max(1.0, math.hypot(ex, ey))
        px, py = -ey / ln, ex / ln
        pts_ = [(0.0, 7), (0.25, 13), (0.7, 11), (1.0, 4)]
        cr.new_path()
        cr.move_to(x + px * 7 * s, y + py * 7 * s)
        for fr, w in pts_:
            cr.line_to(x + ex * fr + px * w * s, y + ey * fr + py * w * s)
        for fr, w in reversed(pts_):
            cr.line_to(x + ex * fr - px * w * s, y + ey * fr - py * w * s)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (58, 58, 66), finish="metal")


def _ig_rotor(cr, x, y, s, th):
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.scale(1, 0.1)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 280 * s, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 228, 214), 0.16))
    cr.fill_preserve()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 56, 52), 0.28))
    cr.set_line_width(2)
    cr.stroke()
    _ig_blade(cr, x, y, s, th)
    disc(cr, x, y, 15 * s, (96, 96, 104), finish="metal")


def _ig_heli(cr, x, foot, s, t):
    """Ingenuity: four splayed carbon legs, a foil-wrapped body with its
    camera, a mast, two stacked counter-rotating rotors, the solar panel."""
    cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
    for (bx, fx, fy, col) in ((-30, -70, -16, (98, 96, 102)), (30, 70, -16, (98, 96, 102)),
                              (-44, -112, 0, (46, 46, 52)), (44, 112, 0, (46, 46, 52))):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((24, 22, 26)))
        cr.set_line_width(11 * s)
        cr.move_to(x + bx * s, foot - 112 * s)
        cr.line_to(x + fx * s, foot + fy * s)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(col))
        cr.set_line_width(6 * s)
        cr.move_to(x + bx * s, foot - 112 * s)
        cr.line_to(x + fx * s, foot + fy * s)
        cr.stroke()
        disc(cr, x + fx * s, foot + fy * s, 9 * s, col, finish="metal")
    box(cr, x - 54 * s, foot - 104 * s, 108 * s, 96 * s, (214, 208, 198),
        depth=34 * s, finish="metal")
    cr.rectangle(x - 48 * s, foot - 170 * s, 96 * s, 30 * s)
    solid(cr, (210, 156, 58), finish="gloss")
    cr.rectangle(x - 48 * s, foot - 130 * s, 96 * s, 14 * s)
    solid(cr, (176, 116, 44), finish="gloss", rim=False)
    disc(cr, x + 26 * s, foot - 168 * s, 11 * s, (30, 30, 36), finish="gloss")
    cylinder(cr, x - 7 * s, foot - 200 * s, 14 * s, 250 * s, (150, 150, 158), finish="metal")
    th = t * 3.5
    _ig_rotor(cr, x, foot - 262 * s, s, -th)
    _ig_rotor(cr, x, foot - 344 * s, s, th + 1.1)
    cylinder(cr, x - 5 * s, foot - 352 * s, 10 * s, 70 * s, (130, 130, 138), finish="metal")
    box(cr, x - 76 * s, foot - 430 * s, 152 * s, 14 * s, (34, 52, 108),
        depth=54 * s, finish="gloss")
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 176, 230), 0.55))
    cr.set_line_width(2)
    for q in range(1, 6):
        qx = x - 76 * s + q * 152 * s / 6
        cr.move_to(qx, foot - 430 * s)
        cr.line_to(qx, foot - 416 * s)
    cr.stroke()


def _ig_ghost(cr, x, foot, s):
    """Where it was meant to retire: its outline, dashed, parked on the sand."""
    cr.new_path()
    cr.rectangle(x - 54 * s, foot - 200 * s, 108 * s, 96 * s)
    cr.move_to(x - 44 * s, foot - 112 * s)
    cr.line_to(x - 112 * s, foot)
    cr.move_to(x + 44 * s, foot - 112 * s)
    cr.line_to(x + 112 * s, foot)
    cr.move_to(x, foot - 200 * s)
    cr.line_to(x, foot - 430 * s)
    for ry in (262, 344):
        cr.new_sub_path()
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(x, foot - ry * s)
        cr.scale(1, 0.1)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 280 * s, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
    ghost(cr, a=0.9)


# the ground route of its flights: out from the airfield by the camera, back
# across the crater floor to the far rim, round, and home toward the camera
_IG_LINE = [(320, 1490), (520, 1455), (740, 1395), (935, 1310), (965, 1240),
            (830, 1196), (570, 1180), (310, 1190), (160, 1225), (195, 1285),
            (360, 1340), (550, 1385)]


def _ig_ground(w):
    segs, tot = [], 0.0
    for a, b in zip(_IG_LINE, _IG_LINE[1:]):
        d = math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1])
        segs.append((a, b, d))
        tot += d
    goal = clamp(w) * tot
    for a, b, d in segs:
        if goal <= d or (a, b, d) == segs[-1]:
            f = clamp(goal / max(1e-6, d))
            return a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * f, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * f
        goal -= d
    return _IG_LINE[-1]


def _ig_sc(y):
    return 0.4 + (y - 1180) * 0.0036


def _ig_spots(N, P5):
    """Landing spot i (0 is the airfield), N+1 of them: flight i is i -> i+1."""
    step = 0.045
    out = []
    for i in range(N + 1):
        if i <= P5:
            w = i * step
        else:
            w = step * P5 + (i - P5) / max(1, N - P5) * (1 - step * P5)
        out.append(_ig_ground(w))
    return out


def _ig_arc_pt(A, B, hh, tau):
    cx, cy = (A[0] + B[0]) / 2, (A[1] + B[1]) / 2 - 2 * hh
    m = 1 - tau
    return (m * m * A[0] + 2 * tau * m * cx + tau * tau * B[0],
            m * m * A[1] + 2 * tau * m * cy + tau * tau * B[1])


def _ig_flight(cr, A, B, planned, upto=1.0):
    """One flight: the hop through the thin air, a dashed arc from the spot it
    took off from to the scorch where it set down."""
    sc = _ig_sc((A[1] + B[1]) / 2)
    hh = (120 if planned else 85) * sc
    n = 14
    cr.new_path()
    for q in range(n + 1):
        x, y = _ig_arc_pt(A, B, hh, upto * q / n)
        if q == 0:
            cr.move_to(x, y)
        else:
            cr.line_to(x, y)
    cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
    cr.set_dash([14 * sc, 10 * sc])
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 20, 18), 0.35))
    cr.set_line_width(max(2.0, 9 * sc))
    cr.stroke_preserve()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((246, 240, 228) if planned else P["accent2"], 0.95))
    cr.set_line_width(max(1.5, 5 * sc))
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_dash([])


def _ig_scorch(cr, x, y):
    sc = _ig_sc(y)
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.scale(1, 0.3)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 34 * sc, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((84, 38, 24), 0.6))
    cr.fill()
    for dx_, dy_ in ((-1, -0.4), (1, -0.4), (-1.3, 0.3), (1.3, 0.3)):
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(x + dx_ * 30 * sc, y + dy_ * 12 * sc)
        cr.scale(1, 0.5)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 5 * sc, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((54, 26, 18), 0.8))
        cr.fill()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a little Mars helicopter, twin rotors
    SUBSTANCE: its flight paths over Mars
    CAUSE: Data cranks a charger and each crank sends the helicopter on another hop across Mars
    Every flight Ingenuity made is one dashed hop through the air, from the
    scorch it lifted off to the scorch it set down. It starts at its airfield
    by the camera and makes the five hops it was built for, white, up to a
    red END OF MISSION sign, where its dashed ghost stays parked as the
    retirement that never came. Then it flies on: hop after hop in the accent,
    out across the crater floor, round under the far rim and back, until 72
    arcs chain across Mars and the five are a short stub at the start. It ends
    big, hovering over its last landing. Done by 0.66 and held: the rotors keep
    turning and Data keeps cranking its charger."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    (lp, planned) = min(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    (lf, flown) = max(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    N = max(2, int(round(flown)))
    P5 = min(N - 1, max(1, int(round(planned))))
    a0, p1, a1 = 0.05, 0.28, 0.66
    spots = _ig_spots(N, P5)

    if u < a0:
        c, g, beat = 0.0, 0.0, 0
    elif u < p1:
        hs = (p1 - a0) / P5
        j = int(clamp((u - a0) / hs, 0, P5 - 0.001))
        f = clamp((u - a0 - j * hs) / hs)
        c = j + ease(seg(f, 0.15, 0.85))
        g, beat = 0.0, j
    elif u < a1:
        g = seg(u, p1, a1)
        c = P5 + (N - P5) * (g * g * (3 - 2 * g))
        beat = P5 + int(g * 6)
    else:
        c, g, beat = float(N), 1.0, P5 + 6
    i = min(N - 1, int(c))
    f = c - i if c < N else 1.0

    # Mars: a red desert under a butterscotch sky, the crater rim far off
    landscape(cr, t, "desert", horizon=1160)
    cr.rectangle(0, 0, W, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((196, 92, 52), 0.32))
    cr.fill()
    ridge(cr, 1150, 90, seed=2.0, n=5)

    # every landing so far, then every hop so far
    done = int(c)

        _ig_scorch(cr, *spots[j])

    text(cr, "END OF MISSION", sx + 4 * es, ey - 112 * es, max(18, int(24 * es)),
         look.INK, face="bold", anchor="center", shadow=False)
    if c > P5 + 0.5:

    # the hero: hopping its five, then cruising on, then hovering, big
    if c >= N:
        gx, gy = spots[N]
        alt = 1.0
    elif u < p1:
        gx, gy = _ig_arc_pt(spots[i], spots[i + 1], 0.0, f)

    else:

    _ig_heli(cr, gx, gy - lift, hs_, t)

    # right by the camera: Martian rocks
    for q_, (rx, ry, rr) in enumerate(((120, 1740, 100), (900, 1700, 80), (600, 1880, 120),
                                       (1020, 1860, 70))):
        contact_shadow(cr, rx, ry + rr * 0.4, rr * 2.2, a=0.35)
        cr.new_path()
        for q in range(8):

    box(cr, dxp + 50, dyp, 76, 86, (190, 186, 176), depth=24, finish="metal")

def _rock(cr, x, y, r, seed, rgb=(156, 74, 44)):
    # an angular Martian boulder: a flat-bottomed, faceted outline, lit
    n = 9
    for i in range(n):
        ang = math.pi + i * math.pi / (n - 1)
        rr = r * (0.74 + 0.26 * ((seed * 7.31 + i * 0.6180339) % 1.0))
        px = x + 1.35 * rr * math.cos(ang)
        py = y + 0.85 * rr * math.sin(ang)
        if i == 0:
            cr.move_to(px, py)
        else:
            cr.line_to(px, py)
    cr.line_to(x + 1.2 * r, y + 0.12 * r)
    cr.line_to(x - 1.2 * r, y + 0.12 * r)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, rgb)


def _blade(cr, x0, x1, y, s, a=1.0):
    # one rotor blade seen edge-on: wide chord near the root, tapering to the tip
    d = 1.0 if x1 >= x0 else -1.0
    L = abs(x1 - x0)
    if L < 6:
        return
    cr.move_to(x0, y - 6 * s)
    cr.curve_to(x0 + d * L * 0.3, y - 13 * s, x0 + d * L * 0.7, y - 9 * s, x1, y - 3 * s)
    cr.line_to(x1, y + 3 * s)
    cr.curve_to(x0 + d * L * 0.7, y + 6 * s, x0 + d * L * 0.3, y + 8 * s, x0, y + 6 * s)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (58, 58, 66), finish="metal", a=a)


def _ingenuity(cr, cx, by, t, snap, s=1.3, a=1.0):
    # Ingenuity: four bowed carbon legs, a gold-foil fuselage with its camera,
    # a tall mast, two counter-rotating paddle rotors, the solar panel on top
    for dx in (-118, -42, 42, 118):
        fx = cx + dx * s
        cr.move_to(cx + dx * 0.38 * s, by - 66 * s)
        cr.curve_to(cx + dx * 0.75 * s, by - 52 * s, fx, by - 30 * s, fx, by - 6 * s)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((34, 34, 40), a))
        cr.set_line_width(11 * s)
        cr.stroke_preserve()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((172, 172, 180), a))
        cr.set_line_width(6 * s)
        cr.stroke()
        disc(cr, fx, by - 6 * s, 10 * s, (120, 120, 128), finish="metal", a=a)
    # the fuselage, wrapped in crinkled gold foil
    bw, bh = 150 * s, 100 * s
    box(cr, cx - bw / 2, by - 56 * s, bw, bh, (214, 170, 84), depth=40 * s,
        finish="metal", a=a)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 108, 40), 0.55 * a))
    cr.set_line_width(2.5 * s)
    for i in range(6):
        y0 = by - 56 * s - bh * (0.12 + 0.15 * i)
        cr.move_to(cx - bw / 2 + 6, y0)
        for j in range(1, 7):
            cr.line_to(cx - bw / 2 + 6 + j * (bw - 12) / 6,
                       y0 + (5 if (i + j) % 2 else -5) * s)
        cr.stroke()
    disc(cr, cx - bw * 0.22, by - 56 * s - bh * 0.38, 13 * s, (30, 34, 44), finish="glass", a=a)
    # the mast
    cylinder(cr, cx - 10 * s, by - 150 * s, 20 * s, 100 * s, (70, 70, 78), finish="metal", a=a)
    cylinder(cr, cx - 6 * s, by - 265 * s, 12 * s, 120 * s, (52, 52, 60), finish="metal", a=a)
    L = 245.0 * s
    A = t * 2 * math.pi * 0.55
    for ry, ang, upper in ((by - 195 * s, -A, False), (by - 248 * s, A, True)):
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(cx, ry)
        cr.scale(1, 0.08)
        cr.arc(0, 0, L, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 40, 46), 0.14 * a))
        cr.fill()
        for k_ in (0.0, math.pi):
            c = math.cos(ang + k_)
            reach = L * (0.45 if (snap and upper and k_ == 0.0) else 1.0)
            _blade(cr, cx, cx + reach * c, ry, s, a)
        disc(cr, cx, ry, 15 * s, (96, 96, 104), finish="metal", a=a)
    box(cr, cx - 62 * s, by - 268 * s, 124 * s, 14 * s, (40, 58, 120), depth=26 * s,
        finish="glass", a=a)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 170, 220), 0.6 * a))
    cr.set_line_width(2)
    for j in range(1, 6):
        gx = cx - 62 * s + j * 124 * s / 6
        cr.move_to(gx, by - 282 * s)
        cr.line_to(gx, by - 268 * s)
        cr.stroke()
    return by - 285 * s


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: Mars helicopter on a rock tower
    SUBSTANCE: stacked red rock slabs
    CAUSE: Data places slab after slab under the helicopter and it climbs with every block
    Ingenuity's flight count is the height of the tower of red Martian rock
    slabs it stands on: Data stacks the slabs and the little helicopter rides
    the tower up, first flight to the 50th to the final one, where a rotor
    blade snaps and falls to the sand. The labels carry no year, so the rows
    are ordered by the count itself (a running flight tally only ever climbs)
    — never by list order. The flight before the last stays on the tower as
    a ghost of its top, so the last climb reads against it at a glance."""
    rows = sorted([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts], key=lambda r: (r[1], r[0]))
    n = len(rows)
    top = max(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.54
    span = (a1 - a0) / max(1, n)
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    slide = ease(seg(f, 0.15, 0.8))
    prev = rows[k - 1][1] if k > 0 else 0.0
    val = 0.0 if u < a0 else prev + (rows[k][1] - prev) * slide
    landed_to = k if slide >= 0.999 else k - 1
    shown = rows[landed_to] if (u >= a0 and landed_to >= 0) else None
    done = u >= a0 and k == n - 1 and slide >= 0.999

    BASE, PAD, SH = 1440, 60, 46
    PX = 340.0 / top
    X0, X1 = 200, 840
    top_y = lambda v: BASE - PAD - PX * v
    ty = top_y(val)

    # Mars: a rust sky, a small pale sun, crater rims fading into the dust
    landscape(cr, t, "desert")
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((196, 92, 50), 0.38))
    cr.paint()
    glow(cr, 250, 760, 160, (250, 222, 190), 0.5)
    disc(cr, 250, 760, 34, (252, 236, 214), finish="gloss")
    ridge(cr, 1150, 120, seed=4.1, n=4)
    solid(cr, (186, 104, 70), edge=False)
    haze(cr, 880, 1220, (230, 168, 128), a=0.55)
    ridge(cr, 1230, 80, seed=1.3)
    solid(cr, (166, 82, 50), edge=False)
    haze(cr, 1080, 1300, (226, 156, 116), a=0.3)
    for i, (rx, ry, rr) in enumerate(((60, 1300, 26), (960, 1290, 22), (1030, 1330, 30))):
        contact_shadow(cr, rx, ry + 4, rr * 2.6, a=0.3)
        _rock(cr, rx, ry, rr, i + 3, (150, 72, 44))

    # spare slabs waiting on the sand behind Data
    for j in range(3):
        contact_shadow(cr, 960, 1462 - j * 30, 190, a=0.3)
        box(cr, 868 + 8 * (j % 2), 1462 - j * 30, 170, 30, (170, 78, 46), depth=30)

    # the tower: red rock slabs stacked one on another
    h_tot = BASE - ty
    full = int(h_tot // SH)
    rem = h_tot - full * SH
    cast_shadow(cr, X0, X1, BASE, length=320, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, (X0 + X1) / 2, BASE + 4, X1 - X0 + 60, a=0.45)
    for i in range(full + 1):
        hh = SH if i < full else rem
        if hh < 1:
            continue
        jx = (((i * 0.6180339) % 1.0) - 0.5) * 36
        wv = ((i * 0.4142136) % 1.0) * 36
        sh_ = int(((i * 37) % 23) - 11)
        col = (178 + sh_, 82 + sh_ // 2, 48 + sh_ // 3)
        box(cr, X0 + jx + wv / 2, BASE - i * SH, (X1 - X0) - wv, hh, col, depth=40)
        if hh > 20:                               # a chip in the slab's face
            cx_ = X0 + 80 + ((i * 211) % 440)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((112, 46, 26), 0.55))
            cr.set_line_width(3)
            cr.move_to(cx_, BASE - i * SH - hh * 0.25)
            cr.line_to(cx_ + 18, BASE - i * SH - hh * 0.55)
            cr.line_to(cx_ + 8, BASE - i * SH - hh * 0.8)
            cr.stroke()

    # THE SCALE on the tower: where the flight before the last left it
    if n >= 2 and landed_to >= n - 2 and u >= a0:
        pl, pv = rows[n - 2]
        y_prev = top_y(pv)
        cr.rectangle(X0, y_prev, X1 - X0, BASE - y_prev)
        ghost(cr, a=0.85)
        then_mark(cr, X0 - 30, X1 - 30, y_prev, pl)

    S = 1.3
    hx = 470
    _ingenuity(cr, hx, ty - 14, t, done, s=S)

    # the snapped blade tip whirls down and lands on the sand by the tower
    if done:
        fl = ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.06))
        sx, sy = hx + 0.72 * 245 * S, ty - 14 - 248 * S
        ex, ey = 120, 1500
        bx = sx + (ex - sx) * fl
        bly = sy + (ey - sy) * fl * fl - 120 * math.sin(math.pi * fl)
        if fl >= 1:
            contact_shadow(cr, ex, ey + 10, 170, a=0.4)
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(bx, bly)
        cr.rotate(5.0 * fl + 0.15)
        _blade(cr, -75, 75, 0, 1.5)
        cr.restore()

    # right by the camera: Martian boulders in the sand
    for i, (rx, ry, rr) in enumerate(((120, 1720, 70), (930, 1790, 90), (560, 1870, 46))):
        contact_shadow(cr, rx, ry + 10, rr * 3.0, a=0.4)
        _rock(cr, rx, ry, rr, i + 1)
    foreground(cr, "desert")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data: points from the ground, steps onto the tower, stacks it as it rises
    if u < a0:
        m = ease(seg(u, 0.0, a0))
        host("point", 960 - 190 * m, BASE, 220)
    elif u < a1 + 0.04:
        host("place", 770, ty - 14, 220, beat=k * 4 + int(clamp(f, 0, 0.999) * 4))
    elif u < 0.9:
        host("hold_up", 770, ty - 14, 220)
    else:
        host("shock", 770, ty - 14, 220)

    if shown is not None:
        lab, v = shown
        unit = "flight" if int(round(v)) == 1 else "flights"
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v))} {unit}", f"Ingenuity on Mars · {lab.lower()}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, a0, a0 + 0.05)), size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Ingenuity", "NASA's Mars helicopter", 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

def _flask_outline(cr, cx, base, wb, wn, hb, hn):

    cr.line_to(cx - wn, base - hb)

    cr.line_to(cx + wb - 24, base)
    cr.curve_to(cx + wb - 8, base, cx + wb + 4, base - 6, cx + wb, base - 22)
    cr.line_to(cx + wn, base - hb)
    cr.line_to(cx + wn, top)
    cr.close_path()

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a giant glass lab flask
    SUBSTANCE: red spiked virus particles
    CAUSE: Data pours virus particles from a bucket into the flask until they fill it
    One Erlenmeyer flask is every case of cervical cancer. A grey sediment
    of the other causes lies in its foot from the start, its top dashed;
    Data climbs a ladder leaned against the flask's shoulder and pours
    bucket after bucket of spiked red HPV particles into its neck, one pour
    per beat, until the virus fills its true share of the flask — the whole
    is the flask, the virus is the share, the grey sliver is everything
    else. Done by 0.58, then held: Data keeps pouring and the full flask
    overflows, particles tumbling down its side and off across the floor."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    total = sum(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    lh, vh = max(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    hp = vh / total
    op = 1.0 - hp

    c0, c1 = 0.03, 0.13
    a0, a1 = 0.13, 0.58
    n = 4
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    grow = ease(seg(f, 0.15, 0.85))
    if u < a0:
        fill = 0.0
    elif u >= a1:
        fill = 1.0
    else:
        fill = (k + grow) / n
    pouring = (a0 <= u < a1 and 0.08 < f < 0.9) or u >= a1

    # the lab: a pale wall, a high window of morning light, shelves of glassware
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (112, 126, 140)), (0.6, (192, 204, 212)), (1, (176, 188, 194))], 0, 1160)
    cr.rectangle(660, 90, 320, 270)
    solid(cr, (226, 236, 240), finish="glass", rim=False)
    glow(cr, 820, 225, 340, (255, 244, 214), 0.55)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((90, 98, 108)))
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    cr.rectangle(660, 90, 320, 270)
    cr.move_to(820, 90)
    cr.line_to(820, 360)
    cr.stroke()
    for sy in (800, 1030):
        box(cr, 640, sy, 420, 18, (150, 132, 108), depth=30)
        for i in range(6):
            fx = 680 + i * 66
            col = [(120, 170, 200), (200, 120, 110), (150, 190, 130), (220, 200, 120)][(i + sy // 10) % 4]
            _small_flask(cr, fx, sy - 18, 0.9 + 0.2 * (i % 2), col)
    haze(cr, 80, 1160, (206, 216, 222), a=0.5)
    # the floor, tiles running to the camera
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (150, 156, 160)), (1, (96, 100, 106))], 1150, H)
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(0, 1150, W, H - 1150)
    cr.clip()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 74, 80), 0.35))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(12):
        cr.move_to(540, 900)
        cr.line_to(-1200 + i * 300, H)
    for j in range(7):
        yy = 1150 + (j * j) * 18
        cr.move_to(0, yy)
        cr.line_to(W, yy)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()

    # the flask
    CX, BASE = 460, 1440
    WB, WN, HB, HN = 310, 70, 560, 140
    TOP = BASE - HB - HN
    iwb, iwn, ihb = WB - 16, WN - 14, HB - 16
    ibase = BASE - 14
    kk_ = (iwb - iwn) / ihb
    area_all = ihb * (iwb + iwn)

    def h_of(frac):
        a = clamp(frac) * area_all
        return (iwb - math.sqrt(max(0.0, iwb * iwb - kk_ * a))) / kk_

    hg = h_of(op)
    hl = h_of(op + hp * fill)
    yg = ibase - hg
    yl = ibase - hl

    cast_shadow(cr, CX - WB, CX + WB, BASE, length=340, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, CX, BASE + 4, 2 * WB + 60, a=0.45)
    _flask_outline(cr, CX, BASE, WB, WN, HB, HN)
    solid(cr, (214, 228, 234), finish="glass", rim=False, edge=False)

    churn = 1.0 + 0.8 * ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.06))

def _yrs(label):
    if "(" in label and ")" in label:
        return label[label.index("(") + 1:label.index(")")]
    return label


def _hall_q(x):
    # depth fraction along the LEFT wall: 0 at the camera, 1 at the far end
    q = clamp(x / 400.0)
    return q, 1380 - 300 * q, 380 + 440 * q


def _lockers(cr, mirror):
    # a row of lockers running down one wall into the distance
    N = 12
    r = 0.8
    tot = (1 - r ** N) / (1 - r)
    xs = [0.0]
    acc = 0.0
    for j in range(N):
        acc += r ** j
        xs.append(400.0 * acc / tot)
    for j in reversed(range(N)):
        xa, xb = xs[j], xs[j + 1]
        qa, fa, ca = _hall_q(xa)
        qb, fb, cb = _hall_q(xb)
        ta = fa - (fa - ca) * 0.6
        tb = fb - (fb - cb) * 0.6
        X = (lambda v: W - v) if mirror else (lambda v: v)
        cr.move_to(X(xa), ta)
        cr.line_to(X(xb), tb)
        cr.line_to(X(xb), fb - 8 * (1 - qb))
        cr.line_to(X(xa), fa - 8 * (1 - qa))
        cr.close_path()
        col = (62, 104, 162) if j % 2 == 0 else (54, 94, 148)
        if mirror:
            col = tuple(int(c * 0.82) for c in col)
        solid(cr, col, finish="metal")
        # vents near the top, a handle at waist height
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((28, 46, 80)))
        cr.set_line_width(max(1.5, 4 * (1 - 0.8 * qa)))
        for s_ in range(3):
            fy0 = 0.12 + s_ * 0.05
            y0 = ta + (fa - ta) * fy0
            y1 = tb + (fb - tb) * fy0
            cr.move_to(X(xa + (xb - xa) * 0.25), y0 + (y1 - y0) * 0.25)
            cr.line_to(X(xa + (xb - xa) * 0.75), y0 + (y1 - y0) * 0.75)
        cr.stroke()
        hx = xa + (xb - xa) * 0.8
        hy = ta + (fa - ta) * 0.5
        cr.rectangle(X(hx) - 3, hy, 6 * (1 - 0.6 * qa) + 2, 40 * (1 - 0.6 * qa))
        solid(cr, (190, 196, 206), finish="metal", rim=False, edge=False)


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a heap of spiky virus germs
    SUBSTANCE: red virus germs
    CAUSE: Data sweeps the heap of germs out of the school hallway with a broom, one sweep at a time
    A school hallway running back between two rows of lockers, clogged
    wall to wall by a heap of red, spiked virus particles: its height is the
    share of teen girls who carried HPV before the vaccine. Each stroke of
    Data's broom sends a clump of germs rolling away toward the camera, and
    the heap shrinks until it stands at today's share while Data works his
    way in after it. The old heap stays as a dashed ghost with its years on
    it, and ticks up the side measure it in today's heap, so the old one
    reads as about six times as big. Done by 0.56 and held: Data keeps
    sweeping and the odd stray germ rolls off."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])

    shrink = ease(seg(f, 0.25, 0.7))
    step = 0.0 if u < a0 else (k + shrink) / n

    val = v0 + (v1 - v0) * step

    CX, BASE = 560, 1440

    hw0 = 120 + 0.57 * h0

    vgrad(cr, [(0, (176, 172, 160)), (1, (226, 222, 206))], 0, 840)
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (214, 208, 190)), (1, (196, 188, 170))], 820, 1090)
    # the far end: double doors with lit windows and an exit sign
    for dx0 in (430, 545):
        cr.rectangle(dx0, 900, 105, 180)
        solid(cr, (150, 112, 74))
        cr.rectangle(dx0 + 25, 920, 55, 70)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((250, 240, 210)))
        cr.fill()
    glow(cr, 540, 960, 200, (255, 240, 200), 0.5)
    cr.rectangle(505, 860, 70, 28)
    solid(cr, (40, 150, 80), rim=False)
    text(cr, "EXIT", 540, 882, 20, (240, 255, 240), anchor="center", shadow=False)
    # side walls above the lockers
    for mirror in (False, True):
        X = (lambda v: W - v) if mirror else (lambda v: v)
        cr.move_to(X(0), 0)

        cr.line_to(X(400), 1080)

        cr.close_path()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((222, 214, 194) if not mirror else (196, 188, 170)))
        cr.fill()
    # the floor
    cr.move_to(0, 1380)
    cr.line_to(400, 1080)
    cr.line_to(680, 1080)
    cr.line_to(W, 1380)
    cr.line_to(W, H)
    cr.line_to(0, H)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.save()
    cr.clip()
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (170, 160, 140)), (1, (112, 104, 92))], 1080, H)
    glow(cr, 540, 1500, 560, (255, 244, 220), 0.22)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((86, 80, 70), 0.35))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(15):
        cr.move_to(540, 1000)
        cr.line_to(-1200 + i * 250, H)
    for y_ in (1110, 1150, 1210, 1300, 1430, 1620, 1880):
        cr.move_to(0, y_)
        cr.line_to(W, y_)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()
    _lockers(cr, False)
    _lockers(cr, True)
    # ceiling lights running back to the doors
    for i in range(6):
        z = i / 5.0
        sc = 1.0 - 0.8 * z
        ly = 150 + 640 * z ** 0.8
        glow(cr, 540, ly + 20 * sc, 260 * sc, (255, 244, 214), 0.4)
        box(cr, 540 - 130 * sc, ly, 260 * sc, 22 * sc, (248, 246, 236), depth=30 * sc)
    haze(cr, 760, 1100, (226, 220, 204), a=0.4)

    # the heap of germs, wall to wall
    cast_shadow(cr, CX - hw, CX + hw, BASE, length=300, a=0.3)

    heap_path(cr, CX, BASE, h, hw)
    solid(cr, (150, 38, 58))
    cr.save()
    heap_path(cr, CX, BASE, h, hw)
    cr.clip()
    for r_ in range(14):
        gy = BASE - 26 - r_ * 50
        off = 31 if r_ % 2 else 0
        for c_ in range(16):
            gx = CX - hw0 + off + c_ * 62
            if gy < heap_top(CX, BASE, h, hw, gx) + 24:
                continue
            _germ(cr, gx, gy, 26)
    cr.restore()
    heap_path(cr, CX, BASE, h, hw)
    edge(cr, (70, 18, 30))
    nx_ = max(2, int((2 * hw - 60) / 64))
    for i in range(nx_ + 1):
        gx = CX - hw + 30 + (2 * hw - 60) * i / nx_
        gy = heap_top(CX, BASE, h, hw, gx) + 10
        _germ(cr, gx, gy, 30)

    # each stroke sends a clump of germs rolling down the hall to the camera
    def _roll(x0, ph, j):
        x = x0 + (1180 - x0) * ph
        y = BASE - 22 + 380 * ph * ph - 30 * abs(math.sin(ph * math.pi * 3 + j))
        _germ(cr, x, y, 26 + 34 * ph)
    if a0 <= u < a1 + 0.01:
        ph = seg(f, 0.25, 1.0)
        if 0 < ph < 1:
            for j in range(3):
                _roll(CX + hw * 0.6 - j * 50, clamp(ph * 1.1 - j * 0.06), j)
    elif u >= a1 + 0.01:
        g = (u - a1 - 0.01) / 0.12
        ph = seg(g % 1.0, 0.25, 1.0)
        if 0 < ph < 1:
            _roll(CX + hw * 0.6, ph, int(g))

    # right by the camera: a dropped backpack, germs that already rolled off

    cr.move_to(70, 1890)
    cr.curve_to(50, 1750, 80, 1630, 190, 1620)
    cr.curve_to(300, 1630, 330, 1750, 310, 1890)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (46, 132, 128))
    cr.move_to(105, 1880)
    cr.curve_to(95, 1800, 120, 1765, 190, 1765)
    cr.curve_to(260, 1765, 285, 1800, 275, 1880)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (36, 110, 108))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((230, 200, 90)))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    cr.move_to(110, 1790)
    cr.curve_to(150, 1770, 230, 1770, 270, 1790)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((28, 70, 70)))
    cr.set_line_width(12)
    cr.move_to(145, 1632)
    cr.curve_to(145, 1570, 235, 1570, 235, 1632)
    cr.stroke()
    contact_shadow(cr, 880, 1860, 150, a=0.4)
    _germ(cr, 880, 1800, 58)
    contact_shadow(cr, 700, 1900, 100, a=0.4)
    _germ(cr, 700, 1862, 38)
    foreground(cr, "town")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data sweeps from the heap's left flank, working in as it shrinks

    # THE SCALE on the heap, drawn after Data and clear of him
    if step > 0.02:

        then_mark(cr, CX - 110, CX + 150, BASE - h0, _yrs(l0))

    for wx in (x + 20 * s, x + 230 * s):
        disc(cr, wx, y - 10 * s, 14 * s, (40, 42, 48))
    box(cr, x, y - 22 * s, 250 * s, 26 * s, (170, 176, 186), depth=60 * s, finish="metal")
    # the push handle
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((90, 96, 106)))
    cr.set_line_width(6 * s)
    cr.move_to(x + 4 * s, y - 30 * s)
    cr.line_to(x - 20 * s, y - 120 * s)
    cr.line_to(x + 10 * s, y - 120 * s)
    cr.stroke()
    for i in range(3):
        box(cr, x + 10 * s + i * 78 * s, y - 48 * s, 70 * s, 26 * s,
            (246, 246, 248), depth=50 * s)
        box(cr, x + 14 * s + i * 78 * s, y - 74 * s, 62 * s, 24 * s,
            (214, 226, 236), depth=46 * s)
        cr.rectangle(x + 10 * s + i * 78 * s, y - 38 * s, 70 * s, 6 * s)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((86, 132, 170)))
        cr.fill()


def _ward_slot(i, side):
    s = 1.9 * 0.74 ** i
    return 540 + side * 80 * s, 900 + 560 * s / 1.9, s


def _wall_pt(x, f, side):
    """A point on a side wall at screen-x `x` (left-wall coords), f 0 top .. 1 floor."""
    top = x * 640 / 380
    bot = 1500 - x * 540 / 380
    return (x if side < 0 else W - x), top + (bot - top) * f


def _wall_quad(cr, xa, xb, f0, f1, side):
    p = [_wall_pt(xa, f0, side), _wall_pt(xb, f0, side),
         _wall_pt(xb, f1, side), _wall_pt(xa, f1, side)]
    cr.move_to(*p[0])
    for q in p[1:]:
        cr.line_to(*q)
    cr.close_path()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a cancer ward's hospital beds
    SUBSTANCE: occupied hospital beds
    CAUSE: Data shoves the patients' beds out of the ward one after another until 88% are gone
    One cancer ward, ten occupied beds down both walls, big by the camera
    and running back to the swinging doors: the WHOLE is the ward. Bed by
    bed, far end first, Data puts both hands on the foot rail and shoves it
    up the aisle and out through the doors, leaving its dashed ghost on
    the floor where it stood, until the vaccinated share of the ward is
    empty. The share is the ward itself — the empty floor against the one
    bed still filled — never a bar laid over it. Done by 0.56 and held:
    one patient's bed is left by the camera, Data at its rail, linen
    trolleys keep rolling."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    lab, val = max(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    share = clamp(val / 100.0)
    N = 10
    nroll = max(1, min(N, int(round(share * N))))
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.56
    dur = 0.14
    gap = (a1 - a0 - dur) / max(1, nroll - 1)

    slots = []
    for i in range(4, -1, -1):
        for side in (-1, 1):
            slots.append((i, side))
    starts = [a0 + b * gap for b in range(nroll)]
    rolls = []
    for b in range(N):
        if b < nroll:
            rolls.append(ease(seg(u, starts[b] + 0.03, starts[b] + dur)))
        else:
            rolls.append(0.0)

    # the ward: ceiling, walls running back to the doors, a polished floor
    VX, VY = 540, 880
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (150, 160, 162)), (0.45, (206, 214, 212)), (1, (178, 186, 186))], 0, H)
    cr.move_to(0, 0)
    cr.line_to(380, 640)
    cr.line_to(380, 960)
    cr.line_to(0, 1500)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (196, 212, 206), edge=False)
    cr.move_to(W, 0)
    cr.line_to(700, 640)
    cr.line_to(700, 960)
    cr.line_to(W, 1500)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (184, 200, 196), edge=False)
    cr.move_to(0, 0)
    cr.line_to(W, 0)
    cr.line_to(700, 640)
    cr.line_to(380, 640)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (226, 228, 222), edge=False, rim=False)
    # windows of daylight down both walls, a privacy curtain gathered by each
    for xa, xb in ((30, 150), (190, 262), (285, 328), (342, 366)):
        for side in (-1, 1):
            _wall_quad(cr, xa, xb, 0.2, 0.5, side)
            solid(cr, (176, 212, 232), finish="glass")
            _wall_quad(cr, xa, xb, 0.2, 0.5, side)
            edge(cr, (236, 240, 240), width=max(2.0, (xb - xa) * 0.05))
            cw = (xb - xa) * 0.35
            _wall_quad(cr, xb + 4, xb + 4 + cw, 0.14, 0.78, side)
            solid(cr, (118, 172, 166))
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((80, 128, 124), 0.6))
            cr.set_line_width(max(1.5, cw * 0.06))
            for k in range(1, 4):
                xx = xb + 4 + cw * k / 4
                cr.move_to(*_wall_pt(xx, 0.16, side))
                cr.line_to(*_wall_pt(xx, 0.76, side))
            cr.stroke()
    cr.save()
    cr.move_to(380, 960)
    cr.line_to(700, 960)
    cr.line_to(W, 1500)
    cr.line_to(W, H)
    cr.line_to(0, H)
    cr.line_to(0, 1500)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.clip()
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (176, 182, 176)), (1, (120, 128, 126))], 960, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((90, 96, 94), 0.35))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(15):
        cr.move_to(VX, VY)
        cr.line_to(-1400 + i * 280, H)
    for i in range(9):
        yy = 960 + (H - 960) * (i / 8.0) ** 1.8
        cr.move_to(0, yy)
        cr.line_to(W, yy)
    cr.stroke()
    glow(cr, VX, 1250, 520, (255, 246, 222), 0.18)
    cr.restore()
    # ceiling lights running back
    for i in range(6):
        z = i / 5.0
        sc = 1.0 - 0.75 * z
        ly = 80 + 520 * z ** 0.8
        glow(cr, VX, ly + 30 * sc, 220 * sc, (255, 248, 226), 0.45)
        box(cr, VX - 110 * sc, ly, 220 * sc, 16 * sc, (248, 246, 236), depth=30 * sc)
    # the back wall and its swinging doors
    cr.rectangle(380, 640, 320, 320)
    solid(cr, (210, 220, 216), edge=False)
    text(cr, "ONCOLOGY", 540, 770, 30, look.INK, face="bold", anchor="center", shadow=False)
    cr.rectangle(462, 800, 156, 160)
    solid(cr, (40, 46, 50), rim=False)
    swing = 0.0
    for b in range(nroll):
        swing = max(swing, math.sin(math.pi * seg(rolls[b], 0.7, 1.0)) if 0.7 < rolls[b] < 1 else 0.0)
        if rolls[b] >= 1.0:
            swing = max(swing, 0.5 * math.exp(-max(0.0, u - starts[b] - dur) * 18))
    dw = 78 * (1 - 0.75 * swing)
    for dx0 in (462, 618 - dw):
        cr.rectangle(dx0, 800, dw, 160)
        solid(cr, (130, 170, 186))
        cr.rectangle(dx0 + dw * 0.25, 830, dw * 0.5, 40)
        solid(cr, (200, 226, 236), finish="glass", rim=False)
    haze(cr, 600, 1000, (222, 228, 226), a=0.3)

    # the beds, the rolled ones on their way out through the doors; each
    # leaves its outline on the floor where a patient used to lie
    items = []
    for b, (i, side) in enumerate(slots):
        fx, yb, s = _ward_slot(i, side)
        r = rolls[b]
        if r > 0.3:
            cr.move_to(fx, yb)
            cr.line_to(fx - side * 300 * s, yb)
            cr.line_to(fx - side * 300 * s, yb - 70 * s)
            cr.line_to(fx, yb - 70 * s)
            cr.close_path()
            ghost(cr, a=0.85 * seg(r, 0.3, 0.6))
        cx = fx + (VX + side * 30 - fx) * r
        cy = yb + (958 - yb) * r
        cs = s + (0.3 - s) * r
        al = 1.0 - seg(r, 0.85, 1.0)
        items.append((cy, cx, cs, side, al))
    for cy, cx, cs, side, al in sorted(items):
        _ward_bed(cr, cx, cy, cs, side, True, a=al)

    # right by the camera: linen trolleys rolling through
    for j in range(2):
        tx = -340 + ((t * 210 + j * 860) % 1720)
        _ward_trolley(cr, tx, 1740 + j * 120, 1.25 + 0.2 * j)
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data pushes each bed by its foot rail, walking it up the aisle, then
    # crosses to the next; when the ward is done he stands at the last bed
    cur = max([b for b in range(nroll) if u >= starts[b]], default=0)
    ci, cside = slots[cur]
    fx, yb, s = _ward_slot(ci, cside)
    rf = min(rolls[cur], 0.45)
    bx = fx + (VX + cside * 30 - fx) * rf
    by = yb + (958 - yb) * rf
    cs = s + (0.3 - s) * rf
    hx = bx - cside * 30 * cs
    hy = min(1500.0, by + 40 * cs)
    hh = clamp(150 * cs, 180, 240)
    if u < a0:
        host("point", hx, hy, hh)
    elif u < a1 + 0.04:
        host("shove", hx, hy, hh, beat=cur)
    else:
        li, lside = slots[N - 1]
        lx, ly, ls = _ward_slot(li, lside)
        go = ease(seg(u, a1 + 0.04, a1 + 0.16))
        ex, ey = lx - lside * 60, min(1500.0, ly + 36)
        host("hold_up", hx + (ex - hx) * go, hy + (ey - hy) * go, 240)

    if u >= a1:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(val))}%", f"less cervical cancer · {lab.lower()}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.05)), size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Cervical cancer", "one ward, before the vaccine",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

stories.title: Africa Sends The Amazon 27 Million Tons Of Dust A Year
stories.hook: The world's biggest rainforest lives off another continent's dust.
stories.closing: A desert's dust feeds a rainforest, so protecting one far-off place quietly protects another.
stories.question: Guessed dust could feed a rainforest?
stories.caption: Africa sends 182 million tons of dust into the sky every year. Most sinks into the ocean — but 27 million tons survives the 5,000-mile trip to the Amazon, carrying the exact nutrient the rainforest is starving for. Would you have guessed dust feeds a rainforest? 👇

segments.say: Winds lift 182 million tons of dust off the Sahara every year. That is a mountain of sand riding the sky.
segments.illustrated_scene:
# scene standard: 2026-10-11.2
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a sandstorm wall rolling over the desert
    SUBSTANCE: tan Sahara sand and dust
    CAUSE: Data shovels sand off the dune into the wind, and each shovelful blows up into the storm wall
    A haboob over the Sahara. It is one wall of dust that runs from edge to
    edge of the horizon. Its top boils in cauliflower billows, its foot is a
    dark curtain, and tongues of sand sweep along the ground in front of it.
    The wall swallows the sun, which shows through the dust only as a pale
    disc. The Great Pyramid stands at the wall's foot, half lost in the
    blowing sand, and it gives the wall a scale. At the start the wall is
    lower than the pyramid. Each shovelful Data throws into the wind rides
    the plume into the wall, and the wall rears up until it towers four
    times over the pyramid. The readout gives the year's tonnage and how
    many Great Pyramids of mass that is (a ratio of the two sourced masses).
    Done by 0.56 and held. Afterwards the billows keep rolling and the sand
    keeps streaming, and Data keeps digging."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    (ld, vd) = max(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    (lp, vp) = min(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    ratio = vd / (vp or 1.0)
    pname = lp.split(" (")[0]

    n = 5
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.56
    per = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / per, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * per) / per)
    grow = ease(seg(f, 0.45, 0.85))          # the wall rears up as the shovelful lands
    frac = 0.0 if u < a0 else (k + grow) / n
    if u >= a1:
        frac = 1.0
    done = u >= a0 and frac >= 0.999
    if u >= a1:                               # after it lands he keeps shovelling
        j = int((u - a1) / per)
        fq = ((u - a1) / per) % 1.0
        beat_i = n + j
    else:
        fq = f
        beat_i = k
    fly = seg(fq, 0.12, 0.55) if u >= a0 else 0.0

    g = landscape(cr, t, "desert")
    # the sky goes brown-orange as the dust rises
    pat = cairo.LinearGradient(0, 0, 0, g)
    pat.add_color_stop_rgba(0, 0.70, 0.44, 0.24, 0.10 + 0.30 * frac)
    pat.add_color_stop_rgba(1, 0.92, 0.62, 0.34, 0.35 + 0.25 * frac)
    cr.rectangle(0, 0, W, g)
    cr.set_source(pat)
    cr.fill()
    SX, SY = 800, 600
    glow(cr, SX, SY, 260, (255, 214, 150), 0.6)
    disc(cr, SX, SY, 70, (255, 226, 170), finish="gloss")
    haze(cr, 600, g + 40, (236, 182, 122), a=0.3)

    # THE STORM: one wall of dust, horizon to horizon, rearing up
    BASE = g + 50
    Hc = 180 + 640 * frac
    m = 9
    sp = 1240.0 / (m - 1)

    def top(x):
        return BASE - Hc * (0.80 + 0.20 * math.sin(math.pi * clamp((x + 80) / 1240.0)))

    def storm_path():
        cr.move_to(-80, BASE + 20)
        cr.line_to(-80, top(-80))
        for i in range(m):
            cx = -80 + i * sp
            r = 0.56 * sp * (1 + 0.07 * math.sin(t * 1.2 + i * 1.9))
            cr.arc(cx, top(cx) + 0.45 * r, r, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.line_to(1160, top(1160))
        cr.line_to(1160, BASE + 20)
        cr.close_path()

    contact_shadow(cr, 540, BASE + 10, 1300, a=0.35)
    storm_path()
    solid(cr, (208, 160, 102))
    cr.save()
    storm_path()
    cr.clip()
    sh = cairo.LinearGradient(0, BASE - Hc - 80, 0, BASE + 20)
    sh.add_color_stop_rgba(0, 0.97, 0.86, 0.64, 0.55)
    sh.add_color_stop_rgba(0.45, 0.82, 0.62, 0.40, 0.0)
    sh.add_color_stop_rgba(1, 0.36, 0.22, 0.12, 0.8)
    cr.rectangle(0, 0, W, BASE + 30)
    cr.set_source(sh)
    cr.fill()
    # the boiling billows inside the wall: lit crowns, shadowed undersides
    for ring, off in ((0.72, 0.0), (0.48, 0.5), (0.26, 0.0)):
        for i in range(m + 1):
            cx = -80 + (i + off) * sp + 30 * math.sin(t * 0.6 + i)
            cy = BASE - Hc * ring + 10 * math.sin(t * 1.1 + i * 2.3)
            r = 0.5 * sp * (1 + 0.1 * math.sin(t * 1.3 + i * 1.7 + ring * 4))
            cr.new_sub_path()
            cr.arc(cx, cy, r, math.pi * 1.1, math.pi * 1.9)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((248, 220, 170), 0.55))
            cr.set_line_width(7)
            cr.stroke()
            cr.new_sub_path()
            cr.arc(cx, cy, r, math.pi * 0.15, math.pi * 0.85)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((132, 88, 50), 0.5))
            cr.set_line_width(9)
            cr.stroke()
    # the dark curtain at the foot, torn sideways by the wind
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((96, 62, 34), 0.5))
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    for i in range(7):
        yy = BASE - 20 - i * 26
        xx = 1200 - ((t * 160 + i * 230) % 1500)
        cr.move_to(xx, yy)
        cr.curve_to(xx - 80, yy - 14, xx - 180, yy + 10, xx - 300, yy - 6)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()
    storm_path()
    edge(cr, (112, 76, 44))

    # the sun drowning behind the dust: a pale disc through the wall
    cov = clamp((SY + 70 - top(SX)) / 140.0)
    if cov > 0:
        glow(cr, SX, SY, 140, (255, 236, 200), 0.3 * cov)
        disc(cr, SX, SY, 62, (246, 222, 178), a=0.4 * cov)

    # the Great Pyramid at the wall's foot, for scale
    PX, PB, ph = 840, BASE + 80, 200.0
    phw = 0.79 * ph
    cast_shadow(cr, PX - phw, PX + phw, PB, length=240, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, PX, PB + 4, 2 * phw + 40, a=0.35)
    fx_ = PX + 0.25 * phw
    cr.move_to(PX, PB - ph)
    cr.line_to(PX - phw, PB - 4)
    cr.line_to(fx_, PB + 14)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (230, 192, 134))
    cr.move_to(PX, PB - ph)
    cr.line_to(fx_, PB + 14)
    cr.line_to(PX + phw, PB - 8)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (160, 118, 76), rim=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((118, 86, 54), 0.5))
    cr.set_line_width(2)
    for i in range(1, 9):
        q = i / 9.0
        cr.move_to(PX - phw * q, PB - ph + (ph - 4) * q)
        cr.line_to(PX + (fx_ - PX) * q, PB - ph + (ph + 14) * q)
        cr.line_to(PX + phw * q, PB - ph + (ph - 8) * q)
    cr.stroke()

    # tongues of sand sweeping along the ground ahead of the wall
    cr.move_to(-80, BASE + 70)
    for i in range(25):
        x = -80 + i * 52
        cr.line_to(x, BASE - 10 - 26 * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(x / 80.0 + t * 2.4)))
    cr.line_to(1160, BASE + 70)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (214, 166, 108), a=0.6, edge=False, rim=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 104, 62), 0.5))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    for i in range(4):
        yy = BASE + 30 + i * 16
        xx = 1160 - ((t * 220 + i * 300) % 1400)
        cr.move_to(xx, yy)
        cr.curve_to(xx - 70, yy - 12, xx - 150, yy + 6, xx - 240, yy - 20)
    cr.stroke()

    # the dune right by the camera, where Data digs
    DCX, DB, DH, DHW = 250, 1620, 230, 560
    contact_shadow(cr, DCX, DB, 2 * DHW, a=0.3)
    heap_path(cr, DCX, DB, DH, DHW)
    solid(cr, (226, 176, 110), edge=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((178, 124, 70), 0.5))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    for i in range(5):
        yy = DB - 40 - i * 30
        cr.move_to(DCX - DHW * 0.7 + i * 40, yy)
        cr.curve_to(DCX - 100, yy - 14, DCX + 60, yy + 10, DCX + DHW * 0.6 - i * 50, yy - 6)
    cr.stroke()

    hx = 140 + 260 * ease(seg(u, a0, a1))
    hy = min(1500.0, heap_top(DCX, DB, DH, DHW, hx) + 8)

    # the plume: sand off his shovel, carried by the wind up into the wall
    sx, sy = hx + 80, hy - 30
    ex, ey = 520, BASE - 0.35 * Hc
    c1x, c1y = sx + 60, sy - 260
    c2x, c2y = ex - 200, ey + 80
    if u >= a0:
        gust = math.sin(math.pi * fly)
        cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
        for lw, col, al in ((70, (206, 154, 94), 0.35 + 0.3 * gust),
                            (32, (232, 190, 130), 0.4 + 0.3 * gust)):
            cr.move_to(sx, sy)
            cr.curve_to(c1x, c1y, c2x, c2y, ex, ey)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(col, al))
            cr.set_line_width(lw)
            cr.stroke()
        cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_BUTT)
        if 0 < fly < 1:                      # this shovelful, riding the wind up
            q = fly
            mq = 1 - q
            px = mq ** 3 * sx + 3 * mq * mq * q * c1x + 3 * mq * q * q * c2x + q ** 3 * ex
            py = mq ** 3 * sy + 3 * mq * mq * q * c1y + 3 * mq * q * q * c2y + q ** 3 * ey
            glow(cr, px, py, 60 + 60 * q, (184, 126, 70), 0.95)
            glow(cr, px, py, 30 + 30 * q, (150, 100, 56), 0.8)

    foreground(cr, "desert")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    if u < a0:
        host("point", hx, hy, 220)
    else:
        host("dig", hx, hy, 220, beat=beat_i)

    if done:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(vd))}M tons",
                    f"of Sahara dust lifted a year · {ratio:.0f}x the {pname}'s mass",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, a1 - 0.02, a1 + 0.04)), size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Sahara dust", "lifted into the sky every year", 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

segments.say: About 27.7 million tons of it crosses the ocean and lands on the Amazon. The rest falls into the sea.
segments.illustrated_scene:
# scene standard: 2026-10-11.2
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a dust cloud crossing the ocean
    SUBSTANCE: orange Saharan dust
    CAUSE: Data pumps a bellows on the African beach, blowing the dust cloud west, and most of it rains into the sea
    One whole cloud of Saharan dust leaves the African beach in the
    foreground. Data fans it west across the Atlantic with a bellows, one
    pump per stretch of ocean. With each pump the trailing part of the cloud
    falls out as a curtain of dust and leaves a brown stain on the sea. Only
    the leading slice of the cloud, cut at the true share, reaches the
    rainforest on the far left and settles on its canopy. The whole cloud
    stays as a dashed ghost where it started, so a glance shows how little
    of it arrives. Done by 0.62, then held while the ship sails on and Data
    keeps pumping. The only numbers printed are the sourced 27.7M tons and
    its share of the cloud; the opening readout names the dust in words."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    tot = sum(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    reach = next((r for r in rows if "amazon" in r[0].lower()),
                 min(rows, key=lambda r: r[1]))
    share = clamp(reach[1] / tot)
    n = 4
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.62
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    mv = ease(seg(f, 0.15, 0.7))
    dr = seg(f, 0.25, 0.85)
    mv_at = ease(seg(0.25, 0.15, 0.7))
    prog = 0.0 if u < a0 else (k + mv) / n
    done = u >= a1
    HZ, SEA1 = 1100, 1450

    # the setting: a dusty sky over the Atlantic
    landscape(cr, t, "coast", horizon=HZ)
    g = cairo.LinearGradient(0, 0, 0, HZ)
    g.add_color_stop_rgba(0, 0.62, 0.42, 0.26, 0.55)
    g.add_color_stop_rgba(1, 0.90, 0.70, 0.50, 0.45)
    cr.rectangle(0, 0, W, HZ)
    cr.set_source(g)
    cr.fill()
    glow(cr, 840, 420, 260, (255, 214, 150), 0.5)
    disc(cr, 840, 420, 70, (255, 226, 170), finish="gloss")
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (70, 104, 126)), (1, (34, 66, 92))], HZ, SEA1 + 60)
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    for i in range(10):
        wy = HZ + 24 + i * 34
        sp = 30 * (1 + 0.25 * i)
        for j in range(5):
            wx = (j * 260 + i * 97 + t * sp) % (W + 200) - 100
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((200, 220, 230), 0.25 + 0.03 * i))
            cr.move_to(wx, wy)
            cr.line_to(wx + 40 + 6 * i, wy)
            cr.stroke()

    # the Amazon on the far left of the horizon
    cr.move_to(0, HZ - 40)
    cr.curve_to(150, HZ - 60, 300, HZ - 36, 430, HZ + 6)
    cr.line_to(430, HZ + 22)
    cr.line_to(0, HZ + 22)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (40, 82, 46), edge=False)
    for i in range(9):
        tx = 14 + i * 46
        tree(cr, tx, HZ + 14 - (8 - i) * 4, 0.5 + 0.1 * (i % 3),
             P["leaf"], P["leaf_shade"], P["trunk"])
    haze(cr, 600, HZ + 24, (214, 170, 120), a=0.35)

    # the cloud: one whole band of dust puffs, leading edge on the left
    N = 20
    X0, L, T, CY = 380.0, 660.0, 300.0, 800.0
    m = max(1, sum(1 for i in range(N) if (i + 0.5) / N < share))
    off = T * prog
    settle = 0.0
    if u >= a0 and k == n - 1:
        settle = ease(seg(f, 0.5, 0.95))
    if done:
        settle = 1.0

    puffs = []        # (i, x, y, r, alpha)
    stains = []       # (x, r, a)
    veils = []        # (x, y, r, a, bottom)
    for i in range(N):
        bx = X0 + L * (i + 0.5) / N
        by = CY + (50 if i % 2 else -40) + 12 * math.sin(t * 0.8 + i)
        r = 100 + 28 * math.sin(i * 1.7)
        if i < m:
            x = bx - off
            y = by + 150 * settle
            puffs.append((i, x, y, r * (1 - 0.15 * settle), 1.0))
            if settle > 0:
                veils.append((x, y, r, 0.45 * settle, HZ - 10))
            continue
        gi = min(n - 1, (N - 1 - i) * n // (N - m))
        if u < a0 or gi > k:
            d = 0.0
        elif gi < k:
            d = 1.0
        else:
            d = dr
        x = bx - (off if d <= 0 else T * (gi + mv_at) / n)
        if d > 0:
            stains.append((x, r, d))
        if d < 1:
            y = by + 200 * d
            if d > 0:
                veils.append((x, y, r, 0.6 * math.sin(math.pi * d), HZ + 70))
            puffs.append((i, x, y, r * (1 - 0.6 * d), 1 - 0.7 * d))

    # the dust that reached the rainforest sits on the canopy
    if settle > 0:
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(200, HZ - 30)
        cr.scale(1, 0.25)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 220, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((196, 140, 84), 0.4 * settle))
        cr.fill()
    # the cloud's shadow on the sea, then the stains of what fell out
    for i, x, y, r, a in puffs:
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(x + 60, HZ + 120)
        cr.scale(1, 0.18)
        cr.arc(0, 0, r, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((20, 30, 40), 0.12 * a))
        cr.fill()
    for x, r, d in stains:
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(x, HZ + 80)
        cr.scale(1, 0.2)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 1.1 * r, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 108, 66), 0.55 * d))
        cr.fill()
    # curtains of dust falling out of the cloud
    for x, y, r, a, yb in veils:
        if a <= 0.01:
            continue
        vg = cairo.LinearGradient(0, y, 0, yb)
        vg.add_color_stop_rgba(0, 0.80, 0.58, 0.36, a)
        vg.add_color_stop_rgba(1, 0.70, 0.50, 0.32, 0.0)
        cr.rectangle(x - 0.7 * r, y, 1.4 * r, max(1, yb - y))
        cr.set_source(vg)
        cr.fill()
    for back in (True, False):
        for i, x, y, r, a in puffs:
            if (i % 2 == 0) != back:
                continue
            col = (184, 130, 80) if back else (214, 158, 98)
            disc(cr, x, y, r, col, a=a)

    # THE SCALE: the whole cloud as a ghost where it started, the slice
    # that arrives bracketed in the accent
    if u >= a0 + span * 0.5:
        x0g, x1g, y0g, y1g, rr = X0 - 80, X0 + L + 80, CY - 170, CY + 190, 120
        cr.new_sub_path()
        cr.arc(x1g - rr, y0g + rr, rr, -math.pi / 2, 0)
        cr.arc(x1g - rr, y1g - rr, rr, 0, math.pi / 2)
        cr.arc(x0g + rr, y1g - rr, rr, math.pi / 2, math.pi)
        cr.arc(x0g + rr, y0g + rr, rr, math.pi, 1.5 * math.pi)
        cr.close_path()
        ghost(cr, a=0.75 * ease(seg(u, a0 + span * 0.5, a0 + span)))
    if u >= a0:
        bx0 = X0 - off
        bx1 = X0 + L * share - off
        by_ = CY - 190 + 150 * settle
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"]))
        cr.set_line_width(8)
        cr.move_to(bx0, by_ + 24)
        cr.line_to(bx0, by_)
        cr.line_to(bx1, by_)
        cr.line_to(bx1, by_ + 24)
        cr.stroke()
        if done:
            text(cr, f"{int(round(share * 100))}%", (bx0 + bx1) / 2 + 30, by_ - 20, 56,
                 look.INK, face="display", anchor="center",
                 alpha=ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.05)))

    # a cargo ship crossing under the cloud
    sx = W + 200 - ((t * 80) % (W + 500))
    sy = 1370
    contact_shadow(cr, sx, sy + 22, 260, a=0.3)
    cr.move_to(sx - 130, sy - 30)
    cr.line_to(sx + 130, sy - 30)
    cr.line_to(sx + 105, sy + 20)
    cr.line_to(sx - 115, sy + 20)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (150, 44, 36))
    for j in range(4):
        box(cr, sx - 100 + j * 50, sy - 30, 44, 36,
            [(70, 110, 150), (200, 150, 60), (90, 130, 90), (170, 70, 60)][j], depth=10)
    box(cr, sx + 92, sy - 30, 26, 60, (230, 226, 216), depth=8)

    # the African beach right by the camera
    cr.move_to(0, H)
    cr.line_to(0, 1500)
    cr.curve_to(300, 1470, 700, 1440, W, 1430)
    cr.line_to(W, H)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (222, 186, 134), edge=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((240, 244, 246), 0.7))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    fo = 8 * math.sin(t * 1.3)
    cr.move_to(0, 1496 + fo)
    cr.curve_to(300, 1466 + fo, 700, 1436 + fo, W, 1426 + fo)
    cr.stroke()
    for i in range(3):
        dx = 140 + i * 360
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(dx, 1700 + 60 * (i % 2))
        cr.scale(1, 0.3)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 150, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        solid(cr, (206, 160, 104), edge=False)
    foreground(cr, "desert", y0=1560)
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data walks along the beach working the bellows at the cloud
    hx = 900 - 220 * clamp(prog)
    hy = 1490
    if u < a0:
        host("point", hx, hy, 220)
    elif not done:
        host("pump", hx, hy, 220, beat=k)
    else:
        host("pump", hx, hy, 220, beat=n + int((u - a1) / 0.1))

    if done:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{reach[1]:.1f}M tons", "of it reaches the Amazon · the rest sinks",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.05)), size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Saharan dust", "blown west across the Atlantic every year",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)
