    cr.stroke()
    cr.move_to(hx_ - 14, hy_ - 20)
    cr.line_to(hx_ - 50, hy_ - 52)
    cr.line_to(hx_ - 10, hy_ - 34)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (150, 104, 70))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((214, 198, 160)))
    cr.set_line_width(11)
    cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
    for sgn in (-1, 1):
        bx_, by_ = hx_ + 4 + sgn * 10, hy_ - 30
        tx_, ty_ = bx_ + sgn * 60 - 10, by_ - 130
        cr.move_to(bx_, by_)
        cr.curve_to(bx_ + sgn * 40, by_ - 40, tx_ - sgn * 10, ty_ + 60, tx_, ty_)
        for q in (0.35, 0.65):
            px = bx_ + (tx_ - bx_) * q
            py = by_ + (ty_ - by_) * q
            cr.move_to(px, py)
            cr.line_to(px + sgn * 34, py - 40)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_BUTT)
    # near legs, out toward the camera
    _leg(cr, CX - 230, BY + 70, CX - 300, GB + 24, 24, 13, fur)
    _leg(cr, CX + 190, BY + 80, CX + 250, GB + 28, 24, 13, fur)

    # the lead: fragments driven into its flank, and the grey heap on it
    reach = 2 * RX * share
    if prog > 0:
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(CX, BY)
        cr.scale(1, RY / RX)
        cr.arc(0, 0, RX, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.clip()
        for i in range(26):
            fx = lx0 + reach * ((i * 0.6180339) % 1.0)
            if fx > split:
                continue
            fy = BY - RY * 0.6 + RY * 1.4 * ((i * 0.4142136) % 1.0)
            _slug(cr, fx, fy, i * 1.3, 1.25, intact=i % 4 == 0)
        cr.reset_clip()
        hcx = lx0 + reach * 0.5 * (0.5 + 0.5 * prog)
        hw = reach * 0.5 * (0.45 + 0.5 * prog)
        hb = BY - RY * 0.35
        hh = 30 + 170 * prog
        contact_shadow(cr, hcx, hb + 6, 2 * hw, a=0.3)
        heap_path(cr, hcx, hb, hh, hw)
        solid(cr, (92, 96, 104), finish="metal")
        cr.save()
        heap_path(cr, hcx, hb, hh, hw)
        cr.clip()
        cnt = int(12 + 46 * prog)
        for i in range(cnt):
            dx = ((i * 0.6180339) % 1.0) * 1.9 - 0.95
            px = hcx + hw * dx
            top_y = heap_top(hcx, hb, hh, hw, px)
            py = hb - (hb - top_y) * ((i * 0.4142136) % 1.0) * 0.95 - 4
            _slug(cr, px, py, i * 1.7, 1.4, intact=i % 5 == 0)
        cr.restore()
        heap_path(cr, hcx, hb, hh, hw)
        edge(cr, (36, 36, 40))
        # the accent marks the share: the lead's part of the body, cut at the split
        cr.save()
        cr.rectangle(0, 0, split, H)
        cr.clip()
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(CX, BY)
        cr.scale(1, RY / RX)
        cr.arc(0, 0, RX + 10, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"], 0.95))
        cr.set_line_width(10)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.restore()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"], 0.95))
        cr.set_line_width(6)
        cr.set_dash([18, 12])
        cr.move_to(split, BY - RY - 30)
        cr.line_to(split, GB + 10)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.set_dash([])
    else:
        hcx, hb, hh, hw = lx0 + reach * 0.25, BY - RY * 0.35, 0.0, 10.0

    # condors feeding on the clean part
    _condor(cr, CX + 150, BY - RY * 0.93 + 4, 0.85, t, 1, flip=True)
    contact_shadow(cr, 910, 1452, 170, a=0.35)
    _condor(cr, 910, 1450, 1.15, t, 5, flip=True)

    # Data and his crate of bullets: he works along the carcass as the lead spreads
    hx, hy = 150 + 270 * prog, 1480
    contact_shadow(cr, 70, 1500, 150, a=0.4)
    box(cr, 0, 1500, 130, 70, (120, 92, 54), depth=30)
    for i in range(6):
        _slug(cr, 18 + i * 19, 1424 - (i % 2) * 6, -0.3 + i * 0.4, 1.0, intact=True)

    if u < a0:
        host("point", hx, hy, 220)
    elif not done:
        host("dig", hx, hy, 220, beat=k)
    elif u < 0.93:
        host("dig", hx, hy, 220, beat=n + int((u - a1) / 0.12))
    else:
        host("shock", hx, hy, 220)

    # the shovelful in flight, landing on the heap on the strike
    p = None
    if a0 <= u < a1 and 0.1 < f < 0.4:
        p = (f - 0.1) / 0.3
    elif done and u < 0.92:
        f2 = ((u - a1) / 0.12) % 1.0
        if 0.1 < f2 < 0.4:
            p = (f2 - 0.1) / 0.3
    if p is not None:
        sx, sy = hx + 70, hy - 170
        ex, ey = hcx, hb - hh - 10
        for j in range(4):
            bx = sx + (ex - sx) * p + 16 * (j - 1.5)
            by = sy + (ey - sy) * p - 180 * math.sin(math.pi * p) + 10 * (j % 2)
            _slug(cr, bx, by, p * 7 + j * 1.6, 1.4, intact=j % 2 == 0)

    # right by the camera: spent bullets and rocks in the dust
    for i, (rx, ry, rs) in enumerate([(1010, 1760, 80), (560, 1860, 50), (300, 1880, 40)]):
        contact_shadow(cr, rx, ry + rs * 0.5, rs * 2.2, a=0.35)
        disc(cr, rx, ry, rs, (150, 112, 84))
    for i in range(5):
        _slug(cr, 140 + i * 170, 1650 + (i % 2) * 60 + i * 12, i * 1.1 + 0.4,
              2.6 + 0.4 * (i % 2), intact=i % 2 == 1)
    foreground(cr, "desert")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    if prog > 0.5:
        text(cr, "lead", hcx, hb - hh - 36, 34, look.INK, face="bold", anchor="center",
             alpha=ease(seg(prog, 0.5, 0.7)))

    if done:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(share * 100))}%",
                    "of wild condor deaths are lead poisoning",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.04)), size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Wild condors", "what still kills them",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

stories.title: Polio Cases Fell 99.9% In One Generation
stories.hook: In 1988, polio paralyzed 350,000 kids a year.
stories.closing: One vaccine. One generation. Almost gone.
stories.question: Did you know polio still exists?
stories.caption: In 1988, polio paralyzed about 350,000 children a year across more than 125 countries. One global vaccination push cut that by over 99.9% -- wild polio now survives in just two countries. Did you know it was that close to zero? 👇

segments.topic: how common polio used to be
segments.say: In 1988, polio paralyzed about 350,000 children across more than 125 countries.
Cases kept falling for decades, down to just a dozen worldwide by 2023.
Wild polio is now endemic in just two countries, down from over 125.

stories.title: One Tournament's Prize Pool Grew 25x
stories.hook: Fans funded a 40 million dollar prize pool. The company barely paid anything.
stories.closing: Fans paid for nearly all of it, so the prize shows how much they cared.
stories.question: Do you watch competitive esports?
stories.caption: Dota 2's championship started with a $1.6 million prize pool in 2011. Fan crowdfunding pushed it to $40 million by 2021 -- then a funding change cut it back down almost overnight. Do you follow competitive gaming? 👇

segments.say: It started small and grew about twenty-five times, hitting 40 million dollars in 2021. That's a fortune.

# scene standard: 2026-10-11.2
def _pz_envelope(cr, cx, cy, r):
    mw = r * 0.24
    my = cy + r * 1.25
    cr.move_to(cx - mw, my)
    cr.curve_to(cx - r * 0.9, cy + r * 0.85, cx - r * 1.04, cy + r * 0.25, cx - r, cy)
    cr.arc(cx, cy, r, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.curve_to(cx + r * 1.04, cy + r * 0.25, cx + r * 0.9, cy + r * 0.85, cx + mw, my)

def _pz_basket(cr, bx, base, w, h):
    top = base - h
    contact_shadow(cr, bx, base + 4, w * 1.3, a=0.45)
    cr.move_to(bx - w / 2, top)
    cr.line_to(bx + w / 2, top)
    cr.line_to(bx + w / 2 - 14, base)
    cr.line_to(bx - w / 2 + 14, base)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (168, 118, 64))
    # the wicker weave
    cr.save()
    cr.move_to(bx - w / 2, top)
    cr.line_to(bx + w / 2, top)
    cr.line_to(bx + w / 2 - 14, base)
    cr.line_to(bx - w / 2 + 14, base)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.clip()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((104, 68, 32), 0.85))

def _pz_sandbags(cr, gx, gy):

def _pz_crowd(cr, t, x0, x1, y, n, s):
    tones = [(222, 180, 150), (176, 124, 92), (120, 84, 60), (236, 200, 170)]
    shirts = [(60, 70, 110), (150, 50, 50), (40, 40, 48), (90, 120, 80), (210, 210, 214)]
    for i in range(n):
        x = x0 + (x1 - x0) * ((i * 0.6180339) % 1.0)

        cr.move_to(x - 13 * s, yy)

        cr.line_to(x + 11 * s, yy - 30 * s + bob)

            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 40, 46)))

            cr.line_to(x + 16 * s, yy - 58 * s + bob)

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a giant gold money balloon
    SUBSTANCE: the swelling gold balloon
    CAUSE: Data pumps a bellows into the balloon and it swells bigger with every pump
    Outside the arena on finals night, the tournament's prize pool is a gold
    hot-air balloon with a dollar sign on it, tethered over a wicker basket
    to stakes in sandbag piles, the fans crowding the plaza behind it. Data
    works a bellows hose into its mouth, and each year's pool inflates it
    further: its AREA is the money, so 2021's balloon holds twenty-five of
    2011's. The 2011 balloon stays inside as a dashed ghost with its top
    marked. As the balloon widens, Data backs away from it, still pumping.
    Done by 0.56, then held: the balloon tugs at its tethers, the arena's
    searchlights sweep, the crowd bobs, and Data keeps pumping."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    n = len(rows)
    top = max(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.56
    span = (a1 - a0) / max(1, n)
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    slide = ease(seg(f, 0.15, 0.7))
    prev = rows[k - 1][1] if k > 0 else 0.0
    val = 0.0 if u < a0 else prev + (rows[k][1] - prev) * slide
    landed_to = k if slide >= 0.999 else k - 1
    keep = sorted({round(i * (n - 1) / max(1, READOUT_SHOWS - 1))
                   for i in range(READOUT_SHOWS)}) if n > READOUT_SHOWS else list(range(n))
    named = max((i for i in keep if i <= landed_to), default=None)
    shown = None if (u < a0 or named is None) else rows[named]
    done = u >= a0 and landed_to >= n - 1
    v0 = rows[0][1] or 1.0
    ratio = rows[-1][1] / v0

    RMAX = 325.0
    BX, BASE = 590.0, 1440.0
    BW, BH = 170.0, 112.0
    MOUTH = BASE - BH - 34
    r = max(24.0, RMAX * math.sqrt(max(0.0, val) / top))
    sway = (22 + 14 * r / RMAX) * math.sin(t * 2.2)
    cx = BX + sway
    cy = MOUTH - 1.25 * r

    # the setting: a town at dusk, the arena behind with its searchlights
    landscape(cr, t, "town")
    for j, (sx, ph) in enumerate(((760, 0.0), (1000, 1.9))):
        ang = -math.pi / 2 + 0.55 * math.sin(t * 0.8 + ph)
        L = 1300
        dx, dy = math.cos(ang), math.sin(ang)
        px, py = -dy, dx
        cr.move_to(sx, 1000)
        cr.line_to(sx + dx * L + px * 90, 1000 + dy * L + py * 90)
        cr.line_to(sx + dx * L - px * 90, 1000 + dy * L - py * 90)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 246, 214), 0.26))
        cr.fill()
    # the arena: a domed hall with a lit FINALS banner and a row of lights
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(840, 1000)
    cr.scale(1, 0.32)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 250, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (168, 176, 192), finish="metal")
    ar = building(cr, 560, 1080, 1200, 210, (150, 160, 180), roof="flat", boards=False)
    cr.rectangle(ar["x0"] + 40, ar["top"] + 34, ar["x1"] - ar["x0"] - 80, 58)
    solid(cr, P["accent2"], finish="gloss")
    glow(cr, (ar["x0"] + ar["x1"]) / 2, ar["top"] + 63, 260, P["accent2"], 0.3)
    text(cr, "GRAND FINALS", (ar["x0"] + ar["x1"]) / 2, ar["top"] + 78, 40, look.INK,
         face="display", anchor="center", shadow=False)
    for i in range(10):
        disc(cr, ar["x0"] + 30 + i * 52, ar["top"] + 130, 9, (255, 236, 170), finish="gloss")
    cr.rectangle(ar["x0"] + 200, ar["base"] - 70, 120, 70)
    solid(cr, (255, 214, 140), finish="glass", rim=False)
    haze(cr, 560, 1180, (226, 214, 200), a=0.4)

    # the plaza paving, running to the camera
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(0, 1200, W, H - 1200)
    cr.clip()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((90, 80, 70), 0.22))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(16):
        cr.move_to(540, 980)
        cr.line_to(-1400 + i * 260, H)
    for i in range(7):
        yy = 1220 + (i ** 1.7) * 26
        cr.move_to(0, yy)
        cr.line_to(W, yy)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()

    # the fans packed outside the doors
    _pz_crowd(cr, t, 600, 1060, 1236, 26, 1.0)
    haze(cr, 1150, 1260, (226, 214, 200), a=0.18)

    # the ground the balloon is tethered to
    cast_shadow(cr, cx - r, cx + r, BASE, length=320, a=0.3)

    # the sandbag piles by the camera, ropes tied off on their stakes
    anchors = [_pz_sandbags(cr, 150, 1720), _pz_sandbags(cr, 950, 1740)]
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 56, 40)))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    for side, (gx, gy) in zip((-1, 1), anchors):
        cr.move_to(cx + side * r * 0.85, cy + r * 0.45)
        cr.line_to(gx, gy)
    cr.stroke()

    # the wicker basket and its lines up to the mouth
    _pz_basket(cr, BX, BASE, BW, BH)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 48, 36)))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    for x in (BX - BW / 2 + 4, BX + BW / 2 - 4):
        cr.move_to(x, BASE - BH - 14)
        cr.line_to(cx + (x - BX) * 0.35, MOUTH + 2)
    cr.stroke()

    # the envelope: gold, gored, a crown ring and a dollar sign on it
    gold = (232, 182, 58)
    glow(cr, cx, cy, r * 1.25, (255, 214, 120), 0.25)
    _pz_envelope(cr, cx, cy, r)
    solid(cr, gold, finish="gloss")
    cr.save()
    _pz_envelope(cr, cx, cy, r)
    cr.clip()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((168, 118, 30)))
    cr.set_line_width(max(2.0, r / 70))
    for j in (1, 2, 3):
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(cx, cy + 0.15 * r)
        cr.scale(j / 3.6, 1.3)
        cr.arc(0, 0, r, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.stroke()
    # a darker band where the envelope necks to the mouth
    cr.rectangle(cx - r, cy + 0.82 * r, 2 * r, 0.12 * r)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 98, 24), 0.8))
    cr.fill()
    cr.restore()
    if r > 50:
        text(cr, "$", cx, cy + 0.32 * r, int(r * 0.95), (110, 72, 18),
             face="display", anchor="center", shadow=False)
    cr.rectangle(cx - r * 0.24, MOUTH - 6, r * 0.48, 12)
    solid(cr, (120, 84, 40), rim=False)

    # THE SCALE inside it: the 2011 balloon as a ghost, its top marked
    if u >= a0 and landed_to >= 1:
        r0 = RMAX * math.sqrt(v0 / top)
        cy0 = MOUTH - 1.25 * r0
        _pz_envelope(cr, cx, cy0, r0)
        ghost(cr, a=0.9)
        then_mark(cr, cx - 120, cx + 120, cy0 - r0, rows[0][0])

    foreground(cr, "town")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data at the bellows, backing off as the balloon widens, the hose to the mouth
    hx = max(110.0, BX - r * 1.05 - 120)
    fy = 1470
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((34, 34, 40)))
    cr.set_line_width(14)
    cr.move_to(hx + 60, fy - 100)
    cr.curve_to(hx + 180, fy - 10, BX - 160, BASE - 30, cx - r * 0.18, MOUTH + 4)
    cr.stroke()
    disc(cr, cx - r * 0.18, MOUTH + 4, 10, (150, 150, 158), finish="metal")
    if u < a0:
        host("point", hx, fy, 240)
    else:
        host("pump", hx, fy, 240, beat=int((u - a0) / 0.06))

    if shown is not None:
        lab, v = shown
        fit_readout(cr, f"${v:g}M", f"one tournament's prize pool · {lab}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, a0, a0 + 0.05)), size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Prize pool", f"one tournament, {rows[0][0]}–{rows[-1][0]}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)
    if done:
        text(cr, f"{ratio:.0f}x", W - 80, 650, 90, look.INK, face="display",
             anchor="right", alpha=ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.05)))

# scene standard: 2026-10-11.2
def _pp_qpos(q):
    # the queue's path: from the counter's front, out toward the camera, then
    # along the bottom of the frame to the right
    way = [(300, 1440), (170, 1525), (205, 1630), (480, 1690), (780, 1700), (1000, 1655)]
    lens = [math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]) for a, b in zip(way, way[1:])]
    goal = clamp(q) * sum(lens)
    for (a, b), ln in zip(zip(way, way[1:]), lens):
        if goal <= ln or ln == lens[-1]:
            f = clamp(goal / max(1e-6, ln))
            return a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * f, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * f
        goal -= ln
    return way[-1]


def _pp_bill(cr, x, y, s, ang):
    # one banknote: green paper, a darker oval at its centre
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.rotate(ang)
    cr.rectangle(-26 * s, -12 * s, 52 * s, 24 * s)
    solid(cr, (112, 164, 98))
    cr.arc(0, 0, 7 * s, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((66, 112, 60)))
    cr.fill()
    cr.restore()


def _pp_person(cr, x, y, s, shirt, pose, skin, suit=False):
    # someone standing in line, feet at (x, y); returns the raised hand
    contact_shadow(cr, x, y, 64 * s, a=0.3)
    for lx in (-16, 4):
        cr.rectangle(x + lx * s, y - 60 * s, 12 * s, 60 * s)
        solid(cr, (38, 38, 50), rim=False, edge=False)
    sh = y - 112 * s
    arm_rgb = tuple(int(c * 0.78) for c in shirt)
    sides = [1] if pose in ("bill", "coin") else ([1, -1] if pose == "cheer" else [])
    cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
    for sg in sides:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(arm_rgb))
        cr.set_line_width(12 * s)
        cr.move_to(x + sg * 22 * s, sh + 8 * s)
        cr.line_to(x + sg * 40 * s, sh - 46 * s)
        cr.stroke()
        disc(cr, x + sg * 40 * s, sh - 48 * s, 7 * s, skin)
    cr.move_to(x - 28 * s, y - 56 * s)
    cr.line_to(x + 28 * s, y - 56 * s)
    cr.line_to(x + 30 * s, sh)
    cr.curve_to(x + 30 * s, sh - 14 * s, x - 30 * s, sh - 14 * s, x - 30 * s, sh)

        cr.move_to(x - 3 * s, sh - 4 * s)

        cr.line_to(x + 4 * s, sh + 24 * s)
        cr.line_to(x - 4 * s, sh + 24 * s)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (40, 42, 50), rim=False, edge=False)
    disc(cr, x, y - 136 * s, 16 * s, skin)
    cr.arc(x, y - 138 * s, 16 * s, math.pi * 1.05, math.pi * 1.95)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (46, 34, 28), rim=False, edge=False)
    hand = (x + 40 * s, sh - 58 * s)
    if pose == "bill":

    elif pose == "coin":

    return hand


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: an antique brass cash register
    SUBSTANCE: the fans' green banknotes
    CAUSE: Data cranks the register open and the line of fans pays their cash into its drawer, wave after wave
    The whole prize pool is ONE line at one register on the arena concourse:
    twenty-five payers, cut at the true split. Twenty-four are fans in the
    team's jersey (the accent), and the last, in a grey suit, is Valve. Data
    cranks the old brass register, a tab pops up, the drawer is open, and a
    wave of fans throws their banknotes into it, three waves until every fan
    has paid and the drawer is stuffed green. Then the suit at the back of
    the line flicks in one coin. Landed by 0.60 and held: the fans who paid
    jump and cheer, the spotlights sweep, and Data keeps ringing it up."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    tot = sum(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    fl, fv = max(rows, key=lambda r_: r_[1])
    vl, vv = min(rows, key=lambda r_: r_[1])
    N = 25
    valve_n = max(1, int(round(vv / tot * N)))
    fans_n = max(3, N - valve_n)

    n = 3
    a0, a1 = 0.12, 0.50
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    starts = [(w * fans_n) // n for w in range(n)] + [fans_n]

    paid = []
    for i in range(fans_n):
        w = max(w_ for w_ in range(n) if starts[w_] <= i)
        j = i - starts[w]
        if u < a0 or w > k:
            p = 0.0
        elif w < k:
            p = 1.0
        else:
            p = clamp((f - 0.3 - 0.045 * j) / 0.3)
        paid.append(p)
    paid_sum = sum(paid)
    fans_done = u >= a0 and min(paid) >= 1.0
    vc = seg(u, 0.52, 0.60)
    valve_done = vc >= 1.0

    # every turn of the crank: one per wave, one for Valve, then he keeps ringing
    cranks = [(a0 + (w + 0.08) * span, a0 + (w + 0.28) * span) for w in range(n)]
    cranks += [(0.50, 0.54), (0.70, 0.74), (0.84, 0.88)]
    turns = sum(ease(seg(u, c0, c1)) for c0, c1 in cranks)
    bi = max([i for i, (c0, _) in enumerate(cranks) if u >= c0], default=0)
    dr = 150 * ease(seg(u, cranks[0][0], cranks[0][1]))

    accent = P["accent2"]
    skins = [(236, 196, 160), (198, 150, 110), (150, 100, 70), (226, 180, 140), (120, 80, 56)]

    # the arena: dark stands full of fans behind the concourse
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (12, 14, 28)), (0.45, (34, 28, 52)), (1, (22, 18, 30))], 0, H)
    shirts = [(160, 60, 70), (60, 90, 150), (200, 170, 70), (80, 130, 90), (120, 80, 150)]
    for row in range(7):
        y = 640 + row * 62
        rad = 13 + row * 1.6
        for i in range(21):
            x = (i * 56 + row * 23) % 1140 - 30
            cr.rectangle(x - rad * 1.3, y, rad * 2.6, rad * 2.2)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(shirts[(i + row) % 5], 0.85))
            cr.fill()
            cr.arc(x, y - rad * 0.6, rad, 0, 2 * math.pi)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 56, 60)))
            cr.fill()
    haze(cr, 600, 1120, (40, 36, 62), a=0.5)

    # the truss and its sweeping spotlights
    box(cr, -20, 220, W + 40, 26, (70, 74, 84), depth=14, finish="metal")
    for i, sx in enumerate((160, 920)):
        ang = 0.34 * math.sin(t * 0.8 + i * 2.3)
        ex = sx + 1200 * math.tan(ang)
        lg = cairo.LinearGradient(sx, 240, sx, 1500)
        lg.add_color_stop_rgba(0, 1.0, 0.95, 0.82, 0.4)
        lg.add_color_stop_rgba(1, 1.0, 0.95, 0.82, 0.06)
        cr.move_to(sx - 18, 250)
        cr.line_to(sx + 18, 250)
        cr.line_to(ex + 140, 1500)
        cr.line_to(ex - 140, 1500)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.set_source(lg)
        cr.fill()
        cylinder(cr, sx - 22, 270, 44, 40, (60, 62, 70), finish="metal")

    # the concourse floor
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (88, 76, 90)), (1, (54, 44, 58))], 1130, H)
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(0, 1130, W, H - 1130)
    cr.clip()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 24, 36), 0.35))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(12):
        cr.move_to(600, 700)
        cr.line_to(-800 + i * 240, H)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()
    glow(cr, 610, 980, 520, (255, 214, 140), 0.22 + 0.12 * paid_sum / fans_n)

    # the counter
    cast_shadow(cr, 300, 980, 1400, length=280, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, 640, 1404, 720, a=0.45)
    box(cr, 300, 1400, 640, 175, (128, 86, 54), depth=80)

    # THE REGISTER: the drawer housing and its slot
    contact_shadow(cr, 640, 1208, 540, a=0.4)
    box(cr, 360, 1205, 500, 105, (176, 128, 52), depth=80, finish="metal")
    cr.rectangle(385, 1112, 450, 82)
    solid(cr, (34, 24, 18), rim=False)
    # the key bank, sloping back, its side, its round keys
    cr.move_to(360, 1100)
    cr.line_to(860, 1100)
    cr.line_to(820, 880)
    cr.line_to(400, 880)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (198, 152, 64), finish="metal")
    cr.move_to(860, 1100)
    cr.line_to(930, 1060)
    cr.line_to(890, 850)
    cr.line_to(820, 880)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (138, 98, 40), finish="metal")
    for r_ in range(4):
        yy = 1068 - r_ * 52
        inset = 40 * (1100 - yy) / 220
        for c_ in range(7):
            kx = 360 + inset + 40 + c_ * (500 - 2 * inset - 80) / 6
            cylinder(cr, kx - 4, yy + 4, 8, 14, (90, 70, 40), finish="metal")
            disc(cr, kx, yy - 10, 16, (238, 230, 208), finish="gloss")
    # the display box and the tabs that pop up as it rings
    box(cr, 430, 880, 360, 120, (186, 140, 58), depth=60, finish="metal")
    cr.rectangle(455, 784, 310, 76)
    solid(cr, (28, 26, 34), finish="gloss", rim=False)
    for i in range(3):
        tp = pop(seg(u, cranks[i][1] - 0.02, cranks[i][1] + 0.02))
        if tp <= 0.01:
            continue
        cr.save()
        cr.rectangle(0, 0, W, 860)
        cr.clip()
        tx_ = 470 + i * 100
        cr.rectangle(tx_, 852 - 110 * tp, 82, 72)
        solid(cr, (246, 242, 232))
        text(cr, "$", tx_ + 41, 852 - 110 * tp + 54, 48, (40, 40, 48), face="display",
             anchor="center", shadow=False)
        cr.restore()
    # the brass crest on top
    cr.move_to(440, 762)
    cr.curve_to(470, 690, 560, 648, 610, 648)
    cr.curve_to(660, 648, 750, 690, 780, 762)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (204, 158, 66), finish="metal")
    disc(cr, 610, 712, 28, (226, 186, 90), finish="metal")
    # the crank on the side
    hx_, hy_ = 900, 1160
    disc(cr, hx_, hy_, 22, (120, 92, 44), finish="metal")
    ca = turns * 2 * math.pi - math.pi / 2
    kx_, ky_ = hx_ + 62 * math.cos(ca), hy_ + 62 * math.sin(ca)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 52, 30)))
    cr.set_line_width(12)
    cr.move_to(hx_, hy_)
    cr.line_to(kx_, ky_)
    cr.stroke()
    disc(cr, kx_, ky_, 14, (196, 54, 44), finish="gloss")

    # the drawer, out toward the camera, filling with the fans' notes
    if dr > 1:
        cr.rectangle(385, 1112, 450, dr)
        solid(cr, (70, 46, 30), rim=False)
        top_ = 1112 + 8
        bot_ = 1112 + dr - 6
        for c_ in range(5):
            q = clamp(paid_sum / fans_n * 5 - c_)
            cx0 = 393 + c_ * 87
            if q > 0.01:
                hgt = (bot_ - top_) * q
                cr.rectangle(cx0, bot_ - hgt, 79, hgt)
                solid(cr, (112, 164, 98), rim=False)
                cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((66, 112, 60), 0.8))
                cr.set_line_width(2)
                for l_ in range(int(hgt // 10)):
                    cr.move_to(cx0 + 4, bot_ - 6 - l_ * 10)
                    cr.line_to(cx0 + 75, bot_ - 6 - l_ * 10)
                cr.stroke()
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((46, 30, 20)))
            cr.set_line_width(5)
            cr.move_to(cx0 + 83, top_ - 6)
            cr.line_to(cx0 + 83, bot_ + 4)
            cr.stroke()
        if valve_done:
            disc(cr, 812, bot_ - 14, 13, P["coin"], finish="metal")
    cr.rectangle(385, 1112 + dr, 450, 82)
    solid(cr, (188, 140, 58), finish="metal")
    disc(cr, 610, 1153 + dr, 13, (120, 92, 44), finish="metal")

    # THE LINE: twenty-four fans in the team's colour, Valve's suit at the back
    people = []
    for i in range(fans_n):
        people.append((i, _pp_qpos(0.92 * i / max(1, fans_n - 1)), 0.95 + 0.55 * i / fans_n))
    flights = []
    for i, (x, y), s in sorted(people, key=lambda r_: r_[1][1]):
        p = paid[i]
        by = y
        if p >= 1.0:
            by = y - 9 * s * max(0.0, math.sin(t * 5.0 + i * 1.3))
        pose = "cheer" if p >= 1.0 else ("down" if p > 0 else "bill")
        hand = _pp_person(cr, x, by, s, accent, pose, skins[i % 5])
        if 0 < p < 1:
            flights.append((hand, p, i))
    vx, vy = _pp_qpos(1.0)
    vh = _pp_person(cr, vx, vy, 1.55, (118, 120, 128),
                    "coin" if vc <= 0 else "down", skins[0], suit=True)

    # the notes flying from the fans' hands into the open drawer
    for (sx, sy), p, i in flights:
        tx = 420 + (i * 53) % 380
        ty = 1112 + dr * 0.5
        bx = sx + (tx - sx) * p
        by = sy + (ty - sy) * p - 220 * math.sin(math.pi * p)
        _pp_bill(cr, bx, by, 1.5, p * 5 + i)
    # Valve's coin, chipped in last
    if 0 < vc < 1:
        tx, ty = 812, 1112 + dr - 20
        bx = vh[0] + (tx - vh[0]) * vc
        by = vh[1] + (ty - vh[1]) * vc - 200 * math.sin(math.pi * vc)
        disc(cr, bx, by, 14, P["coin"], finish="metal")

    # the crate Data stands on to reach the crank
    contact_shadow(cr, 985, 1444, 140, a=0.4)
    box(cr, 925, 1442, 120, 70, (150, 108, 66), depth=24)
    vignette(cr, a=0.3)

    # Data walks from the counter up onto the crate and rings it up
    w_ = ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.11))
    dx, dy = 600 + 385 * w_, 1460 - 88 * w_
    if u < a0:
        host("point", dx, dy, 220)
    elif u < 0.92:
        host("crank", dx, dy, 220, beat=bi)
    else:
        host("cheer", dx, dy, 220)

    if fans_done:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(fv))}%", "of the prize pool paid by fans",
                    80, 520, size=130, max_w=600)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Prize pool", "who paid in", 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130, max_w=600)
    if valve_done:
        va = ease(seg(u, 0.60, 0.65))
        text(cr, f"{int(round(vv))}%", W - 80, 520, 90, look.INK, face="display",
             anchor="right", alpha=va)
        text(cr, "Valve", W - 80, 575, 38, look.INK, face="bold", anchor="right", alpha=va)

# scene standard: 2026-10-11.2
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a glass prize pool tank of gold
    SUBSTANCE: gold prize coins
    CAUSE: Data pours bucket after bucket of gold coins into the tank and it fills to its peak
    One crowdfunded prize pool on an arena stage: a tall glass tank on a
    brass plinth, the fans packed in the stands behind and right by the
    camera with their phones up. Data climbs the ladder on its side and
    pours the fans' money in, one bucket a pour, until the gold heaps up to
    the rim, which is the 2021 peak. The rim carries a mark naming the peak,
    kept on the far side of the tank from Data so nothing is drawn over him.
    Data on the ladder beside the tank shows how big it is. Done by 0.66 and
    held: the spotlights keep sweeping, the fans keep their phones up and
    Data holds the bucket high over the full tank."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    lab, val = rows[-1]
    n = 5
    a0, a1 = 0.2, 0.66

    JERSEY = [(150, 60, 70), (60, 90, 150), (70, 120, 90), (150, 120, 60), (110, 70, 140), (90, 92, 110)]
    for r_ in range(5):
        yy = 760 + r_ * 92

                # the coin's edge, then its face: a stacked coin, not a dot

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a giant pink piggy bank
    SUBSTANCE: gold coins
    CAUSE: Data pours bucket after bucket of fans' coins into the slot and the piggy bank swells
    THE HOOK: the prize pool as one piggy bank in a gamer's bedroom at night.
    Already swelling in the first frame, it grows pour by pour from its 2011
    size to its 2021 size, its AREA being the pool (about 25 times as big),
    shoving Data back across the floor as it fattens. Done by 0.5 and held:
    he keeps pouring, the coins keep arcing into the slot, the LEDs keep
    cycling."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    if len(rows) < 2:
        rows = rows + rows
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    v1 = v1 or 1.0
    ns = len(rows) - 1
    a1 = 0.5
    span = a1 / ns
    k = int(clamp(u / span, 0, ns - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - k * span) / span)
    grow = ease(seg(f, 0.3, 0.85))
    if u >= a1:
        val = v1
        per = 0.14
        ph = ((u - a1) / per) % 1.0
        beat = ns + int((u - a1) / per)
        fly = seg(ph, 0.0, 0.6)
    else:
        val = rows[k][1] + (rows[k + 1][1] - rows[k][1]) * grow
        beat = k
        fly = seg(f, 0.0, 0.4)

    CX, BASE = 610, 1440
    R1 = 430.0
    rx = R1 * math.sqrt(max(val, 0.0) / v1)
    rx = max(rx, 60.0)

    # the bedroom at night
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (24, 22, 46)), (1, (58, 46, 84))], 0, 1210)
    # a window onto the city
    cr.rectangle(70, 600, 330, 380)
    solid(cr, (20, 26, 58), rim=False)
    disc(cr, 320, 680, 34, (236, 234, 214), finish="gloss")
    for i in range(6):
        bh = 90 + (i * 53) % 140
        cr.rectangle(80 + i * 54, 980 - bh, 46, bh)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((12, 14, 34)))
        cr.fill()
        for j in range(int(bh // 30)):
            if (i + j) % 3:
                cr.rectangle(92 + i * 54, 990 - bh + j * 30, 10, 12)
                cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((250, 214, 120), 0.8))
                cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((200, 190, 210)))
    cr.set_line_width(12)
    cr.rectangle(70, 600, 330, 380)
    cr.move_to(235, 600)
    cr.line_to(235, 980)
    cr.stroke()
    # the gaming desk and its glowing monitor
    glow(cr, 870, 880, 380, (90, 160, 255), 0.45)
    contact_shadow(cr, 870, 1210, 400, a=0.35)
    box(cr, 660, 1210, 400, 220, (52, 44, 60), depth=60)
    cr.rectangle(690, 740, 360, 210)
    solid(cr, (30, 30, 40), finish="gloss")
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (70, 120, 230)), (1, (170, 80, 220))], 756, 934, 706, 1034)
    cylinder(cr, 850, 990, 40, 50, (40, 40, 48), finish="metal")
    # an LED strip along the wall, cycling
    for i in range(18):
        hue = (t * 0.6 + i / 18.0) % 1.0
        col = (int(127 + 127 * math.cos(2 * math.pi * hue)),
               int(127 + 127 * math.cos(2 * math.pi * (hue - 0.33))),
               int(127 + 127 * math.cos(2 * math.pi * (hue - 0.66))))
        glow(cr, 30 + i * 60, 1206, 40, col, 0.5)
    haze(cr, 560, 1210, (58, 46, 84), a=0.25)
    # the wooden floor
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (118, 82, 58)), (1, (70, 48, 34))], 1210, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((50, 34, 24), 0.5))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(12):
        cr.move_to(540, 1210)
        cr.line_to(-1200 + i * 300, H)
    cr.stroke()

    # the piggy bank
    cast_shadow(cr, CX - rx, CX + rx, BASE, length=280, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, CX, BASE + 4, 2.1 * rx, a=0.45)
    cy, ry = _hook_piggy(cr, CX, BASE, rx)

    # Data, shoved back across the floor as it fattens
    hx = max(90.0, CX - rx - 90)
    hy = BASE

    # the coins in flight from his bucket into the slot
    if 0 < fly < 1:
        sx, sy = hx + 60, hy - 170
        ex, ey = CX - 0.03 * rx, cy - 0.93 * ry
        for j in range(4):
            q = clamp(fly - j * 0.07)
            if q <= 0 or q >= 1:
                continue
            bx = sx + (ex - sx) * q
            by = sy + (ey - sy) * q - 240 * math.sin(math.pi * q)
            disc(cr, bx + 14 * (j - 1.5), by, 24, P["coin"], finish="metal")

    # right by the camera: a controller and spilled coins on the floor
    for i in range(5):
        disc(cr, 120 + i * 70, 1700 + (i % 2) * 40, 30, P["coin"], finish="metal")
    _hook_controller(cr, 840, 1760, 1.5)
    vignette(cr, a=0.3)

    if u < 0.9:
        host("pour", hx, hy, 220, beat=beat)
    else:
        host("cheer", hx, hy, 220)

    if u >= a1:
        fit_readout(cr, f"${v1:g}M", f"esports' biggest prize pool · {l1}",
                    80, 520, size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"${v0:g}M", f"esports' biggest prize pool · {l0}",
                    80, 520, size=130)

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a giant prize cheque
    SUBSTANCE: the cheque rising up
    CAUSE: Data hauls the rope that hoists the giant cheque up over the cheering fans
    The closing: the 2021 peak prize, forty million dollars, is one giant
    cheque made out from the fans. Pull by pull Data hauls it up out of the
    stage on a rope over the truss, above a crowd holding their phones up,
    until it hangs whole over the arena. Done by 0.55 and held: he keeps
    the rope taut, the spotlights keep sweeping, the phones keep swaying.
    The cheque is clipped to the stage line as it rises, and each line of
    its writing appears only once it is well above Data's head, so no word
    of it is ever behind him."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    lab, v = rows[-1]
    n = 5
    a0, a1 = 0.06, 0.52
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    pull = ease(seg(f, 0.2, 0.75))
    lift = 0.0 if u < a0 else (k + pull) / n

    CW, CH = 840, 440
    CX0 = 120
    STAGE = 1240
    LIM = 1170                      # writing only above Data's raised hands
    top = 1000 - (1000 - 640) * lift
    swing = 6 * math.sin(t * 1.1) * (0.4 + 0.6 * lift)

    # the arena: dark roof, tiers of fans in the stands under haze
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (12, 14, 30)), (0.5, (30, 28, 58)), (1, (60, 48, 80))], 0, 1260)
    for r in range(7):
        ty = 760 + r * 72
        cr.rectangle(0, ty, W, 72)
        solid(cr, (40 + r * 6, 38 + r * 5, 66 + r * 4), rim=False, edge=False)
        for c in range(28):
            hx_ = (c * 40 + r * 17) % (W + 40) - 10
            cr.arc(hx_, ty + 30 + 3 * math.sin(t * 2 + c + r), 11, 0, 2 * math.pi)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 120, 110), 0.8))
            cr.fill()
            if (c + r) % 3 == 0:
                glow(cr, hx_ + 8, ty + 6, 10, (200, 225, 255), 0.6)
    haze(cr, 700, 1260, (60, 50, 90), a=0.45)

    # sweeping spotlights
    for i, (sx, ph) in enumerate(((120, 0.0), (540, 2.1), (960, 4.2))):
        ang = math.pi / 2 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 0.7 + ph)
        ex, ey = sx + 1500 * math.cos(ang), 40 + 1500 * math.sin(ang)
        nx, ny = -math.sin(ang), math.cos(ang)
        cr.move_to(sx, 40)
        cr.line_to(ex + nx * 220, ey + ny * 220)
        cr.line_to(ex - nx * 220, ey - ny * 220)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 240, 200), 0.16))
        cr.fill()
        disc(cr, sx, 40, 26, (230, 230, 220), finish="metal")

    # the truss the cheque hangs from
    for px in (40, 1010):
        cr.rectangle(px, 580, 30, 700)
        solid(cr, (110, 114, 124), finish="metal", rim=False)
    box(cr, 30, 610, 1020, 30, (130, 134, 146), depth=14, finish="metal")
    disc(cr, 990, 596, 22, (90, 92, 100), finish="metal")

    # the cheque on its two cables, rising out of the stage
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 60, 66)))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    for ax in (CX0 + 80, CX0 + CW - 80):
        cr.move_to(ax, 600)
        cr.line_to(ax + swing, top)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(0, 0, W, STAGE)
    cr.clip()
    cr.translate(swing, 0)
    _cheque(cr, CX0, top, CW, CH, v, lab, LIM)
    cr.restore()

    # the stage it rises out of
    cr.move_to(0, STAGE)
    cr.line_to(W, STAGE)
    cr.line_to(W, 1490)
    cr.line_to(0, 1490)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (44, 40, 52), finish="gloss")
    cr.rectangle(0, STAGE, W, 14)
    solid(cr, P["accent2"], rim=False, edge=False)
    glow(cr, 540, STAGE + 10, 500, (255, 220, 170), 0.18)

    # Data backs along the front of the stage as he hauls the rope in
    hx = 680 + 280 * lift
    hy = 1490
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((196, 170, 120)))
    cr.set_line_width(7)
    cr.move_to(990, 596)
    cr.line_to(hx + 20, hy - 150)
    cr.line_to(hx - 60, hy - 10)
    cr.stroke()
    cast_shadow(cr, hx - 40, hx + 40, hy, length=160, a=0.25)

    # right by the camera: the fans, phones up
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (30, 26, 44)), (1, (16, 14, 26))], 1490, H)
    for i in range(7):
        _fan(cr, 70 + i * 160, 1660 + (i % 2) * 70, 1.25 + 0.1 * (i % 2), t, i)
    vignette(cr, a=0.3)

    if u < a0:
        host("point", hx, hy, 220)
    elif u < a1 + 0.04:
        host("haul", hx, hy, 220, beat=k)
    elif u < 0.9:
        host("strain", hx, hy, 220)
    else:
        host("cheer", hx, hy, 220)

    fit_readout(cr, f"${int(round(v))}M", f"prize pool the fans paid for · {lab}",
                80, 540, a=ease(seg(u, a1 - 0.04, a1 + 0.02)), size=120)

stories.title: The Rubik's Cube Record Dropped From 22 To 3 Seconds
stories.hook: A robot just made every human cube champion look like they're standing still.
stories.closing: Humans spent decades getting fast, and a machine beat all of it in under half a second.
stories.question: Could you solve a cube that fast?
stories.caption: The first world championship Rubik's Cube solve in 1982 took almost 23 seconds. The official record has since fallen to about 3.13 seconds -- and a robot beat that too, in well under half a second. Could you even solve one? 👇

segments.say: In 1982, the first world championship solve took almost 23 seconds. For years, that was the number everyone chased.

# scene standard: 2026-10-16.2
def _hg_glass(cr, cx, y0, ny, y1, hw):
    cr.move_to(cx - hw, y0)
    cr.curve_to(cx - hw, y0 + (ny - y0) * 0.55, cx - 16, ny - 70, cx - 16, ny)
    cr.curve_to(cx - 16, ny + 70, cx - hw, y1 - (y1 - ny) * 0.55, cx - hw, y1)
    cr.line_to(cx + hw, y1)
    cr.curve_to(cx + hw, y1 - (y1 - ny) * 0.55, cx + 16, ny + 70, cx + 16, ny)
    cr.curve_to(cx + 16, ny - 70, cx + hw, y0 + (ny - y0) * 0.55, cx + hw, y0)
    cr.close_path()


def _hg_mound(cr, cx, y1, lv, peak, hw):
    cr.move_to(cx - hw - 20, y1 + 4)
    for i in range(25):
        x = cx - hw - 20 + (2 * hw + 40) * i / 24.0
        d = (x - cx) / hw
        cr.line_to(x, y1 - lv - peak * max(0.0, 1 - d * d))
    cr.line_to(cx + hw + 20, y1 + 4)
    cr.close_path()


def _hg_upper(cr, cx, ny, top, dip, hw):
    cr.move_to(cx - hw - 20, ny + 4)
    for i in range(25):
        x = cx - hw - 20 + (2 * hw + 40) * i / 24.0
        d = (x - cx) / hw
        cr.line_to(x, top + dip * max(0.0, 1 - d * d))
    cr.line_to(cx + hw + 20, ny + 4)
    cr.close_path()


def _hg_yr(label):
    digits = "".join(ch for ch in label if ch.isdigit())
    return int(digits) if len(digits) == 4 else 99999


def _hg_spot(cr, x, y, rx, ry, a):
    # a hard-edged follow-spot pool: bright core, a short soft rim
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.scale(1, ry / rx)
    g = cairo.RadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, rx)
    g.add_color_stop_rgba(0.0, 1.0, 0.93, 0.74, a)
    g.add_color_stop_rgba(0.82, 1.0, 0.88, 0.66, a * 0.85)
    g.add_color_stop_rgba(1.0, 1.0, 0.86, 0.62, 0.0)
    cr.set_source(g)
    cr.arc(0, 0, rx, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()
    cr.restore()


def _hg_post(cr, x, y_top, y_bot, wood):
    # a turned wooden post: a shaft with bulbs and collars along it
    cylinder(cr, x - 13, y_bot, 26, y_bot - y_top, wood, finish="gloss")
    for k in range(3):
        by = y_top + (y_bot - y_top) * (0.2 + 0.3 * k)
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(x, by)
        cr.scale(1, 1.6)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 22, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        solid(cr, wood, finish="gloss")
        cr.rectangle(x - 20, by - 44, 40, 8)
        solid(cr, P["brass"], finish="metal", rim=False)
        cr.rectangle(x - 20, by + 36, 40, 8)
        solid(cr, P["brass"], finish="metal", rim=False)


def _hg_face(cr, corner, ea, eb, colors, base_rgb):
    # one face of a cube: a dark body quad and 3x3 lit stickers on it
    ox, oy = corner
    cr.move_to(ox, oy)
    cr.line_to(ox + ea[0], oy + ea[1])
    cr.line_to(ox + ea[0] + eb[0], oy + ea[1] + eb[1])
    cr.line_to(ox + eb[0], oy + eb[1])
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, base_rgb, finish="gloss")
    for r_ in range(3):
        for c_ in range(3):
            a0, a1 = (c_ + 0.1) / 3, (c_ + 0.9) / 3
            b0, b1 = (r_ + 0.1) / 3, (r_ + 0.9) / 3
            pts_ = [(a0, b0), (a1, b0), (a1, b1), (a0, b1)]
            for i, (pa, pb) in enumerate(pts_):
                px = ox + ea[0] * pa + eb[0] * pb
                py = oy + ea[1] * pa + eb[1] * pb
                if i == 0:
                    cr.move_to(px, py)
                else:
                    cr.line_to(px, py)
            cr.close_path()
            solid(cr, colors[(r_ * 3 + c_) % len(colors)], finish="gloss", rim=False)


def _hg_cube(cr, cx, cy, s):
    # a solved Rubik's cube in three-quarter view: top, front, right faces
    fx, fy = cx - s * 0.55, cy - s
    front_a, front_b = (s, 0), (0, s)
    top_a, top_b = (s, 0), (s * 0.42, -s * 0.36)
    _hg_face(cr, (fx + s * 0.42, fy - s * 0.36), (0, s), (-s * 0.42, s * 0.36),
             [(242, 242, 236)], (24, 24, 28))  # placeholder, overdrawn
    _hg_face(cr, (fx + s, fy), (s * 0.42, -s * 0.36), (0, s),
             [(36, 120, 210)], (20, 20, 24))
    _hg_face(cr, (fx, fy), front_a, front_b, [(214, 46, 40)], (24, 24, 28))
    _hg_face(cr, (fx, fy), top_a, top_b, [(250, 246, 236)], (28, 28, 32))


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a giant sand hourglass
    SUBSTANCE: golden sand
    CAUSE: Data taps the brass sand valve at the hourglass neck and the sand runs out the first champion's time
    The 1982 world championship stage: red curtains, a follow-spot sweeping
    the boards, and on them a sand hourglass taller than the stage door,
    turned posts and brass collars. Data climbs the judges' stepladder up
    to its neck, taps the valve, and the sand runs for exactly the first
    winning solve; he taps it shut on that number. The lower bulb's height
    IS the time, so today's record is a mark low on the same sand and ticks
    up the side count how many of it the 1982 solve holds. Done by 0.66 and
    held; the follow-spot keeps sweeping, Data keeps working the valve, and
    the champion's solved cube sits on its mat by the camera."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    rows = sorted(by_time(rows), key=lambda r: _hg_yr(r[0]))
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    v0 = v0 or 1.0
    ratio = v0 / (v1 or 1.0)
    A0, A1 = 0.10, 0.66
    frac = seg(u, A0, A1)

    wood, wood_dk = (150, 98, 56), (110, 70, 40)

    for i in range(14):

    haze(cr, 0, 1310, (60, 26, 32), a=0.45)
    # the stage boards
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (168, 112, 66)), (1, (92, 56, 32))], 1290, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 42, 24), 0.55))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(16):

    cr.stroke()
    cr.rectangle(0, 1282, W, 16)
    solid(cr, (84, 50, 30), rim=False)

    cr.move_to(0, 0)
    cr.line_to(W, 0)
    cr.line_to(W, 150)
    for i in range(7):
        cr.curve_to(W - i * 154 - 40, 210, W - i * 154 - 114, 210, W - (i + 1) * 154, 150)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (160, 36, 44))

    # the warm wash on the hourglass

    # the hourglass: base, glass, sand, turned posts, crown
    cast_shadow(cr, CX - 230, CX + 230, 1440, length=320, a=0.32)
    contact_shadow(cr, CX, 1444, 540, a=0.45)
    box(cr, CX - 235, 1440, 470, 44, wood, depth=70, finish="gloss")

    vgrad(cr, [(0, (52, 30, 36)), (1, (84, 50, 48))], Y0, Y1, CX - HW, CX + HW)
    sand = [(0, (240, 204, 128)), (1, (176, 128, 64))]

    peak = min(36.0, 0.3 * lv + (8 if frac > 0 else 0))

    cr.restore()
    _hg_glass(cr, CX, Y0, NY, Y1, HW)
    solid(cr, (206, 228, 242), finish="glass", a=0.2)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 255, 255), 0.55))
    cr.set_line_width(7)
    cr.move_to(CX - HW + 30, Y0 + 30)
    cr.curve_to(CX - HW + 26, Y0 + 140, CX - 70, NY - 110, CX - 40, NY - 50)

    cr.stroke()
    _hg_glass(cr, CX, Y0, NY, Y1, HW)
    edge(cr, (40, 30, 34))
    _hg_post(cr, CX - 210, 760, 1400, wood_dk)

    box(cr, CX - 235, 760, 470, 44, wood, depth=70, finish="gloss")

    solid(cr, P["brass"], finish="metal", rim=False)
    for fx_ in (CX - 210, CX + 210):

    # the brass valve at the neck and its lever

    lx = hx_c + (hx_o - hx_c) * o

    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass_shade"]))
    cr.set_line_width(14)

    # THE SCALE on the sand
    sa = ease(seg(u, A1, A1 + 0.04))
    if sa > 0:

        then_mark(cr, CX - HW + 20, CX + 120, Y1 - today_h, l1, a=sa)
        times_ticks(cr, CX + HW + 70, Y1, today_h, max(1, int(ratio)), a=sa)

    for r_ in range(3):
        ry = 1400 - r_ * 52

        box(cr, LX0 + 34 * k_, ry + 6, (LX1 - LX0) - 68 * k_, 10, wood, depth=14)
    box(cr, LX0 + 20, LTOP + 6, LX1 - LX0 - 40, 18, wood, depth=26)

    # right by the camera: the judges' table, the champion's solved cube on its mat
    contact_shadow(cr, 820, 1830, 520, a=0.4)
    box(cr, 560, 1890, 450, 70, (124, 80, 48), depth=70, finish="gloss")
    cr.move_to(640, 1820)
    cr.line_to(960, 1820)
    cr.line_to(1000, 1790)
    cr.line_to(690, 1790)

    solid(cr, (40, 120, 82), rim=False)
    contact_shadow(cr, 820, 1812, 220, a=0.5)
    _hg_cube(cr, 820, 1810, 150)
    for i in range(4):
        fx = 70 + i * 140

        disc(cr, fx, 1890, 24, (255, 222, 150), finish="gloss")

segments.illustrated_scene:
# scene standard: 2026-10-16.2
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a giant Rubik's cube monument
    SUBSTANCE: the cube's coloured stickers
    CAUSE: Data grips the cube's top layer with both hands and twists it, each twist solving more faces as the record falls
    A Rubik's cube as tall as a house stands on a stone plinth in a town
    square at sunset, terraced houses and bunting behind it, scrambled
    hand-sized cubes left on the cobbles by the camera. Data stands on a
    tall crate pressed against it, both hands on the top layer's front
    edge, and twists it. Each twist is one record, and it solves more of
    the cube, because a faster time is a better-solved cube. The twist
    runs out and back at an even speed and then holds, so it never
    stutters. The readout holds 1982 from the first frame until a later
    record has landed, then one between, then the latest. Once the cube is
    solved he keeps twisting the top layer, but the cube does not change
    any more. The ratio to 1982 is the scale."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    n = len(rows)
    v0 = rows[0][1] or 1.0
    vmin = min(v for _, v in rows)
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.56
    span = (a1 - a0) / max(1, n)
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    land = ease(seg(f, 0.1, 0.7))
    prev = rows[k - 1][1] if k > 0 else v0
    cur = v0 if u < a0 else prev + (rows[k][1] - prev) * land
    sol = clamp((v0 - cur) / max(0.01, v0 - vmin))

    def tri(r):
        # out and back at one even speed: no slow-down at the turn
        return 1.0 - abs(2.0 * r - 1.0)

    # the twist: the top layer swings out and back on every strike, then holds
    if u < a0:
        r, beat = 0.0, 0
    elif u < a1:
        r, beat = seg(f, 0.1, 0.7), k
    else:
        q = (u - a1) / 0.16
        r, beat = seg(q % 1.0, 0.0, 0.5), n + int(q)
    sh = -46 * tri(r) if 0.0 < r < 1.0 else 0.0

    gy = landscape(cr, t, "town")

    # the square: a terrace of houses across the back, bunting strung over it
    FAR = [(-60, 200, 330, (196, 150, 118)), (200, 430, 300, (170, 112, 92)),
           (430, 690, 360, (206, 176, 140)), (690, 900, 280, (150, 120, 110)),
           (900, 1140, 340, (190, 138, 104))]
    for x0_, x1_, hh, rgb in FAR:
        bb = building(cr, x0_, x1_, gy, hh, rgb, roof="flat", depth=24, boards=False)
        for wy in range(2):
            for wx in range(3):
                ww = (x1_ - x0_) / 3
                cx_ = x0_ + ww * wx + ww * 0.3
                cy_ = bb["top"] + 50 + wy * 120
                cr.rectangle(cx_, cy_, ww * 0.4, 70)
                cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((250, 214, 150) if (wx + wy) % 2 else (70, 64, 70)))
                cr.fill()
    haze(cr, 700, gy + 10, (236, 200, 160), a=0.45)
    birds(cr, t, y0=760, n=4, rgb=(60, 56, 66))
    BUNT = [(200, 40, 40), (250, 204, 30), (30, 84, 196), (30, 154, 72), (244, 124, 24)]
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 50, 50)))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    cr.move_to(0, 800)
    cr.curve_to(300, 880, 760, 880, W, 790)
    cr.stroke()
    for i in range(14):
        bx = 30 + i * 76
        s_ = bx / W
        by = (1 - s_) ** 3 * 800 + 3 * (1 - s_) ** 2 * s_ * 880 + 3 * (1 - s_) * s_ ** 2 * 880 + s_ ** 3 * 790
        cr.move_to(bx - 18, by)
        cr.line_to(bx + 18, by)
        cr.line_to(bx, by + 40)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, BUNT[i % 5], rim=False)

    X0, X1, Y0, Y1 = 300.0, 780.0, 920.0, 1400.0
    DX, DY = 130.0, -90.0
    C = (X1 - X0) / 3
    FACE = [(200, 40, 40), (242, 242, 236), (30, 84, 196)]   # front, top, side
    MIX = [(250, 204, 30), (244, 124, 24), (30, 154, 72), (200, 40, 40),
           (30, 84, 196), (242, 242, 236)]

    def col(face, i):
        thr = ((i * 0.6180339 + face * 0.31) % 1.0) * 0.92 + 0.04
        if sol >= thr:
            return FACE[face]
        return MIX[(i * 5 + face * 3 + 1) % 6]

    def quad(p):
        cr.move_to(*p[0])
        for q_ in p[1:]:
            cr.line_to(*q_)
        cr.close_path()

    # the stone plinth the monument and the crate stand on
    cast_shadow(cr, 150, X1 + DX + 40, 1440, length=380, a=0.32)
    contact_shadow(cr, 560, 1444, 900, a=0.45)
    box(cr, 140, 1440, 760, 40, (186, 178, 166), depth=150)
    contact_shadow(cr, (X0 + X1 + DX) / 2, Y1 + 4, X1 - X0 + DX + 40, a=0.5)

    def body(x0, y0, y1, ofs, rows_idx):
        x1 = x0 + (X1 - X0)
        quad([(x0, y0), (x1, y0), (x1, y1), (x0, y1)])
        solid(cr, (24, 24, 28), finish="gloss")
        quad([(x1, y0), (x1 + DX, y0 + DY), (x1 + DX, y1 + DY), (x1, y1)])
        solid(cr, (16, 16, 20), finish="gloss")
        for ri in rows_idx:
            for c in range(3):
                i = ri * 3 + c
                quad([(x0 + c * C + 10, y0 + (ri - rows_idx[0]) * C + 10),
                      (x0 + (c + 1) * C - 10, y0 + (ri - rows_idx[0]) * C + 10),

# scene standard: 2026-10-16.2
def _rc_quad(cr, o, uv, vv, a0, a1, b0, b1):
    pts_ = [(a0, b0), (a1, b0), (a1, b1), (a0, b1)]
    cr.new_path()
    for i, (a, b) in enumerate(pts_):
        px = o[0] + a * uv[0] + b * vv[0]
        py = o[1] + a * uv[1] + b * vv[1]
        if i == 0:
            cr.move_to(px, py)
        else:
            cr.line_to(px, py)
    cr.close_path()


def _rc_face(cr, o, uv, vv, cols, rows_, body=(22, 22, 26), gap=0.09, pops=None):
    """One face of a cube: the black plastic, then its lit stickers, rows `rows_`.
    `pops` (optional, per sticker 0..1) flashes a sticker white as it flips."""
    r0, r1 = rows_[0], rows_[-1] + 1
    _rc_quad(cr, o, uv, vv, 0, 1, r0 / 3.0, r1 / 3.0)
    solid(cr, body, finish="gloss", rim=False)
    for i in rows_:
        for j in range(3):
            _rc_quad(cr, o, uv, vv, (j + gap) / 3, (j + 1 - gap) / 3,
                     (i + gap) / 3, (i + 1 - gap) / 3)
            solid(cr, cols[i * 3 + j], finish="gloss", rim=False)
            if pops is not None and 0 < pops[i * 3 + j] < 1:
                _rc_quad(cr, o, uv, vv, (j + gap) / 3, (j + 1 - gap) / 3,
                         (i + gap) / 3, (i + 1 - gap) / 3)
                cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 255, 250), 0.8 * math.sin(math.pi * pops[i * 3 + j])))
                cr.fill()


def _rcube(cr, x, y, w, ox, oy, front, top, side, shift=0.0):
    """A small Rubik's cube in three-quarter view, front face bottom-left at
    (x, y), its top layer slid `shift` px sideways as it turns."""
    _rc_face(cr, (x, y - w), (w, 0), (0, w), front, [1, 2])
    _rc_face(cr, (x + w, y - w), (ox, oy), (0, w), side, [1, 2])
    if abs(shift) > 0.5:
        _rc_quad(cr, (x + ox, y - w * 2 / 3.0 + oy), (w, 0), (-ox, -oy), 0, 1, 0, 1)
        solid(cr, (14, 14, 18), rim=False)
    sx = x + shift
    _rc_face(cr, (sx + ox, y - w + oy), (w, 0), (-ox, -oy), top, [0, 1, 2])
    _rc_face(cr, (sx, y - w), (w, 0), (0, w), front, [0])
    _rc_face(cr, (sx + w, y - w), (ox, oy), (0, w), side, [0])


def _rc_corners(cx, base, w, ang, ky=0.35):
    R = w / math.sqrt(2.0)
    out = []
    for k in range(4):
        a = ang + math.pi / 4 + k * math.pi / 2
        out.append((cx + R * math.cos(a), base + R * math.sin(a) * ky))
    return out


def _rc_sides(cr, cs, ang, w, faces, rows_, pops):
    for k in range(4):
        nrm = ang + math.pi / 2 + k * math.pi / 2
        if math.sin(nrm) <= 0.02:
            continue
        c0, c1 = cs[k], cs[(k + 1) % 4]
        _rc_face(cr, (c0[0], c0[1] - w), (c1[0] - c0[0], c1[1] - c0[1]), (0, w),
                 faces[k], rows_, gap=0.06, pops=pops[k])


def _rc_turning_cube(cr, cx, base, w, ang, phi, faces, top, pops, top_pops):
    """A Rubik's cube that really turns: the two lower layers at `ang`, the top
    layer at `ang + phi` about the vertical axis."""
    lo = _rc_corners(cx, base, w, ang)
    _rc_sides(cr, lo, ang, w, faces, [1, 2], pops)
    if abs(phi) > 0.01:            # the dark core shows under the turning layer
        c = [(x, y - w * 2 / 3.0) for x, y in lo]
        cr.new_path()
        cr.move_to(*c[0])
        for p_ in c[1:]:
            cr.line_to(*p_)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (14, 14, 18), rim=False)
    hi = _rc_corners(cx, base, w, ang + phi)
    _rc_sides(cr, hi, ang + phi, w, faces, [0], pops)
    t0, t1, t3 = hi[0], hi[1], hi[3]
    _rc_face(cr, (t0[0], t0[1] - w), (t1[0] - t0[0], t1[1] - t0[1]),
             (t3[0] - t0[0], t3[1] - t0[1]), top, [0, 1, 2], gap=0.06, pops=top_pops)


def _rc_limb(cr, x0, y0, x1, y1, wd, rgb):
    ang = math.atan2(y1 - y0, x1 - x0)
    L = math.hypot(x1 - x0, y1 - y0)
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x0, y0)
    cr.rotate(ang)
    cr.new_path()
    cr.arc(0, 0, wd / 2, math.pi / 2, 3 * math.pi / 2)
    cr.arc(L, 0, wd / 2, -math.pi / 2, math.pi / 2)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, rgb, finish="metal")


def _rc_seam(cr, x0, y0, x1, y1, wd):
    """The panel seam and bolt heads down a robot limb, so it reads machined."""
    ang = math.atan2(y1 - y0, x1 - x0)
    L = math.hypot(x1 - x0, y1 - y0)
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x0, y0)
    cr.rotate(ang)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((20, 40, 60), 0.55))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    cr.move_to(wd * 0.6, -wd * 0.18)
    cr.line_to(L - wd * 0.6, -wd * 0.18)
    cr.stroke()
    for f in (0.3, 0.7):
        cr.arc(L * f, wd * 0.16, 4, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 44, 52)))
        cr.fill()
    cr.restore()


def _rc_elbow(S, vx, vy, a_, hh):
    e1 = (S[0] + vx * a_ - vy * hh, S[1] + vy * a_ + vx * hh)
    e2 = (S[0] + vx * a_ + vy * hh, S[1] + vy * a_ - vx * hh)
    return e1 if e1[1] < e2[1] else e2


_RC_COLS = [(242, 242, 236), (250, 208, 40), (204, 40, 42), (242, 128, 30),
            (34, 92, 204), (30, 160, 72)]


def _rc_scramble(seed):
    return [_RC_COLS[(k * 7 + seed * 5 + k * k * 3) % 6] for k in range(9)]

def _rc_quad(cr, o, a, b, ca, cb, g=0.09):
    h = (0.5 - g) / 3
    pts_ = []
    for da, db in ((-h, -h), (h, -h), (h, h), (-h, h)):
        pa, pb = ca + da, cb + db
        pts_.append((o[0] + a[0] * pa + b[0] * pb, o[1] + a[1] * pa + b[1] * pb))
    cr.move_to(*pts_[0])

    cr.close_path()


def _rc_face_path(cr, o, a, b):
    cr.move_to(*o)
    cr.line_to(o[0] + a[0], o[1] + a[1])
    cr.line_to(o[0] + a[0] + b[0], o[1] + a[1] + b[1])
    cr.line_to(o[0] + b[0], o[1] + b[1])
    cr.close_path()


_RC_COLS = [(240, 240, 234), (250, 204, 40), (206, 40, 40), (244, 124, 32),
            (30, 90, 200), (40, 160, 80)]
_RC_RING = (2, 4, 3, 5)          # round a layer: red, blue, orange, green


def _rc_faces(x, y, s):
    dx, dy = 0.4 * s, -0.26 * s
    front = ((x, y - s), (s, 0), (0, s))
    top = ((x + dx, y - s + dy), (s, 0), (-dx, -dy))
    right = ((x + s, y - s), (dx, dy), (0, s))
    return (top, front, right), dx, dy


def _rc_body(cr, x, y, s):
    (top, front, right), dx, dy = _rc_faces(x, y, s)
    for o, a, b in (right, top, front):
        _rc_face_path(cr, o, a, b)
        solid(cr, (26, 26, 30), finish="gloss")


def _rc_outline(cr, x, y, s):
    dx, dy = 0.4 * s, -0.26 * s
    cr.move_to(x, y)
    cr.line_to(x, y - s)
    cr.line_to(x + dx, y - s + dy)
    cr.line_to(x + s + dx, y - s + dy)
    cr.line_to(x + s + dx, y + dy)
    cr.line_to(x + s, y)
    cr.close_path()


def _rc_scrambled(cr, x, y, s, seed):
    _rc_body(cr, x, y, s)
    faces, _, _ = _rc_faces(x, y, s)
    for fi, (o, a, b) in enumerate(faces):
        for i in range(3):
            for j in range(3):
                _rc_quad(cr, o, a, b, (i + 0.5) / 3, (j + 0.5) / 3)
                solid(cr, _RC_COLS[(i * 5 + j * 3 + fi * 7 + seed) % 6], finish="gloss",
                      rim=False)


def _rc_spinning(cr, x, y, s, offs):
    """A cube whose three layers are each turned offs[j] quarter turns."""
    _rc_body(cr, x, y, s)
    (top, front, right), _, _ = _rc_faces(x, y, s)
    o, a, b = top
    for i in range(3):
        for j in range(3):
            _rc_quad(cr, o, a, b, (i + 0.5) / 3, (j + 0.5) / 3)
            solid(cr, _RC_COLS[0], finish="gloss", rim=False)
    for face, shift in ((front, 0), (right, 3)):
        o, a, b = face
        cr.save()
        _rc_face_path(cr, o, a, b)
        cr.clip()
        for j in range(3):
            for m in range(12):
                pos = (m - 3 * offs[j]) % 12
                if pos > 11:
                    pos -= 12
                q = pos - shift
                if -1 < q < 3:

                    solid(cr, _RC_COLS[_RC_RING[m // 3]], finish="gloss", rim=False)
        cr.restore()

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a giant tear-off calendar
    SUBSTANCE: calendar pages
    CAUSE: Data tears the pages off and tosses them away until it reads 70 days, then he stamps it booked
    In an airport terminal, a plane at the gate through the glass, stands a
    giant tear-off countdown calendar to the flight: its block of pages is
    the days left, page edges coloured on its side — the good-price window
    (earliest good price down to the last good price) in the accent, the
    last stretch before take-off red. It starts at the earliest good price;
    Data, standing at the calendar's left edge, tears pages off and tosses
    them to the floor, following the front face back as the block thins,
    until the front page reads the average sweet spot; then he steps in and
    stamps it BOOKED low on the page beside him — still well inside the
    window, the red tail behind it. Done by 0.50 and held; trolleys keep
    rolling past the camera, a carry-on waits by the lens."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    vals = sorted(v for _, v in rows)
    early, late = vals[-1], vals[0]
    sweet = next((v for l, v in rows if "sweet" in l.lower()), vals[len(vals) // 2])
    early = early or 1.0
    acc = P["accent2"]
    RED = (196, 64, 52)

    BX, BY = 470.0, 1240.0
    FW, FH = 430.0, 590.0
    K = 430.0 / early

    def at(dd):
        return BX - 0.62 * K * dd, BY + 0.42 * K * dd

    n = 6
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.50
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    rip = ease(seg(f, 0.3, 0.6))
    fly = seg(f, 0.3, 0.9)
    per = (early - sweet) / n
    if u < a0:
        d = early
        torn = 0
    elif u < a1:
        d = early - per * (k + rip)
        torn = k + (1 if fly >= 1 else 0)
    else:
        d = sweet
        torn = n
    fx, fy = at(d)
    num = None
    if u < a0 + span * 0.3:
        num = early
    elif u >= a1:
        num = sweet

    cr.rectangle(0, 1136, W, 22)

        box(cr, sx_, 1196, 48, 14, (60, 64, 76), depth=12, finish="metal")
        box(cr, sx_, 1182, 48, 40, (56, 86, 140), depth=12, finish="gloss")

    # the calendar's stand, behind the block of pages

    contact_shadow(cr, (fx + BX + FW) / 2, (fy + BY) / 2 + 10, FW + 300, a=0.35)
    box(cr, BX - 24, BY + 8, FW + 48, FH + 100, (66, 70, 84), depth=26, finish="gloss")

    # the block of pages: its side is the days left, coloured by price window
    bands = [(0.0, min(late, d), RED), (late, min(early, d), acc)]
    for d0, d1, col in bands:
        if d1 - d0 < 0.2:

        ax, ay = at(d0)

    cr.stroke()

    # the front page: red header, binding rings, the plane, the day count
    cr.rectangle(fx, fy - FH, FW, FH)
    solid(cr, (246, 244, 238))
    cr.rectangle(fx, fy - FH, FW, 84)

    if num is not None:
        text(cr, f"{int(round(num))}", fx + FW / 2 + 40, fy - FH + 430, 190, (36, 38, 46),
             face="display", anchor="center", shadow=False)
    sa = ease(seg(u, a1 + 0.035, a1 + 0.05))
    if sa <= 0:
        text(cr, "DAYS TO GO", fx + FW / 2 + 40, fy - FH + 500, 36, (110, 112, 120),
             face="bold", anchor="center", shadow=False)

    # the torn pages, lying where they fell by the camera
    spots = [(170, 1650, 0.35), (420, 1730, -0.45), (680, 1640, 0.55),
             (560, 1860, -0.25), (230, 1860, 0.2), (430, 1580, -0.6)]
    for j in range(min(torn, n)):
        lx, ly, la = spots[j]
        _tc_sheet(cr, lx, ly, 0.5, 0.35, la, FW, FH)
    # the page in flight, from the block to the floor
    if a0 <= u < a1 and 0 < fly < 1:
        lx, ly, la = spots[k]
        p = ease(fly)
        sx0, sy0 = fx + FW / 2 + per * K * 0.62 * (1 - rip), fy - FH / 2
        x = sx0 + (lx - sx0) * p
        y = sy0 + (ly - sy0) * p - 160 * math.sin(math.pi * p)
        _tc_sheet(cr, x, y, 1 - 0.5 * p, 1 - 0.65 * p, la * p + 0.6 * math.sin(math.pi * p),
                  FW, FH)

    # right by the camera: a carry-on waiting, trolleys rolling through
    _tc_suitcase(cr, 860, 1840, 1.25, (52, 84, 140))
    for j in range(2):
        _tc_cart(cr, 1350 - ((t * 200 + j * 900) % 1800), 1885, 1.7)
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # he stands at the calendar's left edge, clear of the page's number,
    # follows the front face back as it thins, then steps in to stamp it
    step = ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.03))
    hx = fx - 70 + 50 * step
    hy = min(1500.0, fy + 40)
    if u < a0:
        host("point", hx, hy, 240)
    elif u < a1:
        host("toss", hx, hy, 240, beat=k)
    else:
        host("stamp", hx, hy, 240, beat=int((u - a1) / 0.11))

    # the BOOKED stamp, drawn after him, low on the page beside his hand
    if sa > 0:
        sx, sy = fx + 170, fy - 90
        sc = 0.8 + 0.2 * pop(sa)
        cr.save()

             anchor="center", alpha=0.9 * sa, shadow=False)

    if u < a1:

                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

def _tag(cr, cx, base, w, h):

    # tapering to the blunt point that carries the string hole
    x0, x1 = cx - w / 2, cx + w / 2

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a giant inflatable plane-fare price tag
    SUBSTANCE: the swelling price tag
    CAUSE: Data pumps a bellows into the price tag and it swells taller with every pump
    On the apron in front of a parked jet stands the fare: a giant
    inflatable price tag. At the best booking day it is one tag tall (kept
    as a dashed ghost, 1x up the side); miss that day and, pump by pump,
    Data blows the price up to the final two weeks' fare, nearly twice as
    tall, the jump above the old price in the accent. Done by 0.60 and
    held; Data keeps pumping, the apron tug keeps crossing."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    lo_l, lo = min(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    hi_l, hi = max(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    lo = lo or 1.0
    pct = int(round((hi / lo - 1) * 100))

    n = 4
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.60
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    grow = ease(seg(f, 0.25, 0.75))           # swells on the push, then holds
    step = 0.0 if u < a0 else (k + grow) / n
    val = lo + (hi - lo) * step
    done = u >= a0 and k == n - 1 and grow >= 0.999

    BASE = 1440
    CX = 590
    H0, W0 = 380.0, 380.0
    h = H0 * val / lo
    w = W0 * math.sqrt(val / lo)

def _proj(lat, lon, lat0, lon0, cx, cy, R, lift=1.0):
    """Orthographic projection onto the globe: screen x, y, and whether the
    point faces us (c > 0), plus the unit-disc x, y."""
    p = math.radians(lat)
    l = math.radians(lon - lon0)
    p0 = math.radians(lat0)
    x = math.cos(p) * math.sin(l)
    y = math.cos(p0) * math.sin(p) - math.sin(p0) * math.cos(p) * math.cos(l)
    c = math.sin(p0) * math.sin(p) + math.cos(p0) * math.cos(p) * math.cos(l)
    return cx + R * lift * x, cy - R * lift * y, c, x, y


def _gc(a, b, s):
    """The point a share `s` of the way along the great circle from a to b."""
    def vec(lat, lon):
        p, l = math.radians(lat), math.radians(lon)
        return (math.cos(p) * math.cos(l), math.cos(p) * math.sin(l), math.sin(p))
    va, vb = vec(*a), vec(*b)
    d = clamp(sum(i * j for i, j in zip(va, vb)), -1.0, 1.0)
    om = math.acos(d) or 1e-6
    ka = math.sin((1 - s) * om) / math.sin(om)
    kb = math.sin(s * om) / math.sin(om)
    v = [ka * i + kb * j for i, j in zip(va, vb)]
    return math.degrees(math.asin(clamp(v[2], -1, 1))), math.degrees(math.atan2(v[1], v[0]))

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a giant world globe on a stand
    SUBSTANCE: a jet's flight route
    CAUSE: Data cranks the globe round by its handle, and the flight route stretches across the Atlantic to Europe
    In front of the airport stands a giant globe with America facing us.
    A domestic trip is a short hop inside America, 70 days ahead, drawn
    first and kept as a dashed ghost with its end pinned. Data walks to the
    big drive wheel at the globe's foot and, crank by crank, swings the
    whole globe round a quarter turn: America slides away left, the ocean
    sweeps across, and Europe with its tower rolls into view, while the
    thick accent route pushes on all the way across to it, a bead for every
    week booked ahead, until it is 276 days. One number; the picture shows
    how much further ahead a far trip is planned. Done by 0.64 and held:
    Data keeps cranking, each turn sending another jet down the route."""
    vals = {str(l).lower(): float(v) for l, v in pts}
    v_dom = vals.get("domestic", min(vals.values())) or 1.0
    v_eu = vals.get("europe", max(vals.values())) or 1.0

    n = 4
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.64
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    roll = ease(seg(f, 0.2, 0.85))           # turns on the crank stroke, then holds
    step = 0.0 if u < a0 else (k + roll) / n
    done = u >= a0 and k == n - 1 and roll >= 0.999
    dom_frac = clamp(v_dom / v_eu, 0.05, 0.95)
    frac = dom_frac + (1.0 - dom_frac) * step

    CX, CY, R = 500, 990, 380
    LAT0 = 34
    lon0 = -100 + 62 * step                   # a quarter turn: America out, Europe in
    HOME, EU = (41.9, -87.6), (48.9, 2.35)
    LIFT = 0.24

    loop = 0.0
    launches = 0
    if done:
        lt = (u - a1) * 7.0
        launches = int(lt)
        loop = lt - launches

    landscape(cr, t, "coast")
    building(cr, 30, 420, 1190, 110, (200, 204, 212), roof="flat", boards=False)
    cylinder(cr, 940, 1190, 40, 170, (210, 212, 218), finish="metal")
    box(cr, 920, 1020, 80, 44, (60, 90, 120), depth=18, finish="glass")
    haze(cr, 700, 1200, (214, 222, 230), a=0.4)
    jx = -320 + ((t * 170) % 1800)
    _sky_jet(cr, jx, 1100 - 0.24 * (jx + 320), 1.2)
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (152, 152, 148)), (1, (110, 110, 108))], 1240, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((232, 196, 60)))
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    cr.move_to(0, 1510)
    cr.line_to(W, 1495)
    cr.stroke()

    # the stand: a turned brass base and post
    cast_shadow(cr, CX - 170, CX + 470, 1450, length=320, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, CX + 140, 1452, 720, a=0.45)
    cylinder(cr, CX - 160, 1450, 320, 46, (150, 110, 60), finish="metal")
    cylinder(cr, CX - 110, 1408, 220, 22, (176, 132, 70), finish="metal")
    cylinder(cr, CX - 20, 1390, 40, 1390 - (CY + R + 10), (176, 132, 70), finish="metal")

    # the drive: a gearbox at the globe's foot, a big wheel on its face
    # right where Data's hand lands, a shaft running into the stand
    GX, GY = 905, 1352
    ga = step * n * 2 * math.pi + (launches + ease(seg(loop, 0.0, 0.4))) * math.pi
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 46, 32)))
    cr.set_line_width(22)
    cr.move_to(GX, GY + 20)
    cr.line_to(CX + 30, 1400)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((200, 160, 96)))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    cr.move_to(GX, GY + 14)
    cr.line_to(CX + 30, 1394)
    cr.stroke()
    box(cr, 900, 1450, 120, 150, (96, 70, 46), depth=34, finish="metal")
    _gear(cr, GX, GY, 76, ga, (210, 166, 90))

    # the globe
    disc(cr, CX, CY, R, (46, 104, 168), finish="gloss")
    cr.save()
    cr.arc(CX, CY, R - 2, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.clip()
    cr.set_source_rgba(1, 1, 1, 0.16)
    cr.set_line_width(2.5)
    for lo in range(-180, 180, 30):
        started = False
        for la in range(-90, 91, 6):
            X, Y, c, _, _ = _proj(la, lo, LAT0, lon0, CX, CY, R)
            if c > 0:
                (cr.line_to if started else cr.move_to)(X, Y)
                started = True
            else:
                started = False
        cr.stroke()
    for la in range(-60, 61, 30):
        started = False
        for lo in range(-180, 181, 6):
            X, Y, c, _, _ = _proj(la, lo, LAT0, lon0, CX, CY, R)
            if c > 0:
                (cr.line_to if started else cr.move_to)(X, Y)
                started = True
            else:
                started = False
        cr.stroke()
    for poly in _LANDS:
        if not any(_proj(la, lo, LAT0, lon0, CX, CY, R)[2] > 0 for la, lo in poly):
            continue
        first = True
        for la, lo in poly:
            X, Y, c, x, y = _proj(la, lo, LAT0, lon0, CX, CY, R)
            if c < 0:
                nrm = math.hypot(x, y) or 1.0
                X, Y = CX + R * x / nrm, CY - R * y / nrm
            if first:
                cr.move_to(X, Y)
                first = False
            else:
                cr.line_to(X, Y)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (104, 156, 86), edge=False)
    g = cairo.RadialGradient(CX - 0.38 * R, CY - 0.42 * R, 0.1 * R, CX, CY, R * 1.04)
    g.add_color_stop_rgba(0, 1, 1, 1, 0.28)
    g.add_color_stop_rgba(0.55, 0, 0, 0, 0.0)
    g.add_color_stop_rgba(1, 0, 0, 0, 0.5)
    cr.set_source(g)
    cr.paint()
    cr.restore()
    cr.arc(CX, CY, R, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    edge(cr, (30, 40, 60), width=5)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 108, 56)))
    cr.set_line_width(24)
    cr.arc(CX, CY, R + 26, math.pi / 2, 3 * math.pi / 2)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 204, 140), 0.85))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    cr.arc(CX, CY, R + 32, math.pi * 0.9, math.pi * 1.4)
    cr.stroke()
    for py in (CY - R - 26, CY + R + 26):
        disc(cr, CX, py, 18, (196, 150, 82), finish="metal")

    def at(s):
        la, lo = _gc(HOME, EU, s)
        return _proj(la, lo, LAT0, lon0, CX, CY, R,
                     lift=1.0 + LIFT * math.sin(math.pi * s))

    def route(s0, s1, m=48):
        out = []
        for i in range(m + 1):
            X, Y, c, _, _ = at(s0 + (s1 - s0) * i / m)
            out.append((X, Y, c))
        return out

    def stroke_route(p, rgb, w):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(rgb))
        cr.set_line_width(w)
        cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
        started = False
        for X, Y, c in p:
            if c > -0.05:
                if started:
                    cr.line_to(X, Y)
                else:
                    cr.move_to(X, Y)
                    started = True
            else:
                started = False
        cr.stroke()

    # Europe's landmark stands on Paris, rolling into view as the globe turns
    ex, ey, ec, _, _ = _proj(EU[0], EU[1], LAT0, lon0, CX, CY, R)
    if ec > 0.08:
        _tower(cr, ex, ey, 2.0)

    hx0, hy0, _, _, _ = _proj(HOME[0], HOME[1], LAT0, lon0, CX, CY, R)
    dom = route(0.0, dom_frac, 20)
    stroke_route(dom, (24, 26, 34), 44)
    stroke_route(dom, (244, 238, 226), 30)
    if frac > dom_frac + 0.005:
        ext = route(dom_frac, frac)
        stroke_route(ext, (24, 26, 34), 44)
        stroke_route(ext, P["accent2"], 30)
    # the route is measured in planning: one bead for every week booked ahead
    weeks = int(frac * v_eu // 7)
    for w_ in range(1, weeks + 1):
        X, Y, c, _, _ = at(7.0 * w_ / v_eu)
        if c > 0:
            cr.arc(X, Y, 6, 0, 2 * math.pi)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((24, 26, 34)))
            cr.fill()
    disc(cr, hx0, hy0, 22, (244, 238, 226), finish="gloss")
    # THE SCALE on the route: the domestic hop stays as a dashed ghost with
    # its end pinned, so the long accent push past it is the difference
    if step > 0.02:
        started = False
        for X, Y, c in dom:
            if c > 0:
                if started:
                    cr.line_to(X, Y + 48)
                else:
                    cr.move_to(X, Y + 48)
                    started = True
        ghost(cr, a=0.9)
    dx_, dy_, dc_, _, _ = at(dom_frac)
    if dc_ > 0:
        disc(cr, dx_, dy_, 18, (244, 238, 226), finish="gloss")
        text(cr, "Domestic", dx_, dy_ + 92, 40, look.INK, face="bold", anchor="center")
    if done and ec > 0:
        disc(cr, ex, ey + 4, 18, P["accent2"], finish="gloss")
        text(cr, "Europe", ex, ey + 66, 44, look.INK, face="bold", anchor="center",
             alpha=ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.05)))

    # the jet: at the tip of the route as it stretches, then each crank sends one down it
    js = frac if not done else max(0.02, frac * ease(loop))
    p1 = route(max(0.0, js - 0.02), js, 2)
    (xa, ya, _), (xb, yb, cb) = p1[0], p1[-1]
    if cb > 0:
        glow(cr, xb, yb, 80, P["accent2"], 0.45)
        _top_jet(cr, xb, yb, math.atan2(yb - ya, xb - xa), 2.4)

    _suitcase(cr, 50, 1880, 250, 300, (52, 84, 136))
    _passport(cr, 800, 1770, 1.25)
    foreground(cr, "town")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data walks from the globe's base to the drive wheel and turns it, the whole beat
    hx = 665 + 175 * ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.08))
    hy = 1450
    if u < a0:
        host("point", hx, hy, 236)
    elif not done:
        host("crank", hx, hy, 236, beat=k)
    else:
        host("crank", hx, hy, 236, beat=n + launches)

    if done:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v_eu))} days", "ahead · Europe's sweet spot to book",
                    80, 520, size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v_dom))} days", "ahead · a domestic flight",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):

    CAUSE: Data hauls the ticket out of the check-in machine hand over hand and it comes out nearly twice as long
    THE HOOK: the same seat, nearly twice the ticket. From the first frame
    Data is already hauling a huge boarding pass out of a check-in machine,

stories.hook: The car industry put all its eggs in one basket, and the basket broke.

segments.say: One company makes 90 percent of the world's most advanced chips. Everyone else shares the last tenth, so one stumble hits everybody.
segments.illustrated_scene:
# scene standard: 2026-10-22
def _wf_xy(a, b, cy=1150.0):
    return 540.0 + a * 500.0, cy + b * 270.0


def _wf_oval(cr, cx, cy, rx, ry):
    cr.save()
