def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a festival crowd seen from behind
    SUBSTANCE: red-haired heads in the crowd
    CAUSE: Data grips a big stage spotlight and aims its beam across the crowd, lighting up who has red hair
    One crowd of 100 at an evening festival is the WHOLE; the low sun is
    behind the stage, so from the back the crowd sits in shadow. For each
    place (its flag on the big screen) Data rolls his spotlight along the
    back of the crowd and runs the beam across it; where it passes, hair
    shows its true colour, and then the floodlights come up on everyone:
    that place's share of the 100 heads is copper red. Two in the world,
    then ten in Ireland, then thirteen in Scotland. Done by 0.62 and held:
    the Scottish crowd stays lit, swaying, Data still working the spot."""
    rows = sorted([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts], key=lambda r: r[1])
    n = len(rows)
    a0, a1 = 0.05, 0.62
    wts = [1.4 if i in (0, n - 1) else 1.0 for i in range(n)]
    tot = sum(wts)
    starts, acc = [], a0
    for w_ in wts:
        starts.append(acc)
        acc += (a1 - a0) * w_ / tot
    if u < a0:
        k, f = 0, 0.0
    elif u >= a1:
        k, f = n - 1, 1.0
    else:
        k = max(i for i in range(n) if starts[i] <= u)
        end = starts[k + 1] if k + 1 < n else a1
        f = clamp((u - starts[k]) / (end - starts[k]))
    # each place: the lights go down (not the first), the beam runs across, floods up
    swap = k > 0 and f < 0.1
    sweep = ease(seg(f, 0.1, 0.6)) if u >= a0 else 0.0
    full = ease(seg(f, 0.6, 0.78)) if u >= a0 else 0.0
    if swap:
        full = 1.0 - ease(seg(f, 0.0, 0.1))
    pk = k - 1 if swap else k
    place = rows[pk]
    landed_i = k if (full >= 0.999 and f >= 0.78) else k - 1
    if u < a0:
        landed_i = -1

    reds = [int(v + 0.5) for _, v in rows]
    after = max(0.0, u - a1)

    # the field at dusk, the sun going down behind the stage
    landscape(cr, t, "field", horizon=980)
    cr.rectangle(0, 0, W, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 24, 60), 0.42))
    cr.fill()
    glow(cr, 540, 700, 520, (255, 170, 90), 0.35)
    # the stage: two towers, a roof truss, the big screen with the flag
    SX0, SX1, SY0, SY1, DECK = 250, 830, 650, 880, 930
    cast_shadow(cr, SX0 - 60, SX1 + 60, DECK + 10, length=120, a=0.25)
    box(cr, SX0 - 110, DECK + 20, SX1 - SX0 + 220, 40, (58, 56, 66), depth=60)
    for tx_ in (SX0 - 90, SX1 + 30):
        box(cr, tx_, DECK, 60, 330, (74, 76, 86), depth=26, finish="metal")
    box(cr, SX0 - 90, 620, SX1 - SX0 + 180, 34, (84, 86, 96), depth=30, finish="metal")
    for j in range(6):                       # stage lights pulsing on the truss
        lx = SX0 - 40 + j * (SX1 - SX0 + 80) / 5
        col = [(255, 90, 120), (120, 160, 255), (255, 210, 120)][j % 3]
        glow(cr, lx, 600, 70, col, 0.5 + 0.4 * math.sin(t * 3 + j * 1.3))
        disc(cr, lx, 600, 14, col, finish="gloss")
    cr.rectangle(SX0 - 14, SY0 - 14, SX1 - SX0 + 28, SY1 - SY0 + 28)
    solid(cr, (30, 30, 36), finish="gloss")
    _rc_flag(cr, place[0], SX0, SY0, SX1 - SX0, SY1 - SY0)
    if k > 0 and f < 0.16:                   # the screen blinks over to the next flag
        cr.rectangle(SX0, SY0, SX1 - SX0, SY1 - SY0)
        cr.set_source_rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75 * clamp(1 - abs(f - 0.1) / 0.06))
        cr.fill()
    haze(cr, 560, 960, (70, 60, 90), a=0.25)

    # the crowd: in shadow, then lit where the beam is and when the floods come up
    people = _rc_crowd(t)
    order = _rc_red_order(people)
    redset = set(order[:reds[pk]])
    for (x, y, r, i, q) in people:
        _rc_person(cr, x, y, r, i, i in redset, 0.34)
    cr.push_group()
    for (x, y, r, i, q) in people:
        _rc_person(cr, x, y, r, i, i in redset, 1.0)
    lit = cr.pop_group()

    # Data rolls the spotlight along the back of the crowd as the beam runs across
    dir_ = 1 if k % 2 == 0 else -1
    s_ = sweep if dir_ > 0 else 1 - sweep
    if u >= a1:
        wob = 0.18 * math.sin(after * 9.0) ** 2
        s_ = 1.0 - wob if dir_ > 0 else wob
    hx = 230 + 380 * s_
    fy, hh = 1500, 230
    px, py = hx + 60, fy - 168
    tx = px - 60 + 360 * s_
    ty = 1170 - 60 * math.sin(math.pi * s_)
    brx, bry = 170, 120
    if u >= a0 and full < 1.0:
        cr.save()
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(tx, ty)
        cr.scale(1, bry / brx)
        cr.arc(0, 0, brx, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.clip()
        cr.set_source(lit)
        cr.paint_with_alpha(1.0 - full)
        cr.restore()
    if full > 0:
        cr.save()
        cr.set_source(lit)
        cr.paint_with_alpha(full)
        cr.restore()

    # the beam itself, from the lamp to the crowd
    ang = math.atan2(ty - py, tx - px)
    ba = 0.0 if u < a0 else 0.26 * (1 - 0.5 * full)
    if ba > 0:
        nx, ny = -math.sin(ang), math.cos(ang)
        g = cairo.LinearGradient(px, py, tx, ty)
        g.add_color_stop_rgba(0, 1, 0.97, 0.86, min(1.0, ba * 1.6))
        g.add_color_stop_rgba(1, 1, 0.97, 0.86, ba * 0.5)
        cr.move_to(px + nx * 20, py + ny * 20)
        cr.line_to(tx + nx * brx * 0.9, ty + ny * bry * 0.9)
        cr.line_to(tx - nx * brx * 0.9, ty - ny * bry * 0.9)
        cr.line_to(px - nx * 20, py - ny * 20)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.set_source(g)
        cr.fill()
        glow(cr, tx, ty, brx, (255, 246, 214), ba)

    foreground(cr, "field")
    # the spotlight on its wheeled stand
    contact_shadow(cr, px, fy + 4, 120, a=0.45)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 40, 46)))
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    for lx_ in (-46, 0, 46):
        cr.move_to(px, py + 40)
        cr.line_to(px + lx_, fy - 10)
    cr.stroke()
    for lx_ in (-46, 46):
        disc(cr, px + lx_, fy - 8, 9, (60, 60, 66), finish="metal")
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(px, py)
    cr.rotate(ang)
    cr.rectangle(-34, -30, 108, 60)
    solid(cr, (52, 54, 62), finish="metal")
    cr.rectangle(70, -38, 16, 76)
    solid(cr, (36, 36, 42), finish="metal")
    cr.restore()
    lx2, ly2 = px + 86 * math.cos(ang), py + 86 * math.sin(ang)
    if u >= a0:
        glow(cr, lx2, ly2, 50, (255, 246, 214), 0.8)
    disc(cr, lx2, ly2, 22, (255, 248, 222) if u >= a0 else (150, 150, 140), finish="glass")
    ca, sa = math.cos(ang), math.sin(ang)
    hands = []
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 30, 34)))
    cr.set_line_width(7)
    for side in (-1, 1):                     # the two handles at the back of the lamp
        bx_ = px - 44 * ca - side * 16 * sa
        by_ = py - 44 * sa + side * 16 * ca
        cr.move_to(px - 32 * ca - side * 16 * sa, py - 32 * sa + side * 16 * ca)
        cr.line_to(bx_, by_)
        hands.append((bx_, by_))
    cr.stroke()
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    if u < a0:
        host("point", hx, fy, hh)
    else:
        host("grip", hx, fy, hh, hands=hands, lower="brace", expr="happy")

    if landed_i >= 0:
        lab, v = rows[landed_i]
        fit_readout(cr, f"{v:g}%", f"have red hair · {lab}", 80, 520, size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Red hair", "how rare is it?", 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)
    if landed_i == n - 1 and rows[0][1] > 0:
        ratio = rows[-1][1] / rows[0][1]
        al = ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.04))
        text(cr, f"{ratio:.0f}x", W - 80, 520, 90, look.INK, face="display",
             anchor="right", alpha=al)
        text(cr, f"the {rows[0][0].lower()}", W - 80, 572, 34, look.INK,
             anchor="right", alpha=al)

def _rh_hat(cr, x, y, r, rgb, rot=0.0, a=1.0):

    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.rotate(rot)
    cr.move_to(-r * 1.1, 0)
    cr.arc(0, 0, r * 1.1, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)

    solid(cr, rgb, a=a)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(tuple(int(c * 0.7) for c in rgb), 0.8 * a))
    cr.set_line_width(max(2.0, r * 0.08))
    for i in range(-3, 4):

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a terrace of football fans in bobble hats
    SUBSTANCE: copper-red hair
    CAUSE: Data pumps a bellows and its gusts blow the fans' hats off, uncovering hidden red hair
    One terrace of a Scottish football ground, 24 fans packed four rows deep
    behind the crush barrier, big and close, each in a coat and a striped
    scarf: the WHOLE. At first only the visibly red-haired share stands
    bare-headed with bright copper hair out, lit by a warm glow and ringed
    by a dashed ghost: the people a glance would count. Everyone else has a
    bobble hat pulled low. Data climbs onto the crush barrier and walks along
    it with a bellows, pumping it twice. Each gust blows a run of hats away,
    and under them is dark hair with a hidden copper streak, the gene that
    never shows. Each one joins the glow, until the glowing block is the
    carrier share. It is nearly three times the ringed visible block, and
    a ratio says so. Done by 0.63 and held: the saltire flies, the hair
    blows, he gives one more pump."""
    vals = sorted(float(v) for _, v in pts)
    vis, car = vals[0], vals[-1]
    ratio = car / (vis or 1.0)
    N = 24
    nv = max(1, int(round(vis / 100.0 * N)))
    nc = max(nv + 1, int(round(car / 100.0 * N)))
    hid = nc - nv
    half = (hid + 1) // 2
    G = [(0.10, 0.30), (0.36, 0.56)]
    FL = 0.07

    def trig(j):
        k = 0 if j < half else 1
        a, b = G[k]
        m = half if k == 0 else hid - half
        jj = j if k == 0 else j - half
        return a + (b - a) * (jj / (m - 1) if m > 1 else 0.5)

    done = u >= G[1][1] + FL

    # the saltire on the stand's pole, up and right, clear of the readout

    cr.move_to(px_, 780)
    cr.line_to(px_, top_ - 20)
    cr.stroke()
    disc(cr, px_, top_ - 24, 9, (210, 180, 90), finish="metal")
    fl = [(px_ + i * 40, top_ + 16 * math.sin(t * 4.5 - i * 0.9) * (i / 5)) for i in range(6)]
    cr.move_to(*fl[0])
    for p in fl[1:]:
        cr.line_to(*p)
    for p in reversed(fl):
        cr.line_to(p[0], p[1] + 125)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (0, 94, 184), rim=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((248, 248, 248)))
    cr.set_line_width(16)
    cr.move_to(fl[0][0], fl[0][1])
    cr.line_to(fl[-1][0], fl[-1][1] + 125)
    cr.move_to(fl[0][0], fl[0][1] + 125)
    cr.line_to(fl[-1][0], fl[-1][1])
    cr.stroke()

    hats = [(52, 70, 110), (60, 104, 78), (120, 124, 132), (190, 150, 60), (90, 70, 110)]
    coats = [(46, 56, 80), (60, 66, 76), (70, 92, 74), (120, 112, 100), (86, 70, 64)]
    scarves = [(30, 60, 140), (170, 40, 44)]
    RED = (214, 92, 38)
    DARK = [(70, 44, 30), (96, 60, 36), (52, 36, 28)]
    STREAK = (222, 104, 40)
    GLOW = P["accent2"]

    # four rows of six on concrete terrace steps, back row first
    cast_shadow(cr, 40, 1040, 1480, length=160, a=0.22)
    seats = {}
    for r in range(4):
        R = 44 + 6 * r
        y = 770 + r * 150
        sp = 165 + 5 * r
        box(cr, -20, y + R * 3.2, 1120, 160, (150, 150, 146), depth=10)
        for c in range(6):
            x = 540 + (c - 2.5) * sp + (3 - r) * 10
            rank = c * 4 + r
            seats[rank] = (x, y, R)
            coat = coats[(c * 3 + r) % 5]
            scarf = scarves[(c + r) % 2]
            hat = hats[(c * 7 + r * 3) % 5]

                _rh_fan(cr, x, y, R, coat, scarf, RED, 1.0, None, 1.0, t, rank)
            elif rank < nc:

                _rh_fan(cr, x, y, R, coat, scarf, DARK[rank % 3], hk,
                        hat, p, t, rank, streak=STREAK)
            else:

    # THE SCALE on the terrace: the visibly red fans keep a dashed ring, so

# scene standard: 2026-10-22
def _rh_limb(cr, x0, y0, x1, y1, w, rgb, finish="matte"):
    dx, dy = x1 - x0, y1 - y0
    L = math.hypot(dx, dy) or 1.0
    nx, ny = -dy / L * w / 2, dx / L * w / 2
    cr.move_to(x0 + nx, y0 + ny)
    cr.line_to(x1 + nx, y1 + ny)
    cr.arc(x1, y1, w / 2, math.atan2(ny, nx), math.atan2(ny, nx) + math.pi)
    cr.line_to(x0 - nx, y0 - ny)
    cr.arc(x0, y0, w / 2, math.atan2(-ny, -nx), math.atan2(-ny, -nx) + math.pi)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, rgb, finish=finish)


def _rh_face(cr, hx, hy, hr, turn, freckles=False, grin=0.0):
    ex = turn * hr * 0.28
    for sx in (-1, 1):
        cr.arc(hx + ex + sx * hr * 0.32, hy + hr * 0.02, hr * 0.085, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((34, 28, 30)))
        cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 52, 48)))
    cr.set_line_width(max(2.0, hr * 0.07))
    cr.arc(hx + ex, hy + hr * (0.26 - 0.04 * grin), hr * (0.24 + 0.08 * grin),
           0.15 * math.pi, 0.85 * math.pi)
    cr.stroke()
    if freckles:
        for j in range(8):
            side = -1 if j < 4 else 1
            fx = hx + ex + side * hr * (0.2 + 0.06 * (j % 4) + 0.04 * (j % 2))
            fy = hy + hr * (0.14 + 0.06 * ((j * 3) % 4))
            cr.arc(fx, fy, hr * 0.035, 0, 2 * math.pi)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((176, 96, 60), 0.9))
            cr.fill()

        disc(cr, x + sx * 48 * s, base - 16 * s, 24 * s, (46, 40, 38))
    if long_hair:

        cr.move_to(hx - hr * 1.14, hy - hr * 0.1)

                    hx - hr * 1.0 + sway, sh + 120 * s)
        cr.line_to(hx + hr * 1.0 + sway, sh + 120 * s)
        cr.curve_to(hx + hr * 1.3 + sway, sh + 70 * s, hx + hr * 1.4, hy + hr * 1.5,
                    hx + hr * 1.14, hy - hr * 0.1)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, hair, finish="gloss")
    cr.move_to(x - 98 * s, sh + 14 * s)
    cr.curve_to(x - 60 * s, sh - 26 * s, x + 60 * s, sh - 26 * s, x + 98 * s, sh + 14 * s)
    cr.line_to(x + 84 * s, hip + 24 * s)
    cr.line_to(x - 84 * s, hip + 24 * s)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, coat)
    for sx in (-1, 1):
        _rh_limb(cr, x + sx * 92 * s, sh + 22 * s, x + sx * 118 * s, hip + 46 * s, 44 * s, coat)
        disc(cr, x + sx * 120 * s, hip + 60 * s, 20 * s, SKIN)
    cr.rectangle(x - 18 * s, hy + hr * 0.7, 36 * s, sh - hy - hr * 0.6)
    solid(cr, SKIN, rim=False)
    disc(cr, hx, hy, hr, SKIN)
    # a full head of brown hair: a thick cap with a side parting and sideburns

                hx + hr * 1.14, hy + hr * 0.25)
    cr.curve_to(hx + hr * 0.95, hy - hr * 0.3, hx + hr * 0.5, hy - hr * 0.5,

stories.title: 20,000 US Bank Branches Have Closed Since 2009
stories.hook: Banking didn't shrink. It just moved.
stories.closing: Banks didn't vanish, they moved into your pocket, so your local branch may be next.
stories.question: When did you last walk into a branch?
stories.caption: US banks have closed roughly 20,000 branches since the 2009 peak — but banking didn't shrink, it just moved. Mobile and online banking adoption nearly doubled in the years that followed. Here's the real story behind the empty storefronts. When did you last actually walk into a branch? 👇

segments.say: US bank branches peaked in 2009. Since then, about one in five has shut its doors.

def _bk_mix(a, b, f):
    return tuple(int(x + (y - x) * f) for x, y in zip(a, b))


def _bk_car(cr, x, y, s, rgb, flip=False):
    """A sedan in profile: a shaped body with hood and trunk, a sloped cabin
    with glass, lit wheels, a headlight at the front."""

    cr.curve_to(m(x + 4 * s), y - 66 * s, m(x + 30 * s), y - 72 * s, m(x + 70 * s), y - 74 * s)
    cr.line_to(m(x + w - 60 * s), y - 76 * s)
    cr.curve_to(m(x + w - 14 * s), y - 72 * s, m(x + w), y - 62 * s, m(x + w), y - 46 * s)

    cr.move_to(m(x + 78 * s), y - 74 * s)

    cr.curve_to(m(x + 232 * s), y - 126 * s, m(x + 250 * s), y - 100 * s, m(x + 262 * s), y - 76 * s)

def _bk_bank(cr, x0, base, s, boards, t):
    """One branch: steps, columns, pediment, BANK over the door, windows lit
    while it is open; `boards` 0..4 are planks nailed over the door."""
    w = 460 * s
    x1 = x0 + w
    sh = 26 * s
    wall_h = 380 * s
    stone = (226, 218, 200)
    cast_shadow(cr, x0, x1, base, length=260 * s, a=0.26)
    contact_shadow(cr, (x0 + x1) / 2, base + 2, w + 40 * s, a=0.38)
    box(cr, x0 - 12 * s, base, w + 24 * s, sh, (200, 194, 180), depth=14 * s)
    b = building(cr, x0, x1, base - sh, wall_h, stone, roof_rgb=(170, 162, 146),
                 roof="flat", depth=0.1 * w, boards=False)
    top = b["top"]
    dark = clamp(boards / 4.0)
    lit = (255, 214, 140)
    off = (34, 38, 48)
    win = _bk_mix(lit, off, dark)
    for fx in (0.15, 0.75):
        wx = x0 + fx * w
        cr.rectangle(wx, top + 70 * s, 0.1 * w, 190 * s)
        solid(cr, win, finish="glass")
        if dark < 0.9:
            glow(cr, wx + 0.05 * w, top + 165 * s, 70 * s, lit, 0.35 * (1 - dark))
    dx0, dw = x0 + 0.38 * w, 0.24 * w
    dh = 210 * s
    dy0 = base - sh - dh
    cr.rectangle(dx0, dy0, dw, dh)
    solid(cr, win, finish="glass")
    if dark < 0.9:
        glow(cr, dx0 + dw / 2, dy0 + dh * 0.6, 110 * s, lit, 0.4 * (1 - dark))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((90, 80, 66)))
    cr.set_line_width(max(2, 5 * s))
    cr.move_to(dx0 + dw / 2, dy0)
    cr.line_to(dx0 + dw / 2, dy0 + dh)
    cr.stroke()
    for fx in (0.1, 0.32, 0.68, 0.9):
        cylinder(cr, x0 + fx * w - 17 * s, base - sh, 34 * s, wall_h - 8 * s,
                 (238, 232, 216))
    cr.rectangle(x0 - 14 * s, top - 40 * s, w + 28 * s, 46 * s)
    solid(cr, (232, 224, 206))
    cr.move_to(x0 - 14 * s, top - 40 * s)
    cr.line_to(x0 + w / 2, top - 140 * s)
    cr.line_to(x1 + 14 * s, top - 40 * s)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (236, 228, 210))
    size = int(32 * s)
    half = 1.6 * size
    if size >= 14 and x0 + w / 2 - half > 20 and x0 + w / 2 + half < W - 20:
        text(cr, "BANK", x0 + w / 2, top - 6 * s, size, (70, 62, 50),
             anchor="center", shadow=False)
    for i in range(4):
        p = clamp(boards - i)
        if p <= 0:
            continue
        cy = dy0 + dh * (0.16 + 0.22 * i) - (1 - pop(p)) * 90 * s
        ang = 0.2 if i % 2 == 0 else -0.2
        L, T = dw + 70 * s, 28 * s
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(dx0 + dw / 2, cy)
        cr.rotate(ang)
        cr.rectangle(-L / 2, -T / 2, L, T)
        solid(cr, (176, 126, 76), a=min(1.0, p * 3))
        if p >= 1:
            for nx in (-L / 2 + 14 * s, L / 2 - 14 * s):
                disc(cr, nx, 0, 5 * s, (90, 92, 98), finish="metal")
        cr.restore()
    if boards > 3.5:
        a = clamp((boards - 3.5) * 2)
        cr.rectangle(dx0 + dw * 0.08, dy0 + dh * 0.34, dw * 0.84, 54 * s)
        solid(cr, (244, 238, 222), a=a)
        text(cr, "CLOSED", dx0 + dw / 2, dy0 + dh * 0.34 + 40 * s,
             max(10, int(32 * s)), WARN, anchor="center", alpha=a, shadow=False)
    return dx0, dy0, dw, dh, base - sh


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a columned bank branch on Main Street
    SUBSTANCE: wooden planks over the door
    CAUSE: Data hammers planks across the bank's door, one strike per plank, until it is shut
    The WHOLE is a street of five bank branches, the nearest one big by the
    camera, the other four receding up the street with their fronts in view.
    From the 2009 peak, each later year's closed share of branches is planked
    over that street: four planks are one branch of five, so 2014's loss is
    about one plank and 2024's is the whole nearest bank boarded up, dark,
    CLOSED — one in five. Done by 0.6 and held; cars keep driving by and Data
    keeps driving in nails, standing on the bank's own steps beside the door
    so the planks and the sign stay in view."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    n = len(rows)
    peak = rows[0][1] or 1.0
    NB = 5
    target = [clamp((peak - v) / peak) * NB * 4 for _, v in rows]

    a0, a1 = 0.18, 0.6
    nt = max(1, n - 1)
    span = (a1 - a0) / nt
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, nt - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    slide = ease(seg(f, 0.1, 0.85))
    if u < a0 or n < 2:
        B = 0.0
        landed_n = 0
    else:
        B = target[k] + (target[min(k + 1, n - 1)] - target[k]) * slide
        landed_n = k + 1 if slide >= 0.999 else k
    shown = rows[min(landed_n, n - 1)]

    landscape(cr, t, "town", horizon=1170)
    birds(cr, t, y0=780, n=4, rgb=(60, 62, 74))
    # sidewalk and road
    cr.rectangle(0, 1420, W, 80)
    solid(cr, (196, 190, 180), edge=False, rim=False)
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (70, 72, 78)), (1, (46, 48, 54))], 1500, H)
    cr.rectangle(0, 1496, W, 10)
    solid(cr, (150, 146, 138), edge=False, rim=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((232, 210, 120), 0.85))
    for i in range(7):
        cr.rectangle(i * 180 + 20, 1752, 110, 10)
    cr.fill()

    # the street of branches, far first; the nearest is the hero, big
    s_list = [1.45, 0.42, 0.3, 0.22, 0.16]
    xs = [24.0, 790.0, 905.0, 985.0, 1032.0]
    bases = [1440.0, 1366.0, 1310.0, 1270.0, 1240.0]
    door = None
    for j in reversed(range(NB)):
        if j == 0:
            haze(cr, 1100, 1370, (214, 206, 196), a=0.3)
        d = _bk_bank(cr, xs[j], bases[j], s_list[j], clamp(B - 4 * j, 0, 4), t)
        if j == 0:
            door = d

    # a street lamp on the sidewalk
    contact_shadow(cr, 770, 1468, 60, a=0.35)
    cylinder(cr, 760, 1468, 20, 400, (52, 56, 64), finish="metal")
    disc(cr, 770, 1066, 22, (255, 230, 170), finish="gloss")

    # right by the camera: traffic going both ways
    _bk_car(cr, -420 + ((t * 300) % 1900), 1720, 1.1, (176, 44, 40))
    _bk_car(cr, 1500 - ((t * 240 + 700) % 1900), 1890, 1.3, (60, 96, 150), flip=True)
    foreground(cr, "town")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data: points down the street, walks up onto the steps, boards up the door
    dx0, dy0, dw, dh, step_y = door
    work_x = dx0 - 105
    sx, sy = 640, 1452
    if u < 0.06:
        host("point", sx, sy, 240)
    elif u < a0:
        w_ = ease(seg(u, 0.06, a0))
        host("hammer", sx + (work_x - sx) * w_, sy + (step_y - sy) * ease(seg(w_, 0.7, 1.0)),
             240, beat=0)
    elif u < a1 + 0.02:
        host("hammer", work_x, step_y, 240, beat=1 + int(B + 0.5))
    else:
        host("hammer", work_x, step_y, 240,
             beat=2 + int(target[-1] + 0.5) + int((u - a1) / 0.13))

    lab, v = shown
    fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v)):,}", f"US bank branches · {lab}", 80, 520,
                a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)
    if n >= 2 and landed_n >= n - 1:
        pct = int(round((peak - rows[-1][1]) / peak * 100))
        text(cr, f"-{pct}%", W - 80, 690, 96, look.INK, face="display",
             anchor="right", alpha=ease(seg(u, a1 - 0.02, a1 + 0.04)))

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: an apartment tower of households
    SUBSTANCE: phones lighting the windows
    CAUSE: Data tosses a phone up into each window, and that home's window lights up with its screen
    One tower is the WHOLE: forty households, five flats to a floor, seen
    in three-quarter view on a street corner — a corner shop beside it, the
    block running away behind it under haze, the road sweeping past toward
    the camera with a car on it, a street tree and a mailbox right by the
    lens. Data walks the pavement under the tower and tosses phones up,
    armful by armful, each one sailing in through a window; the window it
    lands in lights blue, a person on that phone, filling from the ground
    floor up until the lit share of the tower is that year's share of
    households banking mainly by phone or computer. 2013's level stays
    marked on the tower, so 2019's climb past it reads at a glance. Done by
    0.62 and held: Data keeps tossing phones up to homes already lit, the
    story stays put, cars keep driving past."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    N, T = 40, 6
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.62
    span = (a1 - a0) / T
    L0 = int(round(clamp(v0 / 100.0) * N))
    L1 = max(L0, int(round(clamp(v1 / 100.0) * N)))
    targets = []
    for i in range(T):
        if i < 3:
            targets.append(int(round(L0 * (i + 1) / 3.0)))
        else:
            targets.append(int(round(L0 + (L1 - L0) * (i - 2) / 3.0)))
    sched = {}
    prevc = 0
    for i in range(T):
        m = max(0, targets[i] - prevc)
        st = a0 + i * span
        for q in range(m):
            la = st + span * (0.18 + 0.27 * q / max(1, m))
            sched[prevc + q] = (i, la, la + span * 0.35)
        prevc = max(prevc, targets[i])
    lit_len = span * 0.12
    first = [sched[j][2] for j in sched if sched[j][0] <= 2]
    done0 = (max(first) if first else a0 + 3 * span) + lit_len
    done1 = (max(s_[2] for s_ in sched.values()) if sched else a1) + lit_len

    X0, X1, BASE, WALL = 170, 830, 1440, 820
    LOBBY = 1320
    FH = (LOBBY - (BASE - WALL)) / 8.0
    HY = 1520
    ww, wh = 84, 58

    def hx_at(uu):
        if uu < a0:
            return 210.0
        if uu >= a1:
            return 650.0
        i = int(clamp((uu - a0) / span, 0, T - 0.001))
        ff = clamp((uu - a0 - i * span) / span)
        return 210.0 + 440.0 * clamp((i - 1 + ease(seg(ff, 0.0, 0.16))) / (T - 1))

    def win(j):
        r, c = j // 5, j % 5
        pitch = (X1 - X0) / 5.0
        wx = X0 + (pitch - ww) / 2 + c * pitch
        wy = LOBBY - r * FH - 22 - wh
        return wx, wy

    landscape(cr, t, "town")
    # the block running away behind the tower, smaller and paler with distance
    for (bx0, bx1, bh, col) in ((1060, 1200, 520, (150, 146, 156)),
                                (960, 1090, 600, (166, 152, 140)),
                                (860, 1010, 700, (176, 160, 146))):
        b_ = building(cr, bx0, bx1, 1400, bh, col, roof_rgb=(100, 96, 98),
                      roof="flat", depth=40, boards=False)
        for r in range(int(bh // 80)):
            for c in range(2):
                wx_ = bx0 + 22 + c * (bx1 - bx0 - 44) / 2.0
                cr.rectangle(wx_, b_["top"] + 30 + r * 80, 40, 44)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 74, 88), 0.8))
        cr.fill()
    haze(cr, 560, 1420, (214, 200, 186), a=0.5)

    # the pavement, the road sweeping past toward the camera, the near kerb
    cr.rectangle(0, 1400, W, H - 1400)
    solid(cr, (184, 176, 166), edge=False, rim=False)
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(0, 1400, W, 200)
    cr.clip()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 112, 104), 0.35))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(12):
        cr.move_to(1500, 1360)
        cr.line_to(-300 + i * 150, 1640)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()
    cr.move_to(0, _ph_road_top(0))
    cr.line_to(W, _ph_road_top(W))
    cr.line_to(W, _ph_road_bot(W))
    cr.line_to(0, _ph_road_bot(0))
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (84, 86, 94), edge=False, rim=False)
    for yfn in (_ph_road_top, _ph_road_bot):
        cr.move_to(0, yfn(0))
        cr.line_to(W, yfn(W))
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((220, 214, 204)))
        cr.set_line_width(12)
        cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 226, 170), 0.85))
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    cr.set_dash([60, 44])
    cr.move_to(0, (_ph_road_top(0) + _ph_road_bot(0)) / 2)
    cr.line_to(W, (_ph_road_top(W) + _ph_road_bot(W)) / 2)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_dash([])

    # the corner shop beside the tower, its awning out over the pavement
    contact_shadow(cr, 10, 1442, 300, a=0.35)
    building(cr, -160, 130, 1440, 330, (158, 72, 56), roof_rgb=(90, 70, 64),
             roof="flat", depth=50, boards=False)
    cr.rectangle(-110, 1290, 210, 120)
    solid(cr, (240, 214, 150), finish="glass", rim=False)
    cr.move_to(-140, 1270)
    cr.line_to(130, 1270)
    cr.line_to(155, 1320)
    cr.line_to(-140, 1320)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (46, 120, 92))

    # the tower, turned so its side runs back down the street
    cast_shadow(cr, X0, X1 + 120, BASE, length=340, a=0.32)
    contact_shadow(cr, (X0 + X1) / 2 + 80, BASE + 4, X1 - X0 + 240, a=0.42)
    b = building(cr, X0, X1, BASE, WALL, (196, 172, 148), roof_rgb=(110, 104, 100),
                 roof="flat", depth=180, boards=False)
    top = b["top"]
    box(cr, X0 - 14, top + 26, X1 - X0 + 28, 26, (220, 206, 186), depth=40)
    # the side wall's own windows, dim, running back into the picture
    for r in range(8):
        for c in range(2):
            sx0 = X1 + 30 + c * 70
            sy0 = LOBBY - r * FH - 70 - c * 12
            cr.move_to(sx0, sy0)
            cr.line_to(sx0 + 36, sy0 - 10)
            cr.line_to(sx0 + 36, sy0 + 40)
            cr.line_to(sx0, sy0 + 50)
            cr.close_path()
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 70, 84), 0.75))
            cr.fill()
    mid = (X0 + X1) / 2
    box(cr, mid - 80, LOBBY + 6, 160, 20, (46, 92, 120), depth=30, finish="metal")
    cr.rectangle(mid - 46, LOBBY + 30, 92, BASE - LOBBY - 30)
    solid(cr, (70, 56, 46), finish="gloss")
    cr.rectangle(mid - 36, LOBBY + 40, 72, 50)
    solid(cr, (240, 214, 150), finish="glass", rim=False)

    # forty flats; a window lights the moment a phone lands in it
    for j in range(N):
        wx, wy = win(j)
        lit = ease(seg(u, sched[j][2], sched[j][2] + lit_len)) if j in sched else 0.0
        vgrad(cr, [(0, (40, 44, 58)), (1, (74, 78, 94))], wy, wy + wh, wx, wx + ww)
        if lit > 0:
            glow(cr, wx + ww / 2, wy + wh / 2, 90, (90, 170, 255), 0.6 * lit)
            pat = cairo.LinearGradient(0, wy, 0, wy + wh)
            pat.add_color_stop_rgba(0, 170 / 255, 220 / 255, 1.0, lit)
            pat.add_color_stop_rgba(1, 50 / 255, 120 / 255, 230 / 255, lit)
            cr.rectangle(wx, wy, ww, wh)
            cr.set_source(pat)
            cr.fill()
            px = wx + 26 + 30 * ((j * 7) % 3) / 2.0
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((24, 30, 48), 0.9 * lit))
            cr.arc(px, wy + 26, 10, 0, 2 * math.pi)
            cr.fill()
            cr.arc(px, wy + wh + 4, 19, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
            cr.fill()
            cr.rectangle(px + 9, wy + 30, 8, 12)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((250, 252, 255), lit))
            cr.fill()
        cr.rectangle(wx + ww - 16, wy, 14, wh)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 118, 104), 0.7))
        cr.fill()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 228, 214)))
        cr.set_line_width(4)
        cr.move_to(wx + ww / 2, wy)
        cr.line_to(wx + ww / 2, wy + wh)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.rectangle(wx, wy, ww, wh)
        edge(cr, (236, 228, 214), width=5)
        box(cr, wx - 8, wy + wh + 14, ww + 16, 8, (210, 200, 186), depth=12)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 58, 62)))
        cr.set_line_width(3)
        for bi in range(6):
            bxx = wx - 4 + bi * (ww + 8) / 5.0
            cr.move_to(bxx, wy + wh + 6)
            cr.line_to(bxx, wy + wh - 10)
        cr.move_to(wx - 6, wy + wh - 10)
        cr.line_to(wx + ww + 6, wy + wh - 10)
        cr.stroke()

    # THE SCALE on the tower: where 2013 reached stays marked
    if u >= done0 and len(rows) > 1:
        then_mark(cr, X0 - 10, X1 + 30, LOBBY - (L0 / float(N)) * 8 * FH, l0)

    # a street lamp on the corner
    contact_shadow(cr, 110, 1560, 60, a=0.35)
    cylinder(cr, 103, 1560, 14, 330, (54, 58, 66), finish="metal")
    disc(cr, 110, 1226, 20, (250, 236, 196), finish="glass")

    # right by the camera: a car sweeping up the road toward us, a street
    # tree and the mailbox nobody needs now
    cx = W + 160 - ((t * 240) % (W + 560))
    cs = 1.15 - 0.35 * clamp(cx / W, 0, 1)
    cy = _ph_road_top(cx) + 0.72 * (_ph_road_bot(cx) - _ph_road_top(cx))
    _ph_car(cr, cx, cy, cs)
    _ph_mailbox(cr, 40, 1910, 1.0)
    _ph_tree(cr, 1030, 1910, 1.0)
    foreground(cr, "town", y0=1840)
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data walks the pavement under the tower, tossing phones up — and once
    # the share has landed he keeps tossing, to homes already lit
    hx = hx_at(u)
    i_now = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, T - 0.001))
    k2 = int((u - a1) / span) if u >= a1 else 0
    if u < a0:
        host("point", hx, HY, 240)
    elif u < a1:
        host("toss", hx, HY, 240, beat=i_now)
    else:
        host("toss", hx, HY, 240, beat=T + k2)

    # the phones in flight, from his hands in through each window
    flights = []
    for j, (i, la, ld) in sched.items():
        if la <= u < ld:
            flights.append((j, la, ld, hx_at(la)))
    if u >= a1 and L1 > 0:
        la = a1 + k2 * span + span * 0.25
        ld = la + span * 0.35
        if la <= u < ld:
            flights.append(((k2 * 7 + 3) % L1, la, ld, hx))
    for j, la, ld, sx0 in flights:
        p = (u - la) / (ld - la)
        sx, sy = sx0 + 20, HY - 195
        wx, wy = win(j)
        ex, ey = wx + ww / 2, wy + wh / 2
        fx = sx + (ex - sx) * p
        fy = sy + (ey - sy) * p - 200 * math.sin(math.pi * p)
        _ph_flying(cr, fx, fy, p * 2 * math.pi, 1.5 - 0.5 * p)

    if u >= done1 and len(rows) > 1:
        lab, v = l1, v1
    elif u >= done0:
        lab, v = l0, v0
    else:
        lab, v = None, None
    if lab is not None:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v))}%",
                    f"of US households bank mainly by phone or computer · {lab}",
                    80, 520, size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Banking on phones", f"US households, {l0}–{l1}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

segments.say: Closures hit hard in 2020. That year alone, branches closed at more than three times the usual pace.
segments.illustrated_scene:
# scene standard: 2026-10-16.1
def _bk_person(cr, x, foot, h, t, coat, bag=None):
    sw = math.sin(t * 5.2 + x * 0.01)
    cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
    cr.set_line_width(h * 0.075)
    for s_ in (1, -1):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((34, 34, 40)))
        cr.move_to(x, foot - h * 0.46)
        cr.line_to(x + s_ * sw * h * 0.12, foot)
        cr.stroke()
    cr.move_to(x - h * 0.13, foot - h * 0.44)
    cr.curve_to(x - h * 0.16, foot - h * 0.66, x - h * 0.12, foot - h * 0.8, x, foot - h * 0.82)
    cr.curve_to(x + h * 0.12, foot - h * 0.8, x + h * 0.16, foot - h * 0.66, x + h * 0.13, foot - h * 0.44)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, coat)
    # a swinging arm, and a shopping bag in its hand
    hx_ = x - sw * h * 0.1
    hy_ = foot - h * 0.42
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(tuple(int(c * 0.8) for c in coat)))
    cr.set_line_width(h * 0.06)
    cr.move_to(x + h * 0.02, foot - h * 0.74)
    cr.line_to(hx_, hy_)
    cr.stroke()
    if bag is not None:
        cr.rectangle(hx_ - h * 0.07, hy_, h * 0.14, h * 0.16)
        solid(cr, bag)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 36, 34)))
        cr.set_line_width(2.5)
        cr.arc(hx_, hy_, h * 0.04, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.stroke()
    disc(cr, x, foot - h * 0.9, h * 0.085, (214, 170, 138))
    # hair on the back of the head
    cr.arc(x, foot - h * 0.915, h * 0.088, math.pi * 0.95, math.pi * 2.05)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (58, 42, 34), rim=False)


def _bk_dollar(cr, x, y, r, rgb):
    # a dollar sign drawn as a path, so it is part of the medallion itself
    w = r * 0.26
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(rgb))
    cr.set_line_width(max(2.5, r * 0.13))
    cr.move_to(x + w, y - 0.40 * r)
    cr.curve_to(x, y - 0.60 * r, x - 1.3 * w, y - 0.40 * r, x, y)
    cr.curve_to(x + 1.3 * w, y + 0.40 * r, x, y + 0.60 * r, x - w, y + 0.40 * r)
    cr.move_to(x, y - 0.56 * r)
    cr.line_to(x, y + 0.56 * r)
    cr.stroke()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a row of bank branches
    SUBSTANCE: a steel security grille
    CAUSE: Data drags the steel grille shut by hand across the bank fronts, branch after branch
    Inside a marble shopping concourse, one long frontage of four bank
    branches running back into the picture, each a little stone temple: a
    pediment with a gold dollar medallion, fluted columns, a BANK fascia,
    and behind the glass a lit teller hall of brass-barred cages and an
    ATM, its warm light spilling onto the polished floor. Data grips the
    leading bar of the steel security grille and drags it shut along the
    row; each bank goes dark behind it and its light leaves the floor. The
    whole row is 2020's closures. A typical year's pull is a dashed ghost
    about a third of the way along, with its label. He reaches it, then
    keeps dragging to the far end, so the grille has gone three times as
    far. Done by 0.60 and held: he braces on the shut grille while shoppers
    with bags keep walking past near the camera."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    yr = [r_ for r_ in rows if any(ch.isdigit() for ch in r_[0])]
    big = max(yr or rows, key=lambda r_: r_[1])
    others = [r_ for r_ in rows if r_ is not big]
    typ = others[0] if others else big
    vb = big[1] or 1.0
    vt = typ[1]
    ft = clamp(vt / vb)
    ratio = vb / vt if vt else 1.0

    a0, am, ah, a1 = 0.06, 0.24, 0.30, 0.60
    if u < a0:
        frac = 0.0
    elif u < am:
        frac = ft * ease(seg(u, a0, am))
    elif u < ah:
        frac = ft
    else:
        frac = ft + (1 - ft) * ease(seg(u, ah, a1))

    X0, X1 = 150.0, 1010.0

    def fx(s):
        return X0 + (X1 - X0) * s

    def ftop(s):
        return 780.0 + 140.0 * s

    def fbase(s):
        return 1460.0 - 60.0 * s

    def fy(s, v):
        return ftop(s) + (fbase(s) - ftop(s)) * v

    def quad(s0, s1, v0, v1):
        cr.move_to(fx(s0), fy(s0, v0))
        cr.line_to(fx(s1), fy(s1, v0))
        cr.line_to(fx(s1), fy(s1, v1))
        cr.line_to(fx(s0), fy(s0, v1))
        cr.close_path()

    # the whole frame first: the concourse, ceiling to floor
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (52, 50, 56)), (0.35, (120, 114, 108)), (0.6, (176, 168, 156)),
               (1, (120, 112, 100))], 0, H)
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (52, 50, 56)), (0.6, (120, 114, 108)), (1, (176, 168, 156))], 0, 1000)
    for i in range(6):
        z = i / 5.0
        lx = 60 + 820 * z
        ly = 120 + 420 * z
        sc = 1.0 - 0.6 * z
        glow(cr, lx + 100 * sc, ly, 200 * sc, (255, 240, 210), 0.35)
        box(cr, lx, ly, 200 * sc, 24 * sc, (240, 236, 226), depth=40 * sc)
    # the back wall, and the far shops of the concourse glowing at its end
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (176, 168, 156)), (1, (150, 142, 130))], 1000, 1300)
    for i in range(5):
        bx = 1010 + i * 16
        hh_ = 300 - i * 30
        cr.rectangle(bx, 1300 - hh_, 14, hh_)
        solid(cr, (232, 200, 150) if i % 2 else (168, 158, 146), rim=False)
    haze(cr, 600, 1020, (190, 182, 170), a=0.5)
    # the polished marble floor
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (186, 176, 160)), (1, (120, 112, 100))], 1300, H)
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(0, 1300, W, H - 1300)
    cr.clip()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((90, 84, 76), 0.3))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(12):
        cr.move_to(1200, 1200)
        cr.line_to(-1000 + i * 230, H)
    for i in range(6):
        yy = 1480 + i * i * 22
        cr.move_to(0, yy)
        cr.line_to(W, yy - 40)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()
    # a marble column of the concourse, by the camera on the left
    contact_shadow(cr, 70, 1480, 150, a=0.35)
    cylinder(cr, 10, 1480, 120, 900, (226, 218, 204), finish="gloss")

    # the frontage: four stone bank temples side by side, running back
    cast_shadow(cr, X0, X1, 1462, length=160, a=0.24)
    contact_shadow(cr, (X0 + X1) / 2, 1462, X1 - X0, a=0.3)
    quad(0, 1, -0.03, 1.0)
    solid(cr, (214, 206, 190))
    for b_ in range(4):
        s0, s1 = b_ * 0.25 + 0.02, b_ * 0.25 + 0.23
        sm = (s0 + s1) / 2
        sc = 1 - 0.3 * sm
        # the warm light of its teller hall on the floor, gone once shuttered
        lit = 1.0 - clamp((frac - s0) / (s1 - s0))
        if lit > 0.01:
            glow(cr, fx(sm), fbase(sm) + 70, 150 * sc, (255, 214, 150), 0.35 * lit)
        # the pediment, with the gold dollar medallion in it
        cr.move_to(fx(s0 - 0.01), fy(s0 - 0.01, -0.02))
        cr.line_to(fx(s1 + 0.01), fy(s1 + 0.01, -0.02))
        cr.line_to(fx(sm), fy(sm, -0.17))
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (236, 230, 216))
        my = fy(sm, -0.075)
        mr = 28 * sc
        disc(cr, fx(sm), my, mr, P["coin"], finish="gloss")
        _bk_dollar(cr, fx(sm), my, mr, P["coin_edge"])
        # the cornice and the BANK fascia
        quad(s0 - 0.01, s1 + 0.01, -0.02, 0.02)
        solid(cr, (244, 238, 226))
        quad(s0, s1, 0.02, 0.14)
        solid(cr, (36, 70, 120), finish="gloss")
        text(cr, "BANK", fx(sm), fy(sm, 0.115), int(48 * sc), (244, 238, 226),
             face="display", anchor="center", shadow=False)
        # the teller hall behind the glass
        w0, w1 = s0 + 0.035, s1 - 0.035
        quad(w0, w1, 0.2, 0.98)
        cr.save()
        cr.clip()
        vgrad(cr, [(0, (250, 226, 170)), (1, (206, 160, 100))], fy(w0, 0.2) - 10,
              fy(w0, 0.98), fx(w0), fx(w1))
        # a teller behind the counter
        tx_ = fx(w0 + (w1 - w0) * 0.35)
        disc(cr, tx_, fy(w0, 0.47), 16 * sc, (204, 160, 128))
        cr.rectangle(tx_ - 18 * sc, fy(w0, 0.51), 36 * sc, 60 * sc)
        solid(cr, (60, 84, 120), rim=False)
        quad(w0, w1, 0.62, 0.98)
        solid(cr, (120, 84, 54), rim=False, edge=False)
        # brass bars of the teller cages over the counter
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((176, 140, 60)))
        cr.set_line_width(4 * sc)
        for j in range(9):
            sj = w0 + (w1 - w0) * (j + 0.5) / 9
            cr.move_to(fx(sj), fy(sj, 0.34))
            cr.line_to(fx(sj), fy(sj, 0.62))
        cr.move_to(fx(w0), fy(w0, 0.34))
        cr.line_to(fx(w1), fy(w1, 0.34))
        cr.stroke()
        # an ATM in the corner
        sa = w1 - 0.035
        quad(sa, w1 - 0.005, 0.5, 0.98)
        solid(cr, (70, 74, 84), finish="metal", rim=False)
        quad(sa + 0.006, w1 - 0.011, 0.56, 0.66)
        solid(cr, (120, 200, 230), finish="glass", rim=False, edge=False)
        cr.restore()
        quad(w0, w1, 0.2, 0.98)
        edge(cr, (60, 56, 52))
        # fluted columns either side of the glass
        for c0 in (s0, w1):
            quad(c0, c0 + 0.035, 0.16, 1.0)
            solid(cr, (240, 234, 220))
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((170, 162, 148)))
            cr.set_line_width(2.5)
            for q in (0.3, 0.5, 0.7):
                sq = c0 + 0.035 * q
                cr.move_to(fx(sq), fy(sq, 0.18))
                cr.line_to(fx(sq), fy(sq, 0.98))
            cr.stroke()
            quad(c0 - 0.004, c0 + 0.039, 0.145, 0.17)
            solid(cr, (226, 220, 206), rim=False)
        # the marble step in front of it
        quad(s0 - 0.01, s1 + 0.01, 1.0, 1.035)
        solid(cr, (230, 224, 212), rim=False)

    # THE SCALE: a typical year's pull, a ghost on the frontage
    if u >= a0:
        quad(0, ft, 0.17, 1.0)
        ghost(cr, a=0.9)
        text(cr, typ[0].lower(), fx(ft), fy(ft, -0.23), 34, look.INK, face="bold",
             anchor="center")

    # the steel grille, dragged shut along the row; the banks go dark behind it
    if frac > 0.002:
        quad(0, frac, 0.17, 1.0)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((24, 24, 30), 0.82))
        cr.fill()
        cr.save()
        quad(0, frac, 0.17, 1.0)
        cr.clip()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((176, 180, 188)))
        cr.set_line_width(7)
        for i in range(1, 15):
            v = 0.17 + 0.83 * i / 15
            cr.move_to(fx(0), fy(0, v))
            cr.line_to(fx(frac), fy(frac, v))
        s_ = 0.0
        while s_ < frac:
            cr.move_to(fx(s_), fy(s_, 0.17))
            cr.line_to(fx(s_), fy(s_, 1.0))
            s_ += 0.025
        cr.stroke()
        cr.restore()
        xe = fx(frac)

# scene standard: 2026-10-11.2
def _bk_win(N):
    out = []
    x, s = 80.0, 1.0
    for j in range(N):
        top = 1020 - 180 * s
        cy = 1020 + 350 * s
        w = 250 * s
        out.append((x, top, w, cy, s))
        x += w + 34 * s
        s *= 0.82
    return out


def _bk_at(wins, jf):
    jf = clamp(jf, 0, len(wins) - 1)
    j0 = int(jf)
    j1 = min(len(wins) - 1, j0 + 1)
    f = jf - j0
    a, b = wins[j0], wins[j1]
    return tuple(a[i] + (b[i] - a[i]) * f for i in range(5))


def _bk_cornice(x):
    return 740 + 120 * x / W


def _bk_arch(cr, x, top, w, bot, pad=0.0):
    r = w / 2 + pad
    cx = x + w / 2
    cr.new_path()
    cr.move_to(cx - r, bot)
    cr.line_to(cx - r, top + w / 2)
    cr.arc(cx, top + w / 2, r, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.line_to(cx + r, bot)
    cr.close_path()


def _bk_dollar(cr, cx, cy, R):
    # a gold medallion stamped with a dollar sign, drawn as a path
    glow(cr, cx, cy, R * 1.8, (255, 214, 120), 0.35)
    disc(cr, cx, cy, R, P["coin"], finish="metal")
    rr = 0.36 * R
    cr.new_path()
    cr.arc_negative(cx, cy - rr, rr, -math.pi / 4, -1.5 * math.pi)
    cr.arc(cx, cy + rr, rr, -math.pi / 2, 0.75 * math.pi)
    cr.new_sub_path()
    cr.move_to(cx, cy - 2.4 * rr)
    cr.line_to(cx, cy + 2.4 * rr)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((96, 66, 20)))
    cr.set_line_width(max(2.5, 0.16 * R))
    cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_BUTT)


def _bk_column(cr, x, s, bot):
    # a fluted marble column from the counter line up to the cornice
    w = 44 * s
    top = _bk_cornice(x) + 14
    h = bot - top
    if h <= 20:
        return
    contact_shadow(cr, x, bot, w * 1.6, a=0.25)
    cylinder(cr, x - w / 2, bot, w, h, (232, 224, 208))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 138, 118), 0.55))
    cr.set_line_width(max(1.5, 2.5 * s))
    for k in (-0.25, 0.0, 0.25):
        cr.move_to(x + k * w, top + 18 * s)
        cr.line_to(x + k * w, bot - 18 * s)
    cr.stroke()
    box(cr, x - w * 0.8, top + 22 * s, w * 1.6, 20 * s, (226, 216, 196), depth=10 * s)
    box(cr, x - w * 0.75, bot, w * 1.5, 18 * s, (214, 204, 184), depth=10 * s)


def _bk_bill(cr, x, y, w, h, ang):
    # one green banknote: the paper, its border and the oval portrait
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.rotate(ang)
    cr.rectangle(-w / 2, -h / 2, w, h)
    solid(cr, (118, 168, 112), rim=False)
    cr.rectangle(-w / 2 + 0.08 * w, -h / 2 + 0.14 * h, w * 0.84, h * 0.72)
    edge(cr, (60, 104, 62), width=max(1.5, 0.05 * h))
    cr.new_path()
    cr.save()
    cr.scale(1, h / w * 1.6)
    cr.arc(0, 0, w * 0.17, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (168, 204, 156), rim=False)
    cr.restore()


def _bk_cash(cr, x, y, s):
    # bricks of banded bills and rolls of coin on the teller's counter
    for i in range(3):
        bx = x + i * 46 * s
        for lvl in range(2 - i % 2):
            box(cr, bx, y - lvl * 18 * s, 40 * s, 16 * s, (110, 160, 104),
                depth=14 * s)
            cr.rectangle(bx + 15 * s, y - lvl * 18 * s - 16 * s, 9 * s, 16 * s)
            solid(cr, (236, 228, 200), rim=False, edge=False)
    for i in range(3):
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(x + 150 * s + i * 4 * s, y - i * 13 * s)
        cr.rotate(-1.5708)
        cylinder(cr, 0, 0, 12 * s, 54 * s, P["coin"], finish="metal")
        cr.restore()


def _bk_teller(cr, x, cy, s):
    # a bank teller behind the glass, counting out a fan of bills
    cr.new_path()
    cr.move_to(x - 78 * s, cy)
    cr.curve_to(x - 80 * s, cy - 90 * s, x - 60 * s, cy - 118 * s, x, cy - 120 * s)
    cr.curve_to(x + 60 * s, cy - 118 * s, x + 80 * s, cy - 90 * s, x + 78 * s, cy)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (52, 62, 84))
    cr.new_path()
    cr.move_to(x - 26 * s, cy - 118 * s)
    cr.line_to(x + 26 * s, cy - 118 * s)
    cr.line_to(x, cy - 40 * s)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (240, 240, 236), rim=False)
    cr.new_path()
    cr.move_to(x - 7 * s, cy - 112 * s)
    cr.line_to(x + 7 * s, cy - 112 * s)
    cr.line_to(x + 5 * s, cy - 60 * s)
    cr.line_to(x, cy - 50 * s)
    cr.line_to(x - 5 * s, cy - 60 * s)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (150, 40, 40), rim=False)
    disc(cr, x, cy - 158 * s, 34 * s, (226, 180, 146))
    cr.new_path()
    cr.arc(x, cy - 164 * s, 35 * s, math.pi * 1.05, math.pi * 1.95)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (60, 42, 30), rim=False)
    for i in range(5):
        _bk_bill(cr, x + 40 * s, cy - 58 * s, 84 * s, 38 * s, -0.7 + i * 0.22)
    disc(cr, x + 22 * s, cy - 50 * s, 12 * s, (226, 180, 146))


def _bk_phone(cr, t, cx, cy, ang):
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(cx, cy)
    cr.rotate(ang)
    pw, ph, r = 300, 580, 40
    glow(cr, 0, -120, 320, (120, 170, 240), 0.35)
    cr.new_path()
    cr.arc(-pw / 2 + r, -ph / 2 + r, r, math.pi, 1.5 * math.pi)
    cr.arc(pw / 2 - r, -ph / 2 + r, r, 1.5 * math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.arc(pw / 2 - r, ph / 2 - r, r, 0, 0.5 * math.pi)
    cr.arc(-pw / 2 + r, ph / 2 - r, r, 0.5 * math.pi, math.pi)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (34, 36, 44), finish="gloss")
    sx0, sy0, sw, sh = -pw / 2 + 18, -ph / 2 + 22, pw - 36, ph - 44
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(sx0, sy0, sw, sh)
    cr.clip()
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (28, 58, 120)), (1, (14, 30, 70))], sy0, sy0 + sh, sx0, sx0 + sw)
    ix, iy = 0, sy0 + 120
    cr.move_to(ix - 70, iy - 40)
    cr.line_to(ix, iy - 80)
    cr.line_to(ix + 70, iy - 40)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (240, 244, 250), rim=False)
    for c in range(4):
        cr.rectangle(ix - 58 + c * 34, iy - 32, 14, 62)
        solid(cr, (240, 244, 250), rim=False, edge=False)
    cr.rectangle(ix - 74, iy + 32, 148, 14)
    solid(cr, (240, 244, 250), rim=False)
    pitch = 96
    off = (t * 150) % pitch
    for i in range(7):
        ry = sy0 + 200 + i * pitch - off
        cr.rectangle(sx0 + 18, ry, sw - 36, 70)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 242, 250), 0.9))
        cr.fill()
        disc(cr, sx0 + 52, ry + 35, 18, P["accent2"] if i % 2 else (90, 170, 110))
        cr.rectangle(sx0 + 86, ry + 22, 120 - (i % 3) * 24, 12)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 70, 90), 0.8))
        cr.fill()
        cr.rectangle(sx0 + 86, ry + 44, 70, 9)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 130, 150), 0.7))
        cr.fill()
    cr.restore()
    cr.move_to(sx0 + 20, sy0 + 10)
    cr.line_to(sx0 + 120, sy0 + 10)
    cr.line_to(sx0 + 20, sy0 + 200)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 255, 255), 0.12))
    cr.fill()
    cr.restore()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a bank's row of teller windows
    SUBSTANCE: steel roll-down shutters
    CAUSE: Data cranks each teller window's steel shutter down, one typical year of closures per window
    THE CLOSING, inside the local branch the street scenes only showed from
    outside: an old banking hall of arched brass-barred teller cages between
    fluted marble columns under a coffered ceiling, each cage crowned with a
    gold dollar medallion, a teller fanning out green bills behind the
    glass, bricks of banded cash and coin rolls on the counter, and a velvet
    queue rope on brass posts in front. Each window is one typical year of
    closures: the far one comes down first, then 2020 cranks down three
    windows' worth, and the shutter starts to drop on the window nearest the
    camera: your branch may be next. Right by the camera a phone rises out
    of a jeans pocket with the bank on its screen, its transactions
    scrolling: the bank moved into your pocket. Lands by 0.54 and holds
    while Data bears the half-dropped near shutter."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    nodig = [r for r in rows if not any(ch.isdigit() for ch in r[0])]
    base_row = nodig[0] if nodig else min(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    others = [r for r in rows if r is not base_row] or [base_row]
    peak_row = max(others, key=lambda r: r[1])
    bl, bv = base_row
    pl, pv = peak_row
    unit = bv or 1.0
    total = max(1.0, pv / unit)
    N = int(clamp(math.ceil(total - 1e-9), 2, 6))
    totd = min(total, float(N))
    ratio = pv / unit

    A0, A1, B0, B1 = 0.06, 0.18, 0.22, 0.54
    steps = max(1, int(math.ceil(totd - 1e-9)) - 1)
    if u < A0:
        k, f, level = 0, 0.0, 0.0
    elif u < B0:
        k = 0
        f = seg(u, A0, A1)
        level = ease(seg(f, 0.2, 0.9))
    else:
        span = (B1 - B0) / steps
        i = int(clamp((u - B0) / span, 0, steps - 0.001))
        f = clamp((u - B0 - i * span) / span)
        k = 1 + i
        a, b = 1.0 + i, min(2.0 + i, totd)
        level = a + (b - a) * ease(seg(f, 0.2, 0.85))
    landed_base = u >= A1
    landed_peak = u >= B1

    wins = _bk_win(N)
    labels = []

    # the banking hall: a dark coffered ceiling, cream marble wall, stone floor
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (40, 36, 38)), (0.3, (92, 82, 74)), (0.37, (214, 204, 184)),
               (0.68, (190, 178, 158)), (0.72, (150, 132, 108)), (1, (92, 78, 64))], 0, H)
    # coffers: beams running back to the far end of the hall
    cr.save()
    cr.move_to(0, 0)
    cr.line_to(W, 0)
    cr.line_to(W, _bk_cornice(W) - 120)
    cr.line_to(0, _bk_cornice(0) - 120)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.clip()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((26, 22, 22), 0.55))
    cr.set_line_width(14)
    for i in range(12):
        cr.move_to(1300, 1020)
        cr.line_to(-1300 + i * 260, -200)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    for i in range(6):
        yy = 60 + i * 95 + i * i * 6
        cr.move_to(0, yy)
        cr.line_to(W, yy + 90 + i * 8)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()
    # the cornice: a lit moulding across the wall
    cr.move_to(0, _bk_cornice(0) - 30)
    cr.line_to(W, _bk_cornice(W) - 30)
    cr.line_to(W, _bk_cornice(W) + 14)
    cr.line_to(0, _bk_cornice(0) + 14)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (204, 190, 166))
    for i in range(5):
        z = i / 4.0
        lx = 160 + 820 * z
        ly = 300 + 260 * z
        sc = 1.0 - 0.55 * z
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 28, 30)))
        cr.set_line_width(3)
        cr.move_to(lx, 0)
        cr.line_to(lx, ly)
        cr.stroke()
        glow(cr, lx, ly + 20 * sc, 190 * sc, (255, 226, 170), 0.45)
        disc(cr, lx, ly + 10 * sc, 30 * sc, (240, 200, 120), finish="gloss")
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(0, 1300, W, H - 1300)
    cr.clip()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 58, 46), 0.35))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(14):
        cr.move_to(1300, 1020)
        cr.line_to(-1100 + i * 220, H)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()
    glow(cr, 420, 1500, 520, (255, 230, 190), 0.18)
    cast_shadow(cr, wins[0][0], wins[-1][0] + wins[-1][2], 1490, length=220, a=0.18)

    # marble columns between the cages, far first
    for j in reversed(range(N)):
        wx, top, ww, cy, s = wins[j]
        _bk_column(cr, wx + ww + 17 * s, s * 0.95, cy + 12 * s)
    _bk_column(cr, wins[0][0] - 40, 1.0, wins[0][3] + 12)

    # the teller cages, far first; q 0 is the far one, the first to close
    for j in reversed(range(N)):
        wx, top, ww, cy, s = wins[j]
        q = N - 1 - j
        d = clamp(level - q)
        wh = cy - top
        mx = wx + ww / 2
        _bk_arch(cr, wx, top, ww, cy, pad=26 * s)
        solid(cr, (226, 216, 196))
        cr.save()
        _bk_arch(cr, wx, top, ww, cy)
        cr.clip()
        vgrad(cr, [(0, (96, 74, 54)), (1, (54, 40, 30))], top, cy, wx, wx + ww)
        glow(cr, wx + ww * 0.72, cy - 50 * s, 120 * s, (255, 220, 150), 0.4)
        _bk_teller(cr, wx + ww * 0.32, cy, s)
        _bk_cash(cr, wx + ww * 0.5, cy - 4 * s, s * 0.8)
        if d > 0:
            sh = wh * d
            cr.rectangle(wx, top, ww, sh)
            solid(cr, (176, 180, 186), finish="metal", rim=False)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((96, 100, 108), 0.8))
            cr.set_line_width(max(2, 3 * s))
            yy = top + 22 * s
            while yy < top + sh - 8:
                cr.move_to(wx, yy)
                cr.line_to(wx + ww, yy)
                yy += 22 * s
            cr.stroke()
            cr.rectangle(wx, top + sh - 16 * s, ww, 16 * s)
            solid(cr, P["accent2"] if q >= 1 else (84, 88, 96), finish="metal")
            if d >= 0.999:
                labels.append((f"{q + 1}x", wx + ww * 0.5, top + wh * 0.62,
                               max(22, int(48 * s))))
        cr.move_to(wx + 10 * s, top + 60 * s)
        cr.line_to(wx + 80 * s, top + 30 * s)
        cr.line_to(wx + 10 * s, top + 260 * s)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 255, 255), 0.14))
        cr.fill()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass"]))
        cr.set_line_width(max(2, 5 * s))
        nb = 7
        for b_ in range(1, nb):
            bx = wx + ww * b_ / nb
            cr.move_to(bx, top)
            cr.line_to(bx, cy - 110 * s)
        cr.move_to(wx, top + ww * 0.5)
        cr.line_to(wx + ww, top + ww * 0.5)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.restore()
        _bk_arch(cr, wx, top, ww, cy)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass_shade"]))
        cr.set_line_width(max(3, 10 * s))
        cr.stroke()
        _bk_dollar(cr, mx, top - 26 * s, 40 * s)
        cr.new_path()
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(mx, cy)
        cr.scale(1, 0.55)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 50 * s, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (30, 24, 20), rim=False)
        box(cr, wx - 10 * s, top + 6 * s, ww + 20 * s, 26 * s, (128, 132, 140),
            depth=14 * s, finish="metal")
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((50, 52, 58)))
        cr.set_line_width(max(2, 5 * s))
        cr.move_to(wx + ww + 34 * s, top + 40 * s)
        cr.line_to(wx + ww + 34 * s, top + wh * 0.6)
        cr.stroke()
        disc(cr, wx + ww + 34 * s, top + wh * 0.6, 10 * s, (90, 92, 100), finish="metal")
        contact_shadow(cr, mx, cy + 112 * s, ww + 60 * s, a=0.3)
        box(cr, wx - 22 * s, cy + 110 * s, ww + 44 * s, 104 * s, (120, 82, 52),
            depth=26 * s, finish="gloss")
        for p_ in range(3):
            cr.rectangle(wx - 8 * s + p_ * (ww + 16 * s) / 3, cy + 30 * s,
                         (ww + 16 * s) / 3 - 14 * s, 64 * s)
            edge(cr, (80, 52, 32), width=max(2, 3 * s))
        box(cr, wx - 30 * s, cy + 12 * s, ww + 60 * s, 14 * s, (232, 224, 210),
            depth=30 * s, finish="gloss")
        _bk_bill(cr, mx - 50 * s, cy - 2 * s, 70 * s, 30 * s, -0.12)

    # right by the camera: a jeans pocket, low in the frame, with the bank in it
    rise = ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.12))
    cr.move_to(560, H)
    cr.curve_to(600, 1800, 740, 1690, W, 1660)
    cr.line_to(W, H)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (44, 66, 104))
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(860, 1760 + 220 * (1 - rise))
    cr.scale(0.8, 0.8)
    _bk_phone(cr, t, 0, 0, -0.16)
    cr.restore()
    cr.move_to(640, H)
    cr.curve_to(670, 1840, 730, 1790, 790, 1782)
    cr.curve_to(900, 1760, 990, 1756, W, 1770)
    cr.line_to(W, H)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (56, 84, 130))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((214, 164, 80)))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    cr.set_dash([14, 10])
    cr.move_to(676, H)
    cr.curve_to(700, 1860, 750, 1812, 800, 1806)
    cr.curve_to(900, 1786, 990, 1782, W, 1796)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_dash([])

    # the bank queue's velvet rope on brass posts, by the lens on the left
    posts = [(60, 1800), (270, 1760), (470, 1730)]
    for i in range(len(posts) - 1):
        (x0, y0), (x1, y1) = posts[i], posts[i + 1]
        t0, t1 = y0 - 170, y1 - 170
        mxr = (x0 + x1) / 2

# scene standard: 2026-10-11.2
def _dd_gear(cr, x, y, r, ang, teeth=14, rgb=(196, 156, 74)):
    n = teeth * 2
    for i in range(n * 2):
        a = ang + i * math.pi / n
        rr = r if (i // 2) % 2 == 0 else r * 0.84
        px, py = x + rr * math.cos(a), y + rr * math.sin(a)
        if i == 0:
            cr.move_to(px, py)
        else:
            cr.line_to(px, py)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, rgb, finish="metal")
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((92, 70, 34)))
    cr.set_line_width(max(3, r * 0.07))
    for i in range(4):
        a = ang + i * math.pi / 2
        cr.move_to(x + r * 0.2 * math.cos(a), y + r * 0.2 * math.sin(a))
        cr.line_to(x + r * 0.72 * math.cos(a), y + r * 0.72 * math.sin(a))
    cr.stroke()
    disc(cr, x, y, r * 0.2, (150, 116, 56), finish="metal")


def _dd_hand_path(cr, cx, cy, ang, length, width):
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(cx, cy)
    cr.rotate(ang)
    cr.move_to(-length * 0.14, -width * 0.5)
    cr.line_to(length * 0.82, -width * 0.5)
    cr.line_to(length, 0)
    cr.line_to(length * 0.82, width * 0.5)
    cr.line_to(-length * 0.14, width * 0.5)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.restore()


def _dd_ang(minutes):
    return -math.pi / 2 - minutes / 60.0 * 2 * math.pi


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a clock tower's giant clock face
    SUBSTANCE: the clock's minute hand
    CAUSE: Data cranks the tower's winding gear and the minute hand turns toward midnight
    The Doomsday Clock as a real clock tower in a town at sunset. Each year
    Data turns the winding crank at the tower's foot, the gear train turns,
    and the big minute hand swings to that year's setting, read in seconds
    to midnight straight from the data. The time left before midnight is
    the accent wedge between the hand and 12, so it shrinks you can see
    from across the room; every landed year leaves a notch on the rim and
    its old hand stays as a ghost. Done by 0.56 and held; the pendulum
    keeps swinging and Data keeps cranking."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    n = len(rows)
    a0, a1 = 0.1, 0.56
    span = (a1 - a0) / max(1, n)
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    slide = ease(seg(f, 0.15, 0.7))
    start_m = 15.0
    prev = rows[k - 1][1] / 60.0 if k > 0 else start_m
    cur = rows[k][1] / 60.0
    m_now = start_m if u < a0 else prev + (cur - prev) * slide
    landed_to = (k if slide >= 0.999 else k - 1) if u >= a0 else -1
    keep = sorted({round(i * (n - 1) / max(1, READOUT_SHOWS - 1))
                   for i in range(READOUT_SHOWS)}) if n > READOUT_SHOWS else list(range(n))
    named = max((i for i in keep if i <= landed_to), default=None)
    shown = None if named is None else rows[named]

    gy = landscape(cr, t, "town")
    haze(cr, 300, gy, (226, 208, 192), a=0.2)

    # the clock tower, three-quarter view
    TX0, TX1, BASE = 180, 800, 1440
    cast_shadow(cr, TX0, TX1, BASE, length=300, a=0.32)
    contact_shadow(cr, (TX0 + TX1) / 2, BASE + 4, TX1 - TX0 + 80, a=0.4)
    b = building(cr, TX0, TX1, BASE, 760, (156, 144, 130), roof="flat", boards=False)
    cx, cy, R = (b["x0"] + b["x1"]) / 2, 960, 240

    # the dial: brass rim, ivory face, minute ticks
    cr.arc(cx, cy, R + 22, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    solid(cr, (190, 150, 70), finish="metal")
    cr.arc(cx, cy, R, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    solid(cr, (240, 234, 216), finish="gloss", rim=False)
    # the time left before midnight, the accent wedge
    a_h = _dd_ang(m_now)
    cr.move_to(cx, cy)
    cr.arc(cx, cy, R * 0.92, a_h, -math.pi / 2)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"], 0.6))
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 36, 34)))
    for i in range(60):
        a = -math.pi / 2 + i * math.pi / 30
        big = i % 5 == 0
        r0 = R * (0.82 if big else 0.9)
        cr.set_line_width(9 if big else 3)
        cr.move_to(cx + r0 * math.cos(a), cy + r0 * math.sin(a))
        cr.line_to(cx + R * 0.97 * math.cos(a), cy + R * 0.97 * math.sin(a))
        cr.stroke()

    # ghosts of the years the hand has left behind
    for j in range(0, landed_to + 1):
        if j == landed_to:
            continue
        _dd_hand_path(cr, cx, cy, _dd_ang(rows[j][1] / 60.0), R * 0.9, 22)
        ghost(cr, a=0.9)
    # notches on the rim for every landed year
    for j in range(0, landed_to + 1):
        a = _dd_ang(rows[j][1] / 60.0)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((244, 238, 226)))
        cr.set_line_width(7)
        cr.move_to(cx + (R + 4) * math.cos(a), cy + (R + 4) * math.sin(a))
        cr.line_to(cx + (R + 40) * math.cos(a), cy + (R + 40) * math.sin(a))
        cr.stroke()
        lx = max(90, cx + (R + 72) * math.cos(a))
        ly = cy + (R + 72) * math.sin(a) + 10
        text(cr, rows[j][0], lx, ly, 30, look.INK, face="bold", anchor="center")

    # the hands
    _dd_hand_path(cr, cx, cy, -math.pi / 2 - m_now / 720.0 * 2 * math.pi,
                  R * 0.55, 30)
    solid(cr, (34, 32, 36), finish="metal")
    _dd_hand_path(cr, cx, cy, a_h, R * 0.9, 22)
    solid(cr, (30, 28, 32), finish="metal")
    disc(cr, cx, cy, 22, (190, 150, 70), finish="metal")

    # the pendulum case under the dial, the bob always swinging
    PX0, PX1, PY0, PY1 = cx - 110, cx + 110, 1225, 1425
    cr.rectangle(PX0, PY0, PX1 - PX0, PY1 - PY0)
    solid(cr, (46, 36, 32), rim=False)
    sw = 0.4 * math.sin(t * math.pi)
    bx, by = cx + 160 * math.sin(sw), PY0 + 10 + 160 * math.cos(sw)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((170, 140, 80)))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    cr.move_to(cx, PY0 + 10)
    cr.line_to(bx, by)
    cr.stroke()
    disc(cr, bx, by, 36, (210, 168, 80), finish="metal")
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((244, 238, 226)))
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    cr.rectangle(PX0, PY0, PX1 - PX0, PY1 - PY0)
    cr.stroke()

    # the winding gear at the tower's foot and its shaft into the tower
    gang = (start_m - m_now) * 0.9
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 66, 64)))
    cr.set_line_width(12)
    cr.move_to(TX1, 1340)
    cr.line_to(960, 1340)
    cr.stroke()
    contact_shadow(cr, 960, 1444, 120, a=0.35)
    box(cr, 945, 1444, 30, 100, (90, 86, 84), finish="metal")
    _dd_gear(cr, 960, 1340, 62, gang, teeth=12)

    # by the camera: the big drive gear of the clockwork, turning with the crank
    _dd_gear(cr, 130, 1760, 210, -gang * 0.4, teeth=18)
    foreground(cr, "town")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data: points up at the clock, walks to the crank, cranks each year in
    walk_in = ease(seg(u, 0.03, 0.1))
    hx = 680 + 180 * walk_in
    if u < 0.04:
        host("point", hx, 1480, 220)
    elif u < a1 + 0.04:
        host("crank", hx, 1480, 220, beat=k)
    elif u < 0.9:
        host("crank", hx, 1480, 220, beat=n)
    else:
        host("shock", hx, 1480, 220)

    if shown is not None:
        lab, v = shown
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v)):,} seconds", f"to midnight · {lab}", 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, a0, a0 + 0.05)), size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Doomsday Clock", f"time to midnight since {rows[0][0]}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

def _hg_glass(cr, cx, y0, ny, y1, hw, nw):
