def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a giant hourglass of sand
    SUBSTANCE: falling sand
    CAUSE: Data opens the brass valve at the hourglass neck and the sand pours down out of the top
    The time left before midnight is the sand still in the top bulb. In
    1991 the top bulb held all 1,020 seconds of it; each time Data opens
    the valve at the neck another run of sand pours down, until only the
    2025 share is left, 89 seconds, a sliver above the neck. The 1991
    level stays marked on the glass, so a glance reads how little is left.
    A pocket watch by the camera sits a minute and a half before twelve.
    Lands by 0.62 and holds; a thin trickle keeps falling and Data keeps
    working the valve, the level does not move."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    y0 = l0.split()[0]
    y1 = l1.split()[0]
    v0 = v0 or 1.0
    n = 6
    a0, a1 = 0.14, 0.62
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    run = ease(seg(f, 0.15, 0.8))
    flowing = a0 <= u < a1 and 0.1 < f < 0.85
    step = 0.0 if u < a0 else (1.0 if u >= a1 else (k + run) / n)
    val = v0 + (v1 - v0) * step
    frac = clamp(val / v0)

    CX, Y0, NY, Y1 = 540, 690, 1045, 1400
    HW, NW = 240, 16
    SAND = (214, 176, 108)

    landscape(cr, t, "desert")
    birds(cr, t, y0=760, n=3, rgb=(60, 50, 50))

    cast_shadow(cr, 220, 860, 1450, length=340, a=0.32)
    contact_shadow(cr, CX, 1454, 700, a=0.45)
    cylinder(cr, 220, 1450, 640, 50, (120, 78, 44))
    for px in (330, 726):                                  # the back posts
        cylinder(cr, px, 1400, 24, 720, (86, 56, 32))

    # the glass, then the sand inside it
    _hg_glass(cr, CX, Y0, NY, Y1, HW, NW)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((214, 232, 242), 0.22))
    cr.fill()
    yl = NY - 330 * frac ** 0.7
    hb = 20 + 300 * (1 - frac) ** 0.8
    yb = Y1 - hb
    cr.save()
    _hg_glass(cr, CX, Y0, NY, Y1, HW, NW)
    cr.clip()
    cr.move_to(CX - HW - 10, yl)
    cr.line_to(CX, yl + 30)
    cr.line_to(CX + HW + 10, yl)
    cr.line_to(CX + HW + 10, NY + 4)
    cr.line_to(CX - HW - 10, NY + 4)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, SAND, rim=False)
    cr.move_to(CX - HW - 10, Y1 + 5)
    cr.line_to(CX - HW - 10, yb + 70)
    cr.curve_to(CX - 120, yb + 30, CX - 40, yb, CX, yb)
    cr.curve_to(CX + 40, yb, CX + 120, yb + 30, CX + HW + 10, yb + 70)
    cr.line_to(CX + HW + 10, Y1 + 5)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, SAND)
    if u >= a0:                                             # the falling stream
        sw = 12 if flowing else 3
        cr.rectangle(CX - sw / 2, NY, sw, max(0, yb - NY))
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(SAND))
        cr.fill()
    cr.restore()
    # glass highlights and its edge
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 255, 255), 0.45))
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    cr.move_to(CX - HW + 40, Y0 + 30)
    cr.curve_to(CX - HW + 30, Y0 + 160, CX - 140, NY - 90, CX - 60, NY - 40)
    cr.move_to(CX - HW + 40, Y1 - 30)
    cr.curve_to(CX - HW + 30, Y1 - 140, CX - 140, NY + 90, CX - 60, NY + 40)
    cr.stroke()
    _hg_glass(cr, CX, Y0, NY, Y1, HW, NW)
    edge(cr, (60, 70, 80))

    for px in (246, 804):                                   # the front posts
        cylinder(cr, px, 1400, 30, 720, (128, 84, 48))
    cylinder(cr, 220, 680, 640, 50, (120, 78, 44))

    # the brass valve at the neck, its wheel turning as it opens
    disc(cr, CX, NY, 28, P["brass"], finish="metal")
    box(cr, CX + 20, NY + 9, 300, 18, P["brass_shade"], depth=6, finish="metal")
    WX = CX + 330
    turn = (k + run) * 1.3 if u >= a0 else 0.0
    if u >= a1:
        turn = n * 1.3 + 0.6 * ((u - a1) / 0.07)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 90, 30)))
    cr.set_line_width(14)
    cr.arc(WX, NY, 40, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass"]))
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    cr.arc(WX, NY, 40, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    for i in range(4):
        a = turn + i * math.pi / 2
        cr.move_to(WX, NY)
        cr.line_to(WX + 40 * math.cos(a), NY + 40 * math.sin(a))
    cr.stroke()
    disc(cr, WX, NY, 10, P["brass"], finish="metal")

    # the ladder he climbs to reach it
    for rx in (895, 965):
        box(cr, rx, 1484, 12, 360, (110, 76, 46), depth=6)
    for ry in range(1180, 1480, 60):
        box(cr, 895, ry, 82, 10, (128, 88, 52), depth=6)

    # right by the camera: a pocket watch a minute and a half before twelve
    _hg_watch(cr, 190, 1730, 96)
    foreground(cr, "desert")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data: points from the sand, climbs the ladder, works the valve
    if u < 0.04:
        host("point", 990, 1480, 220)
    elif u < a0:
        c = ease(seg(u, 0.04, a0))
        host("climb", 990 - 60 * c, 1480 - 310 * c, 220)
    elif u < a1:
        host("tap", 930, 1170, 220, beat=k)
    elif u < 0.93:
        host("tap", 930, 1170, 220, beat=n + int((u - a1) / 0.07))
    else:
        host("shock", 930, 1170, 220)

    # the 1991 level marked on the glass, drawn after Data, clear of him
    if step > 0.02:
        then_mark(cr, CX - HW + 20, CX + HW - 20, NY - 330, y0)

    if u >= a1:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v1))} seconds", f"to midnight · {y1}, the closest ever",
                    80, 520, size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v0)):,} seconds", f"to midnight · {y0}, the safest ever",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

segments.topic: what's driving the Doomsday Clock to 89 seconds
segments.say: Back then it was just nuclear war. Today the scientists point to 4 converging threats: nuclear risk, climate change, bio threats, and AI.
segments.illustrated_scene:
# scene standard: 2026-10-11.2
def _dc_icon(cr, kind, cx, cy, s):
    ink = (30, 28, 34)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(ink))
    if kind == 0:                                   # nuclear: the trefoil
        for a in (0, 2, 4):
            a0 = -math.pi / 2 + a * math.pi / 3 - math.pi / 6
            cr.move_to(cx, cy)
            cr.arc(cx, cy, 34 * s, a0, a0 + math.pi / 3)
            cr.close_path()
            cr.fill()
        cr.arc(cx, cy, 8 * s, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()
    elif kind == 1:                                 # climate: a flame
        cr.move_to(cx, cy - 38 * s)
        cr.curve_to(cx + 34 * s, cy - 6 * s, cx + 30 * s, cy + 34 * s, cx, cy + 36 * s)
        cr.curve_to(cx - 30 * s, cy + 34 * s, cx - 30 * s, cy + 4 * s, cx - 12 * s, cy - 10 * s)
        cr.curve_to(cx - 10 * s, cy + 6 * s, cx - 2 * s, cy + 8 * s, cx, cy - 38 * s)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.fill()
    elif kind == 2:                                 # bio: three rings
        cr.set_line_width(7 * s)
        for a in (0, 2, 4):
            ang = -math.pi / 2 + a * math.pi / 3
            cr.new_sub_path()
            cr.arc(cx + 16 * s * math.cos(ang), cy + 16 * s * math.sin(ang), 17 * s,
                   0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.arc(cx, cy, 7 * s, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()
    else:                                           # AI: a chip with pins
        cr.rectangle(cx - 22 * s, cy - 22 * s, 44 * s, 44 * s)
        cr.fill()
        cr.set_line_width(5 * s)
        for i in range(3):
            o = (i - 1) * 13 * s
            cr.move_to(cx + o, cy - 34 * s)
            cr.line_to(cx + o, cy + 34 * s)
            cr.move_to(cx - 34 * s, cy + o)
            cr.line_to(cx + 34 * s, cy + o)
        cr.stroke()


# each fuse: where it leaves the frame (E), where it rises off the ground (G),
# and how far from the cap's centre it plugs in — two from the back, two from
# the front, so no two cords run side by side
_BF_FUSES = [((-60, 1330), (230, 1360), -16),
             ((1140, 1330), (850, 1360), 16),
             ((-60, 1660), (330, 1470), -40),
             ((1140, 1660), (750, 1470), 40)]
_BF_CAP_Y = 768


def _bf_path(i):
    (ex, ey), (gx, gy), off = _BF_FUSES[i]
    side = -1 if gx < 540 else 1
    ps = []
    for j in range(17):
        s = j / 16
        ps.append((ex + (gx - ex) * s, ey + (gy - ey) * s + 22 * math.sin(math.pi * s)))
    c1 = (gx + side * 40, gy - 320)
    c2 = (540 + side * (300 if i < 2 else 180), 660)
    e = (540 + off, _BF_CAP_Y)
    for j in range(1, 29):
        s = j / 28
        m = 1 - s
        x = m ** 3 * gx + 3 * m * m * s * c1[0] + 3 * m * s * s * c2[0] + s ** 3 * e[0]
        y = m ** 3 * gy + 3 * m * m * s * c1[1] + 3 * m * s * s * c2[1] + s ** 3 * e[1]
        ps.append((x, y))
    cum = [0.0]
    for a, b in zip(ps, ps[1:]):
        cum.append(cum[-1] + math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]))
    return ps, cum


def _bf_at(ps, cum, fr):
    L = cum[-1] * clamp(fr)
    for j in range(1, len(ps)):
        if cum[j] >= L:
            seg_l = cum[j] - cum[j - 1] or 1.0
            q = (L - cum[j - 1]) / seg_l
            return (ps[j - 1][0] + (ps[j][0] - ps[j - 1][0]) * q,
                    ps[j - 1][1] + (ps[j][1] - ps[j - 1][1]) * q)
    return ps[-1]


def _bf_line(cr, line):
    cr.move_to(*line[0])
    for p_ in line[1:]:
        cr.line_to(*p_)


def _bf_stroke(cr, ps, cum, f0, f1, rgb, w, braid=True):
    """A braided fuse cord: an ink edge, the cord, a darker twist along it."""
    if f1 - f0 <= 0.002:
        return
    L0, L1 = cum[-1] * f0, cum[-1] * f1
    line = [_bf_at(ps, cum, f0)]
    for j, p_ in enumerate(ps):
        if L0 < cum[j] < L1:
            line.append(p_)
    line.append(_bf_at(ps, cum, f1))
    cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
    cr.set_line_join(cairo.LINE_JOIN_ROUND)
    for width, col in ((w + 8, (28, 24, 22)), (w, rgb)):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(col))
        cr.set_line_width(width)
        _bf_line(cr, line)
        cr.stroke()
    if braid:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(tuple(int(c * 0.62) for c in rgb)))
        cr.set_line_width(w * 0.55)
        cr.set_dash([w * 0.5, w * 0.7])
        _bf_line(cr, line)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.set_dash([])
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 244, 214), 0.55))
        cr.set_line_width(max(2, w * 0.18))
        cr.translate(-w * 0.2, -w * 0.2)
        _bf_line(cr, line)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.translate(w * 0.2, w * 0.2)


def _bf_spark(cr, x, y, t, i, s=1.0):
    """The burning end of a fuse: a hot glow, a white core, rays spitting."""
    glow(cr, x, y, 110 * s, (255, 150, 40), 0.9)
    glow(cr, x, y, 50 * s, (255, 236, 160), 1.0)
    cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
    for r in range(9):
        ang = r * 2 * math.pi / 9 + t * 2.1 + i
        ln = (34 + 18 * ((r * 7 + i) % 3)) * s
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 226, 120), 0.95))
        cr.set_line_width(5 * s)
        cr.move_to(x + 12 * s * math.cos(ang), y + 12 * s * math.sin(ang))
        cr.line_to(x + ln * math.cos(ang), y + ln * math.sin(ang))
        cr.stroke()
    disc(cr, x, y, 14 * s, (255, 248, 210), finish="gloss")
    # a curl of smoke trailing up off it
    for q in range(3):
        ph = (t * 0.6 + q / 3 + i * 0.23) % 1.0
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 112, 108), 0.35 * (1 - ph)))
        cr.arc(x + 14 * math.sin(ph * 5 + i), y - 30 - 90 * ph, (10 + 22 * ph) * s,
               0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()


def _bf_sign(cr, x, base, s, kind, word, a):
    if a <= 0:
        return
    cr.push_group()
    contact_shadow(cr, x, base, 70 * s, a=0.35)
    box(cr, x - 7 * s, base, 14 * s, 170 * s, (120, 92, 64), depth=6 * s)
    cy = base - 200 * s
    r = 70 * s
    cr.move_to(x, cy - r)
    cr.line_to(x + r, cy)
    cr.line_to(x, cy + r)
    cr.line_to(x - r, cy)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (242, 198, 44), finish="gloss")
    cr.move_to(x, cy - r + 9 * s)
    cr.line_to(x + r - 9 * s, cy)
    cr.line_to(x, cy + r - 9 * s)
    cr.line_to(x - r + 9 * s, cy)
    cr.close_path()
    edge(cr, (30, 28, 34), width=4 * s)
    _dc_icon(cr, kind, x, cy, 0.8 * s)
    # the word on a plaque on the post, under the diamond — never over a neighbour
    pw = max(70 * s, len(word) * 19 * s + 24 * s)
    box(cr, x - pw / 2, cy + r + 52 * s, pw, 40 * s, (240, 236, 226), depth=6 * s)
    text(cr, word, x, cy + r + 42 * s, int(26 * s), (30, 28, 34), face="bold",
         anchor="center", shadow=False)
    cr.pop_group_to_source()
    cr.paint_with_alpha(a)


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a giant round black bomb
    SUBSTANCE: burning fuse cords
    CAUSE: Data hauls each new fuse cord in hand over hand and plugs it into the bomb, one per threat
    The cartoon bomb everyone knows — the black sphere, the gloss, the
    riveted collar, the cap, the lit fuse — sitting on a desert test range.
    In 1947 one fuse burned toward it: nuclear war. Data hauls in a fresh
    braided fuse for each threat named today — climate, bio, AI — until it
    reaches the cap and catches, so four sparks spit and creep toward one
    bomb from four sides. A hazard sign stands at each fuse, the 1947 one
    marked with its year, so one look reads one fuse then, four now. Done by
    0.56 and held: the sparks keep creeping and Data keeps hauling slack."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    y0 = l0.split(" ")[0]
    y1 = l1.split(" ")[0]
    first = max(1, int(round(v0)))
    total = max(first, int(round(v1)))
    first_d = min(first, 4)
    total_d = min(total, 4)
    new = total_d - first_d
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.56
    span = (a1 - a0) / max(1, new)
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, max(1, new) - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    walk_f = ease(seg(f, 0.0, 0.3))
    tips, lit_at = [], []
    for i in range(total_d):
        if i < first_d:
            tips.append(1.0)
            lit_at.append(0.0)
            continue
        j = i - first_d
        lit_at.append(a0 + j * span + 0.85 * span)
        if u < a0 or j > k:
            tips.append(0.0)
        elif j < k:
            tips.append(1.0)
        else:
            tips.append(ease(seg(f, 0.15, 0.85)))
    done = new == 0 or (u >= a0 and k == new - 1 and f >= 0.85)

    landscape(cr, t, "desert")
    # far mesas under the haze, so the range has a horizon to it
    ridge(cr, 1175, 120, seed=2.0, n=4)
    solid(cr, (196, 140, 104), edge=False)
    ridge(cr, 1185, 60, seed=5.0, n=6)
    solid(cr, (214, 164, 118), edge=False)
    haze(cr, 900, 1190, (236, 206, 170), a=0.5)

    # the hazard signs, one standing where each fuse comes off the ground
    LAB = ["NUCLEAR", "CLIMATE", "BIO", "AI"]
    SIGNS = [(105, 1300, 1.0), (975, 1300, 1.0), (200, 1215, 0.78), (880, 1215, 0.78)]
    for i in (3, 2, 1, 0):
        if i >= total_d:
            continue
        sx, sb, ss = SIGNS[i]
        sa = 1.0 if i < first_d else ease(seg(tips[i], 0.5, 0.9))
        _bf_sign(cr, sx, sb, ss, i % 4, LAB[i % 4], sa)
        if i == 0 and new > 0 and u >= a0:
            text(cr, y0, sx, sb + 44, 34, look.INK, face="bold", anchor="center")

    # the bomb: sphere, riveted collar, cap
    BX, BY, BR = 540, 1050, 250
    cast_shadow(cr, BX - BR + 30, BX + BR - 30, BY + BR, length=400, a=0.34)
    contact_shadow(cr, BX, BY + BR + 2, 2 * BR - 10, a=0.55)
    disc(cr, BX, BY, BR, (40, 40, 50), finish="gloss")
    glow(cr, BX - 100, BY - 110, 80, (255, 255, 255), 0.28)
    cylinder(cr, BX - 80, BY - BR + 34, 160, 40, (100, 102, 112), finish="metal")
    for r_ in range(6):
        disc(cr, BX - 62 + r_ * 25, BY - BR + 14, 6, (170, 172, 180), finish="metal")
    cylinder(cr, BX - 60, _BF_CAP_Y + 70, 120, 70, (156, 158, 166), finish="metal")

    # the fuses: cord from the frame edge to the cap, burnt behind the spark
    sparks = []
    for i in range(total_d):
        if tips[i] <= 0:
            continue
        ps, cum = _bf_path(i)
        tip = tips[i]
        if tip < 0.999:                       # still being hauled in
            _bf_stroke(cr, ps, cum, 0.0, tip, (210, 178, 116), 15)
            continue
        burn = 0.0
        if u >= lit_at[i]:
            burn = 0.06 + 0.32 * (u - lit_at[i])
        if burn > 0:
            _bf_stroke(cr, ps, cum, 0.0, burn, (92, 86, 82), 9, braid=False)
        _bf_stroke(cr, ps, cum, burn, 1.0, (210, 178, 116), 15)
        if burn > 0:
            sparks.append((_bf_at(ps, cum, burn), i))
    for (sx_, sy_), i in sparks:
        _bf_spark(cr, sx_, sy_, t, i)

    # right by the camera: a wooden drum of spare fuse on its side, a rock
    contact_shadow(cr, 880, 1880, 320, a=0.45)
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(880, 1760)
    cr.scale(0.55, 1.0)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 150, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (150, 108, 66))
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(880, 1760)
    cr.scale(0.55, 1.0)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 112, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (210, 178, 116), rim=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 120, 74)))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    for r_ in range(6):
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(880, 1760)
        cr.scale(0.55, 1.0)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 40 + r_ * 13, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.stroke()
    disc(cr, 880, 1760, 24, (70, 54, 40))
    contact_shadow(cr, 150, 1830, 220, a=0.4)
    cr.move_to(40, 1830)
    cr.curve_to(50, 1730, 160, 1700, 230, 1740)
    cr.curve_to(270, 1770, 270, 1820, 260, 1830)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (168, 120, 88))
    foreground(cr, "desert")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data hauls each new fuse in, standing on the cord where it leaves the
    # ground, the slack running from his hands back to the frame edge
    GP = [(g[0] + (60 if g[0] < 540 else -60), g[1] + 30) for _, g, _ in _BF_FUSES]
    HH = 230
    if u < a0 or new == 0:
        hx, hy = GP[first_d - 1]
        role, bt = "point", 0
    elif u < a1 + 0.02:
        px, py = GP[first_d + k - 1]
        nx, ny = GP[first_d + k]
        hx, hy = px + (nx - px) * walk_f, py + (ny - py) * walk_f
        role, bt = "haul", k
    elif u < 0.92:
        hx, hy = GP[total_d - 1]
        role, bt = "haul", new + int((u - a1) / 0.12)
    else:
        hx, hy = GP[total_d - 1]
        role, bt = "shock", 0
    hy = min(1520.0, hy)
    if role == "haul":
        # the cord in his hands, running back to where this fuse lies
        idx = first_d + k if u < a1 + 0.02 else total_d - 1
        ps, cum = _bf_path(idx)
        gx_, gy_ = _bf_at(ps, cum, 0.25)
        hand = (hx + (30 if hx < 540 else -30), hy - HH * 0.5)
        cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
        for width, col in ((21, (28, 24, 22)), (13, (210, 178, 116))):
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(col))
            cr.set_line_width(width)
            cr.move_to(gx_, gy_)
            cr.curve_to(gx_ + (hand[0] - gx_) * 0.5, gy_ + 40,
                        hand[0], hand[1] + 60, *hand)
            cr.stroke()
    host(role, hx, hy, HH, beat=bt)

    if done and u >= a0:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{total} threats", f"driving the Doomsday Clock · {y1}",
                    80, 520, size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{first} threat" if first == 1 else f"{first} threats",
                    f"nuclear war · {y0}", 80, 520,

# scene standard: 2026-10-11.2
def _wf_wave(x0, L, t, i):
    def off(x):
        q = clamp((x - x0) / max(1.0, L))
        return 16 * q * math.sin(q * 5.2 - t * 5.0 - i * 0.9)
    return off


def _wf_flag(cr, x0, y0, L, h, t, i, rgb):
    off = _wf_wave(x0, L, t, i)
    n = 14
    cr.move_to(x0, y0)
    for j in range(1, n + 1):
        x = x0 + L * j / n
        cr.line_to(x, y0 + off(x))
    for j in range(n, -1, -1):
        x = x0 + L * j / n
        cr.line_to(x, y0 + h + off(x))
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, rgb, finish="matte")
    return off


def _wf_symbol(cr, cx, cy, r, kind, t):
    ink = (22, 20, 24)
    if kind == 0:            # radiation trefoil: nuclear
        for a in (-math.pi / 2, math.pi / 6, 5 * math.pi / 6):
            cr.move_to(cx, cy)
            cr.arc(cx, cy, r, a - 0.52, a + 0.52)
            cr.close_path()
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(ink))
            cr.fill()
        disc(cr, cx, cy, r * 0.3, (236, 70, 52))
        disc(cr, cx, cy, r * 0.18, ink)
    elif kind == 1:          # a flame: climate
        cr.move_to(cx, cy + r)
        cr.curve_to(cx - r * 1.0, cy + r * 0.6, cx - r * 0.7, cy - r * 0.2, cx - r * 0.1, cy - r * 1.1)
        cr.curve_to(cx + r * 0.1, cy - r * 0.4, cx + r * 0.5, cy - r * 0.5, cx + r * 0.45, cy - r * 0.9)
        cr.curve_to(cx + r * 1.0, cy - r * 0.1, cx + r * 0.9, cy + r * 0.7, cx, cy + r)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (250, 196, 64), finish="gloss")
        cr.move_to(cx, cy + r * 0.85)
        cr.curve_to(cx - r * 0.45, cy + r * 0.5, cx - r * 0.2, cy, cx + r * 0.05, cy - r * 0.35)
        cr.curve_to(cx + r * 0.45, cy + r * 0.1, cx + r * 0.4, cy + r * 0.6, cx, cy + r * 0.85)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (255, 240, 190), edge=False, rim=False)
    elif kind == 2:          # biohazard rings
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(ink))
        cr.set_line_width(max(6, r * 0.16))
        for a in (-math.pi / 2, math.pi / 6, 5 * math.pi / 6):
            cr.new_sub_path()
            cr.arc(cx + r * 0.42 * math.cos(a), cy + r * 0.42 * math.sin(a), r * 0.5, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.arc(cx, cy, r * 0.22, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.stroke()
    else:                    # a chip: AI
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(ink))
        cr.set_line_width(6)
        for k_ in range(4):
            d = -r * 0.6 + k_ * r * 0.4
            cr.move_to(cx + d, cy - r)
            cr.line_to(cx + d, cy + r)
            cr.move_to(cx - r, cy + d)
            cr.line_to(cx + r, cy + d)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.rectangle(cx - r * 0.72, cy - r * 0.72, r * 1.44, r * 1.44)
        solid(cr, (40, 40, 48), finish="gloss")
        text(cr, "AI", cx, cy + r * 0.24, int(r * 0.7), (240, 236, 226), face="bold",
             anchor="center", shadow=False)


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a harbour storm-warning mast
    SUBSTANCE: red warning flags
    CAUSE: Data hauls the halyard hand over hand, hoisting another warning flag up the mast for each threat
    The closing: a harbour at dusk under a rolling storm, the warning mast
    on the stone jetty. In 1947 it flew one flag, nuclear war. Now Data
    hauls up the rest, one pull per threat, until all four fly at once:
    the scientists aren't being dramatic, the flags are just up. The 1947
    level stays marked on the mast so a glance reads one then, four now.
    Done by 0.55 and held: the flags crack in the wind, the storm rolls in,
    and Data holds the line taut."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    n_then = int(clamp(round(v0), 1, 6))
    n_now = int(clamp(round(v1), n_then, 6))
    m = max(1, n_now - n_then)
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.55
    span = (a1 - a0) / m
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, m - 0.001))

    # the harbour at dusk
    gy = landscape(cr, t, "coast")
    # the far town across the water, lights coming on
    for i, (x0, x1, hh) in enumerate([(30, 150, 110), (170, 260, 150), (600, 720, 120),
                                      (740, 830, 170), (860, 1000, 130)]):
        b = building(cr, x0, x1, gy, hh, (150, 140, 132), roof="gable" if i % 2 else "flat",
                     boards=False)
        for wx in range(int(x0) + 18, int(x1) - 10, 34):
            glow(cr, wx + 6, b["base"] - hh * 0.55, 18, (255, 210, 130), 0.5)
    haze(cr, 700, gy + 10, (120, 118, 132), a=0.5)
    # the storm rolling in from the right, darkening the sky
    roll = 260 * ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.6)) + 18 * t
    for i in range(7):
        cx = 1250 - roll + i * 150 - (i % 2) * 60
        cy = 640 + (i % 3) * 90
        g = cairo.RadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, 300)
        g.add_color_stop_rgba(0, 0.22, 0.23, 0.29, 0.85)
        g.add_color_stop_rgba(1, 0.22, 0.23, 0.29, 0.0)
        cr.set_source(g)
        cr.arc(cx, cy, 300, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()
    # the water, choppy
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    for i in range(16):
        wy = gy + 20 + i * 16
        ph = t * (1.6 + 0.1 * (i % 3)) + i
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((230, 236, 244), 0.35))
        x = -40 + ((i * 97 + t * 60) % 140)
        while x < W:
            cr.move_to(x, wy + 5 * math.sin(ph + x * 0.02))
            cr.line_to(x + 50, wy + 5 * math.sin(ph + (x + 50) * 0.02))
            x += 140
        cr.stroke()

    # the stone jetty running to the camera
    cr.move_to(80, 1420)
    cr.line_to(900, 1400)
    cr.line_to(1240, H)
    cr.line_to(-160, H)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (134, 128, 120))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((84, 80, 76), 0.6))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(7):
        yy = 1430 + i * i * 11
        cr.move_to(0, yy)
        cr.line_to(W, yy - 6)
    for i in range(9):
        cr.move_to(80 + i * 102, 1418)
        cr.line_to(-160 + i * 175, H)
    cr.stroke()

    # the mast
    MX, MB = 470, 1440
    cast_shadow(cr, MX - 18, MX + 18, MB, length=320, a=0.32)
    contact_shadow(cr, MX, MB + 4, 120, a=0.45)
    cylinder(cr, MX - 18, MB, 36, 870, (206, 202, 192), finish="metal")
    cr.rectangle(MX - 160, 640, 320, 16)
    solid(cr, (180, 176, 168), finish="metal")
    disc(cr, MX, 566, 20, (200, 60, 46), finish="gloss")

    # the flags: slots from the masthead down
    FX, L, FH, GAP = MX + 20, 330, 150, 178
    slots = [688 + i * GAP for i in range(n_now)]
    for i in range(n_now):
        if i < n_then:
            rise, unf = 1.0, 1.0
        else:
            j = i - n_then
            if u < a0 + j * span:
                continue
            f = clamp((u - a0 - j * span) / span)
            rise = ease(seg(f, 0.08, 0.8))
            unf = 0.35 + 0.65 * ease(seg(f, 0.4, 0.9))
        y = slots[i] + (1290 - slots[i]) * (1 - rise)
        off = _wf_flag(cr, FX, y, L * unf, FH, t, i, (204, 38, 34))
        cx = FX + L * unf * 0.5
        _wf_symbol(cr, cx, y + FH / 2 + off(cx), 50 * unf, i % 4, t)
    # the halyard the flags ride on, down the mast's face
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 36, 34)))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    cr.move_to(FX, 566)
    cr.line_to(FX, min(1400, slots[-1] + FH + 40))
    cr.stroke()

    # THE SCALE on the mast: where 1947's warning stopped
    if u >= a0:
        my = slots[n_then - 1] + FH + 14
        then_mark(cr, FX - 60, FX + L + 40, my, l0.split()[0],
                  a=ease(seg(u, a0, a0 + 0.06)))

    # right by the camera: a bollard with the rope coiled on it, a lifebuoy
    contact_shadow(cr, 900, 1760, 150, a=0.45)
    cylinder(cr, 840, 1760, 120, 150, (60, 62, 70), finish="metal")
    for r_ in range(4):
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(900, 1700 + r_ * 18)
        cr.scale(1, 0.32)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 76, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((196, 168, 120)))
        cr.set_line_width(11)
        cr.stroke()
    contact_shadow(cr, 170, 1820, 230, a=0.4)
    cr.set_fill_rule(cairo.FILL_RULE_EVEN_ODD)
    cr.arc(170, 1760, 105, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.new_sub_path()
    cr.arc(170, 1760, 58, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    solid(cr, (232, 92, 52), finish="gloss")
    cr.set_fill_rule(cairo.FILL_RULE_WINDING)
    for a in range(4):
        ang = a * math.pi / 2 + 0.4
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((244, 240, 230)))
        cr.set_line_width(46)
        cr.arc(170, 1760, 82, ang - 0.25, ang + 0.25)
        cr.stroke()
    foreground(cr, "coast", y0=1640)
    vignette(cr, a=0.3)

    # Data walks up to the mast and hauls the flags up
    hx = 180 + 210 * ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.12))
    hy = 1452
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 120, 84)))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    cr.move_to(MX - 22, 572)
    cr.line_to(hx + 30, hy - 150)
    cr.stroke()
    if u < a0:
        host("point", hx, hy, 220)
    elif u < a1 + 0.04:
        host("haul", hx, hy, 220, beat=k)
    elif u < 0.9:
        host("strain", hx, hy, 220)
    else:
        host("shock", hx, hy, 220)

    done = u >= a1 + 0.0 and k == m - 1
    if done:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{n_now} threats", f"flying at once · {l1.split()[0]}",
                    80, 520, size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{n_then} threat", f"nuclear war · {l0.split()[0]}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

# scene standard: 2026-10-11.2
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):

    CAUSE: Data cranks the radar dish around and every sweep lights up more unidentified contacts on the scope
    The Pentagon's UFO office as one radar station in the desert: each blip
    on the scope is a group of reports logged. Data turns the big crank on
    the console, the dish on its mast swings, the sweep goes around and
    contacts light up from the centre outward. The first year fills an inner
    disc. That disc stays on the scope as a dashed ghost with its year on it,
    and the next year fills out to almost three times its area. Done by
    0.64, then held while the sweep keeps turning and Data keeps cranking."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    top = max(v0, v1) or 1.0
    ratio = v1 / (v0 or 1.0)
    a0 = 0.08
    p1 = ease(seg(u, a0, 0.30))
    p2 = ease(seg(u, 0.36, 0.64))
    val = v0 * p1 + (v1 - v0) * p2

    sweep = t * 2.2

    gy = landscape(cr, t, "desert")

    # far off: a hangar bunker on the flats

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: an investigation corkboard of reports
    SUBSTANCE: pinned paper reports
    CAUSE: Data tears each explained report off the board and tosses it in the bin, leaving one pinned
    The whole is every UFO report the Pentagon has had, pinned edge to edge
    across one detective's corkboard with red string: 79 sheets, each about
    21 reports, so the unexplained share is exactly ONE sheet, cut at the
    true proportion. Data walks the board left to right, tears the explained
    sheets off by the handful and tosses them into the wastebasket; the
    white wall of paper empties to bare cork, faded patches where every
    sheet hung, until one sheet with the accent pin is left. Done by 0.6 and
    held; Data keeps balling up paper into the bin."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    total = max(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    unexp = min(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    per = int(clamp(round(total / unexp), 2, 100))
    accent = P["accent2"]

    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.60
    nb = 6
    span = (a1 - a0) / nb
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, nb - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)

    # sheet layout: a jittered, overlapping wall of paper
    cols = 10
    rn = max(1, -(-per // cols))
    X0, X1, Y0, Y1 = 168.0, 872.0, 706.0, 1194.0
    cw, ch = (X1 - X0) / cols, (Y1 - Y0) / rn
    pos = []
    for i in range(per):
        c, r = i % cols, i // cols
        x = X0 + cw * (c + 0.5) + 12 * math.sin(i * 12.9898)
        y = Y0 + ch * (r + 0.5) + 10 * math.sin(i * 78.233)
        ang = 0.14 * math.sin(i * 3.7)
        kind = 1 if i % 5 == 2 else (2 if i % 7 == 3 else 0)
        pos.append((x, y, ang, kind))
    sp = min(per - 1, max(0, (rn // 2 - 1) * cols + 4))
    others = sorted([i for i in range(per) if i != sp], key=lambda i: pos[i][0] + 0.001 * i)
    bsz = max(1, -(-len(others) // nb))
    rank = {i: r for r, i in enumerate(others)}

    def q_of(i):
        r = rank[i]
        b, j = r // bsz, r % bsz
        if u < a0 or b > k:
            return 0.0
        if b < k:
            return 1.0
        st = 0.18 + 0.35 * j / bsz
        return clamp((f - st) / 0.45)

    bx = []
    for b in range(nb):
        mem = others[b * bsz:(b + 1) * bsz]
        mx = sum(pos[i][0] for i in mem) / len(mem) if mem else 720.0
        bx.append(clamp(mx - 40, 170, 720))
    if u < a0:
        hx = 170.0
    else:

# scene standard: 2026-10-11.2
def _ufo_saucer(cr, x, y, s, t):
    # the hull: a wide lit metal disc seen from slightly below
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.scale(1, 0.3)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 175 * s, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (176, 182, 194), finish="metal")
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y + 14 * s)
    cr.scale(1, 0.22)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 120 * s, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (96, 102, 116), finish="metal", rim=False)
    # the glass dome on top
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y - 16 * s)
    cr.scale(1, 0.85)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 72 * s, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (150, 214, 204), finish="glass")
    # the ring of lights, chasing slowly round the rim
    for i in range(7):
        lx = x + (i - 3) * 44 * s
        ly = y + 8 * s - abs(i - 3) * 3 * s
        on = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 3.0 - i * 0.9)
        glow(cr, lx, ly, 26 * s, (255, 236, 150), 0.35 + 0.4 * on)
        disc(cr, lx, ly, 9 * s, (255, 232, 140), finish="gloss")


def _ufo_pent(cx, cy, r, sq=0.38, rot=-math.pi / 2 + 0.25):
    return [(cx + r * math.cos(rot + i * 2 * math.pi / 5),
             cy + r * math.sin(rot + i * 2 * math.pi / 5) * sq) for i in range(5)]


def _ufo_poly(cr, ps):
    cr.move_to(*ps[0])
    for p_ in ps[1:]:
        cr.line_to(*p_)
    cr.close_path()


_UFO_PATH = [(452, 1316), (600, 1370), (800, 1410), (930, 1470), (860, 1540),
             (620, 1600), (330, 1680), (60, 1790), (-260, 1930)]


def _ufo_along(s):
    # a point s px along the queue, from the Pentagon's door out to the camera
    for (x0, y0), (x1, y1) in zip(_UFO_PATH, _UFO_PATH[1:]):
        d = math.hypot(x1 - x0, y1 - y0)
        if s <= d:
            q = s / d
            return x0 + (x1 - x0) * q, y0 + (y1 - y0) * q
        s -= d
    return _UFO_PATH[-1]


def _ufo_scale(y):
    # people grow as the line comes toward the camera
    return 0.62 + clamp((y - 1316) / 560.0) * 1.9


def _ufo_person(cr, x, y, sc, i, t, a=1.0):
    # one of the government's own people, report in hand: controllers in
    # hi-vis vests and headsets, pilots and officers in caps
    uni = [(52, 64, 96), (40, 44, 58), (86, 96, 70), (70, 92, 128)][i % 4]
    skin = [(226, 186, 150), (176, 128, 92), (120, 84, 60), (240, 204, 170)][(i * 3) % 4]
    controller = i % 2 == 0
    contact_shadow(cr, x, y, 54 * sc, a=0.32 * a)
    sw = 4 * sc * math.sin(t * 5 + i * 1.3)
    # legs
    for lx, d in ((-11, sw), (2, -sw)):
        cr.move_to(x + (lx + d) * sc, y)
        cr.line_to(x + (lx + 9 + d) * sc, y)
        cr.line_to(x + (lx + 9) * sc, y - 50 * sc)
        cr.line_to(x + lx * sc, y - 50 * sc)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (36, 38, 46), a=a, rim=False)
    # torso: shoulders, a jacket
    cr.move_to(x - 14 * sc, y - 48 * sc)
    cr.line_to(x - 18 * sc, y - 88 * sc)
    cr.curve_to(x - 18 * sc, y - 98 * sc, x - 10 * sc, y - 100 * sc, x, y - 100 * sc)
    cr.curve_to(x + 10 * sc, y - 100 * sc, x + 18 * sc, y - 98 * sc, x + 18 * sc, y - 88 * sc)
    cr.line_to(x + 14 * sc, y - 48 * sc)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, uni, a=a)
    if controller:   # the hi-vis vest with its reflective band
        cr.move_to(x - 13 * sc, y - 52 * sc)
        cr.line_to(x - 15 * sc, y - 92 * sc)
        cr.line_to(x - 5 * sc, y - 98 * sc)
        cr.line_to(x, y - 70 * sc)
        cr.line_to(x + 5 * sc, y - 98 * sc)
        cr.line_to(x + 15 * sc, y - 92 * sc)
        cr.line_to(x + 13 * sc, y - 52 * sc)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (232, 214, 52), a=a, rim=False)
        cr.rectangle(x - 14 * sc, y - 66 * sc, 28 * sc, 4 * sc)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 238, 240), a))
        cr.fill()
    # the arm out front, holding the report
    cr.move_to(x - 16 * sc, y - 92 * sc)
    cr.line_to(x - 24 * sc, y - 70 * sc)
    cr.line_to(x - 30 * sc, y - 66 * sc)
    cr.line_to(x - 26 * sc, y - 60 * sc)
    cr.line_to(x - 12 * sc, y - 72 * sc)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, uni, a=a, rim=False)
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x - 34 * sc, y - 74 * sc)
    cr.rotate(-0.18)
    cr.rectangle(-11 * sc, -15 * sc, 22 * sc, 28 * sc)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (248, 246, 238), a=a, rim=False)
    # head
    disc(cr, x, y - 112 * sc, 12 * sc, skin, a=a)
    if controller:   # headset over the hair
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 30, 34), a))
        cr.set_line_width(3 * sc)
        cr.arc(x, y - 112 * sc, 13 * sc, math.pi * 1.05, math.pi * 1.95)
        cr.stroke()
        disc(cr, x + 12 * sc, y - 110 * sc, 4 * sc, (30, 30, 34), a=a)
    else:            # a peaked cap
        cr.move_to(x - 13 * sc, y - 116 * sc)
        cr.curve_to(x - 12 * sc, y - 130 * sc, x + 12 * sc, y - 130 * sc, x + 13 * sc, y - 116 * sc)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, tuple(int(c * 0.8) for c in uni), a=a, rim=False)
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(x - 8 * sc, y - 116 * sc)
        cr.scale(1, 0.35)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 11 * sc, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        solid(cr, (24, 24, 30), a=a, rim=False)


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: the Pentagon with a UFO over it
    SUBSTANCE: a line of uniformed officials
    CAUSE: Data stamps each report as the line of officials files in, and the line nearly triples
    THE HOOK: a flying saucer hangs over the Pentagon at dusk and the
    government's own people — controllers in hi-vis vests and headsets,
    pilots and officers in caps, reports in hand — are already queued at
    its door. In under two seconds the queue runs from the door out toward
    the camera, nearly three times as many people: the line is the count
    of reports. Data walks down it stamping report after report; done by
    0.5, then the line keeps shuffling in."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    v0 = v0 or 1.0
    ratio = v1 / v0
    grow = ease(seg(u, 0.03, 0.5))
    val = v0 + (v1 - v0) * grow
    done = grow >= 0.999
    count = 8.0 * val / v0

    landscape(cr, t, "field")

    # the saucer over the building, its beam on the roof
    sx = 600 + 110 * math.sin(t * 0.6)
    sy = 780 + 15 * math.sin(t * 1.9)
    cr.move_to(sx - 60, sy + 30)
    cr.line_to(sx + 60, sy + 30)
    cr.line_to(sx + 280, 1060)
    cr.line_to(sx - 280, 1060)
    cr.close_path()
    beam = cairo.LinearGradient(0, sy, 0, 1060)
    beam.add_color_stop_rgba(0, 0.75, 1.0, 0.9, 0.34)
    beam.add_color_stop_rgba(1, 0.75, 1.0, 0.9, 0.06)
    cr.set_source(beam)
    cr.fill()

    # THE PENTAGON: five walls, the rings of its roof, the courtyard
    CX, CY, R, WH = 540, 1180, 450, 150
    outer = _ufo_pent(CX, CY, R)
    cast_shadow(cr, 160, 990, 1300, length=320, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, 570, 1322, 920, a=0.35)
    for i in range(5):
        a_, b_ = outer[i], outer[(i + 1) % 5]
        if (a_[1] + b_[1]) / 2 <= CY:
            continue
        _ufo_poly(cr, [a_, b_, (b_[0], b_[1] - WH), (a_[0], a_[1] - WH)])
        lit = (a_[0] + b_[0]) / 2 < CX
        solid(cr, (214, 206, 190) if lit else (156, 150, 140))
        n_w = int(math.hypot(b_[0] - a_[0], b_[1] - a_[1]) / 24)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((58, 64, 78)))
        for j in range(1, 5):
            for c in range(1, n_w):
                q = c / n_w
                px = a_[0] + (b_[0] - a_[0]) * q
                py = a_[1] + (b_[1] - a_[1]) * q - WH * j / 5.2
                cr.rectangle(px - 4, py - 6, 8, 11)
        cr.fill()
    top = [(x, y - WH) for x, y in outer]
    _ufo_poly(cr, top)
    solid(cr, (184, 178, 166))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((128, 122, 112)))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    for k_ in (0.84, 0.68, 0.54):
        _ufo_poly(cr, _ufo_pent(CX, CY - WH, R * k_))
    cr.stroke()
    court = _ufo_pent(CX, CY - WH, R * 0.42)
    _ufo_poly(cr, court)
    solid(cr, (98, 132, 82), rim=False)
    cr.save()
    _ufo_poly(cr, court)
    cr.clip()
    for i in range(5):
        a_, b_ = court[i], court[(i + 1) % 5]
        if (a_[1] + b_[1]) / 2 >= CY - WH:
            continue
        _ufo_poly(cr, [a_, b_, (b_[0], b_[1] + 46), (a_[0], a_[1] + 46)])
        solid(cr, (150, 144, 132), rim=False)
    cr.restore()
    # the door on the front wall, warm light inside
    DX, DY = 452, 1311
    glow(cr, DX, DY - 30, 100, (255, 214, 150), 0.5)
    cr.rectangle(DX - 36, DY - 76, 72, 76)
    solid(cr, (52, 40, 32), rim=False)
    cr.rectangle(DX - 28, DY - 68, 56, 68)
    solid(cr, (236, 196, 130), rim=False)

    _ufo_saucer(cr, sx, sy, 1.3, t)

    # the concrete walk the line stands on, widening toward the camera
    left, right = [], []
    for j in range(len(_UFO_PATH) - 1):
        (x0, y0), (x1, y1) = _UFO_PATH[j], _UFO_PATH[j + 1]
        d = math.hypot(x1 - x0, y1 - y0) or 1.0
        nx, ny = -(y1 - y0) / d, (x1 - x0) / d
        for (px, py) in ((x0, y0), (x1, y1)):
            w = 22 * _ufo_scale(py)
            left.append((px + nx * w, py + ny * w * 0.6))
            right.append((px - nx * w, py - ny * w * 0.6))
    _ufo_poly(cr, left + list(reversed(right)))
    solid(cr, (206, 198, 182), rim=False, edge=False)

    # the queue of officials: spaced in perspective, shuffling in at the door
    gaps, s = [0.0], 0.0
    for i in range(40):
        y_ = _ufo_along(s)[1]
        s += 40.0 * _ufo_scale(y_)
        gaps.append(s)
    ph = (t * 1.1) % 1.0
    shift = int(t * 1.1)
    people = []
    for i in range(min(39, int(count) + 1)):
        sp = gaps[i + 1] - (gaps[i + 1] - gaps[i]) * ph
        x, y = _ufo_along(sp)
        a = clamp(count - i + ph)
        people.append((y, x, _ufo_scale(y), i + shift, a))
    for y, x, sc, i, a in sorted(people):
        if a > 0.02:
            _ufo_person(cr, x, y, sc, i, t, a=a)

    foreground(cr, "field")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data walks down the line, stamping every report as it goes in
    ds = 140 + 420 * grow
    hx, hy = _ufo_along(ds)
    hx, hy = hx - 40, min(1490.0, hy + 10)
    if u < 0.04:
        host("point", hx, hy, 230)
    elif u < 0.88:
        host("stamp", hx, hy, 230, beat=int(u / 0.1))
    else:
        host("shock", hx, hy, 230)

    if done:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v1)):,} UFO reports", f"filed with the Pentagon · {l1}",
                    80, 520, size=130)
        text(cr, f"{ratio:.1f}x", 80, 690, 90, look.INK, face="display",
             anchor="left", alpha=ease(seg(u, 0.5, 0.55)))
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v0)):,} UFO reports", f"filed with the Pentagon · {l0}",
                    80, 520, size=130)

segments.illustrated_scene:
# scene standard: 2026-10-11.2
def _cv_at(z):
    s = 1.3 * 0.88 ** z
    cum = 1.3 * (1 - 0.88 ** z) / 0.12783
    return 120 + 130 * cum, 1480 - 75 * cum, s


def _cv_off(z, frac):
    x, y, s = _cv_at(z)
    r = 230 * s * frac
    return x + 0.5 * r, y + 0.866 * r


def _cv_bank(z, side, extra=0.0):
    x, y, s = _cv_at(z)
    r = 230 * s + extra
    return x + side * 0.5 * r, y + side * 0.866 * r


def _cv_wall(cr, z0, z1, side, hgt=215):
    zs = [z0 + (z1 - z0) * i / 10 for i in range(11)]
    base = [_cv_bank(z, side) for z in zs]
    tops = [(x, y - hgt * _cv_at(z)[2]) for z, (x, y) in zip(zs, base)]
    cr.move_to(*base[0])
    for p in base[1:]:
        cr.line_to(*p)
    for p in reversed(tops):
        cr.line_to(*p)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (178, 174, 164))
    # the wet stain at the waterline and the expansion joints of the lock wall
    cr.save()
    cr.move_to(*base[0])
    for p in base[1:]:
        cr.line_to(*p)
    for p in reversed(tops):
        cr.line_to(*p)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.clip()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 84, 80), 0.45))
    cr.move_to(*base[0])
    for z, (x, y) in zip(zs, base):
        cr.line_to(x, y - 40 * _cv_at(z)[2])
    for p in reversed(base):
        cr.line_to(*p)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 116, 108), 0.8))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for (bx, by), (tx, ty) in list(zip(base, tops))[1:-1:2]:
        cr.move_to(bx, by)
        cr.line_to(tx, ty)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()
    caps = [(x - side * 13 * _cv_at(z)[2], y - side * 22 * _cv_at(z)[2])
            for z, (x, y) in zip(zs, tops)]
    cr.move_to(*tops[0])
    for p in tops[1:]:
        cr.line_to(*p)
    for p in reversed(caps):
        cr.line_to(*p)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (218, 214, 204), rim=False)


_CV_HULLS = [(48, 64, 96), (150, 46, 40), (40, 84, 76), (60, 60, 68)]
_CV_BOXES = [(196, 72, 52), (60, 110, 170), (214, 160, 60), (90, 140, 90),
             (172, 172, 178), (124, 64, 112)]


def _cv_ship(cr, x, y, s, i, a=1.0, wake=False):
    if a <= 0.01:
        return
    cr.push_group()
    L = 250 * s
    hh = 44 * s
    x0, x1 = x - L / 2, x + L / 2
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y + 6 * s)
    cr.scale(1, 0.14)
    cr.arc(0, 0, L * 0.55, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((10, 40, 50), 0.35))
    cr.fill()
    if wake:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 246, 246), 0.55))
        cr.set_line_width(6 * s)
        cr.move_to(x0 + 6 * s, y + 2 * s)
        cr.curve_to(x0 - 40 * s, y + 14 * s, x0 - 90 * s, y + 30 * s, x0 - 150 * s, y + 52 * s)
        cr.stroke()
    cr.move_to(x0, y - hh)
    cr.line_to(x1 - 12 * s, y - hh)
    cr.line_to(x1 + 16 * s, y - hh - 8 * s)
    cr.curve_to(x1 + 6 * s, y - hh * 0.4, x1 - 10 * s, y, x1 - 40 * s, y + 4 * s)
    cr.line_to(x0 + 12 * s, y + 4 * s)
    cr.line_to(x0, y - 10 * s)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, _CV_HULLS[i % len(_CV_HULLS)], finish="gloss")
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((170, 40, 36)))
    cr.set_line_width(5 * s)
    cr.move_to(x0 + 10 * s, y - 3 * s)
    cr.line_to(x1 - 36 * s, y - 3 * s)
    cr.stroke()
    cw = (L - 110 * s) / 5
    for r in range(2):
        for c in range(5):
            col = _CV_BOXES[(i * 3 + c * 2 + r) % len(_CV_BOXES)]
            box(cr, x0 + 70 * s + c * cw, y - hh - r * 22 * s, cw - 3 * s, 20 * s, col,
                depth=8 * s)
    box(cr, x0 + 12 * s, y - hh, 46 * s, 80 * s, (236, 234, 228), depth=14 * s)
    cr.rectangle(x0 + 15 * s, y - hh - 74 * s, 40 * s, 9 * s)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 52, 66)))
    cr.fill()
    cylinder(cr, x0 + 24 * s, y - hh - 80 * s, 18 * s, 24 * s, (40, 40, 46), finish="metal")
    cr.pop_group_to_source()
    cr.paint_with_alpha(a)


def _cv_ring(cr, x, y, r, w):
    # a life ring: orange and white quarters on a thick ring
    for q in range(8):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((232, 92, 40) if q % 2 == 0 else (244, 240, 232)))
        cr.set_line_width(w)
        cr.arc(x, y, r, q * math.pi / 4, (q + 1) * math.pi / 4)
        cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 30, 26), 0.8))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    cr.arc(x, y, r + w / 2, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.arc(x, y, r - w / 2, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.stroke()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a canal lock and its line of cargo ships
    SUBSTANCE: container ships
    CAUSE: Data cranks the lock gates shut, holding the back of the ship line out
    One canal, one day's line of ships running from the camera up through the
    lock to the sea: that line is the WHOLE, the normal day's crossings. Data
    cranks the great mitre gates shut in three turns of the capstan, its steel
    strut swinging each leaf across the channel, the lock's signal going from
    green to red, and the ships nearest the camera are pushed back and moored
    in a queue while the rest keep steaming out of the lock. The buoy rope
    along the line is cut at the gate, the part still crossing in the accent,
    so a glance says a third of the day's ships are left waiting. Done by 0.56
    and held: the ships beyond keep sailing, the queue rides on its mooring
    lines, Data keeps the capstan cranked."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    dated = [r for r in rows if any(ch.isdigit() for ch in r[0])]
    if len(rows) == 2 and len(dated) == 1:
        after = dated[0]
        before = rows[0] if rows[1] is after else rows[1]
    else:
        rs = by_time(rows)
        before, after = rs[0], rs[-1]
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = before, after
    v0 = v0 or 1.0
    share = clamp(v1 / v0, 0.2, 0.9)
    NS = 9
    zg = clamp(NS * (1 - share), 1.2, 6.0)
    held = max(1, min(int(round(NS * (1 - share))), int(zg + 0.3)))

    NC = 3
    a0, a1 = 0.14, 0.56
    span = (a1 - a0) / NC
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, NC - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    shut = ease(seg(f, 0.25, 0.7))
    g = 0.0 if u < a0 else (k + shut) / NC
    closed = u >= a0 and k == NC - 1 and shut >= 0.999
    v = 1.1
    tf = t if (u <= a0 or u <= 0) else t * a0 / u

    # the setting: jungle hills under a low sun, the canal cut through them
    landscape(cr, t, "field", horizon=930)
    birds(cr, t, y0=700, n=4, rgb=(50, 54, 62))

    zs = [-2.2 + i * 12.0 / 40 for i in range(41)]
    LB = [_cv_bank(z, -1) for z in zs]
    RB = [_cv_bank(z, 1) for z in zs]

    def _water():
        cr.move_to(*LB[0])
        for p in LB[1:]:
            cr.line_to(*p)
        for p in reversed(RB):
            cr.line_to(*p)
        cr.close_path()
    cr.save()
    _water()
    cr.clip()
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (128, 180, 178)), (0.4, (64, 132, 140)), (1, (24, 84, 98))], 900, H)
    for i in range(6):
        z = -1.5 + i * 1.9
        x, y, s = _cv_at(z)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((220, 240, 236), 0.18))
        cr.set_line_width(5 * s)
        cr.move_to(x - 160 * s, y + 60 * s)
        cr.line_to(x + 40 * s, y - 40 * s)
        cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()
    for side in (LB, RB):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((206, 202, 190)))
        cr.set_line_width(9)
        cr.move_to(*side[0])
        for p in side[1:]:
            cr.line_to(*p)
        cr.stroke()

    # the day's whole line, as a buoy rope: the accent is the part still crossing
    cut = zg * g
    zr = [i * 0.25 for i in range(int(NS / 0.25) + 1)]
    for j in range(len(zr) - 1):
        za, zb = zr[j], zr[j + 1]
        col = (150, 152, 158) if zb <= cut + 1e-6 else P["accent2"]
        pa, pb = _cv_off(za, 0.78), _cv_off(zb, 0.78)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(col))
        cr.set_line_width(9 * _cv_at(za)[2])
        cr.move_to(*pa)
        cr.line_to(*pb)
        cr.stroke()
    for j in range(0, len(zr), 2):
        z = zr[j]
        bx, by = _cv_off(z, 0.78)
        col = (150, 152, 158) if z < cut else P["accent2"]
        disc(cr, bx, by, 13 * _cv_at(z)[2], col, finish="gloss")

    # the ships: past the gate they keep steaming out of the lock; this side
    # of it they are pushed back into a queue as the gates close
    ships = []
    B = 9.4 - (zg + 0.6)
    nb = max(1, int(round(B)))
    for i in range(nb):
        z = zg + 0.6 + ((i * B / nb + t * v) % B)
        a = clamp((z - (zg + 0.6)) / 0.7) * clamp((9.4 - z) / 0.7)
        ships.append((z, a, True, i))
    Pn = zg + 2.6
    nn = max(1, int(round(Pn)))
    near = sorted([((i * Pn / nn + tf * v) % Pn) - 2.0 for i in range(nn)], reverse=True)
    for j, zf in enumerate(near):
        tgt = zg - 0.75 - j if j < held else -2.6
        z = zf + (tgt - zf) * g
        a = clamp((zg + 0.6 - z) / 0.6)
        ships.append((z, a, g < 0.05, 20 + j))

    def _draw(sel):
        for z, a, moving, i in sorted(sel, key=lambda e: -e[0]):
            x, y, s = _cv_at(z)
            bob = 2.5 * s * math.sin(t * 1.3 + i * 1.7)
            _cv_ship(cr, x, y + bob, s, i, a=a, wake=moving)

    _cv_wall(cr, zg - 0.3, zg + 2.2, -1)
    _draw([e for e in ships if e[0] >= zg])

    # the mitre gates: tall steel leaves, braced and railed, swung from the
    # walls across the channel
    sg = _cv_at(zg)[2]
    hw = 232 * sg
    gh = 205 * sg

    def _leaf(side):
        px, py = _cv_bank(zg, side)
        ox, oy = 0.866, -0.5
        qx, qy = -side * 0.5, -side * 0.866
        vx, vy = (1 - g) * ox + g * qx, (1 - g) * oy + g * qy
        n_ = math.sqrt(vx * vx + vy * vy) or 1.0
        ex, ey = px + vx / n_ * hw, py + vy / n_ * hw
        th = 16 * sg
        # the leaf's thickness, the back face showing
        cr.move_to(px + th * 0.866, py - th * 0.5)
        cr.line_to(ex + th * 0.866, ey - th * 0.5)
        cr.line_to(ex + th * 0.866, ey - gh - th * 0.5)
        cr.line_to(px + th * 0.866, py - gh - th * 0.5)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (58, 66, 72), finish="metal", rim=False)
        cr.move_to(px, py)
        cr.line_to(ex, ey)
        cr.line_to(ex, ey - gh)
        cr.line_to(px, py - gh)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (104, 116, 122), finish="metal")
        # girders and a diagonal brace
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((46, 52, 58)))
        cr.set_line_width(6 * sg)
        for fr in (0.2, 0.45, 0.7):
            cr.move_to(px, py - gh * fr)
            cr.line_to(ex, ey - gh * fr)
        cr.move_to(px, py - gh * 0.08)
        cr.line_to(ex, ey - gh * 0.92)
        cr.stroke()
        # rivet heads along the top girder
        for i in range(6):
            q = (i + 0.5) / 6
            disc(cr, px + (ex - px) * q, py + (ey - py) * q - gh * 0.95, 4 * sg,
                 (150, 160, 166), finish="metal")
        # the walkway rail across the top
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 200, 60)))
        cr.set_line_width(4 * sg)
        cr.move_to(px, py - gh - 30 * sg)
        cr.line_to(ex, ey - gh - 30 * sg)
        for i in range(5):
            q = i / 4
            rx, ry = px + (ex - px) * q, py + (ey - py) * q - gh
            cr.move_to(rx, ry)
            cr.line_to(rx, ry - 30 * sg)
        cr.stroke()
        return px, py, ex, ey

    _leaf(-1)
    _cv_wall(cr, zg - 0.3, zg + 2.2, 1)
    lp = _leaf(1)
    _draw([e for e in ships if e[0] < zg])

    # the lock's signal on the wall: green while ships cross, red when shut
    sx_, sy_ = _cv_bank(zg + 0.9, 1)
    sy_ -= 215 * _cv_at(zg + 0.9)[2]
    cylinder(cr, sx_ - 6, sy_, 12, 120 * sg, (50, 52, 58), finish="metal")
    sig = tuple(int(a_ + (b_ - a_) * clamp(g * 1.4)) for a_, b_ in zip((70, 210, 100), (226, 52, 40)))
    glow(cr, sx_, sy_ - 130 * sg, 60 * sg, sig, 0.8)
    disc(cr, sx_, sy_ - 130 * sg, 18 * sg, sig, finish="gloss")

    # the held ships ride on mooring lines to bollards on the near bank
    held_ships = [e for e in ships if 20 <= e[3] < 20 + held]
    for z, a, _, i in held_ships:
        if g < 0.3 or z > zg:
            continue
        x, y, s = _cv_at(z)
        bx, by = _cv_bank(z - 0.3, 1, 30)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((214, 196, 150), clamp((g - 0.3) / 0.4) * a))
        cr.set_line_width(5 * s)
        cr.move_to(x + 90 * s, y - 20 * s)
        cr.curve_to(x + 120 * s, y + 30 * s, bx - 20, by - 10, bx, by - 30 * s)
        cr.stroke()
        contact_shadow(cr, bx, by, 40 * s, a=0.35)
        cylinder(cr, bx - 14 * s, by, 28 * s, 34 * s, (44, 46, 52), finish="metal")

    # right by the camera, on the near bank: a life ring on its post, a big
    # bollard with a coil of mooring line, the grass
    cr.save()
    cr.move_to(*RB[0])
    for p in RB[1:]:
        cr.line_to(*p)
    cr.line_to(W + 20, RB[-1][1])
    cr.line_to(W + 20, H + 20)
    cr.line_to(RB[0][0], H + 20)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.clip()
    foreground(cr, "field", y0=1660)
    cr.restore()
    cast_shadow(cr, 740, 860, 1800, length=200, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, 800, 1800, 150, a=0.45)
    cylinder(cr, 740, 1800, 120, 130, (40, 42, 48), finish="metal")
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(800, 1670)
    cr.scale(1, 0.32)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 80, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (52, 54, 62), finish="metal")
    for r_ in range(4):
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(800, 1760 - r_ * 14)
        cr.scale(1, 0.34)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 76 - r_ * 2, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((206, 186, 140)))
        cr.set_line_width(12)
        cr.stroke()
    contact_shadow(cr, 985, 1720, 70, a=0.4)
    box(cr, 972, 1720, 26, 240, (150, 112, 70), depth=10)
    _cv_ring(cr, 985, 1560, 52, 22)
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data walks down the bank to the gate's capstan and cranks it shut; the
    # capstan's strut drives the near leaf across the channel
    sx, sy = _cv_bank(5.4, 1, 20)
    cx_, cy_ = _cv_bank(zg - 0.35, 1, 46)
    w_ = ease(seg(u, 0.03, a0 - 0.01))
    hx = sx + (cx_ - sx) * w_
    hy = min(1500.0, sy + (cy_ - sy) * w_)
    capx, capy = cx_ + 62, cy_ + 4
    px, py, ex, ey = lp
    mx, my = px + (ex - px) * 0.45, py + (ey - py) * 0.45 - gh * 0.55
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((36, 40, 46)))
    cr.set_line_width(16 * sg)
    cr.move_to(capx, capy - 80)
    cr.line_to(mx, my)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((170, 180, 188), 0.8))
    cr.set_line_width(4 * sg)
    cr.move_to(capx, capy - 86)
    cr.line_to(mx, my - 5 * sg)
    cr.stroke()
    contact_shadow(cr, capx, capy, 110, a=0.4)
    cylinder(cr, capx - 42, capy, 84, 80, (196, 160, 52), finish="metal")
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(capx, capy - 80)
    cr.scale(1, 0.34)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 42, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (214, 182, 70), finish="metal")
    ang = g * 6 * math.pi
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 56, 50)))
    cr.set_line_width(9)
    for q in (0.0, math.pi):
        cr.move_to(capx, capy - 82)
        cr.line_to(capx + 78 * math.cos(ang + q), capy - 82 + 26 * math.sin(ang + q))
    cr.stroke()
    disc(cr, capx, capy - 84, 10, (90, 84, 74), finish="metal")
    if u < a0:
        host("point", hx, hy, 230)
    elif u < a1 + 0.04:
        host("crank", hx, hy, 230, beat=k)
    else:
        host("crank", hx, hy, 230, beat=NC + int((u - a1 - 0.04) / 0.11))

    lab1 = l1.split(" (")[0]
    if closed:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v1))} ships", f"a day through the Panama Canal · {lab1}",
                    80, 520, size=130)
        al = ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.05))
        text(cr, f"−{int(round(v0 - v1))}", W - 80, 700, 100, look.INK, face="display",
             anchor="right", alpha=al)
        text(cr, "held back a day", W - 80, 752, 36, look.INK, anchor="right", alpha=al)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v0))} ships", f"a day through the Panama Canal · {l0.lower()}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

segments.topic: why the Panama Canal's lake level dropped
segments.say: The lake that feeds the canal's locks dropped to just 80.3 feet -- well below its normal average.
segments.illustrated_scene:
# scene standard: 2026-10-11.2
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a wooden dock left high and dry
    SUBSTANCE: the lake's water
    CAUSE: Data turns the intake valve open and the lake drains into the pipe to the locks, the water sliding down the dock's posts
    Gatun Lake, the lake that feeds the Panama Canal's locks, seen from its
    own shore. There is no lock wall and no ship. A wooden dock on posts runs
    out over the water, with planks, a ladder, a mooring post and a rowboat
    tied to it. On the near bank the intake pipe that carries the lake to the
    locks has a big red valve wheel. Each turn Data gives it pulls the lake
    in through the pipe's mouth, where a whirlpool turns, and the lake falls
    from its 5-year average to February 2024's level. The water slides down
    every post of the dock and leaves a dark wet band on each one. The ladder
    ends up hanging above the water, the boat sinks on its rope, and mud
    banks and drowned stumps come up all round the shore. The old waterline
    is marked across the posts. It is down by 0.62 and then holds while a
    canoe crosses the far lake and Data gives the wheel one more turn."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    avg = next((r for r in rows if "aver" in r[0].lower()),
               max(rows, key=lambda r: r[1]))
    now = next((r for r in rows if r is not avg), rows[-1])
    l0, v0 = avg
    l1, v1 = now
    d = v0 - v1
    n = 3
    a0, a1 = 0.12, 0.62
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    dr = ease(seg(f, 0.1, 0.9))
    frac = 0.0 if u < a0 else (k + dr) / n
    landed_now = u >= a0 and k == n - 1 and dr >= 0.999
    draining = a0 <= u < a1 and 0.0 < dr < 1.0
    drop = 220.0 * frac
    FS = 890 + 34 * frac
    YN = 1490 - 140 * frac

    def xl(y, q=None):
        q = frac if q is None else q
        return max(-20.0, (y - 1000) * 0.55) + 160 * q

    def DY(x):
        return 1130 - 0.09 * x

    def sc(x):
        return 1 - 0.2 * x / 900

    def wl(x):
        return DY(x) + (70 + drop) * sc(x)

    def wl0(x):
        return DY(x) + 70 * sc(x)

    # the far setting: jungle hills under a low sun, fading into haze
    landscape(cr, t, "field", horizon=820)
    ridge(cr, 840, 190, seed=1.3)
    solid(cr, P["leaf_far_shade"], edge=False)
    treeline(cr, 850, P["leaf_far"], n=16, seed=2)
    haze(cr, 520, 870, (214, 222, 214), a=0.45)
    birds(cr, t, y0=660, n=4, rgb=(50, 54, 60))

    # the lake bed: mud the water used to cover
    cr.rectangle(0, 872, W, 640)
    solid(cr, (156, 124, 88), edge=False, rim=False)
    treeline(cr, 884, P["leaf"], n=12, seed=5)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((104, 80, 56), 0.8))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    for i in range(36):
        x = 30 + (i * 211) % 1020
        y = 900 + (i * 97) % 590
        cr.move_to(x, y)
        cr.line_to(x + 26, y + 10)
        cr.line_to(x + 18, y + 26)
    cr.stroke()
    # the pale ring of the old shoreline
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((226, 216, 192)))
    cr.set_line_width(9)
    cr.move_to(xl(892, 0.0), 892)
    cr.line_to(W, 892)
    cr.move_to(xl(1000, 0.0), 1000)
    cr.line_to(xl(1490, 0.0), 1490)
    cr.stroke()
    # drowned stumps the falling water uncovers
    for sx_, sb_, ss_ in ((120, 1190, 0.6), (250, 1330, 0.7), (640, 1440, 0.75),
                          (860, 1460, 0.7), (420, 1470, 0.65)):
        stump(cr, sx_, sb_, ss_)

    # the lake
    def lake():
        cr.move_to(xl(FS), FS)
        cr.line_to(W + 10, FS)
        cr.line_to(W + 10, YN)
        cr.line_to(xl(YN), YN)
        cr.close_path()
    cr.save()
    lake()
    cr.clip()
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (104, 158, 146)), (1, (30, 80, 86))], FS, YN)
    glow(cr, 360, FS + 80, 300, (255, 226, 170), 0.28)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((216, 240, 232), 0.5))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(14):
        rx = (i * 173 + t * 30) % (W + 120) - 60
        ry = FS + 20 + (i * 61) % max(30, int(YN - FS - 30))
        cr.move_to(rx, ry)
        cr.line_to(rx + 60, ry)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()
    # wet dark mud just above the waterline
    cr.rectangle(0, YN, W, 14)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((96, 76, 52), 0.85))
    cr.fill()
    lake()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 246, 240), 0.85))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    cr.stroke()

    # a canoe crossing the far lake
    cx = 1000 - 360 * ease(seg(u, 0.45, 1.0))
    cy = FS + 46
    cr.move_to(cx - 80, cy - 8)
    cr.curve_to(cx - 40, cy + 12, cx + 40, cy + 12, cx + 80, cy - 8)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (96, 58, 36))
    disc(cr, cx, cy - 22, 12, (200, 70, 50))

    # the dock: back posts, deck, front posts
    XS = [30, 190, 350, 510, 670, 810]
    wood, post = (164, 120, 76), (118, 84, 54)

    def piling(x, top, bot, w):
        cr.rectangle(x - w / 2, top, w, max(2, bot - top))
        solid(cr, post)

    for x in XS:
        s = sc(x)
        bx = x + 30 * s
        piling(bx, DY(x) - 40 * s, wl(x) - 46 * s, 18 * s)
        cr.rectangle(bx - 9 * s, wl0(x) - 46 * s, 18 * s, drop * s)

    cr.move_to(-20, DY(-20))
    for x in range(-20, 841, 20):
        cr.line_to(x, DY(x))
    for x in range(840, -21, -20):
        cr.line_to(x + 30 * sc(x), DY(x) - 48 * sc(x))
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, wood)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((96, 66, 40)))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for x in range(0, 840, 36):
        cr.move_to(x, DY(x))

    cr.stroke()
    cr.move_to(-20, DY(-20))
    cr.line_to(840, DY(840))
    cr.line_to(840, DY(840) + 24 * sc(840))
    cr.line_to(-20, DY(-20) + 24)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (126, 88, 54))
    for x in XS:
        s = sc(x)
        piling(x, DY(x) + 20 * s, wl(x), 24 * s)
        # the bathtub ring: the wet band the falling water leaves on each post
        cr.rectangle(x - 12 * s, wl0(x), 24 * s, drop * s)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 80, 56), 0.9))
        cr.fill()
        if wl(x) < YN and x > xl(wl(x)):
            cr.save()
            cr.translate(x, wl(x))
            cr.scale(1, 0.3)
            cr.arc(0, 0, 22 * s, 0, 2 * math.pi)
            cr.restore()
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 246, 240), 0.8))
            cr.set_line_width(3)
            cr.stroke()
        else:
            contact_shadow(cr, x, wl(x), 50 * s, a=0.35)
    # the ladder, which used to reach into the water
    lx = 700
    ls = sc(lx)
    ly0, ly1 = DY(lx) + 24 * ls, DY(lx) + 170 * ls
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 72, 78)))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    for rx in (lx - 18, lx + 18):
        cr.move_to(rx, ly0 - 40)
        cr.line_to(rx, ly1)
    yy = ly0
    while yy < ly1:
        cr.move_to(lx - 18, yy)
        cr.line_to(lx + 18, yy)
        yy += 28
    cr.stroke()
    # the mooring post and the rowboat on its rope
    mx = 812
    cylinder(cr, mx - 12, DY(mx) + 6, 24, 80, wood)
    bob = 3 * math.sin(t * 1.4)
    wy = wl(950) + bob
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((200, 176, 120)))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    cr.move_to(mx, DY(mx) - 60)
    cr.line_to(870, wy - 30)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.move_to(856, wy - 32)
    cr.line_to(1060, wy - 36)
    cr.curve_to(1050, wy - 4, 1030, wy + 12, 1000, wy + 12)
    cr.line_to(900, wy + 12)
    cr.curve_to(876, wy + 8, 862, wy - 10, 856, wy - 32)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (176, 64, 46), finish="gloss")
    cr.rectangle(940, wy - 30, 14, 26)
    solid(cr, wood, rim=False)

    # the old waterline, marked across the posts
    if u >= a0:
        then_mark(cr, 50, 560, wl0(300), l0)

    # where the water goes: a whirlpool over the intake's mouth
    IX, IY = 1000, YN - 50
    sw = math.sin(math.pi * dr) if draining else (0.4 if u >= a1 else 0.0)
    if sw > 0.02:
        for r_ in range(4):
            cr.save()
            cr.translate(IX, IY)
            cr.scale(1, 0.32)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((232, 246, 244), 0.85 * sw))
            cr.set_line_width(7)
            ang = -t * 3 + r_ * 1.5
            cr.arc(0, 0, 34 + r_ * 30, ang, ang + 2.6)
            cr.stroke()
            cr.restore()

    # the near bank, and the intake pipe that carries the lake to the locks
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (96, 120, 64)), (1, (58, 82, 42))], 1490, H)
    cr.rectangle(975, IY, 50, 1552 - IY)
    solid(cr, (88, 94, 104), finish="metal")
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(IX, IY)
    cr.scale(1, 0.35)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 32, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((24, 30, 36)))
    cr.fill()
    cr.rectangle(-10, 1512, 1035, 40)
    solid(cr, (88, 94, 104), finish="metal")
    VX = 540
    contact_shadow(cr, VX, 1514, 60, a=0.4)
    cylinder(cr, VX - 9, 1514, 18, 80, (76, 82, 92), finish="metal")
    rot = (k + dr) * math.pi * 1.2 if u >= a0 else 0.0
    if u >= a1:
        rot = n * math.pi * 1.2 + math.pi * ease(seg(u, 0.8, 0.9))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((170, 40, 34)))
    cr.set_line_width(11)
    cr.arc(VX, 1420, 50, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.stroke()
    for sp in range(4):
        a_ = rot + sp * math.pi / 2
        cr.move_to(VX, 1420)
        cr.line_to(VX + 50 * math.cos(a_), 1420 + 50 * math.sin(a_))
    cr.set_line_width(7)
    cr.stroke()
    disc(cr, VX, 1420, 12, (190, 60, 50), finish="metal")

    # right by the camera: a rock and the bank's grass
    contact_shadow(cr, 900, 1790, 150, a=0.4)
    disc(cr, 900, 1740, 60, (126, 120, 110))
    foreground(cr, "field", y0=1640)
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data walks the bank to the valve, then turns it, turn after turn
    if u < a0:
        hx = 180 + (VX - 90 - 180) * ease(seg(u, 0.0, a0))
        host("point", hx, 1505, 220)
    elif u < a1:
        host("tap", VX - 90, 1505, 220, beat=k)
    else:
        host("tap", VX - 90, 1505, 220, beat=(n if u >= 0.8 else n - 1))

    if landed_now:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{v1:.1f} ft", f"{d:.1f} ft below its {l0.lower()} · {l1}",
                    80, 520, size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{v0:.1f} ft", f"the lake that feeds the canal · {l0}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

segments.topic: what the Panama Canal drought did to cargo ships
segments.say: That forced ships to carry less cargo too -- the maximum draft dropped to just 44 feet.
segments.illustrated_scene:
# scene standard: 2026-10-11.2
def _deck_y(D, x):
    return D - 20 - 70 * max(0.0, 1.0 - (x - 30) / 420.0) ** 2


def _ship_hull(cr, D):
    cr.move_to(30, _deck_y(D, 30))
    for x in range(60, 1111, 30):
        cr.line_to(x, _deck_y(D, x))
    cr.line_to(1110, 1960)
    cr.line_to(270, 1960)
    cr.curve_to(210, 1620, 130, 1360, 30, _deck_y(D, 30))
    cr.close_path()


def _container(cr, x, y, col, s=1.0):
    w, h = 96 * s, 66 * s
    box(cr, x, y, w, h, col, depth=22 * s, finish="metal")
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((0, 0, 0), 0.2))
    cr.set_line_width(3 * s)
    for i in range(1, 8):
        xx = x + i * w / 8
        cr.move_to(xx, y - 6 * s)
        cr.line_to(xx, y - h + 6 * s)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 255, 255), 0.25))
    cr.set_line_width(2 * s)
    cr.rectangle(x + 3 * s, y - h + 3 * s, w - 6 * s, h - 6 * s)
    cr.stroke()


def _tug(cr, x, y):
    contact_shadow(cr, x + 110, y + 6, 260, a=0.3)
    cr.move_to(x, y - 60)
    cr.line_to(x + 250, y - 60)
    cr.curve_to(x + 260, y - 30, x + 230, y, x + 200, y)
    cr.line_to(x + 30, y)
    cr.curve_to(x + 10, y - 20, x, y - 40, x, y - 60)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (34, 38, 48), finish="gloss")
    cr.rectangle(x + 4, y - 50, 246, 12)
    solid(cr, (190, 52, 40), rim=False)
    box(cr, x + 70, y - 60, 90, 70, (236, 234, 226), depth=24)
    cylinder(cr, x + 120, y - 130, 26, 60, (200, 60, 44), finish="metal")
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((250, 252, 255), 0.7))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    cr.move_to(x - 10, y - 4)
    cr.line_to(x - 140, y + 8)
    cr.stroke()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a cargo ship riding in the water
    SUBSTANCE: shipping containers
    CAUSE: Data hauls containers off the deck on the ship's derrick, and with each one gone the hull rises out of the water
    One loaded container ship at the canal approach, a raked bow in
    three-quarter view and a full stack of corrugated boxes on deck. Her hull
    is red below the old waterline and black above: the red band IS the
    scale. At the normal maximum draft the water sits on the paint line;
    Data hauls the top tier off, one box per pull on the derrick rope, each
    swung ashore onto the quay by the camera, and with each one gone she
    floats higher, until the water reaches the drought-limit mark on the
    bow and a band of red hull stands bare in the sun. Draft marks on the
    bow name only the two drafts; the old waterline is marked on the hull.
    Done by 0.56 and held while a tug keeps crossing."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    (l0, v0) = max(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    (l1, v1) = min(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    diff = max(0.001, v0 - v1)
    K = min(30.0, 200.0 / diff)
    n = 4
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.56
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    lift = ease(seg(f, 0.0, 0.3))
    out = ease(seg(f, 0.3, 0.72))
    grow = ease(seg(f, 0.4, 0.78))
    step = 0.0 if u < a0 else (k + grow) / n
    draft = v0 - diff * step
    dy = -(v0 - draft) * K

    WL = 1300.0
    D0 = 1180.0
    D = D0 + dy
    Py = WL + dy

    landscape(cr, t, "coast", horizon=1170)
    birds(cr, t, y0=760, n=4, rgb=(60, 62, 72))

    # the hull: red bottom paint below the old waterline, black topsides
    cr.save()
    _ship_hull(cr, D)
    cr.clip()
    cr.rectangle(0, 0, W, Py)
    solid(cr, (34, 38, 50), finish="gloss", rim=False)
    cr.rectangle(0, Py, W, H)
    solid(cr, (176, 50, 38), rim=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((0, 0, 0), 0.16))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(10):
        sx_ = 150 + i * 110
        cr.move_to(sx_, D - 120)
        cr.line_to(sx_, H)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((240, 240, 236)))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    cr.move_to(0, Py)
    cr.line_to(W, Py)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()
    _ship_hull(cr, D)
    edge(cr, (16, 18, 24))
    disc(cr, 105, _deck_y(D, 105) + 55, 15, (20, 22, 28), finish="metal")   # hawse
    # the deck seen from above, going back into the picture
    cr.move_to(30, _deck_y(D, 30))
    for x in range(60, 1111, 30):
        cr.line_to(x, _deck_y(D, x))
    for x in range(1110, 29, -30):
        cr.line_to(x + 40, _deck_y(D, x) - 34)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (120, 116, 108), rim=False)
    # the bow's bulwark rail
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((230, 228, 220)))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    cr.move_to(36, _deck_y(D, 36) - 22)
    for x in range(60, 300, 20):
        cr.line_to(x, _deck_y(D, x) - 22)
    cr.stroke()

    # the old deck line where it stood, once she has risen
    if step > 0.02:
        cr.move_to(30, _deck_y(D0, 30))
        for x in range(60, 1081, 30):
            cr.line_to(x, _deck_y(D0, x))
        ghost(cr, a=0.7)

    # bridge at the stern
    sx = 880
    contact_shadow(cr, sx + 60, _deck_y(D, sx + 60), 150, a=0.35)
    box(cr, sx, _deck_y(D, sx + 60), 124, 360, (232, 230, 222), depth=36)
    for r_ in range(4):
        cr.rectangle(sx + 12, _deck_y(D, sx + 60) - 330 + r_ * 76, 100, 28)
        solid(cr, (60, 90, 120), finish="glass", rim=False)

    cols = [(196, 92, 48), (62, 112, 160), (214, 170, 60), (80, 140, 96),
            (170, 60, 60), (120, 124, 132)]
    CW, CH = 96, 66
    bays = [340 + i * 104 for i in range(5)]
    # the three tiers that stay
    for i, bx in enumerate(bays):
        by = _deck_y(D, bx + 50)
        contact_shadow(cr, bx + 50, by, 110, a=0.3)
        for tier in range(3):
            _container(cr, bx, by - tier * CH, cols[(i * 2 + tier) % 6])

    # the quay slots the hauled boxes land on, right by the camera
    slots = [(470, 1790), (610, 1790), (750, 1790), (540, 1704)]
    QS = 1.3

    # top tier: the ones he hauls off, left to right
    moving = None
    landed_q = []
    for i in range(n):
        bx = bays[i]
        base = _deck_y(D, bx + 50) - 3 * CH
        col = cols[(i * 3 + 1) % 6]
        if u < a0 or i > k:
            _container(cr, bx, base, col)
        elif i == k and out < 0.999:
            yl = base - lift * 120
            tx, ty = slots[i]
            x = bx + (tx - bx) * out
            y = yl + (ty - yl) * out - 180 * math.sin(math.pi * out)
            s = 1.0 + (QS - 1.0) * out
            moving = (x, y, s, col)
        else:
            landed_q.append(i)

    # the derrick: mast, boom, and the rope he hauls on
    mx = 290
    mtop = D - 400
    cylinder(cr, mx - 13, _deck_y(D, mx), 26, _deck_y(D, mx) - mtop, (214, 160, 60),
             finish="metal")
    if moving:
        tipx = clamp(moving[0] + CW * moving[2] / 2, mx + 140, 1000)
    else:
        tipx = bays[min(k, n - 1)] + CW / 2
    tipy = mtop + 34
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((214, 160, 60)))
    cr.set_line_width(14)
    cr.move_to(mx, mtop + 60)
    cr.line_to(tipx, tipy)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 50, 30)))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    cr.move_to(mx, mtop + 4)
    cr.line_to(tipx, tipy - 4)
    cr.stroke()
    disc(cr, mx, mtop, 16, (90, 90, 96), finish="metal")
    disc(cr, tipx, tipy, 10, (90, 90, 96), finish="metal")

    # Data on the bow deck, hauling, rising with the ship
    hx = 150 + 40 * min(k, n - 1) * (1 if u >= a0 else 0)
    hy = _deck_y(D, hx)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 50, 30)))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    cr.move_to(hx + 28, hy - 150)
    cr.line_to(mx, mtop)
    cr.stroke()

    # draft marks on the bow stem: a tick a foot, only the two drafts named
    for d in range(int(v1) - 2, int(v0) + 3):
        y = Py + (v0 - d) * K
        top_y = _deck_y(D, 30)
        xs = 30 + (y - top_y) * 0.2
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((244, 242, 236)))
        cr.set_line_width(6)
        cr.move_to(xs + 14, y)
        cr.line_to(xs + 44, y)
        cr.stroke()
        if abs(d - v0) < 0.01 or abs(d - v1) < 0.01:
            text(cr, f"{d:g} ft", xs + 54, y + 12, 36, (244, 242, 236), face="bold")

    # the sea, over everything under the waterline
    g = cairo.LinearGradient(0, WL, 0, H)
    g.add_color_stop_rgba(0, 46 / 255, 110 / 255, 150 / 255, 0.93)
    g.add_color_stop_rgba(1, 18 / 255, 52 / 255, 84 / 255, 0.98)
    cr.rectangle(0, WL, W, H - WL)
    cr.set_source(g)
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 244, 248), 0.85))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    cr.move_to(40, WL)
    for i in range(54):
        x = 40 + i * 20
        cr.line_to(x, WL + 4 * math.sin(t * 3 + i * 0.7))
    cr.stroke()
    for i in range(10):
        wx = (i * 137 + t * 30) % W
        wy = WL + 50 + (i * 53) % 220
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((200, 226, 240), 0.35))
        cr.set_line_width(3)
        cr.move_to(wx, wy)
        cr.line_to(wx + 60, wy)
        cr.stroke()

    # the old waterline, marked on the hull as she rises
    if step > 0.02:
        then_mark(cr, 380, 780, Py, "normal")

    # a tug crossing the water
    _tug(cr, -380 + ((t * 260) % 1860), 1500)

    # right by the camera: the quay, where the hauled boxes are set down
    cr.rectangle(0, 1620, W, H - 1620)
    solid(cr, (150, 146, 138), rim=False)
    cr.rectangle(0, 1608, W, 24)
    solid(cr, (196, 192, 182))
    cast_shadow(cr, 450, 900, 1790, length=220, a=0.3)
    for i in landed_q:
        sx_, sy_ = slots[i]
        if sy_ >= 1790:
            contact_shadow(cr, sx_ + 62, sy_, 140, a=0.4)
    for i in sorted(landed_q, key=lambda j: -slots[j][1]):
        sx_, sy_ = slots[i]
        _container(cr, sx_, sy_, cols[(i * 3 + 1) % 6], QS)
    contact_shadow(cr, 200, 1770, 110, a=0.4)
    cylinder(cr, 150, 1770, 100, 90, (60, 62, 70), finish="metal")
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((214, 196, 150)))
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    cr.move_to(200, 1700)
    cr.curve_to(220, 1560, 200, 1400, 190, Py - 30)
    cr.stroke()
    foreground(cr, "coast", y0=1730)

    # the box in the air, swinging ashore on the derrick
    if moving:
        x, y, s, col = moving
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 36, 30)))
        cr.set_line_width(4)
        cr.move_to(tipx, tipy)
        cr.line_to(x + CW * s / 2, y - CH * s)
        cr.stroke()
        _container(cr, x, y, col, s)
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    if u < a0:
        host("point", hx, hy, 230)
    elif u < 0.62:
        host("haul", hx, hy, 230, beat=k)
    elif u < 0.9:
        host("hold_up", hx, hy, 230)
    else:
        host("cheer", hx, hy, 230)

    done = u >= a0 and k == n - 1 and grow >= 0.999
    if done:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{v1:g} ft", f"max draft · {l1.lower()}", 80, 470, size=130)
        text(cr, f"−{diff:g} ft", W - 80, 470, 80, look.INK, face="display",
             anchor="right", alpha=ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.05)))
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{v0:g} ft", f"max draft · {l0.lower()}", 80, 470,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

stories.hook_was: A drought just throttled global shipping.
