def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a clinic and its queue of sufferers
    SUBSTANCE: people with migraines
    CAUSE: Data drags the clinic's sliding door open with his own hands and holds it while the line walks in to care
    The closing, both halves of the line: the HUGE HIDDEN PROBLEM is a long
    queue of people holding their heads, snaking from the clinic door down
    a paved pavement right up to the camera, the nearest of them life-size,
    spaced so every one of them reads as a person. REAL CARE is Data
    gripping the door's pull bar and dragging it open, pull after pull.
    Done by 0.52 and held to the very last frame (and past it, for any u):
    he keeps both hands on the door, holding it wide, while the line walks
    in to the light and a new sufferer keeps arriving at the back. Only
    migraine is on screen: no other cause's meter, no outlines. The street
    is a street: paving running to the door, a bench, a lamp by the line.
    The motion is one continuous flow, never stop-start: the sufferers walk
    up in overlapping arrivals that end exactly when the line starts moving
    in, and each pull of the door runs almost the whole of its stroke.
    The sky band stays free of text for the closing line; the readout sits
    below it, over the roofline. The bottom of the frame is shaded down so
    the burned captions read clear of the people by the camera."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    ranked = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: -r[1])
    mig = next((r for r in rows if "migraine" in r[0].lower()),
               ranked[1] if len(ranked) > 1 else ranked[0])
    rank = 1 + sum(1 for r in rows if r[1] > mig[1])

    u = max(0.0, u)
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.52
    span = (a1 - a0) / 3
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, 2.999))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    # each pull runs nearly the whole stroke, so the door never stalls
    # for a frame or two between pulls
    pull = ease(seg(f, 0.04, 0.96))
    opened = 0.0 if u < a0 else clamp((k + pull) / 3.0)

    landscape(cr, t, "town")

    # the pavement: paving slabs running from the camera to the clinic door
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(0, 1335, W, H - 1335)
    cr.clip()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 62, 54), 0.22))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(11):
        yy = 1340 + 600 * (i / 10.0) ** 1.6
        cr.move_to(0, yy)
        cr.line_to(W, yy)
    for i in range(12):
        cr.move_to(330, 1240)
        cr.line_to(-700 + i * 210, H)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()

    # the clinic, big, three-quarter, its long shadow going away from the sun
    BASE = 1330
    cast_shadow(cr, 40, 620, BASE, length=340, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, 330, BASE + 4, 620, a=0.42)
    b = building(cr, 40, 620, BASE, 540, (220, 212, 200), roof="flat", boards=False)
    DX0, DX1, DY = 220, 440, BASE - 330
    dw = DX1 - DX0
    for c_ in range(4):
        wx = b["x0"] + 40 + c_ * 135
        wy = b["top"] + 110
        cr.rectangle(wx, wy, 90, 70)
        solid(cr, (250, 214, 150), finish="glass", rim=False)
    for wx in (b["x0"] + 445,):
        cr.rectangle(wx, DY + 20, 90, 150)
        solid(cr, (250, 214, 150), finish="glass", rim=False)
    # the sign: a red cross and the word
    cx_ = (b["x0"] + b["x1"]) / 2 - 60
    cr.rectangle(cx_ - 14, b["top"] + 14, 28, 80)
    solid(cr, (206, 44, 40))
    cr.rectangle(cx_ - 40, b["top"] + 40, 80, 28)
    solid(cr, (206, 44, 40))
    text(cr, "CLINIC", cx_ + 64, b["top"] + 80, 48, (40, 44, 54), face="bold", shadow=False)

    # the doorway: warm light inside
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(DX0, DY, dw, BASE - DY)
    cr.clip()
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (236, 222, 196)), (1, (252, 238, 208))], DY, BASE, DX0, DX1)
    glow(cr, (DX0 + DX1) / 2, BASE - 90, 240, (255, 236, 190), 0.7)
    cr.rectangle(DX0 + 40, BASE - 80, 140, 38)       # a treatment bed inside
    solid(cr, (246, 246, 250), rim=False)
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((80, 84, 96)))
    cr.set_line_width(12)
    cr.rectangle(DX0, DY, dw, BASE - DY)
    cr.stroke()
    # light spilling out down the pavement, toward the line, as the door opens
    if opened > 0:
        cr.move_to(DX0, BASE)
        cr.line_to(DX0 + dw * opened, BASE)
        cr.line_to(DX0 + dw * opened + 300 * opened, BASE + 220)
        cr.line_to(DX0 + 20, BASE + 220)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 236, 190), 0.35 * opened))
        cr.fill()
    # the sliding door, dragged left along the wall
    dx = DX0 - dw * opened
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((46, 44, 48)))
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    cr.move_to(max(4, DX0 - dw - 20), DY - 16)
    cr.line_to(DX1 + 20, DY - 16)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.rectangle(dx, DY - 6, dw, BASE - DY + 6)
    solid(cr, (70, 104, 128), finish="metal")
    cr.rectangle(dx + 22, DY + 30, dw - 44, 150)
    solid(cr, (150, 180, 196), finish="glass", rim=False)
    edge_x = dx + dw
    cr.rectangle(edge_x - 20, DY + 120, 12, 160)      # the long pull bar on its edge
    solid(cr, (214, 214, 220), finish="metal")

    # the street around the line: a lamp beside it, a bench on the left
    _lamp(cr, 975, 1440)
    _bench(cr, 60, 1500, 1.25)

    # the queue: from the door, down the pavement, right up to the camera,
    # spaced so even the back of the line reads person by person
    NS = 10
    n = NS - 1

    def slot(pos):
        p = clamp((pos + 0.5) / NS, 0.0, 1.2)
        return (480 + 560 * p - 220 * p * p, 1345 + 520 * p ** 1.35, 1.35 + 2.4 * p ** 1.6)

    # a planter by the camera on the left, so that corner is the street too
    contact_shadow(cr, 150, 1772, 260, a=0.4)
    box(cr, 30, 1770, 220, 110, (150, 128, 104), depth=50)
    for j in range(6):
        disc(cr, 60 + j * 36, 1650 - 18 * (j % 2), 38, P["shrub"])

    people = []
    SX, SY, SS = 1180.0, 2300.0, 4.2
    if u < a1:
        # overlapping arrivals, the last landing exactly at a1 where the
        # line starts walking in — no gap, no stop-start tail
        D = 2.6 * (a1 - a0) / n
        for i in range(n):
            ta = a0 + (a1 - a0 - D) * i / max(1, n - 1)
            if u < ta:
                continue
            q = clamp((u - ta) / D)
            p = 1.0 - (1.0 - q) * (1.0 - q) * (1.0 - 0.35 * q)
            ex, ey, es = slot(i)
            people.append((SY + (ey - SY) * p, SX + (ex - SX) * p, SS + (es - SS) * p, i, 1.0))
    else:
        o = (u - a1) / 0.09
        fr = o % 1.0
        base_i = int(o)
        for j in range(n + 1):
            pos = j - fr
            pid = j + base_i
            if pos < 0:          # stepping in through the open door
                e = -pos
                sx, sy, ss = slot(0)
                x = sx + ((DX0 + DX1) / 2 - sx) * e
                y = sy + (BASE + 4 - sy) * e
                people.append((y, x, ss - 0.2 * e, pid, 1.0 - e))
            elif pos > n - 1:    # a new one walking up to the back
                e = 1.0 - (pos - (n - 1))
                ex, ey, es = slot(n - 1)
                people.append((SY + (ey - SY) * e, SX + (ex - SX) * e, SS + (es - SS) * e, pid, 1.0))
            else:
                x, y, s = slot(pos)
                people.append((y, x, s, pid, 1.0))

    # Data at the door's edge, both hands on the pull bar: he drags it open,
    # then HOLDS it wide to the last frame while the line goes in
    fx = edge_x - 74
    fy = BASE + 12
    hands = [(edge_x - 14, DY + 150), (edge_x - 14, DY + 250)]
    if u < a0:
        host("point", DX1 + 60, fy, 240)
    else:
        host("grip", fx, fy, 240, hands=hands,
             lower="brace" if u < a1 + 0.04 else "stand",
             expr="strain" if u < a1 + 0.04 else "happy")

    for y, x, s, i, a in sorted(people):
        _ache(cr, x, y, s, i, t, a=a)
    foreground(cr, "town")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # the caption band: shade the bottom of the shot down so the burned
    # captions sit on dark, never on a bright coat
    g = cairo.LinearGradient(0, 1480, 0, H)
    g.add_color_stop_rgba(0, 0.04, 0.04, 0.06, 0.0)
    g.add_color_stop_rgba(0.35, 0.04, 0.04, 0.06, 0.38)
    g.add_color_stop_rgba(1, 0.04, 0.04, 0.06, 0.55)
    cr.rectangle(0, 1480, W, H - 1480)
    cr.set_source(g)
    cr.fill()

    # the readout sits below the closing line's band, over the roofline
    if u >= a1:
        place = {1: "biggest", 2: "second-biggest", 3: "third-biggest"}.get(rank, f"number {rank}")
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(mig[1]))}%",
                    f"of the world's disability · the {place} cause",
                    80, 640, a=ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.05)), size=120)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, mig[0], "a huge hidden problem, waiting for care",
                    80, 640, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=120)

stories.title: Vinyl Records Beat CD Sales In America Again
stories.hook: In 2022, vinyl beat CD sales for the first time since 1987.
stories.closing: Music is moving to streaming, yet people still pay to own something they can hold.
stories.question: Do you still own a CD?
stories.caption: In 2022, vinyl album sales passed CDs in America for the first time since 1987 -- but the twist is what it says about the entire music industry. Do you still own a CD? 👇

segments.say: Vinyl earned two and a half times what old shiny music discs did in 2022. That hasn't happened since 1987.
Vinyl even outsold the old music discs by count, about five records for every four discs. People want something to hold.
Streaming is still 84 percent of music money in America. Vinyl's comeback is a small slice of a much bigger shift.

# scene standard: 2026-10-22
def _pk_pt(gx, gz):
    sc = 1.0 - 0.42 * gz
    return 540 + (gx - 0.5) * 1040 * sc, 1460 - 520 * gz, sc


def _pk_quad(cr, x0, z0, x1, z1):
    ps = [_pk_pt(x0, z0), _pk_pt(x1, z0), _pk_pt(x1, z1), _pk_pt(x0, z1)]
    cr.move_to(ps[0][0], ps[0][1])
    for p in ps[1:]:
        cr.line_to(p[0], p[1])
    cr.close_path()


def _pk_line(cr, x0, z0, x1, z1):
    a = _pk_pt(x0, z0)
    b = _pk_pt(x1, z1)
    cr.move_to(a[0], a[1])
    cr.line_to(b[0], b[1])


def _pk_rr(cr, x, y, w, h, r):
    r = min(r, w / 2, h / 2)
    cr.new_sub_path()
    cr.arc(x + w - r, y + r, r, -math.pi / 2, 0)
    cr.arc(x + w - r, y + h - r, r, 0, math.pi / 2)
    cr.arc(x + r, y + h - r, r, math.pi / 2, math.pi)
    cr.arc(x + r, y + r, r, math.pi, 1.5 * math.pi)
    cr.close_path()


_PK_COURTS = [(0.03, 0.0), (0.53, 0.0), (0.03, 0.52), (0.53, 0.52)]
_PK_SLOTS = [(0.3, 0.1), (0.72, 0.14), (0.28, 0.84), (0.7, 0.88)]
_PK_SHIRTS = [(226, 74, 60), (246, 196, 60), (240, 240, 236), (236, 120, 40),
              (150, 80, 190), (60, 180, 150)]
_PK_SKIN = [(214, 170, 130), (170, 120, 86), (236, 196, 160), (120, 84, 60)]


def _pk_paddle(cr, x, y, ang, s, rgb, a=1.0):
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.rotate(ang)
    cr.rectangle(-3.5 * s, -2 * s, 7 * s, 16 * s)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (34, 34, 40), a=a, rim=False)
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.rotate(ang)
    _pk_rr(cr, -12 * s, -34 * s, 24 * s, 33 * s, 10 * s)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, rgb, finish="gloss", a=a)


def _pk_court(cr, gx, gz):
    _pk_quad(cr, gx - 0.018, gz - 0.018, gx + 0.458, gz + 0.458)
    solid(cr, (70, 128, 92), rim=False)
    _pk_quad(cr, gx, gz, gx + 0.44, gz + 0.44)
    solid(cr, (58, 104, 168), rim=False)
    # the kitchen, a lighter blue either side of the net
    zm = gz + 0.22
    _pk_quad(cr, gx, zm - 0.075, gx + 0.44, zm + 0.075)
    solid(cr, (74, 126, 190), rim=False, edge=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((244, 244, 238)))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    _pk_quad(cr, gx, gz, gx + 0.44, gz + 0.44)
    cr.stroke()
    for kz in (zm - 0.075, zm + 0.075):
        _pk_line(cr, gx, kz, gx + 0.44, kz)
    _pk_line(cr, gx + 0.22, gz, gx + 0.22, zm - 0.075)
    _pk_line(cr, gx + 0.22, zm + 0.075, gx + 0.22, gz + 0.44)
    cr.stroke()


def _pk_net(cr, gx, gz, fr, end=None):
    """The net strung from its left post; `end` = (x, top, bottom) is the
    roll in Data's hands while he walks it across."""
    zm = gz + 0.22
    xl, y, sc = _pk_pt(gx - 0.012, zm)
    xr, _, _ = _pk_pt(gx + 0.452, zm)
    nh = 60 * sc
    cylinder(cr, xl - 6 * sc, y, 12 * sc, nh + 8 * sc, (64, 66, 72), finish="metal")
    if fr <= 0:
        return
    if end is not None:
        ex, et, eb = end
    else:
        ex, et, eb = xl + (xr - xl) * fr, y - nh, y - 4 * sc
    cr.move_to(xl, y - nh)
    cr.line_to(ex, et)
    cr.line_to(ex, eb)
    cr.line_to(xl, y - 4 * sc)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((22, 26, 32), 0.8))
    cr.fill_preserve()
    cr.save()
    cr.clip()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 156, 166), 0.55))
    cr.set_line_width(1.5)
    xx = min(xl, ex) + 8
    while xx < max(xl, ex):
        cr.move_to(xx, min(et, y - nh) - 4)
        cr.line_to(xx, max(eb, y) + 4)
        xx += 8
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((248, 248, 244)))
    cr.set_line_width(7 * sc)
    cr.move_to(xl, y - nh)
    cr.line_to(ex, et)
    cr.stroke()
    if end is None and fr >= 0.999:
        cylinder(cr, xr - 6 * sc, y, 12 * sc, nh + 8 * sc, (64, 66, 72), finish="metal")


def _pk_player(cr, x, y, s, t, i, a):
    if a <= 0.01:
        return
    run = 1.0 - ease(a)
    sw = math.sin(t * 3.2 + i * 1.7)
    x += 26 * s * sw - run * 220 * s
    al = clamp(a * 3)
    skin = _PK_SKIN[i % 4]
    shirt = _PK_SHIRTS[i % len(_PK_SHIRTS)]
    contact_shadow(cr, x, y, 62 * s, a=0.3 * al)
    cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
    st = 8 * s * sw + run * 16 * s * math.sin(t * 12 + i)
    for side in (-1, 1):
        fx = x + side * (10 * s + st)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(skin, al))
        cr.set_line_width(11 * s)
        cr.move_to(x + side * 7 * s, y - 52 * s)
        cr.line_to(fx, y - 8 * s)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(fx + 3 * s, y - 5 * s)
        cr.scale(1.5, 0.8)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 7 * s, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        solid(cr, (244, 244, 240), a=al, rim=False)
    _pk_rr(cr, x - 18 * s, y - 64 * s, 36 * s, 22 * s, 6 * s)
    solid(cr, (40, 44, 56), a=al)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(skin, al))
    cr.set_line_width(9 * s)
    cr.move_to(x - 14 * s, y - 94 * s)
    cr.line_to(x - 26 * s, y - 66 * s)
    cr.stroke()
    _pk_rr(cr, x - 19 * s, y - 104 * s, 38 * s, 46 * s, 13 * s)
    solid(cr, shirt, a=al)
    disc(cr, x, y - 118 * s, 15 * s, skin, a=al)
    # a cap: its crown sits ON the head, the brim part of it
    cr.arc(x, y - 120 * s, 16 * s, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, shirt, a=al)
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x + 12 * s, y - 120 * s)
    cr.scale(1.0, 0.32)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 13 * s, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, shirt, a=al, rim=False)
    hx, hy = x + 34 * s, y - 78 * s - 16 * s * sw
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(skin, al))
    cr.set_line_width(9 * s)
    cr.move_to(x + 15 * s, y - 94 * s)
    cr.line_to(hx, hy)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_BUTT)
    _pk_paddle(cr, hx, hy, 0.5 * sw - 0.3, s, (36, 40, 48), a=al)


def _pk_roll(cr, hx, hy, hh, k):
    """The rolled net he carries upright in his two hands; returns the two
    points his hands go on and the net's top and bottom at the roll."""
    w = 16 + 26 * k
    top, bot = hy - 0.52 * hh, hy - 0.22 * hh
    cylinder(cr, hx - w / 2, bot, w, bot - top, (226, 230, 220))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 34, 40), 0.6))
    cr.set_line_width(2.5)
    for q in range(1, 5):
        yq = top + (bot - top) * q / 5
        cr.move_to(hx - w / 2, yq)
        cr.line_to(hx + w / 2, yq)
    cr.stroke()
    hands = [(hx - w / 2 - 2, hy - 0.46 * hh), (hx + w / 2 + 2, hy - 0.3 * hh)]
    return hands, top, bot


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: four pickleball courts filling with players
    SUBSTANCE: pickleball players
    CAUSE: Data carries a net to each empty court and unrolls it, and players run on to play
    One park of four courts is the whole: in 2019 its players fill ONE
    court; Data carries a rolled net to each empty court in turn and walks
    it across from post to post, and that year's players run on. Four
    players stand for 2019's 3.3 million, so 2023's crowd fills all four
    courts: four times the game, read at a glance, with 2019's court
    outlined. Done by 0.58 and held while the rallies go on and Data holds
    the last net taut."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    n = len(rows)
    vals = [v for _, v in rows]
    v0 = vals[0] or 1.0
    if n >= 3:
        T = [vals[0], vals[-2], (vals[-2] + vals[-1]) / 2, vals[-1]]
        Y = [0, n - 2, n - 2, n - 1]
    elif n == 2:
        d = vals[1] - vals[0]
        T = [vals[0], vals[0] + d / 3, vals[0] + 2 * d / 3, vals[1]]
        Y = [0, 0, 0, 1]
    else:
        T = [vals[0]] * 4
        Y = [0] * 4
    E = 4
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.58
    span = (a1 - a0) / E
    j = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, E - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - j * span) / span)
    walkf = ease(seg(f, 0.0, 0.3))
    unroll = ease(seg(f, 0.3, 0.55))
    fill = ease(seg(f, 0.5, 0.9))
    if u < a0:
        val = 0.0
    else:
        prev = T[j - 1] if j > 0 else 0.0
        val = prev + (T[j] - prev) * fill
    players = min(16.0, val / v0 * 4.0)
    ldone = -1 if u < a0 else (j if fill >= 0.999 else j - 1)
    shown = rows[Y[ldone]] if ldone >= 0 else None

    # where Data is: walking to a court's left post, then walking the net across
    def ends(c):
        gx, gz = _PK_COURTS[c]
        zd = gz + 0.19
        return _pk_pt(gx - 0.012, zd), _pk_pt(gx + 0.452, zd)

    start = (540.0, 1480.0, 1.0)
    if u < a0:
        hx, hy, hs = start
    else:
        pa = ends(j - 1)[1] if j > 0 else start
        L, R = ends(j)
        if unroll <= 0:
            hx = pa[0] + (L[0] - pa[0]) * walkf
            hy = pa[1] + (L[1] - pa[1]) * walkf
            hs = pa[2] + (L[2] - pa[2]) * walkf
        else:
            hx = L[0] + (R[0] - L[0]) * unroll
            hy = L[1] + (R[1] - L[1]) * unroll
            hs = L[2] + (R[2] - L[2]) * unroll
    hy = min(1490.0, hy)
    hh = clamp(240 * hs, 180, 240)
    k_roll = 1.0 - 0.7 * unroll if u >= a0 else 1.0
    r_w = 16 + 26 * k_roll
    r_top, r_bot = hy - 0.52 * hh, hy - 0.22 * hh

    # the setting: a town park at a low sun, trees, clubhouse, fence and lights
    landscape(cr, t, "town", horizon=900)
    treeline(cr, 902, (74, 110, 82), n=14, seed=3)
    cast_shadow(cr, 640, 980, 905, length=140, a=0.2)
    building(cr, 640, 980, 905, 150, (206, 194, 172), roof="flat")
    haze(cr, 600, 905, (214, 206, 196), a=0.4)
    _pk_quad(cr, -0.08, -0.12, 1.08, 1.05)
    solid(cr, (156, 152, 142), rim=False)
    for px in range(20, W, 96):
        cylinder(cr, px, 904, 8, 96, (92, 96, 104), finish="metal")
    cr.rectangle(0, 896, W, 52)
    solid(cr, (40, 82, 62), rim=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((92, 96, 104)))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    cr.move_to(0, 810)
    cr.line_to(W, 810)
    cr.stroke()
    for lx in (40, 1026):
        cylinder(cr, lx, 906, 14, 470, (84, 88, 96), finish="metal")
        box(cr, lx - 34, 436, 82, 26, (60, 62, 70), depth=16, finish="metal")
        glow(cr, lx + 7, 452, 60, (255, 244, 210), 0.35)

    # the courts, far row first: surface, far-side players, net, near-side
    for c in (2, 3, 0, 1):
        gx, gz = _PK_COURTS[c]
        _pk_court(cr, gx, gz)
        onc = [clamp(players - (c * 4 + q)) for q in range(4)]
        for q in (2, 3):
            fx, fz = _PK_SLOTS[q]
            px, py, ps = _pk_pt(gx + 0.44 * fx, gz + 0.44 * fz)
            _pk_player(cr, px, py, 1.35 * ps, t, c * 4 + q, onc[q])
        if u < a0 or c > j:
            _pk_net(cr, gx, gz, 0.0)
        elif c < j:
            _pk_net(cr, gx, gz, 1.0)
        elif unroll > 0:
            _pk_net(cr, gx, gz, 1.0, end=(hx, r_top, r_bot))
        else:
            _pk_net(cr, gx, gz, 0.0)
        for q in (0, 1):
            fx, fz = _PK_SLOTS[q]
            px, py, ps = _pk_pt(gx + 0.44 * fx, gz + 0.44 * fz)
            _pk_player(cr, px, py, 1.35 * ps, t, c * 4 + q, onc[q])
        # a rally over the net once the court is in play
        if u >= a0 and (c < j or (c == j and unroll >= 0.999)) and \
                sum(1 for o in onc if o > 0.9) >= 2:
            p = (t * 0.7 + c * 0.31) % 1.0
            pp = 1 - abs(2 * p - 1)
            bx, by, bs = _pk_pt(gx + 0.44 * (0.35 + 0.3 * p), gz + 0.44 * (0.15 + 0.7 * pp))
            disc(cr, bx, by - 70 * bs - 120 * bs * math.sin(math.pi * pp), 14 * bs,
                 (232, 236, 70), finish="gloss")

    # THE SCALE: 2019's whole game fit on this one court
    if ldone >= 3:
        gx, gz = _PK_COURTS[0]
        _pk_quad(cr, gx - 0.03, gz - 0.03, gx + 0.47, gz + 0.47)
        ghost(cr, a=0.85)
        lx, ly, _ = _pk_pt(gx + 0.22, gz - 0.03)
        text(cr, rows[0][0], lx, ly + 40, 34, look.INK, face="bold", anchor="center")

    # right by the camera: two paddles and balls on the ground
    for bx, by in ((420, 1780), (520, 1850)):
        contact_shadow(cr, bx, by + 28, 64, a=0.35)
        disc(cr, bx, by, 30, (232, 236, 70), finish="gloss")
    _pk_paddle(cr, 860, 1770, 0.5, 4.0, (40, 96, 176))
    _pk_paddle(cr, 180, 1820, -0.6, 3.6, (214, 70, 60))
    foreground(cr, "town")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data: the rolled net in his two hands, walking it across each court
    hands, _, _ = _pk_roll(cr, hx, hy, hh, k_roll)
    if u < 0.035:
        host("point", hx, hy, hh)
    elif u < 0.93:
        lower = "brace" if (u >= a0 and 0 < unroll < 1) else "stand"
        if u < a0:
            lower = "crouch"
        host("grip", hx, hy, hh, hands=hands, lower=lower, expr="strain")
    else:
        host("cheer", hx, hy, hh)

    if shown is not None:
        lab, v = shown
        fit_readout(cr, f"{v:g}M players", f"Americans playing pickleball · {lab}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, a0, a0 + 0.05)), size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Pickleball", f"US players, {rows[0][0]}–{rows[-1][0]}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)
    if ldone >= 3 and n >= 2:
        text(cr, f"{vals[-1] / v0:.1f}x", W - 80, 680, 90, look.INK, face="display",
             anchor="right", alpha=ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.05)))

# scene standard: 2026-10-22
def _pk_pt(f, d):
    FY, NY = 1060.0, 1490.0
    y = FY + d * (NY - FY)
    left = 330 + (110 - 330) * d
    right = 750 + (970 - 750) * d
    return left + (right - left) * f, y


def _pk_quad(cr, f0, d0, f1, d1):
    cr.move_to(*_pk_pt(f0, d0))
    cr.line_to(*_pk_pt(f1, d0))
    cr.line_to(*_pk_pt(f1, d1))
    cr.line_to(*_pk_pt(f0, d1))
    cr.close_path()


def _pk_line(cr, f0, d0, f1, d1, w, rgb, a=1.0):
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(rgb, a))
    cr.set_line_width(w)
    cr.move_to(*_pk_pt(f0, d0))
    cr.line_to(*_pk_pt(f1, d1))
    cr.stroke()


def _pk_ball(cr, x, y, r):
    disc(cr, x, y, r, (214, 226, 70), finish="gloss")
    for i in range(5):
        ang = i * 1.257 + 0.4
        cr.arc(x + r * 0.5 * math.cos(ang), y + r * 0.5 * math.sin(ang), r * 0.13, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 130, 30), 0.8))
        cr.fill()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a tennis court being repainted
    SUBSTANCE: pickleball court paint
    CAUSE: Data drags a paint squeegee down the tennis court, laying pickleball paint past the net
    The whole tennis court is tennis's players. Data drags a resurfacing
    squeegee from the far baseline toward the camera, and the court behind
    it turns pickleball blue-green. It stops at pickleball's share of
    tennis, already past the net, which marks half. Done by 0.62 and held
    while pickleballs bounce on the new paint."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    (lt, tv) = max(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    (lp, pv) = min(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    tv = tv or 1.0
    share = clamp(pv / tv)
    a0, a1 = 0.06, 0.62
    prog = ease(seg(u, a0, a1))
    p = share * prog
    done = u >= a1

    landscape(cr, t, "town", horizon=1040)
    # the fence behind the court
    for i in range(10):
        fx = 20 + i * 118
        cylinder(cr, fx, 1060, 12, 230, (70, 76, 82), finish="metal")
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 68, 74), 0.35))
    cr.set_line_width(2)
    for i in range(-20, 40):
        cr.move_to(i * 40, 830)
        cr.line_to(i * 40 + 230, 1060)
        cr.move_to(i * 40 + 230, 830)
        cr.line_to(i * 40, 1060)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.rectangle(0, 826, W, 8)
    solid(cr, (70, 76, 82), finish="metal", rim=False)
    haze(cr, 700, 1060, (214, 206, 196), a=0.3)

    # the run-off apron and the tennis surface: the whole
    cr.move_to(290, 1040)
    cr.line_to(790, 1040)
    cr.line_to(1040, 1520)
    cr.line_to(40, 1520)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (150, 112, 92), edge=False)
    _pk_quad(cr, 0, 0, 1, 1)
    solid(cr, (118, 126, 138), edge=False)
    W_ = (244, 244, 238)
    for d in (0.0, 1.0, 0.24, 0.76):
        _pk_line(cr, 0 if d in (0.0, 1.0) else 0.12, d, 1 if d in (0.0, 1.0) else 0.88, d, 6, W_)
    for f in (0.0, 1.0, 0.12, 0.88):
        _pk_line(cr, f, 0, f, 1, 6, W_)
    _pk_line(cr, 0.5, 0.24, 0.5, 0.76, 5, W_)

    # the new pickleball paint, laid down behind the squeegee
    if p > 0.002:
        _pk_quad(cr, 0, 0, 1, p)
        solid(cr, P["accent2"], edge=False)
        # pickleball lines on the new paint: a narrower court and its kitchen
        for f in (0.22, 0.78):
            _pk_line(cr, f, 0, f, p, 6, W_)
        _pk_line(cr, 0.22, 0.0, 0.78, 0.0, 6, W_)
        for d in (0.3, 0.42):
            if p > d:
                _pk_line(cr, 0.22, d, 0.78, d, 6, W_)
        if p > 0.3:
            _pk_line(cr, 0.5, 0.0, 0.5, 0.3, 5, W_)
        # the wet front edge
        x0, yb = _pk_pt(0, p)
        x1, _ = _pk_pt(1, p)
        glow(cr, (x0 + x1) / 2, yb, 200, P["accent2"], 0.25)

    # the net, at half the court
    nl, ny = _pk_pt(-0.04, 0.5)
    nr, _ = _pk_pt(1.04, 0.5)
    cast_shadow(cr, nl, nr, ny, length=60, a=0.2)
    cr.rectangle(nl, ny - 50, nr - nl, 50)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 32, 36), 0.55))
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((20, 22, 26), 0.6))
    cr.set_line_width(2)
    for i in range(int((nr - nl) / 14)):
        cr.move_to(nl + i * 14, ny - 50)
        cr.line_to(nl + i * 14, ny)
    for j in range(4):
        cr.move_to(nl, ny - 50 + j * 13)
        cr.line_to(nr, ny - 50 + j * 13)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.rectangle(nl, ny - 56, nr - nl, 9)
    solid(cr, (246, 246, 240), rim=False)
    for px in (nl, nr):
        contact_shadow(cr, px, ny, 30, a=0.3)
        cylinder(cr, px - 7, ny, 14, 66, (60, 64, 70), finish="metal")

    # the squeegee at the paint's edge
    yb = _pk_pt(0, p)[1]
    bx0, _ = _pk_pt(0.02, p)
    bx1, _ = _pk_pt(0.98, p)
    contact_shadow(cr, (bx0 + bx1) / 2, yb + 6, bx1 - bx0, a=0.35)
    box(cr, bx0, yb + 6, bx1 - bx0, 16, (48, 50, 56), depth=10, finish="metal")
    cr.rectangle(bx0, yb + 6, bx1 - bx0, 6)
    solid(cr, (34, 34, 38), rim=False)

    # Data on the right sideline, pulling the pole toward the camera
    dd = (yb - 1060.0) / 430.0
    hh = 192 + 40 * dd
    dx = _pk_pt(1.0, p)[0] + 86
    foot = min(1500.0, yb + 62)
    B = _pk_pt(0.84, p)
    B = (B[0], yb)
    h1 = (dx - 22, foot - 0.58 * hh)
    h2 = (h1[0] + (B[0] - h1[0]) * 0.2, h1[1] + (B[1] - h1[1]) * 0.2)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 120, 80)))
    cr.set_line_width(9)
    cr.move_to(*B)
    cr.line_to(h1[0] + 10, h1[1] - 3)
    cr.stroke()

    # after it lands, the new court is in play
    if done:
        for j in range(2):
            ph = (t * 0.8 + j * 0.5) % 1.0
            d = 0.12 + 0.18 * j
            xa, ya = _pk_pt(0.26, d)
            xb, _ = _pk_pt(0.74, d)
            if j:
                xa, xb = xb, xa
            bxp = xa + (xb - xa) * ph
            byp = ya - 150 * abs(math.sin(math.pi * ph * 2)) - 16
            contact_shadow(cr, bxp, ya, 40, a=0.25)
            _pk_ball(cr, bxp, byp, 22)

    # right by the camera: a paddle and balls on the apron
    contact_shadow(cr, 230, 1700, 220, a=0.35)
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(230, 1660)
    cr.rotate(-0.35)
    cr.rectangle(-26, 60, 52, 120)
    solid(cr, (40, 40, 46))
    cr.scale(1.0, 1.15)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 105, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, P["accent2"], finish="gloss")
    for i, (bx, by) in enumerate(((620, 1760), (760, 1820), (930, 1700))):
        contact_shadow(cr, bx, by + 30, 70, a=0.3)
        _pk_ball(cr, bx, by, 34 + 4 * (i % 2))
    foreground(cr, "town")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    if u < a0:
        host("point", dx, foot, hh)
    else:
        host("grip", dx, foot, hh, hands=[h1, h2], lower="follow",
             expr="strain" if not done else "happy")

    # the net's label goes on the LEFT post, clear of Data on the right
    # sideline, and is drawn after him so nothing of him ever covers it
    if p > 0.45 or done:
        text(cr, "HALF", nl - 22, ny - 14, 30, look.INK, face="bold",
             anchor="right", alpha=ease(seg(u, 0.3, 0.38)))

    if done:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{pv:.1f}M", f"{lp.lower()} players · past half of {lt.lower()}",
                    80, 520, size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{tv:.1f}M", f"{lt.lower()} players · the whole court",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

# scene standard: 2026-10-22
def _bill(cr, x0, xe, y0, y1):
    # the hospital bill: a long sheet fed out of the billing printer, its
    # leading edge (the header) first, itemised charges behind it
    if xe - x0 < 4:
        return
    cr.move_to(x0, y0)
    cr.line_to(xe, y0)
    teeth = 10
    th = (y1 - y0) / teeth
    for i in range(teeth):
        cr.line_to(xe + 10, y0 + (i + 0.5) * th)
        cr.line_to(xe, y0 + (i + 1) * th)
    cr.line_to(x0, y1)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (246, 243, 234))
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(x0, y0, xe - x0, y1 - y0)
    cr.clip()
    # the header: a red cross and the bill's title, riding the leading edge
    cr.rectangle(xe - 92, y0 + 26, 22, 66)
    solid(cr, (206, 48, 44), rim=False)

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):

    The ER of a hospital by a pickleball court. The bill for pickleball
    injuries hangs out of the billing printer at its 2018 length; Data takes
    its leading edge in both hands and walks it out across the room in four
    tugs until it is 2023's length. The paper's length is the cost, so the
    2018 bill stays as a dashed ghost with its year notched on it: about
    2.7 times as long. The sheet hangs low, at his chest, so his hands
    reach its edge. Done by 0.62 and held while the rally goes on outside
    the window."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    top = max(v0, v1) or 1.0
    v0s = v0 or 1.0
    X0, Y0, Y1 = 292, 960, 1340
    LMAX = 680.0
    L0 = LMAX * v0 / top
    L1 = LMAX * v1 / top
    n = 4
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.62
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    pull = ease(seg(f, 0.05, 0.78))
    step = 0.0 if u < a0 else (k + pull) / n
    L = L0 + (L1 - L0) * step
    xe = X0 + L
    done = u >= a0 and k == n - 1 and pull >= 0.999

    # the ER: pale clinic wall, ceiling lights, a tiled floor to the camera
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (120, 140, 140)), (0.6, (196, 212, 206)), (1, (214, 224, 218))], 0, 1190)
    for i in range(4):
        lx = 120 + i * 260

    # the EMERGENCY sign
    box(cr, 640, 300, 360, 86, (206, 48, 44), depth=30, finish="gloss")
    text(cr, "EMERGENCY", 808, 268, 48, (250, 248, 244), face="bold", anchor="center",

    # the window onto the pickleball courts, a rally going on
    WX0, WX1, WY0, WY1 = 360, 1010, 610, 850
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(WX0, WY0, WX1 - WX0, WY1 - WY0)

    vgrad(cr, [(0, (150, 196, 230)), (1, (214, 230, 236))], WY0, WY0 + 110, WX0, WX1)
    treeline(cr, WY0 + 120, P["leaf_far"], n=10, seed=3)
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (70, 150, 140)), (1, (52, 128, 120))], WY0 + 118, WY1, WX0, WX1)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((240, 244, 240)))

    cr.rectangle((WX0 + WX1) / 2 - 3, WY0 + 120, 6, 70)
    solid(cr, (40, 44, 50), rim=False, edge=False)
    for side, px in ((-1, WX0 + 90), (1, WX1 - 90)):

        solid(cr, (60, 70, 120) if side < 0 else (150, 60, 60), edge=False)
        disc(cr, px, WY0 + 128, 16, (210, 170, 140))
    haze(cr, WY0, WY1, (214, 226, 230), a=0.3)
    ph = (t / 1.3) % 2.0
    p = ph if ph < 1 else 2.0 - ph
    bx = WX0 + 110 + (WX1 - WX0 - 220) * ease(p)
    by = WY0 + 150 - 110 * math.sin(math.pi * p)

    cr.restore()
    cr.rectangle(WX0, WY0, WX1 - WX0, WY1 - WY0)
    edge(cr, (236, 238, 236), width=14)

    # the floor
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (150, 160, 166)), (1, (104, 112, 120))], 1180, H)
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(0, 1180, W, H - 1180)
    cr.clip()

    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(16):
        cr.move_to(540, 900)
        cr.line_to(-1100 + i * 220, H)
    for j in range(7):
        yy = 1180 + (j ** 1.6) * 34

    # the billing printer, standing on the floor in three-quarter view
    cast_shadow(cr, 60, 340, 1440, length=260, a=0.25)

    box(cr, 60, 1440, 230, 620, (204, 210, 218), depth=56, finish="metal")
    cr.rectangle(90, 850, 160, 90)

    cr.rectangle(282, Y0 - 14, 12, Y1 - Y0 + 28)

    cr.translate(150, 1760)

    cr.rectangle(60, -6, 40, 74)

    # Data pulls the bill out by its leading edge, walking back across the
    # room; the sheet's lower edge is at his chest, inside his reach

stories.title: Nearly 2,000 People Signed Up To Be Frozen
stories.hook: Alcor is freezing the dead, and nearly everyone waiting in line is still alive.
stories.closing: Nobody knows how to wake them up, so these members are betting on the future.
stories.question: Would you ever sign up to be frozen?
stories.caption: 1,927 people have paid to be cryogenically frozen when they die. Only 222 have actually made it into the tank. Here's the gap between signing up and actually freezing -- and the one problem nobody's solved yet. Would you do it? 👇

segments.say: Alcor has frozen 222 people so far. You only join them after you die, so that group grows slowly.
About 1,927 people have signed up, but most are still alive and waiting. Only a small fraction are frozen.
Freezing your whole body costs $200,000, while head only is far cheaper. Most members pay with life insurance.

# scene standard: 2026-10-22
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a giant block of ice
    SUBSTANCE: solid ice
    CAUSE: Data saws through the ice block and the top chunk falls away, leaving the smaller head-only block
    One price is a block of ice: whole-body preservation is the full block
    standing in a cold-storage room. Data climbs a crate and saws across it at
    the head-only share of the price. The top falls off and slides away, and
    what is left is that share of the block. Then he hops down off the crate
    and holds up the kept block beside it. The full block's old height stays
    as a ghost outline with its top marked, so a glance shows the head-only
    price is well under half."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts[:2]]
    (lw, whole), (lh, head) = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: -r[1])
    whole = whole or 1.0
    share = clamp(head / whole)

    BX, BW, BASE, H0 = 380, 360, 1440, 780
    top = BASE - H0
    hb = H0 * share
    ht = H0 - hb
    cutY = BASE - hb

    a0, c0, c1 = 0.08, 0.16, 0.48
    n = 4
    span = (c1 - c0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - c0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - c0 - k * span) / span)
    if u < c0:
        depth = 0.0
    elif u < c1:
        depth = (k + ease(seg(f, 0.3, 0.7))) / n
    else:
        depth = 1.0
    tip = ease(seg(u, 0.49, 0.6))
    drop = seg(u, 0.52, 0.62) ** 2
    slide = seg(u, 0.62, 1.0)
    fallen = u >= 0.6

    # the cold room: steel walls, ceiling lights, a pale floor
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (40, 52, 66)), (0.6, (96, 120, 140)), (1, (150, 172, 188))], 0, 1160)
    for i in range(6):
        px = 20 + i * 180
        cr.rectangle(px, 720, 160, 420)
        solid(cr, (118, 140, 158), finish="metal", rim=False)
    for i in range(3):
        lx = 180 + i * 360
        glow(cr, lx, 300, 260, (220, 240, 255), 0.45)
        box(cr, lx - 110, 300, 220, 22, (236, 244, 250), depth=30)
    haze(cr, 200, 1160, (170, 196, 214), a=0.45)
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (176, 196, 210)), (1, (120, 140, 156))], 1150, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((90, 108, 124), 0.35))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(12):
        cr.move_to(540, 900)
        cr.line_to(-1200 + i * 300, H)
    cr.stroke()
    glow(cr, 560, 1300, 520, (220, 240, 255), 0.25)

    ICE = (170, 214, 236)
    # the block's shadow and the standing (kept) part
    cast_shadow(cr, BX, BX + BW, BASE, length=300, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, BX + BW / 2, BASE + 4, BW + 120, a=0.4)
    box(cr, BX, BASE, BW, hb, ICE, finish="ice")

    # the top chunk: whole, then cut, then tipped off to the left and slid away
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(BX - 600 * slide, cutY + (BASE - cutY) * drop)
    cr.rotate(-tip * math.pi / 2)
    box(cr, 0, 0, BW, ht, ICE, finish="ice")
    cr.restore()

    # the saw cut creeping in from Data's side
    if 0 < depth and tip <= 0:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 60, 90), 0.9))
        cr.set_line_width(7)
        cr.move_to(BX + BW + 0.22 * BW, cutY - 0.22 * BW * 0.5)
        cr.line_to(BX + BW, cutY)
        cr.line_to(BX + BW - depth * BW, cutY)
        cr.stroke()

    # THE SCALE on the block: the whole-body block as a ghost, its top marked
    if fallen:
        cr.rectangle(BX, top, BW, H0)
        ghost(cr, a=0.9)
        then_mark(cr, BX - 20, BX + BW + 90, top, "whole body")
        steam(cr, BX + BW / 2, cutY - 10, t, 1.0)

    # the crate he stands on to reach the cut
    contact_shadow(cr, 910, BASE + 4, 170, a=0.4)
    box(cr, 840, BASE, 140, 130, (150, 112, 72), depth=30)

    # right by the camera: loose chunks of ice on the floor
    for i, (cx, cy, s) in enumerate([(110, 1720, 90), (300, 1830, 120), (820, 1760, 100),
                                     (960, 1880, 70)]):
        contact_shadow(cr, cx + s / 2, cy + 4, s * 1.3, a=0.35)
        box(cr, cx, cy, s, s * 0.7, ICE, finish="ice")
    foreground(cr, "snow")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data: points from the floor, climbs the crate, saws, then hops down
    # beside the kept block and holds it up
    sx, sy = 1010, 1440
    ex, ey = 900, 1310
    gx, gy = 800, 1500
    if u < a0:
        host("point", sx, sy, 225)
    elif u < c0:
        q = ease(seg(u, a0, c0))
        host("climb", sx + (ex - sx) * q, sy + (ey - sy) * q, 225)
    elif u < c1 + 0.03:
        host("cut", ex, ey, 225, beat=k)
    elif u < 0.6:
        host("shock", ex, ey, 225)
    else:
        q = ease(seg(u, 0.6, 0.7))
        host("hold_up", ex + (gx - ex) * q, ey + (gy - ey) * q, 225)

    if fallen:
        fit_readout(cr, f"${head:,.0f}", f"{lh.lower()} · {int(round((1 - share) * 100))}% less",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.6, 0.65)), size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"${whole:,.0f}", f"to freeze your {lw.split()[0].lower()} body",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

stories.title: America's Top Dog Has a 4.5-Year Life Expectancy
stories.hook: The top-ranked dog has a 4.5-year population life expectancy.
stories.closing: Popularity cannot replace a hard look at a breed's health and care needs.
stories.question: What matters when choosing a dog?
stories.caption: For 31 years, the Labrador Retriever was America's most popular dog. In 2022, one breed finally took the crown, with registrations up over 1,000% since 2012. But that popularity comes at a real cost to the dog itself. Would you still get one? 👇

segments.say: The French Bulldog ranks number 1. It displaced every other breed in the popularity list.
French Bulldog registrations rose 1,000%. Demand exploded rather than simply edging upward.
French Bulldog life expectancy was 4.5 years. That population estimate exposes the health cost popularity can hide.

stories.title: One Man Ate 76 Hot Dogs In 10 Minutes
stories.hook: Hot dog eaters are training their stomachs to do something a normal body can't.
stories.closing: Nobody has beaten 76 yet, so someone is surely training to be next.
stories.question: Could you eat 10 hot dogs that fast?
stories.caption: The Nathan's hot dog eating record used to be 25. Then it jumped to 50, then 76 -- and a real stomach-capacity study shows exactly how a trained eater pulls it off. Could you keep up? 👇

segments.say: Nathan's hot dog contest used to be won with 25. Today's record is triple that, so eaters keep pushing human limits.

# scene standard: 2026-10-16.2
def _hd_rr(cr, x, y, w, h, r):
    r = min(r, h / 2, w / 2)
    cr.new_sub_path()
    cr.arc(x + w - r, y + r, r, -math.pi / 2, 0)
    cr.arc(x + w - r, y + h - r, r, 0, math.pi / 2)
    cr.arc(x + r, y + h - r, r, math.pi / 2, math.pi)
    cr.arc(x + r, y + r, r, math.pi, 1.5 * math.pi)
    cr.close_path()

def _hd_wheel(cr, cx, cy, R, t, ground):

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a giant hot dog on a contest table

    CAUSE: Data places more hot dogs onto its end and the hot dog stretches to three times its length
    Nathan's contest table on the Coney Island boardwalk, the Wonder Wheel
    turning behind it, and on the table ONE hot dog: everything the winner
    ate, end to end. It opens at 2000's winning 25, an ordinary-looking hot
    dog; Data works along the table placing more onto its end, and it
    stretches to 2001's 50 and then to 2021's 76 — three times as long.
    2000's hot dog stays on it as a dashed ghost, and every landed year
    leaves a notch on the table's skirt, below Data's feet. Done by 0.56 and
    held; the wheel turns, steam rises, and the crowd by the camera, seen
    from behind, keeps cheering with their arms up."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    n = len(rows)
    v0 = rows[0][1] or 1.0
    top = max(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.56
    if n > 1:
        steps = n - 1
        span = (a1 - a0) / steps
        k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, steps - 0.001)) + 1
        f = clamp((u - a0 - (k - 1) * span) / span)
        slide = ease(seg(f, 0.1, 0.8)) if u >= a0 else 0.0
        prev = rows[k - 1][1]
        val = prev + (rows[k][1] - prev) * slide
        landed_to = k if slide >= 0.999 else k - 1
    else:
        k, slide, val, landed_to = 0, 1.0, v0, 0
    keep = sorted({round(i * (n - 1) / max(1, READOUT_SHOWS - 1))
                   for i in range(READOUT_SHOWS)}) if n > READOUT_SHOWS else list(range(n))
    named = max((i for i in keep if i <= landed_to), default=0)
    shown = rows[named]

    S = 2.0
    X0, YB, FOOT = 130.0, 1215.0, 1215.0
    L = 690.0 / top
    x1 = X0 + val * L

    # the boardwalk by the sea under a low sun, the Wonder Wheel down the
    # boardwalk under haze, the contest banner in front of it
    landscape(cr, t, "coast", horizon=1000)
    _hd_wheel(cr, 800, 760, 230, t, 1000)
    haze(cr, 480, 1000, (214, 222, 230), a=0.45)
    for px in (110, 970):
        cr.rectangle(px - 9, 720, 18, 300)
        solid(cr, (90, 92, 100), finish="metal", rim=False)
    cr.rectangle(110, 735, 860, 92)
    solid(cr, (34, 120, 66))
    text(cr, "NATHAN'S FAMOUS", 540, 800, 54, (250, 214, 60), face="display",
         anchor="center", shadow=False)
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (176, 140, 98)), (1, (132, 98, 64))], 1000, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((104, 76, 50), 0.55))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(16):
        cr.move_to(540 + (i - 8) * 40, 1000)
        cr.line_to(540 + (i - 8) * 190, H)
    cr.stroke()

    # the contest table in three-quarter, its long shadow away from the sun
    cast_shadow(cr, 30, 1050, 1480, length=220, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, 540, 1482, 1060, a=0.4)
    for lx in (55, 1005):
        cr.rectangle(lx, 1410, 24, 72)
        solid(cr, (70, 70, 76), finish="metal", rim=False)
    cr.move_to(80, 1130)
    cr.line_to(1000, 1130)
    cr.line_to(1050, 1235)
    cr.line_to(30, 1235)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (240, 238, 230))
    cr.rectangle(30, 1235, 1020, 180)
    solid(cr, (34, 78, 150))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((250, 214, 60)))
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    cr.move_to(30, 1244)
    cr.line_to(1050, 1244)
    cr.stroke()
    for i in range(10):                       # bunting along the skirt
        bx = 30 + i * 102
        cr.move_to(bx, 1250)
        cr.line_to(bx + 102, 1250)
        cr.line_to(bx + 51, 1294)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (200, 44, 40) if i % 2 == 0 else (244, 238, 226), rim=False)

    # THE hot dog: one, stretching as Data places more onto its end
    contact_shadow(cr, (X0 + x1) / 2, YB + 2, x1 - X0 + 180, a=0.5)
    _hd_long(cr, X0, x1, YB, S)
    for j, sx_ in enumerate((X0 + 0.3 * (x1 - X0), X0 + 0.75 * (x1 - X0))):
        steam(cr, sx_, YB - 340, t + j * 0.7, strength=0.8)
    if val > v0 + 0.5:                        # 2000's hot dog, where it lay
        _hd_rr(cr, X0 - 48 * S, YB - 164 * S, v0 * L + 96 * S, 168 * S, 60 * S)
        ghost(cr, a=0.9)

    hx = min(985.0, x1 + 40 * S + 70)
    # the next hot dog, from Data's hands onto the end
    if u >= a0 and 0.02 < slide < 0.98 and n > 1:
        q = seg(slide, 0.0, 0.6)
        if 0 < q < 1:
            sx, sy = hx, FOOT - 170
            ex, ey = x1 + 20, YB - 110 * S
            bx = sx + (ex - sx) * q
            by = sy + (ey - sy) * q - 110 * math.sin(math.pi * q)
            cr.save()
            cr.translate(bx, by)
            cr.rotate(-0.4 + 0.4 * q)
            _hd_long(cr, -50, 50, 34, 0.6)
            cr.restore()

    # right by the camera: the crowd, from behind, cheering at the table
    foreground(cr, "town")
    fans = [(120, 1800, (60, 70, 120), (60, 40, 30), (214, 168, 132), True),
            (360, 1840, (160, 52, 50), (28, 22, 20), (150, 104, 76), False),
            (590, 1810, (50, 112, 80), (176, 118, 52), (232, 188, 152), True),
            (820, 1850, (204, 152, 50), (24, 20, 20), (120, 82, 60), False),
            (1020, 1800, (92, 60, 112), (96, 62, 40), (204, 156, 120), True)]
    for i, (fx, fy, rgb, hair, skin, arms) in enumerate(fans):
        bob = 10 * math.sin(t * 3.0 + i * 1.3)
        _hd_fan(cr, fx, fy + bob, rgb, hair, skin, t, i, arms)
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data on the table at the hot dog's end, travelling with it
    if u < a0:
        host("point", hx, FOOT, 236)
    elif u < a1 + 0.04:
        host("place", hx, FOOT, 236, beat=int((val - v0) // 5))
    else:
        host("hold_up", hx, FOOT, 236)

    # THE SCALE on the table's skirt, below Data's feet: a notch where each
    # landed year's hot dog reached
    for j in range(0, landed_to + 1):
        nx = X0 + rows[j][1] * L
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((244, 238, 226)))
        cr.set_line_width(7)
        cr.move_to(nx, 1305)
        cr.line_to(nx, 1350)
        cr.stroke()
        text(cr, rows[j][0], nx, 1398, 38, look.INK, face="bold", anchor="center")

    lab, v = shown
    fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v))} hot dogs", f"won Nathan's in 10 minutes · {lab}",
                80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)
    if n > 1 and landed_to >= n - 1:
        text(cr, f"{rows[-1][1] / v0:.1f}x", W - 80, 680, 90, look.INK, face="display",
             anchor="right", alpha=ease(seg(u, a1 - 0.02, a1 + 0.04)))

segments.say: In a stomach study, a normal eater tapped out early. A competitive eater ate 36 hot dogs before researchers stopped him.
segments.illustrated_scene:
# scene standard: 2026-10-16.2
def _hd_capsule(cr, x, y, w, h):
    r = h / 2.0
    cr.new_sub_path()
    cr.arc(x + r, y + r, r, math.pi / 2, 3 * math.pi / 2)
    cr.arc(x + w - r, y + r, r, -math.pi / 2, math.pi / 2)
    cr.close_path()


def _hd_dog(cr, x, y, ang, L, a=1.0):
    """One hot dog: a bun, the sausage poking out both ends, a line of mustard."""
    h = L * 0.36
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.rotate(ang)
    _hd_capsule(cr, -L * 0.5, -h * 0.5, L, h * 0.55)
    solid(cr, (196, 140, 82), a=a)
    _hd_capsule(cr, -L * 0.58, -h * 0.30, L * 1.16, h * 0.42)
    solid(cr, (178, 70, 48), finish="gloss", a=a)
    _hd_capsule(cr, -L * 0.5, -h * 0.02, L, h * 0.55)
    solid(cr, (226, 172, 106), a=a)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((246, 206, 40), a))
    cr.set_line_width(max(2.0, L * 0.035))
    cr.move_to(-L * 0.42, -h * 0.12)
    for i in range(1, 9):
        cr.line_to(-L * 0.42 + i * L * 0.105, -h * (0.20 if i % 2 else 0.06))
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()


def _hd_stomach(cr, s, J):
    """A J-shaped stomach as the current path, hung by its throat at J.
    Returns its origin (ox, oy); one unit is `s` px."""
    jx, jy = J
    ox, oy = jx + 0.065 * s, jy + 0.475 * s

    def p(x, y):
        return (ox + x * s, oy + y * s)
    cr.new_path()
    cr.move_to(*p(-0.15, -0.5))
    cr.curve_to(*p(-0.45, -0.62), *p(-0.62, -0.3), *p(-0.55, 0.0))
    cr.curve_to(*p(-0.5, 0.4), *p(-0.1, 0.62), *p(0.25, 0.48))
    cr.curve_to(*p(0.45, 0.4), *p(0.58, 0.2), *p(0.6, 0.05))
    cr.line_to(*p(0.48, 0.02))
    cr.curve_to(*p(0.42, 0.22), *p(0.2, 0.3), *p(0.05, 0.22))
    cr.curve_to(*p(-0.12, 0.12), *p(-0.08, -0.2), *p(0.02, -0.45))
    cr.close_path()
    return ox, oy


def _hd_stopwatch(cr, x, y, r, t):
    """A lab stopwatch by the camera: crown, bezel, ticks, a red sweep hand."""
    contact_shadow(cr, x, y + r + 6, 2.1 * r, a=0.4)
    cr.rectangle(x - 0.16 * r, y - r - 0.32 * r, 0.32 * r, 0.24 * r)
    solid(cr, (150, 154, 162), finish="metal")
    cr.rectangle(x - 0.08 * r, y - r - 0.1 * r, 0.16 * r, 0.14 * r)
    solid(cr, (120, 124, 132), finish="metal", rim=False)
    disc(cr, x, y, r, (178, 184, 194), finish="metal")
    disc(cr, x, y, 0.84 * r, (244, 245, 247), finish="gloss")
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 40, 46)))
    for i in range(60):
        a_ = 2 * math.pi * i / 60
        r0 = 0.66 * r if i % 5 == 0 else 0.74 * r
        cr.set_line_width(5 if i % 5 == 0 else 2)
        cr.move_to(x + r0 * math.cos(a_), y + r0 * math.sin(a_))
        cr.line_to(x + 0.8 * r * math.cos(a_), y + 0.8 * r * math.sin(a_))
        cr.stroke()
    ha = -math.pi / 2 + 2 * math.pi * (t / 6.0)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((206, 40, 36)))
    cr.set_line_width(7)
    cr.move_to(x - 0.18 * r * math.cos(ha), y - 0.18 * r * math.sin(ha))
    cr.line_to(x + 0.72 * r * math.cos(ha), y + 0.72 * r * math.sin(ha))
    cr.stroke()
    disc(cr, x, y, 0.07 * r, (60, 60, 66), finish="metal")


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a stomach stuffed with hot dogs
    SUBSTANCE: hot dogs
    CAUSE: Data tosses hot dogs down the throat tube and the stomach stretches with every throw
    A stomach-study lab. A giant stomach hangs from a feeding funnel, its
    throat tube running up to a steel platform. It starts full at the
    control subject's 7 hot dogs. Data climbs the ladder, walks right up to
    the funnel's lip and tosses hot dogs straight in, one throw per stretch,
    and the stomach swells until it holds the competitive eater's 36. Its
    AREA is the count, so the normal stomach stays on it as a dashed ghost.
    Done by 0.62, then held: the stomach churns what it holds while Data
    holds up one more hot dog."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    hi = max(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    lo = min(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    v1 = hi[1] or 1.0
    v0 = lo[1] or 1.0
    n = 6
    a0, a1 = 0.21, 0.62
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    fly = seg(f, 0.0, 0.35)
    grow = ease(seg(f, 0.3, 0.75))
    step = 0.0 if u < a0 else (k + grow) / n
    val = v0 + (v1 - v0) * step
    S1 = 660.0
    s = S1 * math.sqrt(max(val, 0.1) / v1)
    s0 = S1 * math.sqrt(v0 / v1)
    J = (470.0, 800.0)
    done = u >= a0 and k == n - 1 and grow >= 0.999

    # where each hot dog sits inside the stomach, in the stomach's own units
    cr.new_path()
    uox, uoy = _hd_stomach(cr, 1000.0, (0.0, 0.0))
    spots = []
    for i in range(900):
        nx = -0.6 + 1.25 * ((i * 0.6180339 + 0.13) % 1.0)
        ny = -0.55 + 1.15 * ((i * 0.4142136 + 0.29) % 1.0)
        if all(cr.in_fill(uox + (nx + dx) * 1000, uoy + (ny + dy) * 1000)
               for dx, dy in ((0, 0), (0.05, 0), (-0.05, 0), (0, 0.04), (0, -0.04))):
            spots.append((nx, ny, ((i * 0.7548777) % 1.0) * math.pi))
        if len(spots) >= int(v1) + 1:
            break
    cr.new_path()

    # the lab: a tiled back wall, ceiling lights, an X-ray lightbox,
    # cabinets with jars, all under haze
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (176, 190, 198)), (1, (150, 166, 174))], 0, 1200)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 136, 146), 0.35))
    cr.set_line_width(2)
    for i in range(1, 14):
        cr.move_to(i * 84, 200)
        cr.line_to(i * 84, 940)
    for j in range(9):
        cr.move_to(0, 220 + j * 84)
        cr.line_to(W, 220 + j * 84)
    cr.stroke()
    for i in range(4):
        lx = 60 + i * 260
        glow(cr, lx + 80, 140, 160, (255, 250, 236), 0.35)
        box(cr, lx, 150, 160, 18, (240, 244, 246), depth=30)
    cr.rectangle(730, 230, 290, 200)
    solid(cr, (70, 76, 84), finish="metal")
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (200, 226, 240)), (1, (150, 186, 206))], 246, 414, 746, 1004)
    _hd_stomach(cr, 150, (860.0, 262.0))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 84, 104), 0.55))
    cr.fill()
    for i in range(6):
        box(cr, i * 182, 1200, 176, 250, (112, 132, 146), depth=20)
        cr.rectangle(i * 182 + 70, 1030, 36, 8)
        solid(cr, (200, 204, 210), finish="metal", rim=False)
    cr.rectangle(0, 940, W, 14)
    solid(cr, (220, 222, 224), rim=False)
    for i in range(9):
        cylinder(cr, 30 + i * 120, 940, 44, 70 + (i % 3) * 18,
                 [(150, 196, 214), (214, 190, 120), (190, 214, 196)][i % 3], finish="glass")
    haze(cr, 0, 1200, (200, 212, 216), a=0.4)
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (140, 150, 156)), (1, (86, 94, 102))], 1200, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 66, 74), 0.35))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(12):
        cr.move_to(540, 900)
        cr.line_to(-1200 + i * 320, H)
    cr.stroke()

    # the platform beside the funnel, its ladder at the far end
    cast_shadow(cr, 572, 900, 1460, length=260, a=0.22)
    for lx in (572, 880):
        contact_shadow(cr, lx + 8, 1462, 60, a=0.4)
        cr.rectangle(lx, 720, 18, 740)
        solid(cr, (130, 136, 146), finish="metal")
    box(cr, 560, 726, 350, 26, (150, 156, 166), depth=50, finish="metal")
    # a railing along the platform's back edge
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 126, 136)))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    cr.move_to(600, 600)
    cr.line_to(905, 600)
    for rx in (610, 760, 900):
        cr.move_to(rx, 600)
        cr.line_to(rx, 690)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.rectangle(500, 650, 80, 16)
    solid(cr, (140, 146, 156), finish="metal")

    ox, oy = J[0] + 0.065 * s, J[1] + 0.475 * s
    contact_shadow(cr, ox, 1580, 1.1 * s, a=0.22)

    # the throat tube from the funnel to the stomach, the duodenum stub
    p = lambda x, y: (ox + x * s, oy + y * s)
    cr.move_to(448, 722)
    cr.line_to(492, 722)
    cr.line_to(*p(0.02, -0.45))
    cr.line_to(*p(-0.15, -0.5))
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (214, 120, 128))
    cr.move_to(*p(0.48, 0.02))
    cr.line_to(*p(0.6, 0.05))
    cr.curve_to(*p(0.7, 0.12), *p(0.7, 0.22), *p(0.66, 0.3))
    cr.line_to(*p(0.55, 0.28))
    cr.curve_to(*p(0.58, 0.2), *p(0.55, 0.1), *p(0.48, 0.02))
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (206, 112, 120))

    # the stomach: dark inside, the hot dogs packed in bright, a thin glossy
    # membrane over them and a thick muscular wall round the edge
    _hd_stomach(cr, s, J)
    solid(cr, (118, 40, 52), rim=False, edge=False)
    churn = u > a1 + 0.02
    cr.save()
    _hd_stomach(cr, s, J)
    cr.clip()
    cnt = min(len(spots), int(round(val)))
    for i in range(cnt):
        nx, ny, ang = spots[i]
        dx = dy = 0.0
        if churn:
            ph = t * 2.6 + i * 0.9
            dx, dy = 10 * math.sin(ph), 6 * math.cos(ph)
        _hd_dog(cr, ox + nx * s + dx, oy + ny * s + dy, ang, 108)
    _hd_stomach(cr, s, J)
    solid(cr, (238, 146, 152), finish="gloss", a=0.16, edge=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 54, 70), 0.3))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    for j in range(5):
        cr.move_to(*p(-0.45 + j * 0.08, -0.25 + j * 0.06))
        cr.curve_to(*p(-0.3 + j * 0.1, -0.05 + j * 0.05), *p(-0.1 + j * 0.12, 0.25),
                    *p(0.2 + j * 0.06, 0.38 - j * 0.03))
    cr.stroke()
    if churn:
        ph = ((t - a1 * 6.0) % 1.8) / 1.4
        if ph < 1.0:
            bx = ox + s * (-0.65 + 1.35 * ph)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((110, 28, 44), 0.42))
            cr.set_line_width(80)
            cr.move_to(bx - 90, oy - 0.7 * s)
            cr.line_to(bx + 90, oy + 0.7 * s)
            cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 236, 238), 0.5))
    cr.set_line_width(max(6.0, 0.03 * s))
    cr.move_to(*p(-0.36, -0.46))
    cr.curve_to(*p(-0.5, -0.4), *p(-0.52, -0.2), *p(-0.5, -0.05))
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()
    _hd_stomach(cr, s, J)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((206, 102, 116)))
    cr.set_line_width(max(14.0, 0.04 * s))
    cr.stroke()
    _hd_stomach(cr, s, J)
    edge(cr, (92, 34, 44))

    # THE SCALE on the stomach: the normal eater's stomach as a ghost, its
    # name above the stomach (clear of the hot dogs) with a short leader
    if step > 0.02:
        _hd_stomach(cr, s0, J)
        ghost(cr, a=0.9)
        gx, gy = J[0] + 0.065 * s0 - 0.3 * s0, J[1] + 0.475 * s0 - 0.58 * s0
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((244, 238, 226), 0.9))
        cr.set_line_width(3)
        cr.move_to(372, 690)
        cr.line_to(gx, gy)
        cr.stroke()
        text(cr, "normal eater", 380, 680, 32, look.INK, face="bold", anchor="right")

    # the feeding funnel on top
    cr.move_to(395, 630)
    cr.line_to(545, 630)
    cr.line_to(492, 724)
    cr.line_to(448, 724)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (178, 184, 194), finish="metal")
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(470, 630)
    cr.scale(1, 0.22)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 75, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (60, 62, 70), rim=False)

    # the ladder up to the platform, in front
    for rx in (930, 990):
        cr.rectangle(rx, 700, 12, 762)
        solid(cr, (196, 168, 70), finish="metal")
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((170, 142, 56)))
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    for ry in range(760, 1460, 70):
        cr.move_to(936, ry)
        cr.line_to(996, ry)
    cr.stroke()

    # Data: on the floor, up the ladder, then right up to the funnel's lip
    c = ease(seg(u, 0.04, 0.17))
    w = ease(seg(u, 0.17, 0.21))
    hx = 860 + 100 * clamp(c * 3) - 340 * w
    hy = 1480 - 754 * c

    # the hot dog in flight, from his hands into the funnel — a short, low lob
    if u >= a0 and 0 < fly < 1 and u < a1 + 0.04:
        sx, sy = hx - 30, hy - 140
        ex, ey = 470, 640
        bx = sx + (ex - sx) * fly
        by = sy + (ey - sy) * fly - 40 * math.sin(math.pi * fly)
        _hd_dog(cr, bx, by, fly * 4.0, 120)

    # right by the camera: the tray of hot dogs still waiting, a stopwatch
    box(cr, 30, 1890, 640, 46, (170, 176, 186), depth=90, finish="metal")
    for i in range(5):
        _hd_dog(cr, 130 + i * 120, 1820 - (i % 2) * 26, 0.15 * (i - 2), 210)
    _hd_stopwatch(cr, 880, 1760, 130, t)
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    if u < 0.04:
        host("point", hx, hy, 236)
    elif u < 0.17:
        host("climb", hx, hy, 236)
    elif u < a0:
        host("point", hx, hy, 236)
    elif u < a1 + 0.04:
        host("toss", hx, hy, 236, beat=k)
    elif u < 0.9:
        host("hold_up", hx, hy, 236)
        _hd_dog(cr, hx + 55, hy - 170, -0.25, 110)   # one more, held high
    else:

    if done:

# scene standard: 2026-10-16.2
def _hd_capsule(cr, x0, y0, x1, y1, r):
    ang = math.atan2(y1 - y0, x1 - x0)
    cr.new_sub_path()
    cr.arc(x1, y1, r, ang - math.pi / 2, ang + math.pi / 2)
    cr.arc(x0, y0, r, ang + math.pi / 2, ang + 3 * math.pi / 2)
    cr.close_path()


def _hd_dog(cr, cx, cy, L, s, ang):
    """A hot dog, lit: the sausage longer than the bun, the bun in front, mustard on top."""
    dx, dy = math.cos(ang) * L / 2, math.sin(ang) * L / 2
    px, py = -math.sin(ang), math.cos(ang)
    o = -12 * s
    _hd_capsule(cr, cx - dx * 1.14 + px * o, cy - dy * 1.14 + py * o,
                cx + dx * 1.14 + px * o, cy + dy * 1.14 + py * o, 19 * s)
    solid(cr, (178, 72, 46), finish="gloss")
    o = 12 * s
    _hd_capsule(cr, cx - dx + px * o, cy - dy + py * o,
                cx + dx + px * o, cy + dy + py * o, 24 * s)
    solid(cr, (226, 170, 100))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((246, 200, 40)))
    cr.set_line_width(6 * s)
    m = 12
    for i in range(m + 1):
        q = -0.8 + 1.6 * i / m
        w = (-22 if i % 2 else -8) * s
        x = cx + dx * q + px * w
        y = cy + dy * q + py * w
        if i == 0:
            cr.move_to(x, y)
        else:
            cr.line_to(x, y)
    cr.stroke()


def _hd_gull(cr, x, y, s, flap):
    cr.move_to(x - 70 * s, y - 14 * s + flap * s)
    cr.curve_to(x - 40 * s, y - 34 * s + flap * s, x - 14 * s, y - 20 * s, x, y)
    cr.curve_to(x + 14 * s, y - 20 * s, x + 40 * s, y - 34 * s + flap * s,
                x + 70 * s, y - 14 * s + flap * s)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 40, 48)))
    cr.set_line_width(15 * s)
    cr.stroke_preserve()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((248, 248, 244)))
    cr.set_line_width(9 * s)
    cr.stroke()


def _hd_bell(cr, cx, top, h, hw):

    cr.move_to(cx, top - 46)

    # the crown loop

    cr.line_to(cx + hw, top + h)

                cx - hw, top + h)
    cr.line_to(cx - hw, top + 0.9 * h)
    cr.curve_to(cx - 0.66 * hw, top + 0.8 * h, cx - 0.46 * hw, top + 0.55 * h,

    solid(cr, P["brass"], finish="metal")

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a high striker and its brass bell
    SUBSTANCE: a giant hot dog
    CAUSE: Data hauls the rope hand over hand, lifting the hot dog up the tower toward the bell
    The Coney Island boardwalk at sunset. The high striker's height is the
    count: its big brass bell, hung at the top of the striped tower, sits at
    the record, 76 hot dogs, its year dashed under the lip. Pull by pull
    Data hoists a giant hot dog up the track, the lights coming on beneath
    it in the accent, walking backwards down the boardwalk as the rope comes
    in, and it stops at the latest winner's 70.5: just short of the bell,
    the gap left plain to see. Landed by about 0.60, then he holds the rope
    taut and the bell does not ring; a gull glides past."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    rec_l, rec_v = max(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    new_l, new_v = rows[-1]
    rec_v = rec_v or 1.0

    n = 5
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.60
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    rise = ease(seg(f, 0.08, 0.72))
    prog = 0.0 if u < a0 else (k + rise) / n
    val = new_v * prog
    done = u >= a0 and k == n - 1 and rise >= 0.999

    TX, BASE = 430, 1430
    Y0, Y76 = 1170.0, 760.0

    def ly(v):
        return Y0 - (Y0 - Y76) * v / rec_v

    DOG_L = 240
    dog_top = ly(val)

    # the setting: the shore at sunset, the Wonder Wheel far off
    gy = landscape(cr, t, "coast")
    WX, WY, WR = 880, 900, 230
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 60, 70)))
    cr.set_line_width(14)
    cr.move_to(WX - 150, gy)
    cr.line_to(WX, WY)
    cr.line_to(WX + 150, gy)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    cr.arc(WX, WY, WR, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    rot = t * 0.35
    for i in range(16):
        a = rot + i * math.pi / 8
        cr.move_to(WX, WY)
        cr.line_to(WX + WR * math.cos(a), WY + WR * math.sin(a))
    cr.stroke()
    for i in range(12):
        a = rot + i * math.pi / 6
        gx, gy_ = WX + WR * math.cos(a), WY + WR * math.sin(a)
        col = [(214, 60, 56), (60, 120, 190), (236, 190, 60)][i % 3]
        box(cr, gx - 18, gy_ + 34, 36, 30, col, depth=8)
    haze(cr, 600, gy + 10, (236, 200, 170), a=0.45)

    # the boardwalk: planks across the frame, a rail at the back
    cr.rectangle(0, 1240, W, 360)
    solid(cr, (168, 124, 84), edge=False, rim=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((112, 80, 52)))
    yy, gap = 1250.0, 14.0
    while yy < 1600:
        cr.set_line_width(2 + gap * 0.12)
        cr.move_to(0, yy)
        cr.line_to(W, yy)
        cr.stroke()
        yy += gap
        gap *= 1.18
    for i in range(12):
        cr.rectangle(20 + i * 96, 1170, 12, 74)
        solid(cr, (226, 222, 212), rim=False)
    cr.rectangle(0, 1178, W, 10)
    solid(cr, (226, 222, 212), rim=False)

    # the high striker: its long shadow, the striped tower, the track
    TOP = 590
    cast_shadow(cr, TX - 100, TX + 100, BASE, length=320, a=0.32)
    contact_shadow(cr, TX, BASE + 6, 300, a=0.45)
    box(cr, TX - 100, BASE, 200, BASE - TOP, (196, 44, 46), depth=46)
    for i in range(8):
        cr.rectangle(TX - 100, BASE - 30 - i * 100, 200, 40)
        solid(cr, (240, 232, 214), rim=False, edge=False)
    cr.rectangle(TX - 44, Y76 + 6, 88, BASE - Y76 - 16)
    solid(cr, (232, 226, 214), finish="metal")
    # the striking pad and lever at its foot
    box(cr, TX - 150, BASE, 300, 34, (70, 72, 82), depth=40, finish="metal")
    # the lights: lit in the accent below the hot dog, dark above it
    yb = Y0
    while yb > Y76 + 10:
        lit = yb >= dog_top + 10
        for sx in (TX - 72, TX + 72):
            if lit:
                glow(cr, sx, yb, 26, P["accent2"], 0.6)
            disc(cr, sx, yb, 10, P["accent2"] if lit else (110, 110, 118), finish="gloss")
        yb -= 38
    # the pulley arm off the tower's side
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 62, 70)))
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    cr.move_to(TX + 100, Y76 + 30)
    cr.line_to(TX + 200, Y76 + 30)
    cr.stroke()
    disc(cr, TX + 200, Y76 + 30, 18, (90, 92, 100), finish="metal")

    # the hot dog riding the track
    cy = dog_top + DOG_L / 2
    _hd_dog(cr, TX, cy, DOG_L, 1.25, -math.pi / 2)

    # THE BELL at the top, wider than the tower, the record at its lip
    _hd_bell(cr, TX, Y76 - 150, 150, 125)
    then_mark(cr, TX - 170, TX + 110, Y76 + 4, rec_l[:4])

    # Data walks backwards down the boardwalk as the rope comes in
    hx, hy = 700 + 260 * prog, 1480
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 52, 36)))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    cr.move_to(TX + 30, dog_top + 20)
    cr.line_to(TX + 200, Y76 + 30)
    cr.line_to(hx - 10, hy - 140)
    cr.stroke()
    if done:
        text(cr, f"{rec_v - new_v:g} short", TX - 120, (Y76 + dog_top) / 2 + 14, 36,
             look.INK, face="bold", anchor="right")

    # right by the camera: the sand, a hot dog in its paper tray
    cr.rectangle(0, 1590, W, H - 1590)
    solid(cr, (224, 200, 156), edge=False, rim=False)
    foreground(cr, "coast", y0=1600)
    contact_shadow(cr, 230, 1790, 330, a=0.35)
    box(cr, 70, 1790, 320, 60, (246, 242, 232), depth=70)
    _hd_dog(cr, 245, 1720, 260, 1.4, -0.08)

    # a gull glides past once the story has landed
    if u > 0.6:
        gp = seg(u, 0.6, 0.95)
        _hd_gull(cr, -120 + 1320 * gp, 1000 - 80 * math.sin(math.pi * gp), 1.3,
                 14 * math.sin(t * 9))
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    if u < a0:
        host("point", hx, hy, 220)
    elif u < a1 + 0.02:
        host("haul", hx, hy, 220, beat=k)
    elif u < 0.9:
        host("strain", hx, hy, 220)
    else:
        host("shock", hx, hy, 220)

    if done:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{new_v:g}", f"hot dogs · {new_l}", 80, 480,
                    a=ease(seg(u, a1 - 0.03, a1 + 0.02)), size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(rec_v))}", f"hot dogs · {rec_l}", 80, 480,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

def _hd_rr(cr, x0, y0, x1, y1, r):
    cr.new_path()
    cr.arc(x1 - r, y0 + r, r, -math.pi / 2, 0)
    cr.arc(x1 - r, y1 - r, r, 0, math.pi / 2)
    cr.arc(x0 + r, y1 - r, r, math.pi / 2, math.pi)
    cr.arc(x0 + r, y0 + r, r, math.pi, 1.5 * math.pi)
    cr.close_path()


def _hd_sausage(cr, x0, x1, y, r):
    cr.new_path()
    cr.arc(x1, y, r, -math.pi / 2, math.pi / 2)
    cr.arc(x0, y, r, math.pi / 2, 1.5 * math.pi)
    cr.close_path()


def _hd_bun_back(cr, x0, x1, y, r):

def _hd_limb(cr, pts_, w, rgb):
    # a limb as a lit, rounded solid: a dark under-stroke, the colour, a lit line
    cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
    cr.set_line_join(cairo.LINE_JOIN_ROUND)
    for lw, col, off in ((w + 6, (40, 34, 36), 0), (w, rgb, 0),

        cr.new_path()

def _hd_runner(cr, x, fy, h, t):
    # a contender out training along the boardwalk: singlet, shorts, trainers
    s = h / 170.0
    ph = math.sin(t * 9)

                 11 * s, k_)

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a giant hot dog on a grill cart
    SUBSTANCE: yellow mustard
    CAUSE: Data squeezes a mustard bottle down the hot dog's length and runs out short of the record's end
    The closing, back on the Coney Island boardwalk under the Wonder Wheel:
    one giant hot dog in its split bun on a striped hot dog cart, its whole
    length is the record, 76. Data walks along the top of it squeezing a
    line of mustard, squeeze after squeeze, and the line covers the 2025
    winner's share of the record (70.5 of 76) and stops. The bare tip past
    the mustard glows solid in the accent behind a dashed cut, the record's
    flag stuck in its end, and a placard on the cart POINTS UP AT that tip
    saying how short the winner stopped. Done by 0.52 and held to the very
    last frame (u is clamped, so there is never an empty tail): Data keeps
    squeezing his empty bottle over the bare tip, and a contender in a
    singlet jogs past in front of the cart, training to be next."""
    u = clamp(u)
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    rec_l, rec = max(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    rest = [r for r in rows if r[0] != rec_l] or rows
    new_l, new = rest[-1]
    rec = rec or 1.0
    share = clamp(new / rec)
    gap = rec - new
    rec_y = rec_l.split()[0]
    new_y = new_l.split()[0]

    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.52
    grow = ease(seg(u, a0, a1))
    done = u >= a1

    X0, X1 = 170, 900
    SY, R = 1060, 88
    XS, XE = X0 - R * 0.6, X1 + R * 0.6
    L = XE - XS
    tip = XS + L * share * grow
    sx = XS + L * share

    # the setting: the beach, the Wonder Wheel, the boardwalk
    hz = landscape(cr, t, "coast")
    _hd_wheel(cr, 250, 930, 190, t, hz)
    haze(cr, 600, 1180, (236, 206, 178), a=0.45)
    cr.move_to(0, 1300)

    solid(cr, (168, 122, 82), edge=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((112, 78, 50), 0.8))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    for i in range(9):

        cr.move_to(0, y)

    cr.stroke()
    # the railing along the beach side
    for i in range(12):

        solid(cr, (126, 92, 62), rim=False)
    cr.rectangle(0, 1200, W, 14)
    solid(cr, (140, 104, 70), rim=False)

    # the cart: steel body, striped awning, wheels
    cast_shadow(cr, 80, 1000, 1424, length=300, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, 540, 1428, 1000, a=0.45)
    box(cr, 80, 1420, 900, 200, (184, 188, 196), depth=60, finish="metal")
    for i in range(15):
        x = 80 + i * 60
        cr.move_to(x, 1220)

        cr.line_to(x + 60, 1262)
        cr.arc_negative(x + 30, 1262, 30, 0, math.pi)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (204, 52, 40) if i % 2 == 0 else (244, 238, 226), rim=False)
    for wx in (210, 850):
        disc(cr, wx, 1432, 46, (54, 54, 60), finish="metal")
        disc(cr, wx, 1432, 17, (170, 170, 176), finish="metal")

    # the hot dog: the back of the split bun, the sausage, the front of the bun
    _hd_bun_back(cr, X0, X1, SY, R)
    solid(cr, (184, 118, 54))
    for nx in (X0 - R - 4, X1 + R + 4):
        disc(cr, nx, SY, 16, (150, 56, 40))
    _hd_sausage(cr, X0, X1, SY, R)
    solid(cr, (180, 70, 50), finish="gloss")
    cr.save()
    _hd_sausage(cr, X0, X1, SY, R)
    cr.clip()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((110, 36, 26), 0.45))
    cr.set_line_width(12)
    for gx in range(X0 - 60, X1 + 120, 72):
        cr.move_to(gx, SY - R)
        cr.line_to(gx - 50, SY + R)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 210, 180), 0.35))
    cr.set_line_width(14)
    cr.move_to(X0 - 20, SY - R * 0.55)
    cr.line_to(X1 + 20, SY - R * 0.55)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()
    for stx in (300, 600, 860):
        steam(cr, stx, SY - R - 10, t, strength=0.6)

    # the bare tip nobody has eaten: once the mustard stops it glows SOLID in
    # the accent, breathing, so the gap reads from across the room
    ta = ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.06))
    if done:
        pulse = 0.78 + 0.12 * math.sin(t * 3.0)
        glow(cr, (sx + XE) / 2, SY, 200, P["accent2"], 0.6 * ta)
        cr.save()
        cr.rectangle(sx, 0, W - sx, H)

        _hd_sausage(cr, X0, X1, SY, R)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"], pulse * ta))

    # the mustard line, as far as it has been squeezed
    my = SY - R * 0.45
    if tip > XS + 4:
        def _line():
            cr.new_path()
            x = XS
            cr.move_to(x, my + 14 * math.sin(x / 22.0))
            while x < tip:
                x = min(tip, x + 10)
                cr.line_to(x, my + 14 * math.sin(x / 22.0))

        cr.set_line_join(cairo.LINE_JOIN_ROUND)
        _line()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((160, 112, 16)))
        cr.set_line_width(30)
        cr.stroke()
        _line()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((240, 196, 40)))
        cr.set_line_width(21)
        cr.stroke()
        _line()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 236, 150), 0.8))
        cr.set_line_width(5)
        cr.stroke()

    # the front of the bun: a soft belly with a toasted crust and a pale cut lip
    _hd_bun_front(cr, X0, X1, SY, R)
    solid(cr, (226, 166, 92))
    cr.save()
    _hd_bun_front(cr, X0, X1, SY, R)
    cr.clip()
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (200, 130, 60)), (1, (150, 88, 38))], SY + 110, SY + R + 80,
          X0 - 110, X1 + 110)
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((250, 232, 196)))
    cr.set_line_width(12)
    cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
    cr.move_to(X0 - 60, SY + 16)
    cr.curve_to(X0 + 20, SY + 30, X1 - 20, SY + 30, X1 + 50, SY + 16)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 236, 200), 0.5))
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    cr.move_to(X0 - 40, SY + 70)
    cr.curve_to(X0 + 60, SY + 56, X1 - 120, SY + 56, X1, SY + 66)
    cr.stroke()
    _hd_bun_front(cr, X0, X1, SY, R)
    edge(cr, (92, 56, 26))

    # THE SCALE on the hot dog: the record's flag in its end; once the
    # mustard stops, the bare tip is cut off with a dashed line
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 56, 60)))
    cr.set_line_width(7)
    cr.move_to(XE, SY - R * 0.4)
    cr.line_to(XE, SY - R - 130)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.move_to(XE + 3, SY - R - 130)
    cr.line_to(XE + 100, SY - R - 102)
    cr.line_to(XE + 3, SY - R - 74)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (244, 238, 226))
    text(cr, f"{int(round(rec))}", XE + 40, SY - R - 90, 34, look.INK,
         face="bold", anchor="center", shadow=False)
    if done:
        cr.save()
        cr.rectangle(sx, 0, W - sx, H)
        cr.clip()
        _hd_sausage(cr, X0, X1, SY, R)
        cr.move_to(sx, SY - R - 14)
        cr.line_to(sx, SY + R + 14)
        ghost(cr, a=0.95)
        cr.restore()
        # a cream placard on the cart whose pointer reaches up to the bare tip
        gx = (sx + XE) / 2
        PX0, PX1, PY0, PY1 = 470, 1040, 1296, 1416
        cr.new_path()
        cr.move_to(gx - 34, PY0 + 4)
        cr.line_to(gx, 1232)
        cr.line_to(gx + 34, PY0 + 4)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (246, 240, 226), a=ta)
        _hd_rr(cr, PX0, PY0, PX1, PY1, 18)
        solid(cr, (246, 240, 226), a=ta)
        cr.rectangle(PX0 + 14, PY0 + 14, 12, PY1 - PY0 - 28)
        solid(cr, P["accent2"], a=ta, rim=False, edge=False)
        cx_ = (PX0 + PX1) / 2 + 8
        text(cr, f"{gap:g} short", cx_, 1364, 60, look.INK,
             face="display", anchor="center", shadow=False, alpha=ta)
        text(cr, f"where the {new_y} winner stopped", cx_, 1400, 28, look.INK,
             face="bold", anchor="center", shadow=False, alpha=ta)

    # the world keeps moving: a contender jogging past in front of the cart
    _hd_tray(cr, 120, 1900, 1.0)
    rq = seg(u, 0.55, 0.98)
    if 0 < rq < 1:
        _hd_runner(cr, -160 + 1420 * rq, 1700, 260, t)
    foreground(cr, "coast")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data walks the hot dog's length, squeezing, behind the line's tip; once
    # it stops short he keeps squeezing his empty bottle to the very end
    fy = SY - R + 6
    if u < a0:
        hx = X0
        host("point", hx, fy, 240)
    else:
        hx = max(X0, tip - 90)
        k = int((u - a0) / 0.11)
        host("squeeze", hx, fy, 240, beat=k)
        bx, by = hx + 52, fy - 130
        bottle(cr, bx, by, 2.2, 1.8, (236, 190, 36))
        if not done:
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((240, 196, 40)))
            cr.set_line_width(10)
            cr.move_to(bx + 18, by + 30)
            cr.line_to(tip, my)
            cr.stroke()
        elif seg((u - a0) % 0.11, 0.0, 0.05) < 1:
            disc(cr, bx + 20, by + 36, 9, (240, 196, 40), finish="gloss")

    if done:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(rec))} hot dogs",
                    f"still unbeaten · the {new_y} winner ate {new:g}",
                    80, 620, size=120)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(rec))} hot dogs", f"the world record · {rec_y}",
                    80, 620, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=120)
