# scene standard: 2026-10-16.2
def _hd_rr(cr, x0, y0, x1, y1, r):
    r = min(r, (y1 - y0) / 2, max(1.0, (x1 - x0) / 2))
    cr.new_sub_path()
    cr.arc(x1 - r, y0 + r, r, -math.pi / 2, 0)
    cr.arc(x1 - r, y1 - r, r, 0, math.pi / 2)
    cr.arc(x0 + r, y1 - r, r, math.pi / 2, math.pi)
    cr.arc(x0 + r, y0 + r, r, math.pi, 1.5 * math.pi)
    cr.close_path()


def _hd_oval(cr, x, y, rx, ry):
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.scale(max(1.0, rx), max(1.0, ry))
    cr.new_sub_path()
    cr.arc(0, 0, 1, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()


def _hd_dog(cr, x, y, ang, s):
    """One hot dog in its bun, lit, with a line of mustard."""
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.rotate(ang)
    cr.scale(s, s)
    _hd_rr(cr, -62, -10, 62, 18, 14)
    solid(cr, (214, 160, 92))
    _hd_rr(cr, -74, -14, 74, 6, 10)
    solid(cr, (178, 72, 50), finish="gloss")
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((240, 196, 40)))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    cr.move_to(-60, -6)
    for i in range(6):
        cr.line_to(-50 + i * 20, -10 if i % 2 else -2)
    cr.stroke()
    _hd_rr(cr, -62, 0, 62, 26, 13)
    solid(cr, (228, 174, 104))
    cr.restore()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a man gulping hot dogs
    SUBSTANCE: hot dogs in buns
    CAUSE: Data tosses hot dog after hot dog off the platter into the man's open mouth
    THE HOOK, mid-action from frame one: a backyard training session, a
    man at the picnic table with his mouth wide open and Data on the
    tabletop throwing hot dogs into it from a heaped platter, two and
    three in the air at once. In three seconds the platter empties and
    his belly goes from an ordinary gut to a huge, tight balloon: the
    shirt rides up, the buttons pop off, and the belly shoves Data back
    along the table. A normal body can't do that. It lands by 0.5 and
    holds there while Data keeps throwing the last ones."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    lab, rec = max(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])

    eat = ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.5))
    swell = 0.12 + 0.88 * eat
    CX, CY = 640.0, 1090.0
    rx, ry = 130 + 250 * swell, 120 + 180 * swell
    TABLE_TOP = 1310.0

    # the backyard: field, a wooden fence and a tree going back under haze
    landscape(cr, t, "field")
    tree(cr, 940, 1180, 1.6, P["leaf"], P["leaf_shade"], P["trunk"])
    for i in range(14):
        box(cr, i * 80 - 10, 1200, 66, 170, (176, 140, 100), depth=12)
    haze(cr, 900, 1210, (214, 200, 180), a=0.35)

    cast_shadow(cr, 100, 1000, 1500, length=300, a=0.28)

    # THE EATER, sitting behind the table: shoulders, the belly, the shirt
    _hd_oval(cr, CX, 905, 170 + 70 * swell, 95)
    solid(cr, (70, 110, 180))
    _hd_oval(cr, CX, CY, rx, ry)
    solid(cr, (232, 174, 132))
    hem = CY + ry * (0.85 - 0.95 * swell)
    cr.save()
    _hd_oval(cr, CX, CY, rx, ry)
    cr.clip()
    cr.rectangle(0, 0, W, hem)
    solid(cr, (70, 110, 180), edge=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((44, 74, 130), 0.6))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    for i in range(-6, 7):
        cr.move_to(CX + i * 40, 800)
        cr.line_to(CX + i * 40 * (1 + 0.5 * swell), hem)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()
    disc(cr, CX + 8, CY + ry * 0.45, 8 + 6 * swell, (150, 96, 74))
    glow(cr, CX - rx * 0.35, CY - ry * 0.1, 60 + 80 * swell, (255, 236, 214), 0.35 * swell)
    by = 980.0
    while by < hem - 30:
        gap = 4 + 22 * swell
        _hd_oval(cr, CX, by + 30, gap, 10)
        solid(cr, (226, 168, 128), rim=False)
        disc(cr, CX, by, 10, (240, 236, 226), finish="gloss")
        by += 62

    # his head: mouth wide open for the next one
    disc(cr, CX, 760, 108, (228, 172, 130))
    cr.arc(CX, 752, 110, math.pi * 1.08, math.pi * 1.92)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (70, 50, 40), rim=False)
    for ex in (-38, 38):
        disc(cr, CX + ex, 738, 10, (40, 34, 30))
    chew = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.cos(u * 2 * math.pi / 0.1)
    _hd_oval(cr, CX, 808, 52, 28 + 16 * chew)
    solid(cr, (110, 30, 36), rim=False)
    # the end of the last one still going in
    _hd_dog(cr, CX + 10, 806, 0.5, 0.7 + 0.15 * chew)

    # the picnic table in front of him, three-quarter
    for lx in (160, 900):
        contact_shadow(cr, lx + 20, 1502, 90, a=0.35)
        box(cr, lx, 1500, 40, 130, (118, 80, 50), depth=24)
    contact_shadow(cr, 560, 1504, 900, a=0.3)
    box(cr, 100, 1370, 900, 60, (160, 108, 66), depth=90)

    # his arms round the belly, hands flat on the table
    for side in (-1, 1):
        ax = CX + side * (rx + 22)
        cr.move_to(CX + side * (160 + 70 * swell), 880)
        cr.curve_to(ax + side * 40, 960, ax + side * 30, 1180, ax, TABLE_TOP - 20)
        cr.line_to(ax - side * 50, TABLE_TOP - 20)
        cr.curve_to(ax - side * 10, 1180, ax, 1000, CX + side * (120 + 70 * swell), 900)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (228, 172, 130))
        _hd_oval(cr, ax - side * 25, TABLE_TOP - 18, 40, 18)
        solid(cr, (222, 164, 122))

    # the platter on the table, heaped with hot dogs, emptying throw by throw
    PX = 230.0
    contact_shadow(cr, PX, TABLE_TOP + 4, 320, a=0.35)
    _hd_oval(cr, PX, TABLE_TOP - 6, 160, 34)
    solid(cr, (240, 238, 232), finish="gloss")
    stack = [(r_, c) for r_, cnt in enumerate((4, 3, 2, 1)) for c in range(cnt)]
    left = max(2, len(stack) - int(round(eat * (len(stack) - 2))))
    for idx in range(left):
        r_, c = stack[idx]
        cnt = (4, 3, 2, 1)[r_]
        _hd_dog(cr, PX - (cnt - 1) * 52 + c * 104, TABLE_TOP - 26 - r_ * 34,
                0.05 * (c - 1), 0.85)

    # the buttons give way and fly off at the camera
    for j in range(3):
        pf = seg(u, 0.36 + 0.06 * j, 0.62 + 0.06 * j)
        if 0 < pf < 1:
            side = 1 if j % 2 == 0 else -1
            bx = CX + side * (260 + 60 * j) * pf
            byy = 1000 + 60 * j - 300 * math.sin(math.pi * pf) + 700 * pf * pf
            disc(cr, bx, byy, 12 + 40 * pf, (240, 236, 226), finish="gloss")

    # Data on the tabletop, throwing; the belly shoves him back as it grows
    hx = CX - rx - 110
    P_ = 0.1
    k = int(u / P_)
    if u < 0.88:
        host("toss", hx, TABLE_TOP, 210, beat=k)
    else:
        host("shock", hx, TABLE_TOP, 210)
    # a stream of hot dogs in the air, two or three at once
    if u < 0.9:
        for j in range(3):
            fly = ((u / P_) - j / 3.0) % 1.0
            if u < j * P_ / 3.0:
                continue
            sx, sy = hx + 30, TABLE_TOP - 190
            ex, ey = CX, 808.0
            fx = sx + (ex - sx) * fly
            fy = sy + (ey - sy) * fly - 260 * math.sin(math.pi * fly)
            _hd_dog(cr, fx, fy, -0.6 + 1.4 * fly, 1.6 - 0.6 * fly)

    foreground(cr, "field")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(rec))} hot dogs", f"in 10 minutes · {lab}",
                80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

stories.title: Blockbuster Went From 9,000 Stores To Just 1
stories.hook: Blockbuster is dead, and the thing that killed it was sitting in your mailbox.
stories.closing: Even giants can vanish fast when habits change, and one small store still rents movies.
stories.question: Have you ever rented from that store?
stories.caption: Blockbuster once had over 9,000 stores worldwide. While it was still near its peak, Netflix's mail-order subscribers were already tripling. Today exactly one Blockbuster is still open, in Bend, Oregon. So what's keeping it alive? 👇

segments.say: Netflix's mail subscribers nearly tripled, to 12.3 million. Why drive to a store when the movie shows up at home?

# scene standard: 2026-10-16.2
def _nf_at(spots, z):
    z = clamp(z, 0, len(spots) - 1.001)
    i = int(z)
    f = z - i
    (x0, y0, s0), (x1, y1, s1) = spots[i], spots[i + 1]
    return x0 + (x1 - x0) * f, y0 + (y1 - y0) * f, s0 + (s1 - s0) * f


def _nf_mailer(cr, x, y, s, ang, a=1.0):
    # a red Netflix DVD mailer: the envelope, its V flap, the address
    # window, and the silver disc peeking out of the top
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.rotate(ang)
    w, h = 84 * s, 54 * s
    disc(cr, w * 0.16, -h * 0.42, h * 0.46, (222, 226, 236), finish="gloss", a=a)
    disc(cr, w * 0.16, -h * 0.42, h * 0.1, (90, 94, 104), a=a)
    cr.rectangle(-w / 2, -h / 2, w, h)
    solid(cr, (204, 26, 34), finish="gloss", a=a)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 12, 18), a))
    cr.set_line_width(max(1.5, 2.6 * s))
    cr.move_to(-w / 2, -h / 2)
    cr.line_to(0, h * 0.05)
    cr.line_to(w / 2, -h / 2)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.rectangle(-w * 0.36, h * 0.12, w * 0.36, h * 0.22)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((246, 240, 230), 0.92 * a))
    cr.fill()
    cr.restore()


def _nf_mailbox(cr, x, y, s, c):
    contact_shadow(cr, x, y, 90 * s, a=0.35)
    box(cr, x - 6 * s, y, 12 * s, 110 * s, (120, 92, 62), depth=6 * s)
    b = y - 108 * s
    r = 36 * s
    tp = b - 70 * s

    def _d(dx, dy, rr):
        cr.move_to(x - rr + dx, b + dy)
        cr.line_to(x - rr + dx, tp + r + dy)
        cr.arc(x + dx, tp + r + dy, rr, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.line_to(x + rr + dx, b + dy)
        cr.close_path()

    _d(22 * s, -9 * s, r)
    solid(cr, (104, 110, 120), finish="metal", rim=False)
    _d(0.0, 0.0, r)
    solid(cr, (176, 182, 192), finish="metal")
    # the yellow flag on the side swings up once the mail is in
    fl = ease(seg(c, 0.55, 1.0))
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x + r + 16 * s, b - 16 * s)
    cr.rotate(-math.pi / 2 * fl)
    cr.rectangle(0, -3 * s, 38 * s, 6 * s)
    cr.rectangle(24 * s, -16 * s, 16 * s, 13 * s)
    solid(cr, (236, 186, 52), rim=False)
    cr.restore()
    if c <= 0:
        disc(cr, x, b - 30 * s, 5 * s, (80, 82, 90), finish="metal")
        return
    # the door drops open: a dark mouth and the door hanging below it
    op = clamp(c * 5)
    _d(0.0, -6 * s, r - 6 * s)
    solid(cr, (40, 38, 44), a=op, rim=False)
    cr.rectangle(x - r, b, 2 * r, 30 * s * op)
    solid(cr, (156, 162, 172), finish="metal", rim=False)
    # the mailer drops in from his hand and sticks out of the mouth
    sl = ease(seg(c, 0.0, 0.55))
    _nf_mailer(cr, x + 4 * s, b - 26 * s - 150 * s * (1 - sl), 1.2 * s,
               -0.14 + 0.5 * (1 - sl), a=clamp(c * 4))


def _nf_house(cr, hx, base, hs, rgb, roof_rgb):
    cast_shadow(cr, hx, hx + 150 * hs, base, length=160 * hs, a=0.2)
    contact_shadow(cr, hx + 75 * hs, base, 190 * hs, a=0.3)
    hb = building(cr, hx, hx + 150 * hs, base, 120 * hs, rgb, roof_rgb=roof_rgb,
                  roof="gable", depth=60 * hs, boards=False)
    # a front door with its step, and two lit windows with white trim
    cr.rectangle(hx + 62 * hs, base - 64 * hs, 26 * hs, 64 * hs)
    solid(cr, (110, 62, 46), rim=False)
    for wx in (hx + 16 * hs, hx + 104 * hs):
        cr.rectangle(wx, base - 92 * hs, 32 * hs, 34 * hs)
        solid(cr, (252, 224, 150), finish="glass", rim=False)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((246, 242, 234)))
        cr.set_line_width(max(1.5, 3 * hs))
        cr.rectangle(wx, base - 92 * hs, 32 * hs, 34 * hs)
        cr.move_to(wx + 16 * hs, base - 92 * hs)
        cr.line_to(wx + 16 * hs, base - 58 * hs)
        cr.stroke()
    return hb


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a street of mailboxes
    SUBSTANCE: red Netflix DVD mailers
    CAUSE: Data places a red Netflix mailer into each mailbox down the street, raising its flag
    One suburban street of houses, its mailboxes running from right by the
    camera back into the distance, one per million subscribers. Year by year
    Data, the mail carrier, works up the curb from the far end toward the
    camera dropping a big red DVD mailer into each box: its door falls open,
    the red envelope sticks out with the disc peeking out, and its flag
    swings up — 4 boxes in 2005, 12 by 2009, so the red runs from the far
    end almost to the camera. Each landed year leaves a tick on the curb
    with its year written out on the road, down and to the right of the
    curb, always clear of Data. Done by 0.66 and held, Data big in the
    foreground holding up the last mailer."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    n = len(rows)
    N = 13
    a0, a1 = 0.03, 0.66
    span = (a1 - a0) / max(1, n)
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    slide = ease(seg(f, 0.05, 0.85))
    prev = rows[k - 1][1] if k > 0 else 0.0
    val = 0.0 if u < a0 else prev + (rows[k][1] - prev) * slide
    landed_to = k if slide >= 0.999 else k - 1
    keep = sorted({round(i * (n - 1) / max(1, READOUT_SHOWS - 1))
                   for i in range(READOUT_SHOWS)}) if n > READOUT_SHOWS else list(range(n))
    named = max((i for i in keep if i <= landed_to), default=None)
    shown = None if (u < a0 or named is None) else rows[named]
    v0 = rows[0][1] or 1.0
    ratio = rows[-1][1] / v0

    spots = []
    x, y, s = 70.0, 1470.0, 2.0
    for j in range(N + 1):
        spots.append((x, y, s))
        x += 56 * s
        y -= 26 * s
        s *= 0.92

    landscape(cr, t, "town")
    # front lawns from the houses down to the curb
    cr.move_to(-20, spots[0][1] - 330)
    for sx, sy, ss in spots:
        cr.line_to(sx - 40 * ss, sy - 150 * ss)
    cr.line_to(W + 20, spots[-1][1] - 150 * spots[-1][2])
    for sx, sy, ss in reversed(spots):
        cr.line_to(sx + 40 * ss, sy + 20 * ss)
    cr.line_to(-20, spots[0][1] + 30)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (118, 160, 82), edge=False, rim=False)
    # the houses, far first, each its own home with a gap and a tree between
    hues = [(222, 210, 186), (176, 196, 210), (196, 120, 92), (232, 220, 170), (170, 186, 150)]
    roofs = [(92, 70, 64), (70, 76, 92), (96, 102, 114), (110, 74, 58), (80, 86, 80)]
    for idx, j in enumerate(reversed(range(1, N, 3))):
        hx, hy, hs = spots[j]
        base = hy - 150 * hs
        _nf_house(cr, hx - 120 * hs, base, hs, hues[j % 5], roofs[j % 5])
        tx = hx + 70 * hs
        cylinder(cr, tx - 5 * hs, base + 4 * hs, 10 * hs, 60 * hs, P["trunk"])
        disc(cr, tx, base - 70 * hs, 34 * hs, P["leaf"])
        disc(cr, tx - 16 * hs, base - 52 * hs, 24 * hs, P["leaf_shade"])
    haze(cr, 700, 1200, (214, 206, 196), a=0.3)
    # the road along the curb, running to the camera
    cr.move_to(-20, spots[0][1] + 30)
    for sx, sy, ss in spots:
        cr.line_to(sx + 40 * ss, sy + 20 * ss)
    cr.line_to(W + 20, spots[-1][1] + 10)
    cr.line_to(W + 20, H)
    cr.line_to(-20, H)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (84, 86, 92), edge=False, rim=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((200, 196, 186)))
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    cr.move_to(-20, spots[0][1] + 34)
    for sx, sy, ss in spots:
        cr.line_to(sx + 40 * ss, sy + 22 * ss)
    cr.stroke()
    # the centre line of the street, dashed, running away from the camera
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 200, 90)))
    for j in range(0, N, 2):
        x0_, y0_, s0_ = _nf_at(spots, j)
        x1_, y1_, s1_ = _nf_at(spots, j + 1)
        cr.set_line_width(max(3, 9 * s0_))
        cr.move_to(x0_ + 160 * s0_, y0_ + 170 * s0_)
        cr.line_to(x1_ + 160 * s1_, y1_ + 170 * s1_)
        cr.stroke()

    # the mailboxes, far first: the far end fills first, toward the camera
    for p in reversed(range(N)):
        mx, my, ms = spots[p]
        _nf_mailbox(cr, mx, my, ms, clamp(val - (N - 1 - p)))

    # right by the camera: a mailer dropped in the road, its disc peeking out
    _nf_mailer(cr, 860, 1790, 2.6, -0.22)
    foreground(cr, "town")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data the mail carrier works up the curb, box to box, toward the camera
    def _foot(z):
        px, py, ps = _nf_at(spots, z)
        return px + 64 * ps, min(1500.0, py + 40 * ps), ps

    def _hh(ps):
        return clamp(150 * ps, 200, 240)

    if u < a0:
        hx, hy, ds_ = _foot(N - 1)
        hh = _hh(ds_)
        host("point", hx, hy, hh)
    else:
        hx, hy, ds_ = _foot(N - 1 - clamp(val - 0.5, 0, N - 1))
        hh = _hh(ds_)
        if u < a1 + 0.04:
            host("place", hx, hy, hh, beat=int(val))
        else:
            host("hold_up", hx, hy, hh)
    # Data's box, with room for his arms and what he holds
    dbx0, dbx1 = hx - 0.6 * hh, hx + 0.6 * hh
    dby0, dby1 = hy - 1.15 * hh, hy + 20

    # THE SCALE on the street, drawn after Data: each landed year ticks the
    # curb at the box it reached; its year sits out on the road, down and to
    # the right of the tick, and is pushed clear if Data is anywhere near it
    if u >= a0:
        for j in range(0, landed_to + 1):
            z = N - 1 - clamp(rows[j][1] - 0.5, 0, N - 1)
            nx, ny, ns = _nf_at(spots, z)
            cx_ = nx + 40 * ns
            cy_ = ny + 22 * ns
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((244, 238, 226)))
            cr.set_line_width(8)
            cr.move_to(cx_, cy_ - 18)
            cr.line_to(cx_, cy_ + 18)
            cr.stroke()
            if j == named or (j == 0 and named is not None and named != 0):
                lx = cx_ + 150 * ns
                ly = cy_ + 90 * ns
                tw = 50
                if lx + tw > dbx0 and lx - tw < dbx1 and ly + 6 > dby0 and ly - 40 < dby1:
                    lx = max(lx, dbx1 + tw + 20)
                lx = min(lx, W - 60)
                ly = min(1530.0, ly)
                cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((244, 238, 226), 0.7))
                cr.set_line_width(3)
                cr.move_to(cx_, cy_ + 18)
                cr.line_to(lx - 10, ly - 36)
                cr.stroke()
                text(cr, rows[j][0], lx, ly, 34, look.INK, face="bold", anchor="center")

    done = u >= a0 and k == n - 1 and slide >= 0.999
    if shown is not None:
        lab, v = shown
        fit_readout(cr, f"{v:.1f}M", f"Netflix DVD-by-mail subscribers · {lab}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, a0, a0 + 0.05)), size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Netflix by mail", f"subscribers, {rows[0][0]}–{rows[-1][0]}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.03)), size=130)
    if done:
        text(cr, f"{ratio:.1f}x", W - 80, 700, 90, look.INK, face="display",
             anchor="right", alpha=ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.04)))

segments.say: Blockbuster once ran 9,000 stores. By 2014, the company owned none of them. The giant had been hollowed out.
segments.illustrated_scene:
# scene standard: 2026-10-16.2
def _bb_year(lab):
    s = str(lab)
    digs = "".join(ch if ch.isdigit() else " " for ch in s).split()
    for d in digs:
        if len(d) == 4:
            return d
    return s


def _bb_mix(a, b, f):
    f = clamp(f)
    return tuple(int(x + (y - x) * f) for x, y in zip(a, b))


def _bb_ticket(cr, x0, y0, x1, y1):
    # the torn ticket stub: a ragged, zig-zag torn left edge, a notch on the right
    cr.move_to(x0 + 18, y0)
    cr.line_to(x1, y0)
    cr.line_to(x1 - 30, (y0 + y1) / 2)
    cr.line_to(x1, y1)
    cr.line_to(x0 + 18, y1)
    teeth = 7
    hgt = (y1 - y0) / teeth
    for i in range(teeth):
        yy = y1 - (i + 0.5) * hgt
        cr.line_to(x0, yy)
        cr.line_to(x0 + 18, y1 - (i + 1) * hgt)
    cr.close_path()


def _bb_reel(cr, cx, cy, r, ang):
    # a VHS reel: a white hub with six teeth, turning by ang
    disc(cr, cx, cy, r, (236, 234, 228))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 40, 46)))
    cr.set_line_width(max(2.0, r * 0.16))
    for i in range(6):
        a_ = ang + i * math.pi / 3
        cr.move_to(cx + r * 0.3 * math.cos(a_), cy + r * 0.3 * math.sin(a_))
        cr.line_to(cx + r * 0.85 * math.cos(a_), cy + r * 0.85 * math.sin(a_))
    cr.stroke()
    cr.arc(cx, cy, r * 0.22, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 40, 46)))
    cr.fill()


def _bb_vhs(cr, x, y, w, h, ang=0.0, label=(244, 242, 236)):
    # a black VHS cassette seen face-on, its bottom-left at (x, y): the label
    # strip on top, the clear window across the middle, two reels of tape in it
    cr.rectangle(x, y - h, w, h)
    solid(cr, (28, 28, 32), finish="gloss", rim=False)
    cr.rectangle(x + w * 0.1, y - h * 0.92, w * 0.8, h * 0.22)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(label))
    cr.fill()
    cr.rectangle(x + w * 0.2, y - h * 0.6, w * 0.6, h * 0.36)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((84, 90, 102)))
    cr.fill()
    for fx, rr in ((0.33, 0.2), (0.67, 0.14)):
        cr.arc(x + w * fx, y - h * 0.42, h * rr, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 46, 30)))
        cr.fill()
    for fx in (0.33, 0.67):
        _bb_reel(cr, x + w * fx, y - h * 0.42, h * 0.11, ang)


def _bb_case(cr, x, y, w, h, rgb):
    # a rental clamshell standing face-out: cover art, a white rental sticker
    cr.rectangle(x, y - h, w, h)
    solid(cr, rgb, finish="gloss", rim=False)
    cr.rectangle(x + 4, y - h + 6, w - 8, h * 0.16)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((244, 242, 236)))
    cr.fill()
    cr.arc(x + w * 0.5, y - h * 0.45, w * 0.22, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((250, 214, 60), 0.85))
    cr.fill()


def _bb_tape(cr, x, y, s, ang):
    # a VHS cassette nobody returned, lying on the lot
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.rotate(ang)
    contact_shadow(cr, 0, 6 * s, 140 * s, a=0.35)
    _bb_vhs(cr, -62 * s, 4 * s, 124 * s, 74 * s, 0.4)
    cr.restore()


def _bb_dropbox(cr, x, y, s):
    # the after-hours RETURNS box: a blue steel bin with a hooded slot
    contact_shadow(cr, x + 70 * s, y + 4, 190 * s, a=0.4)
    box(cr, x, y, 140 * s, 170 * s, (30, 64, 160), depth=40 * s, finish="metal")
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x + 70 * s, y - 170 * s)
    cr.scale(1, 0.45)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 70 * s, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (36, 72, 172), finish="metal")
    cr.rectangle(x + 22 * s, y - 128 * s, 96 * s, 16 * s)
    solid(cr, (16, 18, 26), edge=False, rim=False)
    _bb_ticket(cr, x + 22 * s, y - 92 * s, x + 118 * s, y - 56 * s)
    solid(cr, (250, 204, 40), rim=False)


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a VHS video rental store
    SUBSTANCE: the steel roll-down shutter
    CAUSE: Data grips the shutter's bottom bar with both hands and pulls it down over the video store's window, pull by pull
    One Blockbuster stands for the whole chain, and it names itself by
    shape: a GIANT VHS CASSETTE on the roof, its reels turning, over the
    blue facade and the yellow torn-ticket stub, and a window wall of black
    VHS tapes and face-out rental boxes. The store is brought forward and
    fills the middle of the frame, so the lot is the foreground, not an
    empty floor. From 9,000 stores to none the company owns, Data, up a
    stepladder, pulls the steel shutter down over the tapes in three pulls,
    stepping down the rungs as it comes, until it hits the sill (by 0.62).
    Then the store dies: the rooftop reels wind down, the ticket, the sign
    and the lot lamp go dark, the CLOSED placard swings, and he keeps
    holding the shutter shut. Nothing drives through."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    y0, y1 = _bb_year(l0), _bb_year(l1)
    n = 3
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.62
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    pull = ease(seg(f, 0.0, 0.6))
    closed = 0.0 if u < a0 else clamp((k + pull) / n)
    done = u >= a1
    off_ticket = ease(seg(u, a1 + 0.02, a1 + 0.07))
    off_band = ease(seg(u, a1 + 0.09, a1 + 0.14))
    off_lamp = ease(seg(u, a1 + 0.17, a1 + 0.22))
    spin = 2.2 * min(t, 6.0 * a1) if not done else 2.2 * 6.0 * a1 + 1.5 * (1 - math.exp(-(u - a1) * 8))

    BASE = 1440
    X0, X1 = 50, 900
    TOP, BOT = 1150, 1420
    GX0, GX1 = 100, 760
    bot = TOP + 14 + (BOT - TOP - 14) * closed

    # the setting: a strip-mall town under a low sun, its parking lot to the camera
    landscape(cr, t, "town")
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (124, 122, 120)), (1, (66, 66, 70))], BASE, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 230, 210), 0.7))
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    for i in range(6):
        sx = 90 + i * 190
        cr.move_to(sx, BASE + 60)
        cr.line_to(sx - 140, 1640)
    cr.stroke()

    # the lot lamp, behind on the right
    cr.rectangle(1010, 880, 14, BASE + 40 - 880)
    solid(cr, (70, 72, 80), finish="metal", rim=False)
    box(cr, 962, 890, 70, 18, (90, 92, 100), depth=12, finish="metal")
    if off_lamp < 1:
        glow(cr, 995, 910, 160, (255, 236, 180), 0.5 * (1 - off_lamp))

    # the store, three-quarter, throwing its long shadow
    cast_shadow(cr, X0, X1, BASE, length=320, a=0.3)
    b = building(cr, X0, X1, BASE, 460, (30, 60, 150), roof="flat", boards=False,
                 depth=130)
    cr.rectangle(b["x0"], BASE - 16, b["x1"] - b["x0"], 16)
    solid(cr, (190, 186, 178), rim=False)

    # THE TELL: a giant VHS cassette standing on the roof, its reels turning
    rtop = b["top"]
    for px in (330, 650):
        cr.rectangle(px, rtop - 30, 14, 34)
        solid(cr, (70, 72, 80), finish="metal", rim=False)
    VW, VH = 560, 230
    vx, vy = 210, rtop - 24
    contact_shadow(cr, vx + VW / 2, vy + 4, VW, a=0.35)
    box(cr, vx, vy, VW, VH, (28, 28, 32), depth=46, finish="gloss")
    cr.rectangle(vx + VW * 0.08, vy - VH * 0.92, VW * 0.84, VH * 0.2)
    solid(cr, _bb_mix((252, 206, 36), (104, 92, 52), off_ticket), rim=False)
    cr.rectangle(vx + VW * 0.18, vy - VH * 0.62, VW * 0.64, VH * 0.42)
    solid(cr, (84, 92, 106), finish="glass", rim=False)
    for fx, rr in ((0.33, 0.17), (0.67, 0.12)):
        cr.arc(vx + VW * fx, vy - VH * 0.41, VH * rr, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 46, 30)))
        cr.fill()
    for fx in (0.33, 0.67):
        _bb_reel(cr, vx + VW * fx, vy - VH * 0.41, VH * 0.1, spin)
    cr.rectangle(vx + VW * 0.3, vy - VH * 0.12, VW * 0.4, VH * 0.06)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((54, 54, 60)))
    cr.fill()

    # the sign: the blue band and the giant yellow torn ticket
    sy0 = b["top"] + 16
    band = _bb_mix((26, 62, 176), (18, 26, 52), off_band)
    cr.rectangle(b["x0"] + 10, sy0, b["x1"] - b["x0"] - 20, 150)
    solid(cr, band)
    tx0, tx1, ty0, ty1 = 130, 830, sy0 + 18, sy0 + 132
    if off_ticket < 1:
        glow(cr, (tx0 + tx1) / 2, (ty0 + ty1) / 2, 420, (255, 214, 60), 0.4 * (1 - off_ticket))
    _bb_ticket(cr, tx0, ty0, tx1, ty1)
    solid(cr, _bb_mix((252, 206, 36), (104, 92, 52), off_ticket))
    text(cr, "BLOCKBUSTER", (tx0 + tx1) / 2 - 12, ty1 - 32,
         fit_size(cr, "BLOCKBUSTER", 80, tx1 - tx0 - 100),
         _bb_mix((22, 46, 140), (40, 40, 50), off_ticket), face="display",
         anchor="center", shadow=False)

    # the glass door on the right
    cr.rectangle(790, TOP + 10, 90, BASE - 16 - TOP - 10)
    solid(cr, (60, 72, 90), finish="glass", rim=False)
    cr.rectangle(800, TOP + 110, 8, 70)
    solid(cr, (200, 202, 210), finish="metal", rim=False)

    # the window: a wall of VHS tapes and face-out rental boxes, warmly lit
    lit = 1.0 - 0.85 * closed
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(GX0, TOP, GX1 - GX0, BOT - TOP)
    cr.clip()
    vgrad(cr, [(0, _bb_mix((60, 56, 52), (252, 240, 210), lit)),
               (1, _bb_mix((40, 36, 34), (206, 180, 132), lit))], TOP, BOT, GX0, GX1)
    covers = [(196, 44, 40), (40, 72, 170), (232, 120, 40), (70, 40, 110), (30, 110, 90)]
    for r in range(3):
        shy = TOP + 92 + r * 86
        cr.rectangle(GX0, shy, GX1 - GX0, 10)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((110, 84, 60)))
        cr.fill()
        for c in range(8):
            x_ = GX0 + 12 + c * 80
            if (r + c) % 3 == 1:
                _bb_case(cr, x_ + 8, shy, 58, 78, covers[(c + r * 2) % 5])
            else:
                _bb_vhs(cr, x_, shy, 74, 48, 0.3 * c + r)
    glow(cr, (GX0 + GX1) / 2, TOP + 40, 380, (255, 236, 190), 0.4 * lit)

    # the shutter, pulled down over it
    cr.rectangle(GX0, TOP, GX1 - GX0, bot - TOP)
    solid(cr, (178, 182, 190), finish="metal", rim=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((108, 112, 122)))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    yy = bot - 22
    while yy > TOP:
        cr.move_to(GX0, yy)
        cr.line_to(GX1, yy)
        yy -= 22
    cr.stroke()
    cr.rectangle(GX0, bot - 18, GX1 - GX0, 18)
    solid(cr, (84, 88, 96), finish="metal")
    cr.restore()
    for mx in (GX0, GX1):
        cr.rectangle(mx - 8, TOP, 16, BOT - TOP)
        solid(cr, (70, 72, 80), finish="metal", rim=False)
    box(cr, GX0 - 14, TOP, GX1 - GX0 + 28, 36, (150, 154, 162), depth=20, finish="metal")

    # the CLOSED placard hung as it lands, swinging on its chains
    if done:
        pa = ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.03))
        ts = max(0.0, (u - a1) * 6.0)
        ang = 0.3 * math.exp(-0.55 * ts) * math.sin(4.2 * ts + 1.2)
        ox, oy = 300.0, TOP + 50.0
        ca, sa = math.cos(ang), math.sin(ang)

        def rot(px, py):
            return ox + px * ca - py * sa, oy + px * sa + py * ca
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 60, 66), pa))
        cr.set_line_width(4)
        cr.move_to(*rot(-60, 80))
        cr.line_to(ox, oy)
        cr.line_to(*rot(60, 80))
        cr.stroke()
        corners = [rot(px, py) for px, py in ((-95, 80), (95, 80), (95, 180), (-95, 180))]
        cr.move_to(*corners[0])
        for p_ in corners[1:]:
            cr.line_to(*p_)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (246, 242, 230), a=pa)
        cxp, cyp = rot(0, 130)
        text(cr, "CLOSED", cxp, cyp + 16, 44, (184, 34, 30), face="bold",
             anchor="center", alpha=pa, shadow=False)

    # Data's stepladder in front of the window
    hx = 540 + 60 * closed
    foot = min(1500.0, bot + 185)
    lx, LT, LB = 580, 1335, 1502
    contact_shadow(cr, lx, LB, 160, a=0.4)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((200, 150, 60)))
    cr.set_line_width(12)
    cr.move_to(lx - 72, LB)
    cr.line_to(lx - 30, LT)
    cr.move_to(lx + 72, LB)
    cr.line_to(lx + 30, LT)
    cr.stroke()
    for i in range(4):
        ry = LT + i * (LB - LT - 30) / 3
        w_ = 30 + 42 * (ry - LT) / (LB - LT)
        box(cr, lx - w_, ry + 8, 2 * w_, 10, (214, 168, 70), depth=8)

    # right by the camera: the returns box and a tape nobody brought back
    _bb_dropbox(cr, 800, 1770, 1.3)
    _bb_tape(cr, 240, 1810, 1.8, -0.12)
    foreground(cr, "town")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    hands = [(hx - 42, bot + 2), (hx + 42, bot + 2)]
    if u < a0:
        host("point", hx, foot, 236)
    elif u < 0.9:
        host("grip", hx, foot, 236, hands=hands, lower="brace", expr="strain")
    else:
        host("grip", hx, foot, 236, hands=hands, lower="crouch", expr="shock")

    if done:

def _bb_sign(cr, x0, x1, y, off):
    """The Blockbuster sign: a blue board with the big yellow torn ticket on it,
    BLOCKBUSTER printed in blue across the ticket."""
    k = 1 - 0.6 * off
    blue = tuple(int(c * k) for c in (28, 64, 170))
    yel = tuple(int(c * k) for c in (252, 210, 40))
    if off < 0.99:

def _bb_shutter(cr, x0, x1, y0, ey):

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: the last two Blockbuster video stores
    SUBSTANCE: a grey steel shutter
    CAUSE: Data grips the shutter's bottom bar with both hands and pulls it down over the Perth store
    Two Blockbusters side by side, all that was left on Earth in 2018: each
    front carries the big yellow torn-ticket sign on blue and a window of
    VHS boxes and black cassettes with their reels. Data, the closing
    manager, walks over and hauls Perth's corrugated steel shutter down by
    its bottom bar until it covers the tapes; Perth's sign goes dark and
    only Bend still glows. The window sits low enough that the bar is in
    his reach from its drum to the sill. The count lands by 0.56 and holds;
    trucks keep passing on the road by the camera. Every word is drawn
    after Data and well above him."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    a_walk, a_pull0, a_pull1 = 0.13, 0.15, 0.5
    close = ease(seg(u, a_pull0, a_pull1))
    off = ease(seg(u, a_pull1, a_pull1 + 0.06))

    landscape(cr, t, "town")
    cr.rectangle(0, 1436, W, 90)
    solid(cr, (176, 172, 164), edge=False, rim=False)
    cr.rectangle(0, 1522, W, H - 1522)
    solid(cr, (64, 66, 72), edge=False, rim=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 220, 150)))
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    for i in range(6):
        cr.move_to(20 + i * 200, 1720)
        cr.line_to(120 + i * 200, 1720)
    cr.stroke()

    PX0, PX1, BX0, BX1 = 30, 520, 560, 1050
    cast_shadow(cr, PX0, PX1, 1440, length=260, a=0.28)
    cast_shadow(cr, BX0, BX1, 1440, length=260, a=0.28)
    building(cr, PX0, PX1, 1440, 470, (210, 198, 176), roof="flat", boards=False)
    building(cr, BX0, BX1, 1440, 470, (214, 202, 180), roof="flat", boards=False)

    # Perth: the window of tapes, the steel shutter coming down over it
    WX0, WX1, WY0, WY1 = PX0 + 44, PX1 - 44, 1240, 1410
    _bb_window(cr, WX0, WX1, WY0, WY1, off)
    edge_y = WY0 + (WY1 - WY0) * close
    _bb_shutter(cr, WX0, WX1, WY0, edge_y)
    cr.rectangle(WX0 - 8, edge_y - 8, WX1 - WX0 + 16, 18)
    solid(cr, (70, 74, 84), finish="metal")
    if close > 0.98:                               # padlocked at both ends
        for lx in (WX0 + 24, WX1 - 24):
            cr.arc(lx, edge_y + 14, 9, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 60, 64)))
            cr.set_line_width(4)
            cr.stroke()
            cr.rectangle(lx - 11, edge_y + 14, 22, 16)
            solid(cr, (200, 160, 60), finish="metal", rim=False)
    cylinder(cr, WX0 - 18, WY0, WX1 - WX0 + 36, 34, (120, 124, 134), finish="metal")
    _bb_sign(cr, PX0 + 22, PX1 - 22, 1170, off)

    # Bend: tapes in the window, the door open and lit to the end
    _bb_window(cr, BX0 + 44, BX0 + 320, 1240, 1410, 0.0)
    cr.rectangle(BX0 + 350, 1210, 100, 230)
    solid(cr, (255, 226, 160), finish="glass", rim=False)
    glow(cr, BX0 + 400, 1330, 170, (255, 220, 150), 0.35)
    cylinder(cr, BX0 + 26, 1240, 312, 34, (120, 124, 134), finish="metal")
    _bb_sign(cr, BX0 + 22, BX1 - 22, 1170, 0.0)

    tx = -300 + (t * 330) % 1500
    contact_shadow(cr, tx, 1800, 260, a=0.35)
    truck(cr, tx, 1790, 1.5)
    foreground(cr, "town")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    HX_END = (WX0 + WX1) / 2
    FY = 1452
    if u < a_walk:
        hx = 820 + (HX_END - 820) * ease(seg(u, 0.02, a_walk))
        host("point", hx, FY, 240)
    elif u < 0.9:
        ey = max(edge_y, WY0 + 4)
        host("grip", HX_END, FY, 240, hands=[(HX_END - 34, ey), (HX_END + 34, ey)],
             lower="brace" if close < 0.999 else "crouch",
             expr="strain" if close < 0.999 else "happy")

    # the town names, above the rooflines, drawn after Data
    text(cr, "PERTH", (PX0 + PX1) / 2, 940, 34, look.INK, face="bold",
         anchor="center", alpha=1.0 - 0.5 * off)

    if u < a_pull1 + 0.05:

                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)
    else:
        n1 = int(round(v1))
        fit_readout(cr, f"{n1} store" if n1 == 1 else f"{n1} stores",

                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, a_pull1 + 0.05, a_pull1 + 0.1)), size=130)

# scene standard: 2026-10-16.2
def _vhs(cr, x, y, w, a=1.0, t=0.0, spin=0.0):
    """A VHS cassette, face on, big enough to read: a flat black shell, a
    white label strip across the top, and the wide window across the bottom
    showing two fat rolls of brown tape on white toothed hubs. Those rolls
    are what make it a VHS and not an audio cassette."""
    h = w * 0.56
    cr.rectangle(x, y, w, h)
    solid(cr, (26, 26, 30), finish="gloss", a=a)
    # ribbed grips on both ends
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 60, 68), a))
    cr.set_line_width(max(1.5, w * 0.012))
    for i in range(4):
        for gx in (x + w * 0.035, x + w * 0.965):
            cr.move_to(gx, y + h * (0.42 + i * 0.12))
            cr.line_to(gx, y + h * (0.48 + i * 0.12))
    cr.stroke()
    # the white label, a yellow stub at its left
    cr.rectangle(x + 0.1 * w, y + 0.08 * h, 0.8 * w, 0.26 * h)
    solid(cr, (240, 236, 226), rim=False, a=a)
    cr.rectangle(x + 0.1 * w, y + 0.08 * h, 0.18 * w, 0.26 * h)
    solid(cr, (250, 204, 40), rim=False, edge=False, a=a)
    # the wide window, the tape rolls seen through it
    wx0, wy0, ww, wh = x + 0.12 * w, y + 0.42 * h, 0.76 * w, 0.44 * h
    cr.rectangle(wx0, wy0, ww, wh)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((52, 50, 58), a))
    cr.fill()
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(wx0, wy0, ww, wh)
    cr.clip()
    cy = y + 0.66 * h
    for k, rr in ((0.3, 0.2), (0.7, 0.12)):
        cx = x + k * w
        cr.arc(cx, cy, rr * w, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((92, 58, 36), a))
        cr.fill()
        cr.arc(cx, cy, rr * w * 0.82, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 80, 50), 0.5 * a))
        cr.set_line_width(max(1.0, w * 0.01))
        cr.stroke()
        cr.arc(cx, cy, 0.075 * w, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((238, 236, 230), a))
        cr.fill()
        ang = spin * t
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 40, 46), a))
        for s_ in range(6):
            a_ = ang + s_ * math.pi / 3
            cr.arc(cx + 0.05 * w * math.cos(a_), cy + 0.05 * w * math.sin(a_),
                   0.012 * w, 0, 2 * math.pi)
            cr.fill()
        cr.arc(cx, cy, 0.022 * w, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()
    # the glass sheen over the window
    cr.move_to(wx0, wy0)
    cr.line_to(wx0 + ww * 0.35, wy0)
    cr.line_to(wx0 + ww * 0.2, wy0 + wh)
    cr.line_to(wx0, wy0 + wh)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(1, 1, 1, 0.08 * a)
    cr.fill()
    cr.restore()
    cr.rectangle(wx0, wy0, ww, wh)
    edge(cr, (14, 14, 18))


def _mix(c0, c1, k):
    return tuple(int(p + (q - p) * k) for p, q in zip(c0, c1))


def _slot(x0, x1, top, base, r, c):
    ry0 = top + 100
    rh = (base - 30 - ry0) / 3.0
    cw = (x1 - x0 - 40) / 3.0
    tw = cw * 0.9
    th = tw * 0.56
    return x0 + 20 + c * cw + (cw - tw) / 2, ry0 + (r + 1) * rh - th - 12, tw


def _shelf(cr, x0, x1, top, base, name, lit):
    cast_shadow(cr, x0, x1, base, length=220, a=0.25)
    contact_shadow(cr, (x0 + x1) / 2, base, x1 - x0 + 40, a=0.35)
    if lit > 0.01:
        glow(cr, (x0 + x1) / 2, (top + base) / 2, (x1 - x0) * 0.8, (255, 226, 170), 0.3 * lit)
    box(cr, x0, base, x1 - x0, base - top, _mix((26, 28, 40), (34, 70, 160), lit), depth=46)
    cr.rectangle(x0 + 16, top + 96, x1 - x0 - 32, base - top - 112)
    solid(cr, _mix((14, 16, 24), (22, 38, 92), lit), rim=False)
    ry0 = top + 100
    rh = (base - 30 - ry0) / 3.0
    for r in range(3):
        cr.rectangle(x0 + 16, ry0 + (r + 1) * rh - 12, x1 - x0 - 32, 12)
        solid(cr, _mix((70, 64, 50), (240, 196, 50), lit), rim=False)
    # the yellow torn-ticket header with the store's town on it
    sx0, sx1, sy0, sy1 = x0 + 20, x1 - 20, top + 14, top + 84
    cr.move_to(sx0, sy0)
    cr.line_to(sx1, sy0)
    cr.line_to(sx1 - 18, sy0 + 22)
    cr.line_to(sx1, sy0 + 40)
    cr.line_to(sx1 - 18, sy1)
    cr.line_to(sx0, sy1)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, _mix((96, 84, 50), (250, 204, 40), lit), finish="gloss")
    text(cr, name, (sx0 + sx1) / 2 - 8, sy1 - 18, 46, _mix((40, 40, 50), (24, 40, 110), lit),
         face="display", anchor="center", shadow=False)


def _cart(cr, hx, fy, n, hands):
    """A wire shopping cart: tapered basket, wire grid, legs, four wheels,
    the push bar under his hands."""
    bt, bb = fy - 140, fy - 56
    tx0, tx1 = hx - 345, hx - 112
    bx0, bx1 = hx - 318, hx - 150
    contact_shadow(cr, (tx0 + tx1) / 2, fy, tx1 - tx0 + 40, a=0.4)
    # legs and the bottom rack
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 154, 164)))
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    cr.move_to(bx0 + 10, bb)
    cr.line_to(bx0 + 4, fy - 22)
    cr.move_to(bx1 - 10, bb)
    cr.line_to(bx1 + 8, fy - 22)
    cr.move_to(bx0 + 4, fy - 30)
    cr.line_to(bx1 + 8, fy - 30)
    cr.stroke()
    for wx in (bx0 + 4, bx0 + 40, bx1 - 20, bx1 + 8):
        disc(cr, wx, fy - 12, 12, (34, 34, 40))
    # the basket's back, then the tapes riding in it
    cr.move_to(tx0, bt)
    cr.line_to(tx1, bt)
    cr.line_to(bx1, bb)
    cr.line_to(bx0, bb)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 62, 72), 0.35))
    cr.fill()
    for i in range(max(0, n)):
        col, lay = i % 3, i // 3
        _vhs(cr, tx0 + 14 + col * 72 + (lay % 2) * 8, bb - 40 - lay * 34, 66)
    # the wire grid over them
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((196, 200, 210)))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(1, 9):
        k = i / 9.0
        cr.move_to(tx0 + (tx1 - tx0) * k, bt)
        cr.line_to(bx0 + (bx1 - bx0) * k, bb)
    for j in range(1, 4):
        k = j / 4.0
        cr.move_to(tx0 + (bx0 - tx0) * k, bt + (bb - bt) * k)
        cr.line_to(tx1 + (bx1 - tx1) * k, bt + (bb - bt) * k)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.move_to(tx0, bt)
    cr.line_to(tx1, bt)
    cr.line_to(bx1, bb)
    cr.line_to(bx0, bb)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 154, 164)))
    cr.set_line_width(7)
    cr.stroke()
    # the push bar, red grip where his hands are
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 154, 164)))
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    cr.move_to(tx1, bt)
    cr.line_to(hands[0][0] - 10, hands[0][1])
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((200, 50, 44)))
    cr.set_line_width(14)
    cr.move_to(hands[0][0] - 12, hands[0][1])
    cr.line_to(hands[1][0] + 12, hands[1][1])
    cr.stroke()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: shelves of black VHS rental tapes
    SUBSTANCE: black VHS tapes
    CAUSE: Data clears the closed store's VHS tapes into his shopping cart and pushes it over to restock the last open store's shelf
    The closing, both halves of the line happening inside the stores the
    story ended on: the PERTH shelf of big face-out VHS tapes (black shells,
    white labels, brown tape rolls in the window) is swept bare row by row
    into Data's wire shopping cart and its lights go out under a CLOSED card
    (a giant gone), then he pushes the loaded cart to the BEND shelf and
    files the tapes into its empty slots, one by one (one small store still
    rents movies). The count lands by 0.42 and holds; he keeps restocking."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    FY, HH = 1480, 220
    a0, G, gs = 0.06, 3, 0.09
    g = int(clamp((u - a0) / gs, 0, G - 0.001))
    gf = clamp((u - a0 - g * gs) / gs)
    fly = ease(seg(gf, 0.15, 0.75)) if u >= a0 else 0.0
    grabs = 0 if u < a0 else g + (1 if fly >= 0.999 else 0)
    dim = ease(seg(u, 0.30, 0.42))
    push = ease(seg(u, 0.38, 0.52))
    hx = 930 - 230 * push
    FS, fa, fsp = 3, 0.54, 0.13
    fk = int(clamp((u - fa) / fsp, 0, FS - 0.001))
    ff = clamp((u - fa - fk * fsp) / fsp)
    ffly = ease(seg(ff, 0.1, 0.7)) if u >= fa else 0.0
    filed = 0 if u < fa else fk + (1 if ffly >= 0.999 else 0)
    filing = u >= fa and 0 < ffly < 0.999
    in_cart = grabs * 3 - filed - (1 if filing else 0)

    # the store: a low ceiling of strip lights, a poster wall, blue carpet
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (40, 38, 46)), (1, (96, 92, 96))], 0, 660)
    for i in range(6):
        z = i / 5.0
        lx, ly, sc = 70 + 820 * z, 200 + 330 * z, 1.0 - 0.6 * z
        on = 1.0 - dim if lx > 540 else 1.0
        glow(cr, lx + 90 * sc, ly, 180 * sc, (255, 240, 205), 0.35 * on)
        box(cr, lx, ly, 180 * sc, 18 * sc, _mix((90, 90, 96), (246, 242, 230), on), depth=36 * sc)
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (78, 90, 130)), (1, (56, 64, 96))], 640, 1320)
    for i in range(7):
        px = 30 + i * 150
        cr.rectangle(px, 680 + (i % 2) * 30, 110, 160)
        solid(cr, [(170, 60, 50), (60, 110, 170), (210, 160, 60), (90, 140, 90)][i % 4])
    haze(cr, 640, 1320, (150, 150, 170), a=0.35)
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (44, 56, 116)), (1, (24, 30, 66))], 1300, H)
    for i in range(40):
        cr.arc(30 + (i * 137) % 1040, 1340 + (i * 89) % 560, 6, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((240, 196, 50) if i % 2 else (196, 60, 50), 0.6))
        cr.fill()
    glow(cr, 300, 1420, 420, (255, 230, 180), 0.18)

    # PERTH, the closed store's shelf, swept bare, going dark
    RX0, RX1, RT, RB = 570, 1020, 720, 1360
    _shelf(cr, RX0, RX1, RT, RB, "PERTH", 1.0 - dim)
    flying = []
    for r in range(3):
        order = 2 - r                         # bottom row first, in reach
        for c in range(3):
            sx, sy, tw = _slot(RX0, RX1, RT, RB, r, c)
            if order < grabs:
                continue
            if u >= a0 and order == g and 0 < fly < 1:
                tx, ty = hx - 330 + c * 72, FY - 200 - grabs * 10
                flying.append((sx + (tx - sx) * fly,
                               sy + (ty - sy) * fly - 150 * math.sin(math.pi * fly),
                               tw + (66 - tw) * fly))
                continue
            _vhs(cr, sx, sy, tw)
    if dim > 0:
        cr.rectangle(RX0, RT, RX1 - RX0 + 46, RB - RT)

        cr.fill()

# scene standard: 2026-10-16.2
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a giant VHS video cassette
    SUBSTANCE: the brown magnetic tape
    CAUSE: Data pulls the tape out of the cassette with both hands and its full reel shrinks to almost nothing
    The hook, mid-action from frame one: a VHS rental tape the size of a
    store stands in an empty town lot at sundown, BE KIND, REWIND on its
    label. The tape already runs out of its front slot into Data's hands.
    He pulls it out in three long hauls, stepping back each time. The
    slack drops in loops at his feet, and in the window the full reel spins
    and shrinks until only a thin ring is left round the hub. The giant has
    been hollowed out. That is done by 0.55 and holds: he keeps his grip on
    the tape and cars keep crossing the lot behind it."""
    HAULS = [(0.0, 0.14), (0.18, 0.34), (0.38, 0.55)]
    p0 = 0.15
    p = p0
    k = 0
    for i, (a, b) in enumerate(HAULS):
        p += (1.0 - p0) / len(HAULS) * ease(seg(u, a, b))
        if u >= a:
            k = i
    HUB, R0 = 40.0, 140.0
    r_left = math.sqrt(HUB * HUB + (R0 * R0 - HUB * HUB) * (1.0 - 0.96 * p))
    spin = -p * 14.0

    # Data walks back from the cassette as he pulls the tape out
    FY = 1480.0
    fx = 720.0 + 270.0 * (p - p0) / (1.0 - p0)
    h1 = (fx - 60.0, FY - 100.0)
    h2 = (fx - 20.0, FY - 92.0)

    # the setting: an empty town lot under a low sun
    gy = landscape(cr, t, "town", horizon=1100)

    # a car keeps crossing the lot behind the tape
    cx = 1180.0 - ((t * 420.0) % 1750.0)
    cy = 1170.0
    contact_shadow(cr, cx + 85, cy + 4, 190, a=0.35)
    box(cr, cx, cy, 170, 42, (176, 50, 44), depth=30, finish="gloss")
    box(cr, cx + 40, cy - 42, 86, 32, (150, 170, 196), depth=24, finish="glass")
    for wx in (cx + 32, cx + 136):
        disc(cr, wx, cy + 2, 16, (24, 24, 28))

    # THE CASSETTE: black shell, three-quarter, standing on its long edge
    X0, X1, BASE, HT = 110.0, 910.0, 1250.0, 470.0
    cast_shadow(cr, X0, X1 + 70, BASE, length=300, a=0.32)
    contact_shadow(cr, (X0 + X1) / 2 + 30, BASE + 4, 900, a=0.45)
    box(cr, X0, BASE, X1 - X0, HT, (30, 30, 34), depth=70, finish="gloss")
    # the raised inner panel
    cr.rectangle(X0 + 40, BASE - HT + 22, X1 - X0 - 80, HT - 44)
    solid(cr, (44, 44, 50), finish="gloss")
    # corner screws
    for sx_, sy_ in ((X0 + 22, BASE - HT + 22), (X1 - 22, BASE - HT + 22),
                     (X0 + 22, BASE - 22), (X1 - 22, BASE - 22)):
        disc(cr, sx_, sy_, 9, (150, 150, 158), finish="metal")
    # the label sticker
    cr.rectangle(230, 806, 560, 64)
    solid(cr, (238, 232, 216), rim=False)
    text(cr, "BE KIND, REWIND", 510, 850, 38, (52, 46, 40), face="bold",
         anchor="center", shadow=False)

    # the window: two reels, the left one full of brown tape
    WX0, WY0, WX1, WY1 = 200.0, 890.0, 820.0, 1180.0
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(WX0, WY0, WX1 - WX0, WY1 - WY0)
    cr.clip()
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (28, 26, 30)), (1, (12, 12, 16))], WY0, WY1, WX0, WX1)
    LX, RX, RY = 360.0, 660.0, 1035.0
    disc(cr, LX, RY, r_left, (104, 66, 40))
    disc(cr, RX, RY, 62, (104, 66, 40))
    for hx_, ang in ((LX, spin), (RX, spin * 0.3)):
        disc(cr, hx_, RY, HUB, (232, 232, 234), finish="gloss")
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 40, 46)))
        cr.set_line_width(7)
        for q in range(6):
            a_ = ang + q * math.pi / 3
            cr.move_to(hx_ + 16 * math.cos(a_), RY + 16 * math.sin(a_))
            cr.line_to(hx_ + 36 * math.cos(a_), RY + 36 * math.sin(a_))
        cr.stroke()
        disc(cr, hx_, RY, 11, (60, 60, 66))
    # the tape running from the full reel down to the slot
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((84, 52, 32)))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    cr.move_to(LX - r_left * 0.2, RY + r_left)
    cr.line_to(700, WY1)
    cr.stroke()
    # the smoked window's shine
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 255, 255), 0.14))
    cr.move_to(WX0 + 360, WY0)
    cr.line_to(WX0 + 470, WY0)
    cr.line_to(WX0 + 330, WY1)
    cr.line_to(WX0 + 220, WY1)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()
    cr.restore()
    cr.rectangle(WX0, WY0, WX1 - WX0, WY1 - WY0)
    edge(cr, (16, 16, 20), width=6)

    # the front slot the tape comes out of
    cr.rectangle(200, 1218, 620, 16)
    solid(cr, (12, 12, 14), rim=False)
    E = (700.0, 1232.0)

    # the slack he has pulled, dropping in loops on the ground
    for i in range(12):
        if p < p0 + (1.0 - p0) * i / 12.0:
            break
        lx = 720.0 + i * 26.0
        ly = 1488.0 + 14.0 * ((i * 0.618) % 1.0)
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(lx, ly)
        cr.rotate(0.3 * math.sin(i * 1.7))
        cr.scale(1.0, 0.32)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 44 + 10 * ((i * 0.41) % 1.0), 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((92, 58, 36)))
        cr.set_line_width(6)
        cr.stroke()

    # the strand: out of the slot, taut into his hands, down to his feet
    sag = 30.0 * (1.0 - ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.55))) + 6.0 * math.sin(t * 2.2)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((84, 52, 32)))
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    cr.move_to(*E)
    cr.curve_to(E[0] + 20, E[1] + 60 + sag, h1[0] - 40, h1[1] + sag, h1[0], h1[1])
    cr.line_to(h2[0], h2[1])
    cr.curve_to(h2[0] + 10, h2[1] + 50, fx - 30, FY - 20, fx - 10, FY + 6)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((170, 120, 80), 0.6))
    cr.set_line_width(2)
    cr.move_to(*E)
    cr.curve_to(E[0] + 20, E[1] + 60 + sag, h1[0] - 40, h1[1] + sag, h1[0], h1[1])
    cr.stroke()

    # right by the camera: an empty rental case lying open on the lot
    contact_shadow(cr, 230, 1712, 330, a=0.45)
    box(cr, 80, 1708, 300, 90, (30, 64, 160), depth=60, finish="gloss")
    cr.rectangle(110, 1640, 240, 40)
    solid(cr, (240, 200, 60), rim=False)
    foreground(cr, "town")
    vignette(cr, a=0.3)

    if u < 0.88:
        host("grip", fx, FY, 220, hands=[h1, h2], lower="brace",
             expr="strain", beat=k)
    else:
        host("shock", fx, FY, 220)

    fit_readout(cr, "Blockbuster", "the giant, hollowed out",
                80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.04)), size=130)

stories.title: The Average US Household Shrank From 3.3 To 2.5
stories.hook: Your grandparents' packed house is gone, and being alone replaced it.
stories.closing: Every person living alone needs a whole home, and that's one reason housing feels so tight.
stories.question: Do you live alone? Tell me below.
stories.caption: In 1960 the average American home had 3.3 people in it. Today it's 2.5 -- the smallest ever recorded. Households didn't shrink because families vanished, they just split into way more, smaller ones. 👇

segments.say: The average American home now holds just 2.5 people, the fewest ever. In 1960, it was over three.

# scene standard: 2026-10-16.2

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a family dinner table, plates set
    SUBSTANCE: the table's wooden end
    CAUSE: Data saws the end off the dinner table and it drops to the floor, one cut per era
    One American family's dinner table under the lamp, its length the
    average household: 250px of table per person. In 1960 it runs 3.33
    people long, a fourth plate set on its end. Data saws that end off and
    it drops to the floor, plate and all (1980, 2.76), then saws again to
    2023's 2.51. THE SCALE is in the picture: the cut-off ends lie on the
    floor beside the table, so a glance reads how much table the household
    lost. Done by 0.57 and held; Data hoists the last cut-off end over his
    head and carries it away."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    n = len(rows)
    if n > 2:
        mid = min(n - 2, max(1, n // 3))
        stops = [rows[0], rows[mid], rows[-1]]
    elif n == 2:
        stops = [rows[0], rows[1]]
    else:
        stops = [rows[0], rows[0]]
    cuts = len(stops) - 1
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.62
    span = (a1 - a0) / cuts
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, cuts - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    saw = 0.0 if u < a0 else ease(seg(f, 0.1, 0.45))

    def started(j):
        return u >= a0 and (j < k or (j == k and f >= 0.45))

    def fall(j):
        if not started(j):
            return 0.0
        if j < k:
            return 1.0
        return seg(f, 0.45, 0.8) ** 2

    n_started = sum(1 for j in range(cuts) if started(j))
    n_landed = sum(1 for j in range(cuts) if started(j) and fall(j) >= 0.999)
    shown = stops[n_landed]

    U = 250.0
    TX0, TOPY, FL = 60.0, 1290.0, 1460.0
    end_x = TX0 + stops[n_started][1] * U
    lift = ease(seg(u, 0.64, 0.70))
    walk = ease(seg(u, 0.70, 0.95))
    xlast = TX0 + stops[-1][1] * U + 120
    if u < a0:
        hx = 940.0
    elif u < 0.64:
        hx = TX0 + stops[k + 1][1] * U + 120
    else:
        hx = xlast + (990 - xlast) * walk
    HH = 236

    # the dining room: warm wall, a window on the evening, a plank floor
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (96, 76, 64)), (0.55, (196, 168, 136)), (1, (214, 190, 156))], 0, 1140)
    cr.rectangle(0, 1040, W, 100)
    solid(cr, (150, 120, 92), rim=False, edge=False)
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (150, 100, 62)), (1, (86, 54, 32))], 1130, H)
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(0, 1130, W, H - 1130)
    cr.clip()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 38, 24), 0.4))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(14):
        cr.move_to(540, 1000)
        cr.line_to(-1100 + i * 250, H)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()
    cr.rectangle(0, 1122, W, 14)
    solid(cr, (70, 46, 30), rim=False)

    WX0, WX1, WY0, WY1 = 720.0, 990.0, 700.0, 930.0
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(WX0, WY0, WX1 - WX0, WY1 - WY0)
    cr.clip()
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (70, 80, 130)), (0.6, (236, 150, 110)), (1, (252, 206, 140))],
          WY0, WY1, WX0, WX1)
    glow(cr, WX0 + 80, WY1 - 50, 110, P["sun_glow"], 0.7)
    ridge(cr, WY1 - 8, 46, seed=1.3)
    solid(cr, P["leaf_far"], edge=False)
    treeline(cr, WY1 + 4, P["leaf_far_shade"], n=6, seed=2)
    haze(cr, WY0, WY1, (236, 170, 130), a=0.4)
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((240, 232, 216)))
    cr.set_line_width(12)
    cr.rectangle(WX0, WY0, WX1 - WX0, WY1 - WY0)
    cr.move_to((WX0 + WX1) / 2, WY0)
    cr.line_to((WX0 + WX1) / 2, WY1)
    cr.stroke()

    # a rug under the table
    cr.move_to(0, 1480)
    cr.line_to(W, 1460)
    cr.line_to(W, H)
    cr.line_to(0, H)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (150, 56, 48), rim=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((226, 196, 140)))
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    cr.move_to(0, 1510)
    cr.line_to(W, 1490)
    cr.stroke()

    # the pendant lamp over dinner
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 34, 30)))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    cr.move_to(470, 0)
    cr.line_to(470, 860)
    cr.stroke()
    glow(cr, 470, 1180, 380, (255, 226, 170), 0.3)

    # the family's chairs behind the table
    for fx in (0.5, 1.4, 2.25):
        _hh_chair_back(cr, TX0 + 70 + fx * U, 960, 1210)

    cr.move_to(430, 860)
    cr.line_to(510, 860)
    cr.line_to(580, 930)
    cr.line_to(360, 930)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (60, 90, 80), finish="gloss")
    glow(cr, 470, 936, 70, (255, 236, 190), 0.8)

    # the table: shadow, back legs, the lit top, front legs
    cast_shadow(cr, TX0, end_x + 70, FL, length=260, a=0.25)
    contact_shadow(cr, (TX0 + end_x) / 2 + 30, FL, end_x - TX0 + 80, a=0.4)
    for lx in (TX0 + 20, TX0 + 560):
        cr.rectangle(lx + 70, TOPY - 90, 28, 170)
        solid(cr, (84, 52, 30))
    _hh_slab(cr, TX0, end_x, TOPY)
    for lx in (TX0 + 20, TX0 + 560):
        cr.rectangle(lx, TOPY + 40, 30, FL - TOPY - 40)
        solid(cr, (104, 64, 38))

    # dinner on it: candles and a place for every person
    for kx in (320, 545):
        contact_shadow(cr, kx + 8, 1236, 36, a=0.3)
        cylinder(cr, kx, 1234, 16, 64, (242, 234, 214))
        fk = 1.0 + 0.1 * math.sin(t * 7 + kx)
        glow(cr, kx + 8, 1160, 40, (255, 200, 110), 0.7)
        cr.move_to(kx + 8, 1170 - 24 * fk)
        cr.curve_to(kx + 18, 1160, kx + 15, 1170, kx + 8, 1172)
        cr.curve_to(kx + 1, 1170, kx - 2, 1160, kx + 8, 1170 - 24 * fk)
        solid(cr, (255, 190, 80), finish="gloss", edge=False)
    for fx in (0.5, 1.4, 2.25):
        _hh_setting(cr, TX0 + 35 + fx * U, TOPY - 45)
    x4 = TX0 + 35 + 3.02 * U
    if not started(0) and x4 + 40 < end_x + 35:
        _hh_setting(cr, x4, TOPY - 45)

    # the saw's kerf, opening as he cuts
    if u >= a0 and not started(k) and saw > 0:
        kx_ = TX0 + stops[k + 1][1] * U
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 24, 14)))
        cr.set_line_width(5)
        cr.move_to(kx_ + 70 * saw, TOPY - 90 * saw)
        cr.line_to(kx_, TOPY)
        cr.line_to(kx_, TOPY + 40 * saw)
        cr.stroke()

    # the cut-off ends: they drop to the floor and stay there
    def piece(j, ox, oy, rot):
        xa = TX0 + stops[j + 1][1] * U
        xb = TX0 + stops[j][1] * U
        if xb - xa < 2:
            return
        ccx, ccy = (xa + xb) / 2 + 35, TOPY - 5
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(ccx + ox, ccy + oy)
        cr.rotate(rot)
        cr.translate(-ccx, -ccy)
        _hh_slab(cr, xa, xb, TOPY)
        if j == 0 and xa < x4 < xb + 35:
            _hh_setting(cr, x4, TOPY - 45)
        cr.restore()

    carried = None
    for j in range(cuts):
        pj = fall(j)
        if not started(j):
            continue
        xa = TX0 + stops[j + 1][1] * U
        xb = TX0 + stops[j][1] * U
        ccx, ccy = (xa + xb) / 2 + 35, TOPY - 5
        ox, oy, rot = 40 * pj, 150 * pj, 0.16 * pj
        if j == cuts - 1 and lift > 0:
            carried = (j, ox + (hx - ccx - ox) * lift,
                       oy + (FL - HH - 40 - ccy - oy) * lift, rot * (1 - lift))
            continue
        contact_shadow(cr, ccx + 40, 1478, xb - xa + 80, a=0.35 * pj)
        piece(j, ox, oy, rot)

    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    if u < a0:
        host("point", hx, FL, HH)
    elif u < 0.64:
        host("cut", hx, FL, HH, beat=k)
    else:
        host("hold_up", hx, FL, HH)
    if carried is not None:
        piece(*carried)

    # right by the camera: the back of a chair at the near end
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(170, 1640)

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: an apartment building of homes
    SUBSTANCE: new floors of homes
    CAUSE: Data hammers each new floor of homes onto the building, so it rises
    America's households as one building on one street: in 1960 it stands
    four storeys of homes; Data, up on its roof, frames and hammers on floor
    after floor, and it rises through 2000 to 2023 — its height is the
    household count. THE SCALE is on the building: the 1960 building stays as
    a dashed ghost with its roofline marked 1960, and 1x/2x ticks up its side
    measure the new building in the old one — about two and a half times.
    Done by 0.56 and held; the cars keep driving and Data keeps hammering."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    n = len(rows)
    v0 = rows[0][1] or 1.0
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.56
    m = max(1, n - 1)
    span = (a1 - a0) / m
    if u < a0 or n < 2:
        val = rows[0][1] if u < a0 else rows[-1][1]
        landed_to = 0 if u < a0 else n - 1
    else:
        k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, m - 0.001))
        f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
        g = ease(seg(f, 0.08, 0.92))
        val = rows[k][1] + (rows[k + 1][1] - rows[k][1]) * g
        landed_to = k + 1 if g >= 0.999 else k
    ratio = rows[-1][1] / v0

    BASE, X0, BW = 1440.0, 360.0, 400.0
    X1 = X0 + BW
    H0 = 290.0
    hmax = 720.0
    unit = min(H0, hmax * v0 / max(v for _, v in rows))
    h = unit * val / v0
    FH = 58.0
    floors = int(h // FH)
    hb = floors * FH
    part = h - hb

    # a town at golden hour, low houses far down the road under haze
    landscape(cr, t, "town", horizon=1100)
    haze(cr, 900, 1110, (226, 214, 196), a=0.4)
    birds(cr, t, y0=780, n=4, rgb=(60, 60, 70))

    # the sidewalk and the building's long shadow
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (206, 200, 188)), (1, (184, 178, 166))], 1440, 1700)
    cast_shadow(cr, X0, X1, BASE, length=320, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, (X0 + X1) / 2 + 40, BASE + 4, BW + 160, a=0.4)

    # the building: finished floors of homes, the next floor framed on top
    b = building(cr, X0, X1, BASE, hb, (196, 140, 112), roof_rgb=(120, 112, 104),
                 roof="flat", depth=0.3 * BW, boards=False)
    top = b["top"]
    # floor lines, windows with lit rooms and curtains, balconies
    for fl in range(floors):
        fy = BASE - (fl + 1) * FH
        cr.rectangle(X0, fy, BW, 5)
        solid(cr, (150, 104, 84), rim=False, edge=False)
        if fl == 0:
            continue
        for c in range(5):
            wx = X0 + 22 + c * 76
            lit = ((fl * 7 + c * 3) % 5) != 0
            cr.rectangle(wx, fy + 14, 44, 34)
            solid(cr, (250, 220, 150) if lit else (70, 84, 100), finish="glass",
                  rim=False)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((240, 236, 226)))
            cr.set_line_width(3)
            cr.rectangle(wx, fy + 14, 44, 34)
            cr.move_to(wx + 22, fy + 14)
            cr.line_to(wx + 22, fy + 48)
            cr.stroke()
            if lit and (fl + c) % 3 == 0:
                cr.rectangle(wx + 2, fy + 16, 12, 30)
                cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((200, 90, 70), 0.85))
                cr.fill()
    # the street door and its awning
    dcx = (X0 + X1) / 2
    cr.rectangle(dcx - 30, BASE - 52, 60, 52)
    solid(cr, (80, 56, 44), rim=False)
    box(cr, dcx - 48, BASE - 56, 96, 8, (60, 96, 120), depth=20)
    # the floor going up: studs rising out of the slab, a top plate
    if part > 2:
        for q in range(9):
            px = X0 + q * (BW - 10) / 8
            cr.rectangle(px, top - part, 10, part)
            solid(cr, (214, 172, 112), rim=False)
        if part > 14:
            cr.rectangle(X0, top - part - 8, BW, 9)
            solid(cr, (196, 154, 98), rim=False)

    # THE SCALE on the building: 1960's building as a ghost, ticks up its side
    if val > v0 * 1.04:
        cr.rectangle(X0 - 6, BASE - H0, BW + 12, H0)
        ghost(cr, a=0.9)
        then_mark(cr, X0 - 30, X1 + 40, BASE - H0, rows[0][0])
        times_ticks(cr, 300, BASE, H0, max(1, int(ratio)))

    # right by the camera: the street, cars driving through town
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (84, 86, 92)), (1, (70, 72, 78))], 1690, 1860)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 214, 120)))
    for j in range(7):
        cr.rectangle(j * 170, 1772, 90, 8)
    cr.fill()
    for j in range(2):
        cx = -320 + ((t * 300 + j * 850) % 1700)
        _ap_car(cr, cx, 1750 + j * 80, 1.25 + 0.15 * j,
                [(196, 52, 44), (60, 96, 160)][j])
    foreground(cr, "town", y0=1860)
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data on the roof, framing each new floor — he rises with the building
    hx = X0 + 90
    hy = top
    if u < a0:
        host("point", hx, hy, 220)
    elif u < a1 + 0.04:
        host("hammer", hx, hy, 220, beat=floors)
    elif u < 0.92:
        host("hammer", hx, hy, 220, beat=50 + int((u - a1) / 0.12))
    else:
        host("cheer", hx, hy, 220)

    lab, v = rows[landed_to]
    fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v))}M households", f"in the US · {lab}",
                80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)
    if n > 1 and landed_to == n - 1:
        text(cr, f"{ratio:.1f}x", W - 80, 1060, 90, look.INK,
             face="display", anchor="right", alpha=ease(seg(u, a1 - 0.02, a1 + 0.04)))

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: an apartment block cut open
    SUBSTANCE: one-person homes
    CAUSE: Data places a new wall into each family flat, floor by floor, splitting it into homes for one person each
    A city street at low sun, an apartment block on its corner in
    three-quarter view under a stone cornice, its front cut away like a
    dollhouse, rowhouses fading down the street behind it, a lamp post and
    the building's mailboxes right by the camera. In 1960 each floor holds
    two family flats, a family of three round the sofa in each: eight homes
    for 1960's households, held long enough to read. Data works up the
    block and back down, carrying each new wall in with his own hands, the
    fresh wall lit in the accent as it slides into place, and each family
    flat becomes small homes with ONE person and one bed in each, the
    one-person rooms glowing in the accent, so the homes multiply with the
    household count: 2000's, then 2023's, about two and a half times as
    many. THE SCALE is in the picture: on a converted floor the old 1960
    flats stay as dashed ghosts round the new homes. Every printed number
    is the household count, in millions, from pts. Finished by 0.56 and
    held: Data holds up one more wall panel, and a neighbour walks past
    with a single suitcase."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    n = len(rows)
    v0 = rows[0][1] or 1.0
    NF = 4
    BASE0 = 8
    counts = [_ap_counts(max(BASE0, int(round(BASE0 * v / v0))), NF) for _, v in rows]

    # the steps: one floor at a time, up the block, then back down
    steps = []
    for ti in range(1, n):
        order = list(range(NF)) if ti % 2 == 1 else list(reversed(range(NF)))
        for fl in order:
            if counts[ti][fl] != counts[ti - 1][fl]:
                steps.append((ti, fl, counts[ti - 1][fl], counts[ti][fl]))
    S = len(steps)
    a0, a1 = 0.12, 0.56
    span = (a1 - a0) / max(1, S)
    si = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, max(0, S - 0.001)))
    sf = clamp((u - a0 - si * span) / span)
    p_now = 0.0 if u < a0 or S == 0 else ease(seg(sf, 0.3, 0.8))

    m_floor = list(counts[0])
    trans = {}
    for i, (ti, fl, m0, m1) in enumerate(steps):
        if u < a0:
            break
        if i < si:
            m_floor[fl] = m1
        elif i == si:
            trans[fl] = (m0, m1, p_now)
    landed_to = 0
    for ti in range(1, n):
        mine = [i for i, s_ in enumerate(steps) if s_[0] == ti]
        if not mine:
            landed_to = ti
            continue
        last = mine[-1]
        if u >= a0 and (last < si or (last == si and p_now >= 0.999)):
            landed_to = ti
    keep = sorted({round(i * (n - 1) / max(1, READOUT_SHOWS - 1))
                   for i in range(READOUT_SHOWS)}) if n > READOUT_SHOWS else list(range(n))
    named = max((i for i in keep if i <= landed_to), default=0)
    lab, val = rows[named]

    BX0, BX1, BASE, FH = 120, 920, 1440, 200
    RX0, RX1 = BX0 + 16, BX1 - 14

    def yl(fl):
        return BASE - fl * FH

    # THE SETTING: a town at low sun, rowhouses fading down the street
    landscape(cr, t, "town")
    birds(cr, t, y0=700, n=4, rgb=(60, 60, 70))
    for i in range(7):
        rowhouse(cr, -60 + i * 175, 160, 150 + 40 * (i % 3), 1190,
                 (190, 150, 126), (146, 108, 92), t=t)
    haze(cr, 760, 1200, (214, 204, 196), a=0.5)

    # the sidewalk, the road running away from the camera, the near kerb
    cr.rectangle(0, BASE - 10, W, 80)
    solid(cr, (200, 194, 184), rim=False, edge=False)
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (88, 90, 98)), (1, (60, 62, 70))], BASE + 70, 1760)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 224, 170), 0.85))
    for i in range(6):
        x0 = 300 + i * 190
        cr.move_to(x0, 1620)
        cr.line_to(x0 + 110, 1620)
        cr.line_to(x0 + 104, 1636)
        cr.line_to(x0 - 6, 1636)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.fill()
    cr.rectangle(0, 1760, W, H - 1760)
    solid(cr, (206, 198, 186), rim=False, edge=False)
    cr.rectangle(0, 1752, W, 14)
    solid(cr, (150, 146, 140), rim=False)

    # the block on its corner, three-quarter, its long shadow down the street
    cast_shadow(cr, BX0, BX1 + 110, BASE, length=300, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, (BX0 + BX1) / 2 + 40, BASE + 4, 940, a=0.4)
    box(cr, BX0, BASE, BX1 - BX0, NF * FH, (172, 92, 70), depth=120)

    coats = [(70, 110, 170), (190, 70, 60), (232, 180, 70), (90, 150, 110), (150, 96, 160)]
    warm = (238, 214, 172)
    wall_at = {}
    for fl in range(NF):
        ry0, ry1 = yl(fl + 1) + 12, yl(fl)
        if fl in trans:
            m0, m1, p = trans[fl]
        else:
            m0 = m1 = m_floor[fl]
            p = 1.0
        xs = [0.0]
        for j in range(1, m1):
            old = j / m0 if j < m0 else 1.0
            xs.append(old + (j / m1 - old) * p)
        xs.append(1.0)
        single = m1 > counts[0][fl] and p > 0.5
        for q in range(m1):
            ux0 = RX0 + xs[q] * (RX1 - RX0)
            ux1 = RX0 + xs[q + 1] * (RX1 - RX0)
            if ux1 - ux0 < 6:
                continue
            tint = 0.6 if single else 0.0
            wall = tuple(int(a + (b - a) * tint) for a, b in zip(warm, P["accent2"]))
            cr.save()
            cr.rectangle(ux0, ry0, ux1 - ux0, ry1 - ry0)
            cr.clip()
            vgrad(cr, [(0, tuple(int(c * 0.72) for c in wall)), (1, wall)], ry0, ry1, ux0, ux1)
            glow(cr, (ux0 + ux1) / 2, ry0 + 40, 90, (255, 236, 190), 0.45)
            wcx = (ux0 + ux1) / 2
            vgrad(cr, [(0, (120, 160, 200)), (1, (200, 220, 236))], ry0 + 26, ry0 + 86,
                  wcx - 34, wcx + 34)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((244, 238, 226)))
            cr.set_line_width(5)
            cr.rectangle(wcx - 34, ry0 + 26, 68, 60)
            cr.stroke()
            cr.rectangle(ux0, ry1 - 16, ux1 - ux0, 16)
            solid(cr, (150, 112, 78), rim=False, edge=False)
            cr.restore()
            uw = ux1 - ux0
            if single:
                # a single bed and one person: a home for one
                box(cr, ux0 + 0.08 * uw, ry1 - 4, 0.42 * uw, 26, (236, 232, 222), depth=16)
                box(cr, ux0 + 0.08 * uw, ry1 - 30, 0.12 * uw, 16, (250, 248, 240), depth=8)
                cr.rectangle(ux0 + 0.06 * uw, ry1 - 58, 8, 54)
                solid(cr, (110, 78, 62), rim=False)
                _ap_person(cr, ux0 + 0.7 * uw, ry1 - 4, 120, coats[(q + fl) % len(coats)])
            else:
                box(cr, ux0 + 0.5 * uw, ry1 - 4, 0.4 * uw, 36, (96, 120, 150), depth=22)
                box(cr, ux0 + 0.5 * uw, ry1 - 40, 0.4 * uw, 26, (86, 108, 136), depth=22)
                for i, (fx, ph) in enumerate([(0.2, 128), (0.34, 122), (0.46, 86)]):
                    _ap_person(cr, ux0 + fx * uw, ry1 - 4, ph,
                               coats[(i + q + fl) % len(coats)])
        for j in range(1, m1):
            wx = RX0 + xs[j] * (RX1 - RX0)
            fresh = fl in trans and j == m1 - 1
            if fresh:
                glow(cr, wx, (ry0 + ry1) / 2, 70, P["accent2"], 0.5)
                cr.rectangle(wx - 9, ry0, 18, ry1 - ry0)
                solid(cr, P["accent2"], rim=True)
                wall_at[fl] = wx
            else:
                cr.rectangle(wx - 7, ry0, 14, ry1 - ry0)
                solid(cr, (214, 206, 192), rim=False)
        # THE SCALE: the 1960 flats as dashed ghosts round the new homes
        if m1 > counts[0][fl] and p > 0.5:
            m_old = counts[0][fl]
            for q in range(m_old):
                gx0 = RX0 + q / m_old * (RX1 - RX0)
                gx1 = RX0 + (q + 1) / m_old * (RX1 - RX0)
                cr.rectangle(gx0 + 6, ry0 + 6, gx1 - gx0 - 12, ry1 - ry0 - 14)
                ghost(cr, a=0.9 * clamp((p - 0.5) / 0.3))

    for fl in range(1, NF + 1):
        cr.rectangle(BX0, yl(fl), BX1 - BX0, 12)
        solid(cr, (196, 188, 176), rim=False)
    cr.rectangle(BX0, yl(NF), 16, NF * FH)
    solid(cr, (180, 100, 78), rim=False)
    cr.rectangle(BX1 - 14, yl(NF), 14, NF * FH)
    solid(cr, (180, 100, 78), rim=False)
    # a stone cornice crowning the block, rooftop vents on it
    box(cr, BX0 - 14, yl(NF) + 8, BX1 - BX0 + 28, 26, (204, 196, 182), depth=130)
    box(cr, BX0 + 120, yl(NF) - 20, 70, 30, (150, 154, 162), depth=30, finish="metal")
    box(cr, BX0 + 560, yl(NF) - 20, 90, 30, (150, 154, 162), depth=30, finish="metal")
    # the entrance steps on the sidewalk
    box(cr, BX0 + 300, BASE + 30, 200, 26, (186, 180, 170), depth=40)

    # right by the camera: a lamp post, the block's mailboxes, a neighbour
    contact_shadow(cr, 70, 1902, 90, a=0.4)
    cylinder(cr, 58, 1900, 26, 760, (58, 60, 68), finish="metal")
    glow(cr, 71, 1130, 90, (255, 226, 170), 0.5)
    disc(cr, 71, 1130, 30, (250, 232, 190), finish="glass")
    _ap_mailboxes(cr, 720, 1900, 4, 3)
    px = -200 + ((t * 230) % 1500)
    _ap_person(cr, px, 1830, 240, (70, 110, 170))
    _ap_case(cr, px + 50, 1830, 72, 58, (150, 60, 54))
    foreground(cr, "town")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data works floor to floor, carrying each new wall in
    def spot(i):
        ti, fl, m0, m1 = steps[i]
        wx = RX0 + (m1 - 1) / m1 * (RX1 - RX0)
        return wx - 62, yl(fl)

    hh = 188
    if u < a0 or S == 0:
        host("point", 990, BASE, 200)
    elif u < a1 + 0.04:
        tx, ty = spot(si)
        fx_, fy_ = spot(si - 1) if si > 0 else (990, BASE)
        g = ease(seg(sf, 0.0, 0.28))
        hx, hy = fx_ + (tx - fx_) * g, fy_ + (ty - fy_) * g
        if steps[si][1] in wall_at and g >= 1:
            hx = wall_at[steps[si][1]] - 62

    else:

                80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

             anchor="right", alpha=ease(seg(u, a1 - 0.02, a1 + 0.04)))
