# scene standard: 2026-10-16.2
def _lots(n):
    lots = []
    s, x1, base = 1.7, 1050.0, 1460.0
    for j in range(n):
        w = 125 * s
        lots.append({"x0": x1 - w, "x1": x1, "base": base, "s": s, "w": w,
                     "wall": 170 * s})
        x1 = x1 - w - 4
        base -= 34 * s
        s *= 0.83
    return lots


def _person(cr, x, foot, ph, rgb):
    """One person standing on their own doorstep, feet at (x, foot)."""
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((34, 30, 36)))
    cr.set_line_width(max(3, 0.09 * ph))
    cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
    hip = foot - 0.45 * ph
    cr.move_to(x - 0.05 * ph, hip)
    cr.line_to(x - 0.07 * ph, foot)
    cr.move_to(x + 0.05 * ph, hip)
    cr.line_to(x + 0.07 * ph, foot)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.move_to(x - 0.15 * ph, hip + 0.04 * ph)
    cr.curve_to(x - 0.17 * ph, foot - 0.84 * ph, x + 0.17 * ph, foot - 0.84 * ph,
                x + 0.15 * ph, hip + 0.04 * ph)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, rgb)
    disc(cr, x, foot - 0.88 * ph, 0.1 * ph, (226, 186, 152))


def _house(cr, lot, rgb, coat, dy=0.0):
    w, wall, x0 = lot["w"], lot["wall"], lot["x0"]
    base = lot["base"] + dy
    b = building(cr, x0, lot["x1"], base, wall, rgb, roof_rgb=(92, 96, 108),
                 roof="gable", depth=0.28 * w, boards=False)
    top = b["top"]
    # the front door, and the one person who lives here standing at it
    dx0, dw, dh = x0 + 0.58 * w, 0.28 * w, 0.56 * wall
    cr.rectangle(dx0, base - dh, dw, dh)
    solid(cr, (120, 70, 52), rim=False)
    # the window: lamplight, one chair, nobody else
    wx0, wx1 = x0 + 0.1 * w, x0 + 0.48 * w
    wy0, wy1 = top + 0.16 * wall, top + 0.6 * wall
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(wx0, wy0, wx1 - wx0, wy1 - wy0)
    cr.clip()
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (252, 220, 150)), (1, (214, 160, 96))], wy0, wy1, wx0, wx1)
    cr.rectangle(wx0 + 0.25 * (wx1 - wx0), wy1 - 0.3 * (wy1 - wy0),
                 0.4 * (wx1 - wx0), 0.3 * (wy1 - wy0))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 80, 60)))
    cr.fill()
    cr.restore()
    cr.rectangle(wx0, wy0, wx1 - wx0, wy1 - wy0)
    edge(cr, (60, 50, 44), width=max(2, 5 * lot["s"]))
    _person(cr, dx0 + dw / 2, base + 4, 0.62 * wall, coat)


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a street of houses packed lot to lot
    SUBSTANCE: one person per house
    CAUSE: Data places a whole new house onto each empty lot for one more person living alone
    The closing: one street, and every house on it holds ONE person, standing
    alone at their own front door. In 1960 four such homes stand on it with
    empty lots between them; Data works down the street from the far end,
    setting a whole new house down onto each empty lot, each with one more
    person at its door, until the share has more than doubled to 2022's and
    there is not one empty lot left: every person alone needs a whole home,
    and the street is full. Done by 0.52 and held; a truck keeps rolling down
    the road and Data holds the street's last house steady."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    v0 = v0 or 1.0
    ratio = v1 / v0
    N0 = 4
    N1 = int(max(N0 + 1, min(10, round(N0 * ratio))))
    lots = _lots(N1)
    first = sorted({int(round(i * (N1 - 1) / (N0 - 1))) for i in range(N0)})
    new = [j for j in reversed(range(N1)) if j not in first]   # far lot first
    m = len(new)
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.52
    span = (a1 - a0) / m
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, m - 0.001))
    d = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    done = u >= a1

    def drop_of(j):
        if j in first:
            return 1.0
        i = new.index(j)
        if u < a0 or i > k:
            return 0.0
        if i < k:
            return 1.0
        return clamp(seg(d, 0.0, 0.6))

    landscape(cr, t, "town", horizon=1120)
    haze(cr, 800, 1200, (216, 208, 198), a=0.35)
    # the sidewalk the street of homes fronts onto
    cr.rectangle(0, 1460, W, 72)
    solid(cr, (196, 190, 180), edge=False, rim=False)

    walls = [(214, 198, 172), (178, 196, 208), (220, 204, 168), (196, 176, 188),
             (176, 192, 164)]
    coats = [(170, 70, 60), (70, 110, 160), (210, 160, 70), (110, 140, 90),
             (150, 90, 150)]
    for j in reversed(range(N1)):
        lot = lots[j]
        p = drop_of(j)
        # the bare lot: trodden dirt where a house will have to go
        cr.move_to(lot["x0"] - 6, lot["base"] + 4)
        cr.line_to(lot["x1"] + 6, lot["base"] + 4)
        cr.line_to(lot["x1"] + 6 + 0.28 * lot["w"], lot["base"] - 0.2 * lot["w"])
        cr.line_to(lot["x0"] - 6 + 0.28 * lot["w"], lot["base"] - 0.2 * lot["w"])
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (164, 134, 96), edge=False)
        if p <= 0:
            continue
        sh = clamp((p - 0.6) / 0.4) if j not in first else 1.0
        if sh > 0:
            cast_shadow(cr, lot["x0"], lot["x1"], lot["base"], length=200 * lot["s"],
                        a=0.28 * sh)
            contact_shadow(cr, (lot["x0"] + lot["x1"]) / 2, lot["base"] + 4,
                           lot["w"] * 1.1, a=0.35 * sh)
        dy = -(1.0 - pop(p)) * 520 * lot["s"]
        _house(cr, lot, walls[j % 5], coats[j % 5], dy)

    # the road by the camera, a truck rolling down it
    cr.rectangle(0, 1530, W, 120)
    solid(cr, (78, 80, 86), edge=False, rim=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 220, 150)))
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    for i in range(7):
        cr.move_to(i * 180 + 20, 1592)
        cr.line_to(i * 180 + 110, 1592)
    cr.stroke()
    tx = -220 + (t * 380) % 1560
    truck(cr, tx, 1630, 2.2)
    # right by the camera: a single mailbox on its post
    contact_shadow(cr, 960, 1880, 120, a=0.4)
    cr.rectangle(950, 1720, 22, 160)
    solid(cr, (110, 84, 60))
    box(cr, 900, 1730, 120, 70, (60, 90, 120), finish="metal")
    foreground(cr, "town", y0=1660)
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data works down the street, setting a house onto each empty lot
    def lot_x(j):
        return (lots[j]["x0"] + lots[j]["x1"]) / 2 + 0.14 * lots[j]["w"]
    hy, hh = 1505, 220
    if u < a0:
        hx = lot_x(new[0]) - 60
        host("point", hx, hy, hh)
    elif not done:
        hx = lot_x(new[k])
        if k + 1 < m:
            hx += (lot_x(new[k + 1]) - hx) * ease(seg(d, 0.6, 1.0))
        host("place", hx, hy, hh, beat=k)
    elif u < 0.88:
        hx = lot_x(new[-1])
        host("hold_up", hx, hy, hh)
    else:
        hx = lot_x(new[-1])
        host("think", hx, hy, hh)

    # text last, clear of Data
    lab, val = (l1, v1) if done else (l0, v0)
    fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(val))}%", f"of US homes hold one person · {lab}",
                80, 690, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=120)
    if done:
        al = ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.05))
        text(cr, f"{ratio:.1f}x", W - 80, 830, 90, look.INK, face="display",
             anchor="right", alpha=al)
        text(cr, f"{l0}'s share", W - 80, 880, 34, look.INK, anchor="right", alpha=al)

# scene standard: 2026-10-16.1
def _qb(p0, c, p1, s):
    return ((1 - s) ** 2 * p0[0] + 2 * (1 - s) * s * c[0] + s * s * p1[0],
            (1 - s) ** 2 * p0[1] + 2 * (1 - s) * s * c[1] + s * s * p1[1])


def _cloud_shapes(cx, base, h, hw, t):
    # one billowing cloud of gas: a crown of lobes over a flat-ish belly
    r = 0.24 * hw
    top, low = [], []
    m = 7
    for j in range(m):
        d = -0.8 + 1.6 * j / (m - 1)
        ph = h * (1 - 0.5 * (d / 0.8) ** 2)
        rr = r * (1 + 0.14 * (1 - abs(d) / 0.8)) + 5 * math.sin(t * 1.1 + j * 1.7)
        top.append((cx + hw * d, base - ph + rr, rr))
    for j in range(5):
        d = -0.7 + 1.4 * j / 4
        low.append((cx + hw * d, base - 0.5 * r, 0.7 * r + 3 * math.sin(t * 0.9 + j)))
    return top, low, r


def _cloud_path(cr, top, low, r, base):
    cr.new_path()
    for x, y, rr in top + low:
        cr.new_sub_path()
        cr.arc(x, y, rr, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.new_sub_path()
    cr.move_to(top[0][0], top[0][1])
    for x, y, _ in top[1:]:
        cr.line_to(x, y)
    cr.line_to(top[-1][0], base - 0.5 * r)
    cr.line_to(top[0][0], base - 0.5 * r)
    cr.close_path()


def _gas_cloud(cr, cx, base, h, hw, t):
    top, low, r = _cloud_shapes(cx, base, h, hw, t)
    # ink the outer border only: stroke every lobe, then fill over the seams
    _cloud_path(cr, top, low, r, base)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((84, 84, 74), 0.85))
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    cr.stroke()
    _cloud_path(cr, top, low, r, base)
    g = cairo.LinearGradient(0, base - h, 0, base)

def _holstein(cr, ang):
    """A big black-and-white cow in three-quarter view, facing left; returns its mouth."""
    PX, PY = 420.0, 1140.0
    GY = 1445
    # legs: far pair darker, near pair lit, hooves dark
    for lx, col in ((470, (196, 192, 184)), (815, (196, 192, 184)),
                    (515, (238, 234, 226)), (780, (238, 234, 226))):
        cr.new_path()

        solid(cr, col)

    cr.move_to(882, 1110)

    def body():

        cr.curve_to(905, 1085, 910, 1180, 882, 1262)
        cr.curve_to(760, 1292, 560, 1292, 450, 1278)

    for bx, by, br in ((610, 1150, 74), (800, 1168, 58), (480, 1232, 42), (700, 1268, 34)):

    # udder

    cr.translate(742, 1288)
    cr.scale(1.4, 0.8)

    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (228, 166, 166))

    # the head, on its neck pivot: it dips to the trough and lifts to belch
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(PX, PY)

    cr.translate(-22, -54)

    def head():

    head()

    cr.clip()
    cr.new_path()
    cr.arc(-70, -26, 48, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    solid(cr, (36, 34, 38), edge=False, rim=False)

    head()
    edge(cr, (40, 36, 34))

    cr.arc(-198, 34, 5, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()
    cr.restore()
    ca, sa = math.cos(ang), math.sin(ang)
    return (PX + (-200) * ca - 58 * sa, PY + (-200) * sa + 58 * ca)


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a cow belching a gas cloud
    SUBSTANCE: grey methane gas
    CAUSE: Data pours feed into the cow's trough; it eats and belches more gas into the swelling cloud
    One big Holstein at her trough on a farm field, a grey cloud of the gas
    she belches hanging over her back, fed by a plume from her mouth. Each
    bucket Data pours, she dips to eat, lifts her head and belches a puff
    up the plume, and the cloud swells. Its height is the tonnage: 2015's
    6.2 billion tons is marked on it where its top stood, and it grows to
    2050's projected 9.1 — about one and a half times as tall. Done by 0.6
    and held; she keeps eating and belching, Data keeps pouring."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    v0 = v0 or 1.0
    ratio = v1 / v0
    y0 = l0.split()[0]
    n = 3
    a0, a1 = 0.12, 0.6
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    grow = ease(seg(f, 0.55, 0.9))
    step = 0.0 if u < a0 else (k + grow) / n
    val = v0 + (v1 - v0) * step

    # the feeding cycle: pour, eat, belch — after it lands it keeps going
    if u < a0:
        cyc, pour_k = -1.0, 0
    elif u < a1:
        cyc, pour_k = f, k
    else:
        q = (u - a1) / 0.12
        cyc, pour_k = q % 1.0, n + int(q)
    if cyc < 0:
        pf = eat = bp = 0.0
    else:
        pf = seg(cyc, 0.0, 0.3)
        eat = ease(seg(cyc, 0.2, 0.4)) * (1 - ease(seg(cyc, 0.45, 0.6)))
        bp = seg(cyc, 0.5, 0.85)
    lift = math.sin(math.pi * bp) if 0 < bp < 1 else 0.0
    ang = -1.0 * eat + 0.14 * lift

    CX, BASE = 600, 1040
    H0 = 270.0
    h = H0 * val / v0
    hw = 300 + 0.15 * h

    landscape(cr, t, "field")
    birds(cr, t, y0=760, n=3, rgb=(60, 60, 70))
    # the rest of the herd grazing far off
    for i, (bx, by) in enumerate(((90, 1190), (250, 1200), (930, 1195), (1030, 1185))):
        contact_shadow(cr, bx, by + 18, 70, a=0.25)
        cow(cr, bx, by, 0.75, t + i)
    haze(cr, 700, 1215, (214, 206, 190), a=0.3)

    # THE GAS: one cloud over her back
    _gas_cloud(cr, CX, BASE, h, hw, t)
    if step > 0.02:
        then_mark(cr, CX - 170, CX + 170, BASE - H0, y0)

    # the cow and her trough
    cast_shadow(cr, 400, 900, 1445, length=300, a=0.28)
    contact_shadow(cr, 650, 1450, 540, a=0.4)
    contact_shadow(cr, 320, 1452, 280, a=0.35)
    box(cr, 200, 1450, 240, 58, (138, 98, 62), depth=50)
    lv = 14 + 26 * pf - 20 * eat
    heap_path(cr, 330, 1394, lv, 100)
    solid(cr, (214, 176, 90))
    mx, my = _holstein(cr, ang)

    # the plume from her mouth into the cloud, a puff riding it on each belch
    E = (CX - 0.5 * hw, BASE - 10)
    C = (mx - 30, (my + E[1]) / 2 - 60)
    pts_ = []
    for i in range(18):
        s = i / 17
        x, y = _qb((mx, my), C, E, s)
        pts_.append((x + 12 * math.sin(t * 2.0 + s * 6) * s, y))
    base_a = 0.35 + 0.3 * lift
    for i in range(len(pts_) - 1):
        s = i / 17
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((140, 138, 122), base_a))
        cr.set_line_width(14 + 54 * s)
        cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
        cr.move_to(*pts_[i])
        cr.line_to(*pts_[i + 1])
        cr.stroke()
    if 0 < bp < 1:
        px, py = _qb((mx, my), C, E, ease(bp))
        glow(cr, px, py, 60 + 50 * bp, (96, 96, 84), 0.85 * (1 - 0.4 * bp))

    # right by the camera: a feed sack and a bucket in the grass
    contact_shadow(cr, 900, 1770, 240, a=0.35)
    sack(cr, 900, 1760, 2.2, label=False)
    contact_shadow(cr, 110, 1830, 170, a=0.35)
    cylinder(cr, 40, 1830, 140, 120, (150, 156, 166), finish="metal")
    foreground(cr, "field")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data walks up to the trough and pours the feed in
    hx = 480 + (120 - 480) * ease(seg(u, 0.02, 0.11))
    hy = 1500
    if 0.05 < pf < 0.32 and cyc >= 0:
        sa = clamp((pf - 0.05) / 0.1) * clamp((0.32 - pf) / 0.06)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((214, 176, 90), 0.9 * sa))
        cr.set_line_width(12)
        cr.move_to(hx + 85, 1300)
        cr.curve_to(hx + 100, 1330, hx + 110, 1360, hx + 115, 1392 - lv * 0.5)
        cr.stroke()
    if u < a0:
        host("point", hx, hy, 220)
    elif u < 0.92:
        host("pour", hx, hy, 220, beat=pour_k)
    else:
        host("shock", hx, hy, 220)

    done = u >= a0 and k == n - 1 and grow >= 0.999
    if done:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{v1:.1f}B tons", f"greenhouse gas from farm animals a year · {l1}",
                    80, 520, size=130)
        text(cr, f"{ratio:.1f}x", W - 80, 650, 90, look.INK, face="display",
             anchor="right", alpha=ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.05)))
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{v0:.1f}B tons", f"greenhouse gas from farm animals a year · {l0}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

# scene standard: 2026-10-16.1
def _gas_cloud_path(cr, x0, x1, base, hgt, grow=1.0, seed=0):
    # ONE billowing body of gas as a single path: a flat underside and a row
    # of overlapping billows along its top, all wound the same way so they
    # fill as one lit shape instead of a heap of separate balls
    w = x1 - x0
    n = max(2, int(w / 80))
    g = 0.35 + 0.65 * grow
    body = hgt * 0.38 * g
    cr.new_path()
    cr.rectangle(x0, base - body, w, body)
    for i in range(n):
        q = (i + 0.5) / n
        bx = x0 + w * q
        r = hgt * (0.40 + 0.16 * (((i + seed) * 0.618) % 1.0)) * g
        by = base - body - r * 0.35 - hgt * 0.14 * math.sin(math.pi * q) * grow
        cr.new_sub_path()
        cr.arc(bx, by, r, 0, 2 * math.pi)


def _gas_blob(cr, x0, x1, base, hgt, rgb, a=1.0, grow=1.0, seed=0, accent=None):
    if x1 - x0 < 4 or grow <= 0:
        return
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(x0, 0, x1 - x0, base + 2)
    cr.clip()
    _gas_cloud_path(cr, x0, x1, base, hgt, grow, seed)
    solid(cr, rgb, a=a)
    if accent is not None:
        _gas_cloud_path(cr, x0, x1, base, hgt, grow, seed)
        edge(cr, accent, width=9, a=0.95)
    cr.restore()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a red cattle barn with its door open
    SUBSTANCE: grey methane gas
    CAUSE: Data drags the barn's sliding door open with his hands and the herd's gas billows out into the sky
    One cloud of human-caused methane hangs over the farm, cut at the true
    shares: the sooty fossil-fuel part over the refinery's flare on the far
    left, waste and rice to the right, and a gap where livestock's part
    belongs. Data grips the barn's sliding door by its handle and drags it
    open, tug by tug; with every tug more of the herd's gas pours out of the
    doorway, rolls up the barn front and swells into the gap, until the
    cloud is whole: livestock's part nearly as wide as fossil fuels', wider
    than waste's. Lands by 0.62 and holds; the herd keeps breathing gas out
    of the open door and Data keeps his hands on it."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    L = next((r for r in rows if "livestock" in r[0].lower()), None)
    if L is None:
        L = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: -r[1])[min(1, len(rows) - 1)]
    others = sorted([r for r in rows if r is not L], key=lambda r: -r[1])
    order = others[:1] + [L] + others[1:]
    tot = sum(v for _, v in order) or 1.0
    vmax = max(v for _, v in order) or 1.0

    # four decisive tugs, each lands then holds, all done by a1
    a0, a1, TUGS = 0.08, 0.62, 4
    span = (a1 - a0) / TUGS
    if u < a0:
        op = 0.0
    else:
        k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, TUGS - 0.001))
        f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
        op = (k + ease(seg(f, 0.0, 0.55))) / TUGS
    op = clamp(op)

    # the whole cloud, high in the sky over the barn, cut at the shares
    CX0, CX1, CB, CHT = 40.0, 1040.0, 870.0, 220.0
    slots = []
    x = CX0
    for r in order:
        xb = x + (CX1 - CX0) * r[1] / tot
        slots.append((r, x, xb))
        x = xb
    li = [s for s in slots if s[0] is L][0]
    lxa, lxb = li[1], li[2]

    gy = landscape(cr, t, "field") or 1170
    # far sources on the horizon: the refinery's flare stack, the landfill
    fx = 120
    contact_shadow(cr, fx, gy + 26, 120, a=0.25)
    cylinder(cr, fx - 80, gy + 24, 60, 70, (170, 170, 168), finish="metal")
    cylinder(cr, fx - 14, gy + 26, 28, 230, (150, 152, 158), finish="metal")
    glow(cr, fx, gy - 216, 50, (255, 170, 60), 0.9)
    disc(cr, fx, gy - 220, 12, (255, 206, 96), finish="gloss")
    lx = (slots[2][1] + slots[2][2]) / 2 if len(slots) > 2 else 900
    heap_path(cr, lx + 60, gy + 30, 70, 120)
    solid(cr, (130, 116, 96))
    haze(cr, 940, gy + 40, (214, 210, 204), a=0.35)

    # trails rising from the far sources into their parts of the cloud
    for j, (r, xa, xb) in enumerate(slots):
        if r is L:
            continue
        sx = fx if j == 0 else lx + 60
        sy = gy - 220 if j == 0 else gy - 20
        ex = (xa + xb) / 2
        for i in range(5):
            ph = (t * 0.32 + i / 5 + j * 0.13) % 1.0
            px = sx + (ex - sx) * ph + 14 * math.sin(ph * 6 + j)
            py = sy - ph * (sy - CB + 30)
            cr.new_path()
            cr.arc(px, py, 12 + 26 * ph, 0, 2 * math.pi)
            solid(cr, (150, 152, 158), a=0.6 * (1 - ph) * min(1.0, ph * 5),
                  edge=False)

    # THE WHOLE: one cloud of human-caused methane
    for j, (r, xa, xb) in enumerate(slots):
        if r is L:
            continue
        rgb = (104, 106, 112) if j == 0 else (172, 174, 180)
        _gas_blob(cr, xa + 2, xb - 2, CB, CHT * (0.6 + 0.4 * r[1] / vmax),
                  rgb, seed=j * 3)
    if op > 0:
        # the herd's gas fills its gap; the accent outlines the share, the
        # gas itself stays gas-grey
        _gas_blob(cr, lxa + 2, lxb - 2, CB, CHT * (0.6 + 0.4 * L[1] / vmax),
                  (196, 198, 204), grow=op, seed=7, accent=P["accent2"])
    # what each part is, written on its own part of the cloud
    for j, (r, xa, xb) in enumerate(slots):
        if xb - xa < 150:
            continue
        if r is L and op < 0.999:
            continue
        lab = r[0].upper()
        text(cr, lab, (xa + xb) / 2, CB - 34, fit_size(cr, lab, 32, xb - xa - 30),
             look.INK, face="bold", anchor="center")

    # the barn, three-quarter, its long shadow, its peak just under the cloud
    BX0, BX1, BASE = 210.0, 810.0, 1440.0
    cast_shadow(cr, BX0, BX1, BASE, length=300, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, (BX0 + BX1) / 2, BASE + 2, BX1 - BX0 + 60, a=0.4)
    b = building(cr, BX0, BX1, BASE, 220, (196, 56, 42), roof="gambrel")
    rx = (b["x0"] + b["x1"]) / 2
    hl_y = b["top"] - 130
    cr.rectangle(rx - 45, hl_y, 90, 90)
    solid(cr, (150, 36, 30), rim=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((244, 238, 226)))
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    cr.rectangle(rx - 45, hl_y, 90, 90)
    cr.move_to(rx - 45, hl_y)
    cr.line_to(rx + 45, hl_y + 90)
    cr.move_to(rx + 45, hl_y)
    cr.line_to(rx - 45, hl_y + 90)
    cr.stroke()

    # the doorway: the herd inside, dark straw-lit stalls
    DX0, DX1 = BX0 + 60, BX0 + 320
    DY = max(b["top"] + 30, 1240.0)
    dw = DX1 - DX0
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(DX0, DY, dw, BASE - DY)
    cr.clip()
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (40, 30, 24)), (1, (96, 72, 46))], DY, BASE, DX0, DX1)
    glow(cr, (DX0 + DX1) / 2, BASE, 200, (230, 180, 110), 0.3)
    cow(cr, DX0 + 80, BASE - 26, 1.0, t)
    cow(cr, DX0 + 190, BASE - 14, 1.05, t + 2.1)
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((244, 238, 226)))
    cr.set_line_width(12)
    cr.rectangle(DX0, DY, dw, BASE - DY)
    cr.stroke()

    # the herd's gas pours out of the open doorway, up the barn front and
    # over the roof into its part of the cloud — a thick, opaque plume
    flow = op if u < a1 else 0.85
    if flow > 0.02:
        gap = dw * max(op, 0.15)
        for i in range(14):
            ph = (t * 0.5 + i / 14) % 1.0
            sx = DX0 + gap * (0.25 + 0.5 * ((i * 0.618) % 1.0))
            ex = lxa + (lxb - lxa) * (0.25 + 0.5 * ((i * 0.37) % 1.0))
            px = sx + (ex - sx) * ease(ph) + 20 * math.sin(ph * 6 + i)
            py = DY + 40 - ph * (DY + 40 - CB + 60)
            rr = 34 + 56 * ph
            cr.new_path()
            cr.arc(px, py, rr, 0, 2 * math.pi)
            solid(cr, (212, 214, 220),
                  a=flow * 0.92 * (1 - ph ** 3) * min(1.0, ph * 6), edge=False)

    # the sliding door on its track, dragged right off the doorway
    dx = DX0 + dw * op
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((46, 44, 48)))
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    cr.move_to(DX0 - 20, DY - 18)
    cr.line_to(DX1 + dw + 20, DY - 18)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.rectangle(dx, DY - 8, dw, BASE - DY + 8)
    solid(cr, (182, 48, 38))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((244, 238, 226)))
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    cr.rectangle(dx + 12, DY + 6, dw - 24, BASE - DY - 18)
    cr.move_to(dx + 12, DY + 6)
    cr.line_to(dx + dw - 12, BASE - 12)
    cr.move_to(dx + dw - 12, DY + 6)
    cr.line_to(dx + 12, BASE - 12)
    cr.stroke()
    for wx in (dx + 40, dx + dw - 40):
        disc(cr, wx, DY - 18, 11, (70, 70, 76), finish="metal")
    # the handle on its leading edge, where his hands go
    hx_ = dx + dw - 6
    cr.rectangle(hx_ - 8, 1290, 16, 90)
    solid(cr, (60, 60, 66), finish="metal")

    # right by the camera: the rest of the herd in the yard
    cow(cr, 160, 1700, 1.5, t + 0.7)
    cow(cr, 900, 1800, 1.7, t + 1.6)
    foreground(cr, "field")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data: walks up to the door's edge, grips the handle, drags it open
    # tug by tug, keeps hold while the gas pours out, then reacts
    fy, hh = 1452.0, 240.0
    hands = [(hx_, 1302.0), (hx_, 1362.0)]
    gx = hx_ + 62
    if u < a0:
        host("point", gx + 120 * (1 - u / a0), fy, hh)
    elif u < 0.9:
        host("grip", gx, fy, hh, hands=hands,
             lower="brace" if u < a1 else "stand",
             expr="strain" if u < a1 else "happy")
    else:
        host("shock", gx, fy, hh)

    if op >= 0.999:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(L[1]))}%",
                    f"of human-caused methane is from {L[0].lower()}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.04)), size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Methane", "the human-made share, by source",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

def _jar_path(cr, x0, x1, base, top):
    r = (x1 - x0) / 2.0
    cr.move_to(x0, base)
    cr.line_to(x0, top + r)
    cr.arc((x0 + x1) / 2.0, top + r, r, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.line_to(x1, base)
    cr.close_path()


def _bell_jar(cr, t, x0, x1, base, top, heat, gas, conv):
    """A glass bell jar on a metal plate, a thermometer inside, the trapped
    heat filling it from the floor up as a glowing orange-red body."""
    cx = (x0 + x1) / 2.0
    w = x1 - x0
    contact_shadow(cr, cx, base + 22, w + 80, a=0.4)
    box(cr, x0 - 26, base + 20, w + 52, 20, (128, 132, 140), finish="metal")
    hin = 0.92 * (base - top - 24)
    lvl = base - hin * heat
    cr.save()
    _jar_path(cr, x0, x1, base, top)
    cr.clip()
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (222, 236, 242)), (0.6, (196, 214, 222)), (1, (168, 188, 198))],
          top, base, x0, x1)
    # the far wall of the glass seen through the near one: a curved floor seam
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(cx, base - 8)
    cr.scale(1, 0.12)
    cr.arc(0, 0, w / 2.0 - 6, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 140, 150), 0.6))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    cr.stroke()
    if heat > 0.0005:
        amp = min(16.0, 2.0 + hin * heat * 0.05)
        cr.save()
        cr.move_to(x0, base)
        for i in range(25):
            xx = x0 + w * i / 24.0
            cr.line_to(xx, lvl + amp * math.sin(xx * 0.025 + t * 2.4))
        cr.line_to(x1, base)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.clip()
        vgrad(cr, [(0, (255, 210, 100)), (0.45, (244, 128, 50)), (1, (190, 40, 26))],
              lvl - 20, base, x0, x1)
        glow(cr, cx, base, w * 0.7, (255, 190, 90), 0.35 * conv)
        # the heat churns inside the glass: bright convection bands rising
        depth = max(1.0, base - lvl)
        if depth > 60:
            for j in range(3):
                yy = base - ((t * 110 + j * depth / 3.0) % depth)
                cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 236, 150), 0.55 * conv))
                cr.set_line_width(16)
                cr.move_to(x0, yy)
                for i in range(13):
                    xx = x0 + w * i / 12.0
                    cr.line_to(xx, yy + 12 * math.sin(xx * 0.03 + t * 3 + j))
                cr.stroke()
        cr.restore()
    # the gas curling in from the hose at the jar's lower left
    if gas > 0:
        for i in range(5):
            ph = (t * 0.3 + i / 5.0) % 1.0
            gy = base - 40 - (base - top - 160) * ph * gas
            gx = x0 + 40 + (w - 160) * ph * (0.5 + 0.4 * math.sin(i * 2.1 + t * 0.6))
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((240, 244, 232), 0.16 * gas * (1 - ph)))
            cr.arc(gx, gy, 30 + 70 * ph, 0, 2 * math.pi)
            cr.fill()
    # thermometer on the right inner wall
    tx = x1 - 56
    t_top, t_bot = top + w / 2.0 - 10, base - 70
    cr.rectangle(tx - 16, t_top, 32, t_bot - t_top)
    solid(cr, (240, 242, 244), finish="gloss")
    mt = t_bot - (t_bot - t_top - 12) * heat
    cr.rectangle(tx - 7, mt, 14, t_bot - mt + 6)
    solid(cr, (206, 36, 30), rim=False, edge=False)
    disc(cr, tx, base - 46, 28, (206, 36, 30), finish="gloss")
    for i in range(9):
        yy = t_bot - (t_bot - t_top - 12) * i / 8.0
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 44, 52)))
        cr.set_line_width(3)
        cr.move_to(tx - 16, yy)
        cr.line_to(tx - 4, yy)
        cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()
    # the glass itself: a long highlight on the lit side, a rim, an ink edge
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 255, 255), 0.55))
    cr.set_line_width(16)
    cr.move_to(x0 + 36, base - 50)
    cr.line_to(x0 + 36, top + w / 2.0)
    cr.arc_negative(cx, top + w / 2.0, w / 2.0 - 36, math.pi, math.pi * 1.32)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 255, 255), 0.25))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    cr.move_to(x0 + 66, base - 80)
    cr.line_to(x0 + 66, top + w / 2.0 + 20)
    cr.stroke()
    _jar_path(cr, x0, x1, base, top)
    edge(cr, (40, 52, 62))
    cr.rectangle(cx - 8, top - 22, 16, 26)
    solid(cr, (130, 150, 158), finish="metal")
    disc(cr, cx, top - 26, 24, (170, 190, 198), finish="gloss")
    return lvl


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: two glass jars heating in the sun
    SUBSTANCE: trapped heat, glowing orange
    CAUSE: Data turns the gas valve and methane pours into the right jar, whose trapped heat climbs far past the carbon dioxide jar
    The classic greenhouse demonstration on a farm table: two identical bell
    jars in the low sun, carbon dioxide in the left, and Data opening the
    valve of a gas cylinder that fills the right one with methane. The heat
    each traps fills its jar from the floor up, the same scale in both: the
    carbon dioxide jar holds a sliver, the methane jar climbs to the top —
    the ratio is the two heights. Done by 0.62, then held while the heat
    churns and Data keeps working the valve. The jars stand on a raised
    table so Data, on the ground in front, never covers them; the jar names
    sit high inside the glass and are drawn after him."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    hi_l, hi = max(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    lo_l, lo = min(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    hi = hi or 1.0
    ratio = hi / (lo or 1.0)

    co2_grow = ease(seg(u, 0.02, 0.14))
    gas = ease(seg(u, 0.2, 0.42))
    heat = ease(seg(u, 0.28, 0.62))
    landed_ = u >= 0.62

    landscape(cr, t, "field")
    birds(cr, t, y0=720, n=4, rgb=(60, 60, 70))
    # the farm the herd lives on, far behind under haze
    building(cr, 420, 640, 1176, 150, (186, 58, 44), roof="gambrel", boards=False)
    haze(cr, 900, 1180, (226, 220, 206), a=0.45)

    # the farm table the experiment stands on: a thick top on four legs
    GROUND = 1500
    cast_shadow(cr, 10, 1060, GROUND - 6, length=280, a=0.26)
    contact_shadow(cr, 540, GROUND - 4, 1060, a=0.35)
    for lx in (40, 240, 820, 1000):
        box(cr, lx, GROUND - 6, 36, GROUND - 6 - 1320, (118, 82, 50), depth=10)
    box(cr, 10, 1324, 1040, 66, (162, 116, 72), depth=34)
    for i in range(1, 6):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((110, 76, 46), 0.6))
        cr.set_line_width(3)
        cr.move_to(10 + i * 173, 1262)
        cr.line_to(10 + i * 173, 1322)
        cr.stroke()

    BASE, TOP = 1238, 660
    _bell_jar(cr, t, 30, 420, BASE, TOP, co2_grow * (lo / hi), 0.0, 0.0)
    _bell_jar(cr, t, 640, 1040, BASE, TOP, heat, gas, clamp(heat * 3))

    # the gas cylinder on the ground in front, its hose up into the methane jar
    CX0, CW, CH = 470, 104, 196
    vy = GROUND - CH - 22
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((34, 36, 40)))
    cr.set_line_width(18)
    cr.move_to(CX0 + CW / 2 + 10, vy)
    cr.curve_to(600, vy - 90, 630, 1180, 664, 1210)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((110, 116, 124)))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    cr.move_to(CX0 + CW / 2 + 8, vy - 3)
    cr.curve_to(598, vy - 93, 628, 1177, 662, 1207)
    cr.stroke()
    contact_shadow(cr, CX0 + CW / 2, GROUND + 2, 150, a=0.5)
    cylinder(cr, CX0, GROUND, CW, CH, (226, 184, 52), finish="metal")
    cr.rectangle(CX0 + CW / 2 - 13, vy, 26, 26)
    solid(cr, (120, 124, 132), finish="metal")
    # the handwheel: it turns as he opens it
    wx, wy = CX0 + CW / 2, vy - 4
    disc(cr, wx, wy, 26, (196, 40, 34), finish="gloss")
    vang = gas * math.pi * 3 + (0.0 if u < 0.62 else 0.6 * math.sin((u - 0.62) * 30))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 22, 20)))
    cr.set_line_width(7)
    for q in range(2):
        a_ = vang + q * math.pi / 2
        cr.move_to(wx - 22 * math.cos(a_), wy - 22 * math.sin(a_))
        cr.line_to(wx + 22 * math.cos(a_), wy + 22 * math.sin(a_))
    cr.stroke()

    # right by the camera: the herd whose belches this is about
    cow(cr, 120, 1800, 2.6, t)
    cow(cr, 930, 1860, 2.9, t + 1.3)
    foreground(cr, "field")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data: points up at the CO2 jar's sliver, walks to the cylinder, works its valve
    hx = 200 + 210 * ease(seg(u, 0.07, 0.2))
    if u < 0.2:
        host("point", hx, GROUND, 236)
    elif u < 0.92:
        k = 0 if u < 0.62 else 1 + int((u - 0.62) / 0.1)
        host("tap", hx, GROUND, 236, beat=k)
    else:
        host("shock", hx, GROUND, 236)

    # the jar names, high in the glass and drawn after Data, clear of him
    text(cr, "CO2", 225, 880, 48, look.INK, face="bold", anchor="center")
    text(cr, "METHANE", 840, 880, 48, look.INK, face="bold", anchor="center")
    if co2_grow > 0.99:
        text(cr, "1x", 225, 1040, 64, look.INK, face="display", anchor="center",
             alpha=ease(seg(u, 0.14, 0.2)))

    if landed_:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(ratio))}x", "the heat methane traps vs carbon dioxide · 20 years",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.62, 0.66)), size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Methane vs CO2", "heat trapped over 20 years",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

stories.title: Mail Nearly Halved While The Stamp Price More Than Doubled
stories.hook: Mailing a letter cost 68 cents even as mail volume nearly halved.
stories.closing: Less mail does not mean cheaper postage; a thinning mailbox can still come with rising costs.
stories.question: What still makes you buy a stamp?
stories.caption: In 2006, the US Postal Service delivered 213 billion pieces of mail. Today it's barely half that -- even as a stamp's price doubled. Here's where all the mail went. 👇

segments.say: Total mail volume fell to 109 billion pieces in the supplied latest year. The peak was nearly twice as high.
segments.illustrated_scene:
# scene standard: 2026-10-16.2
def _arch(cr, x, yb, w, wl):
    # a mailbox's end: straight sides, a round dome over them
    cr.move_to(x, yb)
    cr.line_to(x, yb - wl)
    cr.arc(x + w / 2, yb - wl, w / 2, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.line_to(x + w, yb)
    cr.close_path()


def _letter(cr, cx, cy, w, h, ang, a=1.0):
    # one white envelope: paper, its flap, a red stamp
    if a <= 0.01:
        return
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(cx, cy)
    cr.rotate(ang)
    cr.rectangle(-w / 2, -h / 2, w, h)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (248, 245, 236), a=a)
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(cx, cy)
    cr.rotate(ang)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 140, 124), 0.9 * a))
    cr.set_line_width(max(2.0, w * 0.04))
    cr.move_to(-w / 2 + 2, -h / 2 + 2)
    cr.line_to(0, h * 0.08)
    cr.line_to(w / 2 - 2, -h / 2 + 2)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.rectangle(w / 2 - w * 0.24, -h / 2 + h * 0.12, w * 0.16, h * 0.26)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((200, 50, 42), a))
    cr.fill()
    cr.restore()


def _mailbox(cr, x, y, s, c):
    # a curbside mailbox on its post, its door end facing the street;
    # c = 0 the door hangs open on a mouth stuffed with letters, flag up,
    # c = 1 the letters are out, the door is shut, the flag is down
    contact_shadow(cr, x + 34 * s, y, 74 * s, a=0.35)
    box(cr, x + 16 * s, y, 14 * s, 62 * s, (124, 92, 60), depth=6 * s)
    yb = y - 60 * s
    w, wl = 50 * s, 30 * s
    ox, oy = 62 * s, -25 * s
    _arch(cr, x + ox, yb + oy, w, wl)
    solid(cr, (92, 96, 106), rim=False)
    top = yb - wl - w / 2
    cr.move_to(x + w / 2, top)
    cr.line_to(x + w / 2 + ox, top + oy)
    cr.line_to(x + w + ox, yb + oy)
    cr.line_to(x + w, yb)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (182, 188, 198), finish="metal")
    # the red flag on its side: up for mail, swung down when there is none
    px, py = x + w + ox * 0.55, yb + oy * 0.55 - wl * 0.35
    ang = -math.pi / 2 * (1 - ease(c))
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(px, py)
    cr.rotate(ang)
    cr.rectangle(0, -3 * s, 46 * s, 6 * s)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (150, 32, 28), rim=False)
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(px, py)
    cr.rotate(ang)
    cr.rectangle(28 * s, -2 * s, 20 * s, 16 * s)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (206, 48, 40))
    # the dark mouth
    _arch(cr, x, yb, w, wl)
    solid(cr, (30, 28, 32), rim=False, edge=False)
    # the door, hinged along the bottom, swung up and shut
    fy = -0.5 + 1.5 * ease(seg(c, 0.45, 1.0))
    if abs(fy) < 0.04:
        fy = 0.04 if fy >= 0 else -0.04
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, yb)
    cr.scale(1, fy)
    _arch(cr, 0, 0, w, wl)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (198, 204, 214) if fy > 0 else (148, 154, 164), finish="metal")
    # the letters, a fat fan of white envelopes bursting out of the mouth;
    # they come out toward the street first, then the door shuts
    out = ease(seg(c, 0.0, 0.5))
    la = 1.0 - clamp((c - 0.25) / 0.3)
    spots = ((0.22, 0.30, -0.42), (0.50, 0.46, 0.10), (0.78, 0.30, 0.46),
             (0.36, 0.64, -0.18), (0.66, 0.66, 0.30))
    if c < 1:
        for i, (dx, dy, a_) in enumerate(spots):
            lx = x + w * dx - out * (40 + 14 * i) * s
            ly = yb - (wl + w / 2) * dy - out * 26 * s
            _letter(cr, lx, ly, 34 * s, 22 * s, a_ * (1 - 0.5 * out), la)
    if c >= 1:
        disc(cr, x + w / 2, yb - wl * 0.9, 4 * s, (70, 70, 76), finish="metal")
        # the letters that used to wait here, as a ghost on the shut door
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(x + w * 0.5, yb - (wl + w / 2) * 0.42)
        cr.rotate(-0.12)
        cr.rectangle(-17 * s, -11 * s, 34 * s, 22 * s)
        cr.restore()
        ghost(cr, a=0.8)


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a street of mailboxes stuffed with letters
    SUBSTANCE: white paper letters
    CAUSE: Data pulls the letters out of each mailbox and shoves its door shut, box by box down the street
    One street's row of mailboxes running from the camera back into town:
    the WHOLE is the street's mail. In 2006 every door hangs open on a
    mouth stuffed with white letters, flag up. Data walks the curb toward
    the camera and, box by box, the letters come out and he shoves the
    door shut — flag down, no mail — until the share of the street gone
    quiet is the share of mail that is gone, about half. Each shut door
    keeps a ghost of the letter it used to hold. Done by 0.62 and held:
    he keeps shoving the last door, the mail van keeps driving by."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    v0 = v0 or 1.0
    N = 8
    nc = max(1, min(N - 1, int(round(N * (1 - v1 / v0)))))
    boxes = []
    x, y, s = 260.0, 1450.0, 2.4
    for j in range(N):
        boxes.append((x, y, s))
        x += 70 * s
        y -= 28 * s
        s *= 0.86
    a0, a1 = 0.06, 0.62
    span = (a1 - a0) / nc
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, nc - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    started = u >= a0
    done = u >= a1

    def shut(j):
        if j >= nc or not started:
            return 0.0
        if done:
            return 1.0
        q = nc - 1 - j
        if q < k:
            return 1.0
        if q > k:
            return 0.0
        return seg(f, 0.25, 0.9)

    def pos(j):
        bx, by, bs = boxes[j]
        return bx - 50 * bs, min(1495.0, by + 30), clamp(110 * bs, 180, 240)

    # the town
    landscape(cr, t, "town", horizon=1060)
    for hx0, hx1, hb, hh_, col in ((40, 330, 1130, 260, (214, 196, 170)),
                                   (380, 600, 1100, 200, (176, 190, 204)),
                                   (640, 820, 1078, 150, (206, 170, 150)),
                                   (860, 1010, 1062, 110, (190, 200, 180))):
        contact_shadow(cr, (hx0 + hx1) / 2, hb, hx1 - hx0 + 40, a=0.3)
        building(cr, hx0, hx1, hb, hh_, col, roof_rgb=(110, 96, 92), roof="gable")
    haze(cr, 600, 1150, (206, 214, 224), a=0.3)
    # the mail van doing its round on the back street
    vx = -300 + (t * 170) % 1700
    contact_shadow(cr, vx + 110, 1152, 230, a=0.3)
    box(cr, vx, 1150, 170, 92, (236, 236, 240), depth=36)
    cr.rectangle(vx + 4, 1106, 162, 12)
    solid(cr, (42, 72, 146), edge=False, rim=False)
    box(cr, vx + 170, 1150, 58, 66, (226, 228, 234), depth=30)
    for wx in (vx + 36, vx + 190):
        disc(cr, wx, 1150, 15, (40, 40, 46))

    # the street in front of the row
    cr.move_to(-50, 1576)
    cr.line_to(1130, 1104)
    cr.line_to(1130, 1194)
    cr.line_to(-50, 1976)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (84, 86, 92), edge=False, rim=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 220, 150), 0.85))
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    cr.set_dash([44, 34])
    cr.move_to(-50, 1776)
    cr.line_to(1130, 1149)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_dash([])

    # the mailboxes, far first
    cast_shadow(cr, 240, 1080, 1450, length=260, a=0.22)
    for j in reversed(range(N)):
        bx, by, bs = boxes[j]
        _mailbox(cr, bx, by, bs, shut(j))

    # right by the camera: the blue collection box on the near corner
    contact_shadow(cr, 880, 1862, 280, a=0.4)
    box(cr, 760, 1860, 220, 230, (38, 74, 150), depth=56)
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(870, 1630)
    cr.scale(1, 0.45)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 110, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (44, 82, 162))
    cr.rectangle(800, 1676, 140, 16)
    solid(cr, (24, 30, 44), rim=False)
    _letter(cr, 870, 1668, 96, 60, -0.12)
    foreground(cr, "town")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data walks the curb toward the camera, shoving each door shut
    if not started:
        hx, hy, hh = pos(nc)
        host("point", hx, hy, hh)
    elif done:
        hx, hy, hh = pos(0)
        host("shove", hx, hy, hh, beat=nc + int((u - a1) / 0.12))
    else:
        tgt, prv = nc - 1 - k, nc - k
        g = ease(seg(f, 0.0, 0.25))
        (x0, y0, h0), (x1, y1, h1) = pos(prv), pos(tgt)
        hx, hy, hh = x0 + (x1 - x0) * g, y0 + (y1 - y0) * g, h0 + (h1 - h0) * g
        host("shove", hx, hy, hh, beat=k)

    if done:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v1))} billion", f"pieces of US mail a year · {l1}",
                    80, 520, size=130)
        text(cr, "nearly half the mail, gone", 80, 720, 44, look.INK, face="bold",
             alpha=ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.05)))
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v0))} billion", f"pieces of US mail a year · {l0}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

segments.say: First-Class Mail fell to 46 billion pieces in the measured comparison. Its decline outpaced the overall mail contraction.
The stamp price reached 68 cents in the supplied historical comparison. That more than doubled the earlier price.

stories.title: The Great Lakes Hold 21% Of Earth's Fresh Surface Water
stories.hook: One Great Lake holds more water than the other four.
stories.closing: And somehow Michiganders just call it 'the lake.'
stories.question: Which Great Lake have you swum in?
stories.caption: The five Great Lakes hold 21% of all the fresh surface water on Earth -- and Lake Superior alone holds more than the other four combined. Here's how they actually stack up. 👇

segments.say: Start with the five lakes. Lake Superior alone holds about 2,900 cubic miles -- more than the other four Great Lakes combined.
segments.illustrated_scene:
# scene standard: 2026-10-16.2
def _gl_wave(x, t):
    return 4.0 * math.sin(x * 0.045 + t * 3.1)


def _gl_band(cr, x0, x1, ybot, ytop, t, wavy):
    cr.move_to(x0, ybot)
    if wavy:
        cr.line_to(x0, ytop + _gl_wave(x0, t))
        xs = x0
        while xs < x1:
            xs = min(x1, xs + 14)
            cr.line_to(xs, ytop + _gl_wave(xs, t))
    else:
        cr.line_to(x0, ytop)
        cr.line_to(x1, ytop)
    cr.line_to(x1, ybot)
    cr.close_path()


def _gl_vat(cr, cx, top, bands, cap, t, mark=None):
    """A hanging glass vat, its water stacked in bands from the bottom.
    Returns the y of the water's surface."""
    w, h = 280.0, 280.0
    x0, x1 = cx - w / 2, cx + w / 2
    bot = top + h
    cr.rectangle(x0, top, w, h)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((200, 222, 236), 0.22))
    cr.fill()
    y = bot
    live = [b for b in bands if b[1] > 0.5]
    for i, (lab, vol, rgb) in enumerate(live):
        hh = (h - 8) * vol / cap
        _gl_band(cr, x0 + 6, x1 - 6, y, y - hh, t, i == len(live) - 1)
        solid(cr, rgb, finish="gloss", edge=False, rim=(i == len(live) - 1))
        if hh > 32:
            text(cr, lab, cx, y - hh / 2 + 10, 26, look.INK, face="bold",
                 anchor="center", shadow=True)
        y -= hh
    surface = y
    if mark is not None:
        my = bot - (h - 8) * mark[1] / cap
        then_mark(cr, x0 + 12, x0 + 140, my, mark[0])
    cylinder(cr, x0, bot, w, h, (214, 234, 246), finish="glass", a=0.26)
    cr.rectangle(x0 - 8, top - 6, w + 16, 16)
    solid(cr, P["brass"], finish="metal")
    cr.rectangle(x0 - 10, bot - 4, w + 20, 18)
    solid(cr, P["brass_shade"], finish="metal")
    return surface


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a giant balance scale of lake water
    SUBSTANCE: blue lake water
    CAUSE: Data cranks the flume gate open and each lake's water runs into the right vat, lifting it toward level
    On a Great Lakes shore stands a huge brass balance. Its left vat already
    holds Lake Superior's water and the beam sits hard down on that side.
    Data cranks the gate of a flume and the other four lakes run into the
    right vat one after another, biggest first, each a band of its own
    water. The beam rises toward level but never gets there, because
    Superior still outweighs the other four. THE SCALE is on the glass:
    Superior's level is marked on the right vat, and the four lakes stop
    short of it. Done by 0.66 and held: the water rocks, a freighter crosses
    the lake, and Data keeps cranking. Only Superior's own volume is
    printed; the picture says "more than the other four combined"."""
    rows = sorted([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts], key=lambda r: -r[1])
    ls, vs = rows[0]
    rest = rows[1:]
    n = max(1, len(rest))
    others = sum(v for _, v in rest)
    cap = max(vs, others, 1.0) * 1.1
    a0, a1 = 0.15, 0.66
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    grow = ease(seg(f, 0.25, 0.85))
    flowing = u >= a0 and u < a1 and 0.22 < f < 0.88

    blues = [(52, 122, 192), (66, 138, 204), (44, 108, 178), (78, 150, 212), (58, 128, 186)]
    fills = []
    for i, (lab, v) in enumerate(rest):
        if u < a0 or i > k:
            amt = 0.0
        elif i < k:
            amt = 1.0
        else:
            amt = grow
        fills.append((lab, v * amt, blues[i % len(blues)]))
    R = sum(b[1] for b in fills)
    d = (vs - R) / (vs or 1.0)
    th = 0.32 * math.sqrt(clamp(abs(d))) * (1 if d >= 0 else -1)

    # the shore of a great lake under a low sun
    g = landscape(cr, t, "coast")
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (150, 186, 206)), (1, (70, 120, 166))], g - 6, g + 70)
    fx = -320 + (t * 95.0) % 1720
    fy = g + 20
    cr.move_to(fx, fy)
    cr.line_to(fx + 240, fy)
    cr.line_to(fx + 224, fy + 26)
    cr.line_to(fx + 14, fy + 26)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (92, 42, 36))
    box(cr, fx + 186, fy, 40, 28, (236, 234, 228), depth=8)
    haze(cr, 600, g + 70, (200, 216, 226), a=0.3)

    PX, PY, LB = 540.0, 800.0, 360.0
    xl, yl = PX - LB * math.cos(th), PY + LB * math.sin(th)
    xr, yr = PX + LB * math.cos(th), PY - LB * math.sin(th)

    cast_shadow(cr, 60, 1040, 1440, length=260, a=0.25)
    contact_shadow(cr, 540, 1444, 240, a=0.4)
    box(cr, 450, 1440, 180, 56, (112, 92, 72))
    cylinder(cr, 522, 1386, 36, 586, P["brass"], finish="metal")

    # the flume from the lakes, its gate wheel on the post
    contact_shadow(cr, 1044, 1452, 70, a=0.35)
    box(cr, 1030, 1452, 24, 770, (126, 92, 60), depth=10)
    cr.move_to(W + 10, 648)
    cr.line_to(978, 682)
    cr.line_to(978, 712)
    cr.line_to(W + 10, 684)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (150, 110, 70))
    if u < a0:
        wang = 0.0
    elif u < a1:
        wang = 2 * math.pi * (k + ease(seg(f, 0.0, 0.3)))
    else:
        pk = int((u - a1) / 0.11)
        wang = 2 * math.pi * (n + pk + ease(seg((u - a1) / 0.11 - pk, 0.0, 0.5)))
    WX, WY = 1042, 1310
    disc(cr, WX, WY, 46, (96, 98, 106), finish="metal")
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 40, 46)))
    cr.set_line_width(7)
    for s_ in range(4):
        a_ = wang + s_ * math.pi / 2
        cr.move_to(WX, WY)
        cr.line_to(WX + 40 * math.cos(a_), WY + 40 * math.sin(a_))
    cr.stroke()

    # the beam and its chains
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(PX, PY)
    cr.rotate(-th)
    cr.rectangle(-392, -18, 784, 36)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, P["brass"], finish="metal")
    disc(cr, PX, PY, 28, P["brass_shade"], finish="metal")
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((54, 54, 60)))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    for ex, ey in ((xl, yl), (xr, yr)):
        cr.move_to(ex - 140, ey + 140)
        cr.line_to(ex, ey)
        cr.line_to(ex + 140, ey + 140)
    cr.stroke()

    _gl_vat(cr, xl, yl + 140, [(ls, vs, (34, 96, 170))], cap, t)
    sr = _gl_vat(cr, xr, yr + 140, fills, cap, t,
                 mark=(ls, vs) if u >= a0 else None)
    # the accent marks Superior's surface: the water itself stays blue
    stop = yl + 140 + 280 - 272 * vs / cap
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"]))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    cr.move_to(xl - 134, stop)
    cr.line_to(xl + 134, stop)
    cr.stroke()

    if flowing:
        wob = 3 * math.sin(t * 9)
        cr.move_to(976, 700)
        cr.curve_to(990 + wob, 730, 984, 760, 982 + wob, sr)
        cr.line_to(958 - wob, sr)
        cr.curve_to(960, 760, 962, 720, 978, 690)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (70, 140, 210), finish="gloss", edge=False)
        glow(cr, 970, sr, 40, (220, 240, 255), 0.5)

    # by the camera: the lake lapping at the rocks
    cr.move_to(0, 1580)
    cr.curve_to(220, 1600, 420, 1720, 520, H)
    cr.line_to(0, H)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (50, 112, 172), finish="gloss", edge=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((220, 238, 250), 0.7))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    for i in range(4):
        yy = 1660 + i * 60
        cr.move_to(10, yy + 6 * math.sin(t * 2 + i))
        cr.curve_to(120, yy - 10, 200, yy + 10, 300 - i * 20, yy + 6 * math.sin(t * 2 + i + 1))
    cr.stroke()
    for rx_, ry_, rr in ((470, 1730, 64), (300, 1880, 52), (960, 1780, 70)):
        contact_shadow(cr, rx_, ry_ + rr * 0.8, rr * 2.2, a=0.35)
        disc(cr, rx_, ry_, rr, (128, 124, 118))
    foreground(cr, "coast")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data points at Superior's vat, walks to the gate and cranks the lakes in
    if u < a0:
        hx = 650 + 300 * ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.13))
        host("point", hx, 1450, 220)
    elif u < a1:
        host("crank", 950, 1450, 220, beat=k)
    else:
        host("crank", 950, 1450, 220, beat=n + int((u - a1) / 0.11))

    fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(vs)):,} cu mi", f"Lake {ls} alone", 80, 520,
                a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)
    if u >= a1 and vs > others:
        text(cr, "MORE than the other four combined", W - 80, 1500, 40, look.INK,
             face="bold", anchor="right", alpha=ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.03)))

segments.topic: Great Lakes share of fresh water
segments.say: Add them all up and the Great Lakes hold 21 percent of all the fresh surface water on planet Earth.
segments.illustrated_scene:
# scene standard: 2026-10-16.2
def _gl_bez(p0, p1, p2, p3, s):
    m = 1.0 - s
    x = m * m * m * p0[0] + 3 * m * m * s * p1[0] + 3 * m * s * s * p2[0] + s * s * s * p3[0]
    y = m * m * m * p0[1] + 3 * m * m * s * p1[1] + 3 * m * s * s * p2[1] + s * s * s * p3[1]
    return x, y


def _gl_stream(cr, sx, sy, ex, ey, t, a=1.0):
    # the bucket's lake water arcing over the lip and down onto the surface
    p0 = (sx, sy)
    p1 = (sx - 60, sy - 40)
    p2 = (ex + 60, min(sy, ey) - 60)
    p3 = (ex, ey)
    cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 110, 190), 0.9 * a))
    cr.set_line_width(36)
    cr.move_to(*p0)
    cr.curve_to(p1[0], p1[1], p2[0], p2[1], p3[0], p3[1])
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 210, 248), 0.85 * a))
    cr.set_line_width(12)
    cr.move_to(p0[0] - 6, p0[1] - 6)
    cr.curve_to(p1[0] - 6, p1[1] - 6, p2[0] - 6, p2[1] - 6, p3[0] - 6, p3[1] - 6)
    cr.stroke()
    for i in range(5):
        s = (t * 2.0 + i / 5.0) % 1.0
        bx, by = _gl_bez(p0, p1, p2, p3, s)
        disc(cr, bx, by, 12, (190, 228, 250), finish="gloss", a=0.8 * a)
    # the splash where it lands
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(ex, ey)
    cr.scale(1, 0.3)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 70, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((235, 248, 255), 0.7 * a))
    cr.fill()


def _gl_plume(cr, mx, y, reach, t, a=1.0):
    # the world's water bursting out of the inlet into the tank: a churning
    # white-blue plume that fans out across the floor of the tank
    w = 1.0 + 0.06 * math.sin(t * 9)
    cr.move_to(mx, y - 26)
    cr.curve_to(mx - reach * 0.35, y - 40 * w, mx - reach * 0.7, y - 70 * w, mx - reach, y - 60 * w)
    cr.curve_to(mx - reach * 1.05, y + 10, mx - reach * 0.9, y + 60 * w, mx - reach * 0.6, y + 64 * w)
    cr.curve_to(mx - reach * 0.3, y + 50 * w, mx - 40, y + 30, mx, y + 26)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (96, 170, 232), finish="gloss", a=0.75 * a, edge=False)
    for i in range(4):
        ph = (t * 1.4 + i / 4.0) % 1.0
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(mx - 30 - reach * 0.75 * ph, y + 6 * math.sin(i * 2.1 + t * 3))
        cr.scale(1, 0.55)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 26 + 50 * ph, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 248, 255), 0.55 * (1 - ph) * a))
        cr.fill()
    glow(cr, mx - 20, y, 90, (230, 246, 255), 0.7 * a)


def _gl_fall(cr, x, y0, y1, t, a=1.0):
    # the brimming tank spilling over its lip, down the glass to the sand
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 140, 220), 0.85 * a))
    cr.set_line_width(24)
    cr.move_to(x, y0)
    cr.curve_to(x + 14, y0 + 20, x + 10, y0 + 120, x + 8, y1)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((190, 230, 252), 0.8 * a))
    cr.set_line_width(7)
    cr.move_to(x - 4, y0 + 4)
    cr.curve_to(x + 8, y0 + 24, x + 4, y0 + 120, x + 2, y1)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x + 40, y1 + 6)
    cr.scale(1, 0.24)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 90 + 6 * math.sin(t * 3), 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (70, 140, 210), finish="gloss", a=0.8 * a, edge=False)


def _gl_lighthouse(cr, x, base):
    # a far Great Lakes lighthouse on the point across the water
    contact_shadow(cr, x, base, 60, a=0.25)
    cr.move_to(x - 22, base)
    cr.line_to(x - 14, base - 150)
    cr.line_to(x + 14, base - 150)
    cr.line_to(x + 22, base)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (240, 236, 228))
    cr.rectangle(x - 18, base - 100, 36, 26)
    solid(cr, (190, 52, 44), rim=False)
    box(cr, x - 16, base - 150, 32, 22, (60, 64, 72), depth=6)

    cr.move_to(x - 18, base - 172)
    cr.line_to(x, base - 192)
    cr.line_to(x + 18, base - 172)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (190, 52, 44))


def _gl_rowboat(cr, x, y, s):
    # a wooden rowboat pulled up on the beach, right by the camera
    contact_shadow(cr, x + 210 * s, y + 6, 470 * s, a=0.4)
    cr.move_to(x, y - 110 * s)
    cr.curve_to(x + 60 * s, y + 10 * s, x + 340 * s, y + 10 * s, x + 440 * s, y - 70 * s)
    cr.curve_to(x + 300 * s, y - 120 * s, x + 120 * s, y - 130 * s, x, y - 110 * s)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (156, 98, 56))
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x + 220 * s, y - 108 * s)
    cr.scale(1, 0.18)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 200 * s, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (86, 54, 34), rim=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 36, 22)))
    cr.set_line_width(5 * s)
    for k in range(2):
        cr.move_to(x + 30 * s, y - (78 - k * 34) * s)
        cr.curve_to(x + 120 * s, y - (30 - k * 30) * s, x + 320 * s, y - (30 - k * 30) * s,
                    x + 420 * s, y - (60 - k * 26) * s)
    cr.stroke()
    # the oar laid across it
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x + 120 * s, y - 130 * s)
    cr.rotate(0.22)
    cr.rectangle(0, -7 * s, 300 * s, 14 * s)
    solid(cr, (200, 160, 110))
    cr.rectangle(300 * s, -22 * s, 90 * s, 44 * s)
    solid(cr, (200, 160, 110))
    cr.restore()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a giant glass tank of water
    SUBSTANCE: fresh blue water
    CAUSE: Data opens the valve to flood the empty tank, then pours buckets of Great Lakes water on top until it brims
    One tank on a Great Lakes beach is ALL the fresh surface water on Earth,
    and it starts EMPTY. Data spins the valve on the inlet pipe and the rest
    of the world's water bursts in from the bottom until 79% of the tank is
    full; the level stops at a line marked in the accent on the glass. Then
    he climbs the scaffold and pours the Great Lakes in, bucket by bucket,
    brighter lake-blue, until the top 21% is theirs and the tank brims. The
    whole change is empty to full — big at a glance — and the cut reads
    about a fifth of the whole. Done by 0.64 and held: he keeps pouring and
    the full tank spills over its lip."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    tot = sum(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    gl = next((r for r in rows if "great" in r[0].lower()), None)
    if gl is None:
        gl = min(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    share = clamp(gl[1] / tot)
    rest = 1.0 - share

    # the clock: flood 0.06-0.34, climb 0.34-0.42, walk 0.42-0.46, pour 0.46-0.64
    f0, f1 = 0.06, 0.34
    a0, a1 = 0.46, 0.64
    n = 2
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    rise = ease(seg(f, 0.2, 0.85))
    flood = ease(seg(u, f0, f1))
    if u < a0:
        fill = rest * flood
    elif u >= a1:
        fill = 1.0
    else:
        fill = rest + share * (k + rise) / n

    TX0, TW, BASE, TH = 140, 660, 1450, 740
    TX1 = TX0 + TW
    TOP = BASE - TH
    yb, yf = BASE - 34, TOP + 46
    L = yb - (yb - yf) * fill
    Lcut = yb - (yb - yf) * rest
    ix0, ix1 = TX0 + 14, TX1 - 14
    PY = 1350                                 # inlet pipe centre
    DECK = 830                                # scaffold deck Data pours from

    # the lakeshore: the Great Lakes themselves behind, a beach in front
    landscape(cr, t, "coast")
    _gl_lighthouse(cr, 80, 1210)
    haze(cr, 1020, 1220, (248, 214, 172), a=0.3)
    for i in range(6):                        # slow swells on the lake
        wy = 1200 + i * 24
        off = (t * 30 + i * 90) % 240
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((220, 238, 250), 0.35))
        cr.set_line_width(3 + i)
        for x0 in range(-240, W, 240):
            cr.move_to(x0 + off, wy)
            cr.line_to(x0 + off + 90, wy)
        cr.stroke()
    birds(cr, t, y0=760, n=5, rgb=(60, 60, 72))

    cast_shadow(cr, TX0, TX1, BASE, length=340, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, (TX0 + TX1) / 2, BASE + 4, TW + 80, a=0.42)

    # the inlet pipe running in along the sand, with its valve wheel
    cr.rectangle(TX1 - 10, PY - 32, W - TX1 + 20, 64)
    solid(cr, (118, 122, 132), finish="metal")
    for fx in (900, 1040):
        cr.rectangle(fx, PY - 40, 18, 80)
        solid(cr, (96, 100, 110), finish="metal", rim=False)
    cr.rectangle(860, PY - 46, 44, 92)
    solid(cr, (96, 100, 110), finish="metal")
    cr.rectangle(876, PY - 120, 12, 76)
    solid(cr, (80, 84, 94), finish="metal", rim=False)
    wa = 4 * math.pi * flood
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((170, 40, 36)))
    cr.set_line_width(14)
    cr.arc(882, PY - 124, 50, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_line_width(9)
    for i in range(3):
        ang = wa + i * math.pi / 3
        cr.move_to(882 - 50 * math.cos(ang), PY - 124 - 50 * math.sin(ang))
        cr.line_to(882 + 50 * math.cos(ang), PY - 124 + 50 * math.sin(ang))
    cr.stroke()
    disc(cr, 882, PY - 124, 14, (200, 60, 50), finish="gloss")

    # scaffold and ladder beside the tank
    for lx in (845, 1010):
        cr.rectangle(lx, DECK, 16, BASE - DECK)
        solid(cr, (110, 112, 120), finish="metal", rim=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((90, 92, 100)))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    cr.move_to(853, DECK + 30)
    cr.line_to(1018, BASE - 200)
    cr.move_to(1018, DECK + 30)
    cr.line_to(853, BASE - 200)
    cr.stroke()
    box(cr, 828, DECK + 2, 214, 24, (150, 122, 86), depth=40)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 70, 78)))
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    for rx in (1000, 1046):
        cr.move_to(rx, DECK - 20)
        cr.line_to(rx, BASE)
    for i in range(14):
        ry = DECK + 20 + i * 44
        cr.move_to(1000, ry)
        cr.line_to(1046, ry)
    cr.stroke()

    # the water: the rest of the world below the cut, the Great Lakes above it
    if fill > 0.005:
        lo = max(L, Lcut)
        cr.rectangle(ix0, lo, ix1 - ix0, yb - lo)
        solid(cr, (34, 74, 132), finish="gloss", edge=False)
        vgrad(cr, [(0, (60, 110, 170)), (1, (22, 50, 98))], lo, yb, ix0, ix1)
        if L < Lcut - 1:
            vgrad(cr, [(0, (140, 210, 248)), (1, (70, 160, 230))], L, Lcut, ix0, ix1)
        tilt = 8 * math.sin(t * 2.4)
        cr.move_to(ix0, L - tilt)
        cr.curve_to(ix0 + 200, L - tilt - 20, ix1 - 200, L + tilt + 20, ix1, L + tilt)
        cr.curve_to(ix1 - 200, L + tilt + 34, ix0 + 200, L - tilt + 34, ix0, L - tilt)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (170, 222, 248), finish="gloss", edge=False)
    # the world's water bursting in while the valve is open
    ja = clamp((u - f0) / 0.03) * clamp((f1 - u) / 0.03)
    if ja > 0:
        _gl_plume(cr, ix1, PY, 230 + 160 * flood, t, a=ja)
    # the cut, in the accent, on the glass — where the world's water stops
    ca = ease(seg(u, f1 - 0.03, f1))
    if ca > 0:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"], ca))
        cr.set_line_width(14)
        cr.move_to(TX0 - 22, Lcut)
        cr.line_to(TX1 + 22, Lcut)
        cr.stroke()
        for ex in (TX0 - 22, TX1 + 22):
            disc(cr, ex, Lcut, 12, P["accent2"], finish="gloss", a=ca)

    # the glass tank over the water, with steel hoops
    cylinder(cr, TX0, BASE, TW, TH, (200, 226, 242), finish="glass", a=0.32)
    cr.rectangle(TX0 + 40, TOP + 60, 26, TH - 120)
    cr.set_source_rgba(1, 1, 1, 0.22)
    cr.fill()
    for hy in (TOP + 12, (TOP + BASE) / 2, BASE - 10):
        cr.rectangle(TX0 - 8, hy - 11, TW + 16, 22)
        solid(cr, (120, 124, 134), finish="metal")

    if L < Lcut - 80:
        text(cr, "GREAT LAKES", (TX0 + TX1) / 2, (L + Lcut) / 2 + 18, 54, look.INK,
             face="bold", anchor="center")
    if yb - max(L, Lcut) > 140:
        text(cr, "REST OF THE WORLD", (TX0 + TX1) / 2, (max(L, Lcut) + yb) / 2 + 40, 46,
             look.INK, face="bold", anchor="center")

    # right by the camera: a rowboat on the beach, stones at the waterline
    _gl_rowboat(cr, 20, 1830, 1.0)

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: Britain-shaped basin with Big Ben
    SUBSTANCE: blue lake water
    CAUSE: Data digs through the dike with a shovel and lake water floods the Britain-shaped basin
    The five Great Lakes, spread out flat, cover almost exactly the UK. A
    hollow dug in the shape of Great Britain and Northern Ireland lies just
    behind a dike on the lakeshore — earth walls, chalk-white coast, Big Ben
    in London, a red double-decker on its roads, a Union Jack over Scotland.
    The lake is right by the camera; Data stands on the dike and digs it
    open stroke by stroke, and each stroke lets a surge of lake water in at
    the south coast until the whole UK is full to its coastline. The shape
    IS the yardstick: the water fills it edge to edge. Lands by 0.60 and
    holds while the water ripples and he keeps the channel open."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    lk = next((r for r in rows if "lake" in r[0].lower()), rows[0])
    uk = next((r for r in rows if r is not lk), rows[-1])

    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    surge = ease(seg(f, 0.3, 1.0))              # the water comes on the strike
    fill = 0.0 if u < a0 else (k + surge) / n
    cut = 0.0 if u < a0 else min(1.0, (k + ease(seg(f, 0.25, 0.45))) / n)
    done = u >= a1

    landscape(cr, t, "field", horizon=640)
    haze(cr, 560, 760, (214, 222, 230), a=0.35)

    # the intake on the south coast, where the dike is cut

    cast_shadow(cr, 300, 820, 1420, length=200, a=0.22)
    _gb_outline(cr)

    _gb_outline(cr)
    cr.clip()
    cr.translate(0, 22)
    _gb_outline(cr)
    solid(cr, (180, 150, 106), edge=False)      # the dry floor
    cr.restore()
    rr = 30 + 820 * fill ** 0.85
    if fill > 0:
        cr.save()
        _gb_outline(cr)
        cr.clip()
        _gb_flood(cr, EX, EY, rr, t)
        cr.clip_preserve()
        solid(cr, (52, 122, 190), finish="gloss", edge=False)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((170, 214, 244), 0.6))
        cr.set_line_width(12)
        for i in range(13):

        cr.stroke()

        if fill < 0.999:                        # the foaming front of the flood
            cr.save()
            _gb_outline(cr)
            cr.clip()
            _gb_flood(cr, EX, EY, rr, t)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((240, 248, 255), 0.85))
            cr.set_line_width(10)
            cr.stroke()
            cr.restore()
    _gb_outline(cr)
    edge(cr, (70, 52, 36), width=14)
    _gb_outline(cr)
    edge(cr, (246, 242, 230), width=6)          # the white cliffs

    # the tells: a Union Jack over Scotland, a bus, Big Ben in London
    fx_, fy_ = _gb_p(0.58, 0.34)
    _gb_flag(cr, fx_, fy_, t)
    bx_, by_ = _gb_p(0.56, 0.68)
    _gb_bus(cr, bx_ - 110 + 70 * math.sin(t * 0.6), by_)
    tx_, ty_ = _gb_p(0.80, 0.86)

            cr.translate(lx_, ly_)
            cr.scale(1, 0.3)
            cr.arc(0, 0, 50 + 8 * math.sin(t * 2), 0, 2 * math.pi)
            cr.restore()
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((200, 230, 250), 0.6))
            cr.set_line_width(4)

    # the lake, right by the camera
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (70, 132, 188)), (1, (36, 88, 150))], 1490, 1820)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((226, 240, 252), 0.55))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    for i in range(7):
        yy = 1520 + i * 44
        xo = (t * (40 + 6 * i) + i * 170) % 300 - 300
        while xo < W:
            cr.move_to(xo, yy)
            cr.curve_to(xo + 40, yy - 10, xo + 90, yy - 10, xo + 130, yy)
            xo += 300
    cr.stroke()

    # the dike between the lake and the basin
    contact_shadow(cr, 560, 1500, 760, a=0.35)
    cr.move_to(170, 1505)
    cr.curve_to(240, 1440, 860, 1440, 940, 1505)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (140, 108, 72))
    for gx in range(200, 920, 26):              # grass on its crest

    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((96, 140, 70)))
    cr.set_line_width(4)

        for j in range(5):

            x = CX + (j - 2) * w * 0.15
            cr.move_to(x, y + 10)
            cr.line_to(x, y - 10)

    # the moored boat and reeds by the camera, the beach under them
    _gb_rowboat(cr, 830, 1700, t)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((84, 112, 56)))

    for i in range(9):
        rx = 30 + i * 22

                    rx + 14 * math.sin(t * 1.2 + i), 1650 - (i % 3) * 40)
    cr.stroke()
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (196, 176, 136)), (1, (164, 142, 104))], 1810, H)

    # Data walks the dike to the cut, then digs it open stroke by stroke

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a giant glass water jug
    SUBSTANCE: lake water
    CAUSE: Data opens the jug's tap and its water fills four glasses with plenty left over
    THE HOOK: one huge jug of Lake Superior's water, already pouring when
    the video opens. Data spins the valve wheel on the jug's own outlet and
    it fills four tumblers, one per other Great Lake and each as tall as
    that lake's volume, biggest first. All four are full and the jug still
    has water in it. The jug level is Superior minus what has been poured,
    over Superior. Every glass is full by 0.53 and the picture holds; no
    number arrives after the opening line. After it lands the wheel stops,
    the water in the jug keeps sloshing and Data walks down to the glasses."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    sup = max(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    others = sorted([r for r in rows if r is not sup], key=lambda r: -r[1])[:4]
    v0 = sup[1] or 1.0
    n = len(others)
    a1 = 0.55
    span = a1 / max(1, n)

        f = ease(seg(u, i * span - 0.03, (i + 1) * span - 0.02))
        if i == 0:
            f = 0.3 + 0.7 * ease(seg(u, 0.0, span - 0.02))   # already pouring at frame 1
        fills.append(f)
    poured = sum(v * f for (_, v), f in zip(others, fills))
    left = max(0.0, v0 - poured)
    level = left / v0
    tap_open = u < a1

    landscape(cr, t, "coast")
    birds(cr, t, y0=760, n=4, rgb=(60, 64, 76))

    # the timber stand and the giant jug on it, below the readout
    JX0, JX1, JT, JB = 270, 790, 680, 1200
    cast_shadow(cr, JX0 - 20, JX1 + 60, 1290, length=320, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, 540, 1294, 640, a=0.4)
    box(cr, 250, 1290, 580, 90, (150, 108, 70), depth=60)
    for px in (300, 420, 540, 660, 780):            # plank seams on the stand
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((96, 66, 40), 0.7))
        cr.set_line_width(4)
        cr.move_to(px, 1210)
        cr.line_to(px, 1288)
        cr.stroke()

    # the handle: a thick glass loop fused to the left wall
    hp = [(JX0 + 6, JT + 110), (JX0 - 170, JT + 100), (JX0 - 170, JT + 400), (JX0 + 6, JT + 410)]
    for w_, col, al in ((52, (40, 56, 72), 0.9), (40, (178, 208, 228), 0.95), (12, (240, 250, 255), 0.8)):
        cr.set_line_width(w_)
        cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(col, al))
        cr.move_to(*hp[0])
        cr.curve_to(*hp[1], *hp[2], *hp[3])
        cr.stroke()

    _hk_jug(cr, JX0, JX1, JT, JB)
    solid(cr, (196, 222, 238), finish="glass", a=0.5)
    # the water left in it, sloshing
    inner_top, inner_bot = JT + 30, JB - 12
    wy = inner_bot - (inner_bot - inner_top) * level
    slosh = 12 * math.sin(t * 3.2) * (1.0 if tap_open else 0.7)

    _hk_jug(cr, JX0 + 14, JX1 - 14, JT + 14, JB - 12)
    cr.clip()
    cr.move_to(JX0, wy - slosh)

stories.title: A Language Goes Extinct Every 2 Weeks
stories.hook: Every couple of weeks, a whole language dies, and the world just scrolls past.
stories.closing: When a language dies, a whole way of seeing the world goes silent with it.
stories.question: Do you speak more than one language?
stories.caption: About 40% of the world's roughly 7,000 languages are endangered, and on average one disappears every 2 weeks. Linguists warn as many as half could be gone by 2100. Do you speak more than one language? Tell me below 👇

segments.say: About four in ten languages are endangered, down to their last fluent speakers. When those speakers go, so does the language.

def _stele(cr, x0, x1, top, base, crown=120):
    r = (x1 - x0) / 2.0
    cr.move_to(x0, base)
    cr.line_to(x0, top + crown)
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x0 + r, top + crown)
    cr.scale(1.0, crown / r)
    cr.arc(0, 0, r, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.line_to(x1, base)
    cr.close_path()


def _glyphs(cr, x0, x1, top, base, a):
    if a <= 0.01:
        return
    for r in range(14):
        y = top + 190 + r * 60
        if y > base - 70:
            break

            x = x0 + 58 + c * 40
            if x > x1 - 58:

            s = (r * 7 + c * 13) % 5
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((84, 66, 46), 0.9 * a))
            cr.set_line_width(5)

                cr.move_to(x - 9, y - 14)
                cr.line_to(x + 9, y - 14)
            elif s == 1:

_RUB = [(0.0, 0.0), (1.0, 0.0), (0.94, -0.62), (0.74, -1.0), (0.46, -0.84),
        (0.22, -0.96), (0.04, -0.5)]


def _rubble_path(cr, x, y, w, h, ang, dx=0.0, dy=0.0):
    ca, sa = math.cos(ang), math.sin(ang)
    for i, (px, py) in enumerate(_RUB):
        lx, ly = px * w + dx, py * h + dy
        X, Y = x + lx * ca - ly * sa, y + lx * sa + ly * ca
        if i == 0:
            cr.move_to(X, Y)
        else:
            cr.line_to(X, Y)
    cr.close_path()


def _rubble(cr, x, y, w, h, col, ang=0.0, marks=True):

    side going back, lit face, and a few letters still on it."""

    among ruined columns in the desert. Data walks up to it and swings a
    sledgehammer into it at the true share: each blow drives the crack
    further up the stone, and the last one splits the endangered part off,
    so it tips away and weathers to grey as its letters wear off. The safe
    part stays standing, so the cut reads at a glance: four parts in ten
    broken away. Landed by 0.62, then held while he keeps knocking jagged
    chips off the leaning slab; broken carved lumps lie by the camera."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]

    end = next((r for r in rows if "endanger" in r[0].lower() or "dying" in r[0].lower()),
               min(rows, key=lambda r: r[1]))
    safe = next((r for r in rows if r is not end), None)
    share = end[1] / tot
    safe_share = 1.0 - share

    TX0, TX1, TOP, BASE, DEP = 140, 800, 700, 1440, 40

    else:

    if k < 0:

    elif k < NS:

    tilt = ease(seg(u, T0, 0.62))

                PY + dx * math.sin(ang) + dy * math.cos(ang))

    sand = (206, 182, 140)

        _stele(cr, TX0, TX1, TOP, BASE)
        solid(cr, tuple(int(v * 0.7) for v in col))
        cr.restore()

            if p[1] < reach:

    else:

# scene standard: 2026-10-16.2
def _sb_order(pts):
    # time order that does not depend on the order the rows arrive in: the
    # rows are put in one canonical order first, and a "today"/"now" row is
    # always the latest whatever its label parses as
    rows = sorted((str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts)

    def _now(lab):
        s = lab.lower()
        return any(w in s for w in ("today", "now", "current", "present", "latest"))

    flags = [_now(l) for l, _ in rows]
    if any(flags) and not all(flags):
        past = by_time([r for r, fl in zip(rows, flags) if not fl])
        cur = [r for r, fl in zip(rows, flags) if fl]
        return past + cur
    return by_time(rows)

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a yellow school bus full of families
    SUBSTANCE: the bus leaving the village
    CAUSE: Data grips the wheel and drives the families out of the village to the city
    Why languages vanish: families leave the village for the city and the

    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 220, 150)))

    cr.stroke()

    cast_shadow(cr, bx, bx + BW + 70, BASE, length=260, a=0.28)

    # THE SCALE on the road: the old rate's distance, ticked off as the bus passes
    F0 = X0 + BW + 70
    if go > 0.02:

stories.title: Hearing Aids Started At $300 Instead Of Requiring A Prescription
stories.hook: For years, hearing aids were locked behind a doctor. Not anymore.
stories.closing: Lower prices expand options, but choosing hearing help still means matching the device to the person's needs.
stories.question: What would make hearing aids easier to access?
stories.caption: In 2022 the FDA let hearing aids sell over the counter -- prices dropped from about $4,700 a pair to as low as $300. Even so, only 1 in 5 adults who could benefit from one actually uses one. Know someone who needs one? Tell me below 👇

segments.say: Over-the-counter hearing aid pairs started at $300 in this comparison. The prescription pair cost far more.

def _ha_tag_path(cr, x0, top, x1, bot):

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: hearing aids with a giant price tag
    SUBSTANCE: the yellow price tag
    CAUSE: Data saws the giant price tag down to a small one, two cuts
    A pharmacy display: a pair of hearing aids on velvet pads on a white
    shelf, a huge yellow price tag with its barcode hanging from them on a
    string. Data saws it twice, a long cut down and a short cut across,
    and the scraps fall to the floor, until the tag left is the
    over-the-counter price: its AREA is the price, so what remains is 1/16
    of the old tag, whose outline stays as a dashed ghost. Done by 0.67,
    then held: the little tag swings on its string, Data holds his saw up
    on the step stool, a shopper's red cart rolls across the floor the
    whole beat. Every price sits clear of Data."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts[:2]]
    (lb, vb), (la, va) = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: -r[1])
    vb = vb or 1.0
    ratio = vb / max(1.0, va)
    k = math.sqrt(clamp(va / vb, 0.0, 1.0))

    X0, TOP, W0, H0 = 360.0, 1030.0, 360.0, 450.0
    X1, BOT = X0 + W0, TOP + H0
    tag = (X0, TOP, X1, BOT)
    kw, kh = W0 * k, H0 * k
    CUTX, CUTY = X0 + kw, TOP + kh
    HX, HY = X0 + 40, TOP + 42                 # the hole it hangs from

    c1 = seg(u, 0.14, 0.30)                    # the long cut, down the tag
    f1 = seg(u, 0.30, 0.38)                    # its scrap falls
    c2 = seg(u, 0.48, 0.60)                    # the short cut, across
    f2 = seg(u, 0.60, 0.67)                    # its scrap falls

    # the pharmacy: a cool teal wall, ceiling lights
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (34, 52, 60)), (0.55, (92, 128, 134)), (0.76, (120, 150, 152)),
               (1, (88, 92, 96))], 0, H)
    for i in range(4):
        lx = 135 + i * 270
        glow(cr, lx, 250, 160, (255, 244, 214), 0.4)
        box(cr, lx - 80, 260, 160, 18, (246, 242, 230), depth=30)
    # the lit pharmacy cross on the wall, upper right
    glow(cr, 920, 700, 120, (120, 230, 150), 0.45)
    cr.move_to(895, 640)
    for px_, py_ in ((945, 640), (945, 675), (980, 675), (980, 725), (945, 725),
                     (945, 760), (895, 760), (895, 725), (860, 725), (860, 675),
                     (895, 675)):
        cr.line_to(px_, py_)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (60, 180, 96), finish="gloss")
    # the aisles at either side: shelves of bottles and boxes, under haze
    for side in (0, 1):
        bx = 20 if side == 0 else 880
        for r_ in range(5):
            sy = 840 + r_ * 120
            for c_ in range(4):
                col = [(70, 120, 170), (226, 226, 230), (190, 80, 70), (110, 160, 120)][(r_ + c_ + side) % 4]
                if (r_ + c_) % 2:
                    cylinder(cr, bx + 10 + c_ * 42, sy - 12, 30, 58, col, finish="gloss")
                else:
                    box(cr, bx + 8 + c_ * 43, sy - 12, 32, 64, col, depth=8)
            box(cr, bx, sy, 180, 12, (130, 140, 144), depth=18)
    haze(cr, 700, 1460, (120, 150, 152), a=0.5)

    # the floor running to the camera, its seams kept on the floor
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (168, 160, 150)), (1, (110, 104, 98))], 1460, H)
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(0, 1460, W, H - 1460)
    cr.clip()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((80, 74, 66), 0.3))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(12):
        cr.move_to(540, 1320)
        cr.line_to(-900 + i * 260, H)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()
    cr.rectangle(0, 1452, W, 10)
    solid(cr, (70, 76, 80), rim=False, edge=False)

    # the display shelf on its wall brackets, the pair on velvet pads
    for bx_ in (250, 800):
        cr.move_to(bx_, 1012)
        cr.line_to(bx_ + 30, 1012)
        cr.line_to(bx_ + 8, 1090)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (150, 156, 162), finish="metal")
    contact_shadow(cr, 540, 1016, 660, a=0.4)
    box(cr, 210, 1012, 660, 22, (238, 236, 232), depth=40, finish="gloss")
    for ax in (400, 680):
        contact_shadow(cr, ax, 994, 160, a=0.45)
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(ax, 984)
        cr.scale(1, 0.28)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 80, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        solid(cr, (58, 40, 96))
    _ha_aid(cr, 400, 990, 1.2, flip=True)
    _ha_aid(cr, 680, 990, 1.2, flip=False)

    # the step stool he climbs for the second cut
    _ha_stool(cr, 120, 1260, 120)

    # THE SCALE: once the first scrap is gone, the old tag stays as a ghost
    if u >= 0.30:
        _ha_tag_path(cr, X0, TOP, X1, BOT)
        ghost(cr, a=0.9)

    # the tag left on the string, swinging once the last scrap drops
    rx1 = CUTX if u >= 0.30 else X1
    ry1 = CUTY if u >= 0.60 else BOT
    ang = 0.0

    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((190, 40, 36)))

    # the saw cuts, a dark kerf growing through the paper

    cr.set_line_width(7)
    if 0 < c1 and u < 0.30:
