    if 0 < c2 and u < 0.60:
        cr.move_to(X0, CUTY)
        cr.line_to(X0 + kw * c2, CUTY)
        cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()

    # the scraps fall to the floor and lie there
    if u >= 0.30:
        p = f1
        sx, sy = CUTX + (X1 - CUTX) / 2, TOP + H0 / 2
        _ha_piece(cr, CUTX, TOP, X1 - CUTX, H0, sx + (760 - sx) * p,
                  sy + (1780 - sy) * p * p, 1.45 * p, tag)
    if u >= 0.60:
        p = f2
        sx, sy = X0 + kw / 2, CUTY + (BOT - CUTY) / 2
        _ha_piece(cr, X0, CUTY, kw, BOT - CUTY, sx + (380 - sx) * p,
                  sy + (1720 - sy) * p * p, -1.52 * p, tag)

    # the prices on the tag, in frame coordinates, high on it, clear of Data
    if u < 0.30:
        text(cr, f"${int(round(vb)):,}", X0 + W0 / 2 + 30, TOP + H0 * 0.4, 80,
             P["paper_ink"], face="display", anchor="center", shadow=False)
    elif u >= 0.64:
        lx, ly = X0 + kw / 2 + 4 - HX, TOP + kh * 0.8 - HY
        tx = HX + lx * math.cos(ang) - ly * math.sin(ang)
        ty = HY + lx * math.sin(ang) + ly * math.cos(ang)
        text(cr, f"${int(round(va)):,}", tx, ty, 26, P["paper_ink"], face="display",
             anchor="center", shadow=False, alpha=ease(seg(u, 0.64, 0.67)))

    # right by the camera: a shopper's cart rolling across the floor all beat
    cx = -320 + (t * 210) % 1700
    _ha_cart(cr, cx, 1880, 1.3)

    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data: points, saws the long cut, climbs the stool, saws across, holds up
    if u < 0.06:

    elif u < 0.36:
        host("cut", 600 - 180 * ease(seg(u, 0.06, 0.12)), 1500, 220, beat=0)
    elif u < 0.44:
        c = ease(seg(u, 0.36, 0.44))
        host("climb", 420 - 220 * c, 1500 - 242 * c, 220)
    elif u < 0.66:
        host("cut", 200, 1258, 220, beat=1)
    else:

    if u >= 0.62:
        a = ease(seg(u, 0.62, 0.66))
        fit_readout(cr, f"${int(round(va)):,}", la.lower(), 80, 520, a=a,
                    size=130, max_w=900)

             anchor="right", alpha=ease(seg(u, 0.62, 0.67)))
        text(cr, "cheaper", 1010, 1350, 40, look.INK, anchor="right",
             alpha=ease(seg(u, 0.62, 0.67)))
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"${int(round(vb)):,}", lb.lower(), 80, 520,

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a hearing aid shop
    SUBSTANCE: the people with hearing loss
    CAUSE: Data slides the shop's big glass door open by hand and two of the ten walk in
    Ten adults with hearing loss stand outside one hearing-aid shop: the
    crowd is the WHOLE. Data pulls the wide glass door open by its handle;
    the share who use a hearing aid walk in through it, the rest turn and
    walk away from the storefront, its window full of hearing aids. Done by
    0.56, then held: two inside, eight outside, Data still holding the door,
    traffic passing on the road."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    tot = sum(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    aid_row = min(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    rest_row = max(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    share = aid_row[1] / tot
    N = 10
    m = max(1, min(N - 1, int(round(share * N))))
    a0 = 0.06
    opened = ease(seg(u, a0, 0.22))
    walk_from, walk_to = 0.22, 0.54
    wspan = (walk_to - walk_from) / m
    leave = ease(seg(u, 0.30, 0.56))

    BASE = 1440
    DX0, DX1, DY = 520, 800, 1080
    dw = DX1 - DX0
    DC = (DX0 + DX1) / 2

    # the town, the shop in three-quarter view
    landscape(cr, t, "town", horizon=1120)
    haze(cr, 700, 1160, (210, 214, 222), a=0.3)
    cast_shadow(cr, 100, 900, BASE, length=300, a=0.3)
    b = building(cr, 100, 900, BASE, 600, (176, 194, 206), roof_rgb=(90, 96, 108),
                 roof="flat", boards=False)
    # the fascia sign: an ear with a hearing aid behind it
    box(cr, 520, 1060, 300, 200, (244, 242, 236), depth=40)
    _hc_ear(cr, 640, 955, 1.0)
    _hc_aid(cr, 710, 940, 1.1)
    text(cr, "HEARING AIDS", 420, b["top"] + 70, 46, look.INK, face="bold", anchor="center")
    # the shop window: hearing aids on display stands
    WX0, WX1, WY0, WY1 = 140, 330, 1060, 1330
    cr.rectangle(WX0, WY0, WX1 - WX0, WY1 - WY0)
    solid(cr, (196, 220, 234), finish="glass")
    for i, sx in enumerate((185, 285)):
        contact_shadow(cr, sx, 1310, 60, a=0.3)
        cylinder(cr, sx - 18, 1310, 36, 90, (90, 94, 104), finish="metal")
        _hc_aid(cr, sx, 1180, 1.25)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 76, 88)))
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    cr.rectangle(WX0, WY0, WX1 - WX0, WY1 - WY0)
    cr.stroke()

    # the doorway: the warm, lit shop inside
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(DX0, DY, dw, BASE - DY)
    cr.clip()
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (250, 236, 210)), (1, (196, 166, 128))], DY, BASE, DX0, DX1)
    glow(cr, DC, BASE - 120, 220, (255, 236, 196), 0.5)
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 76, 88)))
    cr.set_line_width(14)
    cr.rectangle(DX0, DY, dw, BASE - DY)
    cr.stroke()

    # the sidewalk and the road by the camera
    cr.rectangle(0, BASE, W, 140)
    solid(cr, (184, 182, 176), edge=False, rim=False)
    cr.rectangle(0, BASE + 140, W, H - BASE - 140)
    solid(cr, (64, 66, 72), edge=False, rim=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 220, 150)))
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    cr.set_dash([60, 50])
    cr.move_to(0, 1760)
    cr.line_to(W, 1760)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_dash([])

    # the wide glass door, slid left along its track by Data
    dx = DX0 - dw * opened
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((46, 44, 48)))
    cr.set_line_width(12)
    cr.move_to(DX0 - dw - 30, DY - 14)
    cr.line_to(DX1 + 20, DY - 14)
    cr.stroke()
    for wx in (dx + 50, dx + dw - 50):
        disc(cr, wx, DY - 14, 12, (70, 70, 76), finish="metal")
    cr.rectangle(dx, DY - 6, dw, BASE - DY + 6)
    solid(cr, (96, 104, 116), finish="metal")
    cr.rectangle(dx + 18, DY + 14, dw - 36, BASE - DY - 34)
    solid(cr, (176, 210, 228), finish="glass")
    # glass glints, so it reads as a pane
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((250, 252, 255), 0.7))
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    cr.move_to(dx + 50, DY + 60)
    cr.line_to(dx + 120, DY + 10 + 20)
    cr.move_to(dx + 50, DY + 120)
    cr.line_to(dx + 170, DY + 40)
    cr.stroke()
    # the long pull handle on the leading edge
    cr.rectangle(dx + 6, DY + 130, 16, 140)
    solid(cr, (60, 62, 70), finish="metal")

    # the crowd: ten adults with hearing loss
    slots = [(130, 1490, 0.95), (330, 1490, 0.95), (600, 1495, 0.95), (760, 1495, 0.95),
             (950, 1490, 0.95), (55, 1535, 1.05), (235, 1535, 1.05), (480, 1535, 1.05),
             (870, 1535, 1.05), (1020, 1535, 1.05)]
    order = sorted(range(N), key=lambda i: abs(slots[i][0] - DC))
    walkers = order[:m]
    people = []
    for j in range(N):
        x, fy, s = slots[j]
        if j in walkers:
            i = walkers.index(j)
            w = clamp((u - walk_from - i * wspan) / wspan)
            we = ease(w)
            ex = DX0 + (i + 1) * dw / (m + 1)
            px = x + (ex - x) * we
            pfy = fy + (BASE - 8 - fy) * we
            ps = s + (0.78 - s) * we
            step = math.sin(w * math.pi * 6) if 0 < w < 1 else 0.0
            people.append((pfy, px, ps, j, 1, step))
        else:
            d = -1 if x < DC else 1
            step = math.sin(leave * math.pi * 4) if 0 < leave < 1 else 0.0
            people.append((fy, x + d * 120 * leave, s, j, d, step))
    for fy, px, ps, j, d, step in sorted(people):
        _hc_person(cr, px, fy, ps, j, face=d, step=step)

    # traffic on the road right by the camera
    cx = -420 + ((t * 300) % 1500)
    truck(cr, cx, 1860, 1.2)
    foreground(cr, "town")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data, his own two hands on the door's handle, close enough to reach it
    if u < a0:
        host("point", DX0 - 60, BASE, 220)
    else:
        hands = [(dx + 14, DY + 190), (dx + 14, DY + 240)]
        host("grip", dx - 30, BASE, 220, hands=hands,
             lower="brace" if opened < 0.999 else "stand",
             expr="strain" if opened < 0.999 else "happy")

    last = clamp((u - walk_from - (m - 1) * wspan) / wspan)
    done = last >= 0.999
    if done:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(share * 100))}%",
                    "of adults with hearing loss use a hearing aid", 80, 520, size=130)
        text(cr, f"{int(round(rest_row[1] / tot * 100))}% don't", W - 80, 720, 70,
             look.INK, face="display", anchor="right",
             alpha=ease(seg(u, walk_to, walk_to + 0.05)))
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Hearing loss", "who walks in for a hearing aid?",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a drugstore shelf of hearing aids
    SUBSTANCE: boxed hearing aid models
    CAUSE: Data pushes a stock cart down the aisle and fills the empty shelf, model after model
    A drugstore's hearing-aid shelf, empty in 2022, when they sat behind the
    pharmacy counter on prescription. Data wheels a stocking trolley along
    the aisle in four pushes, and behind it the shelf fills with boxed
    over-the-counter models, one carton per model, until it holds the 2024
    count. Tags on the top shelf's price rail every 20 models put the scale
    on the shelf, far above Data's head. Done by 0.56 and held: he cheers,
    then rolls the empty trolley on, while a customer's cart rolls past the
    camera and a basket of boxes sits on the floor in front."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    N = int(clamp(round(v1 - v0), 0, 120))
    cols = max(1, int(math.ceil(N / 5.0)))
    X0, XW = 110.0, 820.0
    sw = XW / cols
    BASE, FLOOR = 1410, 1500
    shelf_y = [1340 - 128 * r for r in range(5)]

    npush = 4
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.56
    span = (a1 - a0) / npush
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, npush - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    per = [int(round(N * (j + 1) / npush)) - int(round(N * j / npush)) for j in range(npush)]
    start = [int(round(N * j / npush)) for j in range(npush)]

    def push_x(j):
        last = start[j] + per[j] - 1
        c = max(0, last) // 5
        return min(760.0, X0 + (c + 0.5) * sw - 60)

    hx0 = 150.0
    if u < a0:
        hx = hx0
    else:
        prev = hx0 if k == 0 else push_x(k - 1)
        hx = prev + (push_x(k) - prev) * ease(seg(f, 0.0, 0.42))
    if u > a1:
        hx = push_x(npush - 1) + 110 * ease(seg(u, 0.66, 0.98))

    def appear(i):
        if u < a0:
            return 0.0
        j = min(npush - 1, next((m for m in range(npush) if i < start[m] + per[m]), npush - 1))
        if j < k:
            return 1.0
        if j > k:
            return 0.0
        q = seg(f, 0.38, 0.9) * (per[j] + 3) - (i - start[j])
        return clamp(q / 3.0)

    # the store: ceiling lights, the back wall, a polished floor
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (64, 62, 66)), (0.35, (150, 148, 144)), (1, (210, 206, 196))], 0, BASE)
    for i in range(5):
        lx = 80 + i * 230
        glow(cr, lx + 80, 170, 180, (255, 242, 214), 0.45)
        box(cr, lx, 180, 160, 18, (246, 244, 236), depth=30)
    for i in range(12):
        bx = -20 + i * 100
        box(cr, bx, 1180, 84, 360, (150, 146, 140), depth=16)
        for r_ in range(5):
            for c_ in range(3):
                col = [(190, 70, 60), (214, 168, 70), (80, 124, 170), (110, 156, 90)][(i + r_ + c_) % 4]
                cr.rectangle(bx + 6 + c_ * 26, 1170 - 30 - r_ * 66, 20, 30)
                cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(col, 0.85))
                cr.fill()
    haze(cr, 700, 1200, (196, 194, 188), a=0.6)
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (176, 170, 160)), (1, (120, 114, 106))], BASE - 20, H)
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(0, BASE - 20, W, H - BASE + 20)
    cr.clip()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((86, 80, 72), 0.3))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(14):
        cr.move_to(540, 1100)
        cr.line_to(-900 + i * 220, H)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()
    glow(cr, 540, 1520, 520, (255, 236, 200), 0.18)

    # the shelf unit, three-quarter, throwing its shadow
    cast_shadow(cr, 90, 950, BASE, length=220, a=0.22)
    contact_shadow(cr, 520, BASE, 900, a=0.4)
    box(cr, 90, BASE, 860, 690, (196, 200, 206), depth=110)
    cr.rectangle(X0, 734, XW, 1340 - 734)
    solid(cr, (150, 156, 168), rim=False)
    for y in shelf_y:
        box(cr, 104, y + 14, 832, 14, (226, 228, 232), depth=36, finish="metal")

    # the cartons, one per model
    bands = [P["accent2"], (96, 104, 120), (134, 150, 172)]
    for i in range(N):
        q = appear(i)
        if q <= 0:
            continue
        c, r = i // 5, i % 5
        w = sw * (0.70 + 0.12 * ((i * 7) % 3) / 2.0)
        h = 66 + (i * 37) % 26
        bx = X0 + c * sw + (sw - w) / 2
        drop = 40 * (1 - pop(q))
        _ha_pack(cr, bx, shelf_y[r] - drop, w, h, bands[(i * 5 + c) % 3], a=clamp(q * 2.5))

    # the header board over the bay, its lettering on its own face
    box(cr, 120, 716, 800, 56, P["accent2"], depth=40)
    text(cr, "HEARING AIDS", 520, 704, 38, look.INK, face="bold", anchor="center", shadow=False)

    # THE SCALE on the shelf itself: a price-rail tag on the top shelf's lip
    # every 20 models filled, far above the aisle so Data never stands over it
    top_lip = shelf_y[4] + 2
    for m in range(20, N + 1, 20):
        if appear(m - 1) < 0.999:
            continue
        tx = min(900.0, X0 + ((m - 1) // 5 + 1) * sw - sw / 2)
        cr.rectangle(tx - 28, top_lip, 56, 30)
        solid(cr, (250, 246, 230), rim=False)
        text(cr, str(m), tx, top_lip + 24, 24, (40, 40, 46), face="bold",
             anchor="center", shadow=False)

    # Data and his trolley on the aisle
    filled = sum(1 for i in range(N) if appear(i) >= 0.999)
    load = max(0, min(10, int(round(10 * (1 - filled / max(1, N))))))
    hands = _ha_cart(cr, hx, FLOOR, load)
    dx = hx - 66
    if u < a0:
        host("point", dx, FLOOR, 236)
    elif u < a1 + 0.04:
        host("grip", dx, FLOOR, 236, hands=hands, lower="follow", expr="strain")
    elif u < 0.66:
        host("cheer", dx, FLOOR, 236)
    else:
        host("grip", dx, FLOOR, 236, hands=hands, lower="follow", expr="happy")

    # right by the camera: a basket of boxes on the floor, a customer's cart
    # rolling through the aisle
    _ha_basket(cr, 860, 1860, 1.5)
    cx = -520 + 1700 * seg(u, 0.3, 1.0)
    _ha_trolley(cr, cx, 1800, 1.6)
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    done = N == 0 or (u >= a0 and appear(N - 1) >= 0.999)
    if done and u >= a0:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v1))} models", f"over-the-counter hearing aids · {l1}",
                    80, 500, size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v0))} models", f"over-the-counter hearing aids · {l0}",
                    80, 500, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

    cr.line_to(6, 134)
    cr.line_to(4, 168)
    cr.line_to(-4, 168)

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a padlocked glass cabinet of hearing aids
    SUBSTANCE: the steel chain and padlock
    CAUSE: Data smashes the padlock with a sledgehammer so the chain drops, then pulls the glass door open by its handle
    THE HOOK, mid-action from frame one: hearing aids were locked behind a
    doctor, so the picture is the locked cabinet itself, a tall glass case
    with an Rx placard, two pairs of hearing aids on velvet, a heavy chain
    wrapped round it and a big brass padlock. Data's hammer is already
    coming down: the lock bursts on the strike, the chain slumps link by
    link to the floor, and he takes the door's low handle in both hands and
    swings it open. Done by 0.66 and held: the case open, its light on, Data
    still holding the door, a car passing the window."""
    FLOOR = 1160
    # a clinic room: pale wall, a window on the street, a tiled floor
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (176, 190, 200)), (1, (214, 222, 226))], 0, FLOOR)
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (170, 150, 128)), (1, (120, 100, 82))], FLOOR, H)
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(0, FLOOR, W, H - FLOOR)
    cr.clip()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((80, 64, 50), 0.35))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(14):
        cr.move_to(540, 700)
        cr.line_to(-1300 + i * 280, H)
    for i in range(7):
        yy = FLOOR + 30 * (1.55 ** i)
        cr.move_to(0, yy)
        cr.line_to(W, yy)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()
    cr.rectangle(0, FLOOR - 26, W, 26)
    solid(cr, (236, 238, 236), rim=False)
    # the window: sky, a row of houses, a car going by
    WX0, WX1, WY0, WY1 = 60, 380, 640, 820
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(WX0, WY0, WX1 - WX0, WY1 - WY0)
    cr.clip()
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (150, 196, 230)), (1, (224, 236, 240))], WY0, WY1, WX0, WX1)
    for i in range(5):
        box(cr, WX0 - 20 + i * 76, WY1 - 34, 64, 70 + 18 * (i % 2), (196, 120, 96),
            depth=14)
    cx_ = WX0 - 140 + ((t * 300) % 600)
    box(cr, cx_, WY1 - 4, 120, 30, (46, 98, 168), depth=16, finish="gloss")
    box(cr, cx_ + 26, WY1 - 34, 64, 22, (46, 98, 168), depth=12, finish="gloss")
    cr.restore()
    cr.rectangle(WX0, WY0, WX1 - WX0, WY1 - WY0)
    cr.move_to((WX0 + WX1) / 2, WY0)
    cr.line_to((WX0 + WX1) / 2, WY1)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((244, 244, 240)))
    cr.set_line_width(14)
    cr.stroke()
    haze(cr, 0, FLOOR, (214, 222, 226), a=0.22)

    X0, X1, D, DY_ = 240, 820, 84, 52
    TOP, SHELF, BOT, BASE = 880, 1110, 1316, 1440
    us = 0.14                                # the strike
    o = ease(seg(u, 0.36, 0.66))             # the door swinging open

    cast_shadow(cr, X0, X1 + D, BASE, length=300, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, (X0 + X1) / 2 + 30, BASE + 4, X1 - X0 + 140, a=0.45)
    # the wooden plinth
    cr.move_to(X1, BASE)
    cr.line_to(X1 + D, BASE - DY_)
    cr.line_to(X1 + D, BOT - DY_)
    cr.line_to(X1, BOT)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (92, 62, 40))
    cr.rectangle(X0, BOT, X1 - X0, BASE - BOT)
    solid(cr, (134, 92, 58))
    # the inside of the case, lit when it opens
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(X0, TOP, X1 - X0, BOT - TOP)
    cr.clip()
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (46, 40, 44)), (1, (84, 64, 60))], TOP, BOT, X0, X1)
    glow(cr, (X0 + X1) / 2, SHELF - 60, 380, (255, 230, 180), 0.15 + 0.55 * o)
    for sy in (SHELF, BOT):
        cr.rectangle(X0, sy - 22, X1 - X0, 22)
        solid(cr, (130, 30, 48), rim=False, edge=False)
    for sy in (SHELF, BOT):
        _ha_aid(cr, 420, sy - 112, 0.85)
        _ha_aid(cr, 640, sy - 112, 0.85, flip=True)
    cr.restore()
    cr.rectangle(X0, SHELF - 4, X1 - X0, 10)
    solid(cr, (210, 230, 236), finish="glass", rim=False)
    # the side glass and the cap
    cr.move_to(X1, BOT)
    cr.line_to(X1 + D, BOT - DY_)
    cr.line_to(X1 + D, TOP - DY_)
    cr.line_to(X1, TOP)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (170, 196, 206), finish="glass", a=0.55)
    cr.move_to(X0 - 10, TOP)
    cr.line_to(X0 - 10 + D, TOP - DY_ - 6)
    cr.line_to(X1 + D + 10, TOP - DY_ - 6)
    cr.line_to(X1 + 10, TOP)
    cr.line_to(X1 + 10, TOP + 24)
    cr.line_to(X0 - 10, TOP + 24)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (120, 82, 52))
    # the Rx placard standing on top
    box(cr, 420, TOP - 22, 230, 86, (246, 244, 238), depth=26)
    text(cr, "Rx ONLY", 535, TOP - 46, 44, (200, 40, 40), face="bold",
         anchor="center", shadow=False)

    # the glass door, hinged on the left, the free edge swinging out
    ex = X1 - (X1 - X0) * 0.55 * o
    grow = 34 * o

    def dp(fx, fy):
        top_ = TOP + (-grow) * fx
        bot_ = BOT + grow * fx
        return X0 + (ex - X0) * fx, top_ + (bot_ - top_) * fy

    q = [dp(0, 0), dp(1, 0), dp(1, 1), dp(0, 1)]
    cr.move_to(*q[0])
    for p_ in q[1:]:
        cr.line_to(*p_)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (190, 214, 222), finish="glass", a=0.35)
    cr.move_to(*q[0])
    for p_ in q[1:]:
        cr.line_to(*p_)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 74, 82)))
    cr.set_line_width(12)
    cr.stroke()
    r0, r1 = dp(0.15, 0.08), dp(0.32, 0.08)
    r2, r3 = dp(0.12, 0.6), dp(0.04, 0.6)
    cr.move_to(*r0)
    cr.line_to(*r1)
    cr.line_to(*r2)
    cr.line_to(*r3)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 255, 255), 0.22))
    cr.fill()
    # the handle, low on the free edge, where his hands go
    h0, h1 = dp(0.95, 0.84), dp(0.95, 0.98)
    cr.move_to(*h0)
    cr.line_to(*h1)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 30, 34)))
    cr.set_line_width(18)
    cr.stroke_preserve()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((200, 204, 212)))
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    cr.stroke()

    # the chain wrapped round the case, and the padlock on it
    N = 17
    LX, LY = 700, 1150
    for i in range(N):
        x = 226 + i * (608 / (N - 1))
        y0 = 1150 + 46 * math.sin(math.pi * i / (N - 1))
        ang0 = math.atan2(46 * math.pi / (N - 1) * math.cos(math.pi * i / (N - 1)),
                          608 / (N - 1))
        d = abs(x - LX) / 600 * 0.08
        g = seg(u, us + d, us + d + 0.14)
        g = g * g
        yf = 1470 + 10 * math.sin(i * 1.7)
        y = y0 + (yf - y0) * g
        ang = ang0 + (0.3 * math.sin(i * 2.3) - ang0) * g
        _ha_link(cr, x + 20 * g * math.sin(i), y, ang, i % 2 == 1)
    if u < us:
        _ha_lock(cr, LX, LY - 50, 0.0)
    else:
        p = seg(u, us, us + 0.13)
        glow(cr, LX, LY + 80, 220, (255, 236, 170), 0.8 * (1 - p))
        rot = 1.3 * p
        _ha_lock(cr, LX + 40 * p, LY - 50 + (1388 - LY) * p * p, rot, shackle=False)
        sp = seg(u, us, us + 0.2)
        shx = LX + 220 * sp
        shy = LY + 10 - 200 * math.sin(math.pi * sp * 0.8) + 320 * sp * sp
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(shx, min(1452, shy))
        cr.rotate(5 * sp)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 40, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((26, 28, 34)))
        cr.set_line_width(20)
        cr.stroke_preserve()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((190, 194, 202)))
        cr.set_line_width(12)
        cr.stroke()

    # right by the camera: boxed hearing aids on the floor
    for j, (bx, by, bs) in enumerate(((40, 1880, 1.0), (760, 1860, 1.15))):
        contact_shadow(cr, bx + 130 * bs, by + 4, 300 * bs, a=0.35)
        box(cr, bx, by, 260 * bs, 170 * bs, (236, 230, 216), depth=60 * bs)
        _ha_aid(cr, bx + 130 * bs, by - 90 * bs, 0.5 * bs, flip=j == 1)
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    if u < 0.3:
        host("hammer", 850, 1460, 228, beat=0)
    else:
        g0, g1 = dp(1.0, 0.86), dp(1.0, 0.96)
        host("grip", ex + 46, 1460, 228, hands=[(g0[0] + 4, g0[1]), (g1[0] + 4, g1[1])],
             lower="follow", expr="happy" if o > 0.9 else "strain")

    if u < 0.4:
        fit_readout(cr, "LOCKED UP", "hearing aids, behind a doctor", 80, 520,
                    size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "NOT ANYMORE", "hearing aids, over the counter", 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.4, 0.46)), size=130)

stories.title: The ISS Needs An $843 Million Deorbit Vehicle
stories.hook: NASA will spend $843 million to bring the ISS down.
stories.closing: Ending the station safely matters to everyone living beneath its final path.
stories.question: Should the ISS be replaced?
stories.caption: The ISS has had people living aboard nonstop since November 2000. NASA now plans to deliberately crash it into the ocean by 2031 -- the deorbit vehicle contract alone is $843 million. Will you miss watching it fly over? Tell me below 👇

segments.say: The ISS has hosted people continuously for 24 years, making its planned ending feel almost unthinkable.
segments.illustrated_scene:
# scene standard: 2026-10-22
def _iss_rrect(cr, x, y, w, h, r):
    cr.new_sub_path()
    cr.arc(x + w - r, y + r, r, -math.pi / 2, 0)
    cr.arc(x + w - r, y + h - r, r, 0, math.pi / 2)
    cr.arc(x + r, y + h - r, r, math.pi / 2, math.pi)
    cr.arc(x + r, y + r, r, math.pi, 1.5 * math.pi)
    cr.close_path()


def _iss_lerp(a, b, z):
    return (a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * z, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * z)


def _iss_quad(cr, p):
    cr.move_to(*p[0])
    for q in p[1:]:
        cr.line_to(*q)
    cr.close_path()


def _iss_crew(cr, x, y, s, rot, suit):
    """A floating astronaut in a flight suit, arms out, drifting."""
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.rotate(rot)
    cr.scale(s, s)
    for dx in (-15, 15):
        _iss_rrect(cr, dx - 11, 30, 22, 72, 9)
        solid(cr, suit)
    for sg in (-1, 1):
        cr.move_to(sg * 26, -36)
        cr.line_to(sg * 72, -12)
        cr.line_to(sg * 66, 4)
        cr.line_to(sg * 24, -14)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, suit)
    _iss_rrect(cr, -31, -44, 62, 84, 16)
    solid(cr, suit)
    disc(cr, -12, -22, 8, P["accent2"])
    disc(cr, 0, -70, 27, (228, 190, 158))
    cr.restore()


def _iss_tally(s):
    """The two ends of tally stroke s: four uprights, then the slash across."""
    g, q = divmod(s, 5)
    row, col = divmod(g, 3)
    gx = 225 + col * 240
    top = 720 + row * 300
    bot = top + 200
    if q < 4:
        x = gx + q * 38
        return (x + 6, top), (x - 2, bot)
    return (gx - 22, bot - 40), (gx + 3 * 38 + 22, top + 50)


def _iss_marker(cr, tip):
    """A fat marker pen, nib on the board, barrel back toward his hands."""
    ang = math.atan2(52, -120)
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(*tip)
    cr.rotate(ang)
    _iss_rrect(cr, 14, -14, 120, 28, 10)
    solid(cr, (238, 238, 232), finish="gloss")
    _iss_rrect(cr, 104, -15, 34, 30, 10)
    solid(cr, (40, 70, 150), finish="gloss")
    cr.move_to(0, 0)
    cr.line_to(16, -10)
    cr.line_to(16, 10)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (30, 40, 70))
    cr.restore()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: tally marks on the station wall
    SUBSTANCE: marker-ink tally strokes
    CAUSE: Data draws one tally stroke per year onto the station's wall with a marker held in both hands
    Inside a module of the space station (racks, handrails, the Earth
    turning past the window overhead) the far bulkhead is a white board,
    and on it the crew keep count the way anyone stuck somewhere counts:
    tally marks, four up and one across. Data floats along the board and
    draws one stroke per year since the first crew moved in, row after
    row, until all of them are up — the count itself is the scale, five to
    a gate. The years the count runs between sit in the board's lower
    right corner, well clear of where he works. Done by 0.62 and held: he
    floats down clear of the board and holds the marker up while a
    crewmate drifts past the camera."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (lab0, v0), (lab1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    N = int(clamp(round(v1 - v0), 1, 30))
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.62
    tt = clamp((u - a0) / (a1 - a0)) * N if u >= a0 else 0.0
    done_n = min(N, int(tt))
    local = tt - done_n

    # ---- the module, running away from the camera ----
    NTL, NTR, NBR, NBL = (0, 0), (W, 0), (W, H), (0, H)
    FTL, FTR, FBR, FBL = (140, 600), (940, 600), (940, 1380), (140, 1380)
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (60, 62, 70)), (1, (40, 42, 48))], 0, H)
    _iss_quad(cr, [NTL, NTR, FTR, FTL])
    solid(cr, (214, 212, 204), edge=False)
    _iss_quad(cr, [NTL, FTL, FBL, NBL])
    solid(cr, (196, 194, 186), edge=False)
    _iss_quad(cr, [NTR, NBR, FBR, FTR])
    solid(cr, (176, 174, 168), edge=False)
    _iss_quad(cr, [NBL, FBL, FBR, NBR])
    solid(cr, (156, 154, 150), edge=False)
    for z in (0.25, 0.45, 0.62, 0.76, 0.88):
        tl, tr = _iss_lerp(NTL, FTL, z), _iss_lerp(NTR, FTR, z)
        bl, br = _iss_lerp(NBL, FBL, z), _iss_lerp(NBR, FBR, z)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 118, 112)))
        cr.set_line_width(5 * (1 - z) + 2)
        _iss_quad(cr, [tl, tr, br, bl])
        cr.stroke()
    for (na, fa, nb, fb) in ((NTL, FTL, NBL, FBL), (NTR, FTR, NBR, FBR)):
        for z0, z1, vv in ((0.3, 0.55, 0.55), (0.6, 0.8, 0.4)):
            p0 = _iss_lerp(_iss_lerp(na, nb, vv), _iss_lerp(fa, fb, vv), z0)
            p1 = _iss_lerp(_iss_lerp(na, nb, vv), _iss_lerp(fa, fb, vv), z1)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 110, 170)))
            cr.set_line_width(16 * (1 - z0))
            cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
            cr.move_to(*p0)
            cr.line_to(*p1)
            cr.stroke()
    for side in (0, 1):
        for z0 in (0.35, 0.6):
            na, fa = (NTL, FTL) if side == 0 else (NTR, FTR)
            nb, fb = (NBL, FBL) if side == 0 else (NBR, FBR)
            q = [_iss_lerp(_iss_lerp(na, nb, 0.2), _iss_lerp(fa, fb, 0.2), z0),
                 _iss_lerp(_iss_lerp(na, nb, 0.2), _iss_lerp(fa, fb, 0.2), z0 + 0.15),
                 _iss_lerp(_iss_lerp(na, nb, 0.4), _iss_lerp(fa, fb, 0.4), z0 + 0.15),
                 _iss_lerp(_iss_lerp(na, nb, 0.4), _iss_lerp(fa, fb, 0.4), z0)]
            _iss_quad(cr, q)
            solid(cr, (228, 222, 204))
            cx_ = sum(p[0] for p in q) / 4
            cy_ = sum(p[1] for p in q) / 4
            disc(cr, cx_, cy_, 9 * (1.2 - z0), (60, 160, 90), finish="gloss")
    for z in (0.2, 0.5):
        p = _iss_lerp((540, 0), (540, 600), z)
        glow(cr, p[0], p[1] + 40, 260 * (1 - z * 0.6), (255, 246, 226), 0.35)

    # ---- the window overhead: the Earth turning past ----
    WX, WY, RX, RY = 650, 250, 215, 112
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(WX, WY)
    cr.scale(1, RY / RX)
    cr.arc(0, 0, RX + 26, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (170, 172, 178), finish="metal")
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(WX, WY)
    cr.scale(1, RY / RX)
    cr.arc(0, 0, RX, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.save()
    cr.clip()
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (4, 6, 16)), (1, (10, 14, 34))], WY - RY, WY + RY)
    cr.save()
    cr.arc(WX, WY + 1040, 1100, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.clip()
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (90, 170, 230)), (0.3, (34, 96, 168)), (1, (20, 60, 120))],
          WY - RY, WY + RY)
    for i in range(7):
        lx = WX - 420 + ((i * 230 + t * 95) % 1150)
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(lx, WY + 30 + (i % 3) * 25)
        cr.scale(1.0, 0.45)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 60 + 20 * (i % 2), 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 140, 80), 0.95))
        cr.fill()
    for i in range(10):
        lx = WX - 420 + ((i * 140 + t * 95) % 1150)
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(lx, WY - 20 + (i * 37) % 120)
        cr.scale(1.0, 0.32)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 70, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((248, 250, 252), 0.9))
        cr.fill()
    cr.restore()
    glow(cr, WX, WY - 60, 260, (150, 200, 255), 0.35)
    cr.restore()

    # ---- the far bulkhead: the crew's board, and the tally (the hero) ----
    _iss_quad(cr, [FTL, FTR, FBR, FBL])
    solid(cr, (184, 182, 176), rim=False)
    _iss_rrect(cr, 160, 630, 760, 730, 26)
    solid(cr, (176, 180, 188), finish="metal")
    _iss_rrect(cr, 180, 650, 720, 690, 16)
    solid(cr, (242, 242, 236), finish="gloss")
    for bx, by in ((200, 670), (880, 670), (200, 1320), (880, 1320)):
        disc(cr, bx, by, 9, (120, 124, 132), finish="metal")

    INK_RGB = (30, 40, 70)
    cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
    cr.set_line_width(16)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(INK_RGB))
    for s in range(done_n):
        st, en = _iss_tally(s)
        cr.move_to(*st)
        cr.line_to(*en)
        cr.stroke()
    tip = _iss_tally(0)[0]
    if u >= a0 and done_n < N:
        st, en = _iss_tally(done_n)
        p = ease(seg(local, 0.3, 1.0))
        if p > 0:
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(INK_RGB))
            cr.move_to(*st)
            cr.line_to(*_iss_lerp(st, en, p))
            cr.stroke()
        if local < 0.3:
            prev = _iss_tally(done_n - 1)[1] if done_n > 0 else st
            tip = _iss_lerp(prev, st, ease(local / 0.3))
        else:
            tip = _iss_lerp(st, en, p)
    elif done_n >= N:
        tip = _iss_tally(N - 1)[1]
    # the years the count runs between, in the board's lower right corner,
    # far from every place he writes
    if u >= a0:
        text(cr, lab0, 700, 1312, 34, look.INK, face="bold", anchor="center")
    if done_n >= N:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(INK_RGB))
        cr.set_line_width(5)
        cr.move_to(748, 1300)
        cr.line_to(786, 1300)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.move_to(792, 1300)
        cr.line_to(778, 1290)
        cr.line_to(778, 1310)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.fill()
        text(cr, lab1, 840, 1312, 34, look.INK, face="bold", anchor="center")

    # ---- crew aboard: one floating by the wall, one drifting past the camera ----
    _iss_crew(cr, 995, 1010 + 20 * math.sin(t * 0.6), 0.7, 0.3 + 0.15 * t,
              (64, 92, 140))
    for j in range(2):
        cx_ = -260 + ((t * 120 + j * 760) % 1600)
        _iss_crew(cr, cx_, 1700 + j * 80, 1.7 + 0.2 * j, 0.5 + 0.2 * j,
                  (58, 80, 130))
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # ---- Data: writes every stroke with his own two hands on the marker ----
    fx_, fy_ = tip[0] - 95, tip[1] + 117
    if u < a0:
        host("point", fx_, fy_, 220)
    elif u < a1:
        _iss_marker(cr, tip)
        h1 = (tip[0] - 70, tip[1] + 30)
        h2 = (tip[0] - 100, tip[1] + 43)
        host("grip", fx_, fy_, 220, hands=[h1, h2], lower="follow", expr="strain")
    else:
        e = ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.08))
        lx, ly = fx_ + (300 - fx_) * e, fy_ + (1480 - fy_) * e
        host("hold_up" if u < 0.9 else "cheer", lx, ly, 220)

    # ---- the readout: the data's own years, and the span between them ----
    if done_n < N:

                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v1 - v0))} years",
                    f"nonstop aboard, a human record · {lab1}", 80, 520, size=130)

# scene standard: 2026-10-22
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a supply rocket lifting off its pad
    SUBSTANCE: the rocket and its exhaust
    CAUSE: Data pulls the launch lever down with his own hands and the next resupply rocket lifts off for the station
    Keeping the station running means a launch every year. A rocket stands
    under the gantry on a coastal launch pad at sunset. Data pulls the
    launch lever, the engines light, and the rocket climbs out of the frame
    toward the station in the sky. The next one rolls in on its crawler and
    he pulls the lever again. The bill shows by the first launch, $3 billion
    every year, and it stays up while the launches keep coming, year after
    year. That treadmill is why NASA wants out."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    annual = min(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    total = max(v for _, v in rows)
    a0, a1 = 0.06, 0.62
    span = (a1 - a0) / 3
    if u < a0:
        c, f, p = 0, 0.0, 0.0
    else:
        q = (u - a0) / span
        c, f = int(q), q % 1.0
        p = lever_pull(f, on=(0.16, 0.28), off=(0.8, 0.94))
    roll = 0.0 if (c == 0 or u < a0) else 520 * (1 - ease(seg(f, 0.0, 0.14)))
    lift = seg(f, 0.3, 0.85) if u >= a0 else 0.0
    lit = u >= a0 and f >= 0.27 and f < 0.88 and p > 0.9

    landscape(cr, t, "coast")
    birds(cr, t, y0=760, n=4, rgb=(50, 46, 60))

    # the gantry tower

    for yy in range(700, 1430, 110):

    cr.stroke()
    # its swing arm retracts as the engines light
    arm = 1 - ease(seg(f, 0.2, 0.3)) if u >= a0 else 1.0
    if roll < 1:
        cr.rectangle(430, 900, 170 * arm + 4, 18)
        solid(cr, (150, 46, 38), finish="metal")

    # the rocket: rolls in, stands, lights, climbs
    rx = 600 + roll
    by = 1420 + rdy
    if roll > 1:
        contact_shadow(cr, rx + 90, 1452, 260, a=0.35)
        box(cr, rx - 30, 1468, 240, 34, (90, 92, 98), depth=40, finish="metal")
    if lit:
        fl = 160 + 220 * ease(seg(f, 0.27, 0.4))
        glow(cr, rx + 90, by + fl * 0.5, 160, (255, 190, 90), 0.7)
        cr.move_to(rx + 40, by)
        cr.curve_to(rx + 30, by + fl * 0.5, rx + 80, by + fl, rx + 90, by + fl)
        cr.curve_to(rx + 100, by + fl, rx + 150, by + fl * 0.5, rx + 140, by)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (255, 170, 60), finish="gloss", edge=False)

        cr.curve_to(rx + 60, by + fl * 0.3, rx + 85, by + fl * 0.6, rx + 90, by + fl * 0.6)
        cr.curve_to(rx + 95, by + fl * 0.6, rx + 120, by + fl * 0.3, rx + 115, by)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (255, 240, 200), edge=False, rim=False)
    for sx in (-1, 1):
        bx = rx if sx < 0 else rx + 180

        cr.line_to(bx + 46 * sx, by)
        cr.line_to(bx, by - 130)

    cylinder(cr, rx, by, 180, 620, (236, 236, 232), finish="metal")
    cr.move_to(rx, by - 620)

    box(cr, 760, 1790, 220, 120, (214, 210, 200), depth=50, finish="metal")
    cr.rectangle(780, 1735, 180, 18)
    solid(cr, (30, 52, 130), rim=False)
    contact_shadow(cr, 200, 1742, 200, a=0.35)
    box(cr, 110, 1740, 170, 90, (214, 210, 200), depth=40, finish="metal")
    foreground(cr, "coast")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    GX = 400
    if u < a0:
        host("point", 200 + (GX - 200) * ease(u / a0), 1450, 240)

             expr="strain" if p > 0.5 else "happy")

    if u < a0:
        fit_readout(cr, "The ISS", "what NASA pays to keep it flying", 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)
    else:

def _iss_hcyl(cr, x0, x1, cy, r, rgb, cap=(214, 216, 222)):

    cr.scale(0.3, 1.0)

    solid(cr, cap, finish="metal")


def _iss_panel(cr, x, y, w, h):
    cr.rectangle(x, y, w, h)
    solid(cr, (34, 52, 104), finish="glass")

        cr.move_to(x + 3, y + h * j / 6)

def _iss_shuttle_path(cr, x, y, L):

    cr.move_to(x, y - 0.07 * L)

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: the space station and its tug
    SUBSTANCE: rocket fire pushing it down
    CAUSE: Data pulls the tug's throttle lever down and its engine fires, pushing the station toward Earth
    The deorbit ship flies in and docks on the end of the station. Laid
    over it, dashed, are Space Shuttles at the same price scale: one whole
    shuttle launch, then most of a second. The ship costs nearly two. Data
    walks along the station onto the tug as the shuttles are counted, then
    pulls its throttle lever down with his own hands, the engine lights and
    the whole station sinks toward the glowing atmosphere. Both numbers have
    landed by 0.46. After that the burn keeps going, the clouds race past
    below, and the station keeps sinking. The station rides low enough in
    the frame that Data is always below the readout, never under its words."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    (lb, vb) = max(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    (ls, vs) = min(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    vb = vb or 1.0
    ratio = vb / (vs or 1.0)

    SY0 = 990.0
    drop = 250 * ease(seg(u, 0.46, 0.72)) + 100 * seg(u, 0.72, 1.0)
    SY = SY0 + drop

    # space, stars, the Earth's limb
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (4, 6, 18)), (0.6, (10, 16, 40)), (1, (24, 40, 80))], 0, H)
    for i in range(60):
        sx = (i * 197.3) % W
        sy = (i * 131.7) % 1350
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((230, 236, 255), 0.35 + 0.5 * ((i * 0.37) % 1.0)))
        cr.arc(sx, sy, 1.5 + (i % 3), 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.fill()
    EX, EY, ER = 540, 3420, 2020
    glow(cr, EX, EY - ER, 900, (90, 160, 255), 0.35)
    cr.arc(EX, EY, ER, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    solid(cr, (40, 104, 186), finish="gloss", edge=False)
    cr.save()
    cr.arc(EX, EY, ER, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.clip()
    for i in range(9):
        land_x = ((i * 310 + t * 70) % 1700) - 300
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(land_x, 1480 + (i % 3) * 90)
        cr.scale(1.0, 0.35)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 140 + 40 * (i % 2), 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 130, 80), 0.85))
        cr.fill()
    for i in range(12):
        cx_ = ((i * 233 + t * 180) % 1600) - 260
        cy_ = 1430 + (i * 57) % 300
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(cx_, cy_)
        cr.scale(1.0, 0.32)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 120 + 30 * (i % 3), 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((250, 251, 254), 0.95))
        cr.fill()
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((140, 200, 255), 0.6))
    cr.set_line_width(26)
    cr.arc(EX, EY, ER + 10, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.stroke()
    haze(cr, 1380, 1560, (120, 180, 240), a=0.25)

    # reentry heat building on the station's belly as it sinks
    heat = clamp(drop / 300.0)
    if heat > 0:
        glow(cr, 400, SY + 90, 380, (255, 130, 50), 0.45 * heat)

    # the station: truss, arrays, modules
    TY = SY - 120
    cr.rectangle(40, TY - 10, 580, 20)
    solid(cr, (170, 172, 180), finish="metal")
    for px in (50, 150, 410, 510):
        _iss_panel(cr, px, TY - 150, 88, 135)
    for px in (50, 150):
        _iss_panel(cr, px, TY + 16, 88, 135)
    cr.rectangle(380, TY + 12, 16, 50)
    solid(cr, (150, 152, 160), finish="metal")
    _iss_hcyl(cr, 230, 400, SY, 70, (222, 222, 226))
    _iss_hcyl(cr, 395, 565, SY, 62, (232, 230, 224))
    disc(cr, 300, SY, 22, (90, 130, 180), finish="glass")

    # the deorbit tug flies in and docks on the end
    arrive = ease(seg(u, 0.02, 0.18))
    tx0 = 565 + 700 * (1 - arrive)
    tx1 = tx0 + 375
    _iss_hcyl(cr, tx0, tx1, SY, 55, (60, 62, 70), cap=(90, 92, 100))
    cr.rectangle(tx0 + 40, SY - 55, 120, 110)
    solid(cr, (198, 160, 70), finish="metal", rim=False)
    # its engine bell at the back
    cr.move_to(tx1 + 10, SY - 30)
    cr.line_to(tx1 + 60, SY - 52)
    cr.line_to(tx1 + 60, SY + 52)
    cr.line_to(tx1 + 10, SY + 30)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (110, 110, 118), finish="metal")

    # the price, laid over the tug as shuttles at the same scale
    L = 375.0 * vs / vb
    g1 = ease(seg(u, 0.18, 0.26))
    g2 = ease(seg(u, 0.36, 0.46))
    if g1 > 0 and arrive > 0.99:
        cr.save()
        cr.rectangle(tx0, 0, L * g1, H)
        cr.clip()
        _iss_shuttle_path(cr, tx0, SY, L)
        ghost(cr, a=0.95)
        cr.restore()
        text(cr, "1 shuttle launch", tx0 + L / 2, SY + 118, 28, look.INK,
             anchor="center", alpha=g1)
    if g2 > 0 and arrive > 0.99:
        cr.save()
        cr.rectangle(tx0 + L, 0, (375.0 - L) * g2, H)
        cr.clip()
        _iss_shuttle_path(cr, tx0 + L, SY, L)
        ghost(cr, a=0.95)
        cr.restore()

    # the throttle lever on the tug, at Data's chest, worked by his own hands
    burn_f = seg(u, 0.46, 1.0)
    pull = lever_pull(burn_f, on=(0.0, 0.08), off=(1.01, 1.02)) if u >= 0.46 else 0.0
    px_, py_ = tx0 + 190, SY - 150
    cr.rectangle(px_ - 8, py_, 16, 95)
    solid(cr, (80, 82, 90), finish="metal")
    hands = lever(cr, px_, py_, pull, length=70)

    # Data walks along the station onto the tug while the shuttles are counted
    walk_f = ease(seg(u, 0.18, 0.36))
    gx = px_ - 50
    hx = 300 + (gx - 300) * walk_f
    foot = SY - 55

    # the burn, only while the lever is down
    if pull > 0.5:
        fl = 150 + 40 * pull + 18 * math.sin(t * 6)
        glow(cr, tx1 + 60 + fl * 0.4, SY, fl, (255, 170, 80), 0.7)
        cr.move_to(tx1 + 58, SY - 46)
        cr.curve_to(tx1 + 60 + fl * 0.6, SY - 40, tx1 + 60 + fl, SY - 10, tx1 + 60 + fl * 1.1, SY)
        cr.curve_to(tx1 + 60 + fl, SY + 10, tx1 + 60 + fl * 0.6, SY + 40, tx1 + 58, SY + 46)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (255, 150, 60), finish="gloss", edge=False)
        cr.move_to(tx1 + 58, SY - 24)
        cr.curve_to(tx1 + 60 + fl * 0.4, SY - 18, tx1 + 60 + fl * 0.7, SY, tx1 + 60 + fl * 0.7, SY)
        cr.curve_to(tx1 + 60 + fl * 0.4, SY + 18, tx1 + 60 + fl * 0.2, SY + 22, tx1 + 58, SY + 24)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (255, 236, 170), edge=False, rim=False)

    # right by the camera: the corner of a solar array, close and big
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(-60, 1600)
    cr.rotate(-0.12)
    _iss_panel(cr, 0, 0, 420, 420)
    cr.restore()
    vignette(cr, a=0.3)

    if u < 0.18:
        host("point", hx, foot, 230)
    elif u < 0.36:
        host("think", hx, foot, 230)
    else:
        host("grip", gx, foot, 230, hands=hands, lower="brace",
             expr="strain" if pull > 0.5 else "happy")

    if g2 >= 0.999:
        fit_readout(cr, f"${int(round(vb))}M", "to push the ISS into the ocean",
                    80, 520, size=130)
        text(cr, f"{ratio:.1f}x", W - 80, 640, 90, look.INK, face="display",
             anchor="right", alpha=ease(seg(u, 0.46, 0.51)))
        text(cr, "a shuttle launch", W - 80, 685, 32, look.INK, anchor="right",
             alpha=ease(seg(u, 0.46, 0.51)))
    elif g1 >= 0.999:
        fit_readout(cr, f"${int(round(vs))}M", "one Space Shuttle launch",
                    80, 520, size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Deorbit ship", "NASA's 2024 contract", 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

segments.say: Nearly one in five 311 complaints in New York City is about noise. That's a huge slice of everything people report.
segments.illustrated_scene:
# scene standard: 2026-10-16.2
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a tall New York apartment block
    SUBSTANCE: blaring sound waves
    CAUSE: Data shoves a giant loudspeaker up to the block and its noise floods the lower floors
    The apartment block stands for every complaint the city takes: a
    brick New York walk-up with fire escapes and a water tower on the roof,
    on a real street under a far skyline. Shove by shove, Data rolls a
    huge loudspeaker up the sidewalk to the building, and the closer it
    gets the higher its sound waves wash up the facade: pale rings of
    sound rolling over the windows, which light up and blare, until
    exactly the noise share of the floors is drowned in it. The sound
    keeps its own look (rings of air), and only a bracket down the
    building's edge wears the accent, so the cut sits on the building
    itself. Done by 0.62 and held: the speaker keeps blaring and Data
    keeps his hands on it."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    tot = sum(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    noise = next((r for r in rows if "noise" in r[0].lower()), None)
    if noise is None:
        noise = min(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    rest_lab = next((r[0] for r in rows if r is not noise), "Everything else")
    share = noise[1] / tot

    n = 3
    a0, a1 = 0.06, 0.62
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    mv = ease(seg(f, 0.08, 0.72))
    step = 0.0 if u < a0 else (k + mv) / n
    done = u >= a1
    if done:
        step = 1.0
    fill = share * step

    landscape(cr, t, "town")

    # the neighbours: a far skyline of blocks down the street, under haze
    far = [(-40, 150, 520), (130, 300, 620), (700, 860, 560), (850, 1010, 680), (990, 1140, 480)]
    for i, (x0, x1, hh) in enumerate(far):
        fb = building(cr, x0, x1, 1300, hh, [(150, 132, 120), (128, 120, 118), (160, 140, 124)][i % 3],
                      roof="flat", boards=False)
        for r in range(int(hh // 70)):
            for c in range(3):
                cr.rectangle(fb["x0"] + 14 + c * (x1 - x0 - 20) / 3, fb["top"] + 24 + r * 70,
                             (x1 - x0) / 3 - 26, 34)
                cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((84, 92, 108), 0.8))
                cr.fill()
    haze(cr, 500, 1310, (206, 210, 220), a=0.5)

    # the sidewalk and the street running to the camera
    cr.rectangle(0, 1400, W, 110)
    solid(cr, (176, 172, 164), edge=False)
    for i in range(9):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((130, 126, 120)))
        cr.set_line_width(3)
        cr.move_to(i * 140, 1400)
        cr.line_to(i * 140 - 40, 1510)
        cr.stroke()
    cr.rectangle(0, 1500, W, 22)
    solid(cr, (150, 146, 140))
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (70, 72, 78)), (1, (46, 48, 54))], 1522, H)
    for i in range(6):
        cr.rectangle(60 + i * 190, 1700, 110, 14)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 200, 90)))
        cr.fill()

    # the apartment block: the whole of the city's complaints
    X0, X1, BASE, WH = 200, 720, 1440, 700
    cast_shadow(cr, X0, X1 + 120, BASE, length=340, a=0.32)
    contact_shadow(cr, (X0 + X1) / 2 + 40, BASE + 4, X1 - X0 + 160, a=0.4)
    b = building(cr, X0, X1, BASE, WH, (164, 86, 64), roof="flat", boards=False)
    top, base = b["top"], b["base"]
    fx0, fx1 = b["x0"], b["x1"]
    fw = fx1 - fx0
    hgt = base - top

    # the loudspeaker's position, shoved up the sidewalk to the block
    SY = 1490
    sx = 820 - 200 * step
    SW, SH = 170, 340
    cx, cy = sx, SY - 180
    power = 0.35 + 0.65 * clamp(step * 2.5)

    # THE SOUND washing up the facade: rings of air rolling out of the

        cr.clip()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 244, 220), 0.18))
        cr.rectangle(fx0, cut, fw, base - cut)
        cr.fill()
        for i in range(6):
            r0 = 90 + ((t * 300 + i * 120) % 720)

            cr.arc(cx, cy, r0, math.pi * 0.55, math.pi * 1.45)
            cr.stroke()
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 240, 210), a))
            cr.set_line_width(13)
            cr.arc(cx, cy, r0, math.pi * 0.55, math.pi * 1.45)
            cr.stroke()
        cr.restore()
        # the share in the accent: a bracket down the block's edge, and the line

        solid(cr, P["accent2"])
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"]))

        cr.line_to(fx1 + 20, cut)

    la = ease(seg(u, a1 - 0.06, a1))

             face="bold", anchor="center", alpha=la)

    # the loudspeaker itself, its own waves blasting toward the block

    contact_shadow(cr, sx + SW / 2, SY + 4, SW + 60, a=0.45)

    for (yy, rr) in ((SY - 250, 50), (SY - 110, 66)):

    for wx in (sx + 26, sx + SW - 26):

# scene standard: 2026-10-16.2
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: an office printer spitting out complaints
    SUBSTANCE: a printed paper log
    CAUSE: Data grips the printout's end with both hands and pulls, unspooling twice as much paper
    The city's complaint line at night: a big office printer on a desk prints
    the complaint log, and the paper hangs over the desk and runs out across
    the whole floor. Data takes the printout's end in his own two hands and
    walks it out: first left along the desk, then round and all the way back
    across the room toward the camera. The first pull is the 2010 length,
    which leaves a dashed fold on the paper with its year. The second pull
    doubles it to 2023, a ribbon of paper twice as long snaking across the
    floor. Everything lands by 0.62 and holds. After that the print head
    keeps running, the phone's line lights keep blinking and Data keeps
    holding the paper up."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    v1 = v1 or 1.0
    v0 = v0 or 1.0
    ratio = v1 / v0
    s0 = clamp(v0 / v1)
    g1 = ease(seg(u, 0.10, 0.30))
    g2 = ease(seg(u, 0.38, 0.62))
    L = s0 * g1 + (1.0 - s0) * g2

    # the printout's path across the floor: left along the desk, round,
    # then all the way back across the room toward the camera
    K = [(540.0, 1345.0), (300.0, 1362.0), (150.0, 1388.0), (92.0, 1424.0),
         (165.0, 1456.0), (420.0, 1476.0), (720.0, 1488.0), (960.0, 1496.0)]
    path = []
    nk = len(K)
    for i in range(nk - 1):
        p0 = K[max(i - 1, 0)]
        p1 = K[i]
        p2 = K[i + 1]
        p3 = K[min(i + 2, nk - 1)]
        for j in range(14):
            s = j / 14.0
            s2, s3 = s * s, s * s * s
            x = 0.5 * (2 * p1[0] + (-p0[0] + p2[0]) * s
                       + (2 * p0[0] - 5 * p1[0] + 4 * p2[0] - p3[0]) * s2
                       + (-p0[0] + 3 * p1[0] - 3 * p2[0] + p3[0]) * s3)
            y = 0.5 * (2 * p1[1] + (-p0[1] + p2[1]) * s
                       + (2 * p0[1] - 5 * p1[1] + 4 * p2[1] - p3[1]) * s2
                       + (-p0[1] + 3 * p1[1] - 3 * p2[1] + p3[1]) * s3)
            path.append((x, y))
    path.append(K[-1])
    cum = [0.0]
    for i in range(1, len(path)):
        cum.append(cum[-1] + math.hypot(path[i][0] - path[i - 1][0],
                                        path[i][1] - path[i - 1][1]))
    total = cum[-1] or 1.0

    def at(d):
        d = clamp(d, 0.0, total)
        i = 1
        while i < len(cum) - 1 and cum[i] < d:
            i += 1
        a, b = path[i - 1], path[i]
        sl = cum[i] - cum[i - 1] or 1.0
        f = (d - cum[i - 1]) / sl
        tx, ty = (b[0] - a[0]) / sl, (b[1] - a[1]) / sl
        x, y = a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * f, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * f
        hw = 100.0 + 0.25 * (y - 1335.0)
        return x, y, -ty * hw, tx * hw * 0.5

    # the office at night: a dark wall, a window onto the city
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (34, 38, 54)), (1, (62, 66, 84))], 0, 1260)
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (16, 22, 48)), (0.7, (48, 44, 82)), (1, (120, 86, 96))], 250, 890, 110, 970)
    glow(cr, 540, 880, 420, (255, 170, 120), 0.25)
    for i in range(11):
        bx = 110 + i * 82
        bh = 160 + ((i * 137) % 260)
        box(cr, bx, 890, 70, bh, (58, 62, 86), depth=14)
        for r_ in range(int(bh // 34)):
            for c_ in range(3):
                if (i * 7 + r_ * 3 + c_) % 4 == 0:
                    cr.rectangle(bx + 8 + c_ * 20, 890 - 24 - r_ * 34, 10, 14)
                    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 214, 140), 0.85))
                    cr.fill()
    haze(cr, 250, 890, (60, 60, 96), a=0.45)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((28, 30, 38)))
    cr.set_line_width(18)
    cr.rectangle(110, 250, 860, 640)
    cr.move_to(540, 250)
    cr.line_to(540, 890)
    cr.stroke()
    # carpeted floor running to the camera
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (92, 88, 92)), (1, (132, 124, 120))], 1250, H)
    glow(cr, 560, 1300, 520, (255, 236, 200), 0.18)

    # the desk and the printer on it
    cast_shadow(cr, 200, 880, 1330, length=260, a=0.28)
    contact_shadow(cr, 540, 1332, 720, a=0.4)
    box(cr, 200, 1330, 680, 120, (150, 108, 72), depth=70)
    contact_shadow(cr, 530, 1212, 580, a=0.45)
    box(cr, 250, 1210, 560, 300, (214, 214, 206), depth=110)
    # the paper feed tray on top, a stack of blank sheets in it
    box(cr, 320, 910, 330, 30, (190, 192, 186), depth=80)
    box(cr, 345, 890, 280, 16, (250, 248, 240), depth=70)
    # the control panel: a lit screen and its buttons
    cr.rectangle(690, 930, 96, 44)
    solid(cr, (40, 44, 56), finish="glass", rim=False)
    glow(cr, 738, 952, 60, (110, 200, 255), 0.35)
    cr.rectangle(698, 937, 80, 30)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 200, 250), 0.85))
    cr.fill()
    for bi in range(3):
        disc(cr, 706 + bi * 32, 994, 9, (170, 174, 182), finish="gloss")
    # the print window and its head, racing back and forth
    cr.rectangle(290, 960, 380, 70)
    solid(cr, (36, 40, 50), finish="glass", rim=False)
    hx_ = 310 + 300 * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * math.pi * 1.4))
    box(cr, hx_, 1022, 70, 50, (236, 238, 242), depth=12, finish="metal")
    disc(cr, 772, 1030, 11, (90, 220, 120), finish="gloss")
    # paper drawers either side of the output, with their handle slots
    for dx0 in (270, 680):
        for dy0 in (1080, 1145):
            cr.rectangle(dx0, dy0, 110, 52)
            solid(cr, (200, 200, 194), rim=False)
            cr.rectangle(dx0 + 30, dy0 + 18, 50, 10)
            solid(cr, (60, 62, 68), rim=False, edge=False)
    # the output slot
    cr.rectangle(420, 1092, 240, 16)
    solid(cr, (30, 32, 38), rim=False)

    PAPER = (246, 244, 236)
    INKL = (70, 74, 86)
    # the printout hanging over the front of the printer and the desk
    cr.rectangle(440, 1100, 200, 1345 - 1100)
    solid(cr, PAPER, rim=False)
    off = (L * total) % 30.0
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(440, 1100, 200, 1345 - 1100)
    cr.clip()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(INKL))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    for j in range(10):
        yy = 1080 + j * 30 + off
        cr.move_to(456, yy)
        cr.line_to(456 + 168 * (0.4 + 0.5 * ((j * 0.37) % 1.0)), yy)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()

    # the printout across the floor, as far as he has pulled it
    dL = L * total
    if dL > 2.0:
        samp = [d for d in cum if d < dL] + [dL]
        left, right = [], []
        for d in samp:
            x, y, ox, oy = at(d)
            left.append((x + ox, y + oy))
            right.append((x - ox, y - oy))
        cr.move_to(*left[0])
        for p_ in left[1:]:
            cr.line_to(*p_)
        for p_ in reversed(right):
            cr.line_to(*p_)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, PAPER, rim=False)
        # the printed lines, carried along with the end he pulls
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(INKL))
        cr.set_line_width(4)
        i = 0
        while True:
            d = dL - 40.0 - i * 30.0
            if d <= 6.0:
                break
            x, y, ox, oy = at(d)
            fr = 0.4 + 0.5 * ((i * 0.37) % 1.0)
            cr.move_to(x + ox * 0.82, y + oy * 0.82)
            cr.line_to(x + ox * (0.82 - 1.64 * fr), y + oy * (0.82 - 1.64 * fr))
            i += 1
        cr.stroke()
        # the fan-fold perforations
        cr.save()
        cr.set_dash([8, 8])
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 150, 156), 0.9))
        cr.set_line_width(3)
        i = 0
        while True:
            d = dL - 25.0 - i * 180.0
            if d <= 6.0:
                break
            x, y, ox, oy = at(d)
            cr.move_to(x + ox, y + oy)
            cr.line_to(x - ox, y - oy)
            i += 1
        cr.stroke()
        cr.restore()

    # THE SCALE on the paper: where the 2010 log ended (a dashed fold across it)
    mark_on = L > s0 + 0.12
    if mark_on:
        mx, my, mox, moy = at(s0 * total)
        cr.save()
        cr.set_dash([18, 12])
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((200, 50, 50), 0.95))
        cr.set_line_width(7)
        cr.move_to(mx + mox * 1.25, my + moy * 1.25)
        cr.line_to(mx - mox * 1.25, my - moy * 1.25)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.restore()

    # Data at the end of the printout
    ex, ey, eox, eoy = at(dL)
    fy = min(1500.0, ey + 6)
    hh = 220
    hy = fy - 0.5 * hh
    hands = [(ex - 80, hy), (ex + 80, hy)]
    if u >= 0.08:
        # the end he holds, lifted off the floor into his hands
        e1, e2 = (ex + eox, ey + eoy), (ex - eox, ey - eoy)
        if e1[0] > e2[0]:
            e1, e2 = e2, e1
        cr.move_to(*e1)
        cr.line_to(hands[0][0], hands[0][1])
        cr.line_to(hands[1][0], hands[1][1])
        cr.line_to(*e2)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, PAPER, rim=False)

    # right by the camera: the desk phone, every line blinking, off the hook
    contact_shadow(cr, 200, 1872, 320, a=0.45)
    box(cr, 50, 1870, 290, 110, (40, 42, 50), depth=64, finish="gloss")
    for r_ in range(3):
        for c_ in range(3):
            disc(cr, 84 + c_ * 34, 1790 + r_ * 26, 10, (196, 200, 208), finish="gloss")
    for li in range(4):
        on = int(t * 3.0 + li * 1.7) % 2 == 0
        col = (240, 70, 56) if on else (90, 40, 40)
        if on:
            glow(cr, 210 + li * 32, 1800, 26, (255, 90, 70), 0.6)
        disc(cr, 210 + li * 32, 1800, 10, col, finish="gloss")
    # the coiled cord to the handset
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 32, 38)))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    for k_ in range(41):
        q = k_ / 40.0
        cx_ = 320 + 120 * q + 10 * math.cos(q * 36)
        cy_ = 1840 - 70 * q + 10 * math.sin(q * 36)
        if k_ == 0:
            cr.move_to(cx_, cy_)
        else:
            cr.line_to(cx_, cy_)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(540, 1745)
    cr.rotate(-0.22)
    cr.rectangle(-120, -22, 240, 44)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (46, 48, 56), finish="gloss")
    for sx in (-1, 1):
        disc(cr, 540 + sx * 125 * math.cos(-0.22), 1745 + sx * 125 * math.sin(-0.22),
             38, (46, 48, 56), finish="gloss")
    cup(cr, 960, 1850, 1.2)
    vignette(cr, a=0.3)

    if u < 0.08:
        host("point", ex, fy, hh)
    elif u < 0.62:
        host("grip", ex, fy, hh, hands=hands, lower="brace", expr="strain")
    else:
        host("grip", ex, fy, hh, hands=hands, lower="stand", expr="happy")

    # the fold's year, drawn after Data, above the paper and clear of him
    if mark_on:
        mx, my, mox, moy = at(s0 * total)
        text(cr, l0, mx, my - abs(moy) - 30, 38, look.INK, face="bold",
             anchor="center")

    if g2 >= 0.999:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v1)):,}", f"noise complaints · {l1}",
                    80, 520, size=130)
        text(cr, f"{ratio:.0f}x", W - 80, 700, 90, look.INK, face="display",
             anchor="right", alpha=ease(seg(u, 0.62, 0.66)))
    elif g1 >= 0.999:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v0)):,}", f"noise complaints · {l0}",
                    80, 520, size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Noise calls", "to New York City's complaint line",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)
