# scene standard: 2026-10-16.2
def _plug(cr, x, y, rgb=(214, 172, 84), s=1.0):
    cr.rectangle(x - 9 * s, y - 30 * s, 18 * s, 38 * s)
    solid(cr, rgb, finish="metal", rim=False)
    disc(cr, x, y - 32 * s, 8 * s, (236, 200, 120), finish="metal")


def _cord(cr, x0, y0, x1, y1, sag=150, rgb=(26, 24, 30), w=10):
    cr.new_path()
    cr.move_to(x0, y0)
    cr.curve_to(x0 + 6, y0 + sag, x1 - 6, y1 + sag, x1, y1)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(rgb))
    cr.set_line_width(w)
    cr.stroke()


def _quad(cr, q):
    cr.new_path()
    cr.move_to(*q[0])
    for p_ in q[1:]:
        cr.line_to(*p_)
    cr.close_path()


def _pendant(cr, x, yb, s):
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((20, 18, 24)))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    cr.move_to(x, 0)
    cr.line_to(x, yb - 60 * s)
    cr.stroke()
    glow(cr, x, yb + 20 * s, 220 * s, (255, 222, 166), 0.3)
    _quad(cr, [(x - 22 * s, yb - 60 * s), (x + 22 * s, yb - 60 * s),
               (x + 74 * s, yb), (x - 74 * s, yb)])
    solid(cr, (54, 88, 72), finish="metal")
    disc(cr, x, yb + 4 * s, 14 * s, (255, 240, 200), finish="gloss")


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a city telephone switchboard
    SUBSTANCE: patch cords and lit lines
    CAUSE: Data plugs each new noise call's cord into a free line by hand and it lights up
    The closing, as one picture: New York's complaint line at night, a long
    switchboard running from right by the camera back into the room, an
    elevated train rattling past the window behind it. The WHOLE board is
    every call the line takes: its far lines are already busy and lit
    amber, and the nearest lines, the true noise share of the board, stand
    dark. Data lifts each noise cord off the shelf in his own two hands and
    plugs it in, and that whole line flares red and starts to ring, until
    the sign over the board is cut at the share and not one line is quiet.
    Done by 0.54 and held: the noise lines keep ringing, the clock's hand
    keeps sweeping, the trains keep coming, and Data keeps re-seating the
    last cord as the next call comes in."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    tot = sum(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    noise = next((v for l, v in rows if "noise" in l.lower()),
                 min(v for _, v in rows))
    other = next((l for l, v in rows if "noise" not in l.lower()), "Everything else")
    share = clamp(noise / tot)

    # the board in three-quarter view: near panel big on the left, the row
    # running back into the room to the right
    N, HP = 8, 720.0
    lanes = []
    x_, y_, s_ = 110.0, 1470.0, 1.0
    for j in range(N + 1):
        lanes.append((x_, y_, s_))
        x_ += 170 * s_
        y_ -= 26 * s_
        s_ *= 0.86

    def at(z):
        j = int(clamp(z, 0, N - 0.0001))
        a = clamp(z - j, 0, 1)
        x0, y0, s0 = lanes[j]
        x1, y1, s1 = lanes[j + 1]
        return x0 + (x1 - x0) * a, y0 + (y1 - y0) * a, s0 + (s1 - s0) * a

    def fp(z, b):
        x, y, s = at(z)
        return x, y - b * HP * s, s

    NL = 2 * N
    NN = max(1, min(NL - 1, int(round(share * NL))))

    def zl(L):
        return (L + 0.5) / 2.0

    def jack(L):
        x, y, s = fp(zl(L), 0.24)
        return x, y

    def sock(L):
        x, y, s = fp(zl(L), 0.16)
        return x, y

    def rest(L):
        x, y, s = fp(zl(L), 0.16)
        return x, y + 12 * s

    FOOT = 1490
    NOISE_PLUG = (232, 96, 80)
    W0, P0, a1 = 0.05, 0.2, 0.54
    span = (a1 - P0) / NN
    START = 640.0

    plugged = 0
    tint = 0.0
    for i in range(NN):
        fi = (u - P0 - i * span) / span
        if fi >= 0.65:
            plugged += 1
        tint += ease(seg(fi, 0.65, 0.95))

    held = None
    if u < W0:
        hx, hy = START, rest(0)[1]
    elif u < P0:
        g = ease(seg(u, W0, P0))
        r0 = rest(0)
        hx, hy = START + (r0[0] - START) * g, r0[1]
    elif u < a1:
        i = min(NN - 1, int((u - P0) / span))
        f = (u - P0 - i * span) / span
        pv = rest(0) if i == 0 else jack(i - 1)
        rv = rest(i)
        jv = jack(i)
        if f < 0.3:
            g = ease(f / 0.3)
            hx, hy = pv[0] + (rv[0] - pv[0]) * g, pv[1] + (rv[1] - pv[1]) * g
        elif f < 0.65:
            g = ease((f - 0.3) / 0.35)
            hx, hy = rv[0] + (jv[0] - rv[0]) * g, rv[1] + (jv[1] - rv[1]) * g
        else:
            hx, hy = jv
        if f >= 0.3:
            held = i
    else:
        f2 = ((u - a1) / 0.11) % 1.0
        jv = jack(NN - 1)
        hx = jv[0]
        hy = jv[1] + 60 * math.sin(math.pi * seg(f2, 0.1, 0.55))
        held = NN - 1

    def lit_of(i):
        if u >= a1:
            return 1.0
        return pop(seg((u - P0 - i * span) / span, 0.65, 0.85))

    # the room, full bleed: back wall into a wooden floor
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (30, 26, 36)), (0.25, (52, 46, 56)), (0.6, (72, 62, 66)),
               (0.615, (96, 72, 52)), (1, (42, 32, 26))], 0, H)
    # wainscot along the back wall
    cr.rectangle(0, 1090, W, 92)
    solid(cr, (92, 64, 46), rim=False)
    cr.rectangle(0, 1084, W, 10)
    solid(cr, (150, 112, 70), finish="metal", rim=False)
    # the floorboards running back to the far wall
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(0, 1182, W, H - 1182)
    cr.clip()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 22, 18), 0.45))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    for i in range(16):
        cr.move_to(1300, 1120)
        cr.line_to(-1100 + i * 220, H)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()

    # the window: New York at night, an elevated train going by
    WX0, WY0, WX1, WY1, GY = 470, 640, 1040, 1070, 1000
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(WX0, WY0, WX1 - WX0, WY1 - WY0)
    cr.clip()
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (14, 18, 44)), (0.7, (46, 40, 82)), (1, (120, 80, 94))], WY0, WY1, WX0, WX1)
    glow(cr, 600, 720, 90, (230, 226, 250), 0.3)
    disc(cr, 600, 720, 22, (236, 234, 244))
    for i in range(9):
        bx = WX0 - 20 + i * 70
        bw = 64 + (i * 37) % 44
        bh = 140 + (i * 53) % 170
        box(cr, bx, GY, bw, bh, (46, 52, 82), depth=10)
        for wy in range(int(GY - bh + 20), GY - 12, 26):
            for wx in range(int(bx + 8), int(bx + bw - 10), 20):
                if (wx * 7 + wy * 3) % 5 < 2:
                    cr.rectangle(wx, wy, 8, 11)
                    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 214, 140), 0.8))
                    cr.fill()
    haze(cr, WY0, GY, (70, 60, 100), a=0.35)
    ph = t % 2.8
    if ph < 2.1:
        lead = WX0 - 700 + (ph / 2.1) * 1500
        for k in range(3):
            x = lead + k * 192
            box(cr, x, GY, 180, 48, (176, 182, 194), depth=8, finish="metal")
            for wi in range(5):
                cr.rectangle(x + 12 + wi * 32, GY - 38, 20, 18)
                cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 226, 160)))
                cr.fill()
    cr.rectangle(WX0, GY, WX1 - WX0, 14)
    solid(cr, (40, 40, 48), finish="metal", rim=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 30, 36)))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    for i in range(16):
        cr.move_to(WX0 + i * 38, GY + 14)
        cr.line_to(WX0 + 19 + i * 38, WY1)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()
    cr.rectangle(752, WY0, 14, WY1 - WY0)
    solid(cr, (36, 34, 42), rim=False)
    cr.rectangle(WX0, WY0, WX1 - WX0, WY1 - WY0)
    edge(cr, (30, 28, 34), width=12)
    cr.rectangle(WX0 - 14, WY1 - 4, WX1 - WX0 + 28, 16)
    solid(cr, (110, 96, 90))
    haze(cr, 600, 1180, (80, 70, 84), a=0.25)

    # the wall clock: one call every 45 seconds, its hand never stops
    CX, CY, R = 760, 560, 58
    disc(cr, CX, CY, R + 10, (58, 60, 68), finish="metal")
    disc(cr, CX, CY, R, (238, 234, 224), finish="gloss")
    for i in range(12):
        a = i * math.pi / 6
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 40, 46)))
        cr.set_line_width(5 if i % 3 == 0 else 2)
        cr.move_to(CX + (R - 14) * math.cos(a), CY + (R - 14) * math.sin(a))
        cr.line_to(CX + (R - 4) * math.cos(a), CY + (R - 4) * math.sin(a))
        cr.stroke()
    ha = -math.pi / 2 + 2 * math.pi * t / 2.4
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"], 0.85))
    cr.set_line_width(7)
    cr.arc(CX, CY, R - 20, ha - 1.5 * math.pi, ha)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((24, 24, 30)))
    cr.set_line_width(9)
    cr.move_to(CX - 12 * math.cos(ha), CY - 12 * math.sin(ha))
    cr.line_to(CX + (R - 8) * math.cos(ha), CY + (R - 8) * math.sin(ha))
    cr.stroke()
    disc(cr, CX, CY, 8, (24, 24, 30), finish="metal")

    # the lamps hanging over the operators' room
    _pendant(cr, 300, 250, 1.0)
    _pendant(cr, 640, 200, 0.75)
    _pendant(cr, 930, 170, 0.55)

    # the board's shadows
    cast_shadow(cr, lanes[0][0], lanes[N][0], 1470, length=200, a=0.25)
    contact_shadow(cr, 540, 1476, 960, a=0.45)

    # the cabinets, far first
    for j in reversed(range(N)):
        p00, p10 = fp(j, 0), fp(j + 1, 0)
        p01, p11 = fp(j, 1), fp(j + 1, 1)
        _quad(cr, [p00[:2], p10[:2], p11[:2], p01[:2]])
        solid(cr, (126, 88, 58))
        s0, s1 = p01[2], p11[2]
        _quad(cr, [p01[:2], p11[:2], (p11[0] + 10 * s1, p11[1] - 16 * s1),
                   (p01[0] + 10 * s0, p01[1] - 16 * s0)])
        solid(cr, (176, 132, 86))
        # the dark jack field
        q = [fp(j + 0.07, 0.2), fp(j + 0.93, 0.2), fp(j + 0.93, 0.86), fp(j + 0.07, 0.86)]
        _quad(cr, [p_[:2] for p_ in q])
        solid(cr, (40, 36, 42), rim=False)
    # the near end of the row, turned toward the camera
    n0, n1 = fp(0, 0), fp(0, 1)
    _quad(cr, [n1[:2], n0[:2], (n0[0] - 38, n0[1] + 14), (n1[0] - 38, n1[1] + 14)])
    solid(cr, (92, 62, 42))

    # every line's strip: busy ones glow amber, the noise ones flare red
    for L in range(NL):
        z0, z1 = L / 2.0 + 0.06, (L + 1) / 2.0 - 0.06
        q = [fp(z0, 0.21), fp(z1, 0.21), fp(z1, 0.85), fp(z0, 0.85)]
        _quad(cr, [p_[:2] for p_ in q])
        if L >= NN:
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 196, 120), 0.14))
            cr.fill()
        else:
            lv = lit_of(L)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"], 0.6 * lv))
            cr.fill()
            if lv > 0:
                gx, gy, gs = fp(zl(L), 0.55)
                glow(cr, gx, gy, 220 * gs * lv, P["accent2"], 0.45)

    # jacks and lamps, brass-ringed
    for L in range(NL):
        z = zl(L)
        for b in (0.24, 0.32, 0.40, 0.48):
            x, y, s = fp(z, b)
            disc(cr, x, y, 10 * s, (176, 140, 80), finish="metal")
            cr.arc(x, y, 4.5 * s, 0, 2 * math.pi)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((10, 10, 12)))
            cr.fill()
        for k, b in enumerate((0.70, 0.78)):
            x, y, s = fp(z, b)
            on = L >= NN and (L * 3 + k) % 4 != 0
            cr.arc(x, y, 6 * s, 0, 2 * math.pi)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((250, 206, 124) if on else (70, 58, 50)))
            cr.fill()
        x, y, s = fp(z, 0.62)
        if L >= NN:
            glow(cr, x, y, 30 * s, (255, 210, 130), 0.6)
            disc(cr, x, y, 13 * s, (250, 206, 124), finish="gloss")
        else:
            lv = lit_of(L)
            disc(cr, x, y, 13 * s, (70, 40, 38), finish="gloss")
            if lv > 0:
                glow(cr, x, y, 70 * s * lv, P["accent2"], 0.9)
                disc(cr, x, y, 16 * s * max(0.5, lv), P["accent2"], finish="gloss")

    # the sign over the whole board, cut at the share as the noise lines light
    def _band(z0, z1, rgb):
        if z1 - z0 < 0.01:
            return
        top, bot = [], []
        for i in range(13):
            bx_, by_, bs_ = fp(z0 + (z1 - z0) * i / 12, 0.97)
            top.append((bx_, by_))
            bot.append((bx_, by_ + 0.07 * HP * bs_))
        cr.new_path()
        cr.move_to(*top[0])
        for p_ in top[1:]:
            cr.line_to(*p_)
        for p_ in reversed(bot):
            cr.line_to(*p_)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, rgb)
    cut = share * N * (tint / NN)
    _band(cut, N, (150, 152, 158))
    _band(0, cut, P["accent2"])
    if plugged >= NN:
        tx_, ty_, ts_ = fp(cut / 2, 0.915)
        text(cr, "NOISE", tx_, ty_, max(20, int(30 * ts_)), look.INK,
             anchor="center", shadow=False)
        tx_, ty_, ts_ = fp(cut + 0.25, 0.915)
        text(cr, other.upper(), tx_, ty_, max(18, int(28 * ts_)), (40, 30, 20),
             shadow=False)
    else:
        tx_, ty_, ts_ = fp(2.2, 0.915)
        text(cr, "NEW YORK CITY  ·  311", tx_, ty_, max(18, int(28 * ts_)), (40, 30, 20),
             shadow=False)

    # the keyboard shelf along the whole row
    back = [fp(N * i / 16, 0.16) for i in range(17)]
    front = [(x - 8 * s, y + 34 * s) for x, y, s in back]
    cr.new_path()
    cr.move_to(back[0][0], back[0][1])
    for x, y, s in back[1:]:
        cr.line_to(x, y)
    for p_ in reversed(front):
        cr.line_to(*p_)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (180, 136, 90))
    cr.new_path()
    cr.move_to(*front[0])
    for p_ in front[1:]:
        cr.line_to(*p_)
    for (x, y), (_, _, s) in reversed(list(zip(front, back))):
        cr.line_to(x, y + 20 * s)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (108, 74, 48))

    # every busy line's cord, hanging from its jack to the shelf
    for L in range(NN, NL):
        jx, jy = jack(L)
        sx, sy = sock(L)
        s = at(zl(L))[2]
        _cord(cr, jx, jy + 8 * s, sx + 10 * s * ((L % 3) - 1), sy, sag=70 * s,
              w=max(4, 10 * s))
        _plug(cr, jx, jy + 8 * s, s=s)
    # the noise cords: on the shelf, in his hand, or plugged in
    for i in range(NN):
        sx, sy = sock(i)
        if held == i:
            _cord(cr, hx, hy + 8, sx, sy, sag=110, rgb=(120, 34, 30), w=12)
            _plug(cr, hx, hy + 8, NOISE_PLUG)
        elif i < plugged:
            jx, jy = jack(i)
            _cord(cr, jx, jy + 8, sx, sy, sag=80, rgb=(120, 34, 30), w=12)
            _plug(cr, jx, jy + 8, NOISE_PLUG)
        else:
            rx, ry = rest(i)
            _plug(cr, rx, ry, NOISE_PLUG)

    # every noise line that is in rings, and keeps ringing
    for i in range(NN):
        lv = lit_of(i)
        if lv <= 0:
            continue
        x, y, s = fp(zl(i), 0.62)
        for k in range(2):
            ph_ = (t * 1.1 + i * 0.31 + k * 0.5) % 1.0
            rr = 40 * s + 190 * s * ph_
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((252, 240, 214), 0.75 * (1 - ph_) * lv))
            cr.set_line_width(7)
            cr.arc(x, y, rr, -0.8, 0.8)
            cr.stroke()
            cr.arc(x, y, rr, math.pi - 0.8, math.pi + 0.8)
            cr.stroke()

    # right by the camera: the operator's empty chair, a coil of spare cord
    contact_shadow(cr, 830, 1890, 320, a=0.45)
    for k in range(5):
        a = k * 2 * math.pi / 5 + 0.3
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 40, 46)))
        cr.set_line_width(14)
        cr.move_to(830, 1860)
        cr.line_to(830 + 130 * math.cos(a), 1870 + 40 * math.sin(a))
        cr.stroke()
        disc(cr, 830 + 130 * math.cos(a), 1878 + 40 * math.sin(a), 14, (30, 30, 34))
    cylinder(cr, 815, 1862, 30, 150, (120, 124, 132), finish="metal")
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(830, 1712)
    cr.scale(1.0, 0.3)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 160, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (110, 42, 36), finish="gloss")
    cr.new_path()
    cr.move_to(690, 1700)
    cr.curve_to(680, 1600, 700, 1560, 760, 1556)
    cr.line_to(900, 1556)
    cr.curve_to(960, 1560, 980, 1600, 970, 1700)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (126, 48, 40), finish="gloss")
    contact_shadow(cr, 240, 1830, 300, a=0.35)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((26, 24, 30)))
    cr.set_line_width(12)
    for k in range(4):
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(230 + k * 10, 1790 - k * 8)
        cr.scale(1.0, 0.42)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 130 - k * 8, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.stroke()
    _cord(cr, 350, 1780, 450, 1770, sag=30, w=12)
    _plug(cr, 450, 1770)
    vignette(cr, a=0.3)

    if u < W0:
        host("shock", START - 46, FOOT, 236)
    else:
        host("grip", hx - 46, FOOT, 236, hands=[(hx, hy + 4), (hx - 22, hy + 34)],
             lower="stand", expr="strain" if u < a1 else "shock")

    if plugged >= NN:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(share * 100))}%",
                    "of New York's complaint calls are about noise",
                    80, 520, size=130, max_w=640)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Noise", "New York's complaint line never goes quiet",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130, max_w=640)

stories.title: The World's Oldest Known Wild Bird Is Still Breeding At 74
stories.hook: Meet the bird older than the moon landing.
stories.closing: Wisdom's still raising chicks. The rest of us just have knees that hurt.
stories.question: What's the oldest living thing you've seen?
stories.caption: She's at least 74 years old, outliving every other wild bird we've ever tracked -- and she's still raising chicks. Here's how Wisdom the albatross has pulled it off. What's the oldest living thing you've seen in person? 👇

segments.role: 1 · HOW OLD THIS WILD BIRD REALLY IS
segments.topic: how old this wild bird is
segments.say: Wisdom the albatross is at least 74 years old. Most Laysan albatrosses live around 40 years in the wild. She's nearly doubled it.

segments.role: 2 · WHAT THIS BIRD DID WITH THE EXTRA TIME
segments.say: So she kept breeding. Wisdom has fledged an estimated 36 chicks, more than double what a typical albatross manages in a lifetime.

segments.role: 3 · WHY THIS BIRD GOT TO LIVE THIS LONG
segments.say: She nests at Midway Atoll, a protected refuge holding roughly a third of all Laysan albatrosses alive. Almost nothing preys on her there.

stories.title: Only 23% Of Americans Still Formally Volunteer
stories.hook: Volunteering is slipping, and the gap between graduates and everyone else is huge.
stories.closing: Civic duty didn't die, but when fewer people show up, your community's services pay for it.
stories.question: When did you last volunteer for something?
stories.caption: Formal volunteering through a group or organization hit a record low of 23% in 2021, and it still hasn't caught back up to 2008 levels. Here's where it went, and what it's worth in dollars. When's the last time you volunteered? 👇

segments.say: Volunteering hit a record low in 2021, with just 23% of Americans, then crept back up.
segments.illustrated_scene:
# scene standard: 2026-10-22
def _bb_at(s):
    """A point on the bucket line, from the barn (s=0) back to the trough (s=1)."""
    a, b, c = (540.0, 1320.0), (1000.0, 1365.0), (760.0, 1520.0)
    l1 = math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1])
    l2 = math.hypot(c[0] - b[0], c[1] - b[1])
    d = clamp(s) * (l1 + l2)
    if d <= l1:
        q = d / l1
        return (a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * q, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * q)
    q = (d - l1) / l2
    return (b[0] + (c[0] - b[0]) * q, b[1] + (c[1] - b[1]) * q)


def _bb_h(y):
    return 150 + 80 * clamp((y - 1300) / 220.0)


_BB_SHIRTS = [(70, 108, 158), (156, 72, 60), (88, 128, 88), (206, 168, 84),
              (112, 92, 142), (60, 120, 128), (176, 96, 64), (96, 100, 112),
              (140, 60, 84), (84, 140, 176)]
_BB_SKIN = [(226, 186, 150), (176, 124, 88), (236, 200, 168), (128, 86, 60)]
_BB_PAIL = (156, 160, 168)
_BB_WATER = (70, 140, 210)


def _bb_person(cr, x, fy, h, shirt, skin, walk, t):
    contact_shadow(cr, x, fy, 0.5 * h, a=0.3)
    sw = 0.08 * h * math.sin(t * 8.0) if walk else 0.0
    for side, off in ((-1, sw), (1, -sw)):
        lx = x + side * 0.07 * h
        cr.move_to(lx - 0.055 * h, fy - 0.48 * h)
        cr.line_to(lx + 0.055 * h, fy - 0.48 * h)
        cr.line_to(lx + off + 0.05 * h, fy)
        cr.line_to(lx + off - 0.05 * h, fy)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (58, 62, 76), rim=False)
    cr.move_to(x - 0.17 * h, fy - 0.46 * h)
    cr.line_to(x - 0.15 * h, fy - 0.78 * h)
    cr.curve_to(x - 0.08 * h, fy - 0.83 * h, x + 0.08 * h, fy - 0.83 * h,
                x + 0.15 * h, fy - 0.78 * h)
    cr.line_to(x + 0.17 * h, fy - 0.46 * h)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, shirt)
    disc(cr, x, fy - 0.9 * h, 0.095 * h, skin)
    # the bucket he is passing, held in front of him by its handle
    cylinder(cr, x - 0.09 * h, fy - 0.3 * h, 0.18 * h, 0.16 * h, _BB_PAIL, finish="metal")
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, fy - 0.46 * h)
    cr.scale(1, 0.3)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 0.075 * h, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(_BB_WATER))
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 72, 80)))
    cr.set_line_width(max(2.0, 0.015 * h))
    cr.arc(x, fy - 0.46 * h, 0.09 * h, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.stroke()
    hands = [(x - 0.05 * h, fy - 0.55 * h), (x + 0.05 * h, fy - 0.55 * h)]
    for (sx, sy), (hx, hy) in zip([(x - 0.13 * h, fy - 0.76 * h), (x + 0.13 * h, fy - 0.76 * h)],
                                  hands):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(shirt))
        cr.set_line_width(0.075 * h)
        cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
        cr.move_to(sx, sy)
        cr.line_to(hx, hy)
        cr.stroke()
        disc(cr, hx, hy, 0.04 * h, skin)


def _bb_gap(cr, x, fy, h):
    """Where a volunteer stood: their outline, their bucket dropped in a puddle."""
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x + 0.12 * h, fy - 0.01 * h)

    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(_BB_WATER, 0.8))
    cr.fill()
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x + 0.1 * h, fy - 0.07 * h)
    cr.rotate(1.35)
    cr.rectangle(-0.08 * h, -0.08 * h, 0.16 * h, 0.15 * h)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, _BB_PAIL, finish="metal")
    cr.new_path()
    cr.arc(x, fy - 0.9 * h, 0.095 * h, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.new_sub_path()
    cr.rectangle(x - 0.16 * h, fy - 0.79 * h, 0.32 * h, 0.79 * h)
    ghost(cr, a=0.8)


def _bb_flame(cr, x, base, w, h, t, i):
    sway = 0.18 * w * math.sin(t * 2.3 + i * 1.7)
    tip = h * (1 + 0.14 * math.sin(t * 3.1 + i * 2.3))
    cr.move_to(x - w / 2, base)
    cr.curve_to(x - 0.62 * w, base - 0.45 * tip, x - 0.2 * w + sway, base - 0.72 * tip,
                x + sway * 1.6, base - tip)
    cr.curve_to(x + 0.22 * w + sway, base - 0.66 * tip, x + 0.62 * w, base - 0.42 * tip,
                x + w / 2, base)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (236, 112, 36), finish="gloss", edge=False)
    w2, t2 = 0.55 * w, 0.6 * tip
    cr.move_to(x - w2 / 2, base)
    cr.curve_to(x - 0.6 * w2, base - 0.5 * t2, x + sway, base - 0.8 * t2, x + sway * 1.2, base - t2)
    cr.curve_to(x + 0.6 * w2, base - 0.5 * t2, x + 0.6 * w2, base - 0.3 * t2, x + w2 / 2, base)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (255, 210, 90), edge=False, rim=False)


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a bucket brigade at a burning barn
    SUBSTANCE: the volunteers with their buckets
    CAUSE: Data heads the line and pours each bucket on the fire; when volunteers walk off, the fire flares
    A barn is burning, and the town's volunteers form a bucket line from
    the trough to the door, one person per point of Americans who
    volunteer. In 2008 all 29 come and hold the fire down. In 2021 six walk
    off the line toward the camera, leaving their outlines and their
    dropped buckets in puddles, and the fire roars back up the roof: the
    record low of 23. By 2023 five walk back and the fire is beaten down
    again, one gap still empty. Landed by 0.62 and held while Data keeps
    pouring and the fire keeps burning."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    n = len(rows)
    vals = [int(round(v)) for _, v in rows]
    N = max(1, max(vals))
    low_v = min(v for _, v in rows)
    a0, a1 = 0.06, 0.62
    span = (a1 - a0) / max(1, n)
    if u < a0:
        k, mv = 0, 0.0
    else:
        k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
        f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
        mv = ease(seg(f, 0.0, 0.75))
    pv = vals[k - 1] if k > 0 else 0
    cv = vals[k]
    seen = max(vals[:k]) if k > 0 else 0
    landed_to = -1 if u < a0 else (k if mv >= 0.999 else k - 1)
    keep = sorted({round(i * (n - 1) / max(1, READOUT_SHOWS - 1))
                   for i in range(READOUT_SHOWS)}) if n > READOUT_SHOWS else list(range(n))
    named = max((i for i in keep if i <= landed_to), default=None)
    shown = None if named is None else rows[named]

    order = sorted(range(N), key=lambda i: (i * 0.6180339) % 1.0)
    rank = [0] * N
    for r, i in enumerate(order):
        rank[i] = r

    # who stands in the line this frame
    items = []
    present = 0.0
    for i in range(N):
        bx, by = _bb_at((i + 0.6) / (N + 0.2))
        bh = _bb_h(by)
        was = u >= a0 and rank[i] < pv
        now = u >= a0 and rank[i] < cv
        stag = ((i * 0.37) % 1.0) * 0.4
        g = clamp((mv - stag) / 0.6)
        if was and now:
            o = 0.0
        elif now:
            o = 1.0 - g
        elif was:
            o = g
        else:
            if u >= a0 and rank[i] < seen:
                items.append((by, "gap", bx, by, bh, i))
            continue
        present += 1.0 - o
        if o > 0.999 and not was:
            continue
        x = bx + 160 * o
        fy = by + 700 * o
        h = bh * (1 + 0.5 * o)
        if fy - h > H:
            continue
        if o >= 0.999:
            items.append((by, "gap", bx, by, bh, i))
            continue
        if was and not now and o > 0.0:
            items.append((by, "gap", bx, by, bh, i))
        items.append((fy, "person", x, fy, h, i, 0.0 < o < 1.0))
    short = max(1, N - min(vals))
    flare = clamp((N - present) / short)
    F = 0.45 + 1.4 * flare

    # the farm under a low sun, the barn in three-quarter view
    landscape(cr, t, "field")
    cast_shadow(cr, 100, 520, 1250, length=280, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, 330, 1254, 520, a=0.4)
    b = building(cr, 100, 520, 1250, 290, (176, 52, 40), roof="gambrel")
    mid = (b["x0"] + b["x1"]) / 2
    # smoke over the fire, thicker as it grows
    glow(cr, mid + 40, b["peak"] - 160 * F, 150 + 120 * F, (70, 64, 62), 0.25 + 0.2 * flare)
    glow(cr, mid, b["peak"] + 40, 260 + 160 * F, (255, 140, 50), 0.3 + 0.2 * flare)
    # the doorway, lit from inside by the fire
    dx0, dx1, dy0 = mid - 85, mid + 85, b["base"] - 210
    cr.rectangle(dx0, dy0, dx1 - dx0, b["base"] - dy0)
    solid(cr, (60, 30, 20), rim=False)
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(dx0, dy0, dx1 - dx0, b["base"] - dy0)
    cr.clip()
    glow(cr, mid, b["base"], 200, (255, 150, 60), 0.6)
    for j in range(3):
        _bb_flame(cr, dx0 + 35 + j * 50, b["base"], 70, (60 + 25 * j % 2) * F, t, j + 20)
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((244, 238, 226)))
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    cr.rectangle(dx0, dy0, dx1 - dx0, b["base"] - dy0)
    cr.stroke()
    # the roof on fire: tongues of flame that grow when the line thins
    rx0, rx1 = b["x0"] + 30, b["x1"] + 50
    for i in range(7):
        fx = rx0 + (rx1 - rx0) * i / 6.0
        dist = abs(fx - mid) / max(1.0, (rx1 - rx0) / 2)
        base = b["peak"] + 50 + 70 * dist
        fh = (90 + 60 * ((i * 0.37) % 1.0)) * F
        _bb_flame(cr, fx, base, 70 + 30 * F, fh, t, i)
    steam(cr, mid, dy0 + 30, t, strength=0.9)

    # right by the camera: the water trough the line starts from
    contact_shadow(cr, 870, 1782, 380, a=0.4)
    box(cr, 690, 1780, 330, 120, (132, 98, 66), depth=70)
    cr.move_to(700, 1662)
    cr.line_to(1010, 1662)
    cr.line_to(1070, 1612)
    cr.line_to(760, 1612)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, _BB_WATER, finish="glass", rim=False)

    # the line, far to near
    for it in sorted(items, key=lambda r: r[0]):
        if it[1] == "gap":
            _bb_gap(cr, it[2], it[3], it[4])
        else:
            _, _, x, fy, h, i, walking = it
            _bb_person(cr, x, fy, h, _BB_SHIRTS[i % len(_BB_SHIRTS)],
                       _BB_SKIN[i % len(_BB_SKIN)], walking, t + i)

    foreground(cr, "field")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data: points at the fire from the trough, runs to the head of the
    # line, and pours bucket after bucket; he is driven back when it flares
    w_ = ease(seg(u, a0, a0 + 0.12))
    sx_, sy_ = 880.0, 1500.0
    hx_, hy_ = 420.0 + 70 * flare, 1300.0
    dxp = sx_ + (hx_ - sx_) * w_
    fy = min(1500.0, sy_ + (hy_ - sy_) * w_)
    hh = 220 - 20 * w_
    pouring = False
    if u < a0 + 0.12:
        host("point", dxp, fy, hh)
    elif k == 1 and 0.15 < mv < 0.7 and vals[1] < vals[0]:
        host("shock", dxp, fy, hh)
    else:
        host("pour", dxp, fy, hh, beat=int(t / 1.2))
        pouring = True

    # each bucket he throws arcs onto the fire
    if pouring:
        p = (t % 1.2) / 1.2
        if 0.35 < p < 0.9:
            q = (p - 0.35) / 0.55
            S = (dxp - 40, fy - 0.6 * hh)
            E = (mid + 20, dy0 + 40)

            def _at(qq):
                return (S[0] + (E[0] - S[0]) * qq,
                        S[1] + (E[1] - S[1]) * qq - 170 * math.sin(math.pi * qq))
            p0, p1 = _at(max(0.0, q - 0.16)), _at(q)
            cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(_BB_WATER, 0.9))
            cr.set_line_width(30)
            cr.move_to(*p0)
            cr.line_to(*p1)
            cr.stroke()
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((170, 210, 245), 0.9))
            cr.set_line_width(10)
            cr.move_to(*p0)
            cr.line_to(*p1)
            cr.stroke()

    if shown is not None:
        lab, v = shown
        sub = f"of Americans formally volunteer · {lab}"
        if v == low_v:
            sub += ", a record low"
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v))}%", sub, 80, 520, size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Volunteering", f"Americans who formally volunteer, {rows[0][0]}–{rows[-1][0]}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a crowd of graduates in caps and gowns
    SUBSTANCE: orange hi-vis vests
    CAUSE: Data tosses an orange hi-vis vest to each person who signs up and they wear it
    Volunteer day in town: two crowds of twenty stand under the banner,
    college graduates in caps and gowns on the left, people with no degree
    on the right. Each crowd is one whole. Data walks along the front of
    them, pulling vests from the crate, and tosses a hi-vis vest (the kind
    event volunteers wear, a heart badge on the chest), one throw at a
    time, to each person in it who volunteers: 7 of the 20 graduates (37%),
    then 3 of the 20 others (16%). The vests stay on, so the share reads in
    each crowd at a glance: the graduates' side is more than twice as
    orange. Done by 0.66 and held; he holds up one more vest and a car
    rolls past on the street by the camera."""
    rows = sorted([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts], key=lambda r: -r[1])
    (hl, hv), (ll, lv) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    N = 20
    SHIRTS = [(84, 110, 150), (110, 138, 104), (132, 70, 78), (140, 144, 152),
              (70, 90, 120), (160, 150, 130)]
    SKIN = [(236, 196, 160), (198, 140, 100), (150, 100, 70), (226, 176, 132), (110, 74, 52)]
    FY = 1515

    def chosen(m):
        return [i for i in range(N) if (i + 1) * m // N > i * m // N]

    def spot(side, i):
        r_, c_ = divmod(i, 5)
        x0 = 14 if side == 0 else 548
        return x0 + 50 + c_ * 94 + (r_ % 2) * 47, 1080 + r_ * 120, 1.25 + 0.17 * r_

    def hxf(v):
        if v < 0.08:
            return 90 + 110 * ease(v / 0.08)
        if v < 0.42:
            return 200 + 240 * (v - 0.08) / 0.34
        if v < 0.48:
            return 440 + 240 * ease((v - 0.42) / 0.06)
        if v < 0.66:
            return 680 + 180 * (v - 0.48) / 0.18
        return 860.0

    FL = 0.09
    g_sel = sorted(chosen(int(round(hv / 100.0 * N))), key=lambda i: spot(0, i)[0])
    o_sel = sorted(chosen(int(round(lv / 100.0 * N))), key=lambda i: spot(1, i)[0])
    throws = []
    for j, i in enumerate(g_sel):
        gap = (0.42 - 0.08 - FL) / max(1, len(g_sel) - 1)
        throws.append((0.08 + j * gap, 0, i))
    for j, i in enumerate(o_sel):
        gap = (0.66 - 0.48 - FL) / max(1, len(o_sel) - 1)
        throws.append((0.48 + j * gap, 1, i))
    got = {}
    for la, side, i in throws:
        got[(side, i)] = la

    landscape(cr, t, "town", horizon=1000)
    # the street by the camera, with its kerb, where the car will pass
    cr.rectangle(0, 1772, W, H - 1772)
    solid(cr, (78, 80, 88), rim=False, edge=False)
    cr.rectangle(0, 1756, W, 18)
    solid(cr, (196, 192, 184), rim=False)
    for i in range(6):
        cr.rectangle(30 + i * 200, 1868, 110, 10)
        solid(cr, (226, 220, 196), rim=False, edge=False)

    # the volunteer-day banner behind the crowds
    for px in (110, 952):
        contact_shadow(cr, px + 9, 1062, 40, a=0.3)
        cylinder(cr, px, 1060, 18, 400, (120, 100, 80))
    cr.rectangle(128, 680, 824, 74)
    solid(cr, P["paper"])
    text(cr, "VOLUNTEER DAY", 540, 734, 50, P["paper_ink"], face="bold",
         anchor="center", shadow=False)
    cast_shadow(cr, 30, 1050, 1440, length=220, a=0.22)

    people = []
    for side in (0, 1):
        for i in range(N):
            x, y, s = spot(side, i)
            la = got.get((side, i))
            vest = la is not None and u >= la + FL
            people.append((y, x, s, side == 0, SHIRTS[(i * 5 + side) % len(SHIRTS)],
                           SKIN[(i * 3 + side) % len(SKIN)], vest))
    for y, x, s, grad, sh, sk, vest in sorted(people):
        _vol_person(cr, x, y, s, grad, sh, sk, vest)

    text(cr, hl.upper(), 280, 836, 34, look.INK, face="bold", anchor="center")
    right_lab = ll.upper()
    if u >= 0.66:
        right_lab += f" · {int(round(lv))}%"
    text(cr, right_lab, 810, 836, 34, look.INK, face="bold", anchor="center")

    # right by the camera, on the pavement: the crate of vests he hands out from
    contact_shadow(cr, 165, 1748, 250, a=0.4)
    box(cr, 40, 1748, 230, 110, (150, 110, 70), depth=44)
    for j in range(4):
        _vol_vest(cr, 92 + j * 48, 1630 + (j % 2) * 10, 1.8, -0.35 + 0.22 * j)

    # the vests in flight, from his hands to the volunteer
    k = -1
    for j, (la, side, i) in enumerate(throws):
        if u >= la:
            k = j
        p = (u - la) / FL
        if 0 < p < 1:
            x, y, s = spot(side, i)
            sx, sy = hxf(la) + 30, FY - 170
            ex, ey = x, y - 78 * s
            q = ease(p)
            vx = sx + (ex - sx) * q
            vy = sy + (ey - sy) * q - 140 * math.sin(math.pi * p)
            _vol_vest(cr, vx, vy, 1.5 + (s - 1.5) * q, (1 - q) * 4.0)

    # the world keeps moving once the story has landed: a car rolls past
    if u > 0.68:
        cx = -420 + ((u - 0.68) / 0.3 % 1.0) * (W + 840)
        _vol_car(cr, cx, 1905, 1.15, (48, 88, 150))
    foreground(cr, "town")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    hx = hxf(u)
    if u < 0.08:
        host("point", hx, FY, 230)
    elif u < 0.68:
        host("toss", hx, FY, 230, beat=max(0, k))
    else:
        host("hold_up", hx, FY, 230)

    if u < 0.43:
        fit_readout(cr, "Who volunteers", "college grads vs. no degree", 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(hv))}%", f"of {hl.lower()} volunteer", 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.43, 0.47)), size=130)
    if lv > 0 and u >= 0.62:
        text(cr, f"{hv / lv:.1f}x", W - 80, 600, 100, look.INK, face="display",
             anchor="right", alpha=ease(seg(u, 0.62, 0.66)))

def _rc_tape_route():
    """The receipt's centreline: out of the slot, down the cabinet, across the
    floor and curling toward the camera."""
    way = [(450, 1205), (450, 1330), (456, 1440), (560, 1496), (760, 1516),
           (960, 1522), (1024, 1584), (962, 1684), (730, 1770), (480, 1830),
           (290, 1866)]
    out = []
    m = len(way)
    for i in range(m - 1):
        p0 = way[max(0, i - 1)]
        p1 = way[i]
        p2 = way[i + 1]
        p3 = way[min(m - 1, i + 2)]
        for j in range(10):
            s = j / 10.0
            s2 = s * s
            s3 = s2 * s
            xy = []
            for c in (0, 1):
                xy.append(0.5 * (2 * p1[c] + (-p0[c] + p2[c]) * s
                                 + (2 * p0[c] - 5 * p1[c] + 4 * p2[c] - p3[c]) * s2
                                 + (-p0[c] + 3 * p1[c] - 3 * p2[c] + p3[c]) * s3))
            out.append((xy[0], xy[1]))
    out.append(way[-1])
    return out


def _rc_cut(route, L):
    """The route up to arclength L."""
    pts_ = [route[0]]
    acc = 0.0
    for i in range(1, len(route)):
        x0, y0 = route[i - 1]
        x1, y1 = route[i]
        d = math.hypot(x1 - x0, y1 - y0)
        if acc + d >= L:
            r = (L - acc) / d if d > 0 else 0.0
            pts_.append((x0 + (x1 - x0) * r, y0 + (y1 - y0) * r))
            return pts_
        acc += d
        pts_.append((x1, y1))
    return pts_


def _rc_length(route):
    return sum(math.hypot(route[i][0] - route[i - 1][0], route[i][1] - route[i - 1][1])
               for i in range(1, len(route)))


def _rc_offsets(pts_):
    """Half-width offsets across the paper: upright down the cabinet, lying
    flat (squashed) and widening toward the camera once it is on the floor."""
    offs = []
    n = len(pts_)
    for i, (x, y) in enumerate(pts_):
        ax, ay = pts_[max(0, i - 1)]
        bx, by = pts_[min(n - 1, i + 1)]
        dx, dy = bx - ax, by - ay
        d = math.hypot(dx, dy) or 1.0
        nx, ny = -dy / d, dx / d
        w = 150 + 130 * clamp((y - 1440) / 460.0)
        fy = 1.0 - 0.5 * clamp((y - 1420) / 60.0)
        offs.append((nx * w / 2, ny * w / 2 * fy))
    return offs


def _rc_tape(cr, pts_):
    if len(pts_) < 2:
        return
    offs = _rc_offsets(pts_)
    # the paper's own shadow on the floor, so it lies ON the tiles
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(10, 12)
    cr.move_to(pts_[0][0] + offs[0][0], pts_[0][1] + offs[0][1])
    for (x, y), (ox, oy) in zip(pts_[1:], offs[1:]):
        cr.line_to(x + ox, y + oy)
    for (x, y), (ox, oy) in reversed(list(zip(pts_, offs))):
        cr.line_to(x - ox, y - oy)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 48, 36), 0.25))
    cr.fill()
    cr.move_to(pts_[0][0] + offs[0][0], pts_[0][1] + offs[0][1])
    for (x, y), (ox, oy) in zip(pts_[1:], offs[1:]):
        cr.line_to(x + ox, y + oy)
    for (x, y), (ox, oy) in reversed(list(zip(pts_, offs))):
        cr.line_to(x - ox, y - oy)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (246, 242, 230))
    # the printed lines of the bill, one per stretch of hours
    acc = 0.0
    nxt = 30.0
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 66, 64), 0.75))
    for i in range(1, len(pts_)):
        x0, y0 = pts_[i - 1]
        x1, y1 = pts_[i]
        acc += math.hypot(x1 - x0, y1 - y0)
        while acc >= nxt:
            ox, oy = offs[i]
            r = 0.25 + 0.5 * ((nxt * 0.0137) % 1.0)
            cr.set_line_width(4 + 2 * clamp((y1 - 1440) / 460.0))
            cr.move_to(x1 - ox * 0.75, y1 - oy * 0.75)
            cr.line_to(x1 + ox * (r * 1.5 - 0.75), y1 + oy * (r * 1.5 - 0.75))
            cr.stroke()
            nxt += 36.0


def _rc_server(cr, x, y, s, i, t, tray=False):
    """A volunteer in a green apron: ladling behind the counter, or carrying
    a tray of bowls across the kitchen."""
    cr.move_to(x - 40 * s, y)
    cr.line_to(x - 34 * s, y - 120 * s)
    cr.curve_to(x - 26 * s, y - 140 * s, x + 26 * s, y - 140 * s, x + 34 * s, y - 120 * s)
    cr.line_to(x + 40 * s, y)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (232, 226, 214))
    cr.rectangle(x - 26 * s, y - 112 * s, 52 * s, 112 * s)
    solid(cr, (62, 132, 86), rim=False)
    if tray:
        box(cr, x - 70 * s, y - 120 * s, 140 * s, 10 * s, (170, 172, 178),
            depth=20 * s, finish="metal")
        for b_ in range(3):
            disc(cr, x - 42 * s + b_ * 42 * s, y - 136 * s, 15 * s, (236, 230, 216),
                 finish="gloss")
    else:
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(x + 30 * s, y - 110 * s)
        cr.rotate(0.9 + 0.25 * math.sin(t * 1.4 + i * 1.9))
        cr.rectangle(-6 * s, 0, 12 * s, 70 * s)
        cr.restore()
        solid(cr, (232, 226, 214), rim=False)
    disc(cr, x, y - 160 * s, 24 * s, [(214, 170, 132), (160, 112, 80), (232, 190, 150)][i % 3])
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y - 176 * s)
    cr.scale(1, 0.45)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 25 * s, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (240, 240, 236), rim=False)


def _rc_pantry(cr):
    """Wall shelves of donated food behind the serving line."""
    cans = [(196, 60, 50), (214, 170, 70), (80, 124, 170), (110, 156, 90), (230, 226, 214)]
    for sy in (690, 790):
        box(cr, -20, sy + 14, 1120, 14, (120, 92, 64), depth=18)
        x = 20
        i = int(sy / 10)
        while x < 1040:
            if (i % 5) in (1, 3):
                box(cr, x, sy, 62, 74, (196, 160, 112), depth=14)
                x += 82
            else:
                cylinder(cr, x, sy, 40, 56, cans[i % len(cans)])
                x += 52
            i += 1


def _rc_scroll(cr, x, y, s, flip=1):
    """A brass scroll curl on the register's front."""
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 86, 34), 0.9))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    cr.move_to(x, y)
    cr.curve_to(x + flip * 30 * s, y - 40 * s, x + flip * 70 * s, y - 10 * s,
                x + flip * 50 * s, y + 18 * s)
    cr.curve_to(x + flip * 36 * s, y + 34 * s, x + flip * 20 * s, y + 14 * s,
                x + flip * 34 * s, y + 4 * s)
    cr.stroke()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a giant antique cash register
    SUBSTANCE: the receipt paper
    CAUSE: Data pulls the register's side lever down with both hands and the bill for the volunteers' hours prints out across the floor
    Inside a community kitchen run by volunteers, a huge brass cash register
    rings up what their free hours are worth. Data pulls its side lever down,
    one pull at a time, and while he holds it down the receipt feeds out of
    the slot, down the cabinet and across the floor toward the camera — a
    bill nobody pays. The window says FREE while it prints; when the last
    pull lands (u=0.60) the register shows the total and the readout names
    it. Then Data lets go, walks along the bill and holds a torn-off length
    of it up, while a volunteer carries bowls across the kitchen."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    lab, val = rows[-1]
    yr = "".join(ch for ch in lab if ch.isdigit())[:4] or lab

    n = 4
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.60
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    if u < a0:
        prog, pull = 0.0, 0.0
    elif u < a1:
        prog = k + clamp((f - 0.18) / 0.66)       # it prints while the lever is held down
        pull = lever_pull(f, on=(0.0, 0.18), off=(0.84, 0.98))
    else:
        prog, pull = float(n), 0.0
    done = u >= a1

    route = _rc_tape_route()
    total = _rc_length(route)
    tape = _rc_cut(route, 24 + (total - 24) * prog / n)

    # the kitchen: warm wall, lamps, pantry shelves, the serving line under haze
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (88, 76, 68)), (0.45, (190, 172, 146)), (1, (150, 130, 108))], 0, H)
    for lx in (180, 540, 900):
        glow(cr, lx, 300, 260, (255, 232, 190), 0.45)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 56, 52)))
        cr.set_line_width(4)
        cr.move_to(lx, 0)
        cr.line_to(lx, 260)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.move_to(lx - 60, 300)
        cr.curve_to(lx - 50, 250, lx + 50, 250, lx + 60, 300)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (64, 98, 84), finish="gloss")
    cr.new_path()
    _rc_pantry(cr)
    cr.rectangle(660, 846, 380, 64)
    solid(cr, (64, 98, 84))
    text(cr, "COMMUNITY KITCHEN", 850, 890, 30, (244, 238, 226), anchor="center", shadow=False)
    for i, sx in enumerate((90, 260, 830, 990)):
        _rc_server(cr, sx, 1060, 1.0, i, t)
    box(cr, -40, 1170, 1160, 120, (172, 174, 180), depth=24, finish="metal")
    for px in (120, 900):
        contact_shadow(cr, px + 55, 1052, 120, a=0.3)
        cylinder(cr, px, 1050, 110, 70, (150, 154, 162), finish="metal")
        steam(cr, px + 55, 975, t, strength=0.8)
    haze(cr, 600, 1180, (214, 200, 178), a=0.4)
    # the floor, tiled, running to the camera
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (180, 162, 136)), (1, (116, 100, 82))], 1170, H)
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(0, 1170, W, H - 1170)
    cr.clip()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((90, 78, 64), 0.3))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(14):
        cr.move_to(540, 900)
        cr.line_to(-1100 + i * 250, H)
    for yy in (1230, 1310, 1420, 1570, 1770):
        cr.move_to(0, yy)
        cr.line_to(W, yy)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()
    glow(cr, 450, 1300, 520, (255, 220, 160), 0.18)

    # a volunteer carries a tray of bowls across the kitchen, again and again
    wx = -120 + ((t * 240) % 1340)
    contact_shadow(cr, wx, 1214, 90, a=0.3)
    _rc_server(cr, wx, 1212, 0.95, 1, t, tray=True)

    # THE REGISTER: carved wooden cabinet, brass keyboard, brass tower, crown
    cast_shadow(cr, 150, 880, 1440, length=260, a=0.25)
    contact_shadow(cr, 500, 1446, 820, a=0.45)
    box(cr, 150, 1440, 600, 260, (118, 74, 46), depth=130)
    # a kick plinth along the foot of the cabinet
    cr.rectangle(150, 1418, 600, 22)
    solid(cr, (84, 50, 30), rim=False)
    # two carved, brass-trimmed panels on the cabinet front
    for px0 in (180, 470):
        cr.rectangle(px0, 1206, 250, 120)
        solid(cr, (102, 62, 38))
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["brass"]))
        cr.set_line_width(5)
        cr.rectangle(px0 + 12, 1218, 226, 96)
        cr.stroke()
    _rc_scroll(cr, 220, 1266, 1.0, 1)
    _rc_scroll(cr, 680, 1266, 1.0, -1)
    # the cash drawer with two brass pulls
    cr.rectangle(190, 1342, 520, 70)
    solid(cr, (92, 56, 34))
    for hx_ in (250, 650):
        cr.rectangle(hx_ - 36, 1370, 72, 14)
        solid(cr, P["brass"], finish="metal")
    # brass corner posts
    for cx_ in (150, 736):
        cr.rectangle(cx_, 1180, 14, 238)
        solid(cr, P["brass"], finish="metal", rim=False)
    # the keyboard: brass deck, every key a ringed button on a stem
    box(cr, 190, 1180, 520, 120, P["brass"], depth=110, finish="metal")
    for r_ in range(3):
        for c_ in range(7):
            kx, ky = 228 + c_ * 72, 1088 + r_ * 32
            disc(cr, kx, ky, 16, P["brass_shade"], finish="metal")
            disc(cr, kx, ky - 2, 12, (240, 234, 214), finish="gloss")
    # the tower with a framed window, scroll work either side
    box(cr, 280, 1060, 340, 220, P["brass"], depth=90, finish="metal")
    _rc_scroll(cr, 296, 1010, 0.8, 1)
    _rc_scroll(cr, 604, 1010, 0.8, -1)
    # the crown: an arched brass crest with a finial
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(450, 842)
    cr.scale(1, 0.5)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 170, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, P["brass_shade"], finish="metal")
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(450, 842)
    cr.scale(1, 0.5)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 130, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 86, 34), 0.9))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.rectangle(442, 742, 16, 20)
    solid(cr, P["brass_shade"], finish="metal", rim=False)
    disc(cr, 450, 734, 20, P["brass"], finish="metal")
    # the window, framed in brass
    cr.rectangle(300, 870, 300, 120)
    solid(cr, P["brass_shade"], finish="metal")
    cr.rectangle(310, 880, 280, 100)
    solid(cr, (30, 26, 22), finish="gloss", rim=False)
    glow(cr, 450, 930, 150, (255, 196, 90), 0.25)
    if done:
        text(cr, f"${int(round(val))}B", 450, 958, 66, (255, 196, 90), face="display",
             anchor="center", shadow=False, alpha=ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.03)))
    else:
        text(cr, "FREE", 450, 952, 52, (255, 196, 90), face="display",
             anchor="center", shadow=False)
    # the slot the bill feeds from
    cr.rectangle(362, 1190, 176, 22)
    solid(cr, P["brass_shade"], finish="metal", rim=False)
    cr.rectangle(368, 1194, 164, 16)
    solid(cr, (24, 20, 18), rim=False, edge=False)
    # the side lever he pulls, on the cabinet's right side, leaning toward him;
    # short and low so both hands stay inside his reach through the whole arc
    disc(cr, 840, 1350, 34, P["brass"], finish="metal")
    disc(cr, 840, 1350, 24, P["brass_shade"], finish="metal")
    hands = lever(cr, 840, 1350, pull, length=84, up=0.2, down=1.25,
                  rgb=(70, 58, 44), knob=(150, 40, 34))

    # the bill itself, unrolling
    _rc_tape(cr, tape)

    # right by the camera: a slatted crate of donated cans
    contact_shadow(cr, 950, 1912, 280, a=0.4)
    for i in range(3):
        cylinder(cr, 838 + i * 70, 1800, 56, 70, [(196, 60, 50), (214, 170, 70), (80, 124, 170)][i])
    box(cr, 820, 1910, 230, 120, (186, 146, 98), depth=46)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 88, 54), 0.8))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    for yy in (1830, 1870):
        cr.move_to(822, yy)
        cr.line_to(1048, yy)
    cr.stroke()
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data: walks up, pulls the bill out, then reads it — taller and right
    # beside the lever so both hands reach it at the top and bottom of the arc
    GX, HH = 885, 240
    if u < a0:
        hx = 1060 - (1060 - GX) * ease(seg(u, 0.0, a0))
        host("point", hx, 1440, HH)
    elif u < a1 + 0.02:
        host("grip", GX, 1440, HH, hands=hands, lower="follow", expr="strain")
    else:
        w_ = ease(seg(u, a1 + 0.02, 0.97))
        hx = GX - 300 * w_
        hy = 1440 + 54 * w_
        host("hold_up", hx, hy, HH)
        # the torn-off length of the bill, up in his hands, a ragged tear
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(hx, hy - 248)
        cr.rotate(-0.08)
        cr.move_to(-90, -46)
        cr.line_to(90, -46)
        cr.line_to(90, 46)
        for j in range(9):
            cr.line_to(90 - 20 * (j + 1), 46 + (8 if j % 2 == 0 else 0))
        cr.close_path()
        cr.restore()
        solid(cr, (246, 242, 230))
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 66, 64), 0.75))
        cr.set_line_width(4)
        for j in range(4):
            yy = hy - 276 + j * 20
            cr.move_to(hx - 70, yy + 6)
            cr.line_to(hx + 20 + 15 * (j % 2), yy + 2)
        cr.stroke()

    if done:
        fit_readout(cr, f"${int(round(val))} billion",
                    f"of volunteer work, given free · {yr}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.05)), size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Free labor", f"US volunteer hours · {yr}", 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

stories.title: Japan Has One Vending Machine For Every 31 People
stories.hook: The country that put a vending machine on every corner is losing them.
stories.closing: Somewhere right now, a machine is selling hot soup to a total stranger.
stories.question: What's the strangest thing you've bought from one?
stories.caption: Japan still runs about 4 million vending machines, down from a peak of 5.6 million in 2000, but that's still one for roughly every 31 people. Here's why the count is shrinking, and what's actually inside them. What's the weirdest vending machine snack you've seen? 👇

segments.say: Japan has lost over a quarter of its vending machines since 2000. It still has about 4 million.
segments.illustrated_scene:
# scene standard: 2026-10-22

def _skyline(cr, t, base):

    blocks = [(-30, 150, 360), (120, 130, 470), (255, 170, 300), (430, 120, 520),
              (555, 160, 380), (720, 140, 450), (865, 120, 340), (990, 130, 420)]

            solid(cr, col, finish="gloss")
            for q in range(4):
                cr.rectangle(sx + 7, base - bh + 58 + q * bh * 0.14, 12, 12)
                cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 250, 236), 0.9))
                cr.fill()
    # power lines strung across the street
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 40, 48), 0.7))

    for k in range(3):

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a row of lit vending machines
    SUBSTANCE: the vending machines
    CAUSE: Data grips each vending machine by its side and drags it out of the row and off the street, one at a time
    One Tokyo street at dusk, city blocks and neon signs behind, with a wall
    of seven big drink machines under a striped awning: the WHOLE, filling
    the middle of the frame. Machines are taken from INSIDE the row, one at
    a time: Data grips one by its side and hauls it straight FORWARD, out of
    the line and down onto the kerb toward the camera, so it is plainly in
    front of the row, never sliding along it; then he drags it sideways off
    the street and out of the frame, its plug cord trailing and two scrape
    marks running from its old spot to where it went. Where each stood stays
    a dark empty gap in the row, a clean unfaded patch of wall with the
    unplugged socket and a dashed ghost of the machine, so the loss reads at
    a glance. The count of gaps is the share lost between the two years.
    Done by 0.62 and held: he braces against the row that is left while
    cans roll down the kerb toward the can bin by the camera."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    v0 = v0 or 1.0
    N = 7
    lost = clamp((v0 - v1) / v0)
    r = int(clamp(round(N * lost), 0, 3))
    WM, HM, S = 128, 400, 1.1
    MW, MH = WM * S, HM * S
    GAP, X0, BASE = 8, 22, 1460
    xs = [X0 + i * (MW + GAP) for i in range(N)]
    plan = [(5, 1), (1, -1), (3, 1)][:r]     # (machine, which way it goes)
    a0, a1 = 0.06, 0.62
    span = (a1 - a0) / max(1, r)
    if u < a0 or r == 0:
        k, f = -1, 0.0
    else:
        k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, r - 0.001))
        f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    if u >= a1 and r > 0:
        k, f = r - 1, 1.0
    FWD = 150                                # how far out of the row it comes

    def mpos(j, ff):
        i, d = plan[j]
        x0 = xs[i]
        fwd = ease(seg(ff, 0.10, 0.40))      # straight out of the line
        base = BASE + FWD * fwd
        sc = S * (1 + 0.16 * fwd)
        x0 -= (MW * 0.16 * fwd) / 2          # grows toward the camera, centred
        end = 880 if d > 0 else 30
        push = ease(seg(ff, 0.40, 0.84))     # dragged along the kerb
        off = seg(ff, 0.84, 1.0) ** 2        # and away out of the frame
        return x0 + (end - x0) * push + d * 520 * off, base, sc

    def grip_spot(j, ff):
        x_, b_, sc = mpos(j, ff)
        d = plan[j][1]
        hx = x_ + 4 if d > 0 else x_ + WM * sc - 4
        dx = x_ - 60 if d > 0 else x_ + WM * sc + 60
        fy = min(1500.0, b_ + 40)
        return dx, fy, [(hx, fy - 140), (hx, fy - 104)]

    landscape(cr, t, "town")
    # the city behind the shop, fading into the dusk
    _skyline(cr, t, 840)
    haze(cr, 300, 840, (214, 206, 200), a=0.45)
    # the shop wall the machines line, in three-quarter view
    cast_shadow(cr, -20, 1100, BASE, length=220, a=0.25)
    building(cr, -20, 1100, BASE, 640, (206, 196, 180), roof="flat", boards=False)
    # the striped awning over the whole row
    for i in range(12):
        xa = i * W / 12
        cr.move_to(xa, 860)
        cr.line_to(xa + W / 12, 860)
        cr.line_to(xa + W / 12 + 8, 920)
        cr.line_to(xa + 8, 920)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (200, 50, 42) if i % 2 == 0 else (244, 236, 220), rim=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 40, 36), 0.35))
    cr.rectangle(0, 920, W, 10)
    cr.fill()
    for lx in (130, 540, 950):               # paper lanterns swaying
        sw = 16 * math.sin(t * 1.1 + lx)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((50, 40, 36)))
        cr.set_line_width(3)
        cr.move_to(lx, 926)
        cr.line_to(lx + sw, 946)
        cr.stroke()
        glow(cr, lx + sw, 970, 80, (255, 170, 90), 0.45)
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(lx + sw, 970)
        cr.scale(1.0, 1.2)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 24, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        solid(cr, (214, 64, 44), finish="gloss")
    # pavement, kerb and road
    cr.rectangle(0, BASE, W, 160)
    solid(cr, (156, 152, 146), edge=False, rim=False)
    cr.rectangle(0, 1606, W, 22)
    solid(cr, (196, 192, 184), rim=False)
    cr.rectangle(0, 1628, W, H - 1628)
    solid(cr, (62, 64, 70), edge=False, rim=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 232, 220)))
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    for i in range(6):
        cr.move_to(i * 220 + 20, 1800)
        cr.line_to(i * 220 + 130, 1800)
    cr.stroke()

    removed = [p[0] for p in plan]

    def gone(j):
        return j < k or (j == k and f > 0.0)

    # where the hauled machines stood: a dark empty gap, a clean unfaded
    # patch of wall, the socket, and scrape marks out to where it went
    for j in range(r):
        if not gone(j):
            continue
        gx = xs[plan[j][0]]
        reveal = 1.0 if j < k else ease(seg(f, 0.10, 0.40))
        vgrad(cr, [(0, (120, 112, 102)), (1, (84, 78, 72))], BASE - MH, BASE,
              gx, gx + MW)
        cr.rectangle(gx + 8, BASE - MH + 8, MW - 16, MH - 16)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((232, 226, 214), 0.55))
        cr.fill()
        cr.rectangle(gx + 50, BASE - 300, 40, 56)
        solid(cr, (246, 244, 236), rim=False)
        for sx_ in (62, 78):
            cr.rectangle(gx + sx_, BASE - 282, 4, 14)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 30, 34)))
            cr.fill()
        # scrape marks dragged across the pavement
        mx, mb, msc = mpos(j, f if j == k else 1.0)
        ex = clamp(mx + WM * msc / 2, -40, W + 40)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 66, 62), 0.75 * reveal))
        cr.set_line_width(8)
        for off_ in (-36, 36):
            cr.move_to(gx + MW / 2 + off_, BASE + 6)
            cr.line_to(ex + off_, min(1600.0, mb - 4))
        cr.stroke()
        if j < k or (j == k and f > 0.3):
            cr.rectangle(gx, BASE - MH, MW, MH)
            ghost(cr, a=0.9)
            if j == 0:
                text(cr, l0, gx + MW / 2, BASE - MH - 18, 34, look.INK,
                     face="bold", anchor="center")

    # the row: every machine still standing in its own spot
    cast_shadow(cr, xs[0], xs[N - 1] + MW, BASE, length=200, a=0.25)
    for i in range(N):
        if i in removed and gone(removed.index(i)):
            continue
        _vm_at(cr, xs[i], BASE, S, WM, HM, i, t)

    # the machine being hauled, out in front of the row, its cord trailing
    if 0 <= k < r and 0 < f < 1.0:
        x_, b_, sc = mpos(k, f)
        gx = xs[plan[k][0]]
        cx_ = x_ + WM * sc / 2
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 30, 34)))
        cr.set_line_width(7)
        cr.move_to(gx + 70, BASE - 270)
        cr.curve_to(gx + 70, BASE - 60, cx_, b_ - 10, cx_, b_ - 60)
        cr.stroke()
        _vm_at(cr, x_, b_, sc, WM, HM, plan[k][0], t)

    # once the row is done: cans roll down the kerb
    if u >= a1:
        for j in range(2):
            ph = ((u - a1) / 0.14 + j * 0.5) % 1.0
            cx = 380 + 520 * ph
            _rolling_can(cr, cx, 1580 + 14 * j, ph * 9, [(220, 60, 50), (250, 200, 60)][j])

    # right by the camera: a can bin brimming with empties, cans in the road
    contact_shadow(cr, 915, 1905, 230, a=0.45)
    cylinder(cr, 820, 1905, 190, 210, (46, 96, 170), finish="gloss")
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(915, 1700)
    cr.scale(1.0, 0.22)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 66, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (22, 24, 30), rim=False)
    for q, (ox, col) in enumerate([(-38, (220, 60, 50)), (-4, (250, 200, 60)),
                                   (28, (80, 170, 90))]):
        cylinder(cr, 915 + ox - 14, 1706 - 4 * (q % 2), 30, 46 + 8 * (q % 2), col,
                 finish="gloss")
    cr.rectangle(842, 1770, 146, 44)
    solid(cr, (246, 244, 236), finish="gloss", rim=False)
    cylinder(cr, 900, 1806, 18, 30, (200, 202, 208), finish="metal")
    _big_can(cr, 230, 1880, 2.0, 1.3, (220, 60, 50))
    _big_can(cr, 520, 1900, 1.5, 3.1, (250, 200, 60))
    foreground(cr, "town", y0=1640)
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data hauls each machine out with his own hands; between hauls he walks
    # to the next one with his arms up, ready to take it
    HH = 230
    if r == 0 or u < a0:
        if r:
            sx, sy, _ = grip_spot(0, 0.0)
        else:
            sx, sy = xs[N - 1] - 60, 1480
        host("point", sx, sy, HH)
    elif u < a1:
        if f < 0.10:
            sx, sy, _ = grip_spot(k, 0.0)
            if k > 0:
                px, py, _ = grip_spot(k - 1, 0.84)
                g = ease(seg(f, 0.0, 0.10))
                sx, sy = px + (sx - px) * g, py + (sy - py) * g
            host("hold_up", sx, sy, HH)
        elif f < 0.84:
            dx, dy, hands = grip_spot(k, f)
            host("grip", dx, dy, HH, hands=hands, lower="brace", expr="strain")
        else:
            dx, dy, _ = grip_spot(k, 0.84)
            host("hold_up", dx, dy, HH)
    else:
        px, py, _ = grip_spot(r - 1, 0.84)
        rest = [i for i in range(N) if i not in removed]
        near = min(rest, key=lambda i: abs(xs[i] + MW / 2 - px))
        side = 1 if xs[near] + MW / 2 < px else -1
        hx = xs[near] + (MW - 4 if side > 0 else 4)
        tx = hx + 60 * side
        ty = 1500.0
        g = ease(seg(u, a1, 0.72))
        dx = px + (tx - px) * g
        dy = py + (ty - py) * g
        if g < 1.0:
            host("hold_up", dx, dy, HH)
        elif u < 0.92:
            host("grip", dx, dy, HH, hands=[(hx, ty - 140), (hx, ty - 104)],
                 lower="brace", expr="strain")
        else:
            host("shock", dx, dy, HH)

    if r > 0 and u >= a1:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{v1 / 1e6:.1f}M machines", f"vending machines in Japan · {l1}",
                    80, 520, size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{v0 / 1e6:.1f}M machines", f"vending machines in Japan · {l0}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

segments.say: Japan has one machine for every 31 people. That's more than double the machines per person in the US.

# scene standard: 2026-10-22
def _vm_person(cr, x, y, sc, i, t, moving=0.0, a=1.0):
    coats = [(70, 96, 150), (178, 72, 60), (88, 128, 96), (210, 170, 80),
             (120, 90, 140), (60, 62, 70), (196, 120, 70)]
    skin = [(236, 200, 170), (214, 170, 132), (176, 128, 92)][i % 3]
    h = 80.0 * sc
    bob = 3.0 * sc * abs(math.sin(t * 9 + i)) * moving
    sw = 6.0 * sc * math.sin(t * 9 + i) * moving
    hip = y - h * 0.42 - bob
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 40, 46), a))
    cr.set_line_width(max(2.0, 6.0 * sc))
    cr.move_to(x - 4 * sc, hip)
    cr.line_to(x - 4 * sc + sw, y)
    cr.move_to(x + 4 * sc, hip)
    cr.line_to(x + 4 * sc - sw, y)
    cr.stroke()
    bw, bh = 24.0 * sc, h * 0.40
    r = 8.0 * sc
    bx, by = x - bw / 2, hip - bh
    cr.new_path()
    cr.arc(bx + r, by + r, r, math.pi, 1.5 * math.pi)
    cr.arc(bx + bw - r, by + r, r, 1.5 * math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.line_to(bx + bw, hip)
    cr.line_to(bx, hip)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, coats[i % len(coats)], a=a)
    disc(cr, x, by - 9.5 * sc, 9.5 * sc, skin, a=a)
    cr.new_path()
    cr.arc(x, by - 10.5 * sc, 9.8 * sc, math.pi * 1.05, math.pi * 1.95)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((36, 30, 28), a))
    cr.fill()


def _vm_slot(side, i):
    r, c = divmod(int(i), 10)
    cc = c if r % 2 == 0 else 9 - c
    y = 1300.0 - r * 30.0
    sc = 1.0 - 0.06 * r
    x = (255.0 - cc * 21.0) if side == 0 else (862.0 + cc * 21.0)
    return x, y, sc


def _vm_qpos(side, s):
    s = max(0.0, s)
    i0 = int(s)
    fr = s - i0
    x0, y0, s0 = _vm_slot(side, i0)
    x1, y1, s1 = _vm_slot(side, i0 + 1)
    return x0 + (x1 - x0) * fr, y0 + (y1 - y0) * fr, s0 + (s1 - s0) * fr


def _vm_machine(cr, x0, base, w, h, body, i):

        sy = wy + (r + 1) * wh / 3.0 - 6

        cr.move_to(wx + 4, sy + 2)
        cr.line_to(wx + ww - 4, sy + 2)
        cr.stroke()
        for c in range(5):
            cylinder(cr, wx + 8 + c * cw + 2, sy, cw - 8, wh / 3.0 - 22,
                     drinks[(r * 5 + c + i) % len(drinks)], finish="gloss")
    for c in range(5):
        disc(cr, wx + 16 + c * (ww - 32) / 4.0, wy + wh + 20, 7, (240, 236, 220), finish="gloss")
    cr.rectangle(x0 + w - 62, wy + wh + 44, 40, 90)

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: vending machines with queues of people
    SUBSTANCE: the line of people
    CAUSE: Data drags a second vending machine in by hand and the long line splits to it
    One station plaza, one vending machine, and the queue an American machine
    serves: 70 people snaking through the stanchions. Data grips a second
    machine by its edge and drags it in beside the first; the back of the
    line peels off and walks over, until each machine has Japan's 31. The
    old U.S. line stays as a dashed ghost round the stanchions, so the
    shorter line reads at a glance as less than half. Landed by 0.65 and
    held; afterwards both lines keep shuffling forward, one drink at a time."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    us = next((r for r in rows if "united" in r[0].lower()), max(rows, key=lambda r: r[1]))
    jp = next((r for r in rows if "japan" in r[0].lower()), min(rows, key=lambda r: r[1]))
    nu = max(2, min(90, int(round(us[1]))))
    nj = max(1, min(nu - 1, int(round(jp[1]))))
    ratio = us[1] / (jp[1] or 1.0)
    movers = nu - nj
    q2 = min(nj, movers)
    BASE = 1250.0
    MW, MH = 200.0, 520.0
    M1 = 280.0

    g = landscape(cr, t, "town", horizon=1000)
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (196, 190, 178)), (1, (150, 144, 134))], g, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 114, 104), 0.35))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(16):
        cr.move_to(540, g - 200)
        cr.line_to(-1200 + i * 230, H)
    cr.stroke()
    for i in range(8):
        y = g + 40 + (i * i) * 14
        cr.move_to(0, y)
        cr.line_to(W, y)
    cr.stroke()
    b = building(cr, 40, 900, 1080, 300, (214, 204, 188), roof="flat", boards=False)
    for k in range(6):
        cr.rectangle(80 + k * 136, b["top"] + 50, 90, 110)
        solid(cr, (150, 176, 196), finish="glass")
    haze(cr, 600, 1080, (226, 220, 210), a=0.3)

    slide = ease(seg(u, 0.10, 0.42))
    x2 = 1010.0 + (600.0 - 1010.0) * slide
    cast_shadow(cr, M1, M1 + MW, BASE, length=260, a=0.25)
    cast_shadow(cr, x2, x2 + MW, BASE, length=260, a=0.25)

    # the stanchion lanes for both queues
    for side in (0, 1):
        nrow = (nu - 1) // 10 + 1 if side == 0 else (q2 - 1) // 10 + 1
        for r in range(nrow + 1):
            y = 1300.0 - r * 30.0 + 14
            xa, xb = (52.0, 272.0) if side == 0 else (846.0, 1066.0)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((150, 40, 40), 0.9))
            cr.set_line_width(4)
            gap = 30 if r % 2 == 0 else 0
            cr.move_to(xa + (gap if side == 0 else 0), y)
            cr.line_to(xb - (0 if side == 0 else gap), y)
            cr.stroke()
            for px in (xa, (xa + xb) / 2, xb):
                cylinder(cr, px - 3, y + 6, 6, 30, (180, 182, 188), finish="metal")

    # the people
    people = []
    if u < 0.68:
        for i in range(nj):
            x, y, sc = _vm_slot(0, i)
            people.append((y, x, sc, i, 0.0, 1.0))
        for j in range(movers):
            i = nj + j
            st = 0.42 + 0.12 * j / max(1, movers - 1)
            f = ease(seg(u, st, st + 0.10))
            sx, sy, ss = _vm_slot(0, i)
            if j < q2:
                ex, ey, es = _vm_slot(1, j)
            else:
                ex, ey, es = 1180.0, 1290.0, 1.0
                if f >= 1.0:
                    continue
            x = sx + (ex - sx) * f
            y = sy + (ey - sy) * f + 90 * math.sin(math.pi * f)
            sc = ss + (es - ss) * f
            people.append((y, x, sc, i, 1.0 if 0 < f < 1 else 0.0, 1.0))
    else:
        cyc = int(t)
        sh = ease(seg(t - cyc, 0.0, 0.4))
        mv = 1.0 if 0 < sh < 1 else 0.0
        for side, n in ((0, nj), (1, q2)):
            for i in range(n + 1):
                s = i - sh
                idx = i + cyc + (0 if side == 0 else 1000)
                if s < 0:
                    hx, hy, hs = _vm_slot(side, 0)
                    people.append((hy + 120 * (-s), hx + (40 if side == 1 else -40) * (-s),
                                   hs, idx, mv, 1.0 - (-s)))
                else:
                    x, y, sc = _vm_qpos(side, s)
                    a = clamp(sh * 3) if i == n else 1.0
                    people.append((y, x, sc, idx, mv, a))
    people.sort(key=lambda p: p[0])
    for y, x, sc, idx, mv, a in people:
        if y < BASE:
            _vm_person(cr, x, y, sc, idx, t, mv, a)
    _vm_machine(cr, M1, BASE, MW, MH, (226, 226, 222), 0)
    _vm_machine(cr, x2, BASE, MW, MH, P["accent2"], 3)
    for y, x, sc, idx, mv, a in people:
        if y >= BASE:
            _vm_person(cr, x, y, sc, idx, t, mv, a)

    # the old U.S. line, kept as a ghost round its stanchions
    done = u >= 0.645
    if done:
        rl = (nu - 1) // 10
        ytop = 1300.0 - rl * 30.0 - 80.0 * (1 - 0.06 * rl) - 10
        cr.move_to(46, 1318)
        cr.line_to(276, 1318)
        cr.line_to(276, ytop)
        cr.line_to(46, ytop)
        cr.close_path()
        ghost(cr, a=0.9 * ease(seg(u, 0.645, 0.69)))

    # right by the camera: commuters walking through the plaza
    for j in range(2):
        px = -200 + ((t * 170 + j * 760) % 1500)
        _vm_person(cr, px, 1800 + j * 70, 3.0 + 0.3 * j, j + 4, t, 1.0)
    foreground(cr, "town")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    if done:
        rl = (nu - 1) // 10
        ytop = 1300.0 - rl * 30.0 - 80.0 * (1 - 0.06 * rl) - 10
        text(cr, "U.S. line", 50, ytop - 14, 30, look.INK, face="bold",
             alpha=ease(seg(u, 0.645, 0.69)))

    if u < 0.08:
        host("point", 970, 1330, 220)
    elif u < 0.44:
        dx = x2 - 40
        host("grip", dx, 1330, 220, hands=[(x2 + 8, 1150), (x2 + 8, 1195)],
             lower="brace", expr="strain")
    elif u < 0.9:
        host("hold_up", 560, 1330, 220)
    else:
        host("cheer", 560, 1330, 220)

    if done:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{nj} people", f"per vending machine in Japan · {ratio:.1f}x the US",
                    80, 520, size=130)

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a lit Japanese drink vending machine
    SUBSTANCE: cans of hot and cold drinks
    CAUSE: Data places cans into the machine's window column by column until drinks fill more than half of it
    One vending machine alone by a country road is the WHOLE: its lit sample
    window is cut at the true share. The right part already holds food,
    noodles and tickets; Data stocks the empty left part one column of cans at
    a time, cold drinks with blue buttons and hot ones with red buttons side by
    side in the same box, until drinks fill 55% of it, past a dashed line at
    half. Done by 0.56 and held. Then he holds up a steaming hot can and the
    delivery truck drives off."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    tot = sum(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    drink = next((r for r in rows if "bever" in r[0].lower() or "drink" in r[0].lower()),
                 max(rows, key=lambda r: r[1]))
    share = clamp(drink[1] / tot, 0.05, 0.95)

    WX0, WX1, WY0, WY1 = 290.0, 750.0, 720.0, 1100.0
    ww = WX1 - WX0
    cut = WX0 + ww * share
    NR = 4
    rh = (WY1 - WY0) / NR
    nd = max(1, int(round(share * 9)))
    nf = max(1, 9 - nd)
    dcw = (cut - WX0) / nd
    fcw = (WX1 - cut) / nf

    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.56
    span = (a1 - a0) / nd
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, nd - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    fly = seg(f, 0.0, 0.35)
    drop = ease(seg(f, 0.3, 0.62))

    def col_state(c):
        if u < a0 or c > k:
            return 0.0
        if c < k:
            return 1.0
        return drop

    # the setting: a lone country road at dusk
    landscape(cr, t, "field")
    birds(cr, t, y0=760, n=4, rgb=(60, 60, 70))
    haze(cr, 900, 1250, (230, 200, 170), a=0.25)
    # the delivery truck, parked, then driving off once the job is done
    tx = 120 - 560 * ease(seg(u, 0.62, 0.95))
    contact_shadow(cr, tx, 1290, 220, a=0.3)
    truck(cr, tx, 1270, 1.4)

    # the machine, three-quarter, throwing its long shadow
    MX, MB, MW, MH = 250.0, 1440.0, 540.0, 800.0
    cast_shadow(cr, MX, MX + MW, MB, length=320, a=0.32)
    contact_shadow(cr, MX + MW / 2, MB + 4, MW + 120, a=0.42)
    box(cr, MX, MB, MW, MH, (232, 234, 238), depth=120, finish="gloss")
    # the header, cut at the share: drinks in the accent, the rest neutral
    cr.rectangle(WX0, MB - MH + 22, cut - WX0, 50)
    solid(cr, P["accent2"], finish="gloss")
    cr.rectangle(cut, MB - MH + 22, WX1 - cut, 50)
    solid(cr, (150, 152, 158), finish="gloss")
    # the lit window
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(WX0, WY0, ww, WY1 - WY0)
    cr.clip()
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (60, 66, 78)), (1, (28, 30, 38))], WY0, WY1, WX0, WX1)
    glow(cr, (WX0 + WX1) / 2, (WY0 + WY1) / 2, 300, (255, 250, 230), 0.18)
    drinks = [(110, 70, 40), (90, 150, 80), (200, 40, 40), (180, 210, 235), (240, 150, 40)]
    for r in range(NR):
        sy = WY0 + (r + 1) * rh - 22
        cr.rectangle(WX0, sy, ww, 6)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((200, 204, 212)))
        cr.fill()
        for c in range(nd):
            st = col_state(c)
            if st <= 0:
                continue
            cx = WX0 + (c + 0.5) * dcw
            yy = sy - (1 - st) * (rh * (r + 1) + 40)
            _vm_can(cr, cx, yy, 1.0, drinks[(c + r * 2) % len(drinks)])
        for c in range(nf):
            cx = cut + (c + 0.5) * fcw
            _vm_snack(cr, cx, sy, 0.95, c + r)
    cr.restore()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 74, 84)))
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    cr.rectangle(WX0, WY0, ww, WY1 - WY0)
    cr.stroke()
    # the buttons under each slot: red is hot, blue is cold, side by side
    for c in range(nd):
        cx = WX0 + (c + 0.5) * dcw
        st = col_state(c)
        hot = c % 2 == 0
        disc(cr, cx, WY1 + 26, 11, (210, 50, 44) if hot and st > 0.5 else
             ((50, 110, 210) if st > 0.5 else (150, 152, 158)), finish="gloss")
    for c in range(nf):
        disc(cr, cut + (c + 0.5) * fcw, WY1 + 26, 11, (150, 152, 158), finish="gloss")
    # the cut and the half line, on the window itself
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"]))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    cr.move_to(cut, WY0 - 4)
    cr.line_to(cut, WY1 + 4)
    cr.stroke()
    if u >= a0:
        hxm = WX0 + ww * 0.5
        cr.move_to(hxm, WY0 - 30)
        cr.line_to(hxm, WY1 + 50)
        ghost(cr, a=0.9)
        text(cr, "half", hxm, WY1 + 86, 30, look.INK, face="bold", anchor="center")
    # coin panel and the takeout tray
    box(cr, 640, 1300, 110, 160, (70, 74, 84), depth=8, finish="metal")
    cr.rectangle(686, 1180, 18, 50)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((20, 20, 24)))
    cr.fill()
    cr.rectangle(300, 1330, 320, 70)
    solid(cr, (40, 42, 50), finish="gloss")

    # the recycling bin beside it
    contact_shadow(cr, 960, 1450, 140, a=0.35)
    cylinder(cr, 905, 1448, 110, 190, (90, 120, 160), finish="gloss")

    # right by the camera: empty cans in the grass
    _vm_can(cr, 150, 1760, 2.2, (200, 40, 40))
    _vm_can(cr, 920, 1820, 2.4, (110, 70, 40))
    foreground(cr, "field")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data stocks the window column by column, then holds up a hot can
    HH = 230
    FY = 1440
    if u < a0:
        hx = WX0 - 10
        host("point", hx, FY, HH)
    elif u < a1 + 0.04:
        hx = WX0 + (k + 0.5) * dcw
        host("place", hx, FY, HH, beat=k)
        if 0 < fly < 1:
            sx, sy = hx + 20, FY - HH * 0.9
            ex, ey = hx, WY0 + 10
            bx = sx + (ex - sx) * fly
            by = sy + (ey - sy) * fly - 120 * math.sin(math.pi * fly)
            _vm_can(cr, bx, by, 1.4, drinks[k % len(drinks)])
    else:
        hx = WX0 + (nd - 0.5) * dcw + 60 * ease(seg(u, a1 + 0.04, 0.66))
        host("hold_up", hx, FY, HH)
        cy_ = FY - HH * 1.12
        _vm_can(cr, hx, cy_, 1.3, (110, 70, 40))
        steam(cr, hx, cy_ - 90, t, strength=1.0)

    if u >= a1:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(share * 100))}%",
                    "of Japan's vending machines sell only drinks",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.04)), size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Drinks only", "Japan's vending machines",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a hot-drinks vending machine
    SUBSTANCE: a steaming can of soup
    CAUSE: Data lifts the hot can out of the machine's tray and carries it to a cold stranger
    The closing, on its own shot: a snowy back street at nightfall, one lit
    machine against a shop wall. A stranger in a scarf walks in out of the
    cold; the button lights, a hot can drops into the tray within the first
    half second, Data lifts it out with his own two hands and carries it
    right up to the stranger, who takes it and holds it up to drink, steam
    rising. The can is in the stranger's hand by 0.52, then the picture
    stays put while Data goes back for another and the stranger wanders
    off. Every move overlaps the next — the lift begins as the can lands,
    the walk as the lift ends, the hand-off as the walk slows — so nothing
    stalls between moves. Every grip keeps the can close in front of
    Data's chest. THE SCALE sits down the street: of seven machines in the
    far row, the ones that are gone are dashed outlines (2023 over 2000),
    and the readout is the one number the story built to: about 4 million
    still standing."""

    haze(cr, 980, 1200, (70, 80, 120), a=0.4)
    for i in gone:

        cr.rectangle(fx, 1185 - 96, 46, 96)
        ghost(cr, a=0.75)
