def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a lit vending machine
    SUBSTANCE: the machine's light
    CAUSE: Data pulls the machine's plug out of the wall with both hands and it goes dark
    THE HOOK: losing them. A big drink machine on a Tokyo back street at
    dusk, the brightest thing in the frame, throwing its light on the
    pavement, with Data's hands already on its plug as frame one opens.
    He yanks it and backs away dragging the cord, and the machine dies row
    by row, top to bottom: its halo and the pool of light on the ground go
    out until it is a dark box on a dark street. Done by 0.5, then held:
    he holds the plug up, the paper lantern keeps swaying and a car drives
    past by the camera. His hands stay close in on the plug, his body
    right behind it, so the grip is in reach."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    gone = max(0.0, v0 - v1)

    pull = ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.26))
    q = seg(u, 0.1, 0.48)
    lights = [1.0 - clamp(q * 4 - r) for r in range(4)]
    lavg = sum(lights) / 4.0
    lift = ease(seg(u, 0.5, 0.62))

    FOOT = 1480
    landscape(cr, t, "town")
    building(cr, -60, 1140, 1440, 600, (170, 160, 148), roof="flat")
    # the shop next door, its shutter already down
    cr.rectangle(880, 1060, 200, 380)
    solid(cr, (150, 154, 160), finish="metal")
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((96, 100, 108)))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    for i in range(13):
        cr.move_to(884, 1080 + i * 28)
        cr.line_to(1080, 1080 + i * 28)
    cr.stroke()
    # the pavement, the kerb and the road by the camera
    cr.rectangle(0, 1440, W, 130)
    solid(cr, (150, 146, 140), rim=False, edge=False)
    cr.rectangle(0, 1566, W, 22)
    solid(cr, (196, 192, 184), rim=False)
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (70, 72, 78)), (1, (40, 42, 48))], 1588, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 236, 230), 0.75))
    for i in range(6):
        cr.rectangle(-60 + i * 230, 1748, 140, 12)
    cr.fill()
    # nightfall settles over the street; the sky stays light enough to read
    pat = cairo.LinearGradient(0, 600, 0, 1100)
    pat.add_color_stop_rgba(0, 0.07, 0.08, 0.17, 0.0)
    pat.add_color_stop_rgba(1, 0.07, 0.08, 0.17, 0.55)
    cr.rectangle(0, 600, W, H - 600)
    cr.set_source(pat)
    cr.fill()

    _vm_lantern(cr, 980, 960, t)

    # the machine's light: a halo and a pool on the pavement, gone when it dies
    glow(cr, 560, 1050, 600, (255, 246, 214), 0.75 * lavg)
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(560, 1500)
    cr.scale(1.0, 0.25)
    glow(cr, 0, 0, 520, (255, 244, 210), 0.8 * lavg)
    cr.restore()
    cast_shadow(cr, 340, 780, FOOT, length=300, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, 580, FOOT + 4, 540, a=0.5)
    body = _vm_mix((128, 132, 144), (238, 240, 244), lavg)
    box(cr, 340, FOOT, 440, 860, body, depth=120, finish="gloss")
    cr.rectangle(358, 640, 404, 58)
    solid(cr, _vm_mix((52, 22, 22), (224, 46, 40), lavg), finish="gloss")
    DX, DY, RH, DW = 358, 716, 108, 404
    cans = [(206, 40, 44), (40, 96, 180), (238, 196, 60), (60, 150, 90),
            (240, 240, 236), (120, 70, 40)]
    for r in range(4):
        L = lights[r]
        y0 = DY + r * RH
        vgrad(cr, [(0, _vm_mix((14, 16, 22), (252, 250, 238), L)),
                   (1, _vm_mix((10, 12, 16), (218, 224, 232), L))], y0, y0 + RH, DX, DX + DW)
        for c in range(6):
            base_c = cans[(c + r) % 6]
            col = _vm_mix(_vm_mix(base_c, (16, 18, 22), 0.85), base_c, L)
            cylinder(cr, DX + 14 + c * 66, y0 + RH - 24, 44, 66, col, finish="metal")
            btn = (60, 120, 230) if (c + r) % 2 else (226, 60, 50)
            disc(cr, DX + 36 + c * 66, y0 + RH - 11, 7, _vm_mix((40, 40, 46), btn, L), finish="gloss")
        cr.rectangle(DX, y0 + RH - 4, DW, 4)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 124, 132)))
        cr.fill()
    cr.move_to(DX + 50, DY)
    cr.line_to(DX + 150, DY)
    cr.line_to(DX + 14, DY + 4 * RH)
    cr.line_to(DX, DY + 4 * RH)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 255, 255), 0.14))
    cr.fill()
    cr.rectangle(DX, DY, DW, 4 * RH)
    edge(cr, (40, 42, 48))
    cr.rectangle(660, 1170, 96, 130)
    solid(cr, _vm_mix((90, 92, 100), (160, 164, 172), lavg), finish="metal")
    disc(cr, 708, 1206, 11, _vm_mix((50, 50, 56), (120, 230, 140), lavg), finish="gloss")
    cr.rectangle(390, 1350, 250, 72)
    solid(cr, (30, 32, 38))

    # the can bin beside it, and bollards along the kerb
    contact_shadow(cr, 960, FOOT + 2, 140, a=0.4)
    box(cr, 905, FOOT, 110, 180, (62, 110, 170), depth=28)
    for hx_ in (935, 975):
        disc(cr, hx_, FOOT - 130, 16, (20, 22, 26))
    for bx in (110, 1000):
        contact_shadow(cr, bx + 25, 1584, 70, a=0.4)
        cylinder(cr, bx, 1582, 50, 110, (196, 198, 204), finish="metal")

    # the wall socket, then the cord to the plug in his hands
    cr.rectangle(276, 1312, 40, 50)
    solid(cr, (236, 232, 222))
    px = 296 - 170 * pull
    py = 1337 - 50 * lift
    dropped = u >= 0.88
    if dropped:
        py = FOOT - 6
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((24, 24, 28)))
    cr.set_line_width(11)
    cr.move_to(344, 1420)
    cr.curve_to(330, FOOT, px + 50, FOOT, px + 22, py + 8)
    cr.stroke()
    if dropped:
        cr.rectangle(px - 24, py - 16, 48, 22)
    else:
        cr.rectangle(px - 24, py - 16, 48, 32)
    solid(cr, (214, 212, 204))
    if not dropped and pull > 0.05:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((214, 186, 90)))
        cr.set_line_width(5)
        for dy in (-6, 8):
            cr.move_to(px + 24, py + dy)
            cr.line_to(px + 40, py + dy)
        cr.stroke()

    # by the camera: a car drives past once the street has gone dark
    cs = seg(u, 0.55, 0.97)
    if 0 < cs < 1:
        _vm_car(cr, -440 + 1960 * cs, 1870, 1.05)
    foreground(cr, "town", y0=1600)
    vignette(cr, a=0.3)

    # he stands right behind the plug so both hands stay well inside his reach
    hx = px - 34
    if not dropped:
        host("grip", hx, FOOT, 230, hands=[(px - 10, py), (px + 6, py + 4)],
             lower="brace" if u < 0.5 else "stand", expr="strain" if u < 0.5 else "happy")
    else:
        host("shock", hx, FOOT, 230)

    fit_readout(cr, f"{gone / 1e6:.1f}M gone", f"Japan's vending machines since {l0}",
                80, 520, size=130)

stories.title: China Reached 500 Nuclear Warheads As The World Cut Back
stories.hook: Everyone thought the nuclear nightmare was winding down. China had other plans.
stories.closing: A reversal in nuclear disarmament makes every country's security harder to predict.
stories.question: Can the decline resume?
stories.caption: The global nuclear warhead count fell for nearly 40 straight years after the Cold War. Now it's turning back up, and one country's buildup is the biggest reason why. Did this surprise you? 👇

segments.say: The world once held 70,300 nuclear warheads; treaties then pushed the total sharply downward.

# scene standard: 2026-10-22
def _nk_trefoil(cr, x, y, r):
    cr.arc(x, y, r, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    solid(cr, (236, 196, 52), finish="gloss")
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((24, 22, 20)))
    for i in range(3):
        a = -math.pi / 2 + i * 2 * math.pi / 3
        cr.arc(x, y, 0.86 * r, a - 0.52, a + 0.52)
        cr.arc_negative(x, y, 0.24 * r, a + 0.52, a - 0.52)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.fill()
    cr.arc(x, y, 0.15 * r, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.fill()


def _nk_cone(cr, cx, base, bw, hh):
    # a re-entry vehicle's outline: an aft skirt, then the long taper to a blunt nose
    x0 = cx - bw / 2
    sk = hh * 0.16
    cr.move_to(x0, base)
    cr.line_to(x0 + bw * 0.04, base - sk)
    cr.line_to(cx - bw * 0.13, base - hh * 0.9)
    cr.curve_to(cx - bw * 0.1, base - hh * 1.0, cx + bw * 0.1, base - hh * 1.0,
                cx + bw * 0.13, base - hh * 0.9)
    cr.line_to(x0 + bw * 0.96, base - sk)
    cr.line_to(x0 + bw, base)
    cr.close_path()


def _nk_warhead(cr, cx, base, bw, hh, rgb=(78, 82, 90), mark=True):
    # an upright warhead: the lit taper, a seam at the skirt, a hazard band, the mark
    _nk_cone(cr, cx, base, bw, hh)
    solid(cr, rgb, finish="metal")
    sk = hh * 0.16
    cr.rectangle(cx - bw / 2 - 3, base - 16, bw + 6, 16)
    solid(cr, (46, 48, 54), finish="metal", rim=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((30, 30, 34), 0.8))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    cr.move_to(cx - bw / 2 + bw * 0.04, base - sk)
    cr.line_to(cx + bw / 2 - bw * 0.04, base - sk)
    cr.stroke()
    if not mark:
        return
    # a yellow and black hazard band round the body
    by = base - hh * 0.58
    hw = bw * 0.5 * (1 - 0.58 * 0.82) + 2
    cr.save()
    _nk_cone(cr, cx, base, bw, hh)
    cr.clip()
    cr.rectangle(cx - hw - 4, by, 2 * hw + 8, 16)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 196, 52)))
    cr.fill()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((24, 22, 20)))
    for i in range(-4, 5):
        cr.move_to(cx + i * 14, by)
        cr.line_to(cx + i * 14 + 8, by)
        cr.line_to(cx + i * 14 + 2, by + 16)
        cr.line_to(cx + i * 14 - 6, by + 16)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.fill()
    cr.restore()
    _nk_trefoil(cr, cx, base - 0.33 * hh, 0.2 * bw)


def _nk_cart(cr, x, gy, cw):

def _nk_truck(cr, x, y):

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a train of nuclear warhead carts
    SUBSTANCE: the nuclear warheads
    CAUSE: Data grips the last cart's handle and shoves the warhead train into the dismantling plant
    The world's 1986 stockpile is one long train of big warheads on carts,
    its length the count. With each treaty era Data, hands on the tail
    cart's push bar, shoves the train through the dismantling plant's door,
    and what goes through the door is gone; what is still outside is the
    stockpile left. THE SCALE: the 1986 train stays as a dashed ghost where
    it stood, so the stub left reads as about a fifth of it, and each landed
    year notches where the tail reached. Done by 0.56 and held; trucks keep
    hauling the emptied casings away past the camera."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    n = len(rows)
    top = max(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    GY = 1440.0
    NC, CW = 7, 111.0
    L = NC * CW
    MX = 900.0
    BW, HH = 98.0, 400.0
    WB = GY - 50
    steps = max(1, n - 1)
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.56
    span = (a1 - a0) / steps
    s = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, steps - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - s * span) / span)
    push = ease(seg(f, 0.04, 0.9))
    if u < a0 or n < 2:
        val, landed_n = rows[0][1], 0
    else:
        val = rows[s][1] + (rows[s + 1][1] - rows[s][1]) * push
        landed_n = s + 1 if push >= 0.999 else s
    tail0 = MX - L
    tail = MX - L * val / top
    lab, shown = rows[landed_n]

    landscape(cr, t, "desert")
    # the far compound: hangars and a water tower on the horizon
    for i, (x0, w, h) in enumerate(((20, 170, 90), (230, 120, 70), (420, 200, 110))):
        building(cr, x0, x0 + w, 1180, h, (176, 168, 152), roof="gable", boards=False)
    cylinder(cr, 680, 1060, 50, 50, (170, 166, 156), finish="metal")
    cr.rectangle(700, 1060, 8, 120)
    solid(cr, (120, 116, 110), rim=False, edge=False)
    haze(cr, 950, 1200, (232, 206, 170), a=0.45)

    # the dismantling plant, its big door the front's left half
    cast_shadow(cr, 880, 1200, GY, length=300, a=0.3)
    building(cr, 880, 1200, GY, 640, (176, 170, 158), roof="flat", boards=False)
    DX0, DX1, DY = MX, 1070, 980
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (20, 20, 24)), (1, (58, 54, 50))], DY, GY, DX0, DX1)
    glow(cr, (DX0 + DX1) / 2, GY - 40, 140, (255, 200, 120), 0.18)
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(DX0 - 12, DY - 12, DX1 - DX0 + 24, 12)
    cr.rectangle(DX1, DY - 12, 12, GY - DY + 12)
    cr.clip()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 196, 52)))
    cr.paint()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((24, 22, 20)))
    for i in range(-30, 40):
        cr.move_to(DX0 + i * 30, DY - 12)
        cr.line_to(DX0 + i * 30 + 14, DY - 12)
        cr.line_to(DX0 + i * 30 + 14 + 480, GY)
        cr.line_to(DX0 + i * 30 + 480, GY)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.fill()
    cr.restore()
    # the sign over the door, its word kept well inside the frame
    cr.rectangle(850, DY - 100, 218, 64)
    solid(cr, (44, 46, 52), finish="metal")
    sign = "DISMANTLING"
    text(cr, sign, 959, DY - 56, fit_size(cr, sign, 26, 180), look.INK, face="bold",
         anchor="center", shadow=False)
    disc(cr, 1040, 860, 16, (255, 190, 80), finish="gloss")
    glow(cr, 1040, 860, 50, (255, 190, 80), 0.5 + 0.3 * math.sin(t * 4))

    # the rails running into the plant
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 64, 58)))
    cr.set_line_width(7)
    for ry in (GY - 4, GY + 8):
        cr.move_to(0, ry)
        cr.line_to(DX1, ry)
    cr.stroke()
    for i in range(24):
        cr.rectangle(i * 46, GY - 8, 22, 22)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((96, 78, 60)))
        cr.fill()

    # the 1986 stockpile's ghost, where the whole train stood
    if u >= a0:
        cr.new_path()
        for i in range(NC):
            _nk_cone(cr, tail0 + i * CW + CW / 2, WB, BW, HH)
        ghost(cr, a=0.8)

    # the warhead train, shoved through the door
    cast_shadow(cr, tail, MX, GY, length=240, a=0.28)
    contact_shadow(cr, (tail + MX) / 2, GY + 4, MX - tail + 40, a=0.4)
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(0, 0, MX + 4, H)
    cr.clip()
    for i in range(NC):
        x = tail + i * CW
        if x > MX + 4:
            break
        _nk_cart(cr, x, GY, CW)
        _nk_warhead(cr, x + CW / 2 - 3, WB, BW, HH)
    cr.restore()
    # the push bar on the tail cart
    cr.rectangle(tail - 12, GY - 150, 10, 120)
    solid(cr, (60, 62, 68), finish="metal", rim=False)
    cr.rectangle(tail - 18, GY - 152, 24, 12)
    solid(cr, (60, 62, 68), finish="metal", rim=False)

    # THE SCALE: every landed year notched where the tail reached
    if u >= a0:
        ny0 = WB - HH - 44
        for j in range(0, landed_n + 1):
            nx = MX - L * rows[j][1] / top
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((244, 238, 226)))
            cr.set_line_width(6)
            cr.move_to(nx, ny0)
            cr.line_to(nx, ny0 + 34)
            cr.stroke()
            if j == 0 or j == landed_n:
                text(cr, rows[j][0], nx + (30 if j == 0 else 0), ny0 - 14, 32,
                     look.INK, face="bold", anchor="center")

    # right by the camera: trucks hauling the emptied casings away
    tx = W + 260 - ((t * 240) % 1900)
    _nk_truck(cr, tx, 1780)
    foreground(cr, "desert")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data, hands on the push bar, shoving the train into the plant
    FY, HH_ = 1452.0, 230
    dx = tail - 64
    hands = [(tail - 7, GY - 144), (tail - 7, GY - 106)]
    if u < a0:
        host("point", dx, FY, HH_)
    elif u < 0.9:
        host("grip", dx, FY, HH_, hands=hands, lower="brace", expr="strain")
    else:
        host("grip", dx, FY, HH_, hands=hands, lower="brace", expr="happy")

    fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(shown)):,}", f"nuclear warheads worldwide · {lab}",
                80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)
    if landed_n == n - 1 and n > 1:
        gone = int(round(rows[0][1] - rows[-1][1]))
        al = ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.04))
        text(cr, f"{gone:,} dismantled", W - 80, 720, 76, look.INK, face="display",
             anchor="right", alpha=al)
        text(cr, f"since {rows[0][0]}", W - 80, 770, 36, look.INK,
             anchor="right", alpha=al)

# scene standard: 2026-10-22
def _missile(cr, cx, top, s, nose):
    """A standing missile rising out of its shaft: a long white gloss body,
    the black-and-white roll band, a red warhead cone, four fins at its tail.
    Drawn clipped above the shaft mouth, so it slides UP out of the ground."""
    Lm = 300 * s
    bw = 64 * s
    cone = bw * 1.7
    base = top + Lm * (1.0 - nose) + 6 * s        # the tail, sunk while it rises
    btop = base - Lm + cone
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(0, 0, W, top + 4 * s)
    cr.clip()
    # tail fins, the silhouette's tell
    for side in (-1, 1):
        cr.move_to(cx + side * bw * 0.5, base - 70 * s)
        cr.line_to(cx + side * bw * 1.05, base - 4 * s)
        cr.line_to(cx + side * bw * 1.05, base + 8 * s)
        cr.line_to(cx + side * bw * 0.5, base + 8 * s)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (64, 66, 74), finish="metal")
    # the body
    cr.rectangle(cx - bw / 2, btop, bw, base - btop + 8 * s)
    solid(cr, (238, 238, 232), finish="gloss")
    # the roll band: black and white quarters, every missile's signature
    by = btop + (base - btop) * 0.38
    bh = 30 * s
    cr.rectangle(cx - bw / 2, by, bw / 2, bh)
    cr.rectangle(cx, by + bh, bw / 2, bh)
    solid(cr, (34, 34, 38), rim=False)
    # stage ring
    cr.rectangle(cx - bw / 2, btop + (base - btop) * 0.7, bw, 6 * s)
    solid(cr, (120, 122, 130), rim=False, edge=False)
    # the red warhead cone
    cr.move_to(cx - bw / 2, btop + 2)
    cr.curve_to(cx - bw / 2, btop - cone * 0.55, cx - bw * 0.18, btop - cone * 0.92, cx, btop - cone)
    cr.curve_to(cx + bw * 0.18, btop - cone * 0.92, cx + bw / 2, btop - cone * 0.55, cx + bw / 2, btop + 2)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (200, 44, 38), finish="gloss")
    cr.restore()


def _silo(cr, cx, y, s, rise, pit, opened, nose):
    """One missile silo seen from three-quarters: a concrete collar sunk in
    the sand, a dark shaft, its lid slid aside, and a whole missile standing
    up out of it once it is armed."""
    w = 196 * s
    rx, ry = w * 0.36, w * 0.12
    if rise <= 0.0:
        if pit > 0.0:                                   # the hole he is digging
            cr.save()
            cr.translate(cx, y - 6 * s)
            cr.scale(1, ry / rx)
            cr.arc(0, 0, rx * pit, 0, 2 * math.pi)
            cr.restore()
            solid(cr, (70, 52, 36), rim=False)
        return
    h = 50 * s * rise
    contact_shadow(cr, cx, y + 4 * s, w * 1.2, a=0.38)
    cylinder(cr, cx - w / 2, y, w, h, (182, 176, 164))
    top = y - h
    if nose > 0.0:
        cast_shadow(cr, cx - 30 * s, cx + 30 * s, top, length=260 * s * nose, a=0.22)
    # the shaft
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(cx, top)
    cr.scale(1, ry / rx)
    cr.arc(0, 0, rx, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (34, 32, 36), rim=False)
    # the lid, sliding off to the right on its rails
    lx = cx + opened * rx * 1.55
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(lx, top + 5 * s)
    cr.scale(1, ry / rx)
    cr.arc(0, 0, rx * 1.1, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (84, 88, 94), finish="metal", rim=False)
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(lx, top - 3 * s)
    cr.scale(1, ry / rx)
    cr.arc(0, 0, rx * 1.1, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (132, 136, 144), finish="metal")
    if nose > 0.0:
        _missile(cr, cx, top, s, nose)


def _launcher(cr, x, y, s):
    """A missile transporter driving the desert road."""
    L = 330 * s
    contact_shadow(cr, x + L / 2, y + 4, L * 1.05, a=0.4)
    box(cr, x, y - 26 * s, L, 34 * s, (88, 96, 66), depth=30 * s)
    box(cr, x + L - 70 * s, y - 26 * s, 70 * s, 58 * s, (98, 106, 74), depth=28 * s)
    cr.move_to(x + 10 * s, y - 60 * s)
    cr.line_to(x + L - 90 * s, y - 60 * s)
    cr.curve_to(x + L - 60 * s, y - 60 * s, x + L - 60 * s, y - 84 * s, x + L - 90 * s, y - 84 * s)
    cr.line_to(x + 10 * s, y - 84 * s)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (226, 226, 220), finish="gloss")
    for i in range(5):
        disc(cr, x + 30 * s + i * 62 * s, y + 2, 15 * s, (36, 36, 38))


def _flag(cr, x, base, t):
    cr.rectangle(x - 4, base - 260, 8, 260)
    solid(cr, (150, 150, 156), finish="metal", rim=False)
    fw, fh = 150, 96
    top = base - 256
    cr.move_to(x + 4, top)
    for i in range(1, 11):
        px = x + 4 + fw * i / 10
        cr.line_to(px, top + 10 * math.sin(t * 3.2 - i * 0.7) * i / 10)
    for i in range(10, -1, -1):
        px = x + 4 + fw * i / 10
        cr.line_to(px, top + fh + 10 * math.sin(t * 3.2 - i * 0.7) * i / 10)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (206, 32, 30))
    sx, sy, r = x + 34, top + 28 + 3 * math.sin(t * 3.2 - 2), 15
    for i in range(10):
        a = -math.pi / 2 + i * math.pi / 5
        rr = r if i % 2 == 0 else r * 0.42
        (cr.move_to if i == 0 else cr.line_to)(sx + rr * math.cos(a), sy + rr * math.sin(a))
    cr.close_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((250, 214, 60)))
    cr.fill()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a desert field of nuclear missiles
    SUBSTANCE: white missiles rising from silos
    CAUSE: Data digs a new silo into the sand with his shovel, one dig per new missile
    China's arsenal as its own missile field in the desert: every standing
    missile is a tenth of the 2023 total, a whole missile — red warhead
    cone, black-and-white roll band, tail fins — upright out of its silo.
    The 2020 compound (far and middle rows) is fenced by a dashed ghost
    line with its year on it. Then Data digs the whole near row, one silo
    per dig: the hole opens on the strike, the collar rises, the lid slides
    back and a missile climbs up out of the ground. A new row of three on a
    compound of seven: about half as much again, shown on the ground, not in
    a second number. Done by 0.62 and held; a launcher keeps driving the
    road and the flag keeps flying."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    v0 = v0 or 1.0
    N = 10
    unit = v1 / N if v1 else 1.0
    n0 = int(clamp(round(v0 / unit), 1, N - 1))
    n_new = N - n0
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.62
    span = (a1 - a0) / n_new
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n_new - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)

    landscape(cr, t, "desert", horizon=820)
    # the desert road a launcher drives along
    cr.rectangle(0, 868, W, 34)
    solid(cr, (150, 128, 100), edge=False, rim=False)
    _launcher(cr, 60 + 175 * t, 896, 0.62)

    # the missile field, far rows first
    layout = [(940, 0.6, [270, 450, 630, 810]),
              (1160, 0.8, [300, 540, 780]),
              (1430, 1.15, [230, 540, 850])]
    slots = []
    for (yy, ss, xs) in layout:
        for xx in xs:
            slots.append((xx, yy, ss))
    cast_shadow(cr, 180, 900, 1180, length=220, a=0.16)
    _flag(cr, 965, 1240, t)
    for i, (sx, sy, ss) in enumerate(slots):
        if i < n0:
            _silo(cr, sx, sy, ss, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0)
            continue
        j = i - n0
        if u < a0 or j > k:
            _silo(cr, sx, sy, ss, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
        elif j < k:
            _silo(cr, sx, sy, ss, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0)
        else:
            _silo(cr, sx, sy, ss, ease(seg(f, 0.45, 0.62)), pop(seg(f, 0.33, 0.47)),
                  ease(seg(f, 0.6, 0.74)), ease(seg(f, 0.68, 0.98)))

    # THE SCALE on the ground: the 2020 compound, fenced in a dashed ghost
    if u >= a0:
        cr.move_to(170, 885)
        cr.line_to(910, 885)
        cr.line_to(930, 1215)
        cr.line_to(150, 1215)
        cr.close_path()
        ghost(cr, a=0.9 * ease(seg(u, a0, a0 + 0.06)))
        text(cr, l0, 905, 872, 34, look.INK, face="bold", anchor="right",
             alpha=ease(seg(u, a0, a0 + 0.06)))

    # right by the camera: spare concrete silo rings waiting on the sand
    contact_shadow(cr, 930, 1790, 260, a=0.4)
    cylinder(cr, 800, 1790, 260, 70, (176, 170, 158))
    cylinder(cr, 830, 1720, 200, 60, (186, 180, 168))
    foreground(cr, "desert", y0=1600)
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data digs his way along the near row
    spots = [slots[n0 + j][0] - 165 * slots[n0 + j][2] for j in range(n_new)]
    feet = [min(1480.0, slots[n0 + j][1] + 30) for j in range(n_new)]
    if u < a0:
        host("point", spots[0] - 40, feet[0], 220)
    elif u < a1 + 0.02:
        frm = spots[k - 1] if k > 0 else spots[0] - 40
        hx = frm + (spots[k] - frm) * ease(seg(f, 0.0, 0.25))
        if k == 0 and f < 0.25:
            host("point", hx, feet[k], 220)
        else:
            host("dig", hx, feet[k], 220, beat=k if f >= 0.25 else max(0, k - 1))
    elif u < 0.9:
        host("hold_up", spots[-1], feet[-1], 220)
    else:
        host("cheer", spots[-1], feet[-1], 220)

    if u >= a1:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v1))} warheads", f"China's nuclear arsenal · {l1}",
                    80, 520, size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v0))} warheads", f"China's nuclear arsenal · {l0}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

# scene standard: 2026-10-22
def _nuke(cr, x, y, s, lit, ang=0.0):
    """One nuclear bomb lying on its side, nose to the right: a white body,
    a rounded dark nose, tail fins, a yellow band with the radiation trefoil.
    `lit` 0..1 is how much of the hall's light is on it."""
    def path(fn_):
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(x, y)
        cr.rotate(ang)
        cr.scale(s, s)
        fn_()
        cr.restore()

    def mix(rgb):
        d = 0.22 + 0.78 * lit
        return tuple(int(c * d) for c in rgb)

    def fins():
        cr.move_to(-40, -14)
        cr.line_to(-66, -34)
        cr.line_to(-60, -14)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.move_to(-40, 14)

    path(fins)

    def nose():

    def band():

    cr.translate(x, y)

    for k in range(3):

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a nuclear weapons bunker
    SUBSTANCE: nuclear bombs on racks
    CAUSE: Data grips the bunker's blast door and slides it open by hand, and the hall of bombs behind it lights up row by row
    Russia's arsenal, kept in one bunker dug into a snowy hill at night.
    Data takes the handle on the steel blast door in both hands and walks
    it open, leaning back on it. Behind it a hall of warheads runs back
    into the hill, and its lamps come on one row at a time, front to back.
    Each row is China's whole arsenal, so Russia's hall is about eleven
    Chinas deep. Done by 0.64, then held while the red beacon over the
    door keeps turning and Data braces the door open."""
    rows = sorted([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts], key=lambda r: -r[1])
    top_l, top_v = rows[0]
    cn = [r for r in rows if r[0] == "China"]
    cmp_l, cmp_v = cn[0] if cn else rows[2 if len(rows) > 2 else -1]
    cmp_v = cmp_v or 1.0
    N = max(1, int(round(top_v / cmp_v)))
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.40
    l0, l1 = 0.34, 0.64
    opn = ease(seg(u, a0, a1))
    lit_n = (N + 0.999) * seg(u, l0, l1)

    gy = landscape(cr, t, "snow", time="night", seed="nuclear bunker",
                   skyline=False)
    treeline(cr, gy + 10, (34, 44, 52), n=16, seed=7)
    haze(cr, gy - 260, gy + 30, (40, 48, 70), a=0.4)

    # the hill the bunker is dug into: dark earth under a snow cap
    cr.move_to(-40, gy + 40)
    cr.curve_to(60, 860, 300, 690, 560, 680)
    cr.curve_to(820, 690, 1020, 840, 1120, gy + 40)
    cr.line_to(1120, 1460)
    cr.line_to(-40, 1460)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (86, 92, 104), edge=False)
    cr.move_to(40, 900)
    cr.curve_to(160, 770, 340, 700, 560, 694)
    cr.curve_to(780, 700, 940, 780, 1060, 900)
    cr.curve_to(900, 840, 780, 800, 640, 820)
    cr.curve_to(500, 790, 300, 830, 40, 900)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (200, 210, 226), edge=False)

    # the portal: a concrete face in three-quarter view
    OX0, OX1, OY0, OY1 = 210, 870, 900, 1440
    cast_shadow(cr, 120, 960, 1450, length=300, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, 540, 1452, 900, a=0.45)
    box(cr, 120, 1450, 840, 650, (150, 150, 146), depth=110)

    # the hall behind the opening, in perspective
    VX, VY = 540.0, 1150.0
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(OX0, OY0, OX1 - OX0, OY1 - OY0)
    cr.clip()
    glow_k = clamp(lit_n / N)
    base = tuple(int(c * (0.25 + 0.75 * glow_k)) for c in (120, 118, 110))
    vgrad(cr, [(0, tuple(int(c * 0.5) for c in base)), (0.5, base),
               (1, tuple(int(c * 0.8) for c in base))], OY0, OY1, OX0, OX1)

    def at(X, Y, z):
        s = 1.0 / (1.0 + 3.2 * z)
        return VX + (X - VX) * s, VY + (Y - VY) * s, s
    bx0, by0, _ = at(OX0, OY0, 1.0)
    bx1, by1, _ = at(OX1, OY1, 1.0)
    cr.move_to(OX0, OY1)
    cr.line_to(OX1, OY1)
    cr.line_to(bx1, by1)
    cr.line_to(bx0, by1)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, tuple(int(c * 0.75) for c in base), edge=False, rim=False)
    cr.rectangle(bx0, by0, bx1 - bx0, by1 - by0)
    solid(cr, tuple(int(c * 0.45) for c in base), edge=False, rim=False)
    for i in reversed(range(N)):
        z = (i + 0.6) / (N + 0.4)
        on = clamp(lit_n - i)
        _, cy_, s = at(VX, OY0 + 20, z)
        glow(cr, VX, cy_ + 8 * s, 260 * s, (255, 236, 190), 0.55 * on)
        cr.rectangle(VX - 60 * s, cy_, 120 * s, 10 * s)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 244, 214) if on > 0.5 else (60, 60, 60)))
        cr.fill()
        for side in (-1, 1):
            X = VX + side * 250
            for lv, Y in enumerate((OY1 - 60, OY1 - 190, OY1 - 320)):
                px_, py_, s = at(X, Y, z)
                cr.rectangle(px_ - 120 * s, py_ + 34 * s, 240 * s, 9 * s)
                solid(cr, tuple(int(c * (0.3 + 0.7 * on)) for c in (90, 96, 104)),
                      finish="metal", rim=False, edge=False)
                _nuke(cr, px_ + side * 8 * s * ((i + lv) % 2), py_, 1.55 * s,
                      on, ang=0.03 * (((i * 3 + lv) % 5) - 2))
    cr.restore()
    fa = ease(seg(u, l0 + 0.02, l0 + 0.08))
    if fa > 0:
        text(cr, "each row = all of " + cmp_l, OX1 - 18, OY0 + 52, 38,
             look.INK, face="bold", anchor="right", alpha=fa)

    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 60, 62)))
    cr.set_line_width(14)
    cr.rectangle(OX0, OY0, OX1 - OX0, OY1 - OY0)
    cr.stroke()

    # the blast door: thick steel, hazard stripes, the trefoil sign
    DW = OX1 - OX0 + 30
    dx = OX0 - 15 - (DW - 140) * opn
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 40, 44)))
    cr.set_line_width(12)
    cr.move_to(-20, OY0 - 22)
    cr.line_to(OX1 + 20, OY0 - 22)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.rectangle(dx, OY0 - 12, DW, OY1 - OY0 + 14)
    solid(cr, (118, 124, 116), finish="metal")
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(dx, OY1 - 90, DW, 88)
    cr.clip()
    for i in range(16):
        cr.move_to(dx + i * 70, OY1)
        cr.line_to(dx + i * 70 + 35, OY1)
        cr.line_to(dx + i * 70 + 125, OY1 - 90)
        cr.line_to(dx + i * 70 + 90, OY1 - 90)
        cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (232, 186, 30), rim=False, edge=False)
    cr.restore()
    for ry in (OY0 + 30, OY1 - 110):
        for rx in range(6):
            disc(cr, dx + 40 + rx * (DW - 80) / 5, ry, 9, (90, 94, 90), finish="metal")
    scx, scy = dx + DW * 0.42, OY0 + 190
    disc(cr, scx, scy, 92, (238, 196, 36))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((26, 24, 20)))
    for q in range(3):
        a = -math.pi / 2 + q * 2 * math.pi / 3
        cr.move_to(scx, scy)
        cr.arc(scx, scy, 78, a - 0.52, a + 0.52)
        cr.close_path()
    cr.fill()
    cr.arc(scx, scy, 20, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((238, 196, 36)))
    cr.fill()
    cr.arc(scx, scy, 13, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((26, 24, 20)))
    cr.fill()
    # the handle bar on the door's face, near its leading edge
    ex = dx + DW
    gx = ex - 92
    cr.rectangle(gx - 10, OY0 + 280, 20, 180)
    solid(cr, (64, 66, 70), finish="metal")
    for hy_ in (OY0 + 280, OY0 + 460):
        disc(cr, gx, hy_, 13, (80, 82, 86), finish="metal")

    # the red beacon over the door, turning all beat
    bx, by = 870, OY0 - 120
    ang = t * 2.6
    reach = 1100
    cr.move_to(bx, by)
    cr.line_to(bx + reach * math.cos(ang - 0.16), by + 0.45 * reach * math.sin(ang - 0.16))
    cr.line_to(bx + reach * math.cos(ang + 0.16), by + 0.45 * reach * math.sin(ang + 0.16))
    cr.close_path()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 70, 50), 0.32))
    cr.fill()
    cylinder(cr, bx - 22, by + 30, 44, 50, (70, 72, 76), finish="metal")
    disc(cr, bx, by, 24, (230, 50, 40), finish="gloss")
    glow(cr, bx, by, 90, (255, 80, 60), 0.7)

    # the yard: tyre ruts in the snow running from the camera to the door
    for x_top, x_bot in ((420, 300), (520, 470), (640, 690), (740, 880)):
        cr.move_to(x_top - 14, 1462)
        cr.curve_to(x_top - 20, 1600, x_bot - 40, 1760, x_bot - 60, H)
        cr.line_to(x_bot + 10, H)
        cr.curve_to(x_bot - 10, 1760, x_top + 4, 1600, x_top + 14, 1462)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (150, 160, 178), edge=False, rim=False)

    # right by the camera, left: a perimeter fence, posts leaning, wire sagging
    posts = [(30, 1900, 300, -0.04), (190, 1820, 250, 0.03), (330, 1770, 215, -0.02)]
    for px_, py_, ph, lean in posts:
        contact_shadow(cr, px_ + 12, py_, 60, a=0.35)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 40, 44)))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    for frac in (0.25, 0.55, 0.85):
        for a_, b_ in zip(posts, posts[1:]):
            x0_, y0_ = a_[0] + 12, a_[1] - a_[2] * frac
            x1_, y1_ = b_[0] + 12, b_[1] - b_[2] * frac
            cr.move_to(x0_, y0_)
            cr.curve_to(x0_ + 40, y0_ + 18, x1_ - 40, y1_ + 18, x1_, y1_)
    cr.stroke()
    for px_, py_, ph, lean in posts:
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(px_, py_)
        cr.rotate(lean)
        cr.rectangle(0, -ph, 24, ph)
        cr.restore()
        solid(cr, (96, 98, 104), finish="metal")
    # right: a bomb on its dolly, waiting to go in
    contact_shadow(cr, 860, 1800, 360, a=0.45)
    box(cr, 690, 1790, 340, 40, (60, 64, 70), depth=60, finish="metal")
    for wx in (735, 985):
        disc(cr, wx, 1800, 28, (36, 36, 40), finish="gloss")
    _nuke(cr, 860, 1706, 2.5, 1.0, ang=-0.04)
    foreground(cr, "snow")
    vignette(cr, a=0.3)

    # Data, both hands on the door's handle, leaning back to walk it open
    hx = gx - 98
    if u < a0:
        host("point", hx, 1450, 320)
    else:
        host("grip", hx, 1450, 320, hands=[(gx, OY0 + 345), (gx, OY0 + 395)],
             lower="follow" if u < a1 else "brace",
             expr="strain" if u < a1 else "shock")

    fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(top_v)):,} warheads",
                top_l + " · the world's biggest arsenal", 80, 520,
                a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

stories.title: AI Data Centers Are Quietly Drinking The Water Supply
stories.hook: Google and Microsoft are racing to build AI, and water is the price.
stories.closing: The chatbot doesn't feel thirsty, but the water bill says otherwise, and we all share it.
stories.question: Would a bigger water bill change your mind?
stories.caption: Microsoft's water consumption jumped 34% in a single year. Google used 21.2 million cubic meters in 2022 alone. Every AI conversation you have costs about a bottle of water somewhere in a data center. Did you know that? 👇

segments.say: Microsoft's water use more than tripled to 6.4 million cubic meters. Data centers running AI are thirsty.

# scene standard: 2026-10-22
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a glass water tank feeding a data center
    SUBSTANCE: blue water
    CAUSE: Data turns the valve wheel on the tank's outlet with both hands and the water drains through the pipe into the data center
    The town's water tank stands beside a Microsoft data center. Each year
    Data turns the valve on the outlet once more and the water level drops
    by that year's water use, so the drained height is the cubic meters.
    The 2017 level is marked on the glass, and the 1x 2x 3x ticks measure
    the 2022 drop against the 2017 one: more than three times as far. The
    story is done by 0.66 and held. Then Data walks over to the
    tank, a water tanker drives past to the data center, the cooling
    towers keep steaming and the server lights keep blinking."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    n = len(rows)
    top = max(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    v0 = rows[0][1] or 1.0
    a0, a1 = 0.06, 0.66
    span = (a1 - a0) / max(1, n)
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    turn_f = ease(seg(f, 0.0, 0.14))
    drain = seg(f, 0.12, 0.86)               # steady drain: no slow tails
    flowing = u >= a0 and 0.0 < drain < 1.0
    if u < a0:
        val = 0.0
    else:
        prev = rows[k - 1][1] if k > 0 else 0.0
        val = prev + (rows[k][1] - prev) * drain
    landed_to = k if drain >= 0.999 else k - 1
    keep = sorted({round(i * (n - 1) / max(1, READOUT_SHOWS - 1))
                   for i in range(READOUT_SHOWS)}) if n > READOUT_SHOWS else list(range(n))
    named = max((i for i in keep if i <= landed_to), default=None)
    shown = None if (u < a0 or named is None) else rows[named]

    landscape(cr, t, "field")
    birds(cr, t, y0=820, n=4, rgb=(60, 60, 70))

    TX0, TX1, BASE, TH = 110, 560, 1420, 720
    TW = TX1 - TX0
    TOP = BASE - TH
    FULL = TOP + 50
    DROP = 600.0
    unit = DROP * v0 / top
    level = FULL + DROP * val / top
    ry = 0.11 * TW

    cast_shadow(cr, 650, 1030, BASE, length=280, a=0.28)
    cast_shadow(cr, TX0, TX1, BASE, length=360, a=0.3)
    # the data center: long, low, windowless, server lights blinking
    contact_shadow(cr, 840, BASE + 4, 420, a=0.35)
    b = building(cr, 640, 1030, BASE, 270, (150, 156, 168), roof="flat", boards=False)
    for r_ in range(3):
        cr.rectangle(670, b["top"] + 40 + r_ * 70, 330, 34)
        solid(cr, (44, 50, 62), rim=False)
        for c_ in range(10):
            on = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 3 + c_ * 1.7 + r_)
            cr.rectangle(684 + c_ * 32, b["top"] + 52 + r_ * 70, 14, 8)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((90, 200, 255), 0.4 + 0.6 * on))
            cr.fill()
    text(cr, "DATA CENTER", 835, b["top"] - 14, 34, look.INK, face="bold",
         anchor="center", shadow=False)
    steam_k = min(1.0, 0.5 + (0.8 if flowing else 0.0) + 0.5 * val / top)
    for i, cx_ in enumerate((700, 830, 960)):
        box(cr, cx_ - 50, b["top"] - 40, 100, 70, (176, 182, 192), finish="metal")
        steam(cr, cx_ - 10, b["top"] - 120, t + i * 0.4, strength=steam_k)
        steam(cr, cx_ + 10, b["top"] - 170, t * 1.1 + i, strength=steam_k * 0.8)

    # the outlet pipe from the tank into the data center, the valve on top of it
    PY = BASE - 70
    cr.rectangle(TX1 - 20, PY - 22, 680 - TX1 + 20, 44)
    solid(cr, (120, 128, 140), finish="metal")
    if flowing:   # water rushing through a glass section of the pipe
        cr.save()
        cr.rectangle(TX1 + 4, PY - 16, 40, 32)
        cr.clip()
        for j in range(4):
            sx = TX1 + 4 + ((t * 300 + j * 14) % 56) - 8
            cr.rectangle(sx, PY - 16, 8, 32)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((90, 170, 230)))
            cr.fill()
        cr.restore()
    FOOT = 1470
    WX, WY = 600, FOOT - 160                 # at his shoulder height
    cr.rectangle(WX - 8, WY, 16, PY - WY)
    solid(cr, (70, 72, 80), finish="metal", rim=False)
    turns = (0.0 if u < a0 else k + turn_f) * 0.5
    hands = handwheel(cr, WX, WY, turns, r=34)

    # the tank: the back of the glass, the water, the front of the glass
    contact_shadow(cr, (TX0 + TX1) / 2, BASE + 6, TW + 80, a=0.45)
    cr.rectangle(TX0, TOP, TW, TH)
    solid(cr, (228, 236, 240), finish="glass", a=0.95)
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(TX0 + 6, TOP, TW - 12, TH)
    cr.clip()
    cr.rectangle(TX0, level, TW, BASE - level)
    solid(cr, (24, 78, 150), finish="gloss", edge=False)
    cr.save()
    cr.translate((TX0 + TX1) / 2, level)
    cr.scale(1, ry / (TW / 2))
    cr.arc(0, 0, TW / 2 - 6, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (80, 150, 214), finish="gloss", edge=False)
    if flowing:   # the swirl over the outlet as it drains
        for j in range(3):
            rr = 30 + 40 * ((t * 1.5 + j / 3) % 1)
            cr.save()
            cr.translate(TX1 - 110, level)
            cr.scale(1, 0.3)
            cr.arc(0, 0, rr, 0, 2 * math.pi)
            cr.restore()
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((230, 245, 255), 0.7))
            cr.set_line_width(4)
            cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()
    cylinder(cr, TX0, BASE, TW, TH, (210, 230, 240), finish="glass", a=0.18)
    for hy in (TOP + 140, TOP + 340, TOP + 540):      # the steel hoops
        cr.save()
        cr.translate((TX0 + TX1) / 2, hy)
        cr.scale(1, ry / (TW / 2))
        cr.arc(0, 0, TW / 2, 0, math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 76, 86)))
        cr.set_line_width(10)
        cr.stroke()
    cr.move_to(TX0 - 10, TOP + 4)                      # the conical roof
    cr.line_to((TX0 + TX1) / 2, TOP - 110)
    cr.line_to(TX1 + 10, TOP + 4)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (96, 104, 116), finish="metal")

    # THE SCALE on the glass: where the tank stood full, where 2017's
    # draw-down reached, and the 2022 drop measured against it
    if u >= a0 and landed_to >= 0:
        cr.move_to(TX0 + 16, FULL)
        cr.line_to(TX1 - 16, FULL)
        ghost(cr, a=0.8)
        then_mark(cr, TX0 + 30, TX1 - 30, FULL + unit, rows[0][0])
        times_ticks(cr, TX0 + 30, FULL, -unit, int(top / v0),
                    a=ease(seg(u, a1 - 0.05, a1)))

    # right by the camera: the water main running out to the town
    cr.rectangle(-20, 1690, W + 40, 90)
    solid(cr, (112, 120, 132), finish="metal")
    for fx in (260, 760):
        cr.rectangle(fx, 1676, 40, 118)
        solid(cr, (86, 92, 104), finish="metal")
    # once it has landed the world moves on: a water tanker drives past
    if u > 0.7:
        tx = -480 + (W + 520) * seg(u, 0.7, 1.0)
        ty = 1860
        contact_shadow(cr, tx + 220, ty + 4, 460, a=0.4)
        box(cr, tx + 340, ty - 40, 120, 150, (214, 70, 54), depth=30)       # cab
        cr.rectangle(tx + 360, ty - 170, 80, 50)
        solid(cr, (150, 200, 230), finish="glass")
        cr.rectangle(tx, ty - 60, 340, 24)
        solid(cr, (50, 52, 58), finish="metal")
        cr.move_to(tx + 60, ty - 60)
        cr.line_to(tx + 290, ty - 60)
        cr.arc(tx + 290, ty - 135, 75, math.pi / 2, -math.pi / 2)
        cr.line_to(tx + 60, ty - 210)
        cr.arc(tx + 60, ty - 135, 75, -math.pi / 2, math.pi / 2)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (204, 210, 218), finish="metal")
        # a blue band round the tank and a water drop on it, no words
        cr.rectangle(tx + 40, ty - 150, 270, 26)
        solid(cr, (40, 100, 176), finish="gloss", rim=False)
        dx_, dy_ = tx + 175, ty - 100
        cr.move_to(dx_, dy_ - 34)
        cr.curve_to(dx_ + 8, dy_ - 18, dx_ + 22, dy_ - 4, dx_ + 22, dy_ + 8)
        cr.arc(dx_, dy_ + 8, 22, 0, math.pi)
        cr.curve_to(dx_ - 22, dy_ - 4, dx_ - 8, dy_ - 18, dx_, dy_ - 34)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (60, 140, 214), finish="gloss")
        for wx in (tx + 70, tx + 260, tx + 400):
            disc(cr, wx, ty - 20, 30, (34, 34, 38))
    foreground(cr, "field")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data walks in, turns the valve once per year, then walks to the tank
    gx = WX + 14
    if u < a0:
        host("point", 900 - (900 - gx) * ease(seg(u, 0.0, a0)), FOOT, 220)
    elif u < a1 + 0.02:
        host("grip", gx, FOOT, 220, hands=hands, lower="follow", expr="strain")
    elif u < 0.86:
        w = ease(seg(u, a1 + 0.02, 0.84))
        host("hold_up", gx - (gx - 330) * w, FOOT, 220)
    else:
        host("shock", 330, FOOT, 220)

    if shown is not None:
        lab, v = shown
        fit_readout(cr, f"{v:.1f}M m³", f"of water Microsoft used · {lab}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, a0, a0 + 0.05)), size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Microsoft", f"water use, {rows[0][0]}–{rows[-1][0]}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)
    if named == n - 1:
        text(cr, f"{top / v0:.1f}x", W - 80, 650, 90, look.INK, face="display",
             anchor="right", alpha=ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.05)))

segments.say: Google used 21.2 million cubic meters in 2022, about triple Microsoft's. Big Tech's AI race runs on water.

# scene standard: 2026-10-22
def _dc_drop(cr, cx, cy, h, rgb, a=1.0):
    """A water drop: a pointed top falling to a round belly."""
    r = 0.34 * h
    top = cy - 0.55 * h
    by = cy + 0.12 * h
    cr.move_to(cx, top)
    cr.curve_to(cx + 0.10 * h, top + 0.28 * h, cx + r, by - 0.25 * h, cx + r, by)
    cr.arc(cx, by, r, 0, math.pi)
    cr.curve_to(cx - r, by - 0.25 * h, cx - 0.10 * h, top + 0.28 * h, cx, top)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, rgb, finish="gloss", a=a)


def _dc_tank(cr, x0, w, base, th, level, t, ground, ripple=0.0, ladder=False):
    """A raised glass water tank: braced steel legs, a sight-glass gauge, a
    domed cap with a filler hatch, steel bands, a water-drop badge, and the
    water a lit blue column with a bright surface."""
    # the steel stand: four legs, X-braced, on footings
    contact_shadow(cr, x0 + w / 2, ground + 4, w + 90, a=0.45)
    legs = (x0 + 18, x0 + w * 0.36, x0 + w * 0.64 - 20, x0 + w - 38)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 76, 88)))
    cr.set_line_width(7)
    for la, lb in ((legs[0], legs[1]), (legs[2], legs[3]), (legs[1], legs[2])):
        cr.move_to(la + 10, base + 6)
        cr.line_to(lb + 10, ground - 8)
        cr.move_to(lb + 10, base + 6)
        cr.line_to(la + 10, ground - 8)
    cr.stroke()
    for lx in legs:
        cr.rectangle(lx, base, 20, ground - base)
        solid(cr, (110, 116, 128), finish="metal", rim=False)
        box(cr, lx - 8, ground, 36, 12, (90, 96, 106), depth=10, finish="metal")
    # a ring girder the tank sits on
    box(cr, x0 - 12, base + 14, w + 24, 22, (104, 110, 122), depth=26, finish="metal")
    # the dark inside of the tank, seen through the glass
    cylinder(cr, x0, base, w, th, (52, 60, 72), finish="metal", a=0.55)
    if level > 3:
        cylinder(cr, x0 + 10, base - 6, w - 20, level, (36, 118, 200), finish="glass")
        sy = base - 6 - level
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(x0 + w / 2, sy)
        cr.scale(1, 0.17 + 0.02 * ripple * math.sin(t * 9))
        cr.arc(0, 0, (w - 20) / 2, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        solid(cr, (126, 192, 238), finish="gloss", rim=False)
        if ripple > 0:
            for rr in (0.35, 0.6):
                cr.save()
                cr.translate(x0 + w / 2 + 40, sy)
                cr.scale(1, 0.2)
                cr.arc(0, 0, (w - 20) / 2 * (rr + 0.15 * ((t * 1.5) % 1.0)), 0, 2 * math.pi)
                cr.restore()
                cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((230, 245, 255), 0.6 * ripple))
                cr.set_line_width(3)
                cr.stroke()
    # glass: a faint skin and two long highlights on the lit side
    cylinder(cr, x0, base, w, th, (214, 232, 244), finish="glass", a=0.14)
    for hx, hw_, ha in ((0.13, 0.07, 0.32), (0.24, 0.025, 0.25)):
        cr.rectangle(x0 + w * hx, base - th + 30, w * hw_, th - 60)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 255, 255), ha))
        cr.fill()
    # steel bands
    for yy in (base - 4, base - th * 0.5, base - th + 8):
        cr.rectangle(x0 - 5, yy - 10, w + 10, 20)
        solid(cr, (132, 138, 150), finish="metal", rim=False)
    # the water-drop badge on the upper shell
    bx, byy = x0 + w * 0.56, base - th * 0.76
    disc(cr, bx, byy, 58, (28, 74, 140), finish="gloss")
    _dc_drop(cr, bx, byy + 4, 80, (236, 246, 255))
    # the sight-glass gauge up the left side, showing the same level
    gx = x0 - 26
    cr.rectangle(gx, base - th + 20, 18, th - 30)
    solid(cr, (200, 220, 232), finish="glass", rim=False)
    if level > 3:
        lv = min(level, th - 30)
        cr.rectangle(gx + 3, base - 10 - lv, 12, lv)
        solid(cr, (40, 130, 214), finish="glass", rim=False, edge=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 44, 52)))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(1, 9):
        yy = base - 10 - (th - 30) * i / 9
        cr.move_to(gx + 18, yy)
        cr.line_to(gx + 28, yy)
    cr.stroke()
    for yy in (base - th + 20, base - 10):
        disc(cr, gx + 9, yy, 9, (120, 126, 138), finish="metal")
    # the ladder up the right side
    if ladder:
        lx = x0 + w + 10
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 64, 72)))
        cr.set_line_width(6)
        cr.move_to(lx, ground)
        cr.line_to(lx, base - th)
        cr.move_to(lx + 26, ground)
        cr.line_to(lx + 26, base - th)
        yy = ground - 14
        while yy > base - th:
            cr.move_to(lx, yy)
            cr.line_to(lx + 26, yy)
            yy -= 30
        cr.stroke()
    # domed cap and its filler hatch
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x0 + w / 2, base - th)
    cr.scale(1, 0.32)
    cr.arc(0, 0, w / 2 + 4, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (150, 156, 168), finish="metal")
    cylinder(cr, x0 + w / 2 + 40, base - th - 14, 70, 26, (120, 126, 138), finish="metal")


def _dc_stream(cr, x, y0, y1, t, a=1.0):
    if y1 - y0 < 4 or a <= 0:
        return
    w = 14
    cr.move_to(x - w, y0)
    cr.curve_to(x - 6, y0 + 60, x - 10, y1 - 40, x - 9, y1)
    cr.line_to(x + 9, y1)
    cr.curve_to(x + 10, y1 - 40, x + 6, y0 + 60, x + w, y0)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (70, 156, 226), finish="glass", a=a)
    glow(cr, x, y1, 70, (200, 232, 255), 0.75 * a)
    for j in range(5):
        ang = math.pi * (0.15 + 0.7 * j / 4)
        ph = (t * 2.2 + j * 0.37) % 1.0
        sx = x + math.cos(ang) * 50 * ph * (1 if j % 2 else -1)
        sy = y1 - math.sin(ang) * 60 * ph + 40 * ph * ph
        disc(cr, sx, sy, 7 * (1 - 0.5 * ph), (120, 190, 240), finish="gloss", a=a * (1 - ph))


def _dc_hall(cr, x0, x1, base, t):
    """A data center: long low hall, rows of blue server lights in its
    windows, cooling fans on the roof breathing steam."""
    cast_shadow(cr, x0, x1, base, length=220, a=0.22)
    b = building(cr, x0, x1, base, 240, (184, 190, 200), roof="flat", boards=False)
    n = 7
    for i in range(n):
        wx = b["x0"] + 26 + i * (b["x1"] - b["x0"] - 52) / n
        cr.rectangle(wx, b["top"] + 56, 40, 120)
        solid(cr, (34, 44, 64), finish="glass", rim=False)
        for r_ in range(5):
            on = ((i * 3 + r_ * 5 + int(t * 2)) % 7) != 0
            cr.rectangle(wx + 8, b["top"] + 70 + r_ * 21, 24, 5)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((110, 200, 255) if on else (40, 70, 110), 0.95))
            cr.fill()
    for j in range(3):
        cx = b["x0"] + 50 + j * (b["x1"] - b["x0"] - 150) / 2
        box(cr, cx, b["top"] + 2, 100, 46, (160, 166, 176), depth=24, finish="metal")
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(cx + 62, b["top"] - 44)
        cr.scale(1, 0.32)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 34, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        solid(cr, (50, 54, 62), finish="metal", rim=False)
        steam(cr, cx + 62, b["top"] - 90, t + j, strength=1.7)


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: two glass water tanks at data centers
    SUBSTANCE: blue water
    CAUSE: Data pours buckets of water into each company's tank, one pour for Microsoft and three for Google
    Two identical raised glass cooling-water tanks, water towers on braced
    steel legs with a water-drop badge, a sight-glass gauge and a filler
    hatch, stand in front of their data centers in the desert, a catwalk
    across their domed tops. Data pours one bucket into Microsoft's tank and
    its water rises to 6.4; then he walks the catwalk to Google's and pours
    three times, the water climbing past Microsoft's level. Both tanks are
    the same size, so their heights read the comparison directly.
    Microsoft's level is marked on Google's glass (a short mark, its name
    inside the tank) and 1x 2x 3x ticks up the tank's right side measure
    Google's water in Microsoft's: about three times as much. Done by 0.66
    and held while steam keeps rising off the cooling fans, the server
    lights blink, and Data holds up his bucket over the full tank."""
    rows = sorted([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts], key=lambda r: r[1])
    (lm, vm), (lg, vg) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    vg = vg or 1.0
    ratio = vg / (vm or 1.0)

    GROUND = 1460
    BASE, TH = 1360, 480
    TOP = BASE - TH
    LG = TH * 0.88
    LM = LG * vm / vg
    MX0, GX0, TW = 60, 530, 350

    a0 = 0.06
    fm = seg(u, a0, 0.22)
    lev_m = LM * ease(seg(fm, 0.2, 0.85))
    wk = ease(seg(u, 0.22, 0.30))
    g0, g1, n = 0.30, 0.66, 3
    span = (g1 - g0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - g0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - g0 - k * span) / span)
    rise = ease(seg(f, 0.15, 0.8))
    lev_g = 0.0 if u < g0 else LG * (k + rise) / n
    g_done = u >= g0 and k == n - 1 and rise >= 0.999
    pour_m = 0.0 < seg(fm, 0.1, 0.85) < 1.0 and u < 0.22
    pour_g = u >= g0 and u < g1 + 0.02 and 0.0 < seg(f, 0.1, 0.82) < 1.0

    # the desert, and the data centers behind
    landscape(cr, t, "desert")
    _dc_hall(cr, -40, 500, 1200, t)
    _dc_hall(cr, 560, 1120, 1210, t + 0.5)
    haze(cr, 640, 1230, (236, 214, 184), a=0.38)
    birds(cr, t, y0=700, n=4, rgb=(70, 60, 60))

    # the risers from each tank's belly down to the water main
    for cx in (MX0 + TW / 2, GX0 + TW / 2):
        cr.rectangle(cx - 20, BASE + 30, 40, 1640 - BASE - 30)
        solid(cr, (96, 104, 116), finish="metal")

    # the two tanks, the same size, raised on their stands
    cast_shadow(cr, MX0, MX0 + TW, GROUND, length=320, a=0.3)
    cast_shadow(cr, GX0, GX0 + TW, GROUND, length=320, a=0.3)
    _dc_tank(cr, MX0, TW, BASE, TH, lev_m, t, GROUND, 1.0 if pour_m else 0.0, ladder=True)
    _dc_tank(cr, GX0, TW, BASE, TH, lev_g, t, GROUND, 1.0 if pour_g else 0.0)
    text(cr, lm, MX0 + TW / 2, BASE - 34, 46, look.INK, anchor="center")
    text(cr, lg, GX0 + TW / 2, BASE - 34, 46, look.INK, anchor="center")

    # THE SCALE on Google's tank: Microsoft's level, and the ticks up its side
    if u >= g0:
        then_mark(cr, GX0 + 16, GX0 + 120, BASE - 6 - LM, lm)
        times_ticks(cr, GX0 + TW + 40, BASE - 6, LM, max(1, int(ratio)))

    # the catwalk across the tank tops
    FY = TOP - 30
    box(cr, 30, FY + 16, 880, 16, (96, 102, 112), depth=28, finish="metal")
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((54, 58, 66)))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    cr.move_to(30, FY - 72)
    cr.line_to(910, FY - 72)
    cr.move_to(30, FY - 36)
    cr.line_to(910, FY - 36)
    for px in range(30, 911, 110):
        cr.move_to(px, FY)
        cr.line_to(px, FY - 72)
    cr.stroke()

    # right by the camera: the water main that feeds them, flanged
    cr.rectangle(-10, 1630, W + 20, 120)
    solid(cr, (112, 120, 130), finish="metal")
    for fx in (60, 420, 790):
        cr.rectangle(fx, 1612, 54, 156)
        solid(cr, (82, 88, 98), finish="metal")
        for by_ in (1628, 1752):
            disc(cr, fx + 27, by_, 8, (150, 156, 166), finish="metal")
    foreground(cr, "desert", y0=1770)
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data on the catwalk, his bucket over the tank
    HH = 236
    mx, gx = MX0 + 60, GX0 + 50
    if u < g0:
        hx = mx + (gx - mx) * wk
    else:
        hx = gx + 60 * k
    sx = hx + 76
    if u < a0:
        host("point", mx, FY, HH)
    elif u < 0.22:
        host("pour", hx, FY, HH, beat=0)
        if pour_m:
            _dc_stream(cr, sx, FY - 120, BASE - 6 - lev_m, t)
    elif u < g0:
        host("hold_up", hx, FY, HH)
    elif u < g1 + 0.02:
        host("pour", hx, FY, HH, beat=k + 1)
        if pour_g:
            _dc_stream(cr, sx, FY - 120, BASE - 6 - lev_g, t)
    elif u < 0.9:
        host("hold_up", hx, FY, HH)
    else:
        host("shock", hx, FY, HH)

    if g_done:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{vg:.1f}M m³", f"of water used by {lg} in a year",
                    80, 520, size=130)
        text(cr, f"{ratio:.1f}x", W - 80, 650, 90, look.INK, face="display",
             anchor="right", alpha=ease(seg(u, g1, g1 + 0.04)))
    elif fm >= 0.85:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{vm:.1f}M m³", f"of water used by {lm} in a year",
                    80, 520, size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Thirsty AI", "the water Big Tech's data centers drink",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

# scene standard: 2026-10-22
def _wb_body(cr, mp):
    """The bottle's body in its own frame (pivot at the bottom-right corner,
    upright, x -260..0, y -560..0), traced through mp into the frame."""
    cr.new_path()
    cr.move_to(*mp(-165, -560))
    cr.curve_to(*mp(-200, -540), *mp(-260, -520), *mp(-260, -470))
    cr.line_to(*mp(-260, -30))
    cr.curve_to(*mp(-260, -10), *mp(-250, 0), *mp(-230, 0))
    cr.line_to(*mp(-30, 0))
    cr.curve_to(*mp(-10, 0), *mp(0, -10), *mp(0, -30))
    cr.line_to(*mp(0, -470))
    cr.curve_to(*mp(0, -520), *mp(-60, -540), *mp(-95, -560))
    cr.close_path()


def _wb_quad(cr, mp, x0, y0, x1, y1):
    cr.new_path()
    cr.move_to(*mp(x0, y0))
    cr.line_to(*mp(x1, y0))
    cr.line_to(*mp(x1, y1))
    cr.line_to(*mp(x0, y1))
    cr.close_path()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a giant plastic water bottle
    SUBSTANCE: the bottle's water
    CAUSE: Data tips the bottle over by hand and it pours into the data center's cooling intake
    One long AI chat drinks one bottle of water. A half-liter bottle, blown
    up to the size of the shot, stands in the desert in front of a data
    center. Data gets his own two hands under it and tips it over, and its
    water pours in a stream into the cooling intake until the bottle is
    empty. The whole bottle is the whole chat. Its upright outline stays as
    a ghost where it stood. The empty bottle lands by 0.62 and the readout
    names the chat. After that he keeps it tipped and gives it a slow shake
    for the last drops while the cooling units steam."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    b_row = next((r for r in rows if "bottle" in r[0].lower()), rows[0])
    c_row = next((r for r in rows if r is not b_row), rows[-1])

    PX, PY = 470.0, 1440.0
    tip = ease(seg(u, 0.08, 0.30))
    th = math.radians(55) * tip
    drain = seg(u, 0.24, 0.62)
    vol = 0.92 * (1.0 - drain)
    if u > 0.64:
        q = (u - 0.64) / 0.2
        th += math.radians(4) * ease(seg(u, 0.64, 0.7)) * math.sin(2 * math.pi * q)
    cs, sn = math.cos(th), math.sin(th)

    def mp(lx, ly):
        return (PX + lx * cs - ly * sn, PY + lx * sn + ly * cs)

    def up(lx, ly):
        return (PX + lx, PY + ly)

    # the setting: open desert under a low sun, a data center behind
    landscape(cr, t, "desert")
    haze(cr, 900, 1250, (232, 214, 188), a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, 810, 1304, 560, a=0.35)
    cast_shadow(cr, 560, 1060, 1300, length=260, a=0.25)
    b = building(cr, 560, 1060, 1300, 230, (196, 200, 208), roof_rgb=(110, 116, 128),
                 roof="flat", boards=False)
    for i in range(3):
        ux = b["x0"] + 40 + i * 150
        box(cr, ux, b["top"] - 4, 110, 60, (150, 156, 166), finish="metal")
        steam(cr, ux + 55, b["top"] - 70, t + i * 0.7, strength=1.6)
    for r_ in range(2):
        for c_ in range(6):
            cr.rectangle(b["x0"] + 40 + c_ * 74, b["top"] + 50 + r_ * 70, 46, 18)
            solid(cr, (60, 130, 200), finish="gloss", rim=False)
    text(cr, "DATA CENTER", (b["x0"] + b["x1"]) / 2, b["top"] + 200, 34, look.INK,
         face="bold", anchor="center", shadow=False)

    # the cooling intake the water goes into
    cr.rectangle(1004, 1240, 36, 120)
    solid(cr, (130, 136, 146), finish="metal")
    contact_shadow(cr, 955, 1474, 230, a=0.4)
    cylinder(cr, 860, 1470, 190, 150, (150, 156, 166), finish="metal")
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(955, 1320)
    cr.scale(1, 0.22)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 80, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (36, 44, 56), rim=False)
    text(cr, "COOLING", 955, 1420, 26, look.INK, face="bold", anchor="center",
         shadow=False)

    # where the full bottle stood, its upright outline stays as a ghost
    cast_shadow(cr, 210, 470, 1440, length=300, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, 340, 1444, 300, a=0.4)
    if tip > 0.05:
        _wb_body(cr, up)
        ghost(cr, a=0.8)

    # the bottle, clear plastic
    _wb_body(cr, mp)
    solid(cr, (214, 232, 244), finish="glass", a=0.55)
    # its water: the surface stays level as it tips
    corners = [mp(*p) for p in ((-260, 0), (0, 0), (-260, -470), (0, -470),
                                (-165, -560), (-95, -560))]
    y_low = max(p[1] for p in corners)
    y_high = min(p[1] for p in corners)
    if vol > 0.002:
        level = y_low - vol * (y_low - y_high)
        cr.save()
        _wb_body(cr, mp)
        cr.clip()
        cr.rectangle(0, level, W, H - level)
        solid(cr, (64, 146, 222), finish="gloss", edge=False)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((200, 232, 255), 0.8))
        cr.set_line_width(5)
        cr.move_to(0, level)
        cr.line_to(W, level)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.restore()
    # ribs and the label band, all in the bottle's own frame
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 255, 255), 0.45))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    for ry in (-110, -150, -400, -440):
        cr.move_to(*mp(-256, ry))
        cr.line_to(*mp(-4, ry))
    cr.stroke()
    _wb_quad(cr, mp, -260, -330, 0, -210)
    solid(cr, (40, 110, 190), a=0.95)
    _wb_quad(cr, mp, -260, -285, 0, -262)
    solid(cr, (236, 242, 248), rim=False, edge=False)
    _wb_quad(cr, mp, -172, -620, -88, -560)
    solid(cr, (30, 90, 170), finish="gloss")
    _wb_body(cr, mp)
    edge(cr, (40, 56, 72))

    # the pour: mouth to intake, only while the bottle drains
    mx, my = mp(-130, -625)
    ex, ey = 955.0, 1325.0
    cx_ = mx + 140 * sn
    cy_ = my - 140 * cs
    if 0 < drain < 1 and tip > 0.6:
        flow = clamp(min(drain / 0.06, (1 - drain) / 0.1))
        cr.move_to(mx, my)
        cr.curve_to(cx_, cy_, ex, cy_, ex, ey)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((64, 146, 222)))
        cr.set_line_width(14 + 26 * flow)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.move_to(mx, my)
        cr.curve_to(cx_, cy_, ex, cy_, ex, ey)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((200, 232, 255), 0.8))
        cr.set_line_width(5)
        cr.stroke()
        for j in range(5):
            s_ = (t * 1.6 + j / 5.0) % 1.0
            a_ = 1 - s_
            bx = a_ ** 3 * mx + 3 * a_ * a_ * s_ * cx_ + 3 * a_ * s_ * s_ * ex + s_ ** 3 * ex
            by = a_ ** 3 * my + 3 * a_ * a_ * s_ * cy_ + 3 * a_ * s_ * s_ * cy_ + s_ ** 3 * ey
            disc(cr, bx, by, 14 * flow + 4, (120, 186, 240), finish="gloss")
    elif drain >= 1:
        # the last drops shaken out
        for j in range(2):
            ph = ((u - 0.62) / 0.12 + j * 0.5) % 1.0
            disc(cr, mx + 40, my + ph * (ey - my), 10, (100, 170, 235), finish="gloss")

    # right by the camera: empties lying in the sand
    for i in range(3):
        bottle(cr, 160 + i * 360, 1680 + (i % 2) * 90, 0.4 + i * 1.1, 2.8,
               (190, 220, 240))
    foreground(cr, "desert")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # his hands under the bottle's own edge, lifting it over
    HY = 1300.0
    s_face = (PY - HY - 260 * sn) / max(0.2, cs)
    if s_face >= 10:
        h1, h2 = mp(-260, -s_face), mp(-260, -s_face - 50)
    else:
        w_ = min(260.0, (PY - HY) / max(0.05, sn))
        h1, h2 = mp(-w_, 0), mp(-w_ + 50, 0)
    fx = (h1[0] + h2[0]) / 2 - 60
    if u < 0.08:
        host("point", 120, 1452, 220)
    else:
        host("grip", fx, 1452, 220, hands=[h1, h2],
             lower="brace", expr="strain" if u < 0.64 else "shock")

    if u >= 0.62:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(c_row[1]))} ml", "of water for one long AI chat",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.62, 0.66)), size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(b_row[1]))} ml", b_row[0].lower(),
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

    cylinder(cr, -46 * s, -150 * s, 92 * s, 34 * s, (246, 244, 238), finish="gloss")
    cr.restore()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a giant prescription pill bottle
    SUBSTANCE: white opioid pills
    CAUSE: Data shovels pills out of the bottle, and the pill level drops with every scoop
    The whole bottle holds 100 prescriptions for every 100 Americans. In 2012 the
    pills fill it to 81.3. Scoop by scoop Data digs them out over the open rim
    into the pharmacy's returns bin, riding the pill surface down until it sits
    at 2020's 43.3. A dashed mark on the glass keeps 2012's level, so a glance
    shows the bottle has dropped to about half. It is done by 0.62 and held.
    The bottle reads as itself: amber vial, threaded neck, the white
    child-proof cap stood against it with PUSH DOWN & TURN, the Rx label; a
    small tipped vial spills pills right by the camera."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    n = 5
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.62
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    drop = ease(seg(f, 0.3, 0.7))
    step = 0.0 if u < a0 else (k + drop) / n
    val = v0 + (v1 - v0) * step
    done = u >= a1

    # a BIG open vial, centred, filling the middle of the frame
    BX, BW, BASE = 250, 560, 1420
    NECK = 60                       # the threaded neck above the shoulder
    TOP = 660                       # the mouth
    SH = TOP + NECK                 # the body's top
    CXB = BX + BW / 2
    RY = BW * 0.16
    inner = BASE - 30 - (SH + 20)

    def lvl(v):
        return BASE - 30 - inner * v / 100.0
    LY = lvl(val)

    # full-bleed ground first: the whole frame, top to bottom
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (52, 58, 70)), (0.3, (92, 100, 110)), (0.7, (140, 142, 140)),
               (0.74, (128, 92, 62)), (1, (88, 62, 42))], 0, H)
    # the pharmacy ceiling: light panels running back toward the far wall
    for i in range(6):
        z = i / 5.0
        lx = 60 + 700 * z ** 0.8
        ly = 70 + 230 * z ** 0.9
        sc = 1.0 - 0.6 * z
        glow(cr, lx + 90 * sc, ly, 180 * sc, (255, 240, 205), 0.35)
        box(cr, lx, ly, 180 * sc, 20 * sc, (246, 242, 230), depth=36 * sc)
    # the left side wall running back into the store, its shelves converging
    VX, VY = 820, 900
    cr.move_to(0, 0)
    cr.line_to(230, 330)
    cr.line_to(230, 1160)
    cr.line_to(0, 1330)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (110, 116, 124), rim=False, edge=False)
    for r_ in range(6):
        y0 = 360 + r_ * 160
        yb = y0 + (y0 - VY) * 0.0
        y_far = VY + (y0 - VY) * (1 - 230 / VX)
        cr.move_to(0, y0 + (y0 - VY) * 0.35)
        cr.line_to(230, y_far)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 72, 80)))
        cr.set_line_width(8)
        cr.stroke()
        for i in range(5):
            fx = 12 + i * 44
            fy = (y0 + (y0 - VY) * 0.35) + (y_far - (y0 + (y0 - VY) * 0.35)) * fx / 230
            sc = 1.0 - 0.5 * fx / 230
            cylinder(cr, fx, fy - 4, 30 * sc, 70 * sc,
                     (206, 124, 44) if (i + r_) % 2 else (238, 236, 228), finish="gloss")
    # the PHARMACY sign over the back wall
    glow(cr, 640, 380, 380, (120, 200, 160), 0.25)
    box(cr, 400, 420, 460, 86, (40, 120, 92), depth=30)
    text(cr, "PHARMACY", 630, 394, 52, (240, 250, 244), face="display", anchor="center",
         shadow=False)
    # the back wall of stocked shelves
    for r_ in range(5):
        sy = 620 + r_ * 112
        cr.rectangle(230, sy, W - 230, 12)
        solid(cr, (150, 146, 138), rim=False)
        for i in range(13):
            cylinder(cr, 244 + i * 64, sy, 38, 60 - (i % 3) * 8,
                     (206, 124, 44) if (i + r_) % 3 else (238, 236, 228), finish="gloss")
    haze(cr, 300, 1160, (120, 126, 132), a=0.55)
    # the pickup carousel keeps turning: white prescription bags on a rail
    cr.rectangle(0, 1170, W, 10)
    solid(cr, (50, 52, 58), finish="metal", rim=False)
    for i in range(9):
        bx = -120 + ((t * 70 + i * 150) % 1350)
        _rx_bag(cr, bx, 1206, 1.0)

    # the counter, in perspective: its top runs from the camera back to the wall
    cr.move_to(-20, 1520)
    cr.line_to(W + 20, 1520)
    cr.line_to(W, 1360)
    cr.line_to(60, 1350)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (214, 204, 186), rim=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((190, 178, 158), 0.7))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(1, 8):
        cr.move_to(60 + i * 130, 1352)
        cr.line_to(-20 + i * 150, 1520)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.rectangle(0, 1520, W, H - 1520)
    solid(cr, (128, 92, 62), rim=False, edge=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((96, 66, 44)))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    for i in range(1, 6):
        cr.move_to(i * 180, 1520)
        cr.line_to(i * 180, H)
    cr.stroke()

    # the returns bin on the right, further back on the counter
    contact_shadow(cr, 945, 1424, 200, a=0.35)
    box(cr, 860, 1424, 170, 140, (60, 98, 150), depth=36)
    text(cr, "RETURNS", 945, 1380, 26, (238, 240, 244), face="bold", anchor="center")

    # THE BOTTLE: amber glass, threaded neck, open mouth, pills inside
    cast_shadow(cr, BX, BX + BW, BASE, length=300, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, CXB, BASE + 4, BW + 60, a=0.45)
    cylinder(cr, BX, BASE, BW, BASE - SH, (206, 118, 36), finish="glass", a=0.94)
    # the empty inside above the pills: the far wall, darker amber
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(BX + 14, SH, BW - 28, LY - SH)
    cr.clip()
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (120, 62, 18)), (1, (168, 92, 30))], SH, LY, BX, BX + BW)
    cr.restore()
    # the pills, packed below the level
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(BX + 14, LY, BW - 28, BASE - 20 - LY)
    cr.clip()
    cr.rectangle(BX + 14, LY, BW - 28, BASE - 20 - LY)
    solid(cr, (232, 228, 218), rim=False, edge=False)
    for i in range(170):
        px = BX + 30 + ((i * 0.6180339) % 1.0) * (BW - 60)
