_FW, _FH = 190, 126


def _ol_flag(cr, px, ty, s, t, j, amp):
    fw, fh = _FW * s, _FH * s

    def warp(fx, fy):
        return (px + fw * fx,
                ty + fh * fy + amp * fx * math.sin(t * 3.2 - fx * 7 + j * 1.3))

    def path(poly):
        first = True
        m = len(poly)
        for i in range(m):
            (x0, y0), (x1, y1) = poly[i], poly[(i + 1) % m]
            steps = 6 if m <= 6 else 1
            for q in range(steps):
                w = q / steps
                p_ = warp(x0 + (x1 - x0) * w, y0 + (y1 - y0) * w)
                if first:
                    cr.move_to(*p_)
                    first = False
                else:
                    cr.line_to(*p_)
        cr.close_path()

    for i, (col, poly) in enumerate(_ol_flagdef(j)):
        path(poly)
        solid(cr, col, edge=False, rim=(i == 0))
    # a fold of shade down the wave, so the cloth reads as cloth
    path(_ol_R(0, 0, 1, 1))
    cr.save()
    cr.clip()
    for q in range(3):
        fx = 0.3 + 0.3 * q + 0.05 * math.sin(t * 3.2 + j)
        x0, _ = warp(fx, 0)
        g = cairo.LinearGradient(x0 - 16 * s, 0, x0 + 16 * s, 0)
        g.add_color_stop_rgba(0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
        g.add_color_stop_rgba(0.5, 0, 0, 0, 0.18)
        g.add_color_stop_rgba(1, 0, 0, 0, 0)
        cr.set_source(g)
        cr.rectangle(x0 - 16 * s, ty - amp - 10, 32 * s, fh + 2 * amp + 20)
        cr.fill()
    cr.restore()
    path(_ol_R(0, 0, 1, 1))
    edge(cr, (40, 40, 46))


def _ol_folded(cr, x, foot, s, j):
    """A lowered flag, folded and laid at the foot of its pole, in its own colours."""
    d = _ol_flagdef(j)
    ca = d[0][0]
    cb = d[1][0] if len(d) > 1 else _WHITE
    contact_shadow(cr, x + 34 * s, foot, 80 * s, a=0.35)
    box(cr, x, foot, 68 * s, 16 * s, ca, depth=18 * s)
    box(cr, x + 4 * s, foot - 16 * s, 60 * s, 13 * s, cb, depth=16 * s)
    box(cr, x + 8 * s, foot - 29 * s, 52 * s, 12 * s, ca, depth=14 * s)


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a row of national flags on poles
    SUBSTANCE: the bidding nations' flags
    CAUSE: Data hauls each dropped-out city's flag down its pole by the halyard rope
    Eleven flagpoles march from right by the camera back toward an Olympic
    stadium, one per city that bid in 2004, each flying a real national
    flag you can name by its own pattern: the tricolour, the stars and
    stripes, the red sun, the Union Jack, the Nordic crosses, the maple
    leaf. Poles alternate tall and short so no flag hides another. Year by
    year Data walks the row from the far end toward the camera and hauls
    down the flag of every city that dropped out, folding it at the pole's
    foot, until only the two nearest fly. THE SCALE is on the poles: every
    lowered flag leaves its dashed outline at the masthead, so eleven
    against two reads at a glance. Done by 0.64 and held; the last two
    keep flying."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    n = len(rows)
    cnt = [max(0, int(round(v))) for _, v in rows]
    N = max(1, max(cnt))
    gone, g = [], 0
    for c in cnt:
        g = max(g, N - c)
        gone.append(g)
    R = gone[-1]

    A0, A1, HOLD = 0.05, 0.64, 0.6
    units = max(1, R) - 1 + 1.5 + HOLD * max(0, n - 2)
    unit = (A1 - A0) / units
    starts, land, cur = [], [A0] * n, A0
    for k in range(1, n):
        m = gone[k] - gone[k - 1]
        for _ in range(m):
            starts.append(cur)
            cur += unit
        land[k] = (cur + 0.5 * unit) if m > 0 else cur
        if k < n - 1:
            cur += HOLD * unit
    drop = [ease(clamp((u - s0) / (1.5 * unit))) for s0 in starts]

    poles = _ol_poles(N)

    # the setting: a town under a low sun, the Olympic stadium behind
    landscape(cr, t, "town", horizon=1170)
    contact_shadow(cr, 760, 1215, 700, a=0.3)
    cylinder(cr, 430, 1215, 640, 170, (214, 208, 198))
    for i in range(10):
        ax = 460 + i * 60
        cr.rectangle(ax, 1140, 34, 52)
        cr.arc(ax + 17, 1140, 17, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((64, 60, 66)))
        cr.fill()
    for lx in (420, 1050):
        cylinder(cr, lx - 5, 1215, 10, 360, (150, 154, 162), finish="metal")
        box(cr, lx - 26, 860, 52, 26, (236, 236, 228), depth=10)
    cr.set_line_width(9)
    for dx, dy, col in ((-66, 0, (0, 129, 200)), (0, 0, (30, 30, 34)), (66, 0, (238, 51, 78)),
                        (-33, 26, (252, 177, 49)), (33, 26, (0, 166, 81))):
        cr.new_path()
        cr.arc(760 + dx, 1085 + dy, 29, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(col))
        cr.stroke()
    haze(cr, 800, 1225, (232, 214, 196), a=0.4)

    # the plaza, paving running back toward the stadium
    def _plaza():
        cr.move_to(0, 1232)
        cr.line_to(W, 1205)
        cr.line_to(W, H)
        cr.line_to(0, H)
        cr.close_path()
    _plaza()
    solid(cr, (196, 188, 174), edge=False)
    cr.save()
    _plaza()
    cr.clip()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 112, 100), 0.35))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(14):
        cr.move_to(1250, 1100)
        cr.line_to(-900 + i * 200, H)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()
    glow(cr, 420, 1450, 520, (255, 236, 200), 0.18)

    # the row of flagpoles, far first; tall and short alternate so every
    # flag is seen whole
    for j in reversed(range(N)):
        px, foot, s = poles[j]
        HP = 620 if j % 2 == 0 else 450
        top = foot - HP * s
        i_flag = N - 1 - j
        d = drop[i_flag] if i_flag < len(drop) else 0.0
        pw = 13 * s
        cast_shadow(cr, px - pw / 2, px + pw / 2, foot, length=220 * s, a=0.22)
        contact_shadow(cr, px, foot, 50 * s, a=0.4)
        box(cr, px - 18 * s, foot, 36 * s, 14 * s, (168, 162, 152), depth=10 * s)
        cylinder(cr, px - pw / 2, foot - 12 * s, pw, HP * s - 12 * s, (206, 210, 216),
                 finish="metal")
        disc(cr, px, top - 8 * s, 11 * s, P["brass"], finish="metal")
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 70, 78), 0.85))
        cr.set_line_width(max(1.5, 2.5 * s))
        cr.move_to(px + 8 * s, top)
        cr.line_to(px + 8 * s, foot - 40 * s)
        cr.stroke()
        disc(cr, px + 8 * s, foot - 40 * s, 4 * s, (110, 110, 118), finish="metal")
        fw, fh = _FW * s, _FH * s
        hi = top + 10 * s
        lo = foot - 40 * s - fh
        if d > 0:
            cr.rectangle(px, hi, fw, fh)
            ghost(cr, a=0.6)
        if d < 1.0:
            _ol_flag(cr, px, hi + (lo - hi) * d, s, t, j, 20 * s * (1 - 0.7 * d))
        else:
            _ol_folded(cr, px + 14 * s, foot + 2, s, j)

    # right by the camera: the Olympic podium (gold rings on its faces, no
    # numerals) and the torch, burning
    contact_shadow(cr, 260, 1900, 520, a=0.4)
    for bx, bh in ((40, 120), (210, 190), (380, 80)):
        box(cr, bx, 1910, 170, bh, (230, 226, 216), depth=40)
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    for dx, dy, col in ((-30, 0, (0, 129, 200)), (0, 0, (30, 30, 34)), (30, 0, (238, 51, 78)),
                        (-15, 12, (252, 177, 49)), (15, 12, (0, 166, 81))):
        cr.new_path()
        cr.arc(295 + dx, 1800 + dy, 13, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(col))
        cr.stroke()
    cr.move_to(932, H)
    cr.line_to(992, H)
    cr.line_to(1012, 1660)
    cr.line_to(912, 1660)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (196, 200, 208), finish="metal")
    cylinder(cr, 900, 1672, 124, 28, P["brass"], finish="metal")
    glow(cr, 962, 1580, 160, (255, 170, 60), 0.5)
    fl = 1 + 0.08 * math.sin(t * 7)
    cr.move_to(906, 1648)
    cr.curve_to(900, 1590, 940, 1560, 950, 1500 - 20 * fl)
    cr.curve_to(966, 1550, 990, 1530, 984, 1490 + 14 * math.sin(t * 5))
    cr.curve_to(1020, 1560, 1024, 1610, 1018, 1648)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (250, 150, 40), edge=False)
    foreground(cr, "town")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data walks the row from the far end, hauling each flag down
    def _at(jf):
        jf = clamp(jf, 0, N - 1)
        j0 = int(jf)
        j1 = min(N - 1, j0 + 1)
        w = jf - j0
        return tuple(a + (b - a) * w for a, b in zip(poles[j0], poles[j1]))
    ci = max((i for i, s0 in enumerate(starts) if s0 <= u), default=-1)
    if ci < 0:
        jf = N - 1
    else:
        frm = N - 1 - max(0, ci - 1)
        to = N - 1 - ci
        jf = frm + (to - frm) * ease(clamp((u - starts[ci]) / (0.8 * unit)))
    px, foot, s = _at(jf)
    hx, hy = px + 34 * s, min(1500.0, foot)
    hh = clamp(200 * s, 180, 240)
    if u < A0 or ci < 0:
        host("point", hx, hy, hh)
    elif u < A1 + 0.04:
        host("haul", hx, hy, hh, beat=ci)
    else:
        host("hold_up", hx, hy, hh)

    named = n - 1 if u >= land[n - 1] else 0
    c = cnt[named]
    fit_readout(cr, f"{c} cit{'y' if c == 1 else 'ies'}",
                f"bidding to host the Olympics · {rows[named][0]}",
                80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

# scene standard: 2026-10-22
def _ol_band(cr, cx, y_lo, y_hi, rx_lo, rx_hi, k, rgb, finish="matte"):
    # the front face of one ring of the bowl, lo edge to hi edge, as a lit solid
    n = 28
    for i in range(n + 1):
        a = math.pi * i / n
        x = cx + rx_lo * math.cos(a)
        y = y_lo + rx_lo * k * math.sin(a)
        if i == 0:
            cr.move_to(x, y)
        else:
            cr.line_to(x, y)
    for i in range(n, -1, -1):
        a = math.pi * i / n
        cr.line_to(cx + rx_hi * math.cos(a), y_hi + rx_hi * k * math.sin(a))
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, rgb, finish=finish)


def _ol_arc(cr, cx, y0, r, k):
    # trace the front half-ring of the bowl at one level (no fill)
    for i in range(29):
        a = math.pi * i / 28
        x_ = cx + r * math.cos(a)
        y_ = y0 + r * k * math.sin(a)
        if i == 0:
            cr.move_to(x_, y_)
        else:
            cr.line_to(x_, y_)


def _ol_ellipse(cr, cx, cy, rx, ry):
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(cx, cy)
    cr.scale(rx, ry)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 1, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()


def _ol_flag(cr, x, y, t):
    # the Olympic flag right by the camera, flying left off its pole
    box(cr, x - 6, H, 12, H - y + 10, (206, 208, 214), finish="metal")
    disc(cr, x, y - 8, 10, (214, 180, 80), finish="metal")
    n, fw, fh = 14, 200, 130

    def wav(i):
        return 16 * math.sin(t * 3.0 - i * 0.7) * (i / n)
    cr.move_to(x, y)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        cr.line_to(x - fw * i / n, y + wav(i))
    for i in range(n, -1, -1):
        cr.line_to(x - fw * i / n, y + fh + wav(i))
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (246, 246, 244))
    rings = [((0, 129, 200), -2, 0), ((20, 20, 24), 0, 0), ((238, 51, 78), 2, 0),
             ((252, 177, 49), -1, 1), ((0, 166, 81), 1, 1)]
    for rgb, ox, oy in rings:
        i = n / 2 - ox * 1.5
        rx_ = x - fw * i / n
        ry_ = y + fh * 0.42 + oy * 20 + wav(i)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(rgb))
        cr.set_line_width(5)
        cr.new_sub_path()
        cr.arc(rx_, ry_, 19, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.stroke()


def _ol_cone(cr, x, y, s):
    contact_shadow(cr, x, y, 70 * s, a=0.35)
    cr.move_to(x - 30 * s, y)
    cr.line_to(x - 8 * s, y - 80 * s)
    cr.line_to(x + 8 * s, y - 80 * s)
    cr.line_to(x + 30 * s, y)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (236, 116, 40), finish="gloss")
    cr.move_to(x - 20 * s, y - 28 * s)
    cr.line_to(x - 14 * s, y - 50 * s)
    cr.line_to(x + 14 * s, y - 50 * s)
    cr.line_to(x + 20 * s, y - 28 * s)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (244, 242, 236), rim=False)
    box(cr, x - 40 * s, y + 4 * s, 80 * s, 10 * s, (210, 96, 34), depth=14 * s)


def _ol_crane(cr, t, mx, base, top):
    # a tower crane behind the bowl: a yellow lattice mast, its jib slewing
    # slowly over the stadium with a concrete stand section swinging on the hook
    contact_shadow(cr, mx + 17, base, 90, a=0.3)
    box(cr, mx, base, 34, base - top, (232, 182, 42), depth=10, finish="metal")
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 90, 20), 0.8))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    y_ = base
    while y_ > top + 30:
        cr.move_to(mx + 2, y_)
        cr.line_to(mx + 32, y_ - 30)
        cr.move_to(mx + 32, y_ - 30)
        cr.line_to(mx + 2, y_ - 60)
        y_ -= 60
    cr.stroke()
    th = math.pi + 0.75 * math.sin(t * 0.9)
    L = 460
    px, py = mx + 17, top
    ex, ey = px + L * math.cos(th), py - 60 * math.sin(th)
    cx_, cy_ = px - 0.3 * L * math.cos(th), py + 18 * math.sin(th)   # counter-jib
    nx, ny = -(ey - cy_), ex - cx_
    nl = math.hypot(nx, ny) or 1.0

    cr.line_to(ex + nx * 0.5, ey + ny * 0.5)

    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (236, 188, 48), finish="metal")
    box(cr, cx_ - 26, cy_ + 34, 52, 40, (120, 120, 126), depth=12)    # counterweight
    box(cr, px - 26, py + 12, 52, 44, (224, 176, 40), depth=12, finish="metal")  # cab
    tx = px + 0.82 * L * math.cos(th)
    ty = py - 0.82 * 60 * math.sin(th)
    sw = 26 * math.sin(t * 1.3 + 0.6)
    hx, hy = tx + sw, ty + 300
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 40, 44)))

        cr.move_to(hx - 70, hy + 58 - j * 11)

def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: an Olympic stadium overbuilt past budget
    SUBSTANCE: grey concrete tiers of stands
    CAUSE: Data places tier after tier of concrete stands on the stadium until it towers far over its budget line
    The stadium's height is its cost. It stands at the size the city budgeted
    (the 1x), and tier by tier Data, standing on the front lip of the rim,
    places more grey concrete stands on it until the bowl is 2.56x its
    planned height: the Olympics' average 156% overrun. The new tiers are the
    same concrete as the old, a fresher grey, each capped with a thin accent
    safety rail that marks the overrun share; the stuff itself is never
    recoloured. Floodlight masts ride up on the rim as it climbs. A dashed
    budget line and the rail line (the next-worst kind of project) are marked
    on the facade, ticks up its side count it in budgets. Done by 0.56, then
    held; the site keeps working: the tower crane slews with a stand section
    on its hook, a cement mixer rolls past the camera, the flag flies."""
    rows = sorted([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts], key=lambda r: -r[1])
    lo, vo = rows[0]
    lr, vr = rows[1] if len(rows) > 1 else rows[0]
    ratio = 1.0 + vo / 100.0

    n = 5
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.56
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    grow = ease(seg(f, 0.3, 0.75))
    step = 0.0 if u < a0 else (k + grow) / n

    CX, BASE, RX0, KY = 540, 1380, 360, 0.26
    H0 = 190.0
    hf = H0 * ratio
    h = H0 + (hf - H0) * step

    def rx(l):
        return RX0 + 0.12 * l

    def front(l):
        return BASE - l + KY * rx(l)

    OLD = (190, 186, 178)      # weathered concrete, the budgeted bowl
    NEW = (212, 208, 200)      # fresh concrete, the overrun tiers

    landscape(cr, t, "town")
    # the site's crane behind the bowl, working the whole beat
    _ol_crane(cr, t, 880, BASE - 20, 760)

    cast_shadow(cr, CX - RX0, CX + RX0, BASE + KY * RX0, length=320, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, CX, BASE + KY * RX0, 2 * RX0 + 60, a=0.4)

    # the bowl's facade: concrete all the way up
    _ol_band(cr, CX, BASE, BASE - min(h, H0), rx(0), rx(min(h, H0)), KY, OLD)
    if h > H0 + 0.5:
        _ol_band(cr, CX, BASE - H0, BASE - h, rx(H0), rx(h), KY, NEW)
    # arched concourse openings round the budgeted bowl
    for i in range(1, 12):
        a = math.pi * i / 12
        ox = CX + rx(40) * math.cos(a)
        oy = BASE - 40 + rx(40) * KY * math.sin(a)
        wv = 26 * math.sin(a) + 6
        cr.move_to(ox - wv / 2, oy + 30)
        cr.line_to(ox - wv / 2, oy)
        cr.arc(ox, oy, wv / 2, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.line_to(ox + wv / 2, oy + 30)
        cr.close_path()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 66, 64), 0.8))
        cr.fill()
    # stepped seat rows on every tier: these are stands
    cr.set_line_width(2)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((130, 126, 118), 0.8))
    l = H0 + 12
    while l < h - 4:
        _ol_arc(cr, CX, BASE - l, rx(l), KY)
        l += 14
    cr.stroke()
    # tier seams, and the thin accent safety rail capping each overrun tier
    built = [H0 + (hf - H0) * j / n for j in range(1, n + 1)
             if H0 + (hf - H0) * j / n < h - 2]
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 58, 62), 0.7))
    for l in [H0 / 3, 2 * H0 / 3, H0] + built:
        if l <= h:
            _ol_arc(cr, CX, BASE - l, rx(l), KY)
            cr.stroke()
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"]))
    for l in built + ([h] if h > H0 + 4 else []):
        _ol_arc(cr, CX, BASE - l - 3, rx(l), KY)
        cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 66, 70), 0.45))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    for i in range(1, 12):
        a = math.pi * i / 12
        cr.move_to(CX + rx(0) * math.cos(a), BASE + rx(0) * KY * math.sin(a))
        cr.line_to(CX + rx(h) * math.cos(a), BASE - h + rx(h) * KY * math.sin(a))
    cr.stroke()

    # the open top: the raked concrete stands inside, the track, the pitch
    rt, yt = rx(h), BASE - h
    _ol_ellipse(cr, CX, yt, rt, rt * KY)
    solid(cr, (156, 150, 140))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((110, 104, 96), 0.7))
    cr.set_line_width(2)
    for j in range(1, 5):
        q = 1.0 - 0.08 * j
        _ol_ellipse(cr, CX, yt + 2 * j, rt * q, rt * KY * q)
        cr.stroke()
    _ol_ellipse(cr, CX, yt + 10, rt * 0.62, rt * KY * 0.58)
    solid(cr, (184, 84, 62), rim=False)
    _ol_ellipse(cr, CX, yt + 12, rt * 0.5, rt * KY * 0.44)
    solid(cr, (86, 156, 82), rim=False)
    _ol_ellipse(cr, CX, yt, rt, rt * KY)
    edge(cr, (40, 38, 42))

    # floodlight masts on the back of the rim, riding up as the bowl climbs
    for a in (1.18 * math.pi, 1.5 * math.pi, 1.82 * math.pi):
        fx = CX + rt * math.cos(a)
        fy = yt + rt * KY * math.sin(a)
        box(cr, fx - 5, fy, 10, 130, (176, 178, 186), depth=4, finish="metal")
        box(cr, fx - 34, fy - 130, 68, 34, (70, 72, 80), depth=10, finish="metal")
        for r_ in range(2):
            for c_ in range(3):
                disc(cr, fx - 22 + c_ * 22, fy - 150 + r_ * 14, 6, (255, 244, 210),
                     finish="gloss")

    # THE SCALE on the facade: the budget line, the rail line, budgets up its side
    then_mark(cr, CX - 170, CX + 170, front(H0), "budget")
    hr = H0 * (1 + vr / 100.0)
    if h >= hr:
        then_mark(cr, CX - 170, CX + 170, front(hr), f"{lr.lower()} +{int(round(vr))}%")
    if step > 0.02:
        times_ticks(cr, CX + RX0 + 70, front(0), front(0) - front(H0), max(1, int(ratio)))

    # right by the camera: a cement mixer rolling across the site, cones, the flag
    mx = -320 + ((t * 230) % 1720)
    _ol_mixer(cr, mx, 1700, 1.4, t)
    for x_, y_, s_ in ((120, 1790, 1.5), (330, 1870, 1.8), (720, 1840, 1.6)):
        _ol_cone(cr, x_, y_, s_)
    _ol_flag(cr, 960, 1390, t)
    foreground(cr, "town")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data on the front lip of the rim, laying each tier and working round it
    xd = CX - 0.4 * rt + 220 * step
    dxn = clamp((xd - CX) / rt, -0.99, 0.99)
    yd = min(1500.0, yt + rt * KY * math.sqrt(1 - dxn * dxn) + 16)
    contact_shadow(cr, xd, yd, 90, a=0.35)
    if u < a0:
        host("point", xd, yd, 220)
    elif u < a1 + 0.04:
        host("place", xd, yd, 220, beat=k)
    else:
        host("hold_up", xd, yd, 220)

    done = u >= a0 and k == n - 1 and grow >= 0.999
    if done:
        fit_readout(cr, f"+{int(round(vo))}%", f"average {lo} cost overrun",
                    80, 520, size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "The budget", "what an Olympic host city plans to spend",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

segments.topic: the cost of winning the Olympic bid
segments.say: Montreal built its Olympic stadium in just two years. Paying off the debt it left behind took 30 years instead.

# scene standard: 2026-10-22
def _bigo(cr, cx, base, rx, ry, hgt, tw):
    """Montreal's Big O: an elliptical concrete bowl of curved ribs, a pale
    roof with its open oculus, and the inclined tower leaning over it."""
    cr.move_to(cx + rx, base)
    for i in range(41):
        a = math.pi * i / 40
        cr.line_to(cx + rx * math.cos(a), base + ry * math.sin(a))
    for i in reversed(range(41)):
        a = math.pi * i / 40
        cr.line_to(cx + rx * 0.9 * math.cos(a), base - hgt + ry * 0.9 * math.sin(a))
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (212, 208, 198))
    for i in range(16):
        a = math.pi * (i + 0.5) / 16
        bx, by = cx + rx * math.cos(a), base + ry * math.sin(a)
        tx, ty = cx + rx * 0.9 * math.cos(a), base - hgt + ry * 0.9 * math.sin(a)
        ox = 40 * math.cos(a)
        cr.move_to(bx, by)
        cr.curve_to(bx + ox, by - hgt * 0.4, tx + ox * 1.4, ty + hgt * 0.3, tx, ty)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((132, 128, 122)))
        cr.set_line_width(9)
        cr.stroke()
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(cx, base - hgt)
    cr.scale(1, ry / rx)
    cr.arc(0, 0, rx * 0.9, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (236, 232, 222), finish="gloss")
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(cx - rx * 0.08, base - hgt)
    cr.scale(1, ry / rx)
    cr.arc(0, 0, rx * 0.42, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (66, 70, 80), rim=False)
    b1 = (cx + rx * 0.62, base + ry * 0.45)
    b2 = (cx + rx * 1.02, base + ry * 0.2)
    t2 = (cx + rx * 0.5, base - hgt - tw)
    t1 = (cx + rx * 0.34, base - hgt - tw + 26)
    cr.move_to(*b1)
    cr.line_to(*b2)
    cr.line_to(*t2)
    cr.line_to(*t1)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (200, 196, 186))
    for j in range(1, 6):
        q = j / 6
        cr.move_to(b1[0] + (t1[0] - b1[0]) * q, b1[1] + (t1[1] - b1[1]) * q)
        cr.line_to(b2[0] + (t2[0] - b2[0]) * q, b2[1] + (t2[1] - b2[1]) * q)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 140, 160), 0.8))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 70, 76), 0.8))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for j in range(5):
        a = math.pi * (0.1 + 0.18 * j)
        cr.move_to((t1[0] + t2[0]) / 2, (t1[1] + t2[1]) / 2 + 10)
        cr.line_to(cx - rx * 0.08 + rx * 0.42 * math.cos(a),
                   base - hgt - ry * 0.42 * math.sin(a))
    cr.stroke()


def _chain(cr, x0, y0, x1, y1, sag, link=38):
    """A heavy iron chain of alternating links, sagging between two points."""
    span_ = math.hypot(x1 - x0, y1 - y0) + abs(sag) * 0.6
    n = max(2, int(span_ / (link * 0.75)))
    mx, my = (x0 + x1) / 2, (y0 + y1) / 2 + sag
    ps = []
    for i in range(n + 1):
        q = i / n
        ps.append(((1 - q) ** 2 * x0 + 2 * (1 - q) * q * mx + q * q * x1,
                   (1 - q) ** 2 * y0 + 2 * (1 - q) * q * my + q * q * y1))
    for i in range(n):
        (ax, ay), (bx, by) = ps[i], ps[i + 1]
        ang = math.atan2(by - ay, bx - ax)
        ln = math.hypot(bx - ax, by - ay) * 1.3
        cr.save()
        cr.translate((ax + bx) / 2, (ay + by) / 2)
        cr.rotate(ang)
        if i % 2 == 0:
            cr.scale(1, 0.55)
            cr.arc(0, 0, ln / 2, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        else:
            cr.move_to(-ln / 2, 0)
            cr.line_to(ln / 2, 0)
        cr.restore()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 40, 46)))
        cr.set_line_width(12)
        cr.stroke_preserve()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((156, 158, 168)))
        cr.set_line_width(3)
        cr.stroke()


def _chunk(cr, x, y, s, rot, a, seed):
    """A broken lump of concrete, lit."""
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.rotate(rot)
    for j in range(7):
        ang = 2 * math.pi * j / 7
        rr = s * (0.65 + 0.35 * ((seed * 0.618 + j * 0.414) % 1.0))
        if j == 0:
            cr.move_to(rr * math.cos(ang), rr * math.sin(ang))
        else:
            cr.line_to(rr * math.cos(ang), rr * math.sin(ang))
    cr.close_path()
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (160, 156, 148), a=a)


def _flag(cr, x, top, t):
    """A Canadian flag on a plaza pole right by the camera, flying in the wind."""
    contact_shadow(cr, x, 1900, 70, a=0.4)
    cr.rectangle(x - 7, top, 14, 1900 - top)
    solid(cr, (180, 182, 188), finish="metal")
    disc(cr, x, top - 6, 12, P["brass"], finish="metal")
    fw, fh = 260, 140

    def pt(px, py):
        wav = 16 * math.sin(t * 3.2 - px / 60.0) * (px / fw)
        return x + 8 + px, top + 10 + py + wav

    def band(p0, p1, rgb):
        cr.move_to(*pt(p0, 0))
        for i in range(11):
            cr.line_to(*pt(p0 + (p1 - p0) * i / 10, 0))
        for i in reversed(range(11)):
            cr.line_to(*pt(p0 + (p1 - p0) * i / 10, fh))
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, rgb, rim=False)
    band(0, fw * 0.25, (214, 40, 40))
    band(fw * 0.25, fw * 0.75, (246, 244, 240))
    band(fw * 0.75, fw, (214, 40, 40))
    lx, ly = pt(fw * 0.5, fh * 0.5)
    cr.move_to(lx, ly - 44)
    for ax, ay in [(14, -20), (34, -26), (26, -2), (40, 6), (14, 18), (6, 40),
                   (-6, 40), (-14, 18), (-40, 6), (-26, -2), (-34, -26), (-14, -20)]:
        cr.line_to(lx + ax, ly + ay)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (214, 40, 40), rim=False)


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a concrete ball and chain shackled to a stadium
    SUBSTANCE: chunks of concrete
    CAUSE: Data chips the concrete debt ball away with a pickaxe, strike by strike, until it is gone
    The Big O shoots up in a blink, the two years it took to build, already
    shackled to a huge concrete ball and chain with a dollar sign cut into
    it: the debt it left. Then the slow part. Strike by strike Data chips the
    ball away with a pickaxe, each blow knocking a lump of concrete loose to
    tumble across the plaza toward the camera, until the ball is gone:
    thirty years of paying it off. THE SCALE is on the ball: its first size
    stays as a ghost, and a mark shows how little two years of chipping would
    have taken off. Done by 0.62 and held; Data picks up the freed chain and
    lifts it up, close to his chest, within his reach."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    vals = [v for _, v in rows] or [1.0]
    build = next((v for l, v in rows if "build" in l.lower()), min(vals))
    debt = next((v for l, v in rows if "debt" in l.lower() or "pay" in l.lower()), max(vals))
    ratio = debt / build if build else 0.0

    B0, B1 = 0.03, 0.10            # the stadium goes up fast
    a0, a1 = 0.13, 0.66            # the debt is chipped away slowly
    n = 6
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    rise = ease(seg(u, B0, B1))
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    brk = ease(seg(f, 0.3, 0.45)) if u >= a0 else 0.0
    rem = 1.0 - (k + brk) / n if u >= a0 else 1.0
    done = u >= a0 and k == n - 1 and brk >= 0.999

    GROUND = 1480
    R0 = 200.0
    BX = 640
    r = R0 * math.sqrt(max(0.0, rem))
    by_ = GROUND - r

    landscape(cr, t, "town", horizon=1000)
    birds(cr, t, y0=700, n=4, rgb=(60, 60, 70))
    # the concrete plaza in front of the stadium
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (178, 174, 166)), (1, (130, 126, 118))], 1040, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((110, 106, 100), 0.45))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(12):
        cr.move_to(540, 1040)
        cr.line_to(-1200 + i * 300, H)
    for y in (1150, 1290, 1460, 1680):
        cr.move_to(0, y)
        cr.line_to(W, y)
    cr.stroke()

    CX, BASE, RX, RY, HG, TW = 470, 1010, 300, 95, 150, 250
    cast_shadow(cr, CX - RX, CX + RX, BASE + RY, length=300, a=0.3 * rise)
    contact_shadow(cr, CX, BASE + RY, 2 * RX + 60, a=0.4 * rise)
    if rise > 0:
        bottom = BASE + RY + 12
        top_all = BASE - HG - TW - 30
        cr.save()
        cr.rectangle(0, bottom - rise * (bottom - top_all), W, H)
        cr.clip()
        _bigo(cr, CX, BASE, RX, RY, HG, TW)
        cr.restore()

    # the anchor on the stadium the chain is shackled to
    AX, AY = 790, 1110
    contact_shadow(cr, AX, AY, 80, a=0.35)
    box(cr, AX - 30, AY, 56, 46, (92, 94, 102), finish="metal")
    disc(cr, AX - 2, AY - 30, 12, (70, 72, 80), finish="metal")

    # THE SCALE on the ball: its first size, and how little two years took off
    if u >= a0 + 0.3 * span:
        cr.arc(BX, GROUND - R0, R0, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        ghost(cr, a=0.85)
        r2 = R0 * math.sqrt(max(0.0, 1 - build / (debt or 1.0)))
        then_mark(cr, BX - 150, BX + 150, GROUND - 2 * r2, f"{int(round(build))} yrs")

    # the debt: a concrete ball and chain with a dollar sign cut into it
    if r > 6:
        cast_shadow(cr, BX - r, BX + r, GROUND, length=260, a=0.28)
        contact_shadow(cr, BX, GROUND, 2 * r + 40, a=0.45)
        disc(cr, BX, by_, r, (156, 152, 144))
        for j in range(14):
            px = BX + r * 0.8 * (((j * 0.6180339) % 1.0) * 2 - 1)
            py = by_ + r * 0.8 * (((j * 0.4142136) % 1.0) * 2 - 1)
            if (px - BX) ** 2 + (py - by_) ** 2 < (r * 0.85) ** 2:
                cr.arc(px, py, 3 + r * 0.015, 0, 2 * math.pi)
                cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((104, 100, 94), 0.7))
                cr.fill()
        if r > 50:
            for off, col, wd in ((3, (206, 202, 192), 0.1), (0, (88, 84, 78), 0.09)):
                cr.arc_negative(BX + off, by_ - 0.17 * r + off, 0.2 * r,
                                -math.pi / 4, math.pi / 2)
                cr.arc(BX + off, by_ + 0.23 * r + off, 0.2 * r, -math.pi / 2,
                       3 * math.pi / 4)
                cr.new_sub_path()
                cr.move_to(BX + off, by_ - 0.52 * r + off)
                cr.line_to(BX + off, by_ + 0.56 * r + off)
                cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(col))
                cr.set_line_width(r * wd)
                cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
                cr.stroke()
        ex, ey = BX + r * 0.62, by_ - r * 0.74
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(ex, ey)
        cr.scale(1, 0.7)
        cr.arc(0, 0, max(10, 0.12 * r), 0, 2 * math.pi)
        cr.restore()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 40, 46)))
        cr.set_line_width(12)
        cr.stroke()
        sag = 24
    else:
        sag = 40
        ex, ey = BX + 20, GROUND - 10

    # Data's spot and, once the ball is gone, the chain end in his hands
    hy = GROUND
    hands = None
    if u < 0.08:
        hx = 200
    elif u < a0:
        hx = 200 + (BX - R0 - 90 - 200) * ease(seg(u, 0.08, a0))
    elif u < 0.68:
        hx = BX - r - 90
    else:
        hx = BX - 90
        lift = ease(seg(u, 0.68, 0.76))
        tug = math.sin(math.pi * seg(u, 0.86, 0.94))
        # kept close to his chest: well inside his reach at every point
        yh = hy - 120 - 50 * lift - 20 * tug
        hands = [(hx + 28, yh), (hx + 52, yh - 6)]
        g = ease(seg(u, 0.68, 0.70))
        ex = (BX + 20) + (hands[1][0] - (BX + 20)) * g
        ey = (GROUND - 10) + (hands[1][1] - (GROUND - 10)) * g
        sag = 40 - 10 * lift
    _chain(cr, AX - 2, AY - 30, ex, ey, sag)

    # the lumps each strike knocks loose, tumbling across the plaza
    for i in range(n):
        us = a0 + (i + 0.3) * span
        if u < us:
            continue
        age = (u - us) / span
        if age > 2.0:
            continue
        rb = R0 * math.sqrt(max(0.0, 1 - i / n))
        s = 46 + 0.12 * rb
        x0_, y0_ = BX - rb * 0.85, (GROUND - rb) - rb * 0.25
        yl = GROUND - s * 0.6
        if age < 0.3:
            p = age / 0.3
            x, y, sc, a = x0_ - 50 * p, y0_ + (yl - y0_) * p * p, 1.0, 1.0
        else:
            p = (age - 0.3) / 1.7
            x = x0_ - 50 - 520 * p
            y = yl + 300 * p
            sc = 1.0 + 0.8 * p
            a = 1.0 - clamp((p - 0.8) / 0.2)
            contact_shadow(cr, x, y + s * sc * 0.6, s * sc * 1.8, a=0.3 * a)
        _chunk(cr, x, y, s * sc, age * 5.0 + i, a, i + 1)

    # right by the camera: the flag over the plaza
    _flag(cr, 880, 1590, t)
    foreground(cr, "town")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    if u < B0:
        host("point", hx, hy, 220)
    elif u < 0.08:
        host("cheer", hx, hy, 220)
    elif u < a0:
        host("point", hx, hy, 220)
    elif u < 0.68:
        host("swing_pick", hx, hy, 220, beat=k)
    else:
        host("grip", hx, hy, 220, hands=hands, lower="stand", expr="happy")

    if done:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(debt))} years", "to pay off the debt it left",
                    80, 520, size=130)
        text(cr, f"{ratio:.0f}x", W - 80, 690, 90, look.INK, face="display",
             anchor="right", alpha=ease(seg(u, 0.61, 0.65)))
    elif u >= B1:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(build))} years", "to build Montreal's Olympic stadium",
                    80, 520, size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "The Big O", "Montreal's Olympic stadium", 80, 520,
                    a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.03)), size=130)

stories.title: Why Did US Math Scores Just Drop The Most In 50 Years?
stories.hook: Your kid's math skills are slipping, and the ones who needed help most got hurt worst.
stories.closing: Kids who fall behind in math now struggle later, so this one costs all of us.
stories.question: Did your math skills ever bounce back?
stories.caption: US 13-year-olds just posted the worst math score drop NCES has recorded in 50 years — and five years after the pandemic, scores still haven't recovered. 👇

segments.say: Thirteen-year-olds' math scores climbed for decades. Then they slid to 271, nearly back where they started half a century ago.
The weakest students got hit hardest, losing 14 points, far more than the average student. The gap between kids just got wider.

# scene standard: 2026-10-22
def _mk_kid(cr, x, y, s, shirt, pants, skin, pack, sway):
    # a student standing on (x, y), about 230*s tall, a backpack on his back
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.rotate(sway)
    contact_shadow(cr, 0, 0, 90 * s, a=0.35)
    for lx in (-22 * s, 6 * s):
        cr.rectangle(lx, -88 * s, 18 * s, 88 * s)
        solid(cr, pants, rim=False)
        cr.rectangle(lx - 4 * s, -10 * s, 28 * s, 12 * s)
        solid(cr, (40, 36, 34), rim=False)
    # the backpack hangs behind the body
    cr.rectangle(-46 * s, -168 * s, 30 * s, 72 * s)
    solid(cr, pack)
    cr.move_to(-30 * s, -182 * s)
    cr.curve_to(-38 * s, -150 * s, -34 * s, -110 * s, -26 * s, -96 * s)
    cr.line_to(26 * s, -96 * s)
    cr.curve_to(34 * s, -120 * s, 34 * s, -160 * s, 26 * s, -182 * s)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, shirt)
    # the strap is a band over the shoulder
    cr.move_to(-14 * s, -182 * s)
    cr.line_to(-4 * s, -182 * s)
    cr.line_to(-14 * s, -104 * s)
    cr.line_to(-24 * s, -104 * s)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, tuple(int(c * 0.7) for c in pack), rim=False)
    cr.rectangle(26 * s, -176 * s, 14 * s, 62 * s)
    solid(cr, shirt, rim=False)
    disc(cr, 0, -206 * s, 26 * s, skin)
    cr.arc(0, -214 * s, 27 * s, math.pi * 1.05, math.pi * 1.95)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (52, 38, 30), rim=False)
    cr.restore()


def _column(cr, x, base, total, pw, stone, broken):
    # a classical stone column: a stepped plinth, a fluted shaft built of
    # drums, and a wide capital with scrolls on top — `total` tall
    PL, CAP = 46, 40
    sh = max(20.0, total - PL - CAP)
    shade = tuple(int(c * 0.62) for c in stone)
    box(cr, x - pw / 2 - 26, base, pw + 52, 22, stone, depth=30)
    box(cr, x - pw / 2 - 14, base - 22, pw + 28, PL - 22, stone, depth=26)
    sx0, sy = x - pw / 2, base - PL
    cylinder(cr, sx0, sy, pw, sh, stone)
    # the flutes: deep vertical grooves round the shaft
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(sx0, sy - sh, pw, sh)
    cr.clip()
    for i in range(1, 9):
        q = math.cos(math.pi * i / 9)
        fx = x - q * pw / 2 * 0.96
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(shade, 0.55))
        cr.set_line_width(7 * (1 - 0.6 * abs(q)))
        cr.move_to(fx, sy - 4)
        cr.line_to(fx, sy - sh + 4)
        cr.stroke()
    # the drum seams the column is stacked from
    d = 70
    yy = sy - d
    while yy > sy - sh + 10:
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(shade, 0.7))
        cr.set_line_width(4)
        cr.move_to(sx0, yy)
        cr.curve_to(sx0 + pw * 0.3, yy + 9, sx0 + pw * 0.7, yy + 9, sx0 + pw, yy)
        cr.stroke()
        yy -= d
    cr.restore()
    top = sy - sh
    if broken:
        # the jagged break where the pick bit in, under the capital
        cr.move_to(sx0 - 4, top + 26)
        for i in range(7):
            cr.line_to(sx0 + pw * (i + 0.5) / 7, top + (18 if i % 2 else 2))
        cr.line_to(sx0 + pw + 4, top + 26)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, (176, 168, 154), rim=False)
    # the capital: an abacus slab over an echinus, scrolls at each end
    cr.move_to(x - pw / 2 + 6, top)
    cr.curve_to(x - pw / 2 - 10, top - 14, x - pw / 2 - 18, top - 18, x - pw / 2 - 22, top - 20)
    cr.line_to(x + pw / 2 + 22, top - 20)
    cr.curve_to(x + pw / 2 + 18, top - 18, x + pw / 2 + 10, top - 14, x + pw / 2 - 6, top)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, stone)
    box(cr, x - pw / 2 - 30, top - 18, pw + 60, CAP - 18, stone, depth=28)
    for vx in (x - pw / 2 - 22, x + pw / 2 + 22):
        disc(cr, vx, top - 10, 15, stone)
        cr.arc(vx, top - 10, 7, 0, 2 * math.pi)
        edge(cr, shade, width=3)
    return base - total


def _fallen_drum(cr, x, y, r, ln, ang, stone):
    # one drum of a broken column lying on its side, its fluted face showing
    shade = tuple(int(c * 0.62) for c in stone)
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(x, y)
    cr.rotate(ang)
    contact_shadow(cr, 0, r * 0.9, ln + r, a=0.4)
    cr.rectangle(-ln / 2, -r, ln, 2 * r)
    solid(cr, stone)
    for i in range(1, 6):
        q = -r + 2 * r * i / 6
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(shade, 0.5))
        cr.set_line_width(5)
        cr.move_to(-ln / 2 + 6, q)
        cr.line_to(ln / 2 - 6, q)
        cr.stroke()
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(ln / 2, 0)
    cr.scale(0.42, 1.0)
    cr.arc(0, 0, r, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (232, 226, 212))
    cr.restore()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: students standing on stone columns
    SUBSTANCE: the columns' stone
    CAUSE: Data swings a pickaxe into each column and it crumbles lower, the most under the weakest students
    In front of their school at dusk, three students each stand on top of a
    tall classical stone column — fluted, built of drums, a capital with
    scrolls — all the same height at first. Data takes a pickaxe to each one
    in turn, the national average first, then the bottom quarter, then the
    bottom tenth, and each column breaks down by the points that group lost,
    its drums lying smashed at its foot and rolled right up to the camera.
    The line where they all stood shows how far each one fell, so the
    widening gap reads at a glance. Done by 0.56, then it holds."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    order = sorted(range(len(rows)), key=lambda i: rows[i][1])   # smallest loss first
    n = len(rows)
    xs_sorted = [300, 590, 860]
    # left = biggest loss, right = smallest
    by_loss = sorted(range(n), key=lambda i: -rows[i][1])
    px = {}
    for j, i in enumerate(by_loss):
        px[i] = xs_sorted[min(j, 2)] if n <= 3 else 220 + j * (640 / max(1, n - 1))
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.56
    span = (a1 - a0) / max(1, n)
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    crumble = ease(seg(f, 0.3, 0.75))
    BASE, H0 = 1500.0, 600.0
    top = max(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    scale = min(30.0, 400.0 / top)

    drop = {}
    for s_, i in enumerate(order):
        if u < a0 or s_ > k:
            drop[i] = 0.0
        elif s_ < k:
            drop[i] = rows[i][1] * scale
        else:
            drop[i] = rows[i][1] * scale * crumble
    landed_to = k if crumble >= 0.999 else k - 1
    shown = None if (u < a0 or landed_to < 0) else rows[order[landed_to]]

    gy = landscape(cr, t, "town", time="dusk", seed="students on stone columns", skyline=False)
    # the school behind them
    sc = building(cr, 90, 860, gy + 10, 300, (170, 82, 60), roof_rgb=(80, 76, 84),
                  roof="flat", boards=False)
    for r_ in range(2):
        for c_ in range(6):
            wx = sc["x0"] + 40 + c_ * 125
            wy = sc["top"] + 40 + r_ * 130
            cr.rectangle(wx, wy, 70, 90)
            solid(cr, (250, 214, 150), finish="glass", rim=False)
    cr.rectangle((sc["x0"] + sc["x1"]) / 2 - 140, sc["top"] - 60, 280, 50)
    solid(cr, (232, 226, 210), rim=False)
    text(cr, "SCHOOL", (sc["x0"] + sc["x1"]) / 2, sc["top"] - 22, 34, (70, 50, 40),
         anchor="center", shadow=False)
    # the flag on its pole waves
    fx0, fy0 = 960, gy - 380
    cr.rectangle(fx0 - 5, fy0, 10, 390)
    solid(cr, (180, 182, 190), finish="metal", rim=False)
    cr.move_to(fx0 + 5, fy0 + 6)
    for i in range(9):
        q = i / 8
        cr.line_to(fx0 + 5 + 90 * q, fy0 + 6 + 10 * math.sin(t * 3 - q * 4) * q)
    for i in range(8, -1, -1):
        q = i / 8
        cr.line_to(fx0 + 5 + 90 * q, fy0 + 70 + 10 * math.sin(t * 3 - q * 4) * q)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (196, 52, 48), rim=False)
    haze(cr, gy - 520, gy + 20, (230, 170, 140), a=0.4)

    # the schoolyard: paving running to the camera, a painted court line
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (150, 140, 128)), (1, (112, 104, 94))], gy + 10, H)
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(0, gy + 10, W, H - gy - 10)
    cr.clip()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((96, 88, 80), 0.35))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(12):
        cr.move_to(540, gy - 200)
        cr.line_to(-1200 + i * 300, H)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 220, 150), 0.7))
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    cr.move_to(-40, 1660)
    cr.curve_to(300, 1610, 760, 1610, W + 40, 1680)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.restore()

    looks = [((70, 120, 200), (50, 56, 80), (226, 182, 150), (220, 160, 40)),
             ((200, 80, 90), (60, 70, 90), (170, 120, 90), (60, 140, 110)),
             ((90, 160, 100), (70, 60, 56), (240, 200, 170), (110, 80, 170))]
    PW = 160
    STONE = (222, 214, 198)
    for j, i in enumerate(by_loss):
        x = px[i]
        h = H0 - drop[i]
        cast_shadow(cr, x - PW / 2 - 26, x + PW / 2 + 26, BASE, length=280, a=0.25)
        contact_shadow(cr, x, BASE + 4, PW + 90, a=0.4)
        # the drums it lost lie smashed at its foot
        if drop[i] > 1:
            nchunk = int(drop[i] / 40) + 1
            for c_ in range(nchunk):
                rx = x - PW / 2 - 50 + ((c_ * 0.618) % 1.0) * (PW + 100)
                ry = BASE + 18 - (c_ % 3) * 8
                if c_ % 3 == 0:
                    cr.save()
                    cr.translate(rx, ry)
                    cr.rotate(0.3 * ((c_ % 2) * 2 - 1))
                    cylinder(cr, -28, 0, 56, 30, STONE)
                    cr.restore()
                else:
                    disc(cr, rx, ry - 6, 12 + (c_ * 7) % 10, (200, 192, 178))
        ktop = _column(cr, x, BASE, h, PW, STONE, drop[i] > 1)
        sh, pa, sk, pk = looks[j % 3]
        _mk_kid(cr, x - 6, ktop - 20, 1.12 - 0.04 * j, sh, pa, sk, pk,
                0.04 * math.sin(t * 1.3 + j) * (1 if drop[i] > 1 else 0.3))
        if u >= a0 and order.index(i) <= landed_to:
            lab_ = rows[i][0].replace(" of students", "")
            text(cr, lab_, x, BASE - 74, fit_size(cr, lab_, 34, PW + 10),
                 (60, 50, 40), anchor="center", shadow=False)
    # the line they all stood on — its word kept inside the frame
    if u >= a0 and landed_to >= 0:
        lx0 = px[by_loss[0]] - PW / 2 - 30
        lx1 = min(W - 60, px[by_loss[-1]] + PW / 2 + 30)
        then_mark(cr, lx0, lx1, BASE - H0 - 20, "")
        text(cr, "before", lx1, BASE - H0 - 34, 30, look.INK, anchor="right")

    # chips flying off the strike
    cur = order[k] if u >= a0 else None
    if cur is not None and 0.3 < f < 0.75:
        q = seg(f, 0.3, 0.75)
        for c_ in range(5):
            sx = px[cur] - PW / 2 + 10
            sy = BASE - (H0 - drop[cur]) + 100
            cx_ = sx - 40 * q * (1 + c_ * 0.4)
            cy_ = sy - 90 * math.sin(math.pi * q) * (0.6 + 0.2 * c_) + 300 * q * q
            disc(cr, cx_, cy_, 12 + 3 * c_, (200, 192, 178))

    # right by the camera: drums that rolled all the way out, a maths book,
    # a marked test
    _fallen_drum(cr, 150, 1770, 70, 200, -0.08, STONE)
    disc(cr, 330, 1800, 26, (204, 196, 182))
    disc(cr, 600, 1850, 20, (204, 196, 182))
    contact_shadow(cr, 560, 1745, 240, a=0.35)
    box(cr, 450, 1745, 210, 46, (60, 100, 170), depth=64)
    cr.rectangle(456, 1745 - 40, 198, 8)
    solid(cr, (240, 234, 220), rim=False)
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(800, 1760)
    cr.rotate(-0.15)
    contact_shadow(cr, 110, 130, 220, a=0.25)
    cr.rectangle(0, 0, 220, 130)
    solid(cr, (246, 242, 232), rim=False)
    for r_ in range(4):
        cr.rectangle(20, 24 + r_ * 24, 150 - r_ * 20, 6)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 120, 130)))
        cr.fill()
    text(cr, "x", 180, 70, 44, (200, 40, 40), anchor="center", shadow=False)
    cr.restore()
    foreground(cr, "town")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data walks from column to column, swinging into each
    def spot(i):
        return px[i] - PW / 2 - 95
    if u < a0:
        host("point", spot(order[0]), BASE, 330)
    elif u < a1 + 0.04:
        prev = spot(order[k - 1]) if k > 0 else spot(order[0])
        hx = prev + (spot(order[k]) - prev) * ease(seg(f, 0.0, 0.2))
        host("swing_pick", hx, BASE, 330, beat=k)
    else:
        extra = int((u - a1 - 0.04) / 0.13)
        host("swing_pick", spot(order[-1]), BASE, 330, beat=n + extra)

    if shown is not None:
        lab, v = shown
        fit_readout(cr, f"-{int(round(v))} points", f"math scores · {lab.lower()}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, a0, a0 + 0.05)), size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Math scores", "who lost the most points",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

# scene standard: 2026-10-22
def _mk_lerp(a, b, s):
    return (a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * s, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * s)


def _marker(cr, back, tip):
    """A giant red marker from its cap end `back` to its felt `tip`."""
    dx, dy = tip[0] - back[0], tip[1] - back[1]
    L = max(1.0, math.hypot(dx, dy))
    ux, uy = dx / L, dy / L
    nx, ny = -uy, ux
    w = 22
    b1 = (tip[0] - ux * 50, tip[1] - uy * 50)
    cr.move_to(back[0] + nx * w, back[1] + ny * w)
    cr.line_to(b1[0] + nx * w, b1[1] + ny * w)
    cr.line_to(b1[0] - nx * w, b1[1] - ny * w)
    cr.line_to(back[0] - nx * w, back[1] - ny * w)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (204, 40, 42), finish="gloss")
    c1 = (back[0] + ux * 70, back[1] + uy * 70)
    cr.move_to(back[0] + nx * (w + 3), back[1] + ny * (w + 3))
    cr.line_to(c1[0] + nx * (w + 3), c1[1] + ny * (w + 3))
    cr.line_to(c1[0] - nx * (w + 3), c1[1] - ny * (w + 3))
    cr.line_to(back[0] - nx * (w + 3), back[1] - ny * (w + 3))
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (130, 22, 26), finish="gloss")
    m0 = (back[0] + ux * L * 0.45, back[1] + uy * L * 0.45)
    m1 = (back[0] + ux * (L * 0.45 + 60), back[1] + uy * (L * 0.45 + 60))
    cr.move_to(m0[0] + nx * w, m0[1] + ny * w)
    cr.line_to(m1[0] + nx * w, m1[1] + ny * w)
    cr.line_to(m1[0] - nx * w, m1[1] - ny * w)
    cr.line_to(m0[0] - nx * w, m0[1] - ny * w)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (240, 236, 226), rim=False)
    cr.move_to(b1[0] + nx * w * 0.75, b1[1] + ny * w * 0.75)
    cr.line_to(tip[0] + nx * 5, tip[1] + ny * 5)
    cr.line_to(tip[0] - nx * 5, tip[1] - ny * 5)
    cr.line_to(b1[0] - nx * w * 0.75, b1[1] - ny * w * 0.75)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (150, 24, 28))


def _red(cr, a, b, s, width=16):
    if s <= 0:
        return
    e = _mk_lerp(a, b, clamp(s))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((206, 30, 36), 0.95))
    cr.set_line_width(width)
    cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
    cr.move_to(*a)
    cr.line_to(*e)
    cr.stroke()


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a graded math test
    SUBSTANCE: red ink marks
    CAUSE: Data holds a giant red marker in both hands and crosses out answer after answer, then the old score
    A classroom, the test pinned to the chalkboard: the 2020 grade at the
    top, every answer ticked. Data walks up with a giant red marker and
    crosses out answer after answer, then strikes through the old score and
    writes the new one LOWER on the page, so how far it slipped shows as
    distance. Landed by 0.66 and held: he keeps tracing the ring round the
    new grade while the clock ticks on."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    bounds = [0.06, 0.15, 0.24, 0.33, 0.42, 0.66]
    ns = len(bounds) - 1
    k = 0
    for i in range(ns):
        if u >= bounds[i]:
            k = i
    f = clamp((u - bounds[k]) / (bounds[k + 1] - bounds[k])) if u >= bounds[0] else 0.0
    started = u >= bounds[0]
    done = u >= bounds[-1]

    PX0, PX1, PY0, PY1 = 170, 910, 640, 1250
    ROWS = [800, 880, 960, 1040, 1120, 1200]
    XROWS = [1, 2, 4, 5]
    XX = 535
    SX, SY = 720, 790                       # the old grade
    NY = 1010                               # the new grade, well lower on the page
    NX = 745

    # ---- the classroom ----
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (120, 134, 128)), (0.6, (164, 176, 164)), (1, (150, 158, 146))], 0, 1260)
    cr.rectangle(60, 110, 250, 310)
    solid(cr, (226, 222, 210), rim=False)
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (150, 190, 226)), (1, (214, 230, 240))], 128, 402, 78, 292)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((226, 222, 210)))
    cr.set_line_width(10)
    cr.move_to(185, 128)
    cr.line_to(185, 402)
    cr.move_to(78, 265)
    cr.line_to(292, 265)
    cr.stroke()
    # the wall clock, its hand sweeping
    disc(cr, 930, 290, 70, (238, 236, 228))
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 40, 46)))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    cr.move_to(930, 290)
    cr.line_to(930 + 40 * math.cos(-1.2), 290 + 40 * math.sin(-1.2))
    cr.stroke()
    ang = t * 1.6 - math.pi / 2
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((200, 40, 40)))
    cr.set_line_width(4)
    cr.move_to(930, 290)
    cr.line_to(930 + 58 * math.cos(ang), 290 + 58 * math.sin(ang))
    cr.stroke()
    # wood floor
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (128, 94, 64)), (1, (92, 64, 42))], 1260, H)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((70, 48, 30), 0.5))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(12):
        cr.move_to(540, 1260)
        cr.line_to(-700 + i * 230, H)
    cr.stroke()
    # the chalkboard
    contact_shadow(cr, 540, 1262, 1000, a=0.3)
    cr.rectangle(30, 590, 1020, 670)
    solid(cr, P["chalk_frame"])
    cr.rectangle(50, 608, 980, 634)
    solid(cr, P["chalk_board"], rim=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((230, 232, 226), 0.25))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    for i in range(4):
        cr.move_to(940, 660 + i * 70)
        cr.curve_to(960, 650 + i * 70, 990, 680 + i * 70, 1010, 660 + i * 70)
    cr.stroke()
    box(cr, 30, 1262, 1020, 18, P["chalk_frame"], depth=26)
    box(cr, 120, 1250, 60, 12, (240, 238, 230), depth=10)

    # ---- the test, pinned on ----
    cr.rectangle(PX0 + 14, PY0 + 16, PX1 - PX0, PY1 - PY0)
    cr.set_source_rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)
    cr.fill()
    cr.rectangle(PX0, PY0, PX1 - PX0, PY1 - PY0)
    solid(cr, (248, 245, 234))
    for tx in (PX0 + 40, PX1 - 40):
        cr.rectangle(tx - 40, PY0 - 16, 80, 34)
        solid(cr, (232, 224, 180), a=0.85, rim=False)
    text(cr, "MATH TEST", PX0 + 36, PY0 + 70, 44, P["paper_ink"], face="bold", shadow=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["paper_ink"], 0.55))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    cr.move_to(PX0 + 36, PY0 + 92)
    cr.line_to(PX0 + 380, PY0 + 92)
    cr.stroke()
    for i, ry in enumerate(ROWS):
        # each problem: written lines of working and an answer box
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["paper_ink"], 0.8))
        cr.set_line_width(6)
        cr.set_line_cap(cairo.LINE_CAP_ROUND)
        ln = 150 + 70 * ((i * 0.618) % 1.0)
        cr.move_to(PX0 + 40, ry)
        cr.line_to(PX0 + 40 + ln, ry)
        cr.move_to(PX0 + 40, ry + 26)
        cr.line_to(PX0 + 40 + ln * 0.6, ry + 26)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.rectangle(PX0 + 260, ry - 26, 90, 50)
        cr.set_line_width(3)
        cr.stroke()
        # the 2020 tick
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((206, 30, 36), 0.85))
        cr.set_line_width(7)
        cr.move_to(XX - 22, ry - 2)
        cr.line_to(XX - 8, ry + 14)
        cr.line_to(XX + 20, ry - 24)
        cr.stroke()
    # the old grade, its year under it
    text(cr, f"{int(round(v0))}", SX, SY, 100, (206, 30, 36), face="display",
         anchor="center", shadow=False)
    text(cr, l0, SX, SY + 44, 30, P["paper_ink"], face="bold", anchor="center", shadow=False)

    # ---- the red ink, made by the marker ----
    tip_rest = (330, 1080)
    tip = tip_rest
    base_x = 240
    for j, ri in enumerate(XROWS):
        cy = ROWS[ri]
        s1 = s2 = 0.0
        if started and (k > j or done):
            s1 = s2 = 1.0
        elif started and k == j:
            s1 = seg(f, 0.40, 0.65)
            s2 = seg(f, 0.70, 0.95)
        _red(cr, (XX - 34, cy - 34), (XX + 34, cy + 34), s1)
        _red(cr, (XX + 34, cy - 34), (XX - 34, cy + 34), s2)
    cut = 1.0 if done else (seg(f, 0.10, 0.32) if (started and k == 4) else 0.0)
    _red(cr, (SX - 90, SY - 26), (SX + 90, SY - 42), cut, width=14)
    write = 1.0 if done else (seg(f, 0.36, 0.72) if (started and k == 4) else 0.0)
    ring = 1.0 if done else (seg(f, 0.74, 0.97) if (started and k == 4) else 0.0)
    if write > 0:
        cr.save()
        cr.rectangle(NX - 120, NY - 130, 240 * write, 190)
        cr.clip()
        text(cr, f"{int(round(v1))}", NX, NY, 120, (206, 30, 36), face="display",
             anchor="center", shadow=False)
        cr.restore()
    if ring > 0:
        cr.save()
        cr.translate(NX, NY - 42)
        cr.scale(1.0, 0.62)
        cr.arc(0, 0, 140, -math.pi / 2, -math.pi / 2 + 2 * math.pi * ring)
        cr.restore()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((206, 30, 36), 0.95))
        cr.set_line_width(10)
        cr.stroke()
    if done:
        text(cr, l1, NX, NY + 90, 30, P["paper_ink"], face="bold", anchor="center",
             shadow=False, alpha=1.0)

    # where the marker tip is, and where Data stands for it
    if started:
        if k < 4:
            cy = ROWS[XROWS[k]]
            prev = tip_rest if k == 0 else (XX - 34, ROWS[XROWS[k - 1]] + 30)
            prev_x = 330 if k == 0 else XX
            a1_ = (XX - 34, cy - 34)
            if f < 0.40:
                tip = _mk_lerp(prev, a1_, ease(f / 0.40))
            elif f < 0.65:
                tip = _mk_lerp(a1_, (XX + 34, cy + 34), seg(f, 0.40, 0.65))
            elif f < 0.70:
                tip = _mk_lerp((XX + 34, cy + 34), (XX + 34, cy - 34), seg(f, 0.65, 0.70))
            else:
                tip = _mk_lerp((XX + 34, cy - 34), (XX - 34, cy + 34), seg(f, 0.70, 0.95))
            base_x = prev_x + (XX - prev_x) * ease(seg(f, 0.0, 0.40))
        elif not done:
            prev = (XX - 34, ROWS[XROWS[-1]] + 30)
            c0 = (SX - 90, SY - 26)
            if f < 0.10:
                tip = _mk_lerp(prev, c0, ease(f / 0.10))
            elif f < 0.32:
                tip = _mk_lerp(c0, (SX + 90, SY - 42), seg(f, 0.10, 0.32))
            elif f < 0.36:
                tip = _mk_lerp((SX + 90, SY - 42), (NX - 110, NY - 40), seg(f, 0.32, 0.36))
            elif f < 0.72:
                w_ = seg(f, 0.36, 0.72)
                tip = (NX - 110 + 220 * w_, NY - 40 + 34 * math.sin(w_ * math.pi * 6))
            else:
                r_ = seg(f, 0.72, 1.0)
                ang = -math.pi / 2 + 2 * math.pi * clamp(r_ / 0.9)
                tip = (NX + 140 * math.cos(ang), NY - 42 + 87 * math.sin(ang))
            base_x = XX + (NX - XX) * ease(seg(f, 0.0, 0.36))
        else:
            # the grade has landed: he keeps tracing its ring, slowly
            ang = -math.pi / 2 + (u - bounds[-1]) * 6.0 * 2 * math.pi / 1.8
            tip = (NX + 140 * math.cos(ang), NY - 42 + 87 * math.sin(ang))
            base_x = NX

    # ---- right by the camera: a student's desk, a pencil, an eraser ----
    contact_shadow(cr, 860, 1830, 420, a=0.4)
    box(cr, 640, 1830, 420, 60, (176, 132, 84), depth=120)
    cr.rectangle(660, 1830, 22, 90)
    solid(cr, (70, 72, 80), finish="metal", rim=False)
    box(cr, 700, 1752, 150, 10, (232, 188, 60), depth=14)
    box(cr, 900, 1760, 60, 22, (236, 150, 150), depth=30)
    contact_shadow(cr, 150, 1860, 260, a=0.35)
    box(cr, 40, 1860, 220, 40, (60, 92, 150), depth=60)
    vignette(cr, a=0.26)

    # ---- Data ----
    FY, HH = 1440, 320
    walk_in = ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.06))
    hx = clamp(base_x - 170, 140, 640) if started else 100 + (clamp(330 - 170, 140, 640) - 100) * walk_in
    # his hands stay close in on his chest; the long marker does the reaching
    ch = (hx + 6, FY - 0.66 * HH)
    if not started:
        # the marker carried at his side as he walks up
        _marker(cr, (hx + 60, 1430), (hx + 120, 1170))
        host("point", hx, FY, HH)
    else:
        dx, dy = tip[0] - ch[0], tip[1] - ch[1]
        L = max(1.0, math.hypot(dx, dy))
        d = (dx / L, dy / L)
        h1 = (ch[0] + d[0] * 15, ch[1] + d[1] * 15)
        h2 = (ch[0] + d[0] * 65, ch[1] + d[1] * 65)
        _marker(cr, (ch[0] - d[0] * 40, ch[1] - d[1] * 40), tip)
        host("grip", hx, FY, HH, hands=[h1, h2], lower="follow",
             expr="shock" if u > 0.9 else "strain")

    fit_readout(cr, "Still slipping", f"US math scores · {l0} to {l1}", 80, 540,
                a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=110, max_w=900)

stories.title: E-Scooter ER Visits Rose 260% In Two Years
stories.hook: The scooter boom has a body count of broken heads and bones, and it keeps growing.
stories.closing: Fast adoption needs safety habits and streets that catch up just as quickly.
stories.question: Would you wear a helmet?
stories.caption: E-scooter ER visits nearly quadrupled in just two years — and most head injuries happen to riders without a helmet. 👇

_DECKS = [(52, 54, 60), (226, 228, 230), (40, 120, 84), (58, 60, 66), (190, 60, 50)]


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a heap of crashed e-scooters
    SUBSTANCE: wrecked e-scooters
    CAUSE: Data tosses crashed e-scooters onto the heap at the ER door, one throw at a time
    Outside a hospital's emergency entrance (red cross, EMERGENCY sign, an
    ambulance parked with its light flashing), the scooters of every rider
    brought in pile up by the door. The heap's height is that year's ER
    visits: it starts at 2017's size and swells throw by throw to 2019's.
    2017's heap stays as a dashed ghost with its top marked, and 1x/2x/3x
    ticks up the side measure the new heap in the old one — nearly four
    times as much. Done by 0.5 and held; loose scooters keep sliding down
    its flanks and the ambulance light keeps flashing."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    v0 = v0 or 1.0
    ratio = v1 / v0
    n = 6
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.5
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    fly = seg(f, 0.0, 0.35)
    grow = ease(seg(f, 0.3, 0.7))
    step = 0.0 if u < a0 else (k + grow) / n
    val = v0 + (v1 - v0) * step

    CX, BASE = 520, 1440
    H0 = 110.0
    h = H0 * val / v0
    hw = min(440.0, 1.15 * h)
    h0, hw0 = H0, min(440.0, 1.15 * H0)

    landscape(cr, t, "town")
    haze(cr, 700, 1180, (206, 210, 218), a=0.3)

    # the forecourt in front of the ER
    cr.rectangle(0, 1200, W, H - 1200)
    solid(cr, (140, 140, 146), edge=False, rim=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 220, 120), 0.85))
    cr.set_line_width(8)
    for i in range(5):
        cr.move_to(60 + i * 220, 1640)
        cr.line_to(170 + i * 220, 1640)
    cr.stroke()

    # the hospital's emergency entrance, three-quarter
    cast_shadow(cr, 300, 1010, 1200, length=320, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, 655, 1202, 740, a=0.4)
    b = building(cr, 300, 1010, 1200, 400, (230, 226, 218), roof="flat", boards=False)
    for c_ in range(5):
        wx = 340 + c_ * 135
        cr.rectangle(wx, b["top"] + 30, 85, 64)
        solid(cr, (150, 186, 210), finish="glass", rim=False)
    cr.rectangle(420, b["top"] + 118, 560, 84)
    solid(cr, (196, 36, 40))
    text(cr, "EMERGENCY", 700, b["top"] + 180, 62, (250, 248, 244), face="bold",
         anchor="center", shadow=False)
    _er_cross(cr, 360, b["top"] + 160, 52)
    # the glass doors and the canopy over them
    cr.save()
    cr.rectangle(560, 1040, 280, 160)
    cr.clip()
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (200, 216, 222)), (1, (236, 240, 236))], 1040, 1200, 560, 840)
    glow(cr, 700, 1130, 150, (255, 252, 236), 0.5)
    cr.rectangle(570, 1040, 126, 160)
    solid(cr, (176, 206, 222), finish="glass", a=0.7)
    cr.rectangle(704, 1040, 126, 160)
    solid(cr, (176, 206, 222), finish="glass", a=0.7)
    cr.restore()
    box(cr, 520, 1036, 360, 24, (204, 206, 212), depth=60, finish="metal")

    # the ambulance parked in the bay
    _er_ambulance(cr, 30, 1262, 1.0, t)

    # THE HEAP of crashed scooters, by the ER door
    cast_shadow(cr, CX - hw, CX + hw, BASE, length=300, a=0.3)
    contact_shadow(cr, CX, BASE + 4, 2 * hw + 60, a=0.4)
    heap_path(cr, CX, BASE, h, hw)
    solid(cr, (84, 86, 92))
    cr.save()
    heap_path(cr, CX, BASE, h, hw)
    cr.clip()
    count = int(16 + 64 * (val - v0) / max(1.0, v1 - v0) + 0.5)
    for i in range(count):
        dx = ((i * 0.6180339) % 1.0) * 1.9 - 0.95
        py = (i * 0.4142136) % 1.0
        px = CX + hw * dx
        top_y = heap_top(CX, BASE, h, hw, px)
        sy = BASE - (BASE - top_y) * py * 0.9 + 4
        _er_scooter(cr, px, sy, 0.55 + 0.2 * ((i * 0.37) % 1.0), (i * 1.7) % 6.28 - 3.14,
                    _DECKS[i % len(_DECKS)])
    cr.restore()
    heap_path(cr, CX, BASE, h, hw)
    edge(cr, (36, 36, 40))

    # THE SCALE on the heap: 2017's heap as a ghost, its top marked, ticks up the side
    if step > 0.02:
        heap_path(cr, CX, BASE, h0, hw0)
        ghost(cr, a=0.9)
        then_mark(cr, CX - 30, CX + 170, BASE - h0, l0)
        times_ticks(cr, 1010, BASE, h0, max(1, int(ratio)))

    # Data on the heap's left flank, climbing back as it widens
    hx = CX - hw * 0.72
    hy = min(1500.0, heap_top(CX, BASE, h, hw, hx) + 10)

    # the scooter in flight, from his hands to the summit
    if u >= a0 and 0 < fly < 1:
        sx, sy = hx + 40, hy - 190
        ex, ey = CX + 20, BASE - h - 10
        bx = sx + (ex - sx) * fly
        by = sy + (ey - sy) * fly - 240 * math.sin(math.pi * fly)
        _er_scooter(cr, bx, by, 1.0, fly * 5.0, _DECKS[k % len(_DECKS)])

    # once the heap is done the world keeps moving: loose scooters slide down
    if u > a1:
        for j in range(2):
            ph = ((u - a1) / 0.2 + j / 2) % 1.0
            side = 1 if j % 2 else -1
            bx = CX + side * hw * (0.1 + 0.78 * ph)
            by = heap_top(CX, BASE, h, hw, bx) - 6
            _er_scooter(cr, bx, by, 0.95, side * (0.5 + ph * 2.5), _DECKS[(j * 2 + 1) % len(_DECKS)])

    # right by the camera: a crashed scooter and a cracked helmet in the road
    _er_scooter(cr, 860, 1770, 2.3, -0.35, (52, 54, 60))
    cr.save()
    cr.translate(250, 1800)
    cr.arc(0, 0, 70, math.pi, 2 * math.pi)
    cr.close_path()
    cr.restore()
    solid(cr, (60, 170, 110), finish="gloss")
    foreground(cr, "town")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    if u < a0:
        host("point", hx, hy, 220)
    elif u < a1 + 0.04:
        host("toss", hx, hy, 220, beat=k)
    elif u < 0.9:
        host("hold_up", hx, hy, 220)
    else:
        host("shock", hx, hy, 220)

    done = u >= a0 and k == n - 1 and grow >= 0.999
    if done:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v1)):,} ER visits", f"from e-scooter crashes, US · {l1}",
                    80, 520, size=130)
        text(cr, f"{ratio:.1f}x", W - 80, 680, 90, look.INK, face="display",
             anchor="right", alpha=ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.05)))
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(v0)):,} ER visits", f"from e-scooter crashes, US · {l0}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

# scene standard: 2026-10-22
def _sc_helmet(cr, x, y, s, rgb=(236, 236, 230), a=1.0):
    # a bike helmet seen side-on, its rim at y: the vented dome, the visor, the strap
    cr.move_to(x - 40 * s, y)
    cr.curve_to(x - 44 * s, y - 52 * s, x + 32 * s, y - 62 * s, x + 42 * s, y - 6 * s)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, rgb, finish="gloss", a=a)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((36, 38, 46), a))
    cr.set_line_width(max(2.0, 5 * s))
    for k in range(3):
        vx = x - 18 * s + k * 16 * s
        cr.move_to(vx, y - 42 * s)
        cr.line_to(vx + 8 * s, y - 24 * s)
    cr.stroke()
    cr.move_to(x + 36 * s, y - 9 * s)
    cr.line_to(x + 58 * s, y - 2 * s)
    cr.line_to(x + 40 * s, y + 4 * s)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (36, 38, 46), a=a, rim=False)
    cr.rectangle(x - 40 * s, y - 4 * s, 82 * s, 6 * s)
    solid(cr, (36, 38, 46), a=a, rim=False, edge=False)


def _sc_scooter(cr, x, y, s):
    # a rental e-scooter standing at (x, y): wheels, deck, raked stem, bars, lamp
    contact_shadow(cr, x, y, 160 * s, a=0.38)
    sx = x + 30 * s
    cr.move_to(x + 46 * s, y - 22 * s)
    cr.line_to(sx + 5 * s, y - 140 * s)
    cr.line_to(sx - 4 * s, y - 140 * s)
    cr.line_to(x + 36 * s, y - 22 * s)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (70, 74, 84), finish="metal")
    cr.rectangle(x - 62 * s, y - 33 * s, 112 * s, 14 * s)
    solid(cr, (226, 224, 214), finish="gloss")
    cr.rectangle(x - 62 * s, y - 21 * s, 112 * s, 4 * s)
    solid(cr, (46, 150, 110), rim=False)
    disc(cr, x - 50 * s, y - 15 * s, 15 * s, (36, 36, 40), finish="gloss")
    disc(cr, x + 48 * s, y - 15 * s, 15 * s, (36, 36, 40), finish="gloss")
    cr.rectangle(sx - 25 * s, y - 147 * s, 50 * s, 8 * s)
    solid(cr, (40, 42, 48), rim=False)
    disc(cr, sx + 4 * s, y - 118 * s, 6 * s, (255, 236, 180), finish="gloss")
    return (sx + 22 * s, y - 143 * s)


def _sc_at(row, z):
    z = clamp(z, 0, len(row) - 1.001)
    i = int(z)
    f = z - i
    (x0, y0, s0), (x1, y1, s1) = row[i], row[i + 1]
    return x0 + (x1 - x0) * f, y0 + (y1 - y0) * f, s0 + (s1 - s0) * f


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a row of parked e-scooters
    SUBSTANCE: bike helmets
    CAUSE: Data places a helmet on the handlebars of one scooter after another, but only a third of them get one
    A long line of rental e-scooters parked along a city sidewalk, from
    right by the camera back up the street: the WHOLE is the riders. Data
    takes helmets out of a crate and hangs one on each scooter's bars, one
    place per helmet, until the helmets run out at the true share; every
    scooter after that stands bare. The painted parking bay under the row is
    cut at the same point, the NO HELMET part in the accent. Done by 0.56
    and held: two thirds of the row stand bare while traffic passes behind."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    tot = sum(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    no = next((r for r in rows if r[0].lower().startswith("no")),
              max(rows, key=lambda r: r[1]))
    share = clamp(no[1] / tot)
    N = 9
    n = int(clamp(round((1 - share) * N), 1, N - 1))   # scooters that get a helmet
    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.56
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)

    row = []
    x, y, s = 110.0, 1480.0, 2.2
    for j in range(N + 1):
        row.append((x, y, s))
        x += 62 * s
        y -= 30 * s
        s *= 0.89

    def land(i):
        if u < a0 or i > k:
            return 0.0
        if i < k:
            return 1.0
        return ease(seg(f, 0.25, 0.6))

    def hang(i):
        x_, y_, s_ = row[i]
        return x_ + 52 * s_, y_ - 66 * s_, s_

    def spot(i):
        x_, y_, s_ = row[i]
        return x_ + 72 * s_, y_ + 12, clamp(100 * s_, 180, 240)

    COLS = [(232, 96, 48), (240, 196, 60), (236, 236, 230)]
    helmets_on = sum(land(i) for i in range(n))
    landed_share = u >= a0 and k == n - 1 and land(n - 1) >= 0.999

    # the street: town behind, a road with traffic, the sidewalk
    landscape(cr, t, "town", horizon=1010)
    haze(cr, 500, 1010, (206, 206, 212), a=0.3)
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (78, 80, 88)), (1, (62, 64, 70))], 1010, 1095)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 230, 200), 0.8))
    cr.set_line_width(5)
    for i in range(9):
        cr.move_to(i * 140 - (t * 0) % 140, 1054)
        cr.line_to(i * 140 + 70, 1054)
    cr.stroke()
    tx = -500 + (t * 170) % 2100
    truck(cr, tx, 1086, 1.1)
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (188, 184, 176)), (1, (150, 146, 140))], 1090, H)
    cr.rectangle(0, 1088, W, 10)
    solid(cr, (204, 200, 192), rim=False)
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((120, 116, 110), 0.5))
    cr.set_line_width(3)
    for i in range(8):
        cr.move_to(-200 + i * 220, H)
        cr.line_to(700 + i * 70, 1100)
    cr.stroke()

    # the painted parking bay under the whole row, cut at the share
    def bay(z0, z1, rgb):
        if z1 - z0 < 0.01:
            return
        top, bot = [], []
        for i in range(13):
            bx, by, bs = _sc_at(row, z0 + (z1 - z0) * i / 12)
            top.append((bx - 70 * bs, by - 8 * bs))
            bot.append((bx - 70 * bs, by + 24 * bs))
        cr.move_to(*top[0])
        for p_ in top[1:]:
            cr.line_to(*p_)
        for p_ in reversed(bot):
            cr.line_to(*p_)
        cr.close_path()
        solid(cr, rgb, rim=False)
    cut = N * (1 - share) * helmets_on / n
    bay(0, cut, (214, 214, 218))
    bay(cut, N, P["accent2"])
    if landed_share:
        bx, by, bs = _sc_at(row, 5.2)
        text(cr, "NO HELMET", bx - 60 * bs, by + 16 * bs, 24, look.INK,
             face="bold", shadow=False)

    # the scooters, far first; the helmeted ones carry theirs on the bars
    cast_shadow(cr, 40, 920, 1480, length=200, a=0.18)
    for i in reversed(range(N)):
        x_, y_, s_ = row[i]
        gx, gy = _sc_scooter(cr, x_, y_, s_)
        if i < n and land(i) >= 0.999:
            hx, hy, hs = hang(i)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((36, 38, 46)))
            cr.set_line_width(max(2.0, 4 * hs))
            cr.move_to(hx - 24 * hs, hy)
            cr.line_to(gx, gy)
            cr.line_to(hx + 22 * hs, hy)
            cr.stroke()
            _sc_helmet(cr, hx, hy, hs, COLS[i % 3])

    # right by the camera: the crate the helmets come out of
    contact_shadow(cr, 790, 1890, 340, a=0.4)
    box(cr, 640, 1890, 300, 110, (156, 112, 70), depth=60)
    left = [i for i in range(n) if u < a0 or i > k]
    for j, i in enumerate(left):
        _sc_helmet(cr, 710 + j * 100, 1784, 1.45, COLS[i % 3])
    foreground(cr, "town")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data walks down the row, one helmet per scooter
    sx0, sy0, sh0 = spot(0)
    if u < a0:
        hx, hy, hh = sx0, sy0, sh0
        host("point", hx, hy, hh)
    elif u < a1 + 0.04:
        px, py, ph = spot(k - 1) if k > 0 else spot(0)
        nx, ny, nh = spot(k)
        w = ease(seg(f, 0.0, 0.25))
        hx, hy, hh = px + (nx - px) * w, py + (ny - py) * w, ph + (nh - ph) * w
        host("place", hx, hy, hh, beat=k)
    else:
        hx, hy, hh = spot(n - 1)
        host("hold_up", hx, hy, hh)

    # the helmet in his hands, then onto the bars
    if a0 <= u < a1 + 0.04:
        l = land(k)
        if l < 0.999:
            ax, ay = hx - 10, hy - 0.62 * hh
            ex, ey, es = hang(k)
            bx = ax + (ex - ax) * l
            by = ay + (ey - ay) * l - 70 * math.sin(math.pi * l)
            _sc_helmet(cr, bx, by, 0.9 + (es - 0.9) * l, COLS[k % 3])

    if landed_share:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(no[1]))}%",
                    "of young riders with head injuries had no helmet",
                    80, 520, size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "Head injuries", "the most common e-scooter injury",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)

# scene standard: 2026-10-22

def _seedling(cr, px, py):
    cr.move_to(px - 4, py)
    cr.line_to(px - 3, py - 90)
    cr.line_to(px + 3, py - 90)
    cr.line_to(px + 4, py)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (96, 120, 60))
    disc(cr, px - 16, py - 96, 18, P["leaf"])
    disc(cr, px + 16, py - 100, 18, P["leaf_shade"])


def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a green mangrove forest on stilt roots
    SUBSTANCE: the green mangrove trees
    CAUSE: Data chops the mangrove trees down with an axe, each one falling on the strike
    One dense wall of mangroves on the shore is the whole of the world's
    mangroves in 1980. The share lost by 2005 is a fifth of that same wall,
    cut at its true width: Data chops those trees with an axe and each one
    TOPPLES across the sky on the strike and lies on the mud, leaving a wide
    gap of open sky and bare stumps in the canopy. The old canopy stays as
    a dashed ghost over the gap, and the hectares lost are written inside
    that gap, clear of the readout above, so the lost fifth reads at a
    glance. Done by 0.56 and held; the tide keeps rolling in and he keeps
    chopping."""
    rows = by_time([(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts])
    (l0, v0), (l1, v1) = rows[0], rows[-1]
    v0 = v0 or 1.0
    share = clamp((v0 - v1) / v0)

    N = 10
    X0, X1 = 70, 880
    BASE = 1350
    xs = [X0 + i * (X1 - X0) / (N - 1) for i in range(N)]
    sc = [1.62 + 0.16 * ((i * 0.618) % 1.0) for i in range(N)]
    nl = max(1, int(round(N * share)))
    lost = list(range(N - 1, N - 1 - nl, -1))      # rightmost first
    first_lost = lost[-1]
    x_cut = (xs[first_lost] + xs[first_lost - 1]) / 2 if first_lost > 0 else X0 - 60

    a0, a1 = 0.08, 0.56
    span = (a1 - a0) / nl
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, nl - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    fall = seg(f, 0.3, 0.8) ** 2                   # it FALLS, on the strike
    done = u >= a1

    # the setting: a low sun over open coastal water — no far forest, so the
    # gap cut in the canopy opens onto bright sky
    landscape(cr, t, "coast")
    haze(cr, 900, 1220, (214, 222, 228), a=0.4)
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (58, 104, 116)), (1, (34, 70, 84))], 1215, 1590)
    # the mud bank the forest stands on
    cr.move_to(0, 1304)
    cr.curve_to(300, 1290, 700, 1294, W, 1304)
    cr.line_to(W, 1372)
    cr.curve_to(700, 1382, 300, 1378, 0, 1372)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (104, 86, 64), edge=False)

    cast_shadow(cr, X0 - 60, X1 + 60, BASE, length=260, a=0.28)
    contact_shadow(cr, (X0 + X1) / 2, BASE + 4, X1 - X0 + 180, a=0.35)

    # the forest that stays
    for i in range(N):
        if i not in lost:
            _mangrove(cr, xs[i], BASE, sc[i])
    # the lost share: felled one by one, each crown sweeping down to the mud
    for j, i in enumerate(lost):
        if u < a0 or j > k:
            lean = 0.0
        elif j < k:
            lean = 1.0
        else:
            lean = fall
        if lean > 0:
            stump(cr, xs[i], BASE, 1.0)
        _mangrove(cr, xs[i] + 10 * lean, BASE + 8 * lean, sc[i], lean)

    # THE SCALE: the lost canopy as a ghost where it stood
    gx1 = min(X1 + 110, W - 40)
    if done:
        top = BASE - 440 * sc[lost[0]]
        cr.move_to(x_cut, BASE - 100)
        cr.line_to(x_cut, top + 90)
        cr.curve_to(x_cut + 40, top - 20, gx1 - 50, top - 20, gx1, top + 90)
        cr.line_to(gx1, BASE - 100)
        ghost(cr, a=0.85 * ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.06)))

    # the tide rolling in toward the camera
    for j in range(4):
        wy = 1392 + ((t * 150 + j * 48) % 192)
        cr.move_to(0, wy)
        for x in range(0, W + 60, 60):
            cr.line_to(x, wy + 8 * math.sin(x * 0.02 + t * 1.5 + j))
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((226, 240, 240), 0.75))
        cr.set_line_width(14)
        cr.stroke()

    # right by the camera: the muddy shore and young mangroves
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (120, 100, 76)), (1, (82, 66, 50))], 1590, H)
    for i in range(5):
        _seedling(cr, 110 + i * 210, 1740 + (i % 2) * 90)
    foreground(cr, "coast")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    # Data walks in from the water's edge and fells each tree with the axe
    spot = [xs[i] - 90 for i in lost]
    if u < a0:
        host("point", 990, BASE, 220)
    elif not done:
        prev = spot[k - 1] if k > 0 else 990
        hx = prev + (spot[k] - prev) * ease(seg(f, 0.0, 0.25))
        host("chop", hx, BASE, 220, beat=k)
    else:
        # the gap is cut: he keeps working the last stump
        host("chop", spot[-1], BASE, 220, beat=nl + int((u - a1) / 0.14))

    if done:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{v1:.1f}M hectares", f"of mangrove forest left · {l1}",
                    80, 520, size=130)
        # the loss, written in the open sky of the gap itself
        gap_cx = clamp((x_cut + gx1) / 2, 200, W - 200)
        text(cr, f"-{v0 - v1:.1f}M", gap_cx, 930, 90, look.INK, face="display",
             anchor="center", alpha=ease(seg(u, a1, a1 + 0.05)))
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{v0:.1f}M hectares", f"of mangrove forest · {l0}",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)
